	end
end)

-- Never hold the complete interface behind an infinite character wait. Features
-- can ask for a short wait when pressed, while the menu itself opens instantly.
local function loadCharacter(timeoutSeconds)
	timeoutSeconds = math.max(tonumber(timeoutSeconds) or 6,0)
	local deadline = os.clock() + timeoutSeconds

	repeat
		character = player.Character
		humanoid =
			character
			and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
			or nil
		root =
			character
			and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
			or nil

		if character and humanoid and root then
			return true
		end

		if os.clock() >= deadline then
			return false
		end

		task.wait(.05)
	until false
end
runtimeCore.startupBeganAt = os.clock()
loadCharacter(0)

local function readableTextOn(color)
	local function linearChannel(channel)
		if channel <= .04045 then
			return channel/12.92
		end
		return ((channel+.055)/1.055)^2.4
	end

	local luminance =
		.2126*linearChannel(color.R)
		+.7152*linearChannel(color.G)
		+.0722*linearChannel(color.B)

	return luminance > .19 and ACTIVE_TEXT or TEXT
end

runtimeCore.allows = function(moduleName)
	moduleName = string.upper(tostring(moduleName or "UNIVERSAL"))
	if gui:GetAttribute("SafeMode") == true then
		return moduleName == "UNIVERSAL"
	end
	local profile =
		string.upper(tostring(gui:GetAttribute("RuntimeProfile") or "UNIVERSAL"))
	if moduleName == "UNIVERSAL" or profile == "ALL" then
		return true
	end
	return profile == moduleName
end

local function clampGuiObjectToViewport(object,margin)
	if not object or not object.Parent then
		return
	end

	margin = tonumber(margin) or 4
	camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
	local viewport =
		camera and camera.ViewportSize or Vector2.new(1000,700)
	local size = object.AbsoluteSize
	local position = object.AbsolutePosition
	local maxX = math.max(margin,viewport.X-size.X-margin)
	local maxY = math.max(margin,viewport.Y-size.Y-margin)
	local clampedX = math.clamp(position.X,margin,maxX)
	local clampedY = math.clamp(position.Y,margin,maxY)
	if math.abs(clampedX-position.X) > .5
		or math.abs(clampedY-position.Y) > .5 then
		object.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(clampedX,clampedY)
	end
end

gui:SetAttribute("PanelScale",1)
local function setPanelScale(value,animate)
	value = math.clamp(tonumber(value) or 1,.8,1.3)
	camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
	local viewport =
		camera and camera.ViewportSize or Vector2.new(1000,700)
	local baseWidth = math.max(1,panel.Size.X.Offset)
	local baseHeight = math.max(1,panel.Size.Y.Offset)
	local maximumFitScale = math.max(
		.8,
		math.min(
			1.3,
			(viewport.X-8)/baseWidth,
			(viewport.Y-8)/baseHeight
		)
	)
	value = math.min(value,maximumFitScale)
	gui:SetAttribute("PanelScale",value)
	local scale = panel:FindFirstChild("SmoothScale")
	if not scale then
		return value
	end

	if animate ~= false
		and gui:GetAttribute("ReduceMotion") ~= true then
		TweenService:Create(
			scale,
			TweenInfo.new(.18,Enum.EasingStyle.Back,Enum.EasingDirection.Out),
			{Scale = value}
		):Play()
	else
		scale.Scale = value
	end
	task.delay(animate == false and 0 or .2,function()
		if not menuDeleted
			and not panel:GetAttribute("MenuTransitionBusy") then
			clampGuiObjectToViewport(panel,4)
		end
	end)
	return value
end

local function corner(object,radius)
	local c = Instance.new("UICorner")
	c.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0,radius or 10)
	c.Parent = object
	return c
end
local function addStroke(object,color,thickness,transparency)
	local s = Instance.new("UIStroke")
	local outlineColor = gui:GetAttribute("OutlineColor") or accent
	local selectedColor = color or outlineColor
	s.Color = selectedColor
	s.Thickness = thickness or 1
	s.Transparency = transparency or 0
	s:SetAttribute(
		"NotRubyFixedColor",
		selectedColor ~= accent and selectedColor ~= outlineColor
	)
	s.Parent = object
	return s
end

local function setStatus(text)
	if not status or not status.Parent then
		return
	end
	status.Text = text
	status.TextColor3 = accent
	status.TextTransparency = .36
	status.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(72,33)
	TweenService:Create(
		status,
		TweenInfo.new(.16,Enum.EasingStyle.Quint,Enum.EasingDirection.Out),
		{
			TextTransparency = 0,
			Position = UDim2.fromOffset(65,33)
		}
	):Play()

	local notifyEvent = gui:FindFirstChild("NotRubyNotifyEvent")
	if notifyEvent and notifyEvent:IsA("BindableEvent") then
		notifyEvent:Fire(tostring(text))
	end
end

local startupIssues = {}
local function safeSetup(name,callback)
	local ok,result = pcall(callback)
	if ok then
		return true,result
	end

	local message = tostring(name)..": "..tostring(result)
	table.insert(startupIssues,message)
	gui:SetAttribute("StartupIssueCount",#startupIssues)
	warn("[NOT RUBY] "..message)
	task.defer(function()
		if gui and gui.Parent and not menuDeleted then
			setStatus(string.upper(tostring(name)).." // SETUP FAILED")
		end
	end)
	return false,result
end

local function makeTab(name,text)
	local button = Instance.new("TextButton")
	button.Name = name.."Tab"
	button.Size = UDim2.new(1,0,0,44)
	button.Text = ""
	button.TextSize = 1
	button.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBlack
	button.TextColor3 = TEXT
	button.BackgroundColor3 = SURFACE

	corner(button,12)
	addStroke(button,accent,.7,.9)

	local icon = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	icon.Name = "TabIcon"
	icon.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	icon.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(8,0)
	icon.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(24,44)
	icon.Text = tabIcons[name] or "•"
	icon.TextSize = 14
	icon.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBlack
	icon.TextColor3 = accent
	icon.Parent = button

	local label = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	label.Name = "TabLabel"
	label.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	label.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(34,0)
	label.Size = UDim2.new(1,-40,1,0)
	label.Text = text
	label.TextSize = 9
	label.TextWrapped = true
	label.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBlack
	label.TextColor3 = TEXT
	label.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
	label.Parent = button

	local selectedIndicator = Instance.new("Frame")
	selectedIndicator.Name = "SelectedIndicator"
	selectedIndicator.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0,.5)
	selectedIndicator.Position = UDim2.new(0,4,.5,0)
	selectedIndicator.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(3,0)
	selectedIndicator.BackgroundColor3 = accent
	selectedIndicator.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	selectedIndicator.BorderSizePixel = 0
	selectedIndicator.ZIndex = button.ZIndex + 1
	selectedIndicator.Parent = button
	corner(selectedIndicator,1000)

	local scale = Instance.new("UIScale")
	scale.Scale = 1
	scale.Parent = button

	button.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
		if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch
			or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
			TweenService:Create(
				scale,
				TweenInfo.new(.08,Enum.EasingStyle.Quad,Enum.EasingDirection.Out),
				{Scale = .96}
			):Play()
		end
	end)

	button.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
		if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch
			or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
			TweenService:Create(
				scale,
				TweenInfo.new(.12,Enum.EasingStyle.Quint,Enum.EasingDirection.Out),
				{Scale = 1}
			):Play()
		end
	end)

	tabButtons[name] = button
	return button
end
local function applyTabVisuals()
	do
		local line = header:FindFirstChild("AnimatedAccentLine")
		local glow = header:FindFirstChild("AnimatedAccentGlow")
		if line then
			line.BackgroundColor3 = accent
		end
		if glow then
			glow.BackgroundColor3 = accent
		end
	end

	for name,button in pairs(tabButtons) do
		local selected = name == currentTab
		local selectedTextColor = readableTextOn(accent)
		local indicator = button:FindFirstChild("SelectedIndicator")
		local icon = button:FindFirstChild("TabIcon")
		local label = button:FindFirstChild("TabLabel")
		if indicator then
			indicator.BackgroundColor3 = accent
			TweenService:Create(
				indicator,
				TweenInfo.new(.18,Enum.EasingStyle.Back,Enum.EasingDirection.Out),
				{
					Size = selected and UDim2.fromOffset(3,24) or UDim2.fromOffset(3,0),
					BackgroundTransparency = selected and 0 or 1
				}
			):Play()
		end
		TweenService:Create(
			button,
			TweenInfo.new(.14,Enum.EasingStyle.Quint,Enum.EasingDirection.Out),
			{
				BackgroundColor3 = selected and accent or SURFACE,
				TextColor3 = selected and selectedTextColor or TEXT
			}
		):Play()
		if icon and icon:IsA("TextLabel") then
			icon.TextColor3 = selected and selectedTextColor or accent
		end
		if label and label:IsA("TextLabel") then
			label.TextColor3 = selected and selectedTextColor or TEXT
		end
	end

	for name,page in pairs(pages) do
		page.ScrollBarImageColor3 = accent

		if name == currentTab then
			page.Visible = true
			page.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(10,0)
			page.ScrollBarImageTransparency = .55

			TweenService:Create(
				page,
				TweenInfo.new(.18,Enum.EasingStyle.Quint,Enum.EasingDirection.Out),
				{
					Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0,0),
					ScrollBarImageTransparency = 0
				}
			):Play()
		else
			page.Visible = false
		end
	end
end
local function setTab(name)
	if not pages[name] then
		return
	end
	currentTab = name
	if gui:GetAttribute("SafeMode") ~= true then
		if name == "DOORS" then
			gui:SetAttribute("RuntimeProfile","DOORS")
		elseif name == "LOCUST" then
			gui:SetAttribute("RuntimeProfile","LOCUST")
		elseif name == "SHOOTER" or name == "CHEATS" then
			gui:SetAttribute("RuntimeProfile","SHOOTER")
		end
	end
	applyTabVisuals()
	local displayName = name
	if name == "LOCUST" then
		displayName = "HOUSE OF THE LOCUST"
	elseif name == "HOME" then
		displayName = "UNIVERSAL"
	elseif name == "CREATOR" then
		displayName = "CREATOR"
	elseif name == "DASHBOARD" then
		displayName = "DASHBOARD"
	elseif name == "EXPLOITER" then
		displayName = "EXPLOITER DETECTOR"
	elseif name == "TROLL" then
		displayName = "TROLL"
	elseif name == "NAV" then
		displayName = "NAVIGATOR"
	elseif name == "ACCESS" then
		displayName = "ACCESSIBILITY"
	elseif name == "SYSTEM" then
		displayName = "SYSTEM LAB"
	end
	setStatus(displayName)
end

local function makePair(page,leftText,rightText)

	left.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
	left.TextColor3 = TEXT
	left.BackgroundColor3 = SURFACE_2
	left.BorderSizePixel = 0
	left.AutoButtonColor = false
	left.Parent = row
	corner(left,11)
	addStroke(left,accent,.8,.84)
	local right = Instance.new("TextButton")
	right.Size = UDim2.new(.5,-4,1,0)
	right.Position = UDim2.new(.5,4,0,0)
	right.Text = rightText
	right.TextSize = 10
	right.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
	right.TextColor3 = TEXT
	right.BackgroundColor3 = SURFACE_2
	right.BorderSizePixel = 0
	right.AutoButtonColor = false
	right.Parent = row
	corner(right,11)
	addStroke(right,accent,.8,.84)

	for _,button in ipairs({left,right}) do
		local scale = Instance.new("UIScale")
		scale.Parent = button

		button.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
			if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch
				or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
				TweenService:Create(
					scale,
					TweenInfo.new(.07,Enum.EasingStyle.Quad,Enum.EasingDirection.Out),
					{Scale = .97}
				):Play()
			end
		end)

		button.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
			if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch
				or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
				TweenService:Create(
					scale,
					TweenInfo.new(.12,Enum.EasingStyle.Quint,Enum.EasingDirection.Out),
					{Scale = 1}
				):Play()
			end
		end)
	end

	return left,right
end

			boxStroke,
			TweenInfo.new(.16),
			{Transparency = 1}
		):Play()
	end)

	return box,apply
end

local function showPlayerPicker(titleText,onSelected,includeSelf)
	local oldPicker = gui:FindFirstChild("NotRubyPlayerPicker")
	if oldPicker then
		oldPicker:Destroy()
	end

	local overlay = Instance.new("Frame")
	overlay.Name = "NotRubyPlayerPicker"
	overlay.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1,1)
	overlay.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0,0,0)
	overlay.BackgroundTransparency = .28
	overlay.BorderSizePixel = 0
	overlay.Active = true
	overlay.ZIndex = 950
	overlay.Parent = gui

	local card = Instance.new("Frame")
	card.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(.5,.5)
	card.Position = UDim2.fromScale(.5,.5)
	card.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(410,390)
	card.BackgroundColor3 = BG
	card.BorderSizePixel = 0
	card.ZIndex = 951
	card.Parent = overlay
	corner(card,18)
	addStroke(card,accent,1.8,.02)

	local cardScale = Instance.new("UIScale")
	cardScale.Scale = .9
	cardScale.Parent = card
	TweenService:Create(
		cardScale,
		TweenInfo.new(.18,Enum.EasingStyle.Back,Enum.EasingDirection.Out),
		{Scale = 1}
	):Play()

	local pickerTitle = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	pickerTitle.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	pickerTitle.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(16,12)
	pickerTitle.Size = UDim2.new(1,-64,0,30)
	pickerTitle.Text = titleText or "SELECT PLAYER"
	pickerTitle.TextSize = 14
	pickerTitle.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBlack
	pickerTitle.TextColor3 = TEXT
	pickerTitle.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
	pickerTitle.ZIndex = 952
	pickerTitle.Parent = card

	local closePicker = Instance.new("TextButton")
	closePicker.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(34,34)
	closePicker.Position = UDim2.new(1,-46,0,10)
	closePicker.Text = "X"
	closePicker.TextSize = 13
	closePicker.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBlack
	closePicker.TextColor3 = TEXT
	closePicker.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(92,32,43)
	closePicker.AutoButtonColor = false
	closePicker.ZIndex = 952
	closePicker.Parent = card
	corner(closePicker,9)

	local search = Instance.new("TextBox")
	search.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(14,52)
	search.Size = UDim2.new(1,-28,0,38)
	search.PlaceholderText = "Search username or display name"
	search.Text = ""
	search.ClearTextOnFocus = false
	search.TextSize = 10
	search.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
	search.TextColor3 = TEXT
	search.PlaceholderColor3 = MUTED
	search.BackgroundColor3 = SURFACE_2
	search.BorderSizePixel = 0
	search.ZIndex = 952
	search.Parent = card
	corner(search,10)

	local list = Instance.new("ScrollingFrame")
	list.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(14,100)
	list.Size = UDim2.new(1,-28,1,-114)
	list.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	list.BorderSizePixel = 0
	list.ScrollBarThickness = 3
	list.ScrollBarImageColor3 = accent
	list.AutomaticCanvasSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y
	list.CanvasSize = UDim2.new()
	list.ZIndex = 952
	list.Parent = card

	local listLayout = Instance.new("UIListLayout")
	listLayout.Padding = UDim.new(0,7)
	listLayout.Parent = list

	local rows = {}

	local function close()
		if overlay and overlay.Parent then
			overlay:Destroy()
		end
	end

	local function addPlayerRow(otherPlayer)
		if otherPlayer == player and not includeSelf then
			return
		end

		local row = Instance.new("TextButton")
		row.Name = "Player_"..tostring(otherPlayer.UserId)
		row.Size = UDim2.new(1,-4,0,62)
		row.Text = ""
		row.BackgroundColor3 = SURFACE
		row.BorderSizePixel = 0
		row.AutoButtonColor = false
		row.ZIndex = 953
		row.Parent = list
		corner(row,11)

		local rowScale = Instance.new("UIScale")
		rowScale.Parent = row

		local avatar = Instance.new("ImageLabel")
		avatar.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(46,46)
		avatar.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(8,8)
		avatar.BackgroundColor3 = SURFACE_2
		avatar.BorderSizePixel = 0
		avatar.ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Crop
		avatar.ZIndex = 954
		avatar.Parent = row
		corner(avatar,23)
		addStroke(avatar,accent,1.2,.12)

		local displayName = Instance.new("TextLabel")
		displayName.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		displayName.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(64,9)
		displayName.Size = UDim2.new(1,-76,0,20)
		displayName.Text = otherPlayer.DisplayName
		displayName.TextSize = 11
		displayName.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBlack
		displayName.TextColor3 = TEXT
		displayName.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
		displayName.ZIndex = 954
		displayName.Parent = row

		local username = Instance.new("TextLabel")
		username.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		username.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(64,30)
		username.Size = UDim2.new(1,-76,0,18)
		username.Text = "@"..otherPlayer.Name.."  •  "..tostring(otherPlayer.UserId)
		username.TextSize = 9
		username.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
		username.TextColor3 = MUTED
		username.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
		username.ZIndex = 954
		username.Parent = row

		rows[row] = {
			searchText = string.lower(otherPlayer.Name.." "..otherPlayer.DisplayName)
		}

		row.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
			if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch
				or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
				TweenService:Create(
					rowScale,
					TweenInfo.new(.07),
					{Scale = .97}
				):Play()
			end
		end)

		row.InputEnded:Connect(function()
			TweenService:Create(
				rowScale,
				TweenInfo.new(.12,Enum.EasingStyle.Quint,Enum.EasingDirection.Out),
				{Scale = 1}
			):Play()
		end)

		row.Activated:Connect(function()
			close()
			if onSelected then
				onSelected(otherPlayer)
			end
		end)

		task.spawn(function()
			local ok,image = pcall(function()
				return Players:GetUserThumbnailAsync(
					otherPlayer.UserId,
					Enum.ThumbnailType.HeadShot,
					Enum.ThumbnailSize.Size150x150
				)
			end)
			if ok and image and avatar.Parent then
				avatar.Image = image
			end
		end)
	end

	for _,otherPlayer in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
		addPlayerRow(otherPlayer)
	end

	search:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Text"):Connect(function()
		local query = string.lower(search.Text)
		for row,data in pairs(rows) do
			if row and row.Parent then
				row.Visible =
					query == ""
					or string.find(data.searchText,query,1,true) ~= nil
			end
		end
	end)

	closePicker.Activated:Connect(close)
end

local function setupCreatorTab()
	local creatorTab = makeTab("CREATOR","CREATOR")
	local creatorPage = makePage("CREATOR")
	local creatorUsername = "werdx33xxxr5"
	local creatorDisplayName = "not ruby"
	local creatorUserId = 5717888103
	local creatorThumbnail =
		"rbxthumb://type=AvatarHeadShot&id="
		..tostring(creatorUserId)
		.."&w=420&h=420"
	local creatorPassword = "Not ruby v4 the best"
	local creatorUnlockFile =
		"not_ruby_v4_creator_unlock_"..tostring(player.UserId)..".txt"
	local unlocked = false
	local cornerClicks = 0
	local lastCornerClick = 0
	local function hasRememberedCreatorAccess()
		if type(isfile) ~= "function"
			or type(readfile) ~= "function" then
			return false
		end
		local ok,result = pcall(function()
			if not isfile(creatorUnlockFile) then
				return false
			end
			return tostring(readfile(creatorUnlockFile))
				== tostring(player.UserId)
		end)
		return ok and result == true
	end
	local function rememberCreatorAccess()
		if type(writefile) ~= "function" then
			return false
		end
		local ok = pcall(function()
			writefile(
				creatorUnlockFile,
				tostring(player.UserId)
			)
		end)
		return ok
	end
	makeSection(
		creatorPage,
		"CREATOR",
		"Creator identity hidden."
	)
	local card = Instance.new("Frame")
	card.Size = UDim2.new(1,0,0,255)
	card.BackgroundColor3 = SURFACE
	card.BorderSizePixel = 0
	card.Parent = creatorPage

	)

	logo.ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Crop
	logo.Parent = card
	corner(logo,52)
	addStroke(
		logo,
		gui:GetAttribute("OutlineColor") or accent,
		1.5,
		.05
	)
	local hiddenMark = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	hiddenMark.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	hiddenMark.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1,1)

	hiddenMark.TextSize = 42

	hiddenMark.TextColor3 = accent
	hiddenMark.Parent = logo
	local display = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	display.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	display.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(14,132)
	display.Size = UDim2.new(1,-28,0,27)
	display.Text = "HIDDEN"

	local username = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	username.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	username.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(14,161)
	username.Size = UDim2.new(1,-28,0,21)

	username.TextSize = 10

	username.TextColor3 = accent
	username.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center
	username.Parent = card

	userIdLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1

	local accessLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")

	local function showCreator()
		unlocked = true

	local function openPasswordPrompt()
		if unlocked then
			return

		overlay.Name = "CreatorPasswordPrompt"

		overlay.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0,0,0)

		title.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center
		title.ZIndex = 902
		title.Parent = prompt

		info.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		info.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(16,42)
		info.Size = UDim2.new(1,-32,0,24)
		info.Text = "ENTER PASSWORD"
		info.TextSize = 9
		info.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
		info.TextColor3 = MUTED
		info.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center
		info.ZIndex = 902
		info.Parent = prompt
		local passwordBox = Instance.new("TextBox")
		passwordBox.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(18,74)

		passwordBox.Text = ""
		passwordBox.PlaceholderText = "Password"
		passwordBox.ClearTextOnFocus = false
		passwordBox.TextSize = 11
		passwordBox.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold

		passwordBox.PlaceholderColor3 = MUTED
		passwordBox.BackgroundColor3 = SURFACE_2
		passwordBox.BorderSizePixel = 0
		passwordBox.ZIndex = 902
		passwordBox.Parent = prompt
		corner(passwordBox,10)
		addStroke(
			passwordBox,
			gui:GetAttribute("OutlineColor") or accent,
			1.1,
			.08
		)
		local submit = Instance.new("TextButton")
		submit.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(18,127)
		submit.Size = UDim2.new(.5,-23,0,42)
		submit.Text = "UNLOCK"
		submit.TextSize = 10
		submit.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBlack
		submit.TextColor3 = readableTextOn(accent)
		submit.BackgroundColor3 = accent
		submit.BorderSizePixel = 0
		submit.AutoButtonColor = false
		submit.ZIndex = 902
		submit.Parent = prompt
		corner(submit,10)
		local cancel = Instance.new("TextButton")
		cancel.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1,0)
		cancel.Position = UDim2.new(1,-18,0,127)
		cancel.Size = UDim2.new(.5,-23,0,42)
		cancel.Text = "CANCEL"
		cancel.TextSize = 10
		cancel.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBlack
		cancel.TextColor3 = TEXT
		cancel.BackgroundColor3 = SURFACE_2
		cancel.BorderSizePixel = 0
		cancel.AutoButtonColor = false
		cancel.ZIndex = 902
		cancel.Parent = prompt
		corner(cancel,10)
		local message = Instance.new("TextLabel")
		message.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		message.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(16,174)
		message.Size = UDim2.new(1,-32,0,18)
		message.Text = ""
		message.TextSize = 8
		message.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
		message.TextColor3 = accent
		message.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center
		message.ZIndex = 902
		message.Parent = prompt
		local function tryPassword()
			if passwordBox.Text == creatorPassword then
				message.Text = "ACCESS GRANTED"
				rememberCreatorAccess()
				task.wait(.18)
				if overlay and overlay.Parent then
					overlay:Destroy()
				end
				showCreator()
				accessLabel.Text = "ACCESS REMEMBERED // WELCOME BACK NEXT TIME"
				setStatus("CREATOR ACCESS GRANTED + REMEMBERED")
			else
				message.Text = "INCORRECT PASSWORD"
				passwordBox.Text = ""
			end
		end
		submit.Activated:Connect(tryPassword)
		passwordBox.FocusLost:Connect(function(enterPressed)
			if enterPressed then
				tryPassword()
			end
		end)
		cancel.Activated:Connect(function()
			if overlay and overlay.Parent then
				overlay:Destroy()
			end
		end)
		task.defer(function()
			passwordBox:CaptureFocus()
		end)
	end

			return
		end
		local now = os.clock()
		-- If the user waits too long, restart the hidden 5-click sequence.
		if now - lastCornerClick > 5 then
			cornerClicks = 0
		end
		lastCornerClick = now
		cornerClicks += 1
		if cornerClicks >= 5 then
			cornerClicks = 0
			openPasswordPrompt()
		end
	end)
	creatorTab.Activated:Connect(function()
		setTab("CREATOR")
	end)
	-- Once the correct password has been entered on this account/device,
	-- open Creator automatically on future loads when file persistence exists.
	if hasRememberedCreatorAccess() then
		showCreator()
		accessLabel.Text = "WELCOME BACK // CREATOR ACCESS REMEMBERED"
	end
end

			)

		if ok and image and dashAvatar.Parent then

	end)

	local goUniversal,goTrackers =

	goSettings.Activated:Connect(function() setTab("SETTINGS") end)

	-- LIVE SERVER SNAPSHOT + SAFE QUICK TOOLS
	;(function()
		local startedAt = os.clock()
		local serverCard = makeSection(
			dashboardPage,
			"SERVER SNAPSHOT",
			"Loading live server details..."
		)
		local serverDesc = nil
		for _,child in ipairs(serverCard:GetChildren()) do
			if child:IsA("TextLabel") and child.TextSize == 9 then
				serverDesc = child
				break
			end
		end

		local copyInfoButton,rejoinButton =
			makePair(
				dashboardPage,
				"COPY SERVER INFO",
				"REJOIN SERVER"
			)

		local function formatSession(seconds)
			seconds = math.max(0,math.floor(seconds))
			local minutes = math.floor(seconds/60)
			local hours = math.floor(minutes/60)
			minutes = minutes%60
			local secs = seconds%60
			if hours > 0 then
				return string.format("%dh %02dm %02ds",hours,minutes,secs)
			end
			return string.format("%dm %02ds",minutes,secs)
		end

		local function getPing()
			local value = "--"
			pcall(function()
				local stats = game:GetService("Stats")
				local network = stats:FindFirstChild("Network")
				local serverStats = network and network:FindFirstChild("ServerStatsItem")
				local pingItem = serverStats and serverStats:FindFirstChild("Data Ping")
				if pingItem then
					value = pingItem:GetValueString()
				end
			end)
			return value
		end

		local function updateServerSnapshot()
			if not serverDesc or not serverDesc.Parent then
				return
			end
			serverDesc.Text =
				"Players: "..tostring(#Players:GetPlayers())
				.."  •  Ping: "..getPing()
				.."  •  Session: "..formatSession(os.clock()-startedAt)
		end

		copyInfoButton.Activated:Connect(function()
			local info =
				"NOT RUBY V1 | PlaceId: "..tostring(game.PlaceId)
				.." | JobId: "..tostring(game.JobId)
				.." | Players: "..tostring(#Players:GetPlayers())

			if type(setclipboard) == "function" then
				local ok = pcall(setclipboard,info)
				setStatus(ok and "SERVER INFO COPIED" or "COPY SERVER INFO FAILED")
			else
				setStatus("CLIPBOARD NOT SUPPORTED")
			end
		end)

		rejoinButton.Activated:Connect(function()
			setStatus("REJOINING SERVER...")
			task.spawn(function()
				local ok = pcall(function()
					local teleportService = game:GetService("TeleportService")
					if game.JobId ~= "" then
						teleportService:TeleportToPlaceInstance(
							game.PlaceId,
							game.JobId,
							player
						)
					else
						teleportService:Teleport(game.PlaceId,player)
					end
				end)
				if not ok then
					setStatus("REJOIN FAILED")
				end
			end)
		end)

		updateServerSnapshot()
		task.spawn(function()
			while gui.Parent and not menuDeleted do
				task.wait(1)
				if currentTab == "DASHBOARD" then
					updateServerSnapshot()
				end
			end
		end)
	end)()

			end
			if currentTab == "DASHBOARD" and liveStatus and liveStatus.Parent then
				local labels = {}
				for _,child in ipairs(liveStatus:GetChildren()) do
					if child:IsA("TextLabel") then
						table.insert(labels,child)
					end
				end
				if #labels >= 2 then
					local health = humanoid and math.floor(humanoid.Health + .5) or 0
					local state = "UNKNOWN"

					if humanoid then
						local rawState = humanoid:GetState()
						local moving = humanoid.MoveDirection.Magnitude > .05
						local onGround = humanoid.FloorMaterial ~= Enum.Material.Air
						local verticalVelocity =
							root and root.Parent
							and root.AssemblyLinearVelocity.Y
							or 0

						if rawState == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Jumping
							or (not onGround and verticalVelocity > 1) then
							state = "JUMPING"
						elseif rawState == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Freefall
							or (not onGround and verticalVelocity <= 1) then
							state = "FALLING"
						elseif rawState == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Climbing then
							state = "CLIMBING"
						elseif rawState == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Swimming then
							state = "SWIMMING"
						elseif rawState == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Seated then
							state = "SITTING"
						elseif moving and onGround then
							state = "WALKING"
						elseif onGround then
							state = "IDLE"
						else
							state = string.upper(rawState.Name)
						end
					end

					local pos = root and root.Parent and root.Position or Vector3.zero
					labels[2].Text = string.format(
						"HP: %d   |   State: %s   |   Position: %d, %d, %d",
						health,
						state,
						math.floor(pos.X),
						math.floor(pos.Y),
						math.floor(pos.Z)
					)
				end
			end
		end
	end)

	local selectedPlayer = nil
	local lastPosition = nil
	local lastSampleTime = nil
	local airborneTime = 0
	local signalCounts = {SPEED = 0,TELEPORT = 0,AIR = 0,HOVER = 0,UPWARD = 0,PHYSICS = 0,FORCE = 0,JUMP = 0,NOCLIP = 0}
	local executorAliases = {
		delta = "DELTA",
		wave = "WAVE",
		arceus = "ARCEUS X",
		["arceus x"] = "ARCEUS X",
		codex = "CODEX",
		fluxus = "FLUXUS",
		hydrogen = "HYDROGEN"
	}

	local function normalizeExecutorName(value)
		if typeof(value) ~= "string" then
			return nil
		end
		local cleaned = string.gsub(value,"^%s*(.-)%s*$","%1")
		if cleaned == "" then
			return nil
		end
		return executorAliases[string.lower(cleaned)] or string.upper(cleaned)
	end

	local function resetInspectorHistory()
		lastPosition = nil
		lastSampleTime = nil
		airborneTime = 0
		signalCounts.SPEED = 0
		signalCounts.TELEPORT = 0
		signalCounts.AIR = 0
		signalCounts.HOVER = 0
		signalCounts.UPWARD = 0
		signalCounts.PHYSICS = 0
		signalCounts.FORCE = 0
		signalCounts.JUMP = 0
		signalCounts.NOCLIP = 0
	end

	local function getGameWalkSpeedBaseline()
		local speeds = {}

		for _,otherPlayer in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
			local otherCharacter = otherPlayer.Character
			local otherHumanoid =
				otherCharacter
				and otherCharacter:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")

			if otherHumanoid and otherHumanoid.Health > 0 then
				table.insert(speeds,otherHumanoid.WalkSpeed)
			end
		end

		if #speeds == 0 then
			return 16
		end

		table.sort(speeds)

		-- Use the upper-middle server speed instead of assuming Roblox's
		-- default 16. If the game intentionally makes everybody faster,
		-- that becomes the detector's normal baseline.
		local index = math.clamp(
			math.ceil(#speeds * .75),
			1,
			#speeds
		)

		return math.max(16,speeds[index] or 16)
	end

	local function getGameJumpBaseline()
		local values = {}

		for _,otherPlayer in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
			local otherCharacter = otherPlayer.Character
			local otherHumanoid =
				otherCharacter
				and otherCharacter:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")

			if otherHumanoid and otherHumanoid.Health > 0 then
				local value =
					otherHumanoid.UseJumpPower
					and otherHumanoid.JumpPower
					or otherHumanoid.JumpHeight
				table.insert(values,value)
			end
		end

		if #values == 0 then
			return 50
		end

		table.sort(values)
		local index =
			math.clamp(math.ceil(#values*.75),1,#values)

		return values[index] or 50
	end

	local function hasCharacterForceObject(selectedCharacter)
		for _,object in ipairs(selectedCharacter:GetDescendants()) do
			if object:IsA("BodyVelocity")
				or object:IsA("BodyAngularVelocity")
				or object:IsA("BodyPosition")
				or object:IsA("BodyGyro")
				or object:IsA("LinearVelocity")
				or object:IsA("AngularVelocity")
				or object:IsA("VectorForce")
				or object:IsA("AlignPosition")
				or object:IsA("AlignOrientation") then
				return true,object.ClassName
			end
		end

		return false,nil
	end

	local function hasGroundBelow(selectedCharacter,selectedRoot,distance)
		local params = RaycastParams.new()
		params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
		params.FilterDescendantsInstances = {selectedCharacter}

		local result = workspace:Raycast(
			selectedRoot.Position,
			Vector3.new(0,-math.max(4,distance or 12),0),
			params
		)

		return result ~= nil
	end

	local function getSelectedParts()
		if not selectedPlayer or not selectedPlayer.Parent then
			return nil,nil,nil
		end
		local selectedCharacter = selectedPlayer.Character
		if not selectedCharacter then
			return nil,nil,nil
		end
		local selectedHumanoid = selectedCharacter:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
		local selectedRoot =
			selectedCharacter:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
			or selectedCharacter.PrimaryPart
		return selectedCharacter,selectedHumanoid,selectedRoot
	end

	local function updateInspection()
		if not selectedPlayer or not selectedPlayer.Parent then
			selectedTitle.Text = "NO PLAYER SELECTED"
			selectedUser.Text = "--"
			inspectAvatar.Image = ""
			verdictLabel.Text = "STATUS: --"
			verdictLabel.TextColor3 = MUTED
			executorLabel.Text = "EXECUTOR: --"
			executorLabel.TextColor3 = TEXT
			signalsLabel.Text = "SIGNALS: --"
			return
		end

		selectedTitle.Text = selectedPlayer.DisplayName
		selectedUser.Text = "@"..selectedPlayer.Name.."  •  "..tostring(selectedPlayer.UserId)

		local selectedCharacter,selectedHumanoid,selectedRoot = getSelectedParts()
		if not selectedCharacter or not selectedRoot then
			verdictLabel.Text = "STATUS: CHARACTER UNAVAILABLE"
			verdictLabel.TextColor3 = MUTED
			executorLabel.Text = "EXECUTOR: --"
			signalsLabel.Text = "SIGNALS: waiting for character"
			return
		end

		local now = os.clock()
		if lastPosition and lastSampleTime then
			local dt = math.max(now - lastSampleTime,.001)
			local delta = selectedRoot.Position - lastPosition
			local horizontal =
				Vector3.new(delta.X,0,delta.Z).Magnitude / dt

			local gameWalkSpeed = getGameWalkSpeedBaseline()
			local playerWalkSpeed =
				selectedHumanoid
				and math.max(selectedHumanoid.WalkSpeed,0)
				or gameWalkSpeed

			-- GAME-SPEED-AWARE CHECK:
			-- Fast movement by itself is not enough anymore. The selected
			-- player's WalkSpeed must ALSO be a clear outlier compared with
			-- the rest of the server. This stops games with naturally high
			-- movement speed from being called suspicious.
			local walkSpeedOutlier =
				playerWalkSpeed > (
					strictBaseplateMode
					and math.max(
						gameWalkSpeed * 1.35,
						gameWalkSpeed + 8
					)
					or math.max(
						gameWalkSpeed * 1.65,
						gameWalkSpeed + 20
					)
				)

			local movementTooFast =
				horizontal > (
					strictBaseplateMode
					and math.max(
						gameWalkSpeed * 2.35,
						playerWalkSpeed * 1.7,
						52
					)
					or math.max(
						gameWalkSpeed * 3.5,
						playerWalkSpeed * 2.25,
						110
					)
				)

			if walkSpeedOutlier and movementTooFast then
				signalCounts.SPEED += 1
			else
				-- Old spikes slowly clear instead of permanently marking
				-- somebody suspicious after one network/game-speed burst.
				signalCounts.SPEED =
					math.max(0,signalCounts.SPEED - 1)
			end

			local teleportDistance =
				strictBaseplateMode and 75 or 180

			if delta.Magnitude > teleportDistance
				and dt < .65 then
				signalCounts.TELEPORT += 1
			end
			local velocity = selectedRoot.AssemblyLinearVelocity
			local angularVelocity =
				selectedRoot.AssemblyAngularVelocity.Magnitude

			-- Very high spin or velocity is a useful replicated physics signal.
			local physicsLinearThreshold =
				strictBaseplateMode and 95 or 165
			local physicsAngularThreshold =
				strictBaseplateMode and 18 or 42

			if velocity.Magnitude >= physicsLinearThreshold
				or angularVelocity >= physicsAngularThreshold then
				signalCounts.PHYSICS += 1
			else
				signalCounts.PHYSICS =
					math.max(0,signalCounts.PHYSICS - 1)
			end

			-- In a simple/baseplate game, character force objects are a useful
			-- extra clue. They are NOT treated as proof by themselves outside
			-- strict mode because legitimate games can also use constraints.
			local hasForceObject =
				hasCharacterForceObject(selectedCharacter)

			if hasForceObject then
				signalCounts.FORCE +=
					strictBaseplateMode and 1 or .25
			else
				signalCounts.FORCE =
					math.max(0,signalCounts.FORCE - .5)
			end

			if selectedHumanoid then
				local gameJump = getGameJumpBaseline()
				local selectedJump =
					selectedHumanoid.UseJumpPower
					and selectedHumanoid.JumpPower
					or selectedHumanoid.JumpHeight

				local jumpLimit =
					strictBaseplateMode
					and math.max(gameJump*1.35,gameJump+10)
					or math.max(gameJump*1.8,gameJump+30)

				if selectedJump > jumpLimit then
					signalCounts.JUMP += 1
				else
					signalCounts.JUMP =
						math.max(0,signalCounts.JUMP - 1)
				end
			end

			-- Strict mode checks whether the straight replicated movement path
			-- crossed a collidable object. Repeated hits can indicate noclip.
			if strictBaseplateMode and delta.Magnitude >= 4 then
				local pathParams = RaycastParams.new()
				pathParams.FilterType =
					Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
				pathParams.FilterDescendantsInstances =
					{selectedCharacter}

				local pathHit = workspace:Raycast(
					lastPosition,
					delta,
					pathParams
				)

				if pathHit
					and pathHit.Instance
					and pathHit.Instance:IsA("BasePart")
					and pathHit.Instance.CanCollide then
					signalCounts.NOCLIP += 1
				else
					signalCounts.NOCLIP =
						math.max(0,signalCounts.NOCLIP - 1)
				end
			end

			local noGround =
				not hasGroundBelow(
					selectedCharacter,
					selectedRoot,
					12
				)

			local humanoidAir =
				selectedHumanoid
				and selectedHumanoid.FloorMaterial == Enum.Material.Air

			if humanoidAir and noGround then
				airborneTime += dt

				-- Hovering: clearly off the ground but barely falling/rising.
				if airborneTime >= (strictBaseplateMode and .75 or 1.35)
					and math.abs(velocity.Y) <= 5 then
					signalCounts.HOVER += 1
					airborneTime = .75
				end

				-- Controlled air travel: moving around while remaining far
				-- above any floor for long enough to rule out a normal jump.
				local horizontalAir =
					Vector3.new(
						velocity.X,
						0,
						velocity.Z
					).Magnitude

				if airborneTime >= (strictBaseplateMode and 1.25 or 2.25)
					and horizontalAir >= 5 then
					signalCounts.AIR += 1
					airborneTime = 1
				end

				-- Repeated/controlled upward travel while there is no nearby
				-- floor. A normal jump may spike once, so require repeats.
				if velocity.Y >= (strictBaseplateMode and 12 or 18) then
					signalCounts.UPWARD += 1
				else
					signalCounts.UPWARD =
						math.max(0,signalCounts.UPWARD - 1)
				end
			else
				airborneTime = 0
				signalCounts.UPWARD =
					math.max(0,signalCounts.UPWARD - 1)
			end
		end

		lastPosition = selectedRoot.Position
		lastSampleTime = now

		local signals = {}
		if signalCounts.SPEED >= 2 then
			table.insert(signals,"abnormal speed")
		end
		if signalCounts.TELEPORT >= 2 then
			table.insert(signals,"repeated position jumps")
		end
		if signalCounts.AIR >= 1 then
			table.insert(signals,"controlled airborne travel")
		end
		if signalCounts.HOVER >= 1 then
			table.insert(signals,"hovering with no ground below")
		end
		if signalCounts.UPWARD >= 3 then
			table.insert(signals,"repeated upward flight-like movement")
		end
		if signalCounts.PHYSICS >= 2 then
			table.insert(signals,"extreme replicated physics spike")
		end
		if signalCounts.FORCE >= (strictBaseplateMode and 2 or 5) then
			table.insert(signals,"character force / mover object")
		end
		if signalCounts.JUMP >= 2 then
			table.insert(signals,"abnormal jump setting")
		end
		if strictBaseplateMode and signalCounts.NOCLIP >= 2 then
			table.insert(signals,"possible noclip through solid parts")
		end

		local serverFlag =
			selectedPlayer:GetAttribute("ExploitDetected") == true
		local serverReason =
			selectedPlayer:GetAttribute("ExploitReason")
		local executorName = normalizeExecutorName(
			selectedPlayer:GetAttribute("ExecutorName")
		)

		local speedOnlyServerFlag = false
		if serverFlag
			and typeof(serverReason) == "string"
			and serverReason ~= "" then
			local loweredReason = string.lower(serverReason)
			speedOnlyServerFlag =
				string.find(loweredReason,"speed",1,true) ~= nil
				and string.find(loweredReason,"flight",1,true) == nil
				and string.find(loweredReason,"air",1,true) == nil
				and string.find(loweredReason,"teleport",1,true) == nil
		end

		if serverFlag and not speedOnlyServerFlag then
			table.insert(signals,"server anti-cheat flag")
		elseif speedOnlyServerFlag then
			table.insert(signals,"fast movement (may be game speed)")
		end

		if typeof(serverReason) == "string"
			and serverReason ~= ""
			and not speedOnlyServerFlag then
			table.insert(signals,"server: "..serverReason)
		end

		local strongLocalSignal =
			signalCounts.TELEPORT >= 2
			or signalCounts.AIR >= 1
			or signalCounts.HOVER >= 1
			or signalCounts.UPWARD >= 3
			or signalCounts.SPEED >= 2
			or signalCounts.PHYSICS >= 2
			or signalCounts.JUMP >= 2
			or (
				strictBaseplateMode
				and (
					signalCounts.FORCE >= 2
					or signalCounts.NOCLIP >= 2
				)
			)

		local suspicious =
			(serverFlag and not speedOnlyServerFlag)
			or executorName ~= nil
			or strongLocalSignal

		if suspicious then
			verdictLabel.Text = "STATUS: SUSPICIOUS"
			verdictLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255,92,108)
		else
			verdictLabel.Text = "STATUS: NONE DETECTED"
			verdictLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(90,230,135)
		end

		if executorName then
			executorLabel.Text = "EXECUTOR: "..executorName
			executorLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255,92,108)
		elseif suspicious then
			executorLabel.Text = "EXECUTOR: UNKNOWN"
			executorLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255,170,95)
		else
			executorLabel.Text = "EXECUTOR: NONE"
			executorLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(90,230,135)
		end

		if #signals == 0 then
			signalsLabel.Text =
				"SIGNALS: none observed. This detects replicated behavior/character anomalies, not hidden script code. Exact executor names still require server-reported ExecutorName."
		else
			signalsLabel.Text = "SIGNALS: "..table.concat(signals,", ")
		end
	end

	local function selectInspectorPlayer(otherPlayer)
		if not otherPlayer or otherPlayer == player then
			return
		end

		selectedPlayer = otherPlayer
		resetInspectorHistory()

		task.spawn(function()
			local ok,image = pcall(function()
				return Players:GetUserThumbnailAsync(
					otherPlayer.UserId,
					Enum.ThumbnailType.HeadShot,
					Enum.ThumbnailSize.Size150x150
				)
			end)
			if ok and image and inspectAvatar.Parent and selectedPlayer == otherPlayer then
				inspectAvatar.Image = image
			end
		end)

		updateInspection()
		setStatus("INSPECTING @"..otherPlayer.Name)
	end

	selectPlayerButton.Activated:Connect(function()
		showPlayerPicker("SELECT PLAYER TO INSPECT",selectInspectorPlayer,false)
	end)

	refreshInspectButton.Activated:Connect(function()
		resetInspectorHistory()
		updateInspection()
		setStatus(selectedPlayer and "INSPECTION REFRESHED" or "SELECT A PLAYER FIRST")
	end)

	clearInspectButton.Activated:Connect(function()
		selectedPlayer = nil
		resetInspectorHistory()
		updateInspection()
		setStatus("INSPECTION CLEARED")
	end)

	Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(leavingPlayer)
		if selectedPlayer == leavingPlayer then
			selectedPlayer = nil
			resetInspectorHistory()
			updateInspection()
		end
	end)

	task.spawn(function()
		while not menuDeleted do
			task.wait(.25)
			if selectedPlayer and currentTab == "EXPLOITER" and exploiterPage.Parent then
				updateInspection()
			end
		end
	end)
end
safeSetup("Dashboard",setupFinalAdminTabs)

end
local function setToggle(button,on,label)
	if not button or not button.Parent then
		return
	end
	activeToggleButtons[button] = {
		on = on,
		label = label
	}
	if on then
		button.BackgroundColor3 = accent
		button.TextColor3 = readableTextOn(accent)
		button.Text = label.."  [ON]"
	else
		button.BackgroundColor3 = SURFACE_2
		button.TextColor3 = TEXT
		button.Text = label.."  [OFF]"
	end
end
local function refreshToggleColors()
	for button,data in pairs(activeToggleButtons) do
		if button and button.Parent then
			setToggle(button,data.on,data.label)
		end
	end
end

local function colorsMatch(first,second)
	return first ~= nil
		and second ~= nil
		and math.abs(first.R-second.R) < .001
		and math.abs(first.G-second.G) < .001
		and math.abs(first.B-second.B) < .001
end

local function refreshAccentBoundVisuals(previousAccent)
	if not previousAccent then
		return
	end

	for _,object in ipairs(gui:GetDescendants()) do
		if object:IsA("GuiObject")
			and colorsMatch(object.BackgroundColor3,previousAccent) then
			object.BackgroundColor3 = accent
		end

		if object:IsA("TextLabel")
			or object:IsA("TextButton")
			or object:IsA("TextBox") then
			local baseColor =
				object:GetAttribute("NotRubyBaseTextColor")
			if baseColor ~= nil
				and colorsMatch(baseColor,previousAccent) then
				object:SetAttribute("NotRubyBaseTextColor",accent)
			end
		end

		if (object:IsA("TextLabel")
			or object:IsA("TextButton")
			or object:IsA("TextBox"))
			and colorsMatch(object.TextColor3,previousAccent) then
			object.TextColor3 = accent
		end

		if (object:IsA("ImageLabel") or object:IsA("ImageButton"))
			and colorsMatch(object.ImageColor3,previousAccent) then
			object.ImageColor3 = accent
		end

		if object:IsA("ScrollingFrame")
			and colorsMatch(object.ScrollBarImageColor3,previousAccent) then
			object.ScrollBarImageColor3 = accent
		end

		if object:IsA("UIGradient") then
			local changed = false
			local keypoints = {}
			for _,keypoint in ipairs(object.Color.Keypoints) do
				local value = keypoint.Value
				if colorsMatch(value,previousAccent) then
					value = accent
					changed = true
				end
				table.insert(
					keypoints,
					ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(keypoint.Time,value)
				)
			end
			if changed then
				object.Color = ColorSequence.new(keypoints)
			end
		end
	end

	local aura =
		player.Character
		and player.Character:FindFirstChild("NotRubySelfAura",true)
	if aura and aura:IsA("Highlight")
		and colorsMatch(aura.FillColor,previousAccent) then
		aura.FillColor = accent
	end
end

local function cycleTheme()
	local previousAccent = accent
	themeIndex += 1
	if themeIndex > #themes then
		themeIndex = 1
	end

	accent = themes[themeIndex].color
	refreshAccentBoundVisuals(previousAccent)
	status.TextColor3 = accent
	sidebar.ScrollBarImageColor3 = accent

	applyTabVisuals()
	refreshToggleColors()

	-- MATCH makes every outline follow the selected theme.
	if gui:GetAttribute("OutlineMode") == "MATCH" then
		gui:SetAttribute("OutlineColor",accent)
		for _,object in ipairs(gui:GetDescendants()) do
			if object:IsA("UIStroke")
				and object:GetAttribute("NotRubyFixedColor") ~= true then
				object.Color = accent
			end
		end
	end

	setStatus("THEME: "..themes[themeIndex].name)
end

	makeSection(

	local function setBlur(value)
		blurEnabled = value == true
		setToggle(blurButton,blurEnabled,"BACKGROUND BLUR")
		TweenService:Create(
			blurEffect,

		setStatus(blurEnabled and "BACKGROUND BLUR ON" or "BACKGROUND BLUR OFF")

	local function setHeaderPulse(value)
		pulseEnabled = value == true
		setToggle(pulseButton,pulseEnabled,"HEADER PULSE")
		local glow = header:FindFirstChild("AnimatedAccentGlow")
		if glow then
			glow.Visible = pulseEnabled
		end
		setStatus(pulseEnabled and "HEADER PULSE ON" or "HEADER PULSE OFF")
	end

	local function fitToScreen()
		camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
		local viewport =
			camera and camera.ViewportSize
			or Vector2.new(800,600)

		local width =
			math.max(340,math.min(620,viewport.X-24))
		local height =
			math.max(300,math.min(460,viewport.Y-44))

		panel.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(width,height)
		panel.Position = UDim2.new(.5,-width*.5,.5,-height*.5)
		setPanelScale(gui:GetAttribute("PanelScale"),false)
		setStatus("UI FIT TO SCREEN")
	end

	local function applyUiScale()
		local value = uiScaleValues[uiScaleIndex] or 1
		setPanelScale(value,true)
		uiScaleButton.Text =
			"UI SCALE: "..tostring(math.floor(value*100+.5)).."%"
		setStatus(uiScaleButton.Text)
	end

	local function setAutoFit(value)
		autoFitEnabled = value == true
		setToggle(autoFitButton,autoFitEnabled,"AUTO FIT")

		setStatus(autoFitEnabled and "AUTO FIT ON" or "AUTO FIT OFF")

		return
	end
	humanoid.WalkSpeed =
		sprinting and math.max(walkSpeed,sprintSpeed) or walkSpeed
	pcall(function()
		humanoid.UseJumpPower = true
		humanoid.JumpPower = jumpPower
	end)
end

local function holdButton(button,callback)
	button.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
		if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch
			or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
			callback(true)
			button.BackgroundColor3 = accent
			button.TextColor3 = readableTextOn(accent)
		end
	end)
	button.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
		if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch
			or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
			callback(false)
			button.BackgroundColor3 = SURFACE_2
			button.TextColor3 = TEXT
		end
	end)
end
holdButton(upButton,function(value)
	flyUp = value
end)
holdButton(downButton,function(value)
	flyDown = value
end)
local function stopFlight()
	flying = false
	flyUp = false
	flyDown = false
	if bodyGyro then
		bodyGyro:Destroy()
		bodyGyro = nil
	end
	if flightVelocity then
		flightVelocity:Destroy()
		flightVelocity = nil
	end
	if root and root.Parent then
		root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
	end
	if humanoid then
		humanoid.AutoRotate = true
	end
	if flightControls and flightControls.Parent then
		flightControls.Visible = false
	end
	if flightButton and flightButton.Parent then
		setToggle(flightButton,false,"FREE FLIGHT")
	end
	if quickFlight and quickFlight.Parent then
		setToggle(quickFlight,false,"FREE FLIGHT")
	end
end
local function startFlight()
	if menuDeleted then
		return
	end
	if not character or not character.Parent then
		loadCharacter()
	end
	if not root or not root.Parent or not humanoid then
		return
	end
	if bodyGyro then
		bodyGyro:Destroy()
	end
	if flightVelocity then
		flightVelocity:Destroy()
	end
	root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
	bodyGyro = Instance.new("BodyGyro")
	bodyGyro.Name = "ClarkFreeFlightGyro"
	bodyGyro.MaxTorque = Vector3.new(1e8,1e8,1e8)
	bodyGyro.P = 60000
	bodyGyro.D = 800
	bodyGyro.CFrame = root.CFrame
	bodyGyro.Parent = root
	flightVelocity = Instance.new("BodyVelocity")
	flightVelocity.Name = "ClarkFreeFlightVelocity"
	flightVelocity.MaxForce = Vector3.new(1e9,1e9,1e9)
	flightVelocity.P = 30000
	flightVelocity.Velocity = Vector3.zero
	flightVelocity.Parent = root
	humanoid.AutoRotate = false
	flying = true
	flightControls.Visible = true
	setToggle(flightButton,true,"FREE FLIGHT")
end
local function setFlight(value)
	if value then
		startFlight()
	else
		stopFlight()
	end
	setToggle(quickFlight,flying,"FREE FLIGHT")
	setStatus(flying and "FREE FLIGHT ON" or "FREE FLIGHT OFF")
end
local function setPitchFlight(value)
	pitchFlight = value
	setToggle(pitchButton,pitchFlight,"PITCH FLIGHT")
	setStatus(pitchFlight and "CAMERA PITCH FLIGHT ON" or "LEVEL FLIGHT ON")
end
flightButton.Activated:Connect(function()
	setFlight(not flying)
end)
pitchButton.Activated:Connect(function()
	setPitchFlight(not pitchFlight)
end)
RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
	if menuDeleted then
		return
	end
	if not flying
		or not root
		or not root.Parent
		or not humanoid
		or not bodyGyro
		or not flightVelocity then
		return
	end
	camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
	if not camera then
		return
	end
	local direction = Vector3.zero
	local keyboardUsed = false
	local look = camera.CFrame.LookVector
	local right = camera.CFrame.RightVector
	if not pitchFlight then
		look = Vector3.new(look.X,0,look.Z)
		right = Vector3.new(right.X,0,right.Z)
		if look.Magnitude > .001 then
			look = look.Unit
		end
		if right.Magnitude > .001 then
			right = right.Unit
		end
	end
	if UIS:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.W) then
		direction += look
		keyboardUsed = true
	end
	if UIS:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.S) then
		direction -= look
		keyboardUsed = true
	end
	if UIS:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.D) then
		direction += right
		keyboardUsed = true
	end
	if UIS:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.A) then
		direction -= right
		keyboardUsed = true
	end
	if not keyboardUsed and humanoid.MoveDirection.Magnitude > .03 then
		local flatLook = Vector3.new(
			camera.CFrame.LookVector.X,
			0,
			camera.CFrame.LookVector.Z
		)
		local flatRight = Vector3.new(
			camera.CFrame.RightVector.X,
			0,
			camera.CFrame.RightVector.Z
		)
		if flatLook.Magnitude > .001 then
			flatLook = flatLook.Unit
		end
		if flatRight.Magnitude > .001 then
			flatRight = flatRight.Unit
		end
		local move = humanoid.MoveDirection
		local forwardAmount = move:Dot(flatLook)
		local rightAmount = move:Dot(flatRight)
		local mobileLook =
			pitchFlight and camera.CFrame.LookVector or flatLook
		local mobileRight =
			pitchFlight and camera.CFrame.RightVector or flatRight
		direction += mobileLook * forwardAmount
		direction += mobileRight * rightAmount
	end
	local vertical = 0
	if flyUp then
		vertical += 1
	end
	if flyDown then
		vertical -= 1
	end
	if UIS:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.Space)
		or UIS:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.E) then
		vertical += 1
	end
	if UIS:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.LeftControl)
		or UIS:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.Q) then
		vertical -= 1
	end
	direction += Vector3.new(0,vertical,0)
	if direction.Magnitude > 1 then
		direction = direction.Unit
	end
	flightVelocity.Velocity = direction * flySpeed
	local facing = camera.CFrame.LookVector
	local flatFacing = Vector3.new(facing.X,0,facing.Z)
	if flatFacing.Magnitude > .01 then
		bodyGyro.CFrame =
			CFrame.lookAt(
				root.Position,
				root.Position + flatFacing.Unit
			)
	end
end)

	sprinting = value
	applyMovementStats()
	setToggle(sprintButton,sprinting,"SPRINT")
	setStatus(sprinting and "SPRINT ON" or "SPRINT OFF")
end

-- SMALL SPEED BOOST // isolated inside its own function so it does not add
-- locals/register pressure to the already-large main chunk.
safeSetup("Small Speed Boost",function()
	gui:SetAttribute("SmallSpeedBoost",false)
	gui:SetAttribute("SmallSpeedBoostAmount",4)

	local boostButton =
		makeAction(movementPage,"SMALL SPEED BOOST +4 [OFF]")

	local function refreshBoostButton()
		local enabled = gui:GetAttribute("SmallSpeedBoost") == true
		setToggle(boostButton,enabled,"SMALL SPEED BOOST +4")
	end

	boostButton.Activated:Connect(function()
		local enabled = gui:GetAttribute("SmallSpeedBoost") == true
		gui:SetAttribute("SmallSpeedBoost",not enabled)
		refreshBoostButton()
		setStatus(
			not enabled
			and "SMALL SPEED BOOST +4 ON"
			or "SMALL SPEED BOOST OFF"
		)
	end)

	gui:GetAttributeChangedSignal("SmallSpeedBoost"):Connect(function()
		if boostButton and boostButton.Parent then
			refreshBoostButton()
		end
	end)

	-- Grounded physical assist. This does not depend on WalkSpeed remaining
	-- modified, so a game script restoring WalkSpeed does not cancel it.
	RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
		if menuDeleted
			or gui:GetAttribute("SmallSpeedBoost") ~= true
			or flying then
			return
		end

		local currentCharacter = player.Character
		local currentHumanoid =
			currentCharacter
			and currentCharacter:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
		local currentRoot =
			currentCharacter
			and currentCharacter:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

		if not currentHumanoid
			or currentHumanoid.Health <= 0
			or not currentRoot
			or currentHumanoid.FloorMaterial == Enum.Material.Air then
			return
		end

		local move = currentHumanoid.MoveDirection
		local flatMove = Vector3.new(move.X,0,move.Z)
		if flatMove.Magnitude <= .05 then
			return
		end
		flatMove = flatMove.Unit

		local velocity = currentRoot.AssemblyLinearVelocity
		local horizontal = Vector3.new(velocity.X,0,velocity.Z)
		local forwardSpeed = horizontal:Dot(flatMove)
		local amount = tonumber(gui:GetAttribute("SmallSpeedBoostAmount")) or 4
		local target =
			math.max(tonumber(currentHumanoid.WalkSpeed) or 16,0) + amount

		if forwardSpeed < target-.1 then
			local add = math.min(target-forwardSpeed,amount)
			local boosted = horizontal + flatMove*add
			currentRoot.AssemblyLinearVelocity =
				Vector3.new(boosted.X,velocity.Y,boosted.Z)
		end
	end)

	refreshBoostButton()
end)

local function restoreCollision()
	for part,oldValue in pairs(originalCollision) do
		if part and part.Parent then
			part.CanCollide = oldValue
		end
	end
	table.clear(originalCollision)
end

		restoreCollision()
	end
	setStatus(noclip and "NOCLIP ON" or "NOCLIP OFF")
end

	setNoclip(not noclip)
end)

	if menuDeleted then
		return
	end
	if not noclip or not character then
		return
	end
	for _,object in ipairs(character:GetDescendants()) do
		if object:IsA("BasePart") then
			if originalCollision[object] == nil then
				originalCollision[object] = object.CanCollide
			end
			object.CanCollide = false
		end
	end
end)

local function applyLightingProfile()
	local normalized = (brightnessLevel-50)/50
	local baseBrightness = originalLighting.Brightness
	local baseExposure = originalLighting.ExposureCompensation

	if fullBright then
		baseBrightness = math.max(baseBrightness,3)
		baseExposure = math.max(baseExposure,.35)
		Lighting.Ambient = Color3.fromRGB(180,180,180)
		Lighting.OutdoorAmbient = Color3.fromRGB(180,180,180)
	else
		Lighting.Ambient = originalLighting.Ambient
		Lighting.OutdoorAmbient = originalLighting.OutdoorAmbient
	end

	Lighting.Brightness =
		math.clamp(baseBrightness+normalized*2.2,0,10)
	Lighting.ExposureCompensation =
		math.clamp(baseExposure+normalized*1.8,-3,3)
end

local function setNightVision(value)
	nightVision = value == true
	setToggle(nightButton,nightVision,"NIGHT VISION")

	if visionEffect then
		visionEffect:Destroy()
		visionEffect = nil
	end

	if nightVision then
		visionEffect = Instance.new("ColorCorrectionEffect")
		visionEffect.Name = "NotRubyNightVision"
		visionEffect.Brightness = .18
		visionEffect.Contrast = .12
		visionEffect.Saturation = -.05
		visionEffect.TintColor = Color3.fromRGB(165,255,185)
		visionEffect.Parent = Lighting
	end

	setStatus(nightVision and "NIGHT VISION ON" or "NIGHT VISION OFF")
end

nightButton.Activated:Connect(function()
	setNightVision(not nightVision)
end)

	fullBright = value == true
	setToggle(brightButton,fullBright,"FULL BRIGHT")
	applyLightingProfile()
	setStatus(fullBright and "FULL BRIGHT ON" or "FULL BRIGHT OFF")

local function setBrightnessLevel(value)
	value = tonumber(value)
	if not value then
		setStatus("INVALID BRIGHTNESS")
		return false
	end

	brightnessLevel = math.clamp(math.floor(value+.5),0,100)
	brightnessBox.Text = tostring(brightnessLevel)
	applyLightingProfile()
	setStatus("BRIGHTNESS "..tostring(brightnessLevel).."/100")
	return true
end

brightnessApply.Activated:Connect(function()
	setBrightnessLevel(brightnessBox.Text)
end)
local function applyXrayPart(object)
	if not xrayMode
		or not object:IsA("BasePart")
		or not character
		or object:IsDescendantOf(character)
		or object.Transparency >= 1 then
		return
	end
	if originalTransparency[object] == nil then
		originalTransparency[object] = object.LocalTransparencyModifier
	end
	object.LocalTransparencyModifier = .65
end
local function restoreXray()
	for object,oldValue in pairs(originalTransparency) do
		if object and object.Parent then
			object.LocalTransparencyModifier = oldValue
		end
	end
	table.clear(originalTransparency)
end
local function setXray(value)
	xrayMode = value
	setToggle(xrayButton,xrayMode,"X-RAY")
	if xrayMode then
		for _,object in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
			applyXrayPart(object)
		end
	else
		restoreXray()
	end
	setStatus(xrayMode and "X-RAY ON" or "X-RAY OFF")
end
xrayButton.Activated:Connect(function()
	setXray(not xrayMode)
end)
workspace.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(object)
	if menuDeleted then
		return
	end
	if xrayMode and object:IsA("BasePart") then
		task.defer(function()
			applyXrayPart(object)
		end)
	end
end)

-- WALL / COLLISION PARTS
-- Shows nearby collidable geometry with red outlines. This is useful for
-- seeing actual solid surfaces instead of decorative/non-collidable parts.
gui:SetAttribute("WallPartsVisual",false)

do
local function setupWallPartsVisualizer()
	local scanRadius = 120
	local refreshDelay = .45
	local visualFolder = Instance.new("Folder")
	visualFolder.Name = "NotRubyWallPartVisuals"
	visualFolder.Parent = workspace
	local activeBoxes = {}
	local token = 0

	local function isCharacterPart(part)
		local model = part:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("Model")
		return model and model:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") ~= nil
	end

	local function clearBoxes()
		for part,box in pairs(activeBoxes) do
			if box then
				box:Destroy()
			end
			activeBoxes[part] = nil
		end
	end

	local function removeMissingParts(seen)
		for part,box in pairs(activeBoxes) do
			if not seen[part] or not part.Parent then
				if box then
					box:Destroy()
				end
				activeBoxes[part] = nil
			end
		end
	end

	local function getPartVisualColor(part)
		local smallest =
			math.min(part.Size.X,part.Size.Y,part.Size.Z)

		if smallest <= 1.15 then
			return Color3.fromRGB(255,205,55)
		end

		if part.CanCollide then
			return Color3.fromRGB(255,45,60)
		end

		return Color3.fromRGB(155,160,175)
	end

	local function addPart(part)
		if activeBoxes[part]
			or not part:IsA("BasePart")
			or part.Transparency >= 1
			or isCharacterPart(part) then
			return
		end

		local color = getPartVisualColor(part)
		local box = Instance.new("SelectionBox")
		box.Name = "NotRubyCollisionOutline"
		box.Adornee = part
		box.Color3 = color
		box.SurfaceColor3 = color
		box.SurfaceTransparency = .93
		box.LineThickness = .035
		box.Parent = visualFolder
		activeBoxes[part] = box
	end

	local function refresh()
		local currentRoot =
			player.Character
			and player.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

		if not currentRoot then
			clearBoxes()
			return
		end

		local overlap = OverlapParams.new()
		overlap.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
		overlap.FilterDescendantsInstances = {
			player.Character,
			visualFolder
		}

		local seen = {}
		local nearby = workspace:GetPartBoundsInRadius(
			currentRoot.Position,
			scanRadius,
			overlap
		)

		for _,part in ipairs(nearby) do
			if part:IsA("BasePart")
				and part.Transparency < 1
				and not isCharacterPart(part) then
				seen[part] = true

				local existing = activeBoxes[part]
				if existing then
					local color = getPartVisualColor(part)
					existing.Color3 = color
					existing.SurfaceColor3 = color
				else
					addPart(part)
				end
			end
		end

		removeMissingParts(seen)
	end

	local function stop()
		token += 1
		clearBoxes()
		setToggle(
			wallPartsButton,
			false,
			"WALL / COLLISION PARTS"
		)
	end

	local function start()
		token += 1
		local myToken = token
		setToggle(
			wallPartsButton,
			true,
			"WALL / COLLISION PARTS"
		)

		task.spawn(function()
			while not menuDeleted
				and gui:GetAttribute("WallPartsVisual") == true
				and myToken == token do
				refresh()
				task.wait(refreshDelay)
			end

			if myToken == token then
				clearBoxes()
			end
		end)
	end

	wallPartsButton.Activated:Connect(function()
		gui:SetAttribute(
			"WallPartsVisual",
			not (gui:GetAttribute("WallPartsVisual") == true)
		)
	end)

	gui:GetAttributeChangedSignal("WallPartsVisual"):Connect(function()
		if gui:GetAttribute("WallPartsVisual") == true then
			start()
			setStatus("WALL PARTS // RED SOLID // GRAY NON-COLLIDE // YELLOW THIN")
		else
			stop()
			setStatus("WALL / COLLISION PARTS OFF")
		end
	end)

	gui.Destroying:Connect(function()
		clearBoxes()
		if visualFolder then
			visualFolder:Destroy()
		end
	end)
end
safeSetup("Wall Visuals",setupWallPartsVisualizer)

end

local function getRoot(model)
	if not model or not model:IsA("Model") then
		return nil
	end
	local preferred = {
		"HumanoidRootPart",
		"UpperTorso",
		"Torso",
		"Head"
	}
	for _,name in ipairs(preferred) do
		local part = model:FindFirstChild(name)
		if part and part:IsA("BasePart") then
			return part
		end
	end
	for _,object in ipairs(model:GetChildren()) do
		if object:IsA("BasePart") then
			return object
		end
	end
	return nil
end
local function removeMarker(markerTable,target)
	local data = markerTable[target]
	if data then
		if data.gui then
			data.gui:Destroy()
		end
		markerTable[target] = nil
	end
end
local function clearMarkerTable(markerTable)
	for _,data in pairs(markerTable) do
		if data.gui then
			data.gui:Destroy()
		end
	end
	table.clear(markerTable)
end
local function createMarker(target,name,isMonster)
	if not target or not target:IsA("Model") then
		return
	end
	local targetRoot = getRoot(target)
	if not targetRoot then
		return
	end
	if root and (root.Position-targetRoot.Position).Magnitude > scanRadius then
		return
	end
	local markerTable = isMonster and monsterMarkers or playerMarkers
	if markerTable[target] then
		return
	end
	local billboard = Instance.new("BillboardGui")
	billboard.Name = isMonster and "ClarkMonsterMarker" or "ClarkPlayerMarker"
	billboard.Adornee = targetRoot
	billboard.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(245,72)
	billboard.StudsOffset = Vector3.new(0,4,0)
	billboard.AlwaysOnTop = true
	billboard.MaxDistance = scanRadius
	billboard.Parent = gui
	local frame = Instance.new("Frame")
	frame.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1,1)
	frame.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	frame.Parent = billboard
	local nameLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	nameLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	nameLabel.Size = UDim2.new(1,0,0,27)
	nameLabel.Text = isMonster and "MONSTER // "..name or name
	nameLabel.TextSize = 12
	nameLabel.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBlack
	nameLabel.TextColor3 =
		isMonster
		and Color3.fromRGB(255,68,78)
		or Color3.fromRGB(72,240,125)
	nameLabel.TextStrokeTransparency = .15
	nameLabel.Parent = frame
	local distanceLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	distanceLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	distanceLabel.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0,27)
	distanceLabel.Size = UDim2.new(1,0,0,20)
	distanceLabel.Text = "DISTANCE: --"
	distanceLabel.TextSize = 10
	distanceLabel.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
	distanceLabel.TextColor3 = TEXT
	distanceLabel.TextStrokeTransparency = .2
	distanceLabel.Parent = frame
	markerTable[target] = {
		gui = billboard,
		distance = distanceLabel
	}
end
local function refreshPlayers()
	clearMarkerTable(playerMarkers)
	if not playerLocator then
		return
	end

	local selectedUserId = tonumber(gui:GetAttribute("TrackerTargetUserId")) or 0
	local selectedName = tostring(gui:GetAttribute("TrackerTargetName") or "")
	local foundTarget = false
	local markedCount = 0

	for _,otherPlayer in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
		if otherPlayer ~= player
			and otherPlayer.Character
			and (
				selectedUserId == 0
				or otherPlayer.UserId == selectedUserId
			) then

			createMarker(
				otherPlayer.Character,
				otherPlayer.DisplayName.."  @"..otherPlayer.Name,
				false
			)

			markedCount += 1

			if selectedUserId ~= 0 and otherPlayer.UserId == selectedUserId then
				foundTarget = true
			end
		end
	end

	if trackerInfo and trackerInfo.Parent then
		local labels = {}
		for _,child in ipairs(trackerInfo:GetChildren()) do
			if child:IsA("TextLabel") then
				table.insert(labels,child)
			end
		end

		if #labels >= 2 then
			if selectedUserId == 0 then
				labels[2].Text =
					"Tracking all players  |  Marked: "..tostring(markedCount)
			elseif foundTarget then
				labels[2].Text =
					"Tracking only @"..selectedName
			else
				labels[2].Text =
					"Selected player is not currently available"
			end
		end
	end
end
local function setPlayerLocator(value)
	playerLocator = value
	setToggle(playersButton,playerLocator,"PLAYER LOCATOR")
	setToggle(quickPlayers,playerLocator,"PLAYER LOCATOR")
	if playerLocator then
		refreshPlayers()
	else
		clearMarkerTable(playerMarkers)
	end
	setStatus(playerLocator and "PLAYER LOCATOR ON" or "PLAYER LOCATOR OFF")
end
playersButton.Activated:Connect(function()
	setPlayerLocator(not playerLocator)
end)
refreshPlayersButton.Activated:Connect(function()
	if playerLocator then
		refreshPlayers()
		setStatus("PLAYERS REFRESHED")
	else
		setStatus("PLAYER LOCATOR OFF")
	end
end)

	local function setAllPlayers()

		selectedName.Text = otherPlayer.DisplayName
