		showPlayerPicker("SELECT PLAYER TO LOCATE",selectPlayer,false)
	end)

	allPlayersButton.Activated:Connect(setAllPlayers)

	Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(leavingPlayer)
		local selectedId = tonumber(gui:GetAttribute("TrackerTargetUserId")) or 0
		if selectedId == leavingPlayer.UserId then
			setAllPlayers()
		end
	end)
end
safeSetup("Player Selector",setupPlayerTrackerSelector)

end
local monsterWords = {
	"sally","locust","monster","zombie","creature","beast","enemy",
	"alien","mutant","boss","npc","insect","bug","spider",
	"scorpion","demon","ghoul","crawler","creeper","behemoth",
	"titan","parasite","beetle","wasp","hornet","entity","hostile",
	"killer","hunter","mob","predator","attacker","chaser"
}
local function normalizeName(name)
	return string.lower(
		string.gsub(name or "","[%s_%-%p]+"," ")
	)
end
local function containsMonsterWord(name)
	name = normalizeName(name)
	for _,word in ipairs(monsterWords) do
		if string.find(name,word,1,true) then
			return true
		end
	end
	return false
end
local function isPlayerCharacter(model)
	for _,otherPlayer in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
		if otherPlayer.Character == model then
			return true
		end
	end
	return false
end
local function isMonster(model)
	if not model or not model:IsA("Model") then
		return false
	end
	if isPlayerCharacter(model)
		or model:GetAttribute("NotRubyFakeEntity") == true then
		return false
	end

	if model:GetAttribute("IsMonster") == true
		or model:GetAttribute("Monster") == true
		or model:GetAttribute("IsEnemy") == true
		or model:GetAttribute("Enemy") == true
		or model:GetAttribute("Hostile") == true
		or model:GetAttribute("IsHostile") == true
		or model:GetAttribute("Aggressive") == true
		or model:GetAttribute("IsAggressive") == true then
		return true
	end

	for _,attributeName in ipairs({
		"Damage","AttackDamage","TouchDamage","HitDamage"
	}) do
		local value = model:GetAttribute(attributeName)
		if type(value) == "number" and value > 0 then
			return true
		end
	end

	if CollectionService:HasTag(model,"Monster")
		or CollectionService:HasTag(model,"Enemy")
		or CollectionService:HasTag(model,"Locust")
		or CollectionService:HasTag(model,"Hostile") then
		return true
	end

	if containsMonsterWord(model.Name) then
		return true
	end

	-- V63 fallback: many House of the Locust enemies use ordinary/random
	-- model names. A living non-player Humanoid with a usable root is treated
	-- as a threat even when its name has no monster keyword.
	local npcHumanoid =
		model:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
		or model:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Humanoid",true)
	if npcHumanoid and npcHumanoid.Health > 0 then
		local npcRoot =
			model.PrimaryPart
			or model:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart",true)
			or model:FindFirstChild("Root",true)
			or model:FindFirstChild("Hitbox",true)
			or model:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart",true)
		if npcRoot then
			return true
		end
	end

	return false
end
local function findMonsterModel(object)
	local current = object
	while current and current ~= workspace do
		if current:IsA("Model") and isMonster(current) then
			return current
		end
		current = current.Parent
	end
	return nil
end
local function refreshMonsters()
	clearMarkerTable(monsterMarkers)
	if not monsterLocator then
		return
	end
	local found = {}
	local count = 0
	for _,object in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
		if object:IsA("Model") then
			local monster = findMonsterModel(object)
			if monster
				and not found[monster]
				and not isPlayerCharacter(monster) then
				local monsterRoot = getRoot(monster)
				if monsterRoot
					and (
						not root
						or (root.Position-monsterRoot.Position).Magnitude <= scanRadius
					) then
					found[monster] = true
					createMarker(monster,monster.Name,true)
					count += 1
				end
			end
		end
	end
	setStatus("MONSTERS FOUND: "..tostring(count))
end
local function setMonsterLocator(value)
	if value == true and gui:GetAttribute("SafeMode") == true then
		monsterLocator = false
		gui:SetAttribute("MonsterLocatorActive",false)
		setToggle(monsterButton,false,"MONSTER LOCATOR")
		setToggle(quickLocust,false,"LOCUST LOCATOR")
		setStatus("SAFE MODE // MONSTER LOCATOR BLOCKED")
		return
	end
	if value == true then
		gui:SetAttribute("RuntimeProfile","LOCUST")
	end
	monsterLocator = value
	gui:SetAttribute("MonsterLocatorActive",monsterLocator)
	setToggle(monsterButton,monsterLocator,"MONSTER LOCATOR")
	setToggle(quickLocust,monsterLocator,"LOCUST LOCATOR")
	if monsterLocator then
		refreshMonsters()
	else
		clearMarkerTable(monsterMarkers)
	end
	setStatus(monsterLocator and "MONSTER LOCATOR ON" or "MONSTER LOCATOR OFF")
end
monsterButton.Activated:Connect(function()
	setMonsterLocator(not monsterLocator)
end)
refreshMonstersButton.Activated:Connect(function()
	if monsterLocator then
		refreshMonsters()
	else
		setStatus("MONSTER LOCATOR OFF")
	end
end)
clearMonsterButton.Activated:Connect(function()
	clearMarkerTable(monsterMarkers)
	setStatus("MONSTER MARKERS CLEARED")
end)

-- HOUSE OF THE LOCUST // V74 SAFE ZONE 1 + FIXED SAFE ZONE 2 + MUTUALLY EXCLUSIVE AUTO SAFE
-- Safe Zone 1 remains the original fixed position.
-- Safe Zone 2 is permanently set to the confirmed waypoint: -220, 36, 299.
;(function()
	local SAFE_ZONE_1_POSITION = Vector3.new(-61.6,35.0,306.9)
	local SAFE_ZONE_2_POSITION = Vector3.new(-220,36,299)
	local safeZone2Position = SAFE_ZONE_2_POSITION

	-- 0 = OFF, 1 = SAFE ZONE 1, 2 = SAFE ZONE 2.
	-- One shared engine means both auto-safe modes can never run together.
	local autoSafeMode = 0
	local autoSafeEnabled = false
	local autoSafeRadius = 80
	local autoSafeThreatFilter = "ALL"
	local autoSafeAccumulator = 0
	local autoSafeLastTrigger = 0
	local autoSafeScanToken = 0
	local previousSafeCFrame = nil
	local safeClearStartedAt = nil
	local returnWaitReason = "NO POSITION"
	local RETURN_CLEAR_SECONDS = 2
	local knownThreats = setmetatable({}, {__mode = "k"})

	local function activeSafePosition()
		if autoSafeMode == 2 then
			return safeZone2Position
		end
		return SAFE_ZONE_1_POSITION
	end

	local function activeSafeName()
		return autoSafeMode == 2 and "SAFE ZONE 2" or "SAFE ZONE"
	end

	local function syncAutoSafeToggles()
		local zone1On = autoSafeEnabled and autoSafeMode == 1
		local zone2On = autoSafeEnabled and autoSafeMode == 2

		gui:SetAttribute("AutoSafeZone",zone1On)
		gui:SetAttribute("AutoSafeZone2",zone2On)
		gui:SetAttribute(
			"ActiveSafeZone",
			zone1On and "ONE" or (zone2On and "TWO" or "NONE")
		)

		setToggle(
			locustSafeControls.auto,
			zone1On,
			"AUTO SAFE ZONE"
		)
		setToggle(
			locustSafeControls.auto2,
			zone2On,
			"AUTO SAFE ZONE 2"
		)
	end

	local function setReturnReady(value,reason)
		value = value == true and previousSafeCFrame ~= nil
		gui:SetAttribute("AutoSafeReturnReady",value)

		if value then
			returnWaitReason = "READY"
			locustSafeControls.returnButton.Text =
				"RETURN TO PREVIOUS POSITION [READY]"
			locustSafeControls.returnButton.BackgroundColor3 = accent
			locustSafeControls.returnButton.TextColor3 =
				readableTextOn(accent)
		elseif previousSafeCFrame then
			returnWaitReason = tostring(reason or "WAITING")
			locustSafeControls.returnButton.Text =
				"RETURN TO PREVIOUS POSITION ["
				..returnWaitReason
				.."]"
			locustSafeControls.returnButton.BackgroundColor3 = SURFACE_2
			locustSafeControls.returnButton.TextColor3 = MUTED
		else
			returnWaitReason = "NO POSITION"
			locustSafeControls.returnButton.Text =
				"RETURN TO PREVIOUS POSITION [NO POSITION]"
			locustSafeControls.returnButton.BackgroundColor3 = SURFACE_2
			locustSafeControls.returnButton.TextColor3 = MUTED
		end
	end

	local function clearKnownThreats()
		for monster in pairs(knownThreats) do
			knownThreats[monster] = nil
		end
		gui:SetAttribute("AutoSafeThreatCount",0)
	end

	local function threatMatches(monster)
		if not monster then
			return false
		end

		local filter =
			string.upper(tostring(autoSafeThreatFilter or "ALL"))

		if filter == "" or filter == "ALL" or filter == "*" then
			return true
		end

		local haystack =
			string.lower(tostring(monster.Name or ""))

		for token in string.gmatch(
			string.lower(filter),
			"[^,%s]+"
		) do
			if token ~= ""
				and string.find(haystack,token,1,true) then
				return true
			end
		end

		return false
	end

	local function teleportToSafePosition(
		position,
		statusText,
		rememberReturn,
		zoneName
	)
		zoneName = tostring(zoneName or "SAFE ZONE")

		if not position then
			setStatus(zoneName.." // POSITION NOT SET")
			return false
		end

		if not loadCharacter(2) then
			setStatus(zoneName.." // CHARACTER NOT READY")
			return false
		end

		local currentCharacter = player.Character
		local currentRoot =
			currentCharacter
			and currentCharacter:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

		if not currentCharacter or not currentRoot then
			setStatus(zoneName.." // ROOT NOT FOUND")
			return false
		end

		if rememberReturn == true
			and (currentRoot.Position-position).Magnitude > 12 then
			previousSafeCFrame = currentRoot.CFrame
			safeClearStartedAt = nil
			setReturnReady(false,"WAITING FOR SAFE")
		end

		local _,yaw,_ = currentRoot.CFrame:ToOrientation()
		local destination =
			CFrame.new(position)
			* CFrame.Angles(0,yaw,0)

		pcall(function()
			currentRoot.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
			currentRoot.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
		end)

		local ok,pivotError = pcall(function()
			currentCharacter:PivotTo(destination)
		end)

		if not ok then
			local fallbackOk,fallbackError = pcall(function()
				currentRoot.CFrame = destination
			end)

			if not fallbackOk then
				warn(
					"[NOT RUBY AUTO SAFE] TELEPORT FAILED // "
					..tostring(pivotError)
					.." // "
					..tostring(fallbackError)
				)
				setStatus(zoneName.." // TELEPORT FAILED")
				return false
			end
		end

		task.defer(function()
			if currentRoot and currentRoot.Parent then
				pcall(function()
					currentRoot.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
					currentRoot.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
				end)
			end
		end)

		setStatus(statusText or (zoneName.." // TELEPORTED"))
		return true
	end

	local function resolveAutoSafeThreat(object)
		local cursor = object

		for _ = 1,12 do
			if not cursor or cursor == workspace then
				break
			end

			if cursor:IsA("Model")
				and isMonster(cursor)
				and not isPlayerCharacter(cursor) then
				return cursor
			end

			cursor = cursor.Parent
		end

		return nil
	end

	local function rememberThreat(object)
		if not autoSafeEnabled
			or not object
			or not object.Parent then
			return false
		end

		local monster = resolveAutoSafeThreat(object)

		if monster
			and monster.Parent
			and getRoot(monster)
			and threatMatches(monster) then
			knownThreats[monster] = true
			return true
		end

		return false
	end

	local function scanExistingThreats(token,announce)
		local objects = workspace:GetDescendants()

		for index,object in ipairs(objects) do
			if token ~= autoSafeScanToken
				or not autoSafeEnabled
				or menuDeleted then
				return
			end

			if object:IsA("Model") then
				rememberThreat(object)
			end

			if index % 220 == 0 then
				task.wait()
			end
		end

		local tracked = 0
		for monster in pairs(knownThreats) do
			if monster and monster.Parent then
				tracked += 1
			end
		end

		gui:SetAttribute("AutoSafeThreatCount",tracked)

		if announce == true
			and autoSafeEnabled
			and token == autoSafeScanToken then
			setStatus(
				activeSafeName()
					.." AUTO ARMED // "
					..tostring(tracked)
					.." THREAT"
					..(tracked == 1 and "" or "S")
					.." TRACKED"
			)
		end
	end

	local function disableAutoSafe(statusText)
		autoSafeEnabled = false
		autoSafeMode = 0
		autoSafeScanToken += 1
		clearKnownThreats()
		syncAutoSafeToggles()

		if statusText then
			setStatus(statusText)
		end
	end

	local function enableAutoSafe(mode)
		if gui:GetAttribute("SafeMode") == true then
			setStatus(
				mode == 2
					and "SAFE MODE // AUTO SAFE ZONE 2 BLOCKED"
					or "SAFE MODE // AUTO SAFE ZONE BLOCKED"
			)
			return
		end

		gui:SetAttribute("RuntimeProfile","LOCUST")

		-- Mutual exclusion: enabling one replaces the other immediately.
		autoSafeMode = mode
		autoSafeEnabled = true
		autoSafeScanToken += 1
		autoSafeAccumulator = 0
		autoSafeLastTrigger = 0
		clearKnownThreats()
		syncAutoSafeToggles()

		local token = autoSafeScanToken
		task.spawn(function()
			scanExistingThreats(token,true)
		end)

		setStatus(
			activeSafeName()
				.." AUTO ON // "
				..tostring(autoSafeRadius)
				.." STUDS // "
				..autoSafeThreatFilter
		)
	end

	locustSafeControls.teleport.Activated:Connect(function()
		local moved =
			teleportToSafePosition(
				SAFE_ZONE_1_POSITION,
				"SAFE ZONE // TELEPORTED",
				true,
				"SAFE ZONE"
			)

		if moved and previousSafeCFrame then
			setReturnReady(true)
		end
	end)

	locustSafeControls.teleport2.Activated:Connect(function()
		local moved =
			teleportToSafePosition(
				safeZone2Position,
				"SAFE ZONE 2 // TELEPORTED",
				true,
				"SAFE ZONE 2"
			)

		if moved and previousSafeCFrame then
			setReturnReady(true)
		end
	end)

	locustSafeControls.radiusApply.Activated:Connect(function()
		local value = tonumber(locustSafeControls.radiusBox.Text)

		if not value then
			locustSafeControls.radiusBox.Text =
				tostring(autoSafeRadius)
			setStatus("AUTO SAFE // INVALID RADIUS")
			return
		end

		autoSafeRadius =
			math.clamp(
				math.floor(value+.5),
				5,
				5000
			)

		gui:SetAttribute("AutoSafeRadius",autoSafeRadius)
		locustSafeControls.radiusBox.Text =
			tostring(autoSafeRadius)

		setStatus(
			"AUTO SAFE RADIUS // "
				..tostring(autoSafeRadius)
				.." STUDS"
		)
	end)

	locustSafeControls.filterApply.Activated:Connect(function()
		local value =
			tostring(locustSafeControls.filterBox.Text or "ALL")

		value =
			value:gsub("^%s+",""):gsub("%s+$","")

		if value == "" then
			value = "ALL"
		end

		autoSafeThreatFilter = string.upper(value)
		gui:SetAttribute(
			"AutoSafeThreatFilter",
			autoSafeThreatFilter
		)
		locustSafeControls.filterBox.Text =
			autoSafeThreatFilter

		clearKnownThreats()

		if autoSafeEnabled then
			autoSafeScanToken += 1
			local token = autoSafeScanToken
			task.spawn(function()
				scanExistingThreats(token,true)
			end)
		end

		setStatus(
			"AUTO SAFE THREATS // "
				..autoSafeThreatFilter
		)
	end)

	locustSafeControls.auto.Activated:Connect(function()
		if autoSafeEnabled and autoSafeMode == 1 then
			disableAutoSafe("AUTO SAFE ZONE OFF")
		else
			enableAutoSafe(1)
		end
	end)

	locustSafeControls.auto2.Activated:Connect(function()
		if autoSafeEnabled and autoSafeMode == 2 then
			disableAutoSafe("AUTO SAFE ZONE 2 OFF")
		else
			enableAutoSafe(2)
		end
	end)

	locustSafeControls.returnButton.Activated:Connect(function()
		if not previousSafeCFrame then
			setStatus(
				"AUTO SAFE RETURN // NO PREVIOUS POSITION YET"
			)
			return
		end

		if gui:GetAttribute("AutoSafeReturnReady") ~= true then
			setStatus(
				"AUTO SAFE RETURN // "
					..string.upper(returnWaitReason)
			)
			return
		end

		if not loadCharacter(2) then
			setStatus(
				"AUTO SAFE RETURN // CHARACTER NOT READY"
			)
			return
		end

		local currentCharacter = player.Character
		local currentRoot =
			currentCharacter
			and currentCharacter:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

		if not currentCharacter or not currentRoot then
			setStatus("AUTO SAFE RETURN // ROOT NOT FOUND")
			return
		end

		local destination = previousSafeCFrame
		previousSafeCFrame = nil
		safeClearStartedAt = nil
		setReturnReady(false)

		pcall(function()
			currentRoot.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
			currentRoot.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
			currentCharacter:PivotTo(destination)
		end)

		setStatus(
			"AUTO SAFE // RETURNED TO PREVIOUS POSITION"
		)
	end)

	workspace.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(object)
		if not autoSafeEnabled or menuDeleted then
			return
		end

		task.delay(.08,function()
			if autoSafeEnabled
				and object
				and object.Parent
				and not menuDeleted then
				rememberThreat(object)
			end
		end)
	end)

	local recoveryAccumulator = 0

	RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(deltaTime)
		if menuDeleted or not autoSafeEnabled then
			return
		end

		local safePosition = activeSafePosition()
		if not safePosition then
			disableAutoSafe(
				"AUTO SAFE // ACTIVE SAFE POSITION LOST"
			)
			return
		end

		recoveryAccumulator += deltaTime
		if recoveryAccumulator >= 2.5 then
			recoveryAccumulator = 0
			local token = autoSafeScanToken
			task.spawn(function()
				scanExistingThreats(token,false)
			end)
		end

		autoSafeAccumulator += deltaTime
		if autoSafeAccumulator < .12 then
			return
		end
		autoSafeAccumulator = 0

		local currentRoot =
			player.Character
			and player.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

		if not currentRoot then
			return
		end

		local now = os.clock()
		local inSafeZone =
			(currentRoot.Position-safePosition).Magnitude <= 12
		local dangerNearPrevious = false

		for monster in pairs(knownThreats) do
			if not monster
				or not monster.Parent
				or isPlayerCharacter(monster)
				or not threatMatches(monster) then
				knownThreats[monster] = nil
			else
				local monsterRoot = getRoot(monster)

				if not monsterRoot then
					knownThreats[monster] = nil
				else
					if previousSafeCFrame
						and (
							previousSafeCFrame.Position
							-monsterRoot.Position
						).Magnitude <= autoSafeRadius then
						dangerNearPrevious = true
					end

					if not inSafeZone then
						local distance =
							(
								currentRoot.Position
								-monsterRoot.Position
							).Magnitude

						if distance <= autoSafeRadius
							and now-autoSafeLastTrigger >= 1.25 then
							autoSafeLastTrigger = now

							teleportToSafePosition(
								safePosition,
								activeSafeName()
									.." AUTO // "
									..string.upper(
										tostring(monster.Name)
									)
									.." // "
									..tostring(
										math.floor(distance+.5)
									)
									.." STUDS",
								true,
								activeSafeName()
							)
							return
						end
					end
				end
			end
		end

		if inSafeZone and previousSafeCFrame then
			if dangerNearPrevious then
				safeClearStartedAt = nil
				setReturnReady(false,"MONSTER NEAR")
			else
				safeClearStartedAt =
					safeClearStartedAt or now

				if now-safeClearStartedAt
					>= RETURN_CLEAR_SECONDS then
					setReturnReady(true)
				end
			end
		end
	end)

	runtimeCore.stopEvent.Event:Connect(function()
		disableAutoSafe(nil)
	end)

	setReturnReady(false,"NO POSITION")
	syncAutoSafeToggles()

	gui:SetAttribute("AutoSafeRadius",autoSafeRadius)
	gui:SetAttribute(
		"AutoSafeThreatFilter",
		autoSafeThreatFilter
	)
	gui:SetAttribute("SafeZone2Set",true)
end)()

-- HOUSE OF THE LOCUST // V72 AUTO CABINET + ESP HIDES SEARCHED CABINETS + OPEN EXIT
;(function()
	local SAFE_ZONE_POSITION = Vector3.new(-61.6,35.0,306.9)
	local FLY_SPEED = 105
	local ARRIVE_DISTANCE = 4.25
	local MAX_TRAVEL_SECONDS = 7
	local STALL_SECONDS = 1.1
	local SAFE_CLEAR_SECONDS = 1.25

	local enabled = false
	local workerToken = 0
	local queue = {}
	local queuedRoots = setmetatable({}, {__mode = "k"})
	local searchedRoots = setmetatable({}, {__mode = "k"})
	local blockedUntil = setmetatable({}, {__mode = "k"})
	local originalHoldDurations = setmetatable({}, {__mode = "k"})
	local tapConnections = setmetatable({}, {__mode = "k"})
	local threats = setmetatable({}, {__mode = "k"})
	local activeCabinetRoot = nil
	local activeCabinetPart = nil
	local nearbyTargetFound = nil
	local nearbyTargetKind = nil
	local cabinetESP = {
		enabled = false,
		addPrompt = function() end,
		removeRoot = function() end,
		set = function() end
	}

	-- V66 forward declaration. cabinetThreat() is defined before the actual
	-- scanner implementation, so the shared local must exist first.
	local nearestThreat

	local function compact(value)
		return string.lower(
			tostring(value or "")
				:gsub("[%s_%-%p]+","")
		)
	end

	local function targetItemKind(objectOrName)
		local name
		if typeof(objectOrName) == "Instance" then
			name = compact(objectOrName.Name)
			if objectOrName:IsA("ProximityPrompt") then
				local promptName =
					compact(objectOrName.ObjectText)
					.." "
					..compact(objectOrName.ActionText)
				name = name.." "..promptName
			end
		else
			name = compact(objectOrName)
		end

		-- Check the more specific names before KEY so KeyCard is never
		-- accidentally reported as a normal key.
		if string.find(name,"wirecutter",1,true)
			or string.find(name,"wirecutters",1,true)
			or name == "cutter"
			or name == "cutters" then
			return "WIRE CUTTER"
		end

		if string.find(name,"keycard",1,true)
			or string.find(name,"cardkey",1,true)
			or string.find(name,"accesscard",1,true) then
			return "KEY CARD"
		end

		if name == "key"
			or name == "keyobtain"
			or name == "keypickup"
			or name == "doorkey"
			or name == "roomkey"
			or string.match(name,"^key%d+$") then
			return "KEY"
		end

		return nil
	end

	local function objectPart(object)
		if not object or not object.Parent then
			return nil
		end
		if object:IsA("BasePart") then
			return object
		end
		if object:IsA("Model") then
			return object.PrimaryPart
				or object:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart",true)
				or object:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart",true)
		end
		if object:IsA("Tool") then
			return object:FindFirstChild("Handle")
				or object:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart",true)
		end
		return object:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart",true)
	end

	local itemTracker = {
		found = {},
		required = {"KEY","WIRE CUTTER","KEY CARD"}
	}

	;(function()
		local function inventoryKinds()
			local kinds = {}
			for _,container in ipairs({
				player.Character,
				player:FindFirstChildOfClass("Backpack")
			}) do
				if container then
					for _,object in ipairs(container:GetDescendants()) do
						local kind = targetItemKind(object)
						if kind and not kinds[kind] then
							kinds[kind] = object
						end
					end
				end
			end
			return kinds
		end

		itemTracker.clear = function()
			table.clear(itemTracker.found)
		end

		itemTracker.mark = function(kind)
			if not kind or itemTracker.found[kind] then
				return false
			end
			itemTracker.found[kind] = true
			return true
		end

		itemTracker.hasFound = function(kind)
			return itemTracker.found[kind] == true
		end

		itemTracker.refreshOwnedIntoFound = function()
			local kinds = inventoryKinds()
			for kind in pairs(kinds) do
				itemTracker.found[kind] = true
			end
			return kinds
		end

		itemTracker.findNewInventory = function()
			local kinds = inventoryKinds()
			for _,kind in ipairs(itemTracker.required) do
				if kinds[kind] and not itemTracker.found[kind] then
					return kinds[kind],kind
				end
			end
			return nil,nil
		end

		itemTracker.allFound = function()
			for _,kind in ipairs(itemTracker.required) do
				if not itemTracker.found[kind] then
					return false
				end
			end
			return true
		end

		itemTracker.allOwned = function()
			local kinds = inventoryKinds()
			for _,kind in ipairs(itemTracker.required) do
				if not kinds[kind] then
					return false,kinds
				end
			end
			return true,kinds
		end

		itemTracker.missingFoundText = function()
			local missing = {}
			for _,kind in ipairs(itemTracker.required) do
				if not itemTracker.found[kind] then
					table.insert(missing,kind)
				end
			end
			return #missing > 0 and table.concat(missing," + ") or "NONE"
		end

		itemTracker.missingOwnedText = function()
			local kinds = inventoryKinds()
			local missing = {}
			for _,kind in ipairs(itemTracker.required) do
				if not kinds[kind] then
					table.insert(missing,kind)
				end
			end
			return #missing > 0 and table.concat(missing," + ") or "NONE"
		end

		itemTracker.inventoryKinds = inventoryKinds
	end)()

	local function targetInsideCabinet(cabinetRoot)
		if not cabinetRoot or not cabinetRoot.Parent then
			return nil,nil
		end

		for _,object in ipairs(cabinetRoot:GetDescendants()) do
			local kind = targetItemKind(object)
			if kind and not itemTracker.hasFound(kind) then
				return object,kind
			end

			if object:IsA("ProximityPrompt") then
				kind = targetItemKind(object)
				if kind and not itemTracker.hasFound(kind) then
					return object,kind
				end
			end
		end
		return nil,nil
	end

	local function isCabinetPrompt(prompt)
		if not prompt or not prompt:IsA("ProximityPrompt") then
			return false
		end

		local action = string.lower(tostring(prompt.ActionText or ""))
		local objectText = string.lower(tostring(prompt.ObjectText or ""))

		if string.find(objectText,"cabinet",1,true)
			or string.find(objectText,"drawer",1,true)
			or string.find(objectText,"locker",1,true) then
			return true
		end

		local cursor = prompt.Parent
		for _ = 1,9 do
			if not cursor or cursor == workspace then
				break
			end
			local lowerName = string.lower(tostring(cursor.Name or ""))
			if string.find(lowerName,"cabinet",1,true)
				or string.find(lowerName,"drawer",1,true)
				or string.find(lowerName,"locker",1,true) then
				return true
			end
			cursor = cursor.Parent
		end

		-- House of the Locust visually labels cabinet interactions as Search.
		-- Accept Search prompts as a fallback, but reject obvious non-container
		-- interactions so we do not fly to every prompt in the map.
		if string.find(action,"search",1,true) then
			local denied = {
				"door","lever","button","elevator","hide","closet",
				"bed","pickup","take","grab","open gate"
			}
			local combined = action.." "..objectText
			for _,word in ipairs(denied) do
				if string.find(combined,word,1,true) then
					return false
				end
			end
			return true
		end

		return false
	end

	local function makeCabinetTap(prompt)
		if not prompt
			or not prompt:IsA("ProximityPrompt")
			or not prompt.Parent
			or not isCabinetPrompt(prompt) then
			return false
		end

		if originalHoldDurations[prompt] == nil then
			originalHoldDurations[prompt] = prompt.HoldDuration
		end

		if not tapConnections[prompt] then
			tapConnections[prompt] =
				prompt:GetPropertyChangedSignal("HoldDuration"):Connect(function()
					if gui:GetAttribute("InstantCabinetTap") == true
						and prompt
						and prompt.Parent
						and prompt.HoldDuration ~= 0 then
						pcall(function()
							prompt.HoldDuration = 0
						end)
					end
				end)
		end

		pcall(function()
			prompt.HoldDuration = 0
		end)
		pcall(function()
			prompt.ClickablePrompt = true
		end)

		return true
	end

	local function restoreCabinetTap(prompt)
		if not prompt or not prompt.Parent then
			originalHoldDurations[prompt] = nil
			return
		end

		local original = originalHoldDurations[prompt]
		if original ~= nil then
			pcall(function()
				prompt.HoldDuration = original
			end)
			originalHoldDurations[prompt] = nil
		end
	end

	local function setInstantCabinetTap(value)
		value = value == true

		if value and gui:GetAttribute("SafeMode") == true then
			gui:SetAttribute("InstantCabinetTap",false)
			setToggle(
				locustSafeControls.instantCabinetTap,
				false,
				"INSTANT CABINET TAP"
			)
			setStatus("SAFE MODE // INSTANT CABINET TAP BLOCKED")
			return
		end

		gui:SetAttribute("InstantCabinetTap",value)
		setToggle(
			locustSafeControls.instantCabinetTap,
			value,
			"INSTANT CABINET TAP"
		)

		if value then
			gui:SetAttribute("RuntimeProfile","LOCUST")
			local changed = 0
			local descendants = workspace:GetDescendants()
			for index,object in ipairs(descendants) do
				if object:IsA("ProximityPrompt")
					and makeCabinetTap(object) then
					changed += 1
				end
				if index % 260 == 0 then
					task.wait()
				end
			end
			setStatus(
				"INSTANT CABINET TAP ON // "
					..tostring(changed)
					.." PROMPTS"
			)
		else
			for prompt in pairs(originalHoldDurations) do
				restoreCabinetTap(prompt)
			end
			setStatus("INSTANT CABINET TAP OFF")
		end
	end

	locustSafeControls.instantCabinetTap.Activated:Connect(function()
		setInstantCabinetTap(
			gui:GetAttribute("InstantCabinetTap") ~= true
		)
	end)

	local function resolveCabinet(prompt)
		if not isCabinetPrompt(prompt) then
			return nil,nil
		end

		local promptPart =
			prompt.Parent:IsA("BasePart")
			and prompt.Parent
			or prompt.Parent:FindFirstAncestorWhichIsA("BasePart")

		local cursor = prompt.Parent
		local nearestPart = promptPart
		for _ = 1,9 do
			if not cursor or cursor == workspace then
				break
			end

			if cursor:IsA("BasePart") and not nearestPart then
				nearestPart = cursor
			end

			local lowerName = string.lower(tostring(cursor.Name or ""))
			if string.find(lowerName,"cabinet",1,true)
				or string.find(lowerName,"drawer",1,true)
				or string.find(lowerName,"locker",1,true) then
				return cursor,objectPart(cursor) or nearestPart
			end
			cursor = cursor.Parent
		end

		-- If the game only exposes "Cabinet / Search" through the prompt and
		-- gives the physical model a random name, group by the nearest Model.
		local modelAncestor = prompt.Parent:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("Model")
		if modelAncestor and modelAncestor ~= player.Character then
			return modelAncestor,
				promptPart or objectPart(modelAncestor) or nearestPart
		end

		return prompt.Parent,promptPart or nearestPart
	end

	;(function()
		local folder = Instance.new("Folder")
		folder.Name = "NotRubyCabinetESP"
		folder.Parent = workspace

		local records = setmetatable({}, {__mode = "k"})
		local refreshToken = 0
		local maxDistance = 5000

		local function setCabinetScreenLine(line,startPoint,endPoint,thickness)
			if not line or not line.Parent then
				return
			end
			local delta = endPoint-startPoint
			local length = delta.Magnitude
			if length <= .5 then
				line.Visible = false
				return
			end
			line.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(startPoint.X,startPoint.Y)
			line.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(length,thickness or 2)
			line.Rotation = math.deg(math.atan2(delta.Y,delta.X))
			line.Visible = true
		end

		local function cabinetScreenPoint(part)
			camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
			if not camera or not part or not part.Parent then
				return nil
			end

			local point,onScreen =
				camera:WorldToViewportPoint(part.Position)

			if point.Z <= 0 then
				return nil
			end

			local viewport = camera.ViewportSize
			local margin = 24
			local x = math.clamp(
				point.X,
				margin,
				math.max(margin,viewport.X-margin)
			)
			local y = math.clamp(
				point.Y,
				margin,
				math.max(margin,viewport.Y-margin)
			)

			return Vector2.new(x,y),onScreen
		end

		local function getPart(rootObject,fallbackPart)
			if fallbackPart
				and fallbackPart:IsA("BasePart")
				and fallbackPart.Parent then
				return fallbackPart
			end
			if rootObject and rootObject:IsA("BasePart") then
				return rootObject
			end
			if rootObject and rootObject:IsA("Model") then
				return rootObject.PrimaryPart
					or rootObject:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart",true)
			end
			return rootObject
				and rootObject:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart",true)
				or nil
		end

		local function destroyRecord(rootObject)
			local record = records[rootObject]
			if not record then
				return
			end
			if record.highlight and record.highlight.Parent then
				record.highlight:Destroy()
			end
			if record.billboard and record.billboard.Parent then
				record.billboard:Destroy()
			end
			if record.line and record.line.Parent then
				record.line:Destroy()
			end
			records[rootObject] = nil
		end

		local function updateCount()
			local count = 0
			for rootObject,record in pairs(records) do
				if rootObject
					and rootObject.Parent
					and record
					and record.part
					and record.part.Parent then
					count += 1
				else
					destroyRecord(rootObject)
				end
			end
			gui:SetAttribute("CabinetESPCount",count)
			return count
		end

		cabinetESP.removeRoot = function(rootObject)
			destroyRecord(rootObject)
			updateCount()
		end

		local function clearAll()
			for rootObject in pairs(records) do
				destroyRecord(rootObject)
			end
			for _,object in ipairs(folder:GetChildren()) do
				object:Destroy()
			end
			gui:SetAttribute("CabinetESPCount",0)
		end

		cabinetESP.addPrompt = function(prompt)
			if not cabinetESP.enabled
				or not prompt
				or not prompt:IsA("ProximityPrompt")
				or not prompt.Parent
				or not isCabinetPrompt(prompt) then
				return false
			end

			local cabinetRoot,cabinetPart = resolveCabinet(prompt)
			if not cabinetRoot
				or not cabinetRoot.Parent
				or searchedRoots[cabinetRoot]
				or records[cabinetRoot] then
				return false
			end

			local part = getPart(cabinetRoot,cabinetPart)
			if not part or not part.Parent then
				return false
			end

			local highlight = Instance.new("Highlight")
			highlight.Name = "NotRubyCabinetESPHighlight"
			highlight.Adornee = cabinetRoot
			highlight.DepthMode = Enum.HighlightDepthMode.AlwaysOnTop
			highlight.FillColor = Color3.fromRGB(255,190,67)
			highlight.OutlineColor = Color3.fromRGB(255,238,180)
			highlight.FillTransparency = .82
			highlight.OutlineTransparency = .03
			highlight.Parent = folder

			local billboard = Instance.new("BillboardGui")
			billboard.Name = "NotRubyCabinetESPLabel"
			billboard.Adornee = part
			billboard.AlwaysOnTop = true
			billboard.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(190,34)
			billboard.StudsOffset = Vector3.new(0,2.25,0)
			billboard.MaxDistance = maxDistance
			billboard.Parent = gui

			local label = Instance.new("TextLabel")
			label.Name = "Label"
			label.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1,1)
			label.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(35,28,18)
			label.BackgroundTransparency = .18
			label.BorderSizePixel = 0
			label.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBlack
			label.TextSize = 9
			label.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255,231,175)
			label.TextStrokeTransparency = .55
			label.Text = "CABINET"
			label.Parent = billboard
			corner(label,8)
			addStroke(label,Color3.fromRGB(255,190,67),1,.28)

			local line = Instance.new("Frame")
			line.Name = "NotRubyCabinetESPLine"
			line.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0,.5)
			line.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255,190,67)
			line.BackgroundTransparency = .12
			line.BorderSizePixel = 0
			line.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(0,2)
			line.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0,0)
			line.Rotation = 0
			line.Visible = false
			line.ZIndex = 714
			line.Parent = gui
			corner(line,1000)

			records[cabinetRoot] = {
				highlight = highlight,
				billboard = billboard,
				label = label,
				line = line,
				part = part,
				prompt = prompt
			}
			return true
		end

		local function scanAll()
			if not cabinetESP.enabled or menuDeleted then
				return
			end

			local descendants = workspace:GetDescendants()
			for index,object in ipairs(descendants) do
				if not cabinetESP.enabled or menuDeleted then
					return
				end
				if object:IsA("ProximityPrompt") then
					cabinetESP.addPrompt(object)
				end
				if index % 260 == 0 then
					task.wait()
				end
			end

			local count = updateCount()
			setStatus("CABINET ESP // "..tostring(count).." FOUND")
		end

		cabinetESP.set = function(value)
			value = value == true

			if value and gui:GetAttribute("SafeMode") == true then
				cabinetESP.enabled = false
				gui:SetAttribute("CabinetESP",false)
				gui:SetAttribute("CabinetESPCount",0)
				setToggle(
					locustSafeControls.cabinetESP,
					false,
					"CABINET ESP"
				)
				setStatus("SAFE MODE // CABINET ESP BLOCKED")
				return
			end

			cabinetESP.enabled = value
			gui:SetAttribute("CabinetESP",value)
			refreshToken += 1
			local token = refreshToken

			setToggle(
				locustSafeControls.cabinetESP,
				value,
				"CABINET ESP"
			)

			if not value then
				clearAll()
				setStatus("CABINET ESP OFF")
				return
			end

			gui:SetAttribute("RuntimeProfile","LOCUST")
			setStatus("CABINET ESP // SCANNING")

			task.spawn(function()
				scanAll()

				while cabinetESP.enabled
					and token == refreshToken
					and not menuDeleted do

					local ownRoot =
						player.Character
						and player.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

					for rootObject,record in pairs(records) do
						if not rootObject
							or not rootObject.Parent
							or searchedRoots[rootObject]
							or not record
							or not record.part
							or not record.part.Parent then
							destroyRecord(rootObject)
						elseif record.label and record.label.Parent then
							if ownRoot then
								local distance =
									(ownRoot.Position-record.part.Position).Magnitude
								record.label.Text =
									"CABINET // "
									..tostring(math.floor(distance+.5))
									.." STUDS"

								camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
								local endpoint =
									cabinetScreenPoint(record.part)

								if camera
									and endpoint
									and distance <= maxDistance
									and record.line
									and record.line.Parent then
									local viewport = camera.ViewportSize
									local startPoint =
										Vector2.new(
											viewport.X*.5,
											viewport.Y*.88
										)
									setCabinetScreenLine(
										record.line,
										startPoint,
										endpoint,
										2
									)
									record.line.BackgroundColor3 =
										Color3.fromRGB(255,190,67)
								elseif record.line then
									record.line.Visible = false
								end
							else
								record.label.Text = "CABINET"
								if record.line then
									record.line.Visible = false
								end
							end
						end
					end

					updateCount()
					task.wait(.05)
				end
			end)
		end

		locustSafeControls.cabinetESP.Activated:Connect(function()
			cabinetESP.set(not cabinetESP.enabled)
		end)
	end)()

	local function promptPartFor(record)
		if record
			and record.prompt
			and record.prompt.Parent then
			local parent = record.prompt.Parent
			if parent:IsA("BasePart") then
				return parent
			end
			local part = parent:FindFirstAncestorWhichIsA("BasePart")
			if part then
				return part
			end
		end
		return record and record.part or nil
	end

	local function cabinetThreat(record)
		if not record then
			return nil,math.huge
		end

		local part = promptPartFor(record) or record.part
		if not part or not part.Parent then
			return nil,math.huge
		end

		local monster,distance = nearestThreat(part.Position)
		local radius =
			math.clamp(
				tonumber(gui:GetAttribute("AutoSafeRadius")) or 80,
				20,
				120
			)

		if monster and distance <= radius then
			return monster,distance
		end

		return nil,distance
	end

	local function temporarilyBlockCabinet(record,seconds)
		if record and record.root then
			blockedUntil[record.root] =
				os.clock() + math.max(tonumber(seconds) or 2.5,.5)
		end
	end

	local function requeueCabinet(record,seconds)
		if not record
			or not record.root
			or not record.root.Parent
			or not record.prompt
			or not record.prompt.Parent then
			return
		end

		temporarilyBlockCabinet(record,seconds)
		if not queuedRoots[record.root]
			and not searchedRoots[record.root] then
			queuedRoots[record.root] = true
			table.insert(queue,record)
		end
	end

	local function addCabinetPrompt(prompt)
		if not prompt or not prompt.Parent then
			return
		end

		if gui:GetAttribute("InstantCabinetTap") == true then
			makeCabinetTap(prompt)
		end

		if not enabled then
			return
		end

		local cabinetRoot,cabinetPart = resolveCabinet(prompt)
		if not cabinetRoot
			or not cabinetPart
			or queuedRoots[cabinetRoot]
			or searchedRoots[cabinetRoot] then
			return
		end

		queuedRoots[cabinetRoot] = true
		table.insert(queue,{
			root = cabinetRoot,
			part = cabinetPart,
			prompt = prompt
		})
	end

	local function scanCabinets(token)
		local before = #queue
		local descendants = workspace:GetDescendants()
		for index,object in ipairs(descendants) do
			if not enabled
				or token ~= workerToken
				or menuDeleted then
				return 0
			end

			if object:IsA("ProximityPrompt") then
				addCabinetPrompt(object)
			end

			if index % 240 == 0 then
				task.wait()
			end
		end
		return math.max(#queue-before,0)
	end

	local function rememberThreat(object)
		if not enabled or not object or not object.Parent then
			return
		end

		local cursor = object
		for _ = 1,12 do
			if not cursor or cursor == workspace then
				break
			end
			if cursor:IsA("Model")
				and isMonster(cursor)
				and not isPlayerCharacter(cursor) then
				local monsterRoot = getRoot(cursor)
				if monsterRoot then
					threats[cursor] = true
					return
				end
			end
			cursor = cursor.Parent
		end
	end

	local function scanThreats(token)
		local descendants = workspace:GetDescendants()
		for index,object in ipairs(descendants) do
			if not enabled
				or token ~= workerToken
				or menuDeleted then
				return
			end

			if object:IsA("Model") then
				rememberThreat(object)
			end

			if index % 240 == 0 then
				task.wait()
			end
		end
	end

	nearestThreat = function(position)
		local bestMonster = nil
		local bestDistance = math.huge

		for monster in pairs(threats) do
			if not monster
				or not monster.Parent
				or isPlayerCharacter(monster) then
				threats[monster] = nil
			else
				local monsterRoot = getRoot(monster)
				if not monsterRoot then
					threats[monster] = nil
				else
					local distance =
						(position-monsterRoot.Position).Magnitude
					if distance < bestDistance then
						bestDistance = distance
						bestMonster = monster
					end
				end
			end
		end

		return bestMonster,bestDistance
	end

	local function setCharacterCollision(character,enabledCollision,snapshot)
		if not character then
			return
		end

		for _,part in ipairs(character:GetDescendants()) do
			if part:IsA("BasePart") then
				if snapshot and snapshot[part] == nil then
					snapshot[part] = part.CanCollide
				end

				if enabledCollision == false then
					part.CanCollide = false
				elseif snapshot and snapshot[part] ~= nil then
					part.CanCollide = snapshot[part]
				end
			end
		end
	end

	local function safePivot(characterNow,rootNow,destination)
		if not characterNow or not rootNow then
			return false
		end

		pcall(function()
			rootNow.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
			rootNow.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
		end)

		local pivotOk = pcall(function()
			characterNow:PivotTo(destination)
		end)
		if pivotOk then
			return true
		end

		return pcall(function()
			rootNow.CFrame = destination
		end)
	end

	local function teleportSafe(token,monster,distance)
		if not enabled or token ~= workerToken then
			return false
		end
		if not loadCharacter(2) then
			return false
		end

		local characterNow = player.Character
		local rootNow =
			characterNow
			and characterNow:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		if not characterNow or not rootNow then
			return false
		end

		local _,yaw,_ = rootNow.CFrame:ToOrientation()
		local destination =
			CFrame.new(SAFE_ZONE_POSITION)
			* CFrame.Angles(0,yaw,0)

		if not safePivot(characterNow,rootNow,destination) then
			setStatus("AUTO CABINET // SAFE TELEPORT FAILED")
			return false
		end

		setStatus(
			"AUTO CABINET // MONSTER NEAR // SAFE ZONE // "
				..string.upper(tostring(monster and monster.Name or "THREAT"))
				.." // "
				..tostring(math.floor((distance or 0)+.5))
				.." STUDS"
		)

		local clearStarted = nil
		while enabled and token == workerToken and not menuDeleted do
			local currentRoot =
				player.Character
				and player.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
			if not currentRoot then
				task.wait(.1)
				continue
			end

			local radius =
				math.max(
					tonumber(gui:GetAttribute("AutoSafeRadius")) or 80,
					10
				)
			local _,dangerDistance = nearestThreat(currentRoot.Position)

			if dangerDistance <= radius then
				clearStarted = nil
			else
				clearStarted = clearStarted or os.clock()
				if os.clock()-clearStarted >= SAFE_CLEAR_SECONDS then
					setStatus("AUTO CABINET // SAFE // RESUMING SEARCH")
					return true
				end
			end
			task.wait(.12)
		end

		return false
	end

	local function dangerCheck(token)
		local currentRoot =
			player.Character
			and player.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		if not currentRoot then
			return false
		end

		local monster,distance = nearestThreat(currentRoot.Position)
		local radius =
			math.max(
				tonumber(gui:GetAttribute("AutoSafeRadius")) or 80,
				10
			)

		if monster and distance <= radius then
			return teleportSafe(token,monster,distance)
		end
		return true
	end

	local function cabinetDestination(record,rootNow)
		local part = promptPartFor(record)
		if not part or not part.Parent or not rootNow then
			return nil,nil
		end

		local away = rootNow.Position-part.Position
		away = Vector3.new(away.X,0,away.Z)

		if away.Magnitude < .2 then
			local fallback = -part.CFrame.LookVector
			away = Vector3.new(fallback.X,0,fallback.Z)
		end

		if away.Magnitude < .2 then
			away = Vector3.new(0,0,-1)
		else
			away = away.Unit
		end

		local activationDistance =
			record.prompt
			and tonumber(record.prompt.MaxActivationDistance)
			or 10
		local standDistance =
			math.clamp(activationDistance*.42,2.2,4.4)

		-- Keep HumanoidRootPart close to the prompt's vertical level. This works
		-- better than using a random cabinet model part that may be the roof/back.
		local targetPosition =
			part.Position
			+ away*standDistance
			+ Vector3.new(0,.35,0)

		local lookAt =
			Vector3.new(
				part.Position.X,
				targetPosition.Y,
				part.Position.Z
			)

		return CFrame.lookAt(targetPosition,lookAt),part
	end

	local function smartTravelToCabinet(record,token)
		if not record
			or not record.prompt
			or not record.prompt.Parent then
			return false
		end
		if not loadCharacter(2) then
			return false
		end

		local characterNow = player.Character
		local rootNow =
			characterNow
			and characterNow:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		if not characterNow or not rootNow then
			return false
		end

		local collisionSnapshot = {}
		setCharacterCollision(characterNow,false,collisionSnapshot)

		local started = os.clock()
		local lastProgress = started
		local bestDistance = math.huge
		local lastDangerCheck = 0
		local success = false

		while enabled
			and token == workerToken
			and not menuDeleted
			and record.prompt
			and record.prompt.Parent do

			characterNow = player.Character
			rootNow =
				characterNow
				and characterNow:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
			if not characterNow or not rootNow then
				break
			end

			local now = os.clock()
			if now-lastDangerCheck >= .10 then
				lastDangerCheck = now

				-- First check the CABINET itself. If a monster is guarding it,
				-- abandon this target and let the worker choose another cabinet.
				local cabinetMonster,cabinetDistance = cabinetThreat(record)
				if cabinetMonster then
					setCharacterCollision(characterNow,true,collisionSnapshot)
					return false,"CABINET_DANGER",cabinetMonster,cabinetDistance
				end

				-- Separately protect the player. A monster near the player still
				-- sends us to the configured safe zone before the route resumes.
				local monster,distance = nearestThreat(rootNow.Position)
				local radius =
					math.max(
						tonumber(gui:GetAttribute("AutoSafeRadius")) or 80,
						10
					)

				if monster and distance <= radius then
					setCharacterCollision(characterNow,true,collisionSnapshot)
					local escaped = teleportSafe(token,monster,distance)
					if not escaped then
						break
					end

					characterNow = player.Character
					rootNow =
						characterNow
						and characterNow:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
					if not characterNow or not rootNow then
						break
					end

					collisionSnapshot = {}
					setCharacterCollision(characterNow,false,collisionSnapshot)
					started = os.clock()
					lastProgress = started
					bestDistance = math.huge
				end
			end

			local targetCFrame,targetPart =
				cabinetDestination(record,rootNow)
			if not targetCFrame or not targetPart then
				break
			end

			local distance =
				(rootNow.Position-targetCFrame.Position).Magnitude

			if distance <= ARRIVE_DISTANCE then
				success = safePivot(
					characterNow,
					rootNow,
					targetCFrame
				)
				break
			end

			if distance < bestDistance-.35 then
				bestDistance = distance
				lastProgress = now
			end

			-- Normal movement: fly through the map toward the cabinet.
			local dt = RunService.Heartbeat:Wait()
			local offset = targetCFrame.Position-rootNow.Position
			local step =
				math.min(
					offset.Magnitude,
					FLY_SPEED*math.max(dt,1/120)
				)

			if offset.Magnitude > .001 then
				local nextPosition =
					rootNow.Position + offset.Unit*step
				local nextCFrame =
					CFrame.lookAt(
						nextPosition,
						Vector3.new(
							targetPart.Position.X,
							nextPosition.Y,
							targetPart.Position.Z
						)
					)
				safePivot(characterNow,rootNow,nextCFrame)
			end

			-- Smart fallback: if Roblox physics/server correction leaves us stuck,
			-- or the target is extremely far away, snap into prompt range instead
			-- of hanging forever.
			if now-lastProgress >= STALL_SECONDS
				or now-started >= MAX_TRAVEL_SECONDS then
				local cabinetMonster,cabinetDistance = cabinetThreat(record)
				if cabinetMonster then
					setCharacterCollision(characterNow,true,collisionSnapshot)
					return false,"CABINET_DANGER",cabinetMonster,cabinetDistance
				end

				if dangerCheck(token) then
					success =
						safePivot(
							characterNow,
							rootNow,
							targetCFrame
						)
					if success then
						setStatus(
							"AUTO CABINET // SMART TELEPORT // "
								..string.upper(
									tostring(record.root.Name or "CABINET")
								)
						)
					end
				end
				break
			end
		end

		setCharacterCollision(characterNow,true,collisionSnapshot)

		if success then
			local finalRoot =
				player.Character
				and player.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
			local targetCFrame =
				finalRoot
				and cabinetDestination(record,finalRoot)
				or nil
			if finalRoot and targetCFrame then
				safePivot(player.Character,finalRoot,targetCFrame)
			end
		end

		return success and enabled and token == workerToken
	end

	local function activatePrompt(prompt)
		if not prompt or not prompt.Parent then
			return false
		end

		local originalHold = prompt.HoldDuration
		local originalDistance = prompt.MaxActivationDistance
		local originalLineOfSight = prompt.RequiresLineOfSight

		-- AUTO SEARCH is always true one-tap, independent from the separate
		-- manual Instant Cabinet Tap toggle.
		pcall(function()
			prompt.HoldDuration = 0
			prompt.MaxActivationDistance =
				math.max(originalDistance,16)
			prompt.RequiresLineOfSight = false
			prompt.ClickablePrompt = true
		end)

		local ok = false

		-- Preferred executor path: a single prompt fire, with zero hold time.
		if typeof(fireproximityprompt) == "function" then
			ok = pcall(function()
				fireproximityprompt(prompt)
			end)

			-- Some executors expect an explicit hold-time argument.
			if not ok then
				ok = pcall(function()
					fireproximityprompt(prompt,0)
				end)
			end
		end

		-- Roblox fallback: begin/end immediately. There is deliberately no
		-- hold delay because HoldDuration is already zero.
		if not ok then
			ok = pcall(function()
				prompt:InputHoldBegin()
				prompt:InputHoldEnd()
			end)
		end

		-- Keep manual one-tap enabled if the user turned that feature on.
		-- Otherwise restore the cabinet's original manual interaction settings.
		if gui:GetAttribute("InstantCabinetTap") ~= true then
			task.defer(function()
				if prompt and prompt.Parent then
					pcall(function()
						prompt.HoldDuration = originalHold
						prompt.MaxActivationDistance = originalDistance
						prompt.RequiresLineOfSight = originalLineOfSight
					end)
				end
			end)
		else
			pcall(function()
				prompt.HoldDuration = 0
				prompt.MaxActivationDistance = originalDistance
				prompt.RequiresLineOfSight = originalLineOfSight
			end)
		end

		return ok
	end

	;(function()
		local busy = false

		local function exitRequirementKind(prompt)
			if not prompt or not prompt:IsA("ProximityPrompt") then
				return nil
			end

			local combined =
				compact(prompt.Name)
				..compact(prompt.ObjectText)
				..compact(prompt.ActionText)

			local cursor = prompt.Parent
			for _ = 1,10 do
				if not cursor or cursor == workspace then
					break
				end
				combined = combined..compact(cursor.Name)
				cursor = cursor.Parent
			end

			-- Specific before generic: KeycardReader must never become KEY.
			if string.find(combined,"keycardreader",1,true)
				or string.find(combined,"keycard",1,true)
				or string.find(combined,"cardreader",1,true)
				or string.find(combined,"accesscard",1,true) then
				return "KEY CARD"
			end

			if string.find(combined,"wirecutterneeded",1,true)
				or string.find(combined,"wirecutter",1,true)
				or string.find(combined,"wirecutters",1,true)
				or string.find(combined,"cutwire",1,true)
				or string.find(combined,"cutterneeded",1,true) then
				return "WIRE CUTTER"
			end

			if string.find(combined,"keyhole",1,true)
				or string.find(combined,"insertkey",1,true)
				or string.find(combined,"keyneeded",1,true)
				or string.find(combined,"usekey",1,true) then
				return "KEY"
			end

			return nil
		end

		local function findExitPrompt(kind)
			local ownRoot =
				player.Character
				and player.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
			local bestPrompt = nil
			local bestDistance = math.huge

			for _,object in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
				if object:IsA("ProximityPrompt")
					and exitRequirementKind(object) == kind then
					local part =
						object.Parent:IsA("BasePart")
						and object.Parent
						or object.Parent:FindFirstAncestorWhichIsA("BasePart")
						or objectPart(object.Parent)

					if part and part.Parent then
						local distance =
							ownRoot
							and (ownRoot.Position-part.Position).Magnitude
							or 0
						if distance < bestDistance then
							bestDistance = distance
							bestPrompt = object
						end
					end
				end
			end

			return bestPrompt
		end

		local function equipRequiredTool(kind)
			local backpack = player:FindFirstChildOfClass("Backpack")
			local currentCharacter = player.Character
			local tool = nil

			for _,container in ipairs({currentCharacter,backpack}) do
				if container then
					for _,object in ipairs(container:GetDescendants()) do
						if object:IsA("Tool")
							and targetItemKind(object) == kind then
							tool = object
							break
						end
					end
				end
				if tool then
					break
				end
			end

			if tool
				and backpack
				and tool.Parent == backpack
				and currentCharacter then
				local currentHumanoid =
					currentCharacter:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
				if currentHumanoid then
					pcall(function()
						currentHumanoid:EquipTool(tool)
					end)
				end
			end

			return tool
		end

		local function teleportAndUse(prompt,kind)
			if not prompt or not prompt.Parent or not loadCharacter(2) then
				return false,"TARGET LOST"
			end

			local currentCharacter = player.Character
			local currentRoot =
				currentCharacter
				and currentCharacter:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
			if not currentCharacter or not currentRoot then
				return false,"NO CHARACTER"
			end

			local part =
				prompt.Parent:IsA("BasePart")
				and prompt.Parent
				or prompt.Parent:FindFirstAncestorWhichIsA("BasePart")
				or objectPart(prompt.Parent)
			if not part or not part.Parent then
				return false,"NO EXIT PART"
			end

			equipRequiredTool(kind)

			local away = currentRoot.Position-part.Position
			away = Vector3.new(away.X,0,away.Z)
			if away.Magnitude < .2 then
				local fallback = -part.CFrame.LookVector
				away = Vector3.new(fallback.X,0,fallback.Z)
			end
			if away.Magnitude < .2 then
				away = Vector3.new(0,0,-1)
			else
				away = away.Unit
			end

			local standDistance =
				math.clamp(
					(tonumber(prompt.MaxActivationDistance) or 10)*.38,
					2.1,
					3.8
				)
			local targetPosition =
				part.Position
				+ away*standDistance
				+ Vector3.new(0,.35,0)
			local targetCFrame =
				CFrame.lookAt(
					targetPosition,
					Vector3.new(
						part.Position.X,
						targetPosition.Y,
						part.Position.Z
					)
				)

			local collisionSnapshot = {}
			setCharacterCollision(currentCharacter,false,collisionSnapshot)
			local moved = safePivot(
				currentCharacter,
				currentRoot,
				targetCFrame
			)
			setCharacterCollision(currentCharacter,true,collisionSnapshot)

			if not moved then
				return false,"TELEPORT FAILED"
			end

			task.wait(.12)
			local activated = activatePrompt(prompt)
			if not activated then
				return false,"INTERACT FAILED"
			end

			task.wait(.42)
			return true
		end

		locustSafeControls.openExit.Activated:Connect(function()
			if busy then
				setStatus("OPEN EXIT // ALREADY RUNNING")
				return
			end

			if gui:GetAttribute("SafeMode") == true then
				setStatus("SAFE MODE // OPEN EXIT BLOCKED")
				return
			end

			local allOwned = itemTracker.allOwned()
			if not allOwned then
				setStatus(
					"OPEN EXIT // MISSING: "
						..itemTracker.missingOwnedText()
				)
				return
			end

			busy = true
			gui:SetAttribute("OpenExitBusy",true)
			gui:SetAttribute("RuntimeProfile","LOCUST")

			task.spawn(function()
				local ok,err = xpcall(function()
					-- Fixed order matches the three required exit mechanisms.
					for _,kind in ipairs({
						"KEY",
						"WIRE CUTTER",
						"KEY CARD"
					}) do
						setStatus("OPEN EXIT // FINDING "..kind)
						local prompt = findExitPrompt(kind)
						if not prompt then
							error("COULD NOT FIND "..kind.." EXIT INTERACTION")
						end

						setStatus("OPEN EXIT // TELEPORTING TO "..kind)
						local used,reason = teleportAndUse(prompt,kind)
						if not used then
							error(kind.." // "..tostring(reason))
						end

						setStatus("OPEN EXIT // "..kind.." USED")
					end

					setStatus(
						"OPEN EXIT // ALL 3 EXIT INTERACTIONS ACTIVATED"
					)
				end,function(problem)
					return tostring(problem)
				end)

				if not ok then
					warn("[NOT RUBY OPEN EXIT] "..tostring(err))
					setStatus(
						"OPEN EXIT ERROR // "
							..string.sub(tostring(err),1,100)
					)
				end

				busy = false
				gui:SetAttribute("OpenExitBusy",false)
			end)
		end)
	end)()

	local function chooseNearestRecord()
		local currentRoot =
			player.Character
			and player.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

		local bestIndex = nil
		local bestDistance = math.huge
		local blockedCount = 0
		local now = os.clock()

		for index,record in ipairs(queue) do
			local part = promptPartFor(record) or (record and record.part)
			if record
				and record.root
				and record.root.Parent
				and part
				and part.Parent
				and record.prompt
				and record.prompt.Parent
				and not searchedRoots[record.root] then

				local blocked = blockedUntil[record.root]
				if blocked and blocked > now then
					blockedCount += 1
				else
					blockedUntil[record.root] = nil
					local guard = cabinetThreat(record)
					if guard then
						temporarilyBlockCabinet(record,2.5)
						blockedCount += 1
					else
						local distance =
							currentRoot
							and (currentRoot.Position-part.Position).Magnitude
							or index
						if distance < bestDistance then
							bestDistance = distance
							bestIndex = index
						end
					end
				end
			end
		end

		if not bestIndex then
			return nil,blockedCount
		end

		local record = table.remove(queue,bestIndex)
		if record and record.root then
			queuedRoots[record.root] = nil
		end
		return record,blockedCount
	end

	local function finish(reason,itemKind)
		if not enabled then
			return
		end

		enabled = false
		workerToken += 1
		gui:SetAttribute("AutoCabinetSearch",false)
		setToggle(
			locustSafeControls.autoCabinet,
			false,
			"AUTO CABINET SEARCH"
		)

		activeCabinetRoot = nil
		activeCabinetPart = nil
		nearbyTargetFound = nil
		nearbyTargetKind = nil

		if reason == "ALL_ITEMS" then
			setStatus(
				"AUTO CABINET // ALL 3 ITEMS FOUND // "
					.."KEY + WIRE CUTTER + KEY CARD // READY FOR OPEN EXIT"
			)
		elseif reason == "DONE" then
			local missing = itemTracker.missingFoundText()
			if missing == "NONE" then
				setStatus("AUTO CABINET // ALL 3 ITEMS FOUND")
			else
				setStatus(
					"AUTO CABINET // ALL CABINETS SEARCHED // MISSING: "
						..missing
				)
			end
		else
			setStatus("AUTO CABINET SEARCH OFF")
		end
	end

	local function findCurrentTarget()
		local object,kind = itemTracker.findNewInventory()
		if object and kind then
			return object,kind
		end

		if nearbyTargetFound and nearbyTargetKind then
			if not itemTracker.hasFound(nearbyTargetKind) then
				return nearbyTargetFound,nearbyTargetKind
			end
			nearbyTargetFound = nil
			nearbyTargetKind = nil
		end

		if activeCabinetRoot then
			return targetInsideCabinet(activeCabinetRoot)
		end
		return nil,nil
	end

	local function runWorker(token)
		setStatus("AUTO CABINET // SCANNING MONSTERS")
		scanThreats(token)

		if not enabled or token ~= workerToken then
			return
		end

		setStatus("AUTO CABINET // SCANNING CABINETS")
		local cabinetCount = scanCabinets(token)

		if not enabled or token ~= workerToken then
			return
		end

		if cabinetCount <= 0 and #queue <= 0 then
			setStatus("AUTO CABINET // NO SEARCH CABINETS FOUND")
		end

		local emptyPasses = 0
		while enabled and token == workerToken and not menuDeleted do
			local existingTarget,existingKind = findCurrentTarget()
			if existingTarget and existingKind then
				local newlyFound = itemTracker.mark(existingKind)
				nearbyTargetFound = nil
				nearbyTargetKind = nil
				if itemTracker.allFound() then
					finish("ALL_ITEMS")
					return
				elseif newlyFound then
					setStatus(
						"AUTO CABINET // "
							..existingKind
							.." FOUND // STILL NEED: "
							..itemTracker.missingFoundText()
					)
					task.wait(.12)
				end
			end

			local record,blockedCount = chooseNearestRecord()
			if not record then
				if blockedCount and blockedCount > 0 then
					emptyPasses = 0
					setStatus(
						"AUTO CABINET // "
							..tostring(blockedCount)
							.." GUARDED // WAITING FOR SAFE CABINET"
					)
					task.wait(.35)
					continue
				end

				emptyPasses += 1
				if emptyPasses >= 2 then
					finish("DONE")
					return
				end
				task.wait(.4)
				scanCabinets(token)
				continue
			end
			emptyPasses = 0

			activeCabinetRoot = record.root
			activeCabinetPart = promptPartFor(record) or record.part
			nearbyTargetFound = nil
			nearbyTargetKind = nil

			setStatus(
				"AUTO CABINET // FLYING TO "
					..string.upper(tostring(record.root.Name or "CABINET"))
			)

			if not dangerCheck(token) then
				return
			end

			local guard,guardDistance = cabinetThreat(record)
			if guard then
				requeueCabinet(record,2.5)
				setStatus(
					"AUTO CABINET // CABINET GUARDED // "
						..string.upper(tostring(guard.Name))
						.." // CHOOSING ANOTHER"
				)
				activeCabinetRoot = nil
				activeCabinetPart = nil
				task.wait(.05)
				continue
			end

			local reached,travelReason,travelMonster,travelDistance =
				smartTravelToCabinet(record,token)
			if not reached then
				if travelReason == "CABINET_DANGER" then
					requeueCabinet(record,2.5)
					setStatus(
						"AUTO CABINET // MONSTER NEAR CABINET // "
							..string.upper(
								tostring(
									travelMonster
										and travelMonster.Name
										or "THREAT"
								)
							)
							.." // CHOOSING ANOTHER"
					)
				elseif enabled and token == workerToken then
					-- A lost/destroyed cabinet should not be retried forever.
					searchedRoots[record.root] = true
					if cabinetESP.enabled then
						cabinetESP.removeRoot(record.root)
					end
					setStatus("AUTO CABINET // TARGET LOST // NEXT")
				end
				activeCabinetRoot = nil
				activeCabinetPart = nil
				continue
			end

			local target,targetKind = findCurrentTarget()
			if target and targetKind then
				local newlyFound = itemTracker.mark(targetKind)
				nearbyTargetFound = nil
				nearbyTargetKind = nil
				if itemTracker.allFound() then
					finish("ALL_ITEMS")
					return
				elseif newlyFound then
					setStatus(
						"AUTO CABINET // "
							..targetKind
							.." FOUND // CONTINUING FOR: "
							..itemTracker.missingFoundText()
					)
					task.wait(.12)
				end
			end

			local finalGuard = cabinetThreat(record)
			if finalGuard then
				requeueCabinet(record,2.5)
				setStatus("AUTO CABINET // CABINET BECAME UNSAFE // NEXT")
				activeCabinetRoot = nil
				activeCabinetPart = nil
				continue
			end

			searchedRoots[record.root] = true
			if cabinetESP.enabled then
				cabinetESP.removeRoot(record.root)
			end
			setStatus("AUTO CABINET // ONE-TAP SEARCHING CABINET")
			activatePrompt(record.prompt)

			local deadline = os.clock()+1.0
			repeat
				if not enabled or token ~= workerToken then
					return
				end

				target,targetKind = findCurrentTarget()
				if target and targetKind then
					local newlyFound = itemTracker.mark(targetKind)
					nearbyTargetFound = nil
					nearbyTargetKind = nil
					if itemTracker.allFound() then
						finish("ALL_ITEMS")
						return
					elseif newlyFound then
						setStatus(
							"AUTO CABINET // "
								..targetKind
								.." FOUND // STILL NEED: "
								..itemTracker.missingFoundText()
						)
					end
				end
				task.wait(.05)
			until os.clock() >= deadline

			setStatus("AUTO CABINET // EMPTY // NEXT CABINET")
			activeCabinetRoot = nil
			activeCabinetPart = nil
		end
	end

	locustSafeControls.autoCabinet.Activated:Connect(function()
		if not enabled and gui:GetAttribute("SafeMode") == true then
			setStatus("SAFE MODE // AUTO CABINET SEARCH BLOCKED")
			return
		end

		if enabled then
			finish("OFF")
			return
		end

		gui:SetAttribute("RuntimeProfile","LOCUST")
		enabled = true
		workerToken += 1
		local token = workerToken

		table.clear(queue)
		table.clear(queuedRoots)
		table.clear(searchedRoots)
		table.clear(blockedUntil)
		table.clear(threats)
		activeCabinetRoot = nil
		activeCabinetPart = nil
		nearbyTargetFound = nil
		nearbyTargetKind = nil

		gui:SetAttribute("AutoCabinetSearch",true)
		setToggle(
			locustSafeControls.autoCabinet,
			true,
			"AUTO CABINET SEARCH"
		)

		itemTracker.clear()
		itemTracker.refreshOwnedIntoFound()

		if itemTracker.allFound() then
			finish("ALL_ITEMS")
			return
		end

		setStatus(
			"AUTO CABINET // SEARCHING FOR: "
				..itemTracker.missingFoundText()
		)
		task.spawn(function()
			local ok,err = xpcall(function()
				runWorker(token)
			end,function(problem)
				return tostring(problem)
			end)

			if not ok
				and enabled
				and token == workerToken then
				warn("[NOT RUBY AUTO CABINET] "..tostring(err))
				setStatus(
					"AUTO CABINET ERROR // "
						..string.sub(tostring(err),1,90)
				)
				enabled = false
				workerToken += 1
				gui:SetAttribute("AutoCabinetSearch",false)
				setToggle(
					locustSafeControls.autoCabinet,
					false,
					"AUTO CABINET SEARCH"
				)
			end
		end)
	end)

	workspace.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(object)
		if menuDeleted then
			return
		end

		if object:IsA("ProximityPrompt") then
			task.defer(function()
				if object and object.Parent then
					if gui:GetAttribute("InstantCabinetTap") == true then
						makeCabinetTap(object)
					end
					if cabinetESP.enabled then
						cabinetESP.addPrompt(object)
					end
					if enabled then
						addCabinetPrompt(object)
					end
				end
			end)
		end

		if not enabled then
			return
		end

		if object:IsA("Model") then
			task.defer(function()
				if enabled and object and object.Parent then
					rememberThreat(object)
				end
			end)
		end

		local itemKind = targetItemKind(object)
		if itemKind then
			task.defer(function()
				if not enabled or not object or not object.Parent then
					return
				end

				local backpack =
					player:FindFirstChildOfClass("Backpack")
				local inInventory =
					(
						player.Character
						and object:IsDescendantOf(player.Character)
					)
					or (
						backpack
						and object:IsDescendantOf(backpack)
					)

				local associated = false
				if activeCabinetRoot
					and object:IsDescendantOf(activeCabinetRoot) then
					associated = true
				elseif activeCabinetPart then
					local part = objectPart(object)
					associated =
						part
						and (
							part.Position-activeCabinetPart.Position
						).Magnitude <= 22
						or false
				end

				if (inInventory or associated)
					and not itemTracker.hasFound(itemKind) then
					nearbyTargetFound = object
					nearbyTargetKind = itemKind
				end
			end)
		end
	end)

	runtimeCore.stopEvent.Event:Connect(function()
		if gui:GetAttribute("InstantCabinetTap") == true then
			setInstantCabinetTap(false)
		end
		if cabinetESP.enabled then
			cabinetESP.set(false)
		end
		gui:SetAttribute("OpenExitBusy",false)
		if enabled then
			finish("OFF")
		else
			gui:SetAttribute("AutoCabinetSearch",false)
			setToggle(
				locustSafeControls.autoCabinet,
				false,
				"AUTO CABINET SEARCH"
			)
		end
	end)
end)()

workspace.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(object)
	if menuDeleted or not runtimeCore.allows("LOCUST") then
		return
	end
	if not monsterLocator then
		return
	end
	task.defer(function()
		task.wait(.1)
		if not monsterLocator then
			return
		end
		local monster = findMonsterModel(object)
		if monster
			and not monsterMarkers[monster]
			and not isPlayerCharacter(monster) then
			createMarker(monster,monster.Name,true)
		end
	end)
end)
local markerTimer = 0
RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function(delta)
	if menuDeleted then
		return
	end
	markerTimer += delta
	if markerTimer < .2 then
		return
	end
	markerTimer = 0
	if not root then
		return
	end
	if monsterLocator and not runtimeCore.allows("LOCUST") then
		for _,data in pairs(monsterMarkers) do
			if data.gui then
				data.gui.Enabled = false
			end
		end
	elseif monsterLocator then
		for _,data in pairs(monsterMarkers) do
			if data.gui then
				data.gui.Enabled = true
			end
		end
	end
	for target,data in pairs(playerMarkers) do
		local targetRoot = getRoot(target)
		if not target.Parent or not targetRoot then
			removeMarker(playerMarkers,target)
		else
			local distance =
				math.floor((root.Position-targetRoot.Position).Magnitude)
			if distance > scanRadius then
				data.gui.Enabled = false
			else
				data.gui.Enabled = true
				data.distance.Text = "DISTANCE: "..tostring(distance)
			end
		end
	end
	for target,data in pairs(monsterMarkers) do
		local targetRoot = getRoot(target)
		if not target.Parent or not targetRoot then
			removeMarker(monsterMarkers,target)
		else
			local distance =
				math.floor((root.Position-targetRoot.Position).Magnitude)
			if distance > scanRadius then
				data.gui.Enabled = false
			else
				data.gui.Enabled = true
				data.distance.Text = "DISTANCE: "..tostring(distance)
			end
		end
	end
end)

fixCameraButton.Activated:Connect(function()
	-- Tell every isolated NOT RUBY camera feature to release the camera first.
	gui:SetAttribute(
		"CameraFixPulse",
		(tonumber(gui:GetAttribute("CameraFixPulse")) or 0)+1
	)

	local function hardRepairCamera()
		player.CameraMode = Enum.CameraMode.Classic

		pcall(function()
			player.CameraMinZoomDistance = .5
			player.CameraMaxZoomDistance = 128
		end)

		pcall(function()
			UIS.MouseBehavior = Enum.MouseBehavior.Default
		end)

		loadCharacter(1)

		local currentCharacter = player.Character
		local currentHumanoid =
			currentCharacter
			and currentCharacter:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
		local currentRoot =
			currentCharacter
			and currentCharacter:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		local currentHead =
			currentCharacter
			and currentCharacter:FindFirstChild("Head")

		camera = workspace.CurrentCamera

		if not camera then
			local replacement = Instance.new("Camera")
			replacement.Name = "NotRubyRecoveryCamera"
			replacement.Parent = workspace
			workspace.CurrentCamera = replacement
			camera = replacement
		end

		if not camera then
			return false
		end

		if currentHumanoid then
			pcall(function()
				currentHumanoid.CameraOffset = Vector3.zero
				currentHumanoid.AutoRotate = true
			end)
		end

		-- First force the camera out of a wall/stale CFrame while Scriptable.
		if currentRoot then
			local focusPosition =
				(currentHead and currentHead.Position)
				or (currentRoot.Position+Vector3.new(0,1.8,0))

			local back =
				-currentRoot.CFrame.LookVector
			local recoveryPosition =
				focusPosition
				+back*9
				+Vector3.new(0,2.8,0)

			pcall(function()
				camera.CameraType = Enum.CameraType.Scriptable
				camera.CFrame =
					CFrame.lookAt(recoveryPosition,focusPosition)
				camera.Focus = CFrame.new(focusPosition)
			end)
		end

		-- Hand the camera back to Roblox's normal controller.
		pcall(function()
			camera.CameraType = Enum.CameraType.Custom
		end)

		if currentHumanoid and currentHumanoid.Parent then
			pcall(function()
				camera.CameraSubject = currentHumanoid
			end)
		elseif currentRoot then
			pcall(function()
				camera.CameraSubject = currentRoot
			end)
		end

		pcall(function()
			camera.FieldOfView = originalFOV
		end)

		if fovBox and fovBox.Parent then
			fovBox.Text = tostring(math.floor(originalFOV))
		end

		return true
	end

	local repaired = hardRepairCamera()

	-- Several passes beat one-frame camera locks from old local states.
	for _,delaySeconds in ipairs({.03,.10,.25,.55,1.0}) do
		task.delay(delaySeconds,function()
			if not menuDeleted and gui.Parent then
				hardRepairCamera()
			end
		end)
	end

	setStatus(
		repaired
			and "CAMERA HARD FIX APPLIED"
			or "CAMERA HARD FIX FAILED"
	)
end)

	setMonsterLocator(false)
end)
