		corner(heatGlow,1000)

		local heatScale = Instance.new("UIScale")
		heatScale.Name = "HeatGlowPulseScale"
		heatScale.Scale = .86
		heatScale.Parent = heatGlow

		TweenService:Create(
			heatScale,
			TweenInfo.new(
				.64,
				Enum.EasingStyle.Sine,
				Enum.EasingDirection.InOut,
				-1,
				true
			),
			{Scale = 1.14}
		):Play()

		TweenService:Create(
			heatGlow,
			TweenInfo.new(
				.64,
				Enum.EasingStyle.Sine,
				Enum.EasingDirection.InOut,
				-1,
				true
			),
			{
				BackgroundTransparency = .90,
				BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255,146,47)
			}
		):Play()

		local fireRing = Instance.new("Frame")
		fireRing.Name = "MiniFirePulseRing"
		fireRing.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(.5,.5)
		fireRing.Position = UDim2.fromScale(.5,.5)
		fireRing.Size = UDim2.new(1,6,1,6)
		fireRing.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		fireRing.BorderSizePixel = 0
		fireRing.ZIndex = visualShell.ZIndex-1
		fireRing.Parent = visualShell

		local fireRingCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
		fireRingCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(.5,0)
		fireRingCorner.Parent = fireRing

		local fireRingStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
		fireRingStroke.Name = "FirePulseStroke"
		fireRingStroke.ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border
		fireRingStroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255,103,38)
		fireRingStroke.Thickness = 1.4
		fireRingStroke.Transparency = .58
		fireRingStroke:SetAttribute("NotRubyFixedColor",true)
		fireRingStroke.Parent = fireRing

		local ringScale = Instance.new("UIScale")
		ringScale.Name = "FireRingPulseScale"
		ringScale.Scale = .94
		ringScale.Parent = fireRing

		TweenService:Create(
			ringScale,
			TweenInfo.new(
				.86,
				Enum.EasingStyle.Sine,
				Enum.EasingDirection.InOut,
				-1,
				true
			),
			{Scale = 1.13}
		):Play()

		TweenService:Create(
			fireRingStroke,
			TweenInfo.new(
				.86,
				Enum.EasingStyle.Sine,
				Enum.EasingDirection.InOut,
				-1,
				true
			),
			{
				Transparency = .82,
				Thickness = 3.2,
				Color = Color3.fromRGB(255,177,68)
			}
		):Play()

		-- Pulse the clean mini outline a little with the fire.
		if shellStroke and shellStroke.Parent then
			shellStroke:SetAttribute("NotRubyFixedColor",true)
			TweenService:Create(
				shellStroke,
				TweenInfo.new(
					.78,
					Enum.EasingStyle.Sine,
					Enum.EasingDirection.InOut,
					-1,
					true
				),
				{
					Color = Color3.fromRGB(255,122,45),
					Thickness = 2.2,
					Transparency = .28
				}
			):Play()
		end

		local fireColors = {
			Color3.fromRGB(255,54,28),
			Color3.fromRGB(255,91,31),
			Color3.fromRGB(255,133,35),
			Color3.fromRGB(255,181,52),
			Color3.fromRGB(255,222,111)
		}

		local function emitFlame(core)
			if menuDeleted
				or not gui.Parent
				or not openButton.Parent
				or not visualShell.Parent then
				return
			end

			local flame = Instance.new("Frame")
			flame.Name = core and "MiniCoreFlame" or "MiniOuterFlame"
			flame.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(.5,1)
			flame.BorderSizePixel = 0
			flame.BackgroundColor3 =
				core
				and Color3.fromRGB(255,218,91)
				or fireColors[math.random(1,#fireColors)]
			flame.BackgroundTransparency = core and .04 or .10
			flame.ZIndex = fireHost.ZIndex + (core and 3 or 2)

			local startX =
				core
				and math.random(35,65)/100
				or math.random(18,82)/100

			local width =
				core
				and math.random(4,7)
				or math.random(5,10)

			local height =
				core
				and math.random(12,20)
				or math.random(16,29)

			local rise =
				core
				and math.random(24,36)
				or math.random(30,48)

			flame.Position = UDim2.new(startX,0,1,1)
			flame.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(width,height)
			flame.Rotation =
				core
				and math.random(-9,9)
				or math.random(-18,18)
			flame.Parent = fireHost
			corner(flame,1000)

			local gradient = Instance.new("UIGradient")
			gradient.Name = "FlameGradient"
			gradient.Rotation = 90
			gradient.Color = ColorSequence.new({
				ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(
					0,
					Color3.fromRGB(255,245,171)
				),
				ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(
					.32,
					core
					and Color3.fromRGB(255,215,82)
					or Color3.fromRGB(255,158,41)
				),
				ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(
					.68,
					flame.BackgroundColor3
				),
				ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(
					1,
					Color3.fromRGB(152,26,34)
				)
			})
			gradient.Transparency = NumberSequence.new({
				NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0,.04),
				NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(.55,.02),
				NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1,.54)
			})
			gradient.Parent = flame

			local scale = Instance.new("UIScale")
			scale.Name = "FlameScale"
			scale.Scale = core and .72 or .78
			scale.Parent = flame

			TweenService:Create(
				scale,
				TweenInfo.new(
					core and .30 or .44,
					Enum.EasingStyle.Sine,
					Enum.EasingDirection.Out
				),
				{Scale = core and 1.02 or 1.18}
			):Play()

			local tween = TweenService:Create(
				flame,
				TweenInfo.new(
					core
					and math.random(28,40)/100
					or math.random(38,56)/100,
					Enum.EasingStyle.Quad,
					Enum.EasingDirection.Out
				),
				{
					Position = UDim2.new(
						startX,
						math.random(-8,8),
						0,
						-rise
					),
					Size = UDim2.fromOffset(
						math.max(2,width-2),
						math.max(5,height-7)
					),
					Rotation =
						flame.Rotation
						+math.random(-24,24),
					BackgroundTransparency = 1
				}
			)

			tween:Play()
			tween.Completed:Connect(function()
				if flame then
					flame:Destroy()
				end
			end)
		end

		local function emitSpark()
			if menuDeleted
				or not gui.Parent
				or not visualShell.Parent then
				return
			end

			local spark = Instance.new("Frame")
			spark.Name = "MiniFireEmber"
			spark.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(.5,.5)
			spark.Position =
				UDim2.new(
					math.random(27,73)/100,
					0,
					1,
					-math.random(1,7)
				)
			spark.Size =
				UDim2.fromOffset(
					math.random(2,3),
					math.random(2,4)
				)
			spark.BackgroundColor3 =
				math.random(1,2) == 1
				and Color3.fromRGB(255,209,78)
				or Color3.fromRGB(255,112,34)
			spark.BackgroundTransparency = .05
			spark.BorderSizePixel = 0
			spark.ZIndex = fireHost.ZIndex+4
			spark.Parent = fireHost
			corner(spark,1000)

			local sparkTween = TweenService:Create(
				spark,
				TweenInfo.new(
					math.random(36,62)/100,
					Enum.EasingStyle.Quad,
					Enum.EasingDirection.Out
				),
				{
					Position = UDim2.new(
						spark.Position.X.Scale,
						math.random(-14,14),
						0,
						-math.random(30,52)
					),
					BackgroundTransparency = 1,
					Rotation = math.random(-90,90)
				}
			)

			sparkTween:Play()
			sparkTween.Completed:Connect(function()
				if spark then
					spark:Destroy()
				end
			end)
		end

		task.spawn(function()
			while gui.Parent
				and openButton.Parent
				and visualShell.Parent
				and not menuDeleted do

				if gui:GetAttribute("ReduceMotion") == true then
					task.wait(.30)
				else
					-- Outer flame pair.
					emitFlame(false)
					if math.random(1,100) <= 68 then
						emitFlame(false)
					end

					-- Bright inner core.
					if math.random(1,100) <= 82 then
						emitFlame(true)
					end

					-- Embers/sparks.
					if math.random(1,100) <= 58 then
						emitSpark()
					end
					if math.random(1,100) <= 24 then
						emitSpark()
					end

					task.wait(math.random(9,14)/100)
				end
			end
		end)
	end)()

	-- Keep every visual FX object passive. Only MiniTouchHitbox and
	-- MiniResizeGrip are allowed to receive intentional mini-tab input.
	for _,object in ipairs(visualShell:GetDescendants()) do
		if object:IsA("GuiObject") then
			object.Active = false
			object.Selectable = false
			pcall(function()
				object.Interactable = false
			end)
		end
	end

	visualShell.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(object)
		if object:IsA("GuiObject") then
			object.Active = false
			object.Selectable = false
			pcall(function()
				object.Interactable = false
			end)
		end
	end)

	local panelGlow = Instance.new("UIStroke")
	panelGlow.Name = "MenuCleanGlow"
	panelGlow.ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border
	panelGlow.Color = gui:GetAttribute("OutlineColor") or accent
	panelGlow.Thickness = 3.2
	panelGlow.Transparency = .78
	panelGlow.Parent = panel

	TweenService:Create(
		panelGlow,
		TweenInfo.new(
			1.25,
			Enum.EasingStyle.Sine,
			Enum.EasingDirection.InOut,
			-1,
			true
		),
		{Transparency = .48, Thickness = 4.4}
	):Play()

	local cleanRail = Instance.new("Frame")
	cleanRail.Name = "MenuCleanTopRail"
	cleanRail.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(.5,0)
	cleanRail.Position = UDim2.new(.5,0,0,0)
	cleanRail.Size = UDim2.new(.24,0,0,2)
	cleanRail.BackgroundColor3 = gui:GetAttribute("OutlineColor") or accent
	cleanRail.BackgroundTransparency = .30
	cleanRail.BorderSizePixel = 0
	cleanRail.ZIndex = 220
	cleanRail.Parent = panel
	corner(cleanRail,1000)

	TweenService:Create(
		cleanRail,
		TweenInfo.new(
			1.35,
			Enum.EasingStyle.Sine,
			Enum.EasingDirection.InOut,
			-1,
			true
		),
		{Size = UDim2.new(.56,0,0,2), BackgroundTransparency = .52}
	):Play()
end)()

local miniBlockClickUntil = 0
local miniTapEligible = false
local miniJustDragged = false

do
local function setupMiniTabDrag()
	local miniDragging = false
	local miniDragInput
	local miniDragStart
	local miniStartAbsolute
	local miniStartUDimPosition
	local miniWasDragged = false

	local function insideMiniCircle(position)
		if not position or not miniTouchHitbox or not miniTouchHitbox.Parent then
			return false
		end

		local p = miniTouchHitbox.AbsolutePosition
		local s = miniTouchHitbox.AbsoluteSize
		local radius = math.min(s.X,s.Y)*.49
		local dx = position.X-(p.X+s.X*.5)
		local dy = position.Y-(p.Y+s.Y*.5)
		return dx*dx+dy*dy <= radius*radius
	end

	miniTouchHitbox.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
		if input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.Touch
			and input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
			return
		end

		-- UICorner only changes appearance in Roblox, not the rectangular
		-- GUI hit-test. Reject the invisible square corners manually.
		miniTapEligible = insideMiniCircle(input.Position)
		if not miniTapEligible then
			return
		end

		-- Do not start dragging from the resize grip.
		local grip = openButton:FindFirstChild("MiniResizeGrip")
		if grip then
			local p = input.Position
			local gp = grip.AbsolutePosition
			local gs = grip.AbsoluteSize
			if p.X >= gp.X and p.X <= gp.X + gs.X
				and p.Y >= gp.Y and p.Y <= gp.Y + gs.Y then
				miniTapEligible = false
				return
			end
		end

		miniDragging = true
		miniDragInput = input
		miniDragStart = input.Position
		miniStartAbsolute = openButton.AbsolutePosition
		miniStartUDimPosition = openButton.Position
		miniWasDragged = false
		miniJustDragged = false
	end)

	UIS.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
		if not miniDragging
			or not miniDragStart
			or not miniStartAbsolute
			or not miniStartUDimPosition then
			return
		end

		local validInput =
			input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement
			or (
				input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch
				and input == miniDragInput
			)

		if not validInput then
			return
		end

		local delta = input.Position-miniDragStart

		-- Mobile tap jitter stays a tap. The instant we pass the real drag
		-- threshold, lock this gesture as DRAG before release so Activated
		-- can never race InputEnded and reopen/close the menu.
		if delta.Magnitude < 8 then
			return
		end

		if not miniWasDragged then
			miniWasDragged = true
			miniJustDragged = true
			miniTapEligible = false
			miniBlockClickUntil = os.clock()+.55
		end

		camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
		local viewport =
			camera and camera.ViewportSize
			or Vector2.new(1000,700)

		local size = openButton.AbsoluteSize
		local minDX = 4-miniStartAbsolute.X
		local maxDX =
			viewport.X-miniStartAbsolute.X-size.X-4
		local minDY = 4-miniStartAbsolute.Y
		local maxDY =
			viewport.Y-miniStartAbsolute.Y-size.Y-4

		local appliedX = math.clamp(
			delta.X,
			minDX,
			math.max(minDX,maxDX)
		)
		local appliedY = math.clamp(
			delta.Y,
			minDY,
			math.max(minDY,maxDY)
		)

		openButton.Position = UDim2.new(
			miniStartUDimPosition.X.Scale,
			miniStartUDimPosition.X.Offset+appliedX,
			miniStartUDimPosition.Y.Scale,
			miniStartUDimPosition.Y.Offset+appliedY
		)
	end)

	UIS.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
		if not miniDragging then
			return
		end

		if input == miniDragInput
			or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then

			-- A tap must both start and finish inside the real circular core.
			if not miniWasDragged then
				miniTapEligible =
					miniTapEligible
					and insideMiniCircle(input.Position)
			else
				miniTapEligible = false
				miniBlockClickUntil = os.clock()+.55
			end

			miniDragging = false
			miniDragInput = nil
			miniDragStart = nil
			miniStartAbsolute = nil
			miniStartUDimPosition = nil

			if miniWasDragged then
				task.delay(.58,function()
					if os.clock() >= miniBlockClickUntil then
						miniJustDragged = false
					end
				end)
			end
		end
	end)
end
safeSetup("Dragon Button Drag",setupMiniTabDrag)

end
do
local function setupMiniTabResize()
	local grip = Instance.new("TextButton")
	grip.Name = "MiniResizeGrip"
	grip.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1,1)
	grip.Position = UDim2.new(1,-2,1,-2)
	grip.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(10,10)
	grip.Text = ""
	grip.TextSize = 1
	grip.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBlack
	grip.TextColor3 = accent
	grip.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(38,16,22)
	grip.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	grip.BorderSizePixel = 0
	grip.AutoButtonColor = false
	grip.Active = true
	grip.ZIndex = miniTouchHitbox.ZIndex+2
	grip.Parent = openButton
	corner(grip,1000)

	local resizing = false
	local resizeCommitted = false
	local resizeInput
	local resizeStart
	local startSize
	local resizeStartPosition
	local resizeStartAbsolute

	grip.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
		if input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.Touch
			and input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
			return
		end

		resizing = true
		resizeCommitted = false
		resizeInput = input
		resizeStart = input.Position
		startSize = openButton.AbsoluteSize
		resizeStartPosition = openButton.Position
		resizeStartAbsolute = openButton.AbsolutePosition
	end)

	UIS.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
		if not resizing
			or not resizeStart
			or not startSize
			or not resizeStartAbsolute then
			return
		end

		local valid =
			input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement
			or (
				input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch
				and input == resizeInput
			)

		if not valid then
			return
		end

		camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
		local viewport = camera and camera.ViewportSize or Vector2.new(1000,700)
		local pos = resizeStartAbsolute
		local delta = input.Position - resizeStart

		-- Resize only after a deliberate movement from the tiny corner grip.
		-- This greatly reduces accidental resizing while moving the small tab.
		if not resizeCommitted then
			if delta.Magnitude < 7 then
				return
			end
			resizeCommitted = true
		end

		local startDiameter =
			math.max(startSize.X,startSize.Y)
		local startCenter =
			Vector2.new(
				pos.X + startSize.X*.5,
				pos.Y + startSize.Y*.5
			)

		-- Limit diameter equally around the center. This makes resizing look
		-- like one circle smoothly growing into another circle.
		local maxSize = math.max(
			34,
			math.min(
				140,
				(startCenter.X-4)*2,
				(viewport.X-startCenter.X-4)*2,
				(startCenter.Y-4)*2,
				(viewport.Y-startCenter.Y-4)*2
			)
		)

		local radialDelta =
			(delta.X+delta.Y)*.5

		local size = math.clamp(
			startDiameter + radialDelta,
			34,
			maxSize
		)

		local halfChange = (size-startDiameter)*.5

		openButton.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(size,size)

		if resizeStartPosition then
			openButton.Position =
				UDim2.new(
					resizeStartPosition.X.Scale,
					resizeStartPosition.X.Offset-halfChange,
					resizeStartPosition.Y.Scale,
					resizeStartPosition.Y.Offset-halfChange
				)
		end

		local buttonCorner = openButton:FindFirstChildOfClass("UICorner")
		if buttonCorner then
			buttonCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(.5,0)
		end

		local visualShell = openButton:FindFirstChild("MiniVisualShell")
		if visualShell and visualShell:IsA("Frame") then
			local shellCorner = visualShell:FindFirstChildOfClass("UICorner")
			if shellCorner then
				shellCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(.5,0)
			end

			local brandImage = visualShell:FindFirstChild("BrandImage")
			if brandImage and brandImage:IsA("ImageLabel") then
				brandImage.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1,1)
				brandImage.ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Crop
				local brandCorner = brandImage:FindFirstChildOfClass("UICorner")
				if brandCorner then
					brandCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(.5,0)
				end
			end
		end

		-- Keep the mini photo tab proportional.
		openButton.TextSize = math.clamp(
			math.floor(size * .46),
			16,
			42
		)

		-- Keep the resize grip usable at all sizes.
		local gripSize = math.clamp(
			math.floor(size * .16),
			8,
			14
		)
		grip.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(gripSize,gripSize)
		grip.TextSize = math.clamp(
			math.floor(gripSize * .55),
			7,
			12
		)
	end)

	UIS.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
		if resizing
			and (
				input == resizeInput
				or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
			) then
			resizing = false
			resizeCommitted = false
			resizeInput = nil
			resizeStart = nil
			startSize = nil
			resizeStartPosition = nil
			resizeStartAbsolute = nil
		end
	end)
end
safeSetup("Dragon Button Resize",setupMiniTabResize)

end
local function minimizePanel()
	if menuDeleted
		or not panel.Visible
		or panel:GetAttribute("MenuTransitionBusy") then
		return
	end

	panel:SetAttribute("MenuTransitionBusy",true)

	-- Preserve the user's exact layout before the reference-style close.
	panel:SetAttribute("MenuRestoreXS",panel.Position.X.Scale)
	panel:SetAttribute("MenuRestoreXO",panel.Position.X.Offset)
	panel:SetAttribute("MenuRestoreYS",panel.Position.Y.Scale)
	panel:SetAttribute("MenuRestoreYO",panel.Position.Y.Offset)
	panel:SetAttribute("MenuRestoreW",panel.Size.X.Offset)
	panel:SetAttribute("MenuRestoreH",panel.Size.Y.Offset)

	local restorePosition = panel.Position
	local restoreWidth = panel.Size.X.Offset
	local restoreHeight = panel.Size.Y.Offset
	local restoreClips = panel.ClipsDescendants
	local panelScale = panel:FindFirstChild("SmoothScale")
	local restorePanelScale =
		tonumber(gui:GetAttribute("PanelScale")) or 1

	local absoluteStart = panel.AbsolutePosition
	local miniPosition = openButton.AbsolutePosition
	local miniSize = openButton.AbsoluteSize

	-- Width of the "left menu only" stage seen in the supplied reference.
	local railWidth =
		math.clamp(
			math.floor(restoreWidth*.27),
			158,
			186
		)

	local railPosition =
		UDim2.fromOffset(
			absoluteStart.X,
			absoluteStart.Y
		)

	panel.ClipsDescendants = true

	if panelScale then
		panelScale.Scale = 1
	end

	-- Keep the photo launcher visible the entire time, like the reference.
	openButton.Visible = true

	task.spawn(function()
		-- STAGE 1 // fold the large/right content away first.
		-- The sidebar remains visible for a moment by itself.
		local foldContent =
			TweenService:Create(
				panel,
				TweenInfo.new(
					.18,
					Enum.EasingStyle.Quart,
					Enum.EasingDirection.InOut
				),
				{
					Position = railPosition,
					Size =
						UDim2.fromOffset(
							railWidth,
							restoreHeight
						)
				}
			)

		foldContent:Play()

		task.delay(.045,function()
			if panel:GetAttribute("MenuTransitionBusy") then
				content.Visible = false
			end
		end)

		foldContent.Completed:Wait()

		if menuDeleted then
			return
		end

		-- STAGE 2 // the remaining sidebar rail compresses into a small card
		-- while moving toward the always-visible photo launcher.
		local railCoreWidth =
			math.clamp(
				railWidth,
				150,
				180
			)
		local railCoreHeight = 56

		local panelNow = panel.AbsolutePosition
		local panelNowSize = panel.AbsoluteSize
		local panelNowCenter =
			Vector2.new(
				panelNow.X + panelNowSize.X*.5,
				panelNow.Y + panelNowSize.Y*.5
			)
		local miniCenter =
			Vector2.new(
				miniPosition.X + miniSize.X*.5,
				miniPosition.Y + miniSize.Y*.5
			)
		local coreCenter =
			panelNowCenter:Lerp(
				miniCenter,
				.62
			)

		sidebar.Visible = false

		local collapseRail =
			TweenService:Create(
				panel,
				TweenInfo.new(
					.15,
					Enum.EasingStyle.Quint,
					Enum.EasingDirection.In
				),
				{
					Position =
						UDim2.fromOffset(
							coreCenter.X-railCoreWidth*.5,
							coreCenter.Y-railCoreHeight*.5
						),
					Size =
						UDim2.fromOffset(
							railCoreWidth,
							railCoreHeight
						)
				}
			)

		collapseRail:Play()
		collapseRail.Completed:Wait()

		if menuDeleted then
			return
		end

		-- STAGE 3 // pull the final card directly into the photo button.
		local intoLauncher =
			TweenService:Create(
				panel,
				TweenInfo.new(
					.14,
					Enum.EasingStyle.Quart,
					Enum.EasingDirection.In
				),
				{
					Position =
						UDim2.fromOffset(
							miniPosition.X,
							miniPosition.Y
						),
					Size =
						UDim2.fromOffset(
							math.max(34,miniSize.X),
							math.max(34,miniSize.Y)
						)
				}
			)

		intoLauncher:Play()
		intoLauncher.Completed:Wait()

		if menuDeleted then
			return
		end

		panel.Visible = false

		-- Restore the real menu invisibly, so resizing/dragging settings survive.
		panel.Position = restorePosition
		panel.Size =
			UDim2.fromOffset(
				restoreWidth,
				restoreHeight
			)
		panel.ClipsDescendants = restoreClips
		sidebar.Visible = true
		content.Visible = true

		if panelScale then
			panelScale.Scale = restorePanelScale
		end

		local miniScale =
			openButton:FindFirstChild("SmoothScale")

		if miniScale then
			miniScale.Scale = .82

			TweenService:Create(
				miniScale,
				TweenInfo.new(
					.20,
					Enum.EasingStyle.Back,
					Enum.EasingDirection.Out
				),
				{Scale = 1}
			):Play()
		end

		panel:SetAttribute("MenuTransitionBusy",false)
	end)

	flightControls.Visible = flying
end

local function reopenPanel()
	if menuDeleted
		or panel.Visible
		or panel:GetAttribute("MenuTransitionBusy") then
		return
	end

	panel:SetAttribute("MenuTransitionBusy",true)
	flightControls.Visible = flying

	local restorePosition =
		UDim2.new(
			panel:GetAttribute("MenuRestoreXS")
				or panel.Position.X.Scale,
			panel:GetAttribute("MenuRestoreXO")
				or panel.Position.X.Offset,
			panel:GetAttribute("MenuRestoreYS")
				or panel.Position.Y.Scale,
			panel:GetAttribute("MenuRestoreYO")
				or panel.Position.Y.Offset
		)

	local restoreWidth =
		panel:GetAttribute("MenuRestoreW")
		or panel.Size.X.Offset

	local restoreHeight =
		panel:GetAttribute("MenuRestoreH")
		or panel.Size.Y.Offset

	local railWidth =
		math.clamp(
			math.floor(restoreWidth*.27),
			158,
			186
		)

	local miniPosition = openButton.AbsolutePosition
	local miniSize = openButton.AbsoluteSize
	local panelScale = panel:FindFirstChild("SmoothScale")
	local miniScale = openButton:FindFirstChild("SmoothScale")
	local restorePanelScale =
		tonumber(gui:GetAttribute("PanelScale")) or 1

	-- Start exactly inside the persistent photo launcher.
	panel.Position =
		UDim2.fromOffset(
			miniPosition.X,
			miniPosition.Y
		)
	panel.Size =
		UDim2.fromOffset(
			math.max(34,miniSize.X),
			math.max(34,miniSize.Y)
		)
	panel.ClipsDescendants = true
	sidebar.Visible = false
	content.Visible = false
	panel.Visible = true
	openButton.Visible = true

	if panelScale then
		panelScale.Scale = 1
	end

	task.spawn(function()
		if miniScale then
			TweenService:Create(
				miniScale,
				TweenInfo.new(
					.10,
					Enum.EasingStyle.Quad,
					Enum.EasingDirection.Out
				),
				{Scale = .88}
			):Play()
		end

		-- STAGE 1 // grow from the launcher into the left/sidebar rail first.
		local openRail =
			TweenService:Create(
				panel,
				TweenInfo.new(
					.21,
					Enum.EasingStyle.Back,
					Enum.EasingDirection.Out
				),
				{
					Position = restorePosition,
					Size =
						UDim2.fromOffset(
							railWidth,
							restoreHeight
						)
				}
			)

		openRail:Play()

		task.delay(.08,function()
			if panel:GetAttribute("MenuTransitionBusy")
				and not menuDeleted then
				sidebar.Visible = true
			end
		end)

		openRail.Completed:Wait()

		if menuDeleted then
			return
		end

		-- STAGE 2 // unfold the content section to the right, matching the
		-- sequential left/right opening from the reference clip.
		content.Visible = true

		local unfoldContent =
			TweenService:Create(
				panel,
				TweenInfo.new(
					.24,
					Enum.EasingStyle.Quint,
					Enum.EasingDirection.Out
				),
				{
					Position = restorePosition,
					Size =
						UDim2.fromOffset(
							restoreWidth,
							restoreHeight
						)
				}
			)

		unfoldContent:Play()
		unfoldContent.Completed:Wait()

		if menuDeleted then
			return
		end

		panel.ClipsDescendants = false
		setPanelScale(restorePanelScale,false)

		if miniScale then
			TweenService:Create(
				miniScale,
				TweenInfo.new(
					.18,
					Enum.EasingStyle.Back,
					Enum.EasingDirection.Out
				),
				{Scale = 1}
			):Play()
		end

		clampGuiObjectToViewport(panel,4)
		setTab(currentTab)
		panel:SetAttribute("MenuTransitionBusy",false)
	end)
end

local function setupDeleteConfirmation()
	local overlay = Instance.new("Frame")
	overlay.Name = "DestroyConfirmation"
	overlay.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1,1)
	overlay.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0,0,0)
	overlay.BackgroundTransparency = .28
	overlay.BorderSizePixel = 0
	overlay.Visible = false
	overlay.Active = true
	overlay.ZIndex = 900
	overlay.Parent = gui

	local card = Instance.new("Frame")
	card.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(.5,.5)
	card.Position = UDim2.fromScale(.5,.5)
	card.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(380,205)
	card.BackgroundColor3 = BG
	card.BorderSizePixel = 0
	card.ZIndex = 901
	card.Parent = overlay
	corner(card,18)
	addStroke(card,Color3.fromRGB(235,68,88),1.7,.02)

	local warning = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	warning.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	warning.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(18,18)
	warning.Size = UDim2.new(1,-36,0,28)
	warning.Text = "DESTROY NOT RUBY V1?"
	warning.TextSize = 17
	warning.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBlack
	warning.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255,92,108)
	warning.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center
	warning.ZIndex = 902
	warning.Parent = card

	local message = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	message.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	message.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(20,52)
	message.Size = UDim2.new(1,-40,0,70)
	message.Text = "Are you sure you want to destroy the menu?\nIt will disappear completely with no mini tab."
	message.TextWrapped = true
	message.TextSize = 11
	message.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
	message.TextColor3 = TEXT
	message.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center
	message.TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Center
	message.ZIndex = 902
	message.Parent = card

	local noButton = Instance.new("TextButton")
	noButton.Size = UDim2.new(.5,-24,0,44)
	noButton.Position = UDim2.new(0,16,1,-60)
	noButton.Text = "NO"
	noButton.TextSize = 11
	noButton.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBlack
	noButton.TextColor3 = TEXT
	noButton.BackgroundColor3 = SURFACE_2
	noButton.AutoButtonColor = false
	noButton.ZIndex = 902
	noButton.Parent = card
	corner(noButton,11)

	local yesButton = Instance.new("TextButton")
	yesButton.Size = UDim2.new(.5,-24,0,44)
	yesButton.Position = UDim2.new(.5,8,1,-60)
	yesButton.Text = "YES, DESTROY"
	yesButton.TextSize = 10
	yesButton.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBlack
	yesButton.TextColor3 = TEXT
	yesButton.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(166,42,58)
	yesButton.AutoButtonColor = false
	yesButton.ZIndex = 902
	yesButton.Parent = card
	corner(yesButton,11)

	local stage = 1

	local function closeVisibleMenuKeepFeatures()
		-- Keep the ScreenGui alive for feature visuals such as markers/HUD,
		-- but remove every control that could reopen or control the menu.
		if flightControls and flightControls.Parent then
			flightControls.Visible = false
		end
		if openButton and openButton.Parent then
			openButton:Destroy()
		end
		if panel and panel.Parent then
			panel:Destroy()
		end
		if overlay and overlay.Parent then
			overlay:Destroy()
		end
	end

	local function destroyAndDisableEverything()
		if menuDeleted then
			return
		end
		menuDeleted = true
		universalCleanup()
		remakeLabsCleanup()
		setFlight(false)
		setSprint(false)
		setNoclip(false)
		resetVisuals()
		setPlayerLocator(false)
		setMonsterLocator(false)
		clearMarkerTable(playerMarkers)
		clearMarkerTable(monsterMarkers)
		if openButton and openButton.Parent then
			openButton.Visible = false
		end
		if flightControls and flightControls.Parent then
			flightControls.Visible = false
		end
		if gui and gui.Parent then
			gui:Destroy()
		end
	end

	closeButton.Activated:Connect(function()
		if menuDeleted then
			return
		end
		stage = 1
		warning.Text = "DESTROY NOT RUBY V1?"
		message.Text = "Are you sure you want to destroy the menu?\nIt will disappear completely with no mini tab."
		noButton.Text = "NO"
		yesButton.Text = "YES, DESTROY"
		overlay.Visible = true
	end)

	noButton.Activated:Connect(function()
		if stage == 1 then
			overlay.Visible = false
			return
		end

		-- NO on the second question means keep every currently active
		-- feature running. There will be no menu left to turn them off.
		closeVisibleMenuKeepFeatures()
	end)

	yesButton.Activated:Connect(function()
		if menuDeleted then
			return
		end

		if stage == 1 then
			stage = 2
			warning.Text = "DISABLE ACTIVE FEATURES?"
			message.Text =
				"The menu will be destroyed.\n"
				.."Do you also want to disable all active features?\n\n"
				.."NO = active features stay on until you leave the game."
			noButton.Text = "NO, KEEP ON"
			yesButton.Text = "YES, DISABLE"
			return
		end

		destroyAndDisableEverything()
	end)
end
safeSetup("Delete Confirmation",setupDeleteConfirmation)
end
minimizeButton.Activated:Connect(minimizePanel)
minimizeSettingsButton.Activated:Connect(minimizePanel)
miniTouchHitbox.Activated:Connect(function()
	-- Defer by one scheduler turn. On touch devices Activated and InputEnded
	-- can arrive extremely close together; this guarantees the drag classifier
	-- above wins before we decide whether this was a real tap.
	task.defer(function()
		if not gui.Parent
			or menuDeleted
			or miniJustDragged
			or not miniTapEligible
			or os.clock() < miniBlockClickUntil
			or panel:GetAttribute("MenuTransitionBusy") then
			miniTapEligible = false
			return
		end

		miniTapEligible = false

		if panel.Visible then
			minimizePanel()
		else
			reopenPanel()
		end
	end)
end)
do
local function setupResizing()
local MIN_PANEL_WIDTH = 340
local MIN_PANEL_HEIGHT = 300
local EDGE_SIZE = 12
local CORNER_SIZE = 24
local SCREEN_MARGIN = 4
local resizing = false
local resizeInput
local resizeDirection
local resizeStart
local resizeStartPosition
local resizeStartUDimPosition
local resizeStartSize
local resizeZones = {}
local function beginResize(direction,input)
	if resizePinned then
		return
	end
	if input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.Touch
		and input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
		return
	end
	resizing = true
	resizeInput = input
	resizeDirection = direction
	resizeStart = input.Position
	resizeStartPosition = panel.AbsolutePosition
	resizeStartUDimPosition = panel.Position
	resizeStartSize = Vector2.new(
		panel.Size.X.Offset,
		panel.Size.Y.Offset
	)
	input.Changed:Connect(function()
		if input.UserInputState == Enum.UserInputState.End then
			resizing = false
			resizeInput = nil
			resizeDirection = nil
		end
	end)
end
local function createResizeZone(name,direction,size,position,anchorPoint)
	local zone = Instance.new("TextButton")
	zone.Name = name
	zone.Size = size
	zone.Position = position
	zone.AnchorPoint = anchorPoint or Vector2.zero
	zone.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	zone.BorderSizePixel = 0
	zone.Text = ""
	zone.AutoButtonColor = false
	zone.Active = true
	zone.ZIndex = 120
	zone.Parent = panel
	zone.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
		beginResize(direction,input)
	end)
	table.insert(resizeZones,zone)
	return zone
end
createResizeZone(
	"ResizeTop",
	"top",
	UDim2.new(1,-CORNER_SIZE * 2,0,EDGE_SIZE),
	UDim2.fromOffset(CORNER_SIZE,0)
)
createResizeZone(
	"ResizeBottom",
	"bottom",
	UDim2.new(1,-CORNER_SIZE * 2,0,EDGE_SIZE),
	UDim2.new(0,CORNER_SIZE,1,0),
	Vector2.new(0,1)
)
createResizeZone(
	"ResizeLeft",
	"left",
	UDim2.new(0,EDGE_SIZE,1,-CORNER_SIZE * 2),
	UDim2.fromOffset(0,CORNER_SIZE)
)
createResizeZone(
	"ResizeRight",
	"right",
	UDim2.new(0,EDGE_SIZE,1,-CORNER_SIZE * 2),
	UDim2.new(1,0,0,CORNER_SIZE),
	Vector2.new(1,0)
)
createResizeZone(
	"ResizeTopLeft",
	"topLeft",
	UDim2.fromOffset(CORNER_SIZE,CORNER_SIZE),
	UDim2.fromOffset(0,0)
)
createResizeZone(
	"ResizeTopRight",
	"topRight",
	UDim2.fromOffset(CORNER_SIZE,CORNER_SIZE),
	UDim2.new(1,0,0,0),
	Vector2.new(1,0)
)
createResizeZone(
	"ResizeBottomLeft",
	"bottomLeft",
	UDim2.fromOffset(CORNER_SIZE,CORNER_SIZE),
	UDim2.new(0,0,1,0),
	Vector2.new(0,1)
)
createResizeZone(
	"ResizeBottomRight",
	"bottomRight",
	UDim2.fromOffset(CORNER_SIZE,CORNER_SIZE),
	UDim2.new(1,0,1,0),
	Vector2.new(1,1)
)
local function updateResize(inputPosition)
	if resizePinned
		or not resizing
		or not resizeDirection
		or not resizeStart
		or not resizeStartPosition
		or not resizeStartUDimPosition
		or not resizeStartSize then
		return
	end
	local delta = inputPosition - resizeStart
	camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
	local viewport =
		camera and camera.ViewportSize
		or Vector2.new(1000,700)
	local startLeft = resizeStartPosition.X
	local startTop = resizeStartPosition.Y
	local startWidth = resizeStartSize.X
	local startHeight = resizeStartSize.Y
	local panelScaleValue =
		math.max(.01,tonumber(gui:GetAttribute("PanelScale")) or 1)
	local fromLeft =
		resizeDirection == "left"
		or resizeDirection == "topLeft"
		or resizeDirection == "bottomLeft"
	local fromRight =
		resizeDirection == "right"
		or resizeDirection == "topRight"
		or resizeDirection == "bottomRight"
	local fromTop =
		resizeDirection == "top"
		or resizeDirection == "topLeft"
		or resizeDirection == "topRight"
	local fromBottom =
		resizeDirection == "bottom"
		or resizeDirection == "bottomLeft"
		or resizeDirection == "bottomRight"
	local appliedX = 0
	local appliedY = 0
	local newWidth = startWidth
	local newHeight = startHeight
	if fromLeft then
		local maxLeftDelta =
			(startWidth - MIN_PANEL_WIDTH)*panelScaleValue
		local minLeftDelta = math.min(
			SCREEN_MARGIN - startLeft,
			maxLeftDelta
		)
		appliedX = math.clamp(
			delta.X,
			minLeftDelta,
			maxLeftDelta
		)
		newWidth = startWidth - appliedX/panelScaleValue
	elseif fromRight then
		local availableWidth = math.max(
			MIN_PANEL_WIDTH,
			(viewport.X - startLeft - SCREEN_MARGIN)
			/panelScaleValue
		)
		newWidth = math.clamp(
			startWidth + delta.X/panelScaleValue,
			MIN_PANEL_WIDTH,
			availableWidth
		)
	end
	if fromTop then
		local maxTopDelta =
			(startHeight - MIN_PANEL_HEIGHT)*panelScaleValue
		local minTopDelta = math.min(
			SCREEN_MARGIN - startTop,
			maxTopDelta
		)
		appliedY = math.clamp(
			delta.Y,
			minTopDelta,
			maxTopDelta
		)
		newHeight = startHeight - appliedY/panelScaleValue
	elseif fromBottom then
		local availableHeight = math.max(
			MIN_PANEL_HEIGHT,
			(viewport.Y - startTop - SCREEN_MARGIN)
			/panelScaleValue
		)
		newHeight = math.clamp(
			startHeight + delta.Y/panelScaleValue,
			MIN_PANEL_HEIGHT,
			availableHeight
		)
	end
	panel.Position = UDim2.new(
		resizeStartUDimPosition.X.Scale,
		resizeStartUDimPosition.X.Offset + appliedX,
		resizeStartUDimPosition.Y.Scale,
		resizeStartUDimPosition.Y.Offset + appliedY
	)
	panel.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(newWidth,newHeight)
end
UIS.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
	if not resizing then
		return
	end
	if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement then
		updateResize(input.Position)
	elseif input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch
		and input == resizeInput then
		updateResize(input.Position)
	end
end)
UIS.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
	if input == resizeInput
		or (
			resizing
			and input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
		) then
		resizing = false
		resizeInput = nil
		resizeDirection = nil
	end
end)
end
safeSetup("Panel Resize",setupResizing)
end
do
local function setupDragging()
local dragging = false
local dragInput
local dragStart
local dragStartPosition
local dragStartAbsolute
header.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
	if panelPinned then
		return
	end
	local position = input.Position
	local closePos = closeButton.AbsolutePosition
	local closeSize = closeButton.AbsoluteSize
	local minPos = minimizeButton.AbsolutePosition
	local minSize = minimizeButton.AbsoluteSize
	local insideClose =
		position.X >= closePos.X
		and position.X <= closePos.X + closeSize.X
		and position.Y >= closePos.Y
		and position.Y <= closePos.Y + closeSize.Y
	local insideMin =
		position.X >= minPos.X
		and position.X <= minPos.X + minSize.X
		and position.Y >= minPos.Y
		and position.Y <= minPos.Y + minSize.Y
	if insideClose or insideMin then
		return
	end
	if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch
		or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
		dragging = true
		dragInput = input
		dragStart = input.Position
		dragStartPosition = panel.Position
		dragStartAbsolute = panel.AbsolutePosition
	end
end)
UIS.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
	if panelPinned or not dragging then
		return
	end
	if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement
		or (
			input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch
			and input == dragInput
		) then
		local delta = input.Position - dragStart
		camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
		local viewport =
			camera and camera.ViewportSize or Vector2.new(1000,700)
		local size = panel.AbsoluteSize
		local startAbsolute = dragStartAbsolute or panel.AbsolutePosition
		local minX = 4-startAbsolute.X
		local maxX = viewport.X-startAbsolute.X-size.X-4
		local minY = 4-startAbsolute.Y
		local maxY = viewport.Y-startAbsolute.Y-size.Y-4
		local appliedX =
			math.clamp(delta.X,minX,math.max(minX,maxX))
		local appliedY =
			math.clamp(delta.Y,minY,math.max(minY,maxY))
		panel.Position = UDim2.new(
			dragStartPosition.X.Scale,
			dragStartPosition.X.Offset + appliedX,
			dragStartPosition.Y.Scale,
			dragStartPosition.Y.Offset + appliedY
		)
	end
end)
UIS.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
	if input == dragInput
		or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
		dragging = false
		dragInput = nil
		dragStartAbsolute = nil
	end
end)
end
safeSetup("Panel Drag",setupDragging)
end

			)

			panel.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(620,460)

		if compactRestorePosition then

			clampGuiObjectToViewport(panel,4)

	setPanelScale(gui:GetAttribute("PanelScale"),false)
	setStatus(compactMode and "COMPACT MODE ON" or "COMPACT MODE OFF")

themeButton.Activated:Connect(function()

outlineButton.Activated:Connect(function()
	local choices = {
		{name = "MATCH", color = nil},
		{name = "RUBY", color = Color3.fromRGB(255,42,64)},
		{name = "BLUE", color = Color3.fromRGB(65,155,255)},
		{name = "PURPLE", color = Color3.fromRGB(170,90,255)},
		{name = "GREEN", color = Color3.fromRGB(55,225,135)},
		{name = "GOLD", color = Color3.fromRGB(255,195,60)},
		{name = "CYAN", color = Color3.fromRGB(60,225,240)},
		{name = "WHITE", color = Color3.fromRGB(245,245,250)}
	}

	local index = tonumber(gui:GetAttribute("OutlineIndex")) or 1
	index += 1
	if index > #choices then
		index = 1
	end

	local choice = choices[index]
	local chosenColor = choice.color or accent

	gui:SetAttribute("OutlineIndex",index)
	gui:SetAttribute(
		"OutlineMode",
		choice.color == nil and "MATCH" or "CUSTOM"
	)
	gui:SetAttribute("OutlineColor",chosenColor)

	for _,object in ipairs(gui:GetDescendants()) do
		if object:IsA("UIStroke")
			and object:GetAttribute("NotRubyFixedColor") ~= true then
			object.Color = chosenColor
		end
	end

	outlineButton.Text = "OUTLINE: "..choice.name
	setStatus("OUTLINE: "..choice.name)
end)

local function resetAllFeatures()
	universalCleanup()
	remakeLabsCleanup()
	setFlight(false)
	setSprint(false)
	setNoclip(false)
	resetVisuals()
	setPlayerLocator(false)
	setMonsterLocator(false)
	gui:SetAttribute("SmallSpeedBoost",false)
	gui:SetAttribute(
		"CommandUpsideDown",
		(tonumber(gui:GetAttribute("CommandUpsideDown")) or 0)+1
	)
	walkSpeed = 16
	jumpPower = 50
	sprintSpeed = 42
	flySpeed = 70
	scanRadius = 5000
	walkBox.Text = "16"
	jumpBox.Text = "50"
	sprintBox.Text = "42"
	flyBox.Text = "70"
	radiusBox.Text = "5000"
	applyMovementStats()
	setStatus("ALL FEATURES RESET")
end

local function setupUniversalExtras()
	local trollPage = pages["TROLL"]

	)

	local antiFlingButton = makeAction(homePage,"ANTI FLING [OFF]")
	setToggle(antiFlingButton,false,"ANTI FLING")
	local function restoreAntiFlingCollisions()
		for part,oldCanCollide in pairs(antiFlingOriginalCollisions) do
			if part and part.Parent then
				part.CanCollide = oldCanCollide
			end
		end
		table.clear(antiFlingOriginalCollisions)
	end
	local function suppressFlingCharacter(otherCharacter)
		for _,part in ipairs(otherCharacter:GetDescendants()) do
			if part:IsA("BasePart") then
				if antiFlingOriginalCollisions[part] == nil then
					antiFlingOriginalCollisions[part] = part.CanCollide
				end
				part.CanCollide = false
			end
		end
	end
	local function stopAntiFling()
		antiFlingEnabled = false
		antiFlingToken += 1
		antiFlingLastSafeCFrame = nil
		restoreAntiFlingCollisions()
		if antiFlingButton and antiFlingButton.Parent then
			setToggle(antiFlingButton,false,"ANTI FLING")
		end
	end
	local function startAntiFling()
		antiFlingEnabled = true
		antiFlingToken += 1
		local myToken = antiFlingToken
		setToggle(antiFlingButton,true,"ANTI FLING")
		setStatus("ANTI FLING ON")
		task.spawn(function()
			while antiFlingEnabled
				and myToken == antiFlingToken
				and not menuDeleted do
				local currentCharacter = player.Character
				local currentHumanoid =
					currentCharacter
					and currentCharacter:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
				local currentRoot =
					currentCharacter
					and currentCharacter:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
				if currentRoot then
					local ownLinear =
						currentRoot.AssemblyLinearVelocity.Magnitude
					local ownAngular =
						currentRoot.AssemblyAngularVelocity.Magnitude
					if ownLinear < 70
						and ownAngular < 16
						and currentHumanoid
						and currentHumanoid.FloorMaterial
							~= Enum.Material.Air then
						antiFlingLastSafeCFrame = currentRoot.CFrame
					end
					-- If our character suddenly receives fling-level physics,
					-- kill the velocity and return to the last stable position.
					if ownLinear > 175 or ownAngular > 48 then
						currentRoot.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
						currentRoot.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
						if antiFlingLastSafeCFrame then
							currentRoot.CFrame = antiFlingLastSafeCFrame
						end
						setStatus("ANTI FLING // BLOCKED PHYSICS SPIKE")
					end
					for _,otherPlayer in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
						if otherPlayer ~= player then
							local otherCharacter = otherPlayer.Character
							local otherRoot =
								otherCharacter
								and otherCharacter:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
							if otherRoot and otherCharacter then
								local distance =
									(otherRoot.Position-currentRoot.Position).Magnitude
								if distance <= 55 then
									local otherLinear =
										otherRoot.AssemblyLinearVelocity.Magnitude
									local otherAngular =
										otherRoot.AssemblyAngularVelocity.Magnitude
									if otherLinear > 110
										or otherAngular > 24 then
										suppressFlingCharacter(otherCharacter)
									end
								end
							end
						end
					end
				end
				task.wait(.06)
			end
			if myToken == antiFlingToken then
				restoreAntiFlingCollisions()
			end
		end)
	end
	antiFlingButton.Activated:Connect(function()
		if antiFlingEnabled then
			stopAntiFling()
			setStatus("ANTI FLING OFF")
		else
			startAntiFling()
		end
	end)

	UIS.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
		if hudDragging
			and hudDragStart
			and hudStartPosition
			and hudStartAbsolute
			and (
				input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement
				or (
					input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch
					and input == hudDragInput
				)
			) then

			local delta = input.Position-hudDragStart
			camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
			local viewport =
				camera and camera.ViewportSize or Vector2.new(1000,700)
			local size = hud.AbsoluteSize
			local minX = 4-hudStartAbsolute.X
			local maxX =
				viewport.X-hudStartAbsolute.X-size.X-4
			local minY = 4-hudStartAbsolute.Y
			local maxY =
				viewport.Y-hudStartAbsolute.Y-size.Y-4
			local x = math.clamp(delta.X,minX,math.max(minX,maxX))
			local y = math.clamp(delta.Y,minY,math.max(minY,maxY))

			hud.Position = UDim2.new(
				hudStartPosition.X.Scale,
				hudStartPosition.X.Offset+x,
				hudStartPosition.Y.Scale,
				hudStartPosition.Y.Offset+y
			)
		end

		if hudResizing
			and hudResizeStart
			and hudStartSize
			and (
				input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement
				or (
					input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch
					and input == hudResizeInput
				)
			) then

			camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
			local viewport =
				camera and camera.ViewportSize or Vector2.new(1000,700)
			local delta = input.Position-hudResizeStart
			local position = hud.AbsolutePosition
			local maxWidth = math.max(
				230,
				math.min(560,viewport.X-position.X-4)
			)
			local maxHeight = math.max(
				110,
				math.min(320,viewport.Y-position.Y-4)
			)
			hud.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(
				math.clamp(hudStartSize.X+delta.X,230,maxWidth),
				math.clamp(hudStartSize.Y+delta.Y,110,maxHeight)

		end
	end)

		end

	local fps = 0
	local frameCount = 0
	local frameTimer = 0

	local function cardinalFromLook(look)
		local degrees =
			(math.deg(math.atan2(-look.X,-look.Z))+360)%360

		if degrees < 22.5 or degrees >= 337.5 then
			return "N"
		elseif degrees < 67.5 then
			return "NE"
		elseif degrees < 112.5 then
			return "E"
		elseif degrees < 157.5 then
			return "SE"
		elseif degrees < 202.5 then
			return "S"
		elseif degrees < 247.5 then
			return "SW"
		elseif degrees < 292.5 then
			return "W"
		end

		return "NW"
	end

	RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function(delta)
		if menuDeleted then
			return
		end

		frameCount += 1
		frameTimer += delta

		if frameTimer >= .5 then
			fps = math.floor(frameCount/frameTimer+.5)
			frameCount = 0
			frameTimer = 0
		end

		if not liveHudEnabled or not hud.Parent then
			return
		end

		local currentRoot =
			root and root.Parent
			and root
			or (
				player.Character
				and player.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
			)
		local position =
			currentRoot and currentRoot.Position or Vector3.zero
		local speed =
			currentRoot
			and currentRoot.AssemblyLinearVelocity.Magnitude
			or 0
		local heading =
			currentRoot
			and cardinalFromLook(currentRoot.CFrame.LookVector)
			or "--"

		hudText.Text = string.format(
			"FPS: %d   SPEED: %d\nPOSITION: X %d   Y %d   Z %d\nHEADING: %s   GRAVITY: %d",
			fps,
			math.floor(speed+.5),
			math.floor(position.X+.5),
			math.floor(position.Y+.5),
			math.floor(position.Z+.5),
			heading,
			math.floor(workspace.Gravity+.5)
		)
	end)

	gravityApply.Activated:Connect(function()
		local value = tonumber(gravityBox.Text)
		if not value then
			setStatus("INVALID GRAVITY")
			return
		end

		workspace.Gravity = math.clamp(value,0,500)
		gravityBox.Text = tostring(math.floor(workspace.Gravity))
		setStatus("GRAVITY "..tostring(math.floor(workspace.Gravity)))
	end)

	resetGravityButton.Activated:Connect(function()
		workspace.Gravity = originalGravity
		gravityBox.Text = tostring(math.floor(originalGravity))
		setStatus("GRAVITY RESET")
	end)

	hudButton.Activated:Connect(function()
		liveHudEnabled = not liveHudEnabled
		local scale = hud:FindFirstChild("SmoothScale")

		if liveHudEnabled then
			hud.Visible = true
			if scale then
				scale.Scale = .88
				TweenService:Create(
					scale,
					TweenInfo.new(.18,Enum.EasingStyle.Back,Enum.EasingDirection.Out),
					{Scale = 1}
				):Play()
			end
		else
			hud.Visible = false
		end

		setToggle(hudButton,liveHudEnabled,"LIVE HUD")
		setStatus(liveHudEnabled and "LIVE HUD ON" or "LIVE HUD OFF")
	end)

	local function releaseFakeLagRoot()
		if fakeLagHeldRoot and fakeLagHeldRoot.Parent then
			-- Do not fight the normal Freeze option if it was enabled separately.
			if not frozen then
				fakeLagHeldRoot.Anchored = false
			end
		end
		fakeLagHeldRoot = nil
	end

	local function stopFakeLag()
		fakeLagEnabled = false
		gui:SetAttribute("FakeLagEnabled",false)
		fakeLagToken += 1
		releaseFakeLagRoot()
	end

	local function startFakeLag()
		stopFakeLag()

		-- Fake Lag and the permanent Freeze button both use Anchored,
		-- so turn Freeze off first to avoid the two systems fighting.
		if frozenRoot and frozenRoot.Parent then
			frozenRoot.Anchored = false
			frozenRoot = nil
		end
		frozen = false
		setToggle(freezeButton,false,"FREEZE")

		fakeLagEnabled = true
		fakeLagToken += 1
		local token = fakeLagToken

		task.spawn(function()
			while fakeLagEnabled and fakeLagToken == token do
				if not root or not root.Parent then
					task.wait(.1)
					continue
				end

				local currentRoot = root
				fakeLagHeldRoot = currentRoot
				currentRoot.Anchored = true
				local elapsed = 0

				while fakeLagEnabled
					and fakeLagToken == token
					and currentRoot.Parent
					and elapsed < fakeLagHold do
					local step = math.min(.05,fakeLagHold-elapsed)
					task.wait(step)
					elapsed += step
				end

				if currentRoot.Parent
					and currentRoot.Anchored
					and not frozen then
					currentRoot.Anchored = false
				end

				fakeLagHeldRoot = nil
				if fakeLagEnabled and fakeLagToken == token then
					task.wait(fakeLagRelease)
				end
			end

			releaseFakeLagRoot()
		end)
	end

	local function setFakeLag(value)
		gui:SetAttribute("FakeLagEnabled",value == true)
		if value then
			startFakeLag()
		else
			stopFakeLag()
		end
		setToggle(fakeLagButton,fakeLagEnabled,"FAKE LAG")
		setStatus(fakeLagEnabled and "FAKE LAG ON" or "FAKE LAG OFF")
	end

	fakeLagApply.Activated:Connect(function()
		local value = tonumber(fakeLagBox.Text)
		if not value then
			setStatus("INVALID FAKE LAG STRENGTH / FREEZE")
			return
		end
		fakeLagHold = math.clamp(value,.05,10)
		fakeLagBox.Text = tostring(fakeLagHold)
		setStatus("FAKE LAG STRENGTH / FREEZE "..tostring(fakeLagHold).."s")
	end)

	fakeLagButton.Activated:Connect(function()
		setFakeLag(not fakeLagEnabled)
	end)

	gui:GetAttributeChangedSignal("CommandFakeLag"):Connect(function()
		setFakeLag(not fakeLagEnabled)
	end)

	freezeButton.Activated:Connect(function()
		if not root or not root.Parent then
			loadCharacter(2)
		end

		if not root then
			setStatus("CHARACTER UNAVAILABLE")
			return
		end

		frozen = not frozen
		if frozen then
			frozenRoot = root
			root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
			root.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
			root.Anchored = true
		elseif frozenRoot and frozenRoot.Parent then
			frozenRoot.Anchored = false
			frozenRoot = nil
		end

		setToggle(freezeButton,frozen,"FREEZE")
		setStatus(frozen and "CHARACTER FROZEN" or "CHARACTER UNFROZEN")
	end)

	sitButton.Activated:Connect(function()
		if not humanoid or not humanoid.Parent then
			loadCharacter(2)
		end

		if humanoid then
			humanoid.Sit = not humanoid.Sit
			setStatus(humanoid.Sit and "SITTING" or "STANDING")
		else
			setStatus("CHARACTER UNAVAILABLE")
		end
	end)

	jumpButton.Activated:Connect(function()
		if not loadCharacter(2) then
			setStatus("CHARACTER UNAVAILABLE")
			return
		end

		if frozenRoot and frozenRoot.Parent then
			frozenRoot.Anchored = false
			frozenRoot = nil
			frozen = false
			setToggle(freezeButton,false,"FREEZE")
		end

		if fakeLagEnabled and root.Anchored then
			root.Anchored = false
			fakeLagHeldRoot = nil
			task.wait()
		end

		humanoid.Sit = false
		humanoid.Jump = true
		pcall(function()
			humanoid:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Jumping)
		end)
		setStatus("JUMP")
	end)

	local function isPerformanceObject(object)
		return object:IsA("ParticleEmitter")
			or object:IsA("Trail")
			or object:IsA("Beam")
			or object:IsA("Smoke")
			or object:IsA("Fire")
			or object:IsA("Sparkles")
	end

	local function disablePerformanceObject(object)
		if not performanceMode or not isPerformanceObject(object) then
			return
		end

		if performanceStates[object] == nil then
			performanceStates[object] = object.Enabled
		end
		object.Enabled = false
	end

	local function restorePerformance()
		for object,wasEnabled in pairs(performanceStates) do
			if object and object.Parent then
				object.Enabled = wasEnabled
			end
		end
		table.clear(performanceStates)
		Lighting.GlobalShadows = originalShadows
	end

	local function setPerformance(value)
		performanceMode = value == true
		if performanceMode then
			originalShadows = Lighting.GlobalShadows
			Lighting.GlobalShadows = false
			for _,object in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
				disablePerformanceObject(object)
			end
		else
			restorePerformance()
		end

		setToggle(performanceButton,performanceMode,"PERFORMANCE")
		setStatus(
			performanceMode
			and "PERFORMANCE MODE ON"
			or "PERFORMANCE MODE OFF"
		)
	end

	workspace.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(object)
		if menuDeleted or not performanceMode then
			return
		end
		task.defer(function()
			if not menuDeleted then
				disablePerformanceObject(object)
			end
		end)
	end)

	performanceButton.Activated:Connect(function()
		setPerformance(not performanceMode)
	end)

	cameraResetButton.Activated:Connect(function()
		camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
		loadCharacter(1)

		if camera then
			camera.CameraType = Enum.CameraType.Custom
			if humanoid then
				camera.CameraSubject = humanoid
			end
			camera.FieldOfView = originalFOV
			fovBox.Text = tostring(math.floor(originalFOV))
			setStatus("CAMERA RESET")
		else
			setStatus("CAMERA UNAVAILABLE")
		end
	end)

	-- --------------------------------------------------------
	-- V86 TROLL // UPSIDE DOWN
	-- Uses local-player-owned root physics, so games that replicate normal
	-- character physics can show the upside-down orientation to other players.
	-- --------------------------------------------------------
	local function flatDirection(vector,fallback)
		local flat = Vector3.new(vector.X,0,vector.Z)
		if flat.Magnitude <= .01 then
			return fallback
		end
		return flat.Unit
	end

	local function removeUpsideDownRig()
		if upsideDownAlign and upsideDownAlign.Parent then
			upsideDownAlign:Destroy()
		end
		upsideDownAlign = nil

		if upsideDownAttachment and upsideDownAttachment.Parent then
			upsideDownAttachment:Destroy()
		end
		upsideDownAttachment = nil
	end

	local function uprightCurrentRoot()
		local currentRoot =
			upsideDownRoot
			and upsideDownRoot.Parent
			and upsideDownRoot
			or (
				player.Character
				and player.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
			)

		if not currentRoot then
			return
		end

		local forward =
			flatDirection(
				currentRoot.CFrame.LookVector,
				upsideDownLastForward
			)

		local linear = currentRoot.AssemblyLinearVelocity
		local angular = currentRoot.AssemblyAngularVelocity

		pcall(function()
			currentRoot.CFrame =
				CFrame.lookAt(
					currentRoot.Position,
					currentRoot.Position+forward,
					Vector3.new(0,1,0)
				)
		end)

		pcall(function()
			currentRoot.AssemblyLinearVelocity = linear
			currentRoot.AssemblyAngularVelocity =
				Vector3.new(0,angular.Y,0)
		end)
	end

	local function restoreUpsideDown()
		upsideDownGeneration += 1
		removeUpsideDownRig()

		if upsideDownHumanoid and upsideDownHumanoid.Parent then
			pcall(function()
				upsideDownHumanoid.AutoRotate =
					upsideDownSavedAutoRotate ~= false
			end)
		end

		uprightCurrentRoot()

		upsideDownRoot = nil
		upsideDownHumanoid = nil
		upsideDownSavedAutoRotate = nil
	end

	local function buildUpsideDownRig()
		if not upsideDownEnabled or menuDeleted then
			return false
		end

		if not loadCharacter(2) then
			return false
		end

		local currentCharacter = player.Character
		local currentHumanoid =
			currentCharacter
			and currentCharacter:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
		local currentRoot =
			currentCharacter
			and currentCharacter:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

		if not currentHumanoid or not currentRoot then
			return false
		end

		removeUpsideDownRig()

		upsideDownRoot = currentRoot
		upsideDownHumanoid = currentHumanoid
		upsideDownSavedAutoRotate = currentHumanoid.AutoRotate

		upsideDownLastForward =
			flatDirection(
				currentRoot.CFrame.LookVector,
				Vector3.new(0,0,-1)
			)

		currentHumanoid.AutoRotate = false

		upsideDownAttachment = Instance.new("Attachment")
		upsideDownAttachment.Name = "NotRubyUpsideDownAttachment"
		upsideDownAttachment.Parent = currentRoot

		upsideDownAlign = Instance.new("AlignOrientation")
		upsideDownAlign.Name = "NotRubyUpsideDownAlign"
		upsideDownAlign.Mode = Enum.OrientationAlignmentMode.OneAttachment
		upsideDownAlign.Attachment0 = upsideDownAttachment
		upsideDownAlign.RigidityEnabled = true
		upsideDownAlign.ReactionTorqueEnabled = false
		upsideDownAlign.Responsiveness = 200
		upsideDownAlign.MaxTorque = 1000000000
		upsideDownAlign.MaxAngularVelocity = 1000000
		upsideDownAlign.Parent = currentRoot

		local generation = upsideDownGeneration

		task.spawn(function()
			while upsideDownEnabled
				and not menuDeleted
				and generation == upsideDownGeneration
				and currentRoot.Parent
				and currentHumanoid.Parent
				and upsideDownAlign
				and upsideDownAlign.Parent do

				local moveDirection = currentHumanoid.MoveDirection
				if moveDirection.Magnitude > .08 then
					upsideDownLastForward =
						flatDirection(
							moveDirection,
							upsideDownLastForward
						)
				else
					upsideDownLastForward =
						flatDirection(
							currentRoot.CFrame.LookVector,
							upsideDownLastForward
						)
				end

				local position = currentRoot.Position
				local target =
					CFrame.lookAt(
						position,
						position+upsideDownLastForward,
						Vector3.new(0,-1,0)
					)

				pcall(function()
					upsideDownAlign.CFrame = target.Rotation
				end)

				-- Lightweight correction prevents the normal Humanoid controller
				-- from instantly standing the avatar upright again.
				pcall(function()
					local linear =
						currentRoot.AssemblyLinearVelocity
					currentRoot.CFrame =
						CFrame.new(position)*target.Rotation
					currentRoot.AssemblyLinearVelocity = linear
				end)

				RunService.Heartbeat:Wait()
			end
		end)

		return true
	end

	local function setUpsideDown(value)
		value = value == true

		if value == upsideDownEnabled then
			setToggle(
				upsideDownButton,
				upsideDownEnabled,
				"UPSIDE DOWN"
			)
			return
		end

		if value then
			upsideDownEnabled = true
			upsideDownGeneration += 1
			gui:SetAttribute("UpsideDownEnabled",true)

			if not buildUpsideDownRig() then
				upsideDownEnabled = false
				gui:SetAttribute("UpsideDownEnabled",false)
				restoreUpsideDown()
				setToggle(
					upsideDownButton,
					false,
					"UPSIDE DOWN"
				)
				setStatus("UPSIDE DOWN // CHARACTER UNAVAILABLE")
				return
			end

			setToggle(
				upsideDownButton,
				true,
				"UPSIDE DOWN"
			)
			setStatus(
				"UPSIDE DOWN ON // FULL AVATAR INVERTED"
			)
		else
			upsideDownEnabled = false
			gui:SetAttribute("UpsideDownEnabled",false)
			restoreUpsideDown()
			setToggle(
				upsideDownButton,
				false,
				"UPSIDE DOWN"
			)
			setStatus("UPSIDE DOWN OFF // AVATAR RESTORED")
		end
	end

	upsideDownButton.Activated:Connect(function()
		setUpsideDown(not upsideDownEnabled)
	end)

	gui:GetAttributeChangedSignal("CommandUpsideDown"):Connect(function()
		setUpsideDown(not upsideDownEnabled)
	end)

	local function restoreInvisible()
		for object,data in pairs(invisibleOriginal) do
			if object and object.Parent then
				if data.kind == "part" then
					object.LocalTransparencyModifier = data.value
				else
					object.Transparency = data.value
				end
			end
		end
		table.clear(invisibleOriginal)
	end

	local function applyInvisible()
		local currentCharacter = player.Character
		if not currentCharacter then
			return false
		end

		for _,object in ipairs(currentCharacter:GetDescendants()) do
			if object:IsA("BasePart") then
				if invisibleOriginal[object] == nil then
					invisibleOriginal[object] = {
						kind = "part",
						value = object.LocalTransparencyModifier
					}
				end
				object.LocalTransparencyModifier = 1
			elseif object:IsA("Decal") then
				if invisibleOriginal[object] == nil then
					invisibleOriginal[object] = {
						kind = "decal",
						value = object.Transparency
					}
				end
				object.Transparency = 1
			end
		end

		return true
	end

	local function setInvisible(value)
		value = value == true
		if invisibleEnabled == value then
			return
		end

		invisibleEnabled = value
		gui:SetAttribute("InvisibleEnabled",invisibleEnabled)

		if invisibleEnabled then
			if not applyInvisible() then
				invisibleEnabled = false
				gui:SetAttribute("InvisibleEnabled",false)
				setStatus("CHARACTER UNAVAILABLE")
			end
		else
			restoreInvisible()
		end

		setToggle(invisibleButton,invisibleEnabled,"INVISIBLE")
		setStatus(
			invisibleEnabled
			and "INVISIBLE LOCAL VIEW ON"
			or "INVISIBLE LOCAL VIEW OFF"
		)
	end

	invisibleButton.Activated:Connect(function()
		setInvisible(not invisibleEnabled)
	end)

	gui:GetAttributeChangedSignal("CommandInvisible"):Connect(function()
		setInvisible(not invisibleEnabled)
	end)

	local function clearSelfHighlight()
		if selfHighlight and selfHighlight.Parent then
			selfHighlight:Destroy()
		end
		selfHighlight = nil
	end

	local function setSelfHighlight(value)
		selfHighlightEnabled = value == true
		clearSelfHighlight()

		if selfHighlightEnabled and player.Character then
			selfHighlight = Instance.new("Highlight")
			selfHighlight.Name = "NotRubySelfAura"
			selfHighlight.Adornee = player.Character
			selfHighlight.FillColor = accent
			selfHighlight.OutlineColor = TEXT
			selfHighlight.FillTransparency = .72
			selfHighlight.OutlineTransparency = .05
			selfHighlight.DepthMode = Enum.HighlightDepthMode.AlwaysOnTop
			selfHighlight.Parent = player.Character
		end

		setToggle(auraButton,selfHighlightEnabled,"SELF AURA")
		setStatus(selfHighlightEnabled and "SELF AURA ON" or "SELF AURA OFF")
	end

	auraButton.Activated:Connect(function()
		setSelfHighlight(not selfHighlightEnabled)
	end)

	sparkButton.Activated:Connect(function()
		if not loadCharacter(1) or not root then
			setStatus("CHARACTER UNAVAILABLE")
			return
		end

		local attachment = Instance.new("Attachment")
		attachment.Name = "NotRubySparkBurst"
		attachment.Parent = root

		local emitter = Instance.new("ParticleEmitter")
		emitter.Texture = "rbxasset://textures/particles/sparkles_main.dds"
		emitter.Color = ColorSequence.new({
			ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0,accent),
			ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1,TEXT)
		})
		emitter.LightEmission = 1
		emitter.Lifetime = NumberRange.new(.7,1.3)
		emitter.Speed = NumberRange.new(7,14)
		emitter.SpreadAngle = Vector2.new(180,180)
		emitter.Rate = 0
		emitter.Rotation = NumberRange.new(0,360)
		emitter.RotSpeed = NumberRange.new(-120,120)
		emitter.Parent = attachment
		emitter:Emit(48)

		task.delay(1.6,function()
			if attachment and attachment.Parent then
				attachment:Destroy()
			end
		end)
		setStatus("SPARK BURST")
	end)

	refreshCharacterButton.Activated:Connect(function()
		setStatus("REFRESHING CHARACTER REFERENCES")
		if loadCharacter(3) then
			applyMovementStats()
			if playerLocator then
				refreshPlayers()
			end
			if monsterLocator then
				task.defer(refreshMonsters)
			end
			setStatus("CHARACTER REFERENCES READY")
		else
			setStatus("CHARACTER REFRESH FAILED")
		end
	end)

	respawnButton.Activated:Connect(function()
		if not humanoid or not humanoid.Parent then
			loadCharacter(1)
		end

		if humanoid then
			humanoid.Health = 0
			setStatus("RESPAWNING")
		else
			setStatus("CHARACTER UNAVAILABLE")
		end
	end)

	player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function()
		antiFlingLastSafeCFrame = nil
		restoreAntiFlingCollisions()
		if frozenRoot and frozenRoot.Parent then
			frozenRoot.Anchored = false
		end
		frozen = false
		frozenRoot = nil
		fakeLagHeldRoot = nil
		setToggle(freezeButton,false,"FREEZE")
		restoreInvisible()
		invisibleEnabled = false
		gui:SetAttribute("InvisibleEnabled",false)
		setToggle(invisibleButton,false,"INVISIBLE")

		removeUpsideDownRig()
		upsideDownRoot = nil
		upsideDownHumanoid = nil
		upsideDownSavedAutoRotate = nil

		if upsideDownEnabled then
			task.delay(.25,function()
				if upsideDownEnabled
					and not menuDeleted then
					upsideDownGeneration += 1
					if not buildUpsideDownRig() then
						setUpsideDown(false)
					end
				end
			end)
		end

		clearSelfHighlight()
		if selfHighlightEnabled then
			task.defer(function()
				if not menuDeleted then
					setSelfHighlight(true)
				end
			end)
		end
	end)

	universalCleanup = function()
		liveHudEnabled = false
		if hud and hud.Parent then
			hud.Visible = false
		end

		if frozenRoot and frozenRoot.Parent then
			frozenRoot.Anchored = false
		end
		frozen = false
		frozenRoot = nil

		if performanceMode then
			performanceMode = false
			restorePerformance()
		end

		if antiFlingEnabled then
			stopAntiFling()
		else
			restoreAntiFlingCollisions()
		end

		if fakeLagEnabled then
			stopFakeLag()
		else
			releaseFakeLagRoot()
		end

		if fakeLagButton and fakeLagButton.Parent then
			setToggle(fakeLagButton,false,"FAKE LAG")
		end

		if invisibleEnabled then
			invisibleEnabled = false
			restoreInvisible()
			gui:SetAttribute("InvisibleEnabled",false)
		end

		selfHighlightEnabled = false
		clearSelfHighlight()

		if upsideDownEnabled then
			upsideDownEnabled = false
			gui:SetAttribute("UpsideDownEnabled",false)
			restoreUpsideDown()
		else
			removeUpsideDownRig()
		end
		setToggle(upsideDownButton,false,"UPSIDE DOWN")

		workspace.Gravity = originalGravity
		setToggle(hudButton,false,"LIVE HUD")
		setToggle(freezeButton,false,"FREEZE")
		setToggle(performanceButton,false,"PERFORMANCE")
		setToggle(invisibleButton,false,"INVISIBLE")
		setToggle(auraButton,false,"SELF AURA")
	end
end
safeSetup("Universal Extras",setupUniversalExtras)
end
Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(otherPlayer)
	if menuDeleted then
		return
	end
	if not playerLocator then
		return
	end
	otherPlayer.CharacterAdded:Connect(function()
		task.wait(.2)
		if playerLocator then
			refreshPlayers()
		end
	end)
end)
Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function()
	if menuDeleted then
		return
	end
	if playerLocator then
		task.defer(refreshPlayers)
	end
end)
player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(newCharacter)
	if menuDeleted then
		return
	end
	stopFlight()
	restoreCollision()
	character = newCharacter
	humanoid =
		newCharacter:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
		or newCharacter:WaitForChild("Humanoid",5)
	root =
		newCharacter:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		or newCharacter:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart",5)
	if not humanoid or not root then
		setStatus("CHARACTER REFERENCES INCOMPLETE")
		return
	end
	task.wait(.1)
	applyMovementStats()
	if playerLocator then
		refreshPlayers()
	end
	if monsterLocator then
		task.defer(refreshMonsters)
	end
end)

local function setupRemakeLabs()
	-- --------------------------------------------------------

	navigationCard.BackgroundColor3 = SURFACE
	navigationCard.BorderSizePixel = 0
