	local function colorToData(color)
		return {
			r = math.floor(color.R*255+.5),
			g = math.floor(color.G*255+.5),
			b = math.floor(color.B*255+.5)
		}
	end

	local function dataToColor(data,fallback)
		if typeof(data) ~= "table" then
			return fallback
		end

		return Color3.fromRGB(
			math.clamp(tonumber(data.r) or 0,0,255),
			math.clamp(tonumber(data.g) or 0,0,255),
			math.clamp(tonumber(data.b) or 0,0,255)
		)
	end

	local function captureSettings()
		local savedPanelPosition = panel.Position
		local savedPanelWidth = panel.Size.X.Offset
		local savedPanelHeight = panel.Size.Y.Offset
		if panel:GetAttribute("MenuTransitionBusy") then
			savedPanelPosition = UDim2.new(
				panel:GetAttribute("MenuRestoreXS")
					or savedPanelPosition.X.Scale,
				panel:GetAttribute("MenuRestoreXO")
					or savedPanelPosition.X.Offset,
				panel:GetAttribute("MenuRestoreYS")
					or savedPanelPosition.Y.Scale,
				panel:GetAttribute("MenuRestoreYO")
					or savedPanelPosition.Y.Offset
			)
			savedPanelWidth =
				panel:GetAttribute("MenuRestoreW") or savedPanelWidth
			savedPanelHeight =
				panel:GetAttribute("MenuRestoreH") or savedPanelHeight
		end

		local saved = {
			themeIndex = themeIndex,
			accent = colorToData(accent),
			brightnessLevel = brightnessLevel,
			panelScale = tonumber(gui:GetAttribute("PanelScale")) or 1,
			errorSoundEnabled = errorSoundEnabled,
			errorSoundIndex = errorSoundIndex,
			customErrorSoundId = customErrorSoundId,
			useCustomErrorSound = useCustomErrorSound,
			outlineMode =
				gui:GetAttribute("OutlineMode"),
			outlineIndex =
				gui:GetAttribute("OutlineIndex"),
			outline =
				colorToData(
					gui:GetAttribute("OutlineColor")
					or accent
				),
			panel = {
				xs = savedPanelPosition.X.Scale,
				xo = savedPanelPosition.X.Offset,
				ys = savedPanelPosition.Y.Scale,
				yo = savedPanelPosition.Y.Offset,
				w = savedPanelWidth,
				h = savedPanelHeight
			},
			mini = {
				xs = openButton.Position.X.Scale,
				xo = openButton.Position.X.Offset,
				ys = openButton.Position.Y.Scale,
				yo = openButton.Position.Y.Offset,
				w = openButton.AbsoluteSize.X,
				h = openButton.AbsoluteSize.Y
			}
		}

		local hud = gui:FindFirstChild("NotRubyLiveHUD")
		if hud and hud:IsA("GuiObject") then
			saved.hud = {
				xs = hud.Position.X.Scale,
				xo = hud.Position.X.Offset,
				ys = hud.Position.Y.Scale,
				yo = hud.Position.Y.Offset,
				w = hud.AbsoluteSize.X,
				h = hud.AbsoluteSize.Y
			}
		end

		state.data.settings = saved
	end

	local function applySavedSettings()
		local saved = state.data.settings
		if typeof(saved) ~= "table" then
			return
		end

		if saved.errorSoundEnabled ~= nil then
			errorSoundEnabled = saved.errorSoundEnabled == true
		end

		if tonumber(saved.errorSoundIndex) then
			errorSoundIndex =
				normalizeErrorSoundIndex(saved.errorSoundIndex)
		end

		if saved.customErrorSoundId ~= nil then
			customErrorSoundId =
				tostring(saved.customErrorSoundId or "")
					:gsub("%D","")
		end

		useCustomErrorSound =
			saved.useCustomErrorSound == true
			and customErrorSoundId ~= ""

		customSoundIdBox.Text = customErrorSoundId

		errorSound.SoundId =
			"rbxassetid://"..currentErrorSoundId()
		gui:SetAttribute("ErrorSoundEnabled",errorSoundEnabled)
		gui:SetAttribute(
			"ErrorSoundId",
			currentErrorSoundId()
		)
		setToggle(
			errorSoundToggle,
			errorSoundEnabled,
			"ERROR SOUND"
		)
		errorSoundChange.Text =
			"CHANGE SOUND: "..currentErrorSoundName()

		if saved.accent then
			local previousAccent = accent
			accent =
				dataToColor(saved.accent,accent)
			refreshAccentBoundVisuals(previousAccent)

			local savedIndex =
				tonumber(saved.themeIndex)

			if savedIndex
				and savedIndex >= 1
				and savedIndex <= #themes then
				themeIndex = savedIndex
				themeButton.Text =
					"THEME: "
					..themes[themeIndex].name
			else
				themeIndex = 0
				themeButton.Text = "THEME: CUSTOM"
			end

			status.TextColor3 = accent
			sidebar.ScrollBarImageColor3 = accent
			applyTabVisuals()
			refreshToggleColors()
		end

		if saved.outline then
			local outline =
				dataToColor(saved.outline,accent)

			gui:SetAttribute(
				"OutlineMode",
				saved.outlineMode or "MATCH"
			)
			gui:SetAttribute(
				"OutlineIndex",
				tonumber(saved.outlineIndex) or 1
			)
			gui:SetAttribute("OutlineColor",outline)

			for _,object in ipairs(gui:GetDescendants()) do
				if object:IsA("UIStroke")
					and object:GetAttribute("NotRubyFixedColor") ~= true then
					object.Color = outline
				end
			end

			outlineButton.Text =
				saved.outlineMode == "CUSTOM"
				and "OUTLINE: CUSTOM"
				or "OUTLINE: MATCH"
		end

		if saved.brightnessLevel ~= nil then
			setBrightnessLevel(saved.brightnessLevel)
		end

		if typeof(saved.panel) == "table" then
			panel.Position =
				UDim2.new(
					tonumber(saved.panel.xs) or .5,
					tonumber(saved.panel.xo) or -310,
					tonumber(saved.panel.ys) or .5,
					tonumber(saved.panel.yo) or -230
				)
			panel.Size =
				UDim2.fromOffset(
					math.clamp(
						tonumber(saved.panel.w) or 620,
						340,
						820
					),
					math.clamp(
						tonumber(saved.panel.h) or 460,
						300,
						620
					)
				)
		end

		if saved.panelScale ~= nil then
			setPanelScale(saved.panelScale,false)
		else
			setPanelScale(1,false)
		end

		if typeof(saved.mini) == "table" then
			openButton.Position =
				UDim2.new(
					tonumber(saved.mini.xs) or 1,
					tonumber(saved.mini.xo) or -64,
					tonumber(saved.mini.ys) or 1,
					tonumber(saved.mini.yo) or -66
				)

			local size =
				math.clamp(
					tonumber(saved.mini.w) or 50,
					34,
					140
				)

			openButton.Size =
				UDim2.fromOffset(size,size)
			local restoredMiniCorner =
				openButton:FindFirstChildOfClass("UICorner")
			if restoredMiniCorner then
				restoredMiniCorner.CornerRadius =
					UDim.new(.5,0)
			end
			openButton.TextSize =
				math.clamp(
					math.floor(size*.46),
					16,
					42
				)
		end

		local hud = gui:FindFirstChild("NotRubyLiveHUD")
		if hud
			and hud:IsA("GuiObject")
			and typeof(saved.hud) == "table" then

			hud.Position =
				UDim2.new(
					tonumber(saved.hud.xs) or 0,
					tonumber(saved.hud.xo) or 18,
					tonumber(saved.hud.ys) or 0,
					tonumber(saved.hud.yo) or 82
				)
			hud.Size =
				UDim2.fromOffset(
					math.clamp(
						tonumber(saved.hud.w) or 322,
						230,
						560
					),
					math.clamp(
						tonumber(saved.hud.h) or 142,
						110,
						320
					)
				)
		end

		task.defer(function()
			if menuDeleted then
				return
			end
			clampGuiObjectToViewport(panel,4)
			clampGuiObjectToViewport(openButton,4)
			if hud and hud:IsA("GuiObject") then
				clampGuiObjectToViewport(hud,4)
			end
		end)
	end

	ui.saveSettingsNow.Activated:Connect(function()
		captureSettings()
		if saveStorage() then
			notify("SETTINGS SAVED")
		else
			notify("FILE STORAGE UNAVAILABLE")
		end
	end)

	ui.clearSavedSettings.Activated:Connect(function()
		if state.canFiles
			and type(delfile) == "function" then
			pcall(function()
				if isfile(state.file) then
					delfile(state.file)
				end
			end)
		end

		state.data.settings = {}
		errorSoundEnabled = true
		errorSoundIndex = 1
		customErrorSoundId = ""
		useCustomErrorSound = false
		customSoundIdBox.Text = ""
		errorSound.SoundId =
			"rbxassetid://"..currentErrorSoundId()
		gui:SetAttribute("ErrorSoundEnabled",true)
		gui:SetAttribute(
			"ErrorSoundId",
			currentErrorSoundId()
		)
		setToggle(errorSoundToggle,true,"ERROR SOUND")
		errorSoundChange.Text =
			"CHANGE SOUND: "..currentErrorSoundName()
		state.data.favorites = {}
		state.data.presets = {}
		state.data.waypoints = {}
		rebuildWaypoints()
		rebuildFavorites()
		notify("SAVED NOT RUBY SETTINGS CLEARED")
	end)

	applySavedSettings()

	-- --------------------------------------------------------
	-- Scan feature buttons only after all extra Settings rows exist.
	-- --------------------------------------------------------
	task.defer(function()
		task.wait(.15)
		scanFeatureButtons()
		rebuildFavorites()
	end)

	-- Automatically instrument feature buttons created later.
	for pageName,page in pairs(pages) do
		page.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(object)
			if object:IsA("TextButton")
				and object.Name ~= "FavoriteStar"
				and not object.Parent:IsA("TextButton") then
				task.defer(function()
					if object.Parent then
						makeFavoriteStar(object,pageName)
						rebuildFavorites()
					end
				end)
			end
		end)
	end

	-- Utility pages are created after the Power Suite loads.
	-- Watch the Content container too so late-added tabs still join Search
	-- and Favorites instead of being invisible to those systems.
	content.ChildAdded:Connect(function(newPage)
		if not newPage:IsA("ScrollingFrame") then
			return
		end

		task.defer(function()
			task.wait()
			local pageName =
				string.gsub(newPage.Name,"Page$","")

			for _,object in ipairs(newPage:GetDescendants()) do
				if object:IsA("TextButton")
					and object.Name ~= "FavoriteStar"
					and not object.Parent:IsA("TextButton") then
					makeFavoriteStar(object,pageName)
				end
			end

			newPage.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(object)
				if object:IsA("TextButton")
					and object.Name ~= "FavoriteStar"
					and not object.Parent:IsA("TextButton") then
					task.defer(function()
						if object.Parent then
							makeFavoriteStar(object,pageName)
							rebuildFavorites()
						end
					end)
				end
			end)

			rebuildFavorites()
		end)
	end)

	-- --------------------------------------------------------
	-- Autosave
	-- --------------------------------------------------------
	task.spawn(function()
		while gui.Parent and not menuDeleted do
			task.wait(8)
			captureSettings()
			saveStorage()
		end
	end)

	gui.Destroying:Connect(function()
		captureSettings()
		saveStorage()
		destroyWaypointObjects()
		if errorSound and errorSound.Parent then
			errorSound:Destroy()
		end
	end)

	gui:SetAttribute("ErrorSystemLoaded",true)
	notify("POWER TOOLS LOADED // SEARCH + FAVORITES + PRESETS + MORE")
end
safeSetup("Power Suite",setupPowerSuite)

local function setupProfileIntro()
	local entering = false
	panel.Visible = false

	local LocalizationService = game:GetService("LocalizationService")

	-- Per-account visit counter. On environments with file persistence,
	-- visit 1 says normal welcome; visit 2+ says WELCOME BACK // VISIT #N.
	local visitCount = 1
	local visitFile =
		"not_ruby_v1_dragon_visits_"..tostring(player.UserId)..".txt"
	local languageFile =
		"not_ruby_v1_dragon_language_"..tostring(player.UserId)..".txt"

	do
		if type(isfile) == "function"
			and type(readfile) == "function"
			and type(writefile) == "function" then

			pcall(function()
				local previous = 0

				if isfile(visitFile) then
					previous =
						tonumber(readfile(visitFile))
						or 0
				end

				visitCount = math.max(1,previous + 1)
				writefile(visitFile,tostring(visitCount))
			end)
		end
	end

	gui:SetAttribute("NotRubyVisitCount",visitCount)

	-- Flags are generated with Regional Indicator Unicode characters.
	-- This avoids hard-coding flag emoji bytes into the source.
	local function countryFlag(countryCode)
		countryCode = string.upper(tostring(countryCode or ""))
		if #countryCode ~= 2 then
			return ""
		end

		local first = string.byte(countryCode,1)
		local second = string.byte(countryCode,2)

		if not first or not second
			or first < 65 or first > 90
			or second < 65 or second > 90 then
			return ""
		end

		return utf8.char(
			0x1F1E6 + first - 65,
			0x1F1E6 + second - 65
		)
	end

	-- 3 supported welcome languages: English, Arabic and Russian.
	-- "aliases" lets the country search recognize common countries that
	-- normally use the same supported language.
	local languages = {
		{
			code = "en",
			name = "English",
			country = "United States",
			countryCode = "US",
			aliases = "United States USA US America United Kingdom UK Britain England Canada Australia New Zealand Ireland Singapore Philippines",

		},

	}

	local intro = Instance.new("Frame")
	intro.Name = "NotRubyWelcome"

	countrySearch.ZIndex = 506
	countrySearch.Parent = introCard
	corner(countrySearch,10)
	addStroke(
		countrySearch,
		gui:GetAttribute("OutlineColor") or accent,
		1.2,
		.08
	)

	local searchResults = Instance.new("ScrollingFrame")
	searchResults.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(18,323)
	searchResults.Size = UDim2.new(1,-36,0,96)
	searchResults.BackgroundColor3 = BG
	searchResults.BackgroundTransparency = .02
	searchResults.BorderSizePixel = 0
	searchResults.ScrollBarThickness = 3
	searchResults.ScrollBarImageColor3 = accent
	searchResults.CanvasSize = UDim2.fromOffset(0,0)
	searchResults.AutomaticCanvasSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y
	searchResults.ScrollingDirection = Enum.ScrollingDirection.Y
	searchResults.Visible = false
	searchResults.ZIndex = 520
	searchResults.Parent = introCard
	corner(searchResults,10)
	addStroke(
		searchResults,
		gui:GetAttribute("OutlineColor") or accent,
		1.2,
		.04
	)

	local resultsLayout = Instance.new("UIListLayout")
	resultsLayout.Padding = UDim.new(0,4)
	resultsLayout.SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder
	resultsLayout.Parent = searchResults

	local resultsPadding = Instance.new("UIPadding")
	resultsPadding.PaddingTop = UDim.new(0,5)
	resultsPadding.PaddingBottom = UDim.new(0,5)
	resultsPadding.PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0,5)
	resultsPadding.PaddingRight = UDim.new(0,5)
	resultsPadding.Parent = searchResults

	local enterButton = Instance.new("TextButton")
	enterButton.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(.5,1)
	enterButton.Position = UDim2.new(.5,0,1,-16)
	enterButton.Size = UDim2.new(1,-36,0,48)
	enterButton.Text = "ENTER NOT RUBY"
	enterButton.TextSize = 11
	enterButton.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBlack
	enterButton.TextColor3 = readableTextOn(accent)
	enterButton.BackgroundColor3 = accent
	enterButton.AutoButtonColor = false
	enterButton.ZIndex = 502
	enterButton.Parent = introCard
	corner(enterButton,12)
	addStroke(enterButton,accent,1.2,.08)

	local languageIndex = 1
	local searchSerial = 0

	local localeAliases = {
		-- Unsupported locales intentionally fall back to English.
	}

	local function findLanguageIndex(code)
		code = string.lower(tostring(code or "en"))
		code = string.match(code,"^[a-z]+") or "en"
		code = localeAliases[code] or code

		for index,language in ipairs(languages) do
			if language.code == code then
				return index
			end
		end

		return 1
	end

	local function normalizeSearch(value)
		value = string.lower(tostring(value or ""))
		value = string.gsub(value,"%s+"," ")
		value = string.gsub(value,"^%s+","")
		value = string.gsub(value,"%s+$","")
		return value
	end

	local function clearSearchResults()
		for _,child in ipairs(searchResults:GetChildren()) do
			if child:IsA("GuiButton") or child.Name == "NoCountryResult" then
				child:Destroy()
			end
		end
	end

	local function updateLanguage()
		local language = languages[languageIndex]
		if not language then
			return
		end

		local flag = countryFlag(language.countryCode)

		if visitCount > 1 then
			if language.code == "ar" then
				welcomeText.Text =
					"مرحباً بعودتك // الزيارة رقم "
					..tostring(visitCount)
			elseif language.code == "ru" then
				welcomeText.Text =
					"С ВОЗВРАЩЕНИЕМ // ВИЗИТ №"
					..tostring(visitCount)
			else
				welcomeText.Text =
					"WELCOME BACK // VISIT #"
					..tostring(visitCount)
			end
		else
			welcomeText.Text = language.welcome
		end
		welcomeSubtitle.Text = language.subtitle
		languageCaption.Text = language.language
		countrySearch.PlaceholderText = language.search

		languageButton.Text =
			flag
			.."  "
			..language.name
			.."  •  "
			..language.country
			.."  ("
			..tostring(languageIndex)
			.."/"
			..tostring(#languages)
			..")"

		enterButton.Text = language.enter

		gui:SetAttribute("WelcomeLanguageCode",language.code)
		gui:SetAttribute("WelcomeLanguageName",language.name)
		gui:SetAttribute("WelcomeCountry",language.country)
		gui:SetAttribute("WelcomeCountryCode",language.countryCode)

		if type(writefile) == "function" then
			pcall(function()
				writefile(languageFile,language.code)
			end)
		end
	end

	local function selectLanguage(index,clearSearch)
		if not languages[index] then
			return
		end

		languageIndex = index
		updateLanguage()

		if clearSearch then
			countrySearch.Text = ""
			searchResults.Visible = false
			clearSearchResults()
		end

		local scale = languageButton:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIScale")
		if not scale then
			scale = Instance.new("UIScale")
			scale.Parent = languageButton
		end

		scale.Scale = .97
		TweenService:Create(
			scale,
			TweenInfo.new(.14,Enum.EasingStyle.Back,Enum.EasingDirection.Out),
			{Scale = 1}
		):Play()
	end

	local function changeLanguage(direction)
		local newIndex = languageIndex + direction

		if newIndex < 1 then
			newIndex = #languages
		elseif newIndex > #languages then
			newIndex = 1
		end

		selectLanguage(newIndex,true)
	end

	local function rebuildCountrySearch()
		searchSerial += 1
		local mySerial = searchSerial
		local query = normalizeSearch(countrySearch.Text)

		clearSearchResults()

		if query == "" then
			searchResults.Visible = false
			return
		end

		local matches = {}

		for index,language in ipairs(languages) do
			local haystack = normalizeSearch(
				language.country
				.." "
				..language.name
				.." "
				..language.code
				.." "
				..language.countryCode
				.." "
				..tostring(language.aliases or "")
			)

			if string.find(haystack,query,1,true) then
				table.insert(matches,index)
			end
		end

		if mySerial ~= searchSerial then
			return
		end

		searchResults.Visible = true

		if #matches == 0 then
			local empty = Instance.new("TextLabel")
			empty.Name = "NoCountryResult"
			empty.Size = UDim2.new(1,-10,0,34)
			empty.BackgroundTransparency = 1
			empty.Text = "NO COUNTRY FOUND"
			empty.TextSize = 9
			empty.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
			empty.TextColor3 = MUTED
			empty.ZIndex = 521
			empty.Parent = searchResults
			return
		end

		for order,index in ipairs(matches) do
			local language = languages[index]
			local result = Instance.new("TextButton")
			result.Name = "CountryResult_"..tostring(index)
			result.Size = UDim2.new(1,-10,0,36)
			result.BackgroundColor3 = SURFACE_2
			result.BorderSizePixel = 0
			result.AutoButtonColor = false
			result.Text =
				countryFlag(language.countryCode)
				.."  "
				..language.country
				.."  •  "
				..language.name
			result.TextSize = 9
			result.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
			result.TextColor3 = TEXT
			result.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
			result.LayoutOrder = order
			result.ZIndex = 521
			result.Parent = searchResults
			corner(result,8)

			local resultPadding = Instance.new("UIPadding")
			resultPadding.PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0,10)
			resultPadding.PaddingRight = UDim.new(0,8)
			resultPadding.Parent = result

			result.Activated:Connect(function()
				selectLanguage(index,true)
			end)
		end
	end

	-- Auto-select a supported language from the player's Roblox locale.
	local localeOk,localeId = pcall(function()
		return LocalizationService.RobloxLocaleId
	end)

	if localeOk and localeId then
		languageIndex = findLanguageIndex(localeId)
	end

	if type(isfile) == "function"
		and type(readfile) == "function" then
		pcall(function()
			if isfile(languageFile) then
				languageIndex =
					findLanguageIndex(readfile(languageFile))
			end
		end)
	end

	updateLanguage()

	previousLanguage.Activated:Connect(function()
		changeLanguage(-1)
	end)

	nextLanguage.Activated:Connect(function()
		changeLanguage(1)
	end)

	languageButton.Activated:Connect(function()
		changeLanguage(1)
	end)

	countrySearch:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Text"):Connect(function()
		rebuildCountrySearch()
	end)

	countrySearch.FocusLost:Connect(function()
		-- Keep matching results open if there is still text so the user can tap one.
		if normalizeSearch(countrySearch.Text) == "" then
			searchResults.Visible = false
		end
	end)

	for _,button in ipairs({
		previousLanguage,
		languageButton,
		nextLanguage,
		enterButton
	}) do
		local scale = Instance.new("UIScale")
		scale.Parent = button

		button.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
			if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch
				or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
				TweenService:Create(
					scale,
					TweenInfo.new(.07,Enum.EasingStyle.Quad,Enum.EasingDirection.Out),
					{Scale = .97}
				):Play()
			end
		end)

		button.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
			if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch
				or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
				TweenService:Create(
					scale,
					TweenInfo.new(.12,Enum.EasingStyle.Back,Enum.EasingDirection.Out),
					{Scale = 1}
				):Play()
			end
		end)
	end

	task.spawn(function()
		local ok,image = pcall(function()
			return Players:GetUserThumbnailAsync(
				player.UserId,
				Enum.ThumbnailType.AvatarBust,
				Enum.ThumbnailSize.Size420x420
			)
		end)

		if ok and image then
			if introAvatar.Parent then
				introAvatar.Image = image
			end

			local homeAvatar =
				homePage:FindFirstChild("HomeProfileAvatar",true)

			if homeAvatar and homeAvatar:IsA("ImageLabel") then
				homeAvatar.Image = image
			end
		end
	end)

	TweenService:Create(
		introCard,
		TweenInfo.new(.30,Enum.EasingStyle.Quint,Enum.EasingDirection.Out),
		{Size = UDim2.fromOffset(420,465)}
	):Play()

	enterButton.Activated:Connect(function()
		if entering or menuDeleted then
			return
		end

		entering = true

		local selectedLanguage = languages[languageIndex]
		if selectedLanguage then
			gui:SetAttribute(
				"WelcomeLanguageCode",
				selectedLanguage.code
			)
			gui:SetAttribute(
				"WelcomeLanguageName",
				selectedLanguage.name
			)
			gui:SetAttribute(
				"WelcomeCountry",
				selectedLanguage.country
			)
			gui:SetAttribute(
				"WelcomeCountryCode",
				selectedLanguage.countryCode
			)
		end

		camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
		local viewport =
			camera and camera.ViewportSize or Vector2.new(800,600)
		if viewport.X < 650 or viewport.Y < 510 then
			local width = math.max(340,math.min(620,viewport.X-18))
			local height = math.max(300,math.min(460,viewport.Y-30))
			panel.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(width,height)
			panel.Position = UDim2.new(.5,-width*.5,.5,-height*.5)
		end
		setPanelScale(gui:GetAttribute("PanelScale"),false)

		panel.Visible = true
		setTab("DASHBOARD")

		local tween = TweenService:Create(
			intro,
			TweenInfo.new(.18),
			{BackgroundTransparency = 1}
		)
		tween:Play()
		tween.Completed:Wait()

		if intro then
			intro:Destroy()
		end

		setStatus(
			"READY // "
			..string.upper(player.DisplayName)
		)
	end)
end
local introReady = safeSetup("Welcome",setupProfileIntro)
if not introReady then
	panel.Visible = true
	currentTab = pages["DASHBOARD"] and "DASHBOARD" or "HOME"
	applyTabVisuals()
	setStatus("READY // WELCOME RECOVERED")
end
end

-- If the ScreenGui is removed externally or replaced by a fresh run, restore
-- every gameplay/lighting state instead of leaving old connections active.
gui.Destroying:Connect(function()
	if menuDeleted then
		return
	end
	menuDeleted = true
	pcall(universalCleanup)
	pcall(remakeLabsCleanup)
	pcall(function()
		setFlight(false)
		setSprint(false)
		setNoclip(false)
		resetVisuals()
		setPlayerLocator(false)
		setMonsterLocator(false)
		clearMarkerTable(playerMarkers)
		clearMarkerTable(monsterMarkers)
		player.CameraMode = Enum.CameraMode.Classic
		camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
		if camera then
			camera.CameraType = Enum.CameraType.Custom
			if humanoid and humanoid.Parent then
				camera.CameraSubject = humanoid
			end
		end
	end)
end)

applyMovementStats()
currentTab = pages["DASHBOARD"] and "DASHBOARD" or "HOME"
applyTabVisuals()
setStatus("READY")

local function setupShooterGamesTab(shooterSecurityAllowed)
	local shooterTab = makeTab("SHOOTER","SHOOTER GAMES")
	local shooterPage = makePage("SHOOTER")
	local trollPage = pages["TROLL"]
	shooterTab.Activated:Connect(function()
		setTab("SHOOTER")
	end)

	-- Extra competitive/client tools. Every control below uses the exact same
	-- shooterSecurityAllowed() gate as Aimbot / Auto Shoot / Fling.
	tabIcons.CHEATS = "⚡"
	local cheatsTab = makeTab("CHEATS","CHEATS")
	local cheatsPage = makePage("CHEATS")
	cheatsTab.Activated:Connect(function()
		setTab("CHEATS")
	end)
	-- Keep every feature's controls in one visual block so the
	-- toggle/button, radius/power and related settings cannot drift apart.
	local function makeControlGroup(page)
		local group = Instance.new("Frame")
		group.Size = UDim2.new(1,0,0,0)
		group.AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y
		group.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		group.BorderSizePixel = 0
		local nextOrder = 0
		group.ChildAdded:Connect(function(child)
			if not child:IsA("UIListLayout") then
				nextOrder = nextOrder + 1
				child.LayoutOrder = nextOrder
			end
		end)
		group.Parent = page
		local layout = Instance.new("UIListLayout")
		layout.Padding = UDim.new(0,8)
		layout.HorizontalAlignment = Enum.HorizontalAlignment.Center
		layout.SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder
		layout.Parent = group
		return group
	end
	-- --------------------------------------------------------
	-- OTHER HUBS
	-- External hubs are still protected by the same own-game PlaceId lock.
	-- --------------------------------------------------------
	local otherHubsTab = makeTab("OTHERHUBS","OTHER HUBS")
	local otherHubsPage = makePage("OTHERHUBS")
	otherHubsTab.Activated:Connect(function()
		setTab("OTHERHUBS")
	end)
	local otherHubsGroup = makeControlGroup(otherHubsPage)
	makeSection(
		otherHubsGroup,
		"BOOM EMPYREUS'S HUB",
		"Loads Boom Empyreus's Hub."
	)
	local boomEmpyreusHubButton =
		makeAction(
			otherHubsGroup,
			shooterSecurityAllowed()
			and "EXECUTE BOOM EMPYREUS'S HUB"
			or "BOOM EMPYREUS'S HUB [LOCKED]"
		)
	boomEmpyreusHubButton.Activated:Connect(function()
		if not shooterSecurityAllowed() then
			boomEmpyreusHubButton.Text =
				"BOOM EMPYREUS'S HUB [LOCKED]"
			setStatus(
				"BOOM EMPYREUS'S HUB // WRONG PLACEID"
			)
			return
		end
		boomEmpyreusHubButton.Text =
			"BOOM EMPYREUS'S HUB [LOADING]"
		setStatus("BOOM EMPYREUS'S HUB // LOADING")
		task.spawn(function()
			local ok,err = pcall(function()
				if type(loadstring) ~= "function" then
					error("LOADSTRING IS NOT SUPPORTED BY THIS RUNTIME")
				end
				local source = game:HttpGet(
					"https://pastebin.com/raw/fNjdsV4F",
					true
				)
				if type(source) ~= "string" or #source < 2 then
					error("HUB SOURCE DOWNLOAD RETURNED EMPTY DATA")
				end
				local runner,compileError = loadstring(source)
				if not runner then
					error(compileError or "LOADSTRING COMPILE FAILED")
				end
				runner()
			end)
			if ok then
				boomEmpyreusHubButton.Text =
					"EXECUTE BOOM EMPYREUS'S HUB"
				setStatus(
					"BOOM EMPYREUS'S HUB // LOADED"
				)
			else
				boomEmpyreusHubButton.Text =
					"EXECUTE BOOM EMPYREUS'S HUB"
				setStatus(
					"BOOM EMPYREUS'S HUB // LOAD ERROR"
				)
				warn(
					"[NOT RUBY V1] Boom Empyreus Hub error:",
					err
				)
			end
		end)
	end)
	-- --------------------------------------------------------
	-- AUTO DODGE // TROLL
	-- Broad held-threat detection: equipped Tools plus common weapon Models.
	-- Roblox has no universal damage property, so equipped Tools are treated
	-- as possible damage threats even when their damage is script-defined.
	-- Floating DODGE button remains a manual fallback.

	)

			autoDodgeGroup,

			or "AUTO DODGE [LOCKED]"
		)
	local dodgeRadiusBox,dodgeRadiusApply =

	local dodgeDistanceBox,dodgeDistanceApply =
		makeNumberRow(
			autoDodgeGroup,
			"DODGE DISTANCE",

			"SET"

		dodgeButton.TextColor3 = TEXT

		dodgeButton.BorderSizePixel = 0
		dodgeButton.AutoButtonColor = false
		dodgeButton.Visible = false
		dodgeButton.ZIndex = 850
		dodgeButton.Parent = gui
	corner(dodgeButton,1000)
	addStroke(
		dodgeButton,
		gui:GetAttribute("OutlineColor") or accent,
		2,
		.02
	)
	-- --------------------------------------------------------
	-- FLING // TROLL
	-- Client physics fling based on the supplied mechanism.
	-- Hard-gated by the same own-game PlaceId checker as shooter tools.

	local shooterAimGroup = makeControlGroup(shooterPage)
	makeSection(

	local autoFaceButton =

	local locatorObjects = {}
	local function isSameTeam(otherPlayer)
		if otherPlayer == player then
			return true
		end
		if player.Neutral or otherPlayer.Neutral then
			return false
		end
		return player.Team ~= nil
			and otherPlayer.Team ~= nil
			and player.Team == otherPlayer.Team
	end

	local extraVisualFolder = Instance.new("Folder")
	extraVisualFolder.Name = "NotRubyExtraCheatVisuals"
	extraVisualFolder.Parent = workspace
	local extraVisualObjects = {}
	local hitboxOriginals = {}

	local function setScreenLine(frame,pointA,pointB,thickness)
		local delta = pointB-pointA
		local length = delta.Magnitude
		frame.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(.5,.5)
		frame.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(
			(pointA.X+pointB.X)*.5,
			(pointA.Y+pointB.Y)*.5
		)
		frame.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(math.max(1,length),thickness or 2)
		frame.Rotation = math.deg(math.atan2(delta.Y,delta.X))
	end

	local function clearExtraVisual(otherPlayer)
		local bundle = extraVisualObjects[otherPlayer]
		if not bundle then
			return
		end
		for _,object in pairs(bundle) do
			if typeof(object) == "Instance" and object.Parent then
				object:Destroy()
			end
		end
		extraVisualObjects[otherPlayer] = nil
	end

	local function clearAllExtraVisuals()
		for otherPlayer in pairs(extraVisualObjects) do
			clearExtraVisual(otherPlayer)
		end
	end

	local function ensureExtraVisual(otherPlayer)
		if otherPlayer == player or isSameTeam(otherPlayer) then
			clearExtraVisual(otherPlayer)
			return nil
		end
		local character = otherPlayer.Character
		local humanoid =
			character
			and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
		local rootPart =
			character
			and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		local head =
			character
			and character:FindFirstChild("Head")
		if not humanoid
			or humanoid.Health <= 0
			or not rootPart then
			clearExtraVisual(otherPlayer)
			return nil
		end

		local bundle = extraVisualObjects[otherPlayer]
		if bundle
			and bundle.root == rootPart
			and bundle.tracer
			and bundle.tracer.Parent
			and bundle.billboard
			and bundle.billboard.Parent then
			return bundle
		end
		clearExtraVisual(otherPlayer)

		local tracer = Instance.new("Frame")
		tracer.Name = "NotRubyTracer_"..tostring(otherPlayer.UserId)
		tracer.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255,70,85)
		tracer.BorderSizePixel = 0
		tracer.Visible = false
		tracer.ZIndex = 706
		tracer.Parent = overlay
		corner(tracer,1000)

		local billboard = Instance.new("BillboardGui")
		billboard.Name = "NotRubyHealthESP_"..tostring(otherPlayer.UserId)
		billboard.Adornee = head or rootPart
		billboard.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(250,46)
		billboard.StudsOffset = Vector3.new(0,3.3,0)
		billboard.AlwaysOnTop = true
		billboard.Enabled = false
		billboard.Parent = extraVisualFolder

		local label = Instance.new("TextLabel")
		label.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1,1)
		label.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		label.Text = otherPlayer.DisplayName
		label.TextSize = 10
		label.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBlack
		label.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255,85,95)
		label.TextStrokeTransparency = .22
		label.Parent = billboard

		bundle = {
			tracer = tracer,
			billboard = billboard,
			label = label,
			root = rootPart,
			humanoid = humanoid
		}
		extraVisualObjects[otherPlayer] = bundle
		return bundle
	end

	local function updateExtraVisuals()
		if not shooterSecurityAllowed() then
			clearAllExtraVisuals()
			return
		end
		if not state.tracers and not state.healthEsp then
			clearAllExtraVisuals()
			return
		end
		camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
		if not camera then
			return
		end
		local viewport = camera.ViewportSize
		local origin2D = Vector2.new(viewport.X*.5,viewport.Y-24)
		local localRoot =
			player.Character
			and player.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		for _,otherPlayer in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
			if otherPlayer ~= player and not isSameTeam(otherPlayer) then
				local bundle = ensureExtraVisual(otherPlayer)
				if bundle then
					local screen,onScreen =
						camera:WorldToViewportPoint(bundle.root.Position)
					bundle.tracer.Visible =
						state.tracers
						and onScreen
						and screen.Z > 0
					if bundle.tracer.Visible then
						setScreenLine(
							bundle.tracer,
							origin2D,
							Vector2.new(screen.X,screen.Y),
							2
						)
					end
					bundle.billboard.Enabled = state.healthEsp
					if state.healthEsp then
						local health = math.max(0,math.floor(bundle.humanoid.Health+.5))
						local maxHealth = math.max(1,math.floor(bundle.humanoid.MaxHealth+.5))
						local distance = 0
						if localRoot then
							distance = math.floor(
								(localRoot.Position-bundle.root.Position).Magnitude
							)
						end
						bundle.label.Text =
							otherPlayer.DisplayName
							.."  //  HP "
							..tostring(health)
							.."/"
							..tostring(maxHealth)
							.."  //  "
							..tostring(distance)
							.." studs"
					end
				end
			else
				clearExtraVisual(otherPlayer)
			end
		end
		for otherPlayer in pairs(extraVisualObjects) do
			if otherPlayer.Parent ~= Players or isSameTeam(otherPlayer) then
				clearExtraVisual(otherPlayer)
			end
		end
	end

	local function restoreHitboxes()
		for rootPart,original in pairs(hitboxOriginals) do
			if rootPart and rootPart.Parent then
				pcall(function()
					rootPart.Size = original.Size
					rootPart.Transparency = original.Transparency
				end)
			end
			hitboxOriginals[rootPart] = nil
		end
	end

	local function refreshHitboxes()
		if not state.hitboxExpander or not shooterSecurityAllowed() then
			restoreHitboxes()
			return
		end
		local liveRoots = {}
		for _,otherPlayer in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
			if otherPlayer ~= player and not isSameTeam(otherPlayer) then
				local character = otherPlayer.Character
				local humanoid =
					character
					and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
				local rootPart =
					character
					and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
				if humanoid
					and humanoid.Health > 0
					and rootPart
					and rootPart:IsA("BasePart") then
					liveRoots[rootPart] = true
					if not hitboxOriginals[rootPart] then
						hitboxOriginals[rootPart] = {
							Size = rootPart.Size,
							Transparency = rootPart.Transparency
						}
					end
					pcall(function()
						rootPart.Size = Vector3.new(
							state.hitboxSize,
							state.hitboxSize,
							state.hitboxSize
						)
						rootPart.Transparency = math.max(
							hitboxOriginals[rootPart].Transparency,
							.58
						)
					end)
				end
			end
		end
		for rootPart,original in pairs(hitboxOriginals) do
			if not liveRoots[rootPart] then
				if rootPart and rootPart.Parent then
					pcall(function()
						rootPart.Size = original.Size
						rootPart.Transparency = original.Transparency
					end)
				end
				hitboxOriginals[rootPart] = nil
			end
		end
	end

	local function clearLocator(targetPlayer)
		local bundle = locatorObjects[targetPlayer]
		if not bundle then
			return
		end
		for _,object in pairs(bundle) do
			if object and object.Parent then
				object:Destroy()
			end
		end
		locatorObjects[targetPlayer] = nil
	end
	local function clearAllLocators()
		for targetPlayer in pairs(locatorObjects) do
			clearLocator(targetPlayer)
		end
	end
	local function shouldShowPlayer(otherPlayer)
		if otherPlayer == player then
			return false,nil
		end
		local sameTeam = isSameTeam(otherPlayer)
		if sameTeam and state.teamLocator then
			return true,Color3.fromRGB(65,225,120)
		end
		if not sameTeam and state.enemyLocator then
			return true,Color3.fromRGB(255,55,70)
		end
		return false,nil
	end
	local function createLocator(otherPlayer,color)
		clearLocator(otherPlayer)
		local character = otherPlayer.Character
		if not character then
			return
		end
		local humanoid =
			character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
		local head = character:FindFirstChild("Head")
		local root =
			character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		if not humanoid or not root then
			return
		end
		local highlight = Instance.new("Highlight")
		highlight.Name =
			"NotRubyShooterHighlight_"
			..tostring(otherPlayer.UserId)
		highlight.Adornee = character
		highlight.FillColor = color
		highlight.OutlineColor = color
		highlight.FillTransparency = .78
		highlight.OutlineTransparency = .05
		highlight.DepthMode =
			Enum.HighlightDepthMode.AlwaysOnTop
		highlight.Parent = locatorFolder
		local billboard = Instance.new("BillboardGui")
		billboard.Name =
			"NotRubyShooterLabel_"
			..tostring(otherPlayer.UserId)
		billboard.Adornee = head or root
		billboard.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(220,42)
		billboard.StudsOffset = Vector3.new(0,2.7,0)
		billboard.AlwaysOnTop = true
		billboard.Parent = locatorFolder
		local label = Instance.new("TextLabel")
		label.Name = "Label"
		label.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1,1)
		label.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		label.Text = otherPlayer.DisplayName
		label.TextSize = 10
		label.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBlack
		label.TextColor3 = color
		label.TextStrokeTransparency = .28
		label.Parent = billboard
		locatorObjects[otherPlayer] = {
			highlight = highlight,
			billboard = billboard,
			label = label,
			root = root
		}
	end
	local function refreshLocators()
		for _,otherPlayer in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
			local show,color =
				shouldShowPlayer(otherPlayer)
			if show then
				local bundle = locatorObjects[otherPlayer]
				local character = otherPlayer.Character
				if not bundle
					or not bundle.highlight
					or not bundle.highlight.Parent
					or bundle.highlight.Adornee ~= character then
					createLocator(otherPlayer,color)
				else
					bundle.highlight.FillColor = color
					bundle.highlight.OutlineColor = color
					bundle.label.TextColor3 = color
				end
			else
				clearLocator(otherPlayer)
			end
		end
		for targetPlayer in pairs(locatorObjects) do
			if targetPlayer.Parent ~= Players then
				clearLocator(targetPlayer)
			end
		end
	end
	local function isAimTargetVisible(targetPart)
		camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
		if not camera or not targetPart then
			return false
		end
		local origin = camera.CFrame.Position
		local direction = targetPart.Position - origin
		local params = RaycastParams.new()
		params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
		params.FilterDescendantsInstances = {
			player.Character
		}
		local result = workspace:Raycast(origin,direction,params)
		if not result then
			return true
		end
		return result.Instance
			and result.Instance:IsDescendantOf(targetPart.Parent)
	end
	local function getBestAimTarget()
		camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
		if not camera then
			return nil
		end
		local viewport = camera.ViewportSize
		local center =
			Vector2.new(viewport.X*.5,viewport.Y*.5)
		local bestPart = nil
		local bestDistance = state.fovRadius
		for _,otherPlayer in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
			if otherPlayer ~= player
				and not isSameTeam(otherPlayer)
				and (
					not state.selectedAimbotPlayer
					or otherPlayer == state.selectedAimbotPlayer
				) then
				local character = otherPlayer.Character
				local humanoid =
					character
					and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
				local targetPart =
					character
					and (
						character:FindFirstChild(state.aimTarget)
						or character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
					)
				if humanoid
					and humanoid.Health > 0
					and targetPart
					and targetPart:IsA("BasePart") then
					local screenPosition,onScreen =
						camera:WorldToViewportPoint(targetPart.Position)
					if onScreen and screenPosition.Z > 0 then
						local screenDistance =
							(Vector2.new(
								screenPosition.X,
								screenPosition.Y
							)-center).Magnitude
						if screenDistance <= bestDistance
							and isAimTargetVisible(targetPart) then
							bestDistance = screenDistance
							bestPart = targetPart
						end
					end
				end
			end
		end
		return bestPart
	end
	local function getAimbotTargetPart()
		camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
		if not camera then
			state.lockedTarget = nil
			return nil
		end
		local viewport = camera.ViewportSize
		local center =
			Vector2.new(viewport.X*.5,viewport.Y*.5)
		local function validTarget(otherPlayer)
			if not otherPlayer
				or otherPlayer == player
				or otherPlayer.Parent ~= Players
				or isSameTeam(otherPlayer) then
				return nil
			end
			if state.selectedAimbotPlayer
				and otherPlayer ~= state.selectedAimbotPlayer then
				return nil
			end
			local character = otherPlayer.Character
			local humanoid =
				character
				and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
			local targetPart =
				character
				and (
					character:FindFirstChild(state.aimTarget)
					or character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
				)
			if not humanoid
				or humanoid.Health <= 0
				or not targetPart
				or not targetPart:IsA("BasePart") then
				return nil
			end
			local screenPosition,onScreen =
				camera:WorldToViewportPoint(targetPart.Position)
			if not onScreen or screenPosition.Z <= 0 then
				return nil
			end
			local distance =
				(Vector2.new(
					screenPosition.X,
					screenPosition.Y
				)-center).Magnitude
			if distance > state.fovRadius then
				return nil
			end
			if not isAimTargetVisible(targetPart) then
				return nil
			end
			return targetPart
		end
		local currentPart = validTarget(state.lockedTarget)
		if currentPart then
			return currentPart
		end
		state.lockedTarget = nil
		if state.selectedAimbotPlayer then
			local selectedPart =
				validTarget(state.selectedAimbotPlayer)
			if selectedPart then
				state.lockedTarget =
					state.selectedAimbotPlayer
			end
			return selectedPart
		end
		local bestPlayer = nil
		local bestPart = nil
		local bestDistance = state.fovRadius
		for _,otherPlayer in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
			local part = validTarget(otherPlayer)
			if part then
				local screenPosition =
					camera:WorldToViewportPoint(part.Position)
				local distance =
					(Vector2.new(
						screenPosition.X,
						screenPosition.Y
					)-center).Magnitude
				if distance < bestDistance then
					bestDistance = distance
					bestPlayer = otherPlayer
					bestPart = part
				end
			end
		end
		state.lockedTarget = bestPlayer
		return bestPart
	end
	local damageKeys = {
		"Damage",
		"damage",
		"BaseDamage",
		"HitDamage",
		"AttackDamage",
		"Dmg",
		"Power"
	}
	local weaponNameHints = {
		"sword","knife","blade","katana","dagger","axe","hammer",
		"bat","club","mace","spear","gun","pistol","rifle",
		"shotgun","smg","sniper","bow","crossbow","weapon",
		"bomb","grenade","launcher","cannon","wand","staff"
	}
	local function nameLooksLikeWeapon(name)
		local lower = string.lower(tostring(name or ""))
		for _,hint in ipairs(weaponNameHints) do
			if string.find(lower,hint,1,true) then
				return true
			end
		end
		return false
	end
	local function objectAdvertisesDamage(object)
		if not object then
			return false
		end
		for _,key in ipairs(damageKeys) do
			local attribute = nil
			pcall(function()
				attribute = object:GetAttribute(key)
			end)
			if typeof(attribute) == "number" and attribute > 0 then
				return true
			end
			local valueObject = nil
			pcall(function()
				valueObject = object:FindFirstChild(key,true)
			end)
			if valueObject
				and (
					valueObject:IsA("NumberValue")
					or valueObject:IsA("IntValue")
				)
				and tonumber(valueObject.Value)
				and tonumber(valueObject.Value) > 0 then
				return true
			end
		end
		return false
	end
	local function getHeldDamageThreat(otherPlayer)
		local otherCharacter =
			otherPlayer
			and otherPlayer.Character
		if not otherCharacter then
			return false,nil
		end

		-- Tool is Roblox's standard equipped/held object. Damage is often
		-- implemented only inside scripts/remotes, so any equipped Tool is
		-- considered a possible damage threat even without a visible Damage value.
		local equippedTool = otherCharacter:FindFirstChildOfClass("Tool")
		if equippedTool then
			return true,equippedTool
		end

		-- Some games weld a Model directly into the character instead of using
		-- Tool. Detect Models that look held/weapon-like or advertise damage.
		for _,object in ipairs(otherCharacter:GetChildren()) do
			if object:IsA("Model") then
				local hasHandle = object:FindFirstChild("Handle",true) ~= nil
				if hasHandle
					or nameLooksLikeWeapon(object.Name)
					or objectAdvertisesDamage(object) then
					return true,object
				end
			end
		end
		return false,nil
	end
	local function findDodgeThreat(requireHeldThreat)
		local currentCharacter = player.Character
		local currentRoot =
			currentCharacter
			and currentCharacter:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		if not currentRoot then
			return nil,nil,nil
		end
		local bestPlayer = nil
		local bestRoot = nil
		local bestThreatObject = nil
		local bestDistance = state.dodgeRadius
		for _,otherPlayer in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
			if otherPlayer ~= player then
				local threatening,threatObject =
					getHeldDamageThreat(otherPlayer)
				if not requireHeldThreat or threatening then
					local otherCharacter = otherPlayer.Character
					local otherHumanoid =
						otherCharacter
						and otherCharacter:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
					local otherRoot =
						otherCharacter
						and otherCharacter:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
					if otherHumanoid
						and otherHumanoid.Health > 0
						and otherRoot then
						local distance =
							(currentRoot.Position-otherRoot.Position).Magnitude
						if distance <= bestDistance then
							bestDistance = distance
							bestPlayer = otherPlayer
							bestRoot = otherRoot
							bestThreatObject = threatObject
						end
					end
				end
			end
		end
		return bestPlayer,bestRoot,bestThreatObject
	end
	local function performDodge(requireHeldThreat,silentNoTarget)
		if not state.autoDodge
			or not shooterSecurityAllowed() then
			return
		end
		local now = os.clock()
		if now - state.lastDodge < .25 then
			return
		end
		local currentCharacter = player.Character
		local currentRoot =
			currentCharacter
			and currentCharacter:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		if not currentRoot then
			setStatus("NO CHARACTER ROOT FOUND")
			return
		end
		local threatPlayer,threatRoot,threatObject =
			findDodgeThreat(requireHeldThreat == true)
		if not threatPlayer or not threatRoot then
			if not silentNoTarget then
				setStatus(
					requireHeldThreat
					and "AUTO DODGE // NO HELD DAMAGE THREAT IN RADIUS"
					or "DODGE // NO PLAYER IN RADIUS"
				)
			end
			return
		end
		local direction =
			currentRoot.Position-threatRoot.Position
		direction = Vector3.new(direction.X,0,direction.Z)
		if direction.Magnitude < .1 then
			camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
			local look =
				camera
				and camera.CFrame.LookVector
				or Vector3.new(0,0,-1)
			direction = Vector3.new(-look.X,0,-look.Z)
		end
		if direction.Magnitude < .1 then
			direction = Vector3.new(1,0,0)
		end
		local offset =
			direction.Unit*state.dodgeDistance
		local params = RaycastParams.new()
		params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
		params.FilterDescendantsInstances = {
			currentCharacter,
			threatPlayer.Character
		}
		local hit =
			workspace:Raycast(
				currentRoot.Position,
				offset,
				params
			)
		if hit then
			local safeDistance =
				math.max(0,hit.Distance-2)
			if safeDistance < 2 then
				setStatus("AUTO DODGE // PATH BLOCKED")
				return
			end
			offset = direction.Unit*safeDistance
		end
		local rotation =
			currentRoot.CFrame-currentRoot.Position
		currentRoot.CFrame =
			CFrame.new(currentRoot.Position+offset)*rotation
		currentRoot.AssemblyLinearVelocity =
			Vector3.new(0,currentRoot.AssemblyLinearVelocity.Y,0)
		state.lastDodge = now
		setStatus(
			"DODGED // "
			..threatPlayer.DisplayName
			..(
				threatObject
				and " // "..string.upper(string.sub(threatObject.Name,1,16))
				or ""
			)
		)
	end
	local function setAutoDodge(value)
		if not shooterSecurityAllowed() then
			state.autoDodge = false
			dodgeButton.Visible = false
			autoDodgeButton.Text = "AUTO DODGE [LOCKED]"
			setStatus(
				"SET SHOOTER_ALLOWED_PLACE_ID TO YOUR GAME PLACEID"
			)
			return
		end
		state.autoDodge = value == true
		gui:SetAttribute("ShooterAutoDodge",state.autoDodge)
		state.lastDodge = 0
		dodgeButton.Visible = state.autoDodge
		setToggle(
			autoDodgeButton,
			state.autoDodge,
			"AUTO DODGE"
		)
		if state.autoDodge then
			setStatus(
				"AUTO DODGE ON"
			)
		else
			setStatus("AUTO DODGE OFF")
		end
	end
	-- --------------------------------------------------------
	-- PLACEID-LOCKED CLIENT FLING
	-- Adapted from the user-supplied physics mechanism.
	-- The lock is checked before starting AND continuously while running.
	-- --------------------------------------------------------
	local function stopClientFling(message)
		if state.flingActive then
			state.flingActive = false
			state.flingToken = state.flingToken + 1
		end
		if shooterSecurityAllowed() then
			setToggle(flingButton,false,"FLING")
		else
			flingButton.Text = "FLING [LOCKED]"
		end
		if message then
			setStatus(message)
		end
	end
	local function startClientFling()
		if not shooterSecurityAllowed() then
			stopClientFling()
			flingButton.Text = "FLING [LOCKED]"
			setStatus(
				"SET SHOOTER_ALLOWED_PLACE_ID TO YOUR GAME PLACEID"
			)
			return
		end
		if state.flingActive then
			stopClientFling("FLING STOPPED")
			return
		end
		local targetPlayer = state.selectedFlingPlayer
		if not targetPlayer
			or targetPlayer == player
			or targetPlayer.Parent ~= Players then
			setStatus("FLING ERROR // NO PLAYER SELECTED")
			return
		end
		local character = player.Character
		local humanoid =
			character
			and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
		local rootPart =
			character
			and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		local targetCharacter = targetPlayer.Character
		local targetHumanoid =
			targetCharacter
			and targetCharacter:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
		local targetRoot =
			targetCharacter
			and targetCharacter:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		local targetHead =
			targetCharacter
			and targetCharacter:FindFirstChild("Head")
		local targetAccessory =
			targetCharacter
			and targetCharacter:FindFirstChildOfClass("Accessory")
		local targetHandle =
			targetAccessory
			and targetAccessory:FindFirstChild("Handle")
		local targetPart = targetRoot or targetHead or targetHandle
		if not character
			or not humanoid
			or not rootPart then
			setStatus("FLING ERROR // YOUR CHARACTER IS NOT READY")
			return
		end
		if not targetCharacter
			or not targetHumanoid
			or targetHumanoid.Health <= 0
			or not targetPart
			or not targetPart:IsA("BasePart") then
			setStatus("FLING ERROR // TARGET INVALID")
			return
		end
		if targetHumanoid.Sit then
			setStatus("FLING ERROR // TARGET IS SITTING")
			return
		end
		state.flingActive = true
		state.flingToken = state.flingToken + 1
		local myToken = state.flingToken
		setToggle(flingButton,true,"FLING")
		setStatus("FLING ON")
		task.spawn(function()
			local oldPosition = rootPart.CFrame
			local oldCameraSubject =
				workspace.CurrentCamera
				and workspace.CurrentCamera.CameraSubject
				or humanoid
			local oldFallenPartsDestroyHeight =
				workspace.FallenPartsDestroyHeight
			local oldSeatedState =
				humanoid:GetStateEnabled(
					Enum.HumanoidStateType.Seated
				)
			local bodyVelocity = nil
			local function restore()
				if bodyVelocity and bodyVelocity.Parent then
					bodyVelocity:Destroy()
				end
				if humanoid and humanoid.Parent then
					pcall(function()
						humanoid:SetStateEnabled(
							Enum.HumanoidStateType.Seated,
							oldSeatedState
						)
					end)
				end
				if workspace.CurrentCamera then
					workspace.CurrentCamera.CameraSubject =
						(humanoid and humanoid.Parent)
						and humanoid
						or oldCameraSubject
				end
				if rootPart and rootPart.Parent then
					pcall(function()
						rootPart.CFrame =
							oldPosition*CFrame.new(0,.5,0)
						rootPart.AssemblyLinearVelocity =
							Vector3.zero
						rootPart.AssemblyAngularVelocity =
							Vector3.zero
					end)
				end
				pcall(function()
					workspace.FallenPartsDestroyHeight =
						oldFallenPartsDestroyHeight
				end)
			end
			local ok,_err =
				xpcall(
					function()
						pcall(function()
							workspace.FallenPartsDestroyHeight = 0/0
						end)
						bodyVelocity = Instance.new("BodyVelocity")
						bodyVelocity.Name = "NotRubyFlingVelocity"
						bodyVelocity.Velocity = Vector3.zero
						bodyVelocity.MaxForce =
							Vector3.new(9e9,9e9,9e9)
						bodyVelocity.Parent = rootPart
						humanoid:SetStateEnabled(
							Enum.HumanoidStateType.Seated,
							false
						)
						local linearPower =
							math.max(
								1e6,
								state.flingPower*450000
							)
						local angularPower =
							math.max(
								1e7,
								state.flingPower*4300000
							)
						while state.flingActive
							and state.flingToken == myToken
							and shooterSecurityAllowed()
							and targetPlayer.Parent == Players
							and targetHumanoid.Parent
							and targetHumanoid.Health > 0
							and targetPart.Parent do
							local cycleStart = os.clock()
							local angle = 0
							if workspace.CurrentCamera then
								workspace.CurrentCamera.CameraSubject =
									targetHead
									or targetHandle
									or targetHumanoid
							end
							while state.flingActive
								and state.flingToken == myToken
								and shooterSecurityAllowed()
								and os.clock()-cycleStart < 2
								and targetPart.Parent do
								angle = angle + 100
								local velocityMagnitude =
									targetPart.AssemblyLinearVelocity.Magnitude
								local moveDirection =
									targetHumanoid.MoveDirection
								local offsets
								if velocityMagnitude < 50 then
									offsets = {
										CFrame.new(
											0,
											1.5,
											0
										)
										+moveDirection
										*velocityMagnitude/1.25,
										CFrame.new(
											0,
											-1.5,
											0
										)
										+moveDirection
										*velocityMagnitude/1.25,
										CFrame.new(
											0,
											1.5,
											0
										)
										+moveDirection,
										CFrame.new(
											0,
											-1.5,
											0
										)
										+moveDirection
									}
								else
									offsets = {
										CFrame.new(
											0,
											1.5,
											targetHumanoid.WalkSpeed
										),
										CFrame.new(
											0,
											-1.5,
											-targetHumanoid.WalkSpeed
										),
										CFrame.new(0,-1.5,0)
									}
								end
								for index,offset in ipairs(offsets) do
									if not state.flingActive
										or state.flingToken ~= myToken
										or not shooterSecurityAllowed()
										or not targetPart.Parent then
										break
									end
									local spin =
										index%2 == 0
										and CFrame.Angles(
											0,
											0,
											0
										)
										or CFrame.Angles(
											math.rad(angle),
											0,
											0
										)
									rootPart.CFrame =
										CFrame.new(
											targetPart.Position
										)*offset*spin
									rootPart.AssemblyLinearVelocity =
										Vector3.new(
											linearPower,
											linearPower*10,
											linearPower
										)
									rootPart.AssemblyAngularVelocity =
										Vector3.new(
											angularPower,
											angularPower,
											angularPower
										)
									RunService.Heartbeat:Wait()
								end
							end
							if rootPart and rootPart.Parent then
								rootPart.CFrame =
									oldPosition*CFrame.new(0,.5,0)
								rootPart.AssemblyLinearVelocity =
									Vector3.zero
								rootPart.AssemblyAngularVelocity =
									Vector3.zero
							end
							task.wait(.12)
						end
					end,
					function(errorMessage)
						return tostring(errorMessage)
					end
				)
			restore()
			-- Only the currently-running fling session may change the button.
			if state.flingToken == myToken then
				state.flingActive = false
				if shooterSecurityAllowed() then
					setToggle(flingButton,false,"FLING")
				else
					flingButton.Text = "FLING [LOCKED]"
				end
				if not ok then
					setStatus("FLING ERROR // CLIENT PHYSICS FAILED")
				else
					setStatus("FLING STOPPED")
				end
			end
		end)
	end

		setToggle(

			setStatus(

				state.autoShoot
				and "AUTO SHOOT ON"
				or "AUTO SHOOT OFF"
			)
		end

	local function tryAutoShoot(targetPart)
		if not state.autoShoot
			or not shooterSecurityAllowed()
			or not targetPart then
			return
		end
		local now = os.clock()
		if now - state.lastAutoShot < .05 then
			return
		end
		local character = player.Character
		local tool =
			character
			and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Tool")
		if not tool or tool.Enabled == false then
			if not state.shootNoWeaponReported then
				state.shootNoWeaponReported = true
				setStatus(
					"AUTO SHOOT ERROR // NO WEAPON EQUIPPED"
				)
			end
			return
		end
		state.shootNoWeaponReported = false
		state.lastAutoShot = now
		pcall(function()
			tool:Activate()
		end)
	end
	local function setSecurityToggle(button,stateKey,label,value)

			button.BackgroundColor3 = SURFACE_2
			button.TextColor3 = MUTED
			setStatus("SET SHOOTER_ALLOWED_PLACE_ID TO YOUR GAME PLACEID")
			return false
		end
		state[stateKey] = value == true
		setToggle(button,state[stateKey],label)
		setStatus(label.." "..(state[stateKey] and "ON" or "OFF"))
		return true
	end

			return state.selectedAimbotPlayer

		end
		return nil
	end

	end

	-- ---------------- TOUCH FLING ----------------
	-- Replacement based on the supplied hidden-fling implementation.
	-- Uses the existing NOT RUBY button/UI and the same PlaceId security gate.
	local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
	if not ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("juisdfj0i32i0eidsuf0iok") then
		local detection = Instance.new("Decal")
		detection.Name = "juisdfj0i32i0eidsuf0iok"
		detection.Parent = ReplicatedStorage
	end

	local function startTouchFling()
		if not shooterSecurityAllowed() then
			state.touchFling = false
			touchFlingButton.Text = "TOUCH FLING [LOCKED]"
			touchFlingButton.BackgroundColor3 = SURFACE_2
			touchFlingButton.TextColor3 = MUTED
			setStatus("SET SHOOTER_ALLOWED_PLACE_ID TO YOUR GAME PLACEID")
			return
		end

		if state.touchFling then
			return
		end

		state.touchFling = true
		state.touchFlingToken = state.touchFlingToken + 1
		local myToken = state.touchFlingToken
		setToggle(touchFlingButton,true,"TOUCH FLING")
		setStatus("TOUCH FLING ON")

		task.spawn(function()
			local movel = 0.1

			while state.touchFling
				and state.touchFlingToken == myToken
				and shooterSecurityAllowed()
				and gui.Parent
				and not menuDeleted do

				RunService.Heartbeat:Wait()

				local character = player.Character
				local hrp =
					character
					and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

				if hrp then
					local vel = hrp.Velocity
					hrp.Velocity =
						vel*10000
						+Vector3.new(0,10000,0)

					RunService.RenderStepped:Wait()

					if not state.touchFling
						or state.touchFlingToken ~= myToken
						or not hrp.Parent then
						break
					end

					hrp.Velocity = vel
					RunService.Stepped:Wait()

					if hrp.Parent then
						hrp.Velocity =
							vel
							+Vector3.new(0,movel,0)
						movel = -movel
					end
				end
			end

			if state.touchFlingToken == myToken then
				state.touchFling = false
				if shooterSecurityAllowed()
					and gui.Parent
					and not menuDeleted then
					setToggle(touchFlingButton,false,"TOUCH FLING")
				else
					touchFlingButton.Text = "TOUCH FLING [LOCKED]"
				end
			end
		end)
	end

	local function stopTouchFling(message)
		if state.touchFling then
			state.touchFling = false
			state.touchFlingToken = state.touchFlingToken + 1
		end

		if shooterSecurityAllowed() then
			setToggle(touchFlingButton,false,"TOUCH FLING")
		else
			touchFlingButton.Text = "TOUCH FLING [LOCKED]"
			touchFlingButton.BackgroundColor3 = SURFACE_2
			touchFlingButton.TextColor3 = MUTED
		end

		if message then
			setStatus(message)
		end
	end

	touchFlingButton.Activated:Connect(function()
		if not shooterSecurityAllowed() then
			stopTouchFling(
				"SET SHOOTER_ALLOWED_PLACE_ID TO YOUR GAME PLACEID"
			)
			return
		end

		if state.touchFling then
			stopTouchFling("TOUCH FLING OFF")
		else
			startTouchFling()
		end
	end)

	local function performDirectionalDash(directionName)
		if not shooterSecurityAllowed() then
			setStatus("SET SHOOTER_ALLOWED_PLACE_ID TO YOUR GAME PLACEID")
			return
		end
		local ownRoot =
			player.Character
			and player.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		if not ownRoot then
			setStatus("DASH // CHARACTER NOT READY")
			return
		end
		local cf = ownRoot.CFrame
		local direction = cf.LookVector
		if directionName == "BACK" then direction = -cf.LookVector end
		if directionName == "LEFT" then direction = -cf.RightVector end
		if directionName == "RIGHT" then direction = cf.RightVector end
		local flat = Vector3.new(direction.X,0,direction.Z)
		if flat.Magnitude < .05 then return end
		local offset = flat.Unit*state.dashDistance
		local params = RaycastParams.new()
		params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
		params.FilterDescendantsInstances = {player.Character}
		local hit = workspace:Raycast(ownRoot.Position,offset,params)
		if hit then
			local allowed = math.max(0,hit.Distance-2.5)
			if allowed < 1 then
				setStatus("DASH // PATH BLOCKED")
				return
			end
			offset = flat.Unit*allowed
		end
		ownRoot.CFrame = ownRoot.CFrame + offset
		ownRoot.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(0,ownRoot.AssemblyLinearVelocity.Y,0)
		setStatus("DASH // "..directionName)
	end

	local function wallExitDistance(part,hitPosition,direction)
		if not part or not part:IsA("BasePart") then
			return nil
		end
		local unit = direction.Magnitude > .001 and direction.Unit or nil
		if not unit then
			return nil
		end
		-- Move a tiny amount inside the part so the math starts from the
		-- entry face rather than from a floating-point point just outside it.
		local localPoint =
			part.CFrame:PointToObjectSpace(hitPosition+unit*.03)
		local localDirection =
			part.CFrame:VectorToObjectSpace(unit)
		local half = part.Size*.5
		local best = math.huge
		local function testAxis(positionValue,directionValue,halfSize)
			if math.abs(directionValue) < 1e-6 then
				return
			end
			local boundary = directionValue > 0 and halfSize or -halfSize
			local distance = (boundary-positionValue)/directionValue
			if distance > .001 and distance < best then
				best = distance
			end
		end
		testAxis(localPoint.X,localDirection.X,half.X)
		testAxis(localPoint.Y,localDirection.Y,half.Y)
		testAxis(localPoint.Z,localDirection.Z,half.Z)
		if best == math.huge then
			return nil
		end
		return best+.03
	end

	local function phaseThroughWall()
		if not shooterSecurityAllowed() then
			phaseWallButton.Text = "PHASE THROUGH WALL [LOCKED]"
			setStatus("SET SHOOTER_ALLOWED_PLACE_ID TO YOUR GAME PLACEID")
			return
		end
		local ownCharacter = player.Character
		local ownRoot =
			ownCharacter
			and ownCharacter:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		if not ownRoot then
			setStatus("PHASE // CHARACTER NOT READY")
			return
		end
		camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
		local look =
			camera
			and camera.CFrame.LookVector
			or ownRoot.CFrame.LookVector
		local direction = Vector3.new(look.X,0,look.Z)
		if direction.Magnitude < .05 then
			direction = Vector3.new(
				ownRoot.CFrame.LookVector.X,
				0,
				ownRoot.CFrame.LookVector.Z
			)
		end
		if direction.Magnitude < .05 then
			setStatus("PHASE // FACE A WALL")
			return
		end
		direction = direction.Unit
		local params = RaycastParams.new()
		params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
		params.FilterDescendantsInstances = {ownCharacter}
		params.IgnoreWater = true
		local origin = ownRoot.Position+Vector3.new(0,.2,0)
		local hit = workspace:Raycast(
			origin,
			direction*state.wallPhaseRange,
			params
		)
		if not hit then
			setStatus("PHASE // NO WALL IN RANGE")
			return
		end
		local wall = hit.Instance
		if not wall or not wall:IsA("BasePart") then
			setStatus("PHASE // WALL TYPE NOT SUPPORTED")
			return
		end
		local thickness = wallExitDistance(wall,hit.Position,direction)
		if not thickness then
			setStatus("PHASE // COULD NOT MEASURE WALL")
			return
		end
		if thickness > 500 then
			setStatus(
				"PHASE // WALL TOO THICK // "
				..tostring(math.floor(thickness+.5))
				.." STUDS"
			)
			return
		end
		local clearance = math.max(3,ownRoot.Size.Z*1.5)
		local destination =
			hit.Position+direction*(thickness+clearance)
		local rotation = ownRoot.CFrame-ownRoot.Position
		ownRoot.CFrame = CFrame.new(destination)*rotation
		ownRoot.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
		ownRoot.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
		setStatus(
			"PHASED // "
			..string.upper(string.sub(wall.Name,1,14))
			.." // "
			..string.format("%.1f",thickness)
			.." STUD WALL"
		)
	end

	local doorGuideLine = Instance.new("Frame")

	doorGuideLine.BorderSizePixel = 0
	doorGuideLine.Visible = false
	doorGuideLine.ZIndex = 715
	doorGuideLine.Parent = overlay
	corner(doorGuideLine,1000)

	keyGuideLabel.ZIndex = 716
	keyGuideLabel.Parent = overlay

	addStroke(keyGuideLabel,Color3.fromRGB(255,220,70),1,.35)

	local doorGuideLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	doorGuideLabel.Name = "DoorGuideLabel"

	doorGuideLabel.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(150,28)

	local keyGuideHighlight = Instance.new("Highlight")
	keyGuideHighlight.Name = "NotRubyKeyGuideHighlight"

	keyGuideHighlight.FillTransparency = .76

	keyGuideHighlight.Parent = doorsOverlayFolder

	doorGuideHighlight.Name = "NotRubyDoorGuideHighlight"
	doorGuideHighlight.DepthMode = Enum.HighlightDepthMode.AlwaysOnTop
	doorGuideHighlight.FillColor = accent

	doorGuideHighlight.OutlineTransparency = .03

	local doorsKeyTarget = nil
	local doorsDoorTarget = nil
	local doorsKeyAdornee = nil
	local doorsDoorAdornee = nil
	local doorsKeyRoom = "--"
	local doorsDoorRoom = "--"
	local doorsLastScan = 0

	-- --------------------------------------------------------
	-- DOORS ENTITY NOTIFIER // LOW-LAG + ONE ALERT PER SPAWN
	-- --------------------------------------------------------
	local doorsEntityNotifier = (function()
		local M = {}
		local seenRoots = setmetatable({}, {__mode = "k"})
		local lastKindAt = {}

		local entityNames = {
			{"sally","sally"},
			{"ambush","ambush"},
			{"rush","rush"},
			{"screech","screech"},
			{"seek","seek"},
			{"figure","figure"},
			{"halt","halt"},
			{"shade","halt"},
			{"hallwayshade","halt"},
			{"eyes","eyes"},
			{"snare","snare"},
			{"giggle","giggle"},
			{"grumble","grumble"},
			{"dread","dread"},
			{"timothy","timothy"},
			{"jack","jack"},
			{"shadow","shadow"},
			{"gloombat","gloombat"},
			{"lookman","lookman"},
			{"blitz","blitz"},
			{"vacuum","vacuum"},
			{"haste","haste"},
			{"a60","a-60"},
			{"a90","a-90"},
			{"a120","a-120"}
		}

		local function classify(object)
			if not object
				or not (
					object:IsA("Model")
					or object:IsA("BasePart")
					or object:IsA("Folder")
				) then
				return nil
			end

			local lowerName = string.lower(tostring(object.Name or ""))

			-- Seek's wall/ceiling eyes are pre-chase decoration. They must not
			-- trigger the Seek notification before the player enters the chase room.
			if string.find(lowerName,"seek",1,true)
				and string.find(lowerName,"eye",1,true) then
				return nil
			end

			-- Do not mistake Figure books for Figure itself.
			if string.find(lowerName,"book",1,true) then
				return nil
			end

			for _,entry in ipairs(entityNames) do
				if string.find(lowerName,entry[1],1,true) then
					return entry[2]
				end
			end

			for _,flagName in ipairs({
				"IsMonster","Monster","IsEntity","Entity",
				"IsEnemy","Enemy","Hostile"
			}) do
				local ok,value = pcall(function()
					return object:GetAttribute(flagName)
				end)
				if ok and value == true then
					return lowerName ~= "" and lowerName or "entity"
				end
			end

			if object:IsA("Model") then
				local humanoid = object:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
				if humanoid
					and humanoid.Health > 0
					and not Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(object) then
					return lowerName ~= "" and lowerName or "monster"
				end
			end

			return nil
		end

		local function resolveRoot(object)
			local fakeCursor = object
			for _ = 1,10 do
				if not fakeCursor or fakeCursor == workspace then
					break
				end
				if fakeCursor:GetAttribute("NotRubyFakeEntity") == true
					or fakeCursor:GetAttribute("LocalOnly") == true then
					return nil,nil
				end
				fakeCursor = fakeCursor.Parent
			end

			-- Sally can reuse/nest helper objects whose names contain "Rush".
			-- Always check the whole nearby ancestry for Sally FIRST, otherwise a
			-- nested Rush helper can incorrectly win before we reach Sally's root.
			local sallyCursor = object
			for _ = 1,9 do
				if not sallyCursor or sallyCursor == workspace then
					break
				end

				local sallyName =
					string.lower(tostring(sallyCursor.Name or ""))
				local sallyFlag = false
				for _,flagName in ipairs({"Sally","IsSally"}) do
					local ok,value = pcall(function()
						return sallyCursor:GetAttribute(flagName)
					end)
					if ok and value == true then
						sallyFlag = true
						break
					end
				end

				if string.find(sallyName,"sally",1,true)
					or sallyFlag then
					if sallyCursor:IsA("Model") then
						return sallyCursor,"sally"
					end
					local sallyModel =
						sallyCursor:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("Model")
					if sallyModel
						and sallyModel ~= player.Character then
						return sallyModel,"sally"
					end
				end

				sallyCursor = sallyCursor.Parent
			end

			local cursor = object
			local matchedObject = nil
			local matchedKind = nil

			for _ = 1,9 do
				if not cursor or cursor == workspace then
					break
				end

				local kind = classify(cursor)
				if kind then
					matchedObject = cursor
					matchedKind = kind
					if cursor:IsA("Model") then
						return cursor,kind
					end
				end

				cursor = cursor.Parent
			end

			if matchedObject then
				local model = matchedObject:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("Model")
				if model and model ~= player.Character then
					return model,matchedKind
				end
				return matchedObject,matchedKind
			end

			return nil,nil
		end

		local function playWarning(kind)
			local soundService = game:GetService("SoundService")
			local debris = game:GetService("Debris")

			local function pulse(speed)
				local sound = Instance.new("Sound")
				sound.Name = "NotRubyDoorsEntityWarning"
				sound.SoundId = "rbxassetid://7383525713"
				sound.Volume = 1.25
				sound.PlaybackSpeed = speed
				sound.Parent = soundService
				pcall(function()
					soundService:PlayLocalSound(sound)
				end)
				debris:AddItem(sound,4)
			end

			if kind == "ambush" then
				pulse(.82)
				task.delay(.38,function()
					if gui and gui.Parent and not menuDeleted then
						pulse(.82)
					end
				end)
			elseif kind == "rush" then
				pulse(1.08)
			else
				pulse(.94)
			end
		end

		local function seekNameLooksLikeEye(value)
			local lower = string.lower(tostring(value or ""))
			return
				string.find(lower,"seek",1,true) ~= nil
				and (
					string.find(lower,"eye",1,true) ~= nil
					or string.find(lower,"eyes",1,true) ~= nil
				)
		end

		local function seekRootIsEyeHelper(root)
			local cursor = root
			for _ = 1,8 do
				if not cursor or cursor == workspace then
					break
				end

				if seekNameLooksLikeEye(cursor.Name) then
					return true
				end

				cursor = cursor.Parent
			end
			return false
		end

		local function roomFromNumber(currentRooms,value)
			local number = tonumber(value)
			if not currentRooms or not number then
				return nil
			end

			number = math.floor(number+.5)

			local direct =
				currentRooms:FindFirstChild(tostring(number))
				or currentRooms:FindFirstChild(string.format("%04d",number))
			if direct and (direct:IsA("Model") or direct:IsA("Folder")) then
				return direct
			end

			return nil
		end

		local function seekCurrentRoom(currentRooms)
			if not currentRooms then
				return nil
			end

			local ownCharacter = player.Character

			-- Cheap room-state sources first.
			for _,holder in ipairs({player,ownCharacter,currentRooms}) do
				if holder then
					for _,attributeName in ipairs({
						"CurrentRoom","LatestRoom","RoomNumber","Room"
					}) do
						local ok,value = pcall(function()
							return holder:GetAttribute(attributeName)
						end)
						if ok and value ~= nil then
							local room = roomFromNumber(currentRooms,value)
							if room then
								return room
							end
						end
					end
				end
			end

			local replicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
			local gameData = replicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("GameData")
			if gameData then
				for _,valueName in ipairs({
					"LatestRoom","CurrentRoom","RoomNumber"
				}) do
					local valueObject = gameData:FindFirstChild(valueName)
					if valueObject and valueObject:IsA("ValueBase") then
						local room = roomFromNumber(currentRooms,valueObject.Value)
						if room then
							return room
						end
					end
				end
			end

			-- Geometry fallback only if no room state exists.
			local ownRoot =
				ownCharacter
				and ownCharacter:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
			if not ownRoot then
				return nil
			end

			local rooms = {}
			for _,room in ipairs(currentRooms:GetChildren()) do
				if (room:IsA("Model") or room:IsA("Folder"))
					and tonumber(room.Name) then
					table.insert(rooms,room)
				end
			end

			table.sort(rooms,function(a,b)
				return (tonumber(a.Name) or -1) > (tonumber(b.Name) or -1)
			end)
			while #rooms > 6 do
				table.remove(rooms)
			end

			local bestRoom = nil
			local bestDistance = math.huge
			for _,room in ipairs(rooms) do
				local distance = math.huge

				if room:IsA("Model") then
					local ok,boxCf,boxSize = pcall(function()
						local cf,size = room:GetBoundingBox()
						return cf,size
					end)
					if ok and boxCf and boxSize then
						local p = boxCf:PointToObjectSpace(ownRoot.Position)
						local dx = math.max(math.abs(p.X)-boxSize.X*.5,0)
						local dy = math.max(math.abs(p.Y)-boxSize.Y*.5,0)
						local dz = math.max(math.abs(p.Z)-boxSize.Z*.5,0)
						distance = Vector3.new(dx,dy,dz).Magnitude
					end
				end

				if distance < bestDistance then
					bestDistance = distance
					bestRoom = room
				end
			end

			return bestRoom
		end

		local function strongSeekMarkerName(value)
			local lower = string.lower(tostring(value or ""))
			if string.find(lower,"seek",1,true) == nil then
				return false
			end
			if string.find(lower,"eye",1,true) ~= nil then
				return false
			end

			return
				lower == "seek"
				or string.find(lower,"seekmoving",1,true) ~= nil
				or string.find(lower,"seekrig",1,true) ~= nil
				or string.find(lower,"seekchase",1,true) ~= nil
				or string.find(lower,"seektrigger",1,true) ~= nil
				or string.find(lower,"seekintro",1,true) ~= nil
				or string.find(lower,"seekarm",1,true) ~= nil
		end

		local function playerIsInSeekRoom(root)
			-- Eye decorations/pre-chase Seek eyes NEVER count as the chase.
			if seekRootIsEyeHelper(root) then
				return false
			end

			local currentRooms = workspace:FindFirstChild("CurrentRooms")
			local currentRoom = seekCurrentRoom(currentRooms)
			if not currentRoom then
				return false
			end

			-- Strongest case: actual Seek object is under the room the player is in.
			if root and root:IsDescendantOf(currentRoom) then
				return true
			end

			-- DOORS/remakes often keep the moving Seek rig in workspace but put
			-- a SeekTrigger/SeekIntro/SeekChase marker inside the chase room.
			local checked = 0
			for _,object in ipairs(currentRoom:GetDescendants()) do
				checked += 1
				if strongSeekMarkerName(object.Name) then
					return true
				end

				-- Hard cap prevents a giant room from adding lag.
				if checked >= 220 then
					break
				end
			end

			-- Final fallback: a real Seek/SeekMoving rig that is physically close
			-- while the player is in the current room. SeekEye helpers were already
			-- rejected above.
			if root and strongSeekMarkerName(root.Name) then
				local ownRoot =
					player.Character
					and player.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
				local seekPart =
					root:IsA("BasePart")
					and root
					or (
						root:IsA("Model")
						and (
							root.PrimaryPart
							or root:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart",true)
						)
					)
				if ownRoot and seekPart then
					return (ownRoot.Position-seekPart.Position).Magnitude <= 135
				end
			end

			return false
		end

		function M.alert(kind,root)
			-- Dupe has its own visual guide only. Never send Dupe notifications/sounds.
			if kind == "dupe" then
				return
			end

			if not root
				or not (
					state.doorsEntityAlerts
					or state.doorsFloor2MonsterAlerts
				)
				or not shooterSecurityAllowed()
				or menuDeleted
				or not gui.Parent then
				return
			end

			-- V91: Floor 2's dedicated notifier also owns Halt.
			-- Skip them in the legacy notifier while Floor 2 notifications are ON
			-- so one spawn cannot produce both a generic old toast and the new
			-- image toast.
			if state.doorsFloor2MonsterAlerts then
				local floor2Specific =
					kind == "giggle"
					or kind == "gloombat"
					or kind == "gloombats"
					or kind == "grumble"
					or kind == "queen"
					or kind == "damseek"

				local cursor = root
				for _ = 1,8 do
					if not cursor or cursor == workspace then
						break
					end

					local compactName =
						string.lower(
							tostring(cursor.Name or "")
						):gsub("[^%w]","")

					if string.find(compactName,"giggle",1,true)
						or string.find(compactName,"gloombat",1,true)
						or string.find(compactName,"grumble",1,true)
						or string.find(compactName,"queen",1,true)
						or string.find(compactName,"damseek",1,true)
						or string.find(compactName,"seekdam",1,true) then
						floor2Specific = true
						break
					end

					cursor = cursor.Parent
				end

				if floor2Specific then
					return
				end
			end

			-- Seek warning is room-driven now. Do not consume/mark the Seek root
			-- while the pre-chase eyes are spawning; the backup scan can retry it
			-- when the player actually enters the chase room.
			if kind == "seek" and not playerIsInSeekRoom(root) then
				return
			end

			-- Every actual spawned root can notify only once.
			if seenRoots[root] then
				return
			end

			local now = os.clock()

			-- V96: shared Halt guard lets legacy Shade detection and the dedicated
			-- Floor 2 watcher both act as fallbacks without double notifications.
			if kind == "halt" then
				local sharedLast =
					tonumber(
						gui:GetAttribute("DoorsHaltLastAlertAt")
					)
					or 0
				if now-sharedLast < 2.75 then
					seenRoots[root] = true
					return
				end
			end
			-- Rush and Seek both create/reparent multiple helper roots during one
			-- encounter. Give them encounter-sized suppression windows so one chase
			-- produces one warning instead of a new popup for every helper/model.
			local sameKindWindow =
				kind == "seek" and 360
				or kind == "rush" and 15
				or 2.25
			if now-(lastKindAt[kind] or 0) < sameKindWindow then
				seenRoots[root] = true
				return
			end

			seenRoots[root] = true
			lastKindAt[kind] = now
			if kind == "halt" then
				gui:SetAttribute("DoorsHaltLastAlertAt",now)
			end

			local message
			if kind == "sally" then
				message = "SALLY SPAWNED // WATCH OUT"
			elseif kind == "rush" then
				message = "RUSH SPAWNED // HIDE"
			elseif kind == "ambush" then
				message = "AMBUSH SPAWNED // HIDE // IT MAY RETURN"
			elseif kind == "eyes" then
				message = "EYES SPAWNED // LOOK AWAY"
			elseif kind == "screech" then
