				message = "SCREECH SPAWNED // LOOK AROUND"
			elseif kind == "figure" then
				message = "FIGURE SPAWNED // STAY QUIET"
			elseif kind == "seek" then
				message = "SEEK SPAWNED // RUN"
			elseif kind == "halt" then
				message = "HALT SPAWNED // TURN AROUND"
			elseif kind == "snare" then
				message = "SNARE SPAWNED // WATCH THE FLOOR"
			else
				message = string.upper(tostring(kind or "ENTITY"))
					.." DETECTED // MONSTER SPAWNED"
			end

			-- setStatus() already sends exactly one NotRubyNotifyEvent.
			setStatus(message)
			playWarning(kind)

			-- Only use Roblox's fallback notification when the custom toast event
			-- does not exist. Never fire the custom event a second time here.
			local notifyEvent = gui:FindFirstChild("NotRubyNotifyEvent")
			if not (notifyEvent and notifyEvent:IsA("BindableEvent")) then
				pcall(function()
					game:GetService("StarterGui"):SetCore(
						"SendNotification",
						{
							Title = "NOT RUBY // DOORS",
							Text = message,
							Duration = 5
						}
					)
				end)
			end
		end

		function M.inspect(object)
			local root,kind = resolveRoot(object)
			if root and kind then
				M.alert(kind,root)
			end
		end

		function M.shallowScan()
			-- Only two shallow levels: much cheaper than GetDescendants().
			for _,top in ipairs(workspace:GetChildren()) do
				M.inspect(top)
				if top:IsA("Folder") or top:IsA("Model") then
					for _,child in ipairs(top:GetChildren()) do
						M.inspect(child)
					end
				end
			end
		end

		function M.shouldInspectAdded(object)
			if object:IsA("Model") or object:IsA("Folder") then
				return true
			end
			if object:IsA("BasePart") then
				local lowerName = string.lower(tostring(object.Name or ""))
				for _,entry in ipairs(entityNames) do
					if string.find(lowerName,entry[1],1,true) then
						return true
					end
				end
			end
			return false
		end

		return M
	end)()

	trackAdvanced(
		workspace.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(object)
			if not runtimeCore.allows("DOORS") then
				return
			end
			-- Notifier is OFF by default. When disabled, skip entity inspection
			-- completely so new workspace objects do not create needless scan work.
			if not (
					state.doorsEntityAlerts
					or state.doorsFloor2MonsterAlerts
				)
				or not shooterSecurityAllowed()
				or menuDeleted
				or not gui.Parent then
				return
			end

			if not doorsEntityNotifier.shouldInspectAdded(object) then
				return
			end
			-- Small delay lets reparented/spawned models finish settling.
			task.delay(.12,function()
				if object and object.Parent then
					doorsEntityNotifier.inspect(object)
				end
			end)
		end)
	)

	-- Event-driven detection above is the primary path. Keep only a slower
	-- backup scan for unusual reparenting so entity warnings stay reliable
	-- without sweeping the workspace almost every second.
	task.spawn(function()
		task.wait(.45)
		while gui and gui.Parent and not menuDeleted do
			if runtimeCore.allows("DOORS")
				and (
					state.doorsEntityAlerts
					or state.doorsFloor2MonsterAlerts
				)
				and shooterSecurityAllowed() then
				doorsEntityNotifier.shallowScan()
			end
			task.wait(1.75)
		end
	end)

	local function getDoorsCurrentRooms()
		return workspace:FindFirstChild("CurrentRooms")
	end

	local function getRoomNameFor(object,currentRooms)
		if not object or not currentRooms then
			return "--"
		end
		local cursor = object
		while cursor and cursor.Parent and cursor.Parent ~= currentRooms do
			cursor = cursor.Parent
		end
		if cursor and cursor.Parent == currentRooms then
			return tostring(cursor.Name)
		end
		return "--"
	end

	local function getRecentDoorsRooms(currentRooms,limit)
		local rooms = {}
		if not currentRooms then
			return rooms
		end

		for _,room in ipairs(currentRooms:GetChildren()) do
			if room:IsA("Model") or room:IsA("Folder") then
				table.insert(rooms,room)
			end
		end

		table.sort(rooms,function(a,b)
			local an = tonumber(a.Name)
			local bn = tonumber(b.Name)
			if an and bn then
				return an > bn
			elseif an then
				return true
			elseif bn then
				return false
			end
			return tostring(a.Name) > tostring(b.Name)
		end)

		while #rooms > (limit or 5) do
			table.remove(rooms)
		end
		return rooms
	end

	local function findDoorHitbox(doorObject)
		if not doorObject then
			return nil
		end

		if doorObject:IsA("BasePart") then
			return doorObject
		end

		local bestPart = nil
		local bestScore = -math.huge

		for _,part in ipairs(doorObject:GetDescendants()) do
			if part:IsA("BasePart") then
				local name = string.lower(tostring(part.Name or ""))
				local score = 0

				if name == "doorhitbox"
					or name == "hitbox"
					or name == "interacthitbox"
					or name == "doorcollision"
					or name == "collision"
					or name == "collider" then
					score += 200
				elseif string.find(name,"hitbox",1,true) then
					score += 150
				end

				if name == "door" or name == "doorpart" then
					score += 70
				end

				-- Prefer one big flat door/hitbox part, not frame/knob/plaque pieces.
				local sx,sy,sz = part.Size.X,part.Size.Y,part.Size.Z
				local largest = math.max(sx,sy,sz)
				local smallest = math.min(sx,sy,sz)
				local middle = sx + sy + sz - largest - smallest
				if largest >= 5 and middle >= 2 and smallest <= 2.2 then
					score += 35
				end
				if part.Transparency >= .85 then
					score += 30
				end
				if part.CanCollide then
					score += 8
				end

				for _,badWord in ipairs({
					"frame","knob","handle","lock","plaque","number",
					"sign","hinge","trim","decor"
				}) do
					if string.find(name,badWord,1,true) then
						score -= 90
					end
				end

				if score > bestScore then
					bestScore = score
					bestPart = part
				end
			end
		end

		return bestPart
	end

	local function getActiveDoorsRoom(currentRooms)
		if not currentRooms then
			return nil
		end

		local function findRoomByNumber(value)
			local number = tonumber(value)
			if not number then
				return nil
			end

			number = math.floor(number+.5)

			-- Normal DOORS CurrentRooms names are numeric. Try the cheap exact
			-- lookups first so Door Guide does not recalculate room bounding boxes.
			local direct =
				currentRooms:FindFirstChild(tostring(number))
				or currentRooms:FindFirstChild(string.format("%04d",number))
			if direct and (direct:IsA("Model") or direct:IsA("Folder")) then
				return direct
			end

			-- Rare remakes format room names differently. Only inspect the recent
			-- few rooms instead of walking the whole run history.
			for _,room in ipairs(getRecentDoorsRooms(currentRooms,6)) do
				if tonumber(room.Name) == number then
					return room
				end
			end

			return nil
		end

		local ownCharacter = player.Character

		-- Fast path 1: player/character/current-room attributes.
		for _,holder in ipairs({player,ownCharacter,currentRooms}) do
			if holder then
				for _,attributeName in ipairs({
					"CurrentRoom","LatestRoom","RoomNumber","Room"
				}) do
					local ok,value = pcall(function()
						return holder:GetAttribute(attributeName)
					end)
					if ok and value ~= nil then
						local room = findRoomByNumber(value)
						if room then
							return room
						end
					end
				end
			end
		end

		-- Fast path 2: common DOORS GameData values. This is optional and safely
		-- skipped in remakes that do not expose the same hierarchy.
		local replicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
		local gameData = replicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("GameData")
		if gameData then
			for _,valueName in ipairs({
				"LatestRoom","CurrentRoom","RoomNumber"
			}) do
				local valueObject = gameData:FindFirstChild(valueName)
				if valueObject and valueObject:IsA("ValueBase") then
					local room = findRoomByNumber(valueObject.Value)
					if room then
						return room
					end
				end
			end
		end

		-- Fallback for custom/remade room systems: use geometry, but only among
		-- six recent rooms rather than repeatedly measuring ten.
		local ownRoot =
			ownCharacter
			and ownCharacter:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		if not ownRoot then
			return nil
		end

		local bestRoom = nil
		local bestDistance = math.huge
		local bestNumber = -math.huge

		for _,room in ipairs(getRecentDoorsRooms(currentRooms,6)) do
			local roomNumber = tonumber(room.Name)
			if roomNumber then
				local distance = math.huge

				if room:IsA("Model") then
					local ok,boxCf,boxSize = pcall(function()
						local cf,size = room:GetBoundingBox()
						return cf,size
					end)
					if ok and boxCf and boxSize then
						local p = boxCf:PointToObjectSpace(ownRoot.Position)
						local dx = math.max(math.abs(p.X)-boxSize.X*.5,0)
						local dy = math.max(math.abs(p.Y)-boxSize.Y*.5,0)
						local dz = math.max(math.abs(p.Z)-boxSize.Z*.5,0)
						distance = Vector3.new(dx,dy,dz).Magnitude
					end
				end

				if distance == math.huge then
					local checked = 0
					for _,part in ipairs(room:GetDescendants()) do
						if part:IsA("BasePart") then
							distance = math.min(
								distance,
								(ownRoot.Position-part.Position).Magnitude
							)
							checked += 1
							if checked >= 18 then
								break
							end
						end
					end
				end

				if distance < bestDistance-.05
					or (
						math.abs(distance-bestDistance) <= .05
						and roomNumber > bestNumber
					) then
					bestDistance = distance
					bestNumber = roomNumber
					bestRoom = room
				end
			end
		end

		return bestRoom
	end

	local function parseDoorNumber(value)
		local raw = tostring(value or "")
		local digits = string.match(raw,"^%s*0*(%d+)%s*$")
		if not digits then
			return nil
		end
		local number = tonumber(digits)
		if number and number >= 0 and number <= 9999 then
			return number
		end
		return nil
	end

	local function readDoorDisplayedNumber(
		doorObject,
		room,
		roomDescendants,
		knownHitbox,
		expectedNumber
	)
		if not doorObject then
			return nil
		end

		local function compactDoorToken(value)
			return string.lower(
				tostring(value or "")
			):gsub("[^%w]","")
		end

		local function strongNumberContainer(object)
			local cursor = object
			for _ = 1,6 do
				if not cursor or cursor == room then
					break
				end

				local c = compactDoorToken(cursor.Name)
				if string.find(c,"doornumber",1,true)
					or string.find(c,"doorplaque",1,true)
					or string.find(c,"numberplaque",1,true)
					or string.find(c,"doorsign",1,true)
					or c == "plaque"
					or c == "sign" then
					return true
				end

				cursor = cursor.Parent
			end
			return false
		end

		local function attributeNumber(object)
			if not object then
				return nil
			end

			-- V98: RoomNumber/RoomId/generic Number are ignored because they can
			-- describe the room containing the door instead of the plaque number.
			for _,attributeName in ipairs({
				"DoorNumber",
				"NextRoom",
				"NextRoomNumber",
				"TargetRoom",
				"DestinationRoom",
				"DestRoom"
			}) do
				local ok,value = pcall(function()
					return object:GetAttribute(attributeName)
				end)
				if ok then
					local number = parseDoorNumber(value)
					if number ~= nil then
						return number
					end
				end
			end

			return nil
		end

		local direct = attributeNumber(doorObject)
		if direct ~= nil then
			return direct
		end

		local hitbox = knownHitbox or findDoorHitbox(doorObject)
		local candidates = {}

		local function addCandidate(number,part,priority)
			if number == nil then
				return
			end

			local distance = math.huge
			if hitbox and part and part:IsA("BasePart") then
				distance = (part.Position-hitbox.Position).Magnitude
			end

			table.insert(candidates,{
				number = number,
				distance = distance,
				priority = priority or 0
			})
		end

		for _,object in ipairs(doorObject:GetDescendants()) do
			local attr = attributeNumber(object)
			if attr ~= nil then
				addCandidate(
					attr,
					object:IsA("BasePart")
						and object
						or object:FindFirstAncestorWhichIsA("BasePart"),
					210
				)
			end

			local value = nil
			local priority = 0

			if object:IsA("TextLabel")
				or object:IsA("TextButton")
				or object:IsA("TextBox") then
				if strongNumberContainer(object) then
					value = object.Text
					priority = 190
				end
			elseif object:IsA("IntValue")
				or object:IsA("NumberValue")
				or object:IsA("StringValue") then

				local c = compactDoorToken(object.Name)
				if string.find(c,"doornumber",1,true)
					or string.find(c,"nextroom",1,true)
					or string.find(c,"destination",1,true)
					or string.find(c,"targetroom",1,true)
					or (
						c == "number"
						and strongNumberContainer(object)
					) then
					value = object.Value
					priority = 180
				end
			end

			if value ~= nil then
				local number = parseDoorNumber(value)
				if number ~= nil then
					addCandidate(
						number,
						object:FindFirstAncestorWhichIsA("BasePart"),
						priority
					)
				end
			end
		end

		if room and hitbox then
			for _,object in ipairs(
				roomDescendants or room:GetDescendants()
			) do
				if object:IsA("TextLabel")
					or object:IsA("TextButton")
					or object:IsA("TextBox") then

					if strongNumberContainer(object) then
						local number = parseDoorNumber(object.Text)
						if number ~= nil then
							local guiObject =
								object:FindFirstAncestorWhichIsA("SurfaceGui")
								or object:FindFirstAncestorWhichIsA("BillboardGui")
							local part =
								(guiObject and guiObject.Adornee)
								or object:FindFirstAncestorWhichIsA("BasePart")

							if part
								and (part.Position-hitbox.Position).Magnitude <= 8.5 then
								addCandidate(number,part,160)
							end
						end
					end
				end
			end
		end

		if #candidates == 0 then
			return nil
		end

		table.sort(candidates,function(a,b)
			if expectedNumber ~= nil then
				local am = a.number == expectedNumber
				local bm = b.number == expectedNumber
				if am ~= bm then
					return am
				end
			end

			if a.priority ~= b.priority then
				return a.priority > b.priority
			end

			return a.distance < b.distance
		end)

		return candidates[1].number
	end

	local function getDoorCandidates(room,roomDescendants)
		local models = {}
		local parts = {}
		local seen = {}

		if not room then
			return models
		end

		for _,object in ipairs(roomDescendants or room:GetDescendants()) do
			local lowerName = string.lower(tostring(object.Name or ""))
			if object:IsA("Model") and lowerName == "door" then
				if not seen[object] then
					seen[object] = true
					table.insert(models,object)
				end
			elseif object:IsA("BasePart") and lowerName == "door" then
				local ancestorDoor = object:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("Model")
				if not ancestorDoor or string.lower(ancestorDoor.Name) ~= "door" then
					table.insert(parts,object)
				end
			end
		end

		-- Prefer Door models. BasePart-only doors are a fallback for simple remakes.
		if #models > 0 then
			return models
		end
		return parts
	end

	local function findNamedAncestor(object,targetName)
		local cursor = object and object.Parent
		local wanted = string.lower(targetName)
		while cursor and cursor ~= workspace do
			if string.lower(cursor.Name) == wanted then
				return cursor
			end
			cursor = cursor.Parent
		end
		return nil
	end

	local function bestPartFromObject(object)
		if not object then
			return nil
		end
		if object:IsA("BasePart") then
			return object
		end
		if object:IsA("Model") then
			if object.PrimaryPart then
				return object.PrimaryPart
			end
			return object:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart",true)
		end
		return object:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart",true)
	end

	local function distanceFromLocalRoot(part)
		local ownRoot =
			player.Character
			and player.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		if not ownRoot or not part then
			return math.huge
		end
		return (ownRoot.Position-part.Position).Magnitude
	end

	-- ITEM ESP is intentionally packed into one controller object.
	-- This keeps the parent DOORS setup well below Luau's local-register limit.
	local doorsItemEsp = (function()
		local M = {}
		local objects = {}
		local lastScan = 0
		local lastVisual = 0

		-- Strict collectible/hiding-spot recognition. No generic "pick up"
		-- fallback: that was what caused shelves/furniture and many random lines.
		-- Candles are intentionally excluded, and library/Figure books are handled
		-- only by the separate LIBRARY BOOK ESP below.
		local patterns = {
			{"crucifix","CRUCIFIX"},
			{"skeletonkey","SKELETON KEY"},
			{"goldpile","GOLD"},
			{"goldpickup","GOLD"},
			{"coinpickup","GOLD"},
			{"coinpile","GOLD"},
			{"lockpick","LOCKPICK"},
			{"lighter","LIGHTER"},
			{"flashlight","FLASHLIGHT"},
			{"vitamin","VITAMINS"},
			{"battery","BATTERY"},
			{"bandage","BANDAGE"},
			{"herb","HERB"},
			{"starlight","STARLIGHT"},
			{"straplight","STRAPLIGHT"},
			{"bulklight","BULKLIGHT"},
			{"laserpointer","LASER POINTER"},
			{"shears","SHEARS"},
			{"shakelight","SHAKELIGHT"},
			{"wardrobe","HIDING SPOT"},
			{"closet","HIDING SPOT"},
			{"locker","HIDING SPOT"},
			{"hidingspot","HIDING SPOT"},
			{"underbed","HIDING SPOT"}
		}

		local function compactName(value)
			return string.lower(
				string.gsub(tostring(value or ''),'[^%w]','')
			)
		end

		local function classifyName(name)
			local compact = compactName(name)
			if compact == '' then
				return nil
			end

			for _,entry in ipairs(patterns) do
				local token = entry[1]
				-- Accept normal item suffixes/prefixes such as LighterPickup,
				-- but avoid matching a random ancestor just because one child is an item.
				if compact == token
					or string.sub(compact,1,#token) == token
					or string.sub(compact,-#token) == token then
					return entry[2]
				end
			end

			return nil
		end

		local function promptLabel(prompt)
			if not prompt or not prompt:IsA('ProximityPrompt') then
				return nil
			end

			local action = string.lower(tostring(prompt.ActionText or ''))
			local objectText = tostring(prompt.ObjectText or '')
			local parentName = tostring(prompt.Parent and prompt.Parent.Name or '')

			-- Hiding spots are allowed, but only when the prompt/hierarchy really
			-- looks like a hide interaction.
			if string.find(action,'hide',1,true) then
				return 'HIDING SPOT'
			end

			local named = classifyName(objectText)
				or classifyName(parentName)
			if named then
				return named
			end

			-- No generic TAKE/GRAB/COLLECT fallback. Unknown prompts are ignored.
			return nil
		end

		local function hasMatchingPrompt(root,label)
			if not root then
				return false
			end
			for _,descendant in ipairs(root:GetDescendants()) do
				if descendant:IsA('ProximityPrompt') then
					local promptKind = promptLabel(descendant)
					if promptKind == label then
						return true
					end
				end
			end
			return false
		end

		local function partFor(root)
			if not root then return nil end
			if root:IsA('BasePart') then return root end
			if root:IsA('Tool') then
				return root:FindFirstChild('Handle')
					or root:FindFirstChildWhichIsA('BasePart',true)
			end
			if root:IsA('Model') then
				return root.PrimaryPart
					or root:FindFirstChildWhichIsA('BasePart',true)
			end
			return nil
		end

		local function promptRoot(prompt,label)
			local cursor = prompt and prompt.Parent
			local nearestPart = nil

			for _ = 1,7 do
				if not cursor or cursor == workspace then
					break
				end

				if cursor:IsA('BasePart') then
					nearestPart = nearestPart or cursor
				elseif cursor:IsA('Tool') then
					local ownLabel = classifyName(cursor.Name)
					if ownLabel == label then
						return cursor
					end
				elseif cursor:IsA('Model') then
					local ownLabel = classifyName(cursor.Name)
					-- Only promote to a Model if THAT MODEL is actually the item or
					-- hiding spot. Never promote a Lighter prompt to its bookshelf.
					if ownLabel == label then
						return cursor
					end
				end

				cursor = cursor.Parent
			end

			return nearestPart
		end

		local function rootFor(object)
			if not object then
				return nil,nil
			end

			if object:IsA('ProximityPrompt') then
				local label = promptLabel(object)
				if not label then
					return nil,nil
				end

				local resolvedRoot = promptRoot(object,label)

				if label == 'CRUCIFIX' then
					local cursor = object.Parent
					local crucifixRoot = nil

					for _ = 1,7 do
						if not cursor or cursor == workspace then
							break
						end

						if (
							cursor:IsA('Model')
							or cursor:IsA('Tool')
							or cursor:IsA('BasePart')
						)
							and classifyName(cursor.Name) == 'CRUCIFIX' then
							crucifixRoot = cursor
							break
						end

						cursor = cursor.Parent
					end

					-- If the prompt says Crucifix but its hierarchy contains no
					-- Crucifix object at all, treat it as a false/template prompt.
					if not crucifixRoot then
						return nil,nil
					end

					resolvedRoot = crucifixRoot
				end

				return resolvedRoot,label
			end

			if object:IsA('Tool') then
				local label = classifyName(object.Name)
				if label then
					return object,label
				end
				return nil,nil
			end

			if object:IsA('Model') then
				local label = classifyName(object.Name)
				if not label then
					return nil,nil
				end

				-- Hiding spots are structural models.
				if label == 'HIDING SPOT' then
					return object,label
				end

				-- Crucifix false-positive fix:
				-- DOORS can leave hidden/template objects named Crucifix in a room.
				-- A Model named Crucifix is shown ONLY if it owns a real matching
				-- ProximityPrompt, meaning the player can actually interact with it.
				if label == 'CRUCIFIX'
					and not hasMatchingPrompt(object,label) then
					return nil,nil
				end

				if compactName(object.Name) == 'book'
					and not hasMatchingPrompt(object,label) then
					return nil,nil
				end

				return object,label
			end

			return nil,nil
		end

		local function colorFor(label)
			local upper = string.upper(tostring(label or ''))
			if string.find(upper,'GOLD',1,true) then
				return Color3.fromRGB(255,220,55)
			elseif string.find(upper,'CRUCIFIX',1,true) then
				return Color3.fromRGB(120,235,255)
			elseif string.find(upper,'FIGURE BOOK',1,true) then
				return Color3.fromRGB(185,130,255)
			elseif string.find(upper,'HIDING SPOT',1,true) then
				return Color3.fromRGB(100,255,155)
			elseif string.find(upper,'KEY',1,true) then
				return Color3.fromRGB(255,235,120)
			end
			return gui:GetAttribute('OutlineColor') or accent
		end

		local function screenPoint(part)
			camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
			if not camera or not part then
				return nil
			end

			local viewport = camera.ViewportSize
			local raw = camera:WorldToViewportPoint(part.Position)
			local center = Vector2.new(viewport.X*.5,viewport.Y*.5)
			local point = Vector2.new(raw.X,raw.Y)

			if raw.Z <= 0 then
				point = center-(point-center)
			end

			local margin = 28
			return Vector2.new(
				math.clamp(point.X,margin,math.max(margin,viewport.X-margin)),
				math.clamp(point.Y,margin,math.max(margin,viewport.Y-margin))
			)
		end

		local function remove(root)
			local record = objects[root]
			if not record then return end
			if record.highlight and record.highlight.Parent then
				record.highlight:Destroy()
			end
			if record.billboard and record.billboard.Parent then
				record.billboard:Destroy()
			end
			if record.line and record.line.Parent then
				record.line:Destroy()
			end
			objects[root] = nil
		end

		function M.clear()
			local roots = {}
			for root in pairs(objects) do
				table.insert(roots,root)
			end
			for _,root in ipairs(roots) do
				remove(root)
			end
		end

		local function add(root,label)
			if not root or objects[root] then return end
			local part = partFor(root)
			if not part then return end

			local color = colorFor(label)

			local highlight = Instance.new('Highlight')
			highlight.Name = 'NotRubyDoorsCollectibleESP'
			highlight.Adornee = root
			highlight.DepthMode = Enum.HighlightDepthMode.AlwaysOnTop
			highlight.FillColor = color
			highlight.OutlineColor = color
			highlight.FillTransparency = .82
			highlight.OutlineTransparency = .02
			highlight.Parent = doorsOverlayFolder

			local billboard = Instance.new('BillboardGui')
			billboard.Name = 'NotRubyDoorsCollectibleLabel'
			billboard.Adornee = part
			billboard.AlwaysOnTop = true
			billboard.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(180,30)
			billboard.StudsOffset = Vector3.new(0,1.8,0)
			billboard.MaxDistance = state.doorsGuideMaxDistance
			billboard.Parent = part

			local labelObject = Instance.new('TextLabel')
			labelObject.BackgroundColor3 = SURFACE
			labelObject.BackgroundTransparency = .22
			labelObject.BorderSizePixel = 0
			labelObject.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1,1)
			labelObject.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBlack
			labelObject.TextSize = 9
			labelObject.TextColor3 = color
			labelObject.TextStrokeTransparency = .4
			labelObject.Text = tostring(label)
			labelObject.Parent = billboard
			corner(labelObject,8)
			addStroke(labelObject,color,1,.3)

			local line = Instance.new('Frame')
			line.Name = 'NotRubyDoorsCollectibleLine'
			line.BackgroundColor3 = color
			line.BackgroundTransparency = .18
			line.BorderSizePixel = 0
			line.Visible = false
			line.ZIndex = 714
			line.Parent = overlay
			corner(line,1000)

			objects[root] = {
				part = part,
				label = tostring(label),
				color = color,
				highlight = highlight,
				billboard = billboard,
				labelObject = labelObject,
				line = line
			}
		end

		function M.scan()
			lastScan = os.clock()

			if gui:GetAttribute(
				"DoorsMinecartProtectionActive"
			) == true then
				return
			end

			if not state.doorsItemEsp or not shooterSecurityAllowed() then
				return
			end

			local currentRooms = workspace:FindFirstChild('CurrentRooms')
			if not currentRooms then return end

			local found = {}
			local count = 0

			-- Scan ONLY the room the player is currently in. This prevents old
			-- collectible markers from staying behind after the player advances.
			local activeRoom = getActiveDoorsRoom(currentRooms)
			if activeRoom then
				for _,object in ipairs(activeRoom:GetDescendants()) do
					if count >= 20 then break end

					if object:IsA('Model')
						or object:IsA('Tool')
						or object:IsA('ProximityPrompt') then
						local root,label = rootFor(object)
						if root and label and not found[root] then
							local part = partFor(root)
							if part
								and distanceFromLocalRoot(part)
									<= state.doorsGuideMaxDistance then
								found[root] = true
								count += 1
								add(root,label)
							end
						end
					end
				end
			end

			local removeList = {}
			for root in pairs(objects) do
				if not root.Parent or not found[root] then
					table.insert(removeList,root)
				end
			end
			for _,root in ipairs(removeList) do
				remove(root)
			end
		end

		function M.update()
			if not state.doorsItemEsp or not shooterSecurityAllowed() then
				M.clear()
				return
			end

			if gui:GetAttribute(
				"DoorsMinecartProtectionActive"
			) == true then
				for _,record in pairs(objects) do
					if record.billboard then record.billboard.Enabled = false end
					if record.highlight then record.highlight.Enabled = false end
					if record.line then record.line.Visible = false end
				end
				return
			end

			local now = os.clock()
			if now-lastScan >= 1.2 then
				M.scan()
			end
			if now-lastVisual < .18 then
				return
			end
			lastVisual = now

			camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
			local currentRooms = workspace:FindFirstChild('CurrentRooms')
			local removeList = {}

			for root,record in pairs(objects) do
				local part = record.part
				if not root.Parent or not part or not part.Parent then
					table.insert(removeList,root)
				elseif record.label == 'CRUCIFIX'
					and not hasMatchingPrompt(root,'CRUCIFIX') then
					-- The pickup is gone/inactive; clear the marker immediately.
					table.insert(removeList,root)
				else
					record.billboard.Enabled = true
					record.highlight.Enabled = true

					local distance = math.floor(distanceFromLocalRoot(part)+.5)
					local roomName = getRoomNameFor(root,currentRooms)
					record.billboard.MaxDistance = state.doorsGuideMaxDistance
					record.labelObject.Text =
						record.label
						..' // ROOM '..tostring(roomName)
						..' // '..tostring(distance)..' studs'

					local endpoint = screenPoint(part)
					if camera and endpoint and distance <= state.doorsGuideMaxDistance then
						local viewport = camera.ViewportSize
						local startPoint = Vector2.new(viewport.X*.5,viewport.Y*.86)
						setScreenLine(record.line,startPoint,endpoint,2)
						record.line.BackgroundColor3 = record.color
						record.line.Visible = true
					else
						record.line.Visible = false
					end
				end
			end

			for _,root in ipairs(removeList) do
				remove(root)
			end
		end

		function M.hasObjects()
			return next(objects) ~= nil
		end

		return M
	end)()

	-- Once a room door has opened, remember that room for this session so
	-- the guide never points back to the same door even if it later closes.
	local doorsCompletedRooms = {}

	local function isDoorsDupeDoor(doorObject,expectedNumber,displayedNumber)
		if not doorObject or not doorObject.Parent then
			return false
		end

		-- Main DOORS-style Dupe rule: a numbered door that does NOT show the
		-- expected next room number is fake. This works even if its model is
		-- simply named "Door" and has no special Dupe attribute.
		if expectedNumber ~= nil
			and displayedNumber ~= nil
			and displayedNumber ~= expectedNumber then
			return true
		end

		local lowerName = string.lower(tostring(doorObject.Name or ""))
		for _,word in ipairs({
			"dupe","fakedoor","fake door",
			"wrongdoor","wrong door","trapdoor","trap door"
		}) do
			if string.find(lowerName,word,1,true) then
				return true
			end
		end

		for _,flagName in ipairs({
			"Dupe","IsDupe","Fake","IsFake",
			"WrongDoor","IsWrongDoor","Trap","IsTrap"
		}) do
			local ok,value = pcall(function()
				return doorObject:GetAttribute(flagName)
			end)
			if ok and value == true then
				return true
			end

			local valueObject = doorObject:FindFirstChild(flagName,true)
			if valueObject
				and valueObject:IsA("BoolValue")
				and valueObject.Value == true then
				return true
			end
		end

		return false
	end

	local function isDoorsDoorOpen(doorObject)
		if not doorObject or not doorObject.Parent then
			return false
		end

		-- Support common state attributes if the remake sets one.
		for _,attributeName in ipairs({
			"Opened",
			"Open",
			"IsOpen",
			"DoorOpen"
		}) do
			local ok,value = pcall(function()
				return doorObject:GetAttribute(attributeName)
			end)
			if ok and value == true then
				return true
			end
		end

		-- Also support BoolValue-based door state.
		for _,valueName in ipairs({
			"Opened",
			"Open",
			"IsOpen",
			"DoorOpen"
		}) do
			local valueObject =
				doorObject:FindFirstChild(valueName,true)
			if valueObject
				and valueObject:IsA("BoolValue")
				and valueObject.Value == true then
				return true
			end
		end

		-- Your door model contains a HingeConstraint. A meaningful hinge angle
		-- means the physical door has swung away from its closed position.
		local hinge =
			doorObject:FindFirstChild("HingeConstraint",true)
		if hinge and hinge:IsA("HingeConstraint") then
			local ok,angle = pcall(function()
				return math.abs(hinge.CurrentAngle)
			end)
			if ok and tonumber(angle) and angle >= 8 then
				return true
			end
		end

		return false
	end

	local function markDoorRoomCompleted(doorObject,roomName)
		if not doorObject then
			return
		end
		if isDoorsDoorOpen(doorObject) then
			local key = tostring(roomName or "--")
			if key ~= "--" then
				doorsCompletedRooms[key] = true
			end
		end
	end

	local function refreshDoorsTargets()
		doorsLastScan = os.clock()
		gui:SetAttribute("DoorsGuideDirty",false)

		doorsKeyTarget = nil
		doorsDoorTarget = nil
		doorsKeyAdornee = nil
		doorsDoorAdornee = nil
		doorsKeyRoom = "--"
		doorsDoorRoom = "--"

		if not shooterSecurityAllowed() then
			return
		end

		local currentRooms = getDoorsCurrentRooms()
		if not currentRooms then
			return
		end

		local activeRoom = getActiveDoorsRoom(currentRooms)
		if not activeRoom then
			return
		end

		local activeRoomNumber = tonumber(activeRoom.Name)
		if not activeRoomNumber then
			return
		end
		local expectedDoorNumber = activeRoomNumber + 1

		-- Take ONE snapshot and reuse it for key, door and nearby-plaque checks.
		-- V52 repeatedly called GetDescendants() several times per scan.
		local roomDescendants = activeRoom:GetDescendants()

		-- If the user only wants Door Guide, do not waste time scanning every part
		-- for keys. Smart Guide still needs the key check.
		if state.doorsKeyGuide or state.doorsSmartGuide then
			local bestKeyDistance = state.doorsGuideMaxDistance
			for _,object in ipairs(roomDescendants) do
				if object:IsA("BasePart") then
					local lowerName = string.lower(object.Name)
					local keyCandidate =
						lowerName == "keyhitbox"
						or (
							lowerName == "key"
							and findNamedAncestor(object,"KeyObtain")
						)

					if keyCandidate then
						local distance = distanceFromLocalRoot(object)
						if distance < bestKeyDistance then
							bestKeyDistance = distance
							doorsKeyTarget = object
							doorsKeyAdornee =
								findNamedAncestor(object,"KeyObtain") or object
							doorsKeyRoom = tostring(activeRoom.Name)
						end
					end
				end
			end
		end

		local bestDoorDistance = state.doorsGuideMaxDistance
		local fallbackDoor = nil
		local fallbackHitbox = nil
		local fallbackDistance = math.huge
		local fallbackCount = 0
		local roomCompleted =
			doorsCompletedRooms[tostring(activeRoom.Name)] == true

		if not roomCompleted then
			for _,doorObject in ipairs(
				getDoorCandidates(activeRoom,roomDescendants)
			) do
				-- Resolve the physical target once and reuse it for plaque detection.
				local hitbox = findDoorHitbox(doorObject)
				if hitbox then
					local displayedNumber =
						readDoorDisplayedNumber(
							doorObject,
							activeRoom,
							roomDescendants,
							hitbox,
							expectedDoorNumber
						)

					local dupeNow =
						isDoorsDupeDoor(
							doorObject,
							expectedDoorNumber,
							displayedNumber
						)

					if not dupeNow and not isDoorsDoorOpen(doorObject) then
						local distance = distanceFromLocalRoot(hitbox)

						if displayedNumber == expectedDoorNumber then
							if distance < bestDoorDistance then
								bestDoorDistance = distance
								doorsDoorTarget = hitbox
								doorsDoorAdornee = doorObject
								doorsDoorRoom = tostring(activeRoom.Name)
							end
						elseif displayedNumber == nil then
							-- Important speed fallback:
							-- if this room has exactly ONE plausible unopened door,
							-- guide to it immediately instead of waiting for its number
							-- plaque/UI to finish streaming in.
							fallbackCount += 1
							if distance < fallbackDistance then
								fallbackDistance = distance
								fallbackDoor = doorObject
								fallbackHitbox = hitbox
							end
						end
					end
				end
			end
		end

		if not doorsDoorTarget
			and fallbackCount == 1
			and fallbackDoor
			and fallbackHitbox
			and fallbackDistance <= state.doorsGuideMaxDistance then

			doorsDoorTarget = fallbackHitbox
			doorsDoorAdornee = fallbackDoor
			doorsDoorRoom = tostring(activeRoom.Name)
		end
	end

	-- Mark the guide dirty as soon as a new room/door/plaque/key streams in.
	-- The RenderStepped controller will do one batched refresh on the next tick.
	trackAdvanced(
		workspace.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(object)
			if not runtimeCore.allows("DOORS") then
				return
			end
			if not (
				state.doorsKeyGuide
				or state.doorsDoorGuide
				or state.doorsSmartGuide
			) then
				return
			end

			local currentRooms = getDoorsCurrentRooms()
			if not currentRooms or not object then
				return
			end

			if object.Parent == currentRooms then
				gui:SetAttribute("DoorsGuideDirty",true)
				return
			end

			local lowerName = string.lower(tostring(object.Name or ""))
			local relevant =
				lowerName == "door"
				or lowerName == "doorhitbox"
				or lowerName == "keyhitbox"
				or lowerName == "keyobtain"
				or string.find(lowerName,"plaque",1,true) ~= nil
				or string.find(lowerName,"doornumber",1,true) ~= nil
				or string.find(lowerName,"roomnumber",1,true) ~= nil

			if not relevant
				and not (
					object:IsA("TextLabel")
					or object:IsA("TextButton")
					or object:IsA("TextBox")
				) then
				return
			end

			local cursor = object
			for _ = 1,8 do
				if not cursor or cursor == workspace then
					break
				end
				if cursor.Parent == currentRooms then
					gui:SetAttribute("DoorsGuideDirty",true)
					break
				end
				cursor = cursor.Parent
			end
		end)
	)

	local function clampedGuidePoint(worldPart)
		camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
		if not camera or not worldPart then
			return nil,false
		end

		local viewport = camera.ViewportSize
		local raw,onScreen = camera:WorldToViewportPoint(worldPart.Position)
		local center = Vector2.new(viewport.X*.5,viewport.Y*.5)
		local point = Vector2.new(raw.X,raw.Y)

		if raw.Z <= 0 then
			point = center-(point-center)
			onScreen = false
		end

		local margin = 34
		point = Vector2.new(
			math.clamp(point.X,margin,math.max(margin,viewport.X-margin)),
			math.clamp(point.Y,margin,math.max(margin,viewport.Y-margin))
		)
		return point,onScreen
	end

	local function hideDoorsGuideVisuals()
		keyGuideLine.Visible = false
		doorGuideLine.Visible = false
		keyGuideLabel.Visible = false
		doorGuideLabel.Visible = false
		keyGuideHighlight.Enabled = false
		doorGuideHighlight.Enabled = false
	end

	local function updateOneDoorsGuide(
		enabled,
		targetPart,
		adornee,
		roomName,
		line,
		label,
		prefix,
		color
	)
		if not enabled or not targetPart or not targetPart.Parent then
			line.Visible = false
			label.Visible = false
			return nil
		end

		camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
		local ownRoot =
			player.Character
			and player.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		if not camera or not ownRoot then
			line.Visible = false
			label.Visible = false
			return nil
		end

		local distance = math.floor((ownRoot.Position-targetPart.Position).Magnitude+.5)
		if distance > state.doorsGuideMaxDistance then
			line.Visible = false
			label.Visible = false
			return nil
		end

		local endpoint = clampedGuidePoint(targetPart)
		if not endpoint then
			line.Visible = false
			label.Visible = false
			return nil
		end

		local viewport = camera.ViewportSize
		local startPoint = Vector2.new(viewport.X*.5,viewport.Y*.82)
		setScreenLine(line,startPoint,endpoint,3)
		line.BackgroundColor3 = color
		line.Visible = true

		label.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(endpoint.X,endpoint.Y-8)
		label.Text =
			prefix
			.."  // ROOM "
			..tostring(roomName)
			.."  // "
			..tostring(distance)
			.." studs"
		label.Visible = true

		return distance
	end

	local function updateDoorsGuide()
		if gui:GetAttribute(
			"DoorsMinecartProtectionActive"
		) == true then
			hideDoorsGuideVisuals()
			return
		end

		if not shooterSecurityAllowed() then
			hideDoorsGuideVisuals()
			return
		end

		-- If the door currently being guided has just opened, retire that room
		-- immediately and rescan for the next unopened generated door.
		if doorsDoorAdornee
			and doorsDoorAdornee.Parent
			and isDoorsDoorOpen(doorsDoorAdornee) then
			markDoorRoomCompleted(
				doorsDoorAdornee,
				doorsDoorRoom
			)
			doorsDoorTarget = nil
			doorsDoorAdornee = nil
			refreshDoorsTargets()
		elseif gui:GetAttribute("DoorsGuideDirty") == true
			or os.clock()-doorsLastScan >= .90 then
			refreshDoorsTargets()
		end

		local showKey = state.doorsKeyGuide
		local showDoor = state.doorsDoorGuide

		-- Smart Guide shows one clear route: key first when a key exists,
		-- otherwise the nearest generated room door.
		if state.doorsSmartGuide then
			if doorsKeyTarget and doorsKeyTarget.Parent then
				showKey = true
				showDoor = false
			else
				showKey = false
				showDoor = true
			end
		end

		local keyDistance = updateOneDoorsGuide(
			showKey,
			doorsKeyTarget,
			doorsKeyAdornee,
			doorsKeyRoom,
			keyGuideLine,
			keyGuideLabel,
			"KEY",
			Color3.fromRGB(255,220,70)
		)

		local outlineColor = gui:GetAttribute("OutlineColor") or accent
		local doorDisplayRoom = doorsDoorRoom
		local numericDoorRoom = tonumber(doorsDoorRoom)
		if numericDoorRoom then
			doorDisplayRoom = string.format("%04d",numericDoorRoom+1)
		end
		local doorDistance = updateOneDoorsGuide(
			showDoor,
			doorsDoorTarget,
			doorsDoorAdornee,
			doorDisplayRoom,
			doorGuideLine,
			doorGuideLabel,
			"DOOR",
			outlineColor
		)
		doorGuideLabel.TextColor3 = readableTextOn(outlineColor)

		keyGuideHighlight.Adornee = doorsKeyAdornee
		keyGuideHighlight.Enabled =
			showKey
			and doorsKeyAdornee ~= nil
			and doorsKeyTarget ~= nil
			and keyDistance ~= nil

		doorGuideHighlight.Adornee = doorsDoorTarget
		doorGuideHighlight.FillColor = outlineColor
		doorGuideHighlight.OutlineColor = outlineColor
		doorGuideHighlight.Enabled =
			showDoor
			and doorsDoorAdornee ~= nil
			and doorsDoorTarget ~= nil
			and doorDistance ~= nil

		local keyText = "KEY: NOT FOUND"
		if doorsKeyTarget and doorsKeyTarget.Parent then
			keyText =
				"KEY: ROOM "
				..tostring(doorsKeyRoom)
				.." // "
				..tostring(
					math.floor(distanceFromLocalRoot(doorsKeyTarget)+.5)
				)
				.." studs"
		end

		local doorText = "DOOR: NOT FOUND"
		if doorsDoorTarget and doorsDoorTarget.Parent then
			doorText =
				"DOOR: "
				..tostring(doorDisplayRoom)
				.." // "
				..tostring(
					math.floor(distanceFromLocalRoot(doorsDoorTarget)+.5)
				)
				.." studs"
		end
		doorsStatusLabel.Text = keyText.."\n"..doorText
	end

	keyGuideButton.Activated:Connect(function()
		if secureAdvancedToggle(
			keyGuideButton,
			"doorsKeyGuide",
			"KEY GUIDE",
			not state.doorsKeyGuide
		) then
			state.doorsSmartGuide = false
			setToggle(smartGuideButton,false,"SMART GUIDE")
			refreshDoorsTargets()
			updateDoorsGuide()
		end
	end)

	doorGuideButton.Activated:Connect(function()
		if secureAdvancedToggle(
			doorGuideButton,
			"doorsDoorGuide",
			"DOOR GUIDE",
			not state.doorsDoorGuide
		) then
			state.doorsSmartGuide = false
			setToggle(smartGuideButton,false,"SMART GUIDE")
			refreshDoorsTargets()
			updateDoorsGuide()
		end
	end)

	smartGuideButton.Activated:Connect(function()
		local newValue = not state.doorsSmartGuide
		if secureAdvancedToggle(
			smartGuideButton,
			"doorsSmartGuide",
			"SMART GUIDE",
			newValue
		) then
			if newValue then
				state.doorsKeyGuide = false
				state.doorsDoorGuide = false
				setToggle(keyGuideButton,false,"KEY GUIDE")
				setToggle(doorGuideButton,false,"DOOR GUIDE")
			end
			refreshDoorsTargets()
			updateDoorsGuide()
		end
	end)

	refreshDoorsButton.Activated:Connect(function()
		if not shooterSecurityAllowed() then
			setStatus("SET SHOOTER_ALLOWED_PLACE_ID TO YOUR GAME PLACEID")
			return
		end
		refreshDoorsTargets()
		updateDoorsGuide()
		setStatus("DOORS TARGETS REFRESHED")
	end)

	-- --------------------------------------------------------
	-- KEY GUIDE + LEVER OVERLAY
	-- When KEY GUIDE is ON, also shows the nearest lever in the active room.
	-- This is deliberately isolated so it cannot push the DOORS scope toward
	-- Luau's 200-local register limit.
	;(function()
		local leverLine = Instance.new("Frame")
		leverLine.Name = "LeverGuideLine"
		leverLine.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255,178,68)
		leverLine.BorderSizePixel = 0
		leverLine.Visible = false
		leverLine.ZIndex = 717
		leverLine.Parent = overlay
		corner(leverLine,1000)

		local leverLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")
		leverLabel.Name = "LeverGuideLabel"
		leverLabel.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(.5,1)
		leverLabel.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(170,30)
		leverLabel.BackgroundColor3 = SURFACE
		leverLabel.BackgroundTransparency = .16
		leverLabel.BorderSizePixel = 0
		leverLabel.Text = "LEVER"
		leverLabel.TextSize = 9
		leverLabel.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBlack
		leverLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255,225,165)
		leverLabel.Visible = false
		leverLabel.ZIndex = 718
		leverLabel.Parent = overlay
		corner(leverLabel,8)
		addStroke(leverLabel,Color3.fromRGB(255,178,68),1,.28)

		local leverHighlight = Instance.new("Highlight")
		leverHighlight.Name = "NotRubyLeverGuideHighlight"
		leverHighlight.DepthMode = Enum.HighlightDepthMode.AlwaysOnTop
		leverHighlight.FillColor = Color3.fromRGB(255,178,68)
		leverHighlight.OutlineColor = Color3.fromRGB(255,235,185)
		leverHighlight.FillTransparency = .80
		leverHighlight.OutlineTransparency = .03
		leverHighlight.Enabled = false
		leverHighlight.Parent = doorsOverlayFolder

		local leverTarget = nil
		local leverPart = nil
		local leverRoom = "--"
		local leverLastScan = 0

		local function hideLeverGuide()
			leverLine.Visible = false
			leverLabel.Visible = false
			leverHighlight.Enabled = false
			leverHighlight.Adornee = nil
		end

		local function namedLever(object)
			if not object then
				return false
			end
			local lowerName = string.lower(tostring(object.Name or ""))
			return string.find(lowerName,"lever",1,true) ~= nil
		end

		local function leverRootFor(object,activeRoom)
			if not object or not object.Parent then
				return nil
			end

			local cursor = object
			local fallbackPart = object:IsA("BasePart") and object or nil
			for _ = 1,8 do
				if not cursor or cursor == activeRoom.Parent then
					break
				end
				if namedLever(cursor) then
					if cursor:IsA("Model") or cursor:IsA("BasePart") then
						return cursor
					end
				end
				if not fallbackPart and cursor:IsA("BasePart") then
					fallbackPart = cursor
				end
				if cursor == activeRoom then
					break
				end
				cursor = cursor.Parent
			end
			return nil
		end

		local function partForLever(target)
			if not target or not target.Parent then
				return nil
			end
			if target:IsA("BasePart") then
				return target
			end
			if target:IsA("Model") then
				return target.PrimaryPart
					or target:FindFirstChild("Handle",true)
					or target:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart",true)
			end
			return nil
		end

		local function scanLever()
			leverLastScan = os.clock()
			leverTarget = nil
			leverPart = nil
			leverRoom = "--"

			if not state.doorsKeyGuide
				or not shooterSecurityAllowed() then
				return
			end

			local currentRooms = getDoorsCurrentRooms()
			if not currentRooms then
				return
			end

			local activeRoom = getActiveDoorsRoom(currentRooms)
			if not activeRoom then
				return
			end

			local bestDistance = state.doorsGuideMaxDistance
			local seen = {}

			for _,object in ipairs(activeRoom:GetDescendants()) do
				if object:IsA("Model")
					or object:IsA("BasePart")
					or object:IsA("ProximityPrompt") then

					local root = leverRootFor(object,activeRoom)
					if root and not seen[root] then
						seen[root] = true
						local part = partForLever(root)
						if part then
							local distance = distanceFromLocalRoot(part)
							if distance < bestDistance then
								bestDistance = distance
								leverTarget = root
								leverPart = part
								leverRoom = tostring(activeRoom.Name)
							end
						end
					end
				end
			end
		end

		local function updateLeverGuide()
			if not state.doorsKeyGuide
				or not shooterSecurityAllowed() then
				hideLeverGuide()
				return
			end

			if os.clock()-leverLastScan >= .5
				or not leverTarget
				or not leverTarget.Parent
				or not leverPart
				or not leverPart.Parent then
				scanLever()
			end

			if not leverTarget or not leverPart then
				hideLeverGuide()
				return
			end

			camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
			local ownRoot =
				player.Character
				and player.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
			if not camera or not ownRoot then
				hideLeverGuide()
				return
			end

			local distance =
				math.floor((ownRoot.Position-leverPart.Position).Magnitude+.5)
			if distance > state.doorsGuideMaxDistance then
				hideLeverGuide()
				return
			end

			local endpoint = clampedGuidePoint(leverPart)
			if not endpoint then
				hideLeverGuide()
				return
			end

			local viewport = camera.ViewportSize
			local startPoint = Vector2.new(viewport.X*.5,viewport.Y*.82)
			setScreenLine(leverLine,startPoint,endpoint,3)
			leverLine.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255,178,68)
			leverLine.Visible = true

			leverLabel.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(endpoint.X,endpoint.Y-8)
			leverLabel.Text =
				"LEVER // ROOM "
				..tostring(leverRoom)
				.." // "
				..tostring(distance)
				.." studs"
			leverLabel.Visible = true

			leverHighlight.Adornee = leverTarget
			leverHighlight.Enabled = true
		end

		local accumulator = 0
		trackAdvanced(
			RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function(deltaTime)
			if not runtimeCore.allows("DOORS") then
				return
			end
				accumulator += deltaTime
				if accumulator < .1 then
					return
				end
				accumulator = 0

				if menuDeleted or not gui.Parent then
					return
				end

				if state.doorsKeyGuide then
					updateLeverGuide()
				else
					hideLeverGuide()
				end
			end)
		)

		gui.Destroying:Connect(function()
			hideLeverGuide()
		end)
	end)()

	-- --------------------------------------------------------
	-- TAP KEY UNLOCK // REMOVE HOLD FROM LOCKED DOOR PROMPTS
	-- Converts the locked-door/key ProximityPrompt hold into a normal tap.
	-- It does NOT auto-fire the prompt; the player still taps the interaction
	-- normally. Original HoldDuration values are restored when disabled.
	;(function()
		gui:SetAttribute("DoorsTapKeyUnlock",false)

		local tapKeyButton =
			makeAction(
				doorsGroup,
				shooterSecurityAllowed()
					and "TAP KEY UNLOCK [OFF]"
					or "TAP KEY UNLOCK [LOCKED]"
			)

		local originalDurations = setmetatable({}, {__mode = "k"})
		local trackedPrompts = setmetatable({}, {__mode = "k"})
		local scanAccumulator = 0

		local function compact(value)
			return string.lower(
				string.gsub(tostring(value or ""),"[^%w]","")
			)
		end

		local function containsAny(value,words)
			local c = compact(value)
			for _,word in ipairs(words) do
				if string.find(c,word,1,true) then
					return true
				end
			end
			return false
		end

		local function ancestryLooksLikeDoorLock(prompt)
			if not prompt or not prompt.Parent then
				return false
			end

			local cursor = prompt.Parent
			for _ = 1,8 do
				if not cursor or cursor == workspace then
					break
				end

				local name = compact(cursor.Name)
				if containsAny(name,{
					"doorlock",
					"keylock",
					"keyhole",
					"padlock",
					"lock",
					"lockeddoor"
				}) then
					return true
				end

				-- The normal room door hierarchy is allowed, but only if the
				-- prompt itself also looks like an unlock/open-with-key prompt.
				if name == "door" or name == "doorhitbox" then
					local promptText =
						compact(prompt.Name)
						.." "
						..compact(prompt.ActionText)
						.." "
						..compact(prompt.ObjectText)

					if containsAny(promptText,{
						"key",
						"lock",
						"unlock",
						"open"
					}) then
						return true
					end
				end

				cursor = cursor.Parent
			end

			return false
		end

		local function promptLooksLikeKeyUnlock(prompt)
			if not prompt or not prompt:IsA("ProximityPrompt") then
				return false
			end

			if ancestryLooksLikeDoorLock(prompt) then
				return true
			end

			local combined =
				compact(prompt.Name)
				.." "
				..compact(prompt.ActionText)
				.." "
				..compact(prompt.ObjectText)

			-- Strong prompt-side names used by DOORS/remakes.
			return containsAny(combined,{
				"unlockdoor",
				"doorunlock",
				"keyunlock",
				"keylock",
				"usekey",
				"insertkey"
			})
		end

		local function makeInstant(prompt)
			if not promptLooksLikeKeyUnlock(prompt) then
				return
			end

			if originalDurations[prompt] == nil then
				originalDurations[prompt] = prompt.HoldDuration
			end

			trackedPrompts[prompt] = true

			pcall(function()
				prompt.HoldDuration = 0
			end)
		end

		local function scanRelevantPrompts()
			if gui:GetAttribute("DoorsTapKeyUnlock") ~= true
				or not shooterSecurityAllowed() then
				return
			end

			local currentRooms = getDoorsCurrentRooms()
			if currentRooms then
				for _,room in ipairs(getRecentDoorsRooms(currentRooms,4)) do
					for _,object in ipairs(room:GetDescendants()) do
						if object:IsA("ProximityPrompt") then
							makeInstant(object)
						end
					end
				end
			end

			-- Some DOORS remakes keep a lock/prompt outside CurrentRooms.
			for _,object in ipairs(workspace:GetChildren()) do
				if object:IsA("ProximityPrompt") then
					makeInstant(object)
				end
			end
		end

		local function restoreAll()
			for prompt in pairs(trackedPrompts) do
				if prompt and prompt.Parent then
					local original = originalDurations[prompt]
					if original ~= nil then
						pcall(function()
							prompt.HoldDuration = original
						end)
					end
				end
			end

			table.clear(trackedPrompts)
			table.clear(originalDurations)
		end

		local function setEnabled(enabled)
			gui:SetAttribute("DoorsTapKeyUnlock",enabled)
			setToggle(tapKeyButton,enabled,"TAP KEY UNLOCK")

			if enabled then
				scanRelevantPrompts()
				setStatus("TAP KEY UNLOCK ON // LOCKED DOORS ARE TAP")
			else
				restoreAll()
				setStatus("TAP KEY UNLOCK OFF")
			end
		end

		tapKeyButton.Activated:Connect(function()
			if not shooterSecurityAllowed() then
				gui:SetAttribute("DoorsTapKeyUnlock",false)
				tapKeyButton.Text = "TAP KEY UNLOCK [LOCKED]"
				setStatus("SET SHOOTER_ALLOWED_PLACE_ID TO YOUR GAME PLACEID")
				return
			end

			setEnabled(
				gui:GetAttribute("DoorsTapKeyUnlock") ~= true
			)
		end)

		if shooterSecurityAllowed() then
			setToggle(tapKeyButton,false,"TAP KEY UNLOCK")
		end

		trackAdvanced(
			workspace.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(object)
				if not runtimeCore.allows("DOORS") then
					return
				end
				if gui:GetAttribute("DoorsTapKeyUnlock") ~= true
					or not object:IsA("ProximityPrompt") then
					return
				end

				task.defer(function()
					if object and object.Parent
						and gui:GetAttribute("DoorsTapKeyUnlock") == true then
						makeInstant(object)
					end
				end)
			end)
		)

		trackAdvanced(
			RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(deltaTime)
				if not runtimeCore.allows("DOORS") then
					return
				end
				scanAccumulator += deltaTime
				if scanAccumulator < .35 then
					return
				end
				scanAccumulator = 0

				if menuDeleted or not gui.Parent then
					return
				end

				if gui:GetAttribute("DoorsTapKeyUnlock") == true then
					-- Re-apply in case the game restores the hold duration.
					for prompt in pairs(trackedPrompts) do
						if prompt and prompt.Parent then
							pcall(function()
								prompt.HoldDuration = 0
							end)
						end
					end
					scanRelevantPrompts()
				end
			end)
		)

		gui.Destroying:Connect(function()
			gui:SetAttribute("DoorsTapKeyUnlock",false)
			restoreAll()
		end)
	end)()

	-- --------------------------------------------------------
	-- DOORS QUICK BOOST // MINIMUM 18 + SEEK OVERRIDE
	-- Keeps WalkSpeed from dropping below 18 during normal movement, crouching,
	-- backwards movement, etc. Higher game-controlled speeds are left untouched,
	-- so Seek can raise/change the player's speed during the chase.
	;(function()
		gui:SetAttribute("DoorsQuickBoost",false)
		gui:SetAttribute("DoorsQuickBoostSpeed",18)

		local MIN_SPEED = 18

		local quickBoostToggleEvent =
			gui:FindFirstChild("NotRubyDoorsQuickBoostToggle")
		if not quickBoostToggleEvent
			or not quickBoostToggleEvent:IsA("BindableEvent") then
			if quickBoostToggleEvent then
				quickBoostToggleEvent:Destroy()
			end
			quickBoostToggleEvent = Instance.new("BindableEvent")
			quickBoostToggleEvent.Name = "NotRubyDoorsQuickBoostToggle"
			quickBoostToggleEvent.Parent = gui
		end

		local quickBoostButton =
			makeAction(
				doorsGroup,
				shooterSecurityAllowed()
					and "QUICK BOOST MIN 18 [OFF]"
					or "QUICK BOOST [LOCKED]"
			)

		local savedWalkSpeed = nil
		local savedHumanoid = nil
		local speedLockConnection = nil
		local ancestryConnection = nil
		local boostAccumulator = 0
		local applying = false

		local function disconnectSpeedLock()
			if speedLockConnection then
				pcall(function()
					speedLockConnection:Disconnect()
				end)
				speedLockConnection = nil
			end

			if ancestryConnection then
				pcall(function()
					ancestryConnection:Disconnect()
				end)
				ancestryConnection = nil
			end
		end

		local function currentHumanoid()
			local ownCharacter = player.Character
			return
				ownCharacter
				and ownCharacter:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
				or nil
		end

		local function refreshButton()
			local floor2Button =
				gui:FindFirstChild(
					"Floor2QuickBoostButton",
					true
				)

			if not shooterSecurityAllowed() then
				quickBoostButton.Text = "QUICK BOOST [LOCKED]"
				if floor2Button
					and floor2Button:IsA("TextButton") then
					floor2Button.Text = "QUICK BOOST [LOCKED]"
				end
				return
			end

			local enabled = gui:GetAttribute("DoorsQuickBoost") == true

			setToggle(
				quickBoostButton,
				enabled,
				"QUICK BOOST MIN 18"
			)

			if floor2Button
				and floor2Button:IsA("TextButton") then
				setToggle(
					floor2Button,
					enabled,
					"QUICK BOOST MIN 18"
				)
			end
		end

		local function enforceMinimum(humanoid)
			if applying
				or gui:GetAttribute("DoorsQuickBoost") ~= true
				or not shooterSecurityAllowed()
				or not humanoid
				or not humanoid.Parent
				or humanoid.Health <= 0 then
				return
			end

			-- IMPORTANT: only block reductions below 18.
			-- If Seek/game logic raises WalkSpeed above 18, leave it alone.
			if humanoid.WalkSpeed < MIN_SPEED then
				applying = true
				humanoid.WalkSpeed = MIN_SPEED
				applying = false
			end
		end

		local function attachSpeedLock(humanoid)
			if not humanoid or humanoid.Health <= 0 then
				return
			end

			if savedHumanoid ~= humanoid then
				disconnectSpeedLock()

				savedHumanoid = humanoid
				savedWalkSpeed = humanoid.WalkSpeed

				speedLockConnection =
					humanoid:GetPropertyChangedSignal("WalkSpeed"):Connect(function()
						if gui:GetAttribute("DoorsQuickBoost") ~= true then
							return
						end

						-- Crouch/backwards commonly lower/reset WalkSpeed.
						-- Restore only when it falls BELOW 18. Seek's higher
						-- chase speed is allowed to remain exactly as the game sets it.
						if humanoid.WalkSpeed < MIN_SPEED then
							task.defer(function()
								if humanoid
									and humanoid.Parent
									and gui:GetAttribute("DoorsQuickBoost") == true then
									enforceMinimum(humanoid)
								end
							end)
						end
					end)

				ancestryConnection =
					humanoid.AncestryChanged:Connect(function(_,parent)
						if not parent and savedHumanoid == humanoid then
							disconnectSpeedLock()
							savedHumanoid = nil
							savedWalkSpeed = nil
						end
					end)
			end

			enforceMinimum(humanoid)
		end

		local function applyBoost()
			if gui:GetAttribute("DoorsQuickBoost") ~= true
				or not shooterSecurityAllowed() then
				return
			end

			local humanoid = currentHumanoid()
			if not humanoid or humanoid.Health <= 0 then
				return
			end

			attachSpeedLock(humanoid)
			enforceMinimum(humanoid)
		end

		local function disableBoost()
			gui:SetAttribute("DoorsQuickBoost",false)

			local humanoid = currentHumanoid()
			if humanoid
				and savedHumanoid == humanoid
				and savedWalkSpeed ~= nil
				and humanoid.Health > 0 then
				applying = true
				humanoid.WalkSpeed = savedWalkSpeed
				applying = false
			end

			disconnectSpeedLock()
			savedHumanoid = nil
			savedWalkSpeed = nil
			refreshButton()
		end

		local function toggleBoost()
			if not shooterSecurityAllowed() then
				gui:SetAttribute("DoorsQuickBoost",false)
				refreshButton()
				setStatus("SET SHOOTER_ALLOWED_PLACE_ID TO YOUR GAME PLACEID")
				return
			end

			local enabled = gui:GetAttribute("DoorsQuickBoost") == true
			if enabled then
				disableBoost()
				setStatus("DOORS QUICK BOOST OFF")
				return
			end

			gui:SetAttribute("DoorsQuickBoostSpeed",MIN_SPEED)
			gui:SetAttribute("DoorsQuickBoost",true)

			local humanoid = currentHumanoid()
			if humanoid then
				savedHumanoid = nil
				savedWalkSpeed = nil
				attachSpeedLock(humanoid)
			end

			applyBoost()
			refreshButton()
			setStatus(
				"DOORS QUICK BOOST // MINIMUM 18 // SEEK CAN OVERRIDE"
			)
		end

		quickBoostButton.Activated:Connect(toggleBoost)
		quickBoostToggleEvent.Event:Connect(toggleBoost)

		gui:GetAttributeChangedSignal("DoorsQuickBoost"):Connect(function()
			if gui.Parent and not menuDeleted then
				refreshButton()
			end
		end)

		if shooterSecurityAllowed() then
			refreshButton()
		end

		-- Fallback catches unusual reset order. It only raises speed back to 18
		-- when something lowers it; it never overwrites a higher Seek speed.
		trackAdvanced(
			RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(deltaTime)
				if not runtimeCore.allows("DOORS") then
					return
				end
				boostAccumulator += deltaTime
				if boostAccumulator < .05 then
					return
				end
				boostAccumulator = 0

				if menuDeleted or not gui.Parent then
					return
				end

				if gui:GetAttribute("DoorsQuickBoost") == true then
					applyBoost()
				end
			end)
		)

		player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(characterAdded)
			disconnectSpeedLock()
			savedHumanoid = nil
			savedWalkSpeed = nil

			if gui:GetAttribute("DoorsQuickBoost") == true then
				task.spawn(function()
					local humanoid =
						characterAdded:WaitForChild("Humanoid",5)
					if humanoid
						and gui:GetAttribute("DoorsQuickBoost") == true then
						attachSpeedLock(humanoid)
						enforceMinimum(humanoid)
					end
				end)
			end
		end)

		gui.Destroying:Connect(function()
			disableBoost()
		end)
		runtimeCore.stopEvent.Event:Connect(function()
			disableBoost()
		end)

	end)()

	-- --------------------------------------------------------
	-- DOOR 100 BREAKER POLE ESP // FIXED FOR ACTUAL PICKUP MODEL
	-- Tracks the loose Door 100 breaker-pole pickup objects themselves.
	-- Main supported runtime name: LiveBreakerPolePickup.
	;(function()
		gui:SetAttribute("Doors100SwitchEsp",false)

		local switchEspButton =
			makeAction(
				doorsGroup,
				shooterSecurityAllowed()
					and "DOOR 100 BREAKER POLE ESP [OFF]"
					or "DOOR 100 BREAKER POLE ESP [LOCKED]"
			)

		local switchFolder = Instance.new("Folder")
		switchFolder.Name = "NotRubyDoor100BreakerPoleESP"
		switchFolder.Parent = workspace

		local records = {}
		local room100 = nil
		local lastScan = 0
		local visualAccumulator = 0
		local MAX_SWITCHES = 12

		local function compactName(value)
			return string.lower(
				string.gsub(tostring(value or ""),"[^%w]","")
			)
		end

		local function isBreakerPoleName(value)
			local compact = compactName(value)

			-- Actual DOORS runtime pickup name + a few close variants used by
			-- remakes. We do NOT match generic Switch/Breaker names anymore.
			return compact == "livebreakerpolepickup"
				or compact == "breakerpolepickup"
				or compact == "livebreakerpole"
				or compact == "breakerpole"
		end

		local function getRoom100()
			local currentRooms = getDoorsCurrentRooms()
			if not currentRooms then
				return nil
			end

			local direct = currentRooms:FindFirstChild("100")
			if direct then
				return direct
			end

			for _,room in ipairs(currentRooms:GetChildren()) do
				if tonumber(room.Name) == 100 then
					return room
				end
			end

			return nil
		end

		local function canonicalPole(object,room)
			if not object or not object.Parent or not room then
				return nil
			end

			local cursor = object
			for _ = 1,7 do
				if not cursor or cursor == room.Parent then
					break
				end

				if (
					cursor:IsA("Model")
					or cursor:IsA("Tool")
					or cursor:IsA("BasePart")
				)
					and isBreakerPoleName(cursor.Name) then
					return cursor
				end

				if cursor == room then
					break
				end

				cursor = cursor.Parent
			end

			return nil
		end

		local function partFor(root)
			if not root or not root.Parent then
				return nil
			end

			if root:IsA("BasePart") then
				return root
			end

			if root:IsA("Tool") then
				return root:FindFirstChild("Handle")
					or root:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart",true)
			end

			if root:IsA("Model") then
				return root.PrimaryPart
					or root:FindFirstChild("Handle",true)
					or root:FindFirstChild("Main",true)
					or root:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart",true)
			end

			return nil
		end

		local function destroyRecord(root)
			local record = records[root]
			if not record then
				return
			end

			for _,object in ipairs({
				record.highlight,
				record.billboard,
				record.line
			}) do
				if object and object.Parent then
					object:Destroy()
				end
			end

			records[root] = nil
		end

		local function clear()
			local roots = {}
			for root in pairs(records) do
				table.insert(roots,root)
			end

			for _,root in ipairs(roots) do
				destroyRecord(root)
			end
		end

		local function add(root)
			if not root or not root.Parent or records[root] then
				return
			end

			local part = partFor(root)
			if not part then
				return
			end

			local count = 0
			for _ in pairs(records) do
				count += 1
			end
			if count >= MAX_SWITCHES then
				return
			end

			local color = Color3.fromRGB(80,215,255)

			local highlight = Instance.new("Highlight")
			highlight.Name = "NotRubyDoor100BreakerPoleHighlight"
			highlight.Adornee = root
			highlight.DepthMode = Enum.HighlightDepthMode.AlwaysOnTop
			highlight.FillColor = color
			highlight.OutlineColor = Color3.fromRGB(220,250,255)
			highlight.FillTransparency = .72
			highlight.OutlineTransparency = .02
			highlight.Parent = switchFolder

			local billboard = Instance.new("BillboardGui")
			billboard.Name = "NotRubyDoor100BreakerPoleLabel"
			billboard.Adornee = part
			billboard.AlwaysOnTop = true
			billboard.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(210,32)
			billboard.StudsOffset = Vector3.new(0,1.8,0)
			billboard.MaxDistance = state.doorsGuideMaxDistance
			billboard.Parent = part

			local label = Instance.new("TextLabel")
			label.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1,1)
			label.BackgroundColor3 = SURFACE
			label.BackgroundTransparency = .16
			label.BorderSizePixel = 0
			label.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBlack
			label.TextSize = 9
			label.TextColor3 = color
			label.Text = "BREAKER POLE"
			label.Parent = billboard
			corner(label,8)
			addStroke(label,color,1,.25)

			local line = Instance.new("Frame")
			line.Name = "NotRubyDoor100BreakerPoleLine"
			line.BackgroundColor3 = color
			line.BackgroundTransparency = .12
			line.BorderSizePixel = 0
			line.Visible = false
			line.ZIndex = 721
			line.Parent = overlay
			corner(line,1000)

			records[root] = {
				part = part,
				highlight = highlight,
				billboard = billboard,
				label = label,
				line = line,
				color = color
			}
		end

		local function scan()
			lastScan = os.clock()

			if gui:GetAttribute("Doors100SwitchEsp") ~= true
				or not shooterSecurityAllowed() then
				return
			end

			local newRoom = getRoom100()
			if newRoom ~= room100 then
				room100 = newRoom
				clear()
			end

			if not room100 then
				return
			end

			local found = {}

			-- Scan the actual pickup models/parts by their real runtime name.
			for _,object in ipairs(room100:GetDescendants()) do
				if object:IsA("Model")
					or object:IsA("Tool")
					or object:IsA("BasePart") then
					local root = canonicalPole(object,room100)
					if root and not found[root] then
						found[root] = true
						add(root)
					end
				end
			end

			local stale = {}
			for root in pairs(records) do
				if not root.Parent
					or not root:IsDescendantOf(room100)
					or not found[root] then
					table.insert(stale,root)
				end
			end

			for _,root in ipairs(stale) do
				destroyRecord(root)
			end
		end

		local function update()
			if gui:GetAttribute("Doors100SwitchEsp") ~= true
				or not shooterSecurityAllowed() then
				clear()
				return
			end

			if os.clock()-lastScan >= 2 then
				scan()
			end

			camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
			local ownRoot =
				player.Character
				and player.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

			if not camera or not ownRoot then
				return
			end

			local removeList = {}
			local index = 0

			for root,record in pairs(records) do
				local part = partFor(root)

				if not root.Parent
					or not part
					or not part.Parent
					or not room100
					or not root:IsDescendantOf(room100) then
					table.insert(removeList,root)
				else
					index += 1
					record.part = part
					record.billboard.Adornee = part
					record.billboard.MaxDistance = state.doorsGuideMaxDistance

					local distance =
						math.floor((ownRoot.Position-part.Position).Magnitude+.5)

					record.label.Text =
						"BREAKER POLE "
						..tostring(index)
						.." // "
						..tostring(distance)
						.." studs"

					local visible = distance <= state.doorsGuideMaxDistance
					record.highlight.Enabled = visible
					record.billboard.Enabled = visible

					if visible then
						local endpoint = clampedGuidePoint(part)
						if endpoint then
							local viewport = camera.ViewportSize
							local startPoint =
								Vector2.new(
									viewport.X*.5 + (index-1)*5,
									viewport.Y*.86
								)

							setScreenLine(record.line,startPoint,endpoint,2)
							record.line.BackgroundColor3 = record.color
							record.line.Visible = true
						else
							record.line.Visible = false
						end
					else
						record.line.Visible = false
					end
				end
			end

			for _,root in ipairs(removeList) do
				destroyRecord(root)
			end
		end

		local function processAdded(object)
			if gui:GetAttribute("Doors100SwitchEsp") ~= true
				or not shooterSecurityAllowed()
				or not room100
				or not object
				or not object.Parent
				or not object:IsDescendantOf(room100) then
				return
			end

			local root = canonicalPole(object,room100)
			if root then
				add(root)
			end
		end

		switchEspButton.Activated:Connect(function()
			if not shooterSecurityAllowed() then
				gui:SetAttribute("Doors100SwitchEsp",false)
				switchEspButton.Text = "DOOR 100 BREAKER POLE ESP [LOCKED]"
				setStatus("SET SHOOTER_ALLOWED_PLACE_ID TO YOUR GAME PLACEID")
				clear()
				return
			end

			local enabled =
				gui:GetAttribute("Doors100SwitchEsp") == true
			enabled = not enabled
			gui:SetAttribute("Doors100SwitchEsp",enabled)
			setToggle(
				switchEspButton,
				enabled,
				"DOOR 100 BREAKER POLE ESP"
			)

			if enabled then
				room100 = getRoom100()
				scan()
				update()
				setStatus("DOOR 100 BREAKER POLE ESP ON")
			else
				clear()
				room100 = nil
				setStatus("DOOR 100 BREAKER POLE ESP OFF")
			end
		end)

		if shooterSecurityAllowed() then
			setToggle(
				switchEspButton,
				false,
				"DOOR 100 BREAKER POLE ESP"
			)
		end

		trackAdvanced(
			workspace.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(object)
				if not runtimeCore.allows("DOORS") then
					return
				end
				if gui:GetAttribute("Doors100SwitchEsp") ~= true then
					return
				end

				task.defer(function()
					if object and object.Parent then
						if not room100 then
							room100 = getRoom100()
						end
						processAdded(object)
					end
				end)
			end)
		)

		trackAdvanced(
			RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(deltaTime)
				if not runtimeCore.allows("DOORS") then
					return
				end
				visualAccumulator += deltaTime
				if visualAccumulator < .18 then
					return
				end
				visualAccumulator = 0

				if menuDeleted or not gui.Parent then
					return
				end

				if gui:GetAttribute("Doors100SwitchEsp") == true then
					update()
				end
			end)
		)

		gui.Destroying:Connect(function()
			gui:SetAttribute("Doors100SwitchEsp",false)
			clear()
			if switchFolder and switchFolder.Parent then
				switchFolder:Destroy()
			end
		end)
	end)()

	-- --------------------------------------------------------
	-- AUTO ELEVATOR POWER // DOOR 100 BREAKER PUZZLE
	-- Automatically watches the Room 100 breaker/elevator-power display and
	-- activates the requested numbered breaker. It learns the puzzle directly
	-- from replicated UI/values instead of using a hard-coded answer.
	;(function()
		gui:SetAttribute("DoorsAutoElevatorPower",false)

		local autoPowerButton =
			makeAction(
				doorsGroup,
				shooterSecurityAllowed()
					and "AUTO ELEVATOR POWER [OFF]"
					or "AUTO ELEVATOR POWER [LOCKED]"
			)

		local room100 = nil
		local puzzleRoot = nil
		local switchMap = {}
		local switchRoots = {}
		local lastBuild = 0
		local lastAction = 0
		local lastSeenStepAt = 0
		local lastWaitingStatus = 0
		local lastSignature = nil
		local attemptsForStep = 0
		local solverAccumulator = 0
		local startedPuzzle = false
		local completionSent = false
		local directRemote = nil
		local lastRemoteLookup = 0
		local lastRemoteAttempt = 0
		local remoteAttempts = 0
		local directMethodAnnounced = false

		local function compact(value)
			return string.lower(
				string.gsub(tostring(value or ""),"[^%w]","")
			)
		end

		local function containsAny(value,words)
			local c = compact(value)
			for _,word in ipairs(words) do
				if string.find(c,word,1,true) then
					return true
				end
			end
			return false
		end


		-- Remote-first completion path. Older DOORS builds expose the breaker
		-- completion RemoteEvent as ReplicatedStorage.Bricks.EBF. We prefer this
		-- exact puzzle-specific path before trying to infer the physical panel.
		local function findDirectBreakerRemote()
			local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

			local bricks = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("Bricks")
			if bricks then
				local ebf = bricks:FindFirstChild("EBF")
				if ebf
					and (
						ebf:IsA("RemoteEvent")
						or ebf:IsA("RemoteFunction")
					) then
					return ebf
				end
			end

			-- Conservative fallback for renamed builds: exact strong names only.
			local exactNames = {
				ebf = true,
				elevatorbreakerfinish = true,
				breakerpuzzlefinish = true,
				elevatorpowerfinish = true,
				breakerboxfinish = true
			}

			for _,object in ipairs(ReplicatedStorage:GetDescendants()) do
				if (
					object:IsA("RemoteEvent")
					or object:IsA("RemoteFunction")
				)
					and exactNames[compact(object.Name)] then
					return object
				end
			end

			return nil
		end

		local function fireDirectBreakerRemote(remote)
			if not remote or not remote.Parent then
				return false
			end

			if remote:IsA("RemoteEvent") then
				return pcall(function()
					remote:FireServer()
				end)
			end

			if remote:IsA("RemoteFunction") then
				local ok = pcall(function()
					remote:InvokeServer()
				end)
				return ok
			end

			return false
		end

		local function tryDirectCompletion(now)
			now = now or os.clock()

			if not directRemote
				or not directRemote.Parent
				or now-lastRemoteLookup >= 1.5 then
				lastRemoteLookup = now
				directRemote = findDirectBreakerRemote()
			end

			if not directRemote then
				return false
			end

			-- Some builds only accept the completion request after the minigame
			-- finishes opening, so retry a few times instead of firing once.
			if remoteAttempts < 4
				and now-lastRemoteAttempt >= .55 then
				lastRemoteAttempt = now

				if fireDirectBreakerRemote(directRemote) then
					remoteAttempts += 1

					if not directMethodAnnounced then
						directMethodAnnounced = true
						setStatus(
							"AUTO ELEVATOR POWER // DIRECT BREAKER REMOTE FOUND"
						)
					end
				else
					directRemote = nil
				end
			end

			return true
		end

		local function getRoom100()
			local currentRooms = getDoorsCurrentRooms()
			if not currentRooms then
				return nil
			end

			local direct = currentRooms:FindFirstChild("100")
			if direct then
				return direct
			end

			for _,room in ipairs(currentRooms:GetChildren()) do
				if tonumber(room.Name) == 100 then
					return room
				end
			end

			return nil
		end

		local function isLoosePole(object)
			if not object then
				return false
			end
			local name = compact(object.Name)
			return string.find(name,"breakerpole",1,true) ~= nil
				or string.find(name,"livebreakerpolepickup",1,true) ~= nil
		end

		local function interactionFor(root)
			if not root or not root.Parent then
				return nil,nil
			end

			if root:IsA("ProximityPrompt") then
				return "prompt",root
			end
			if root:IsA("ClickDetector") then
				return "click",root
			end

			local prompt = root:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("ProximityPrompt",true)
			if prompt then
				return "prompt",prompt
			end

			local click = root:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("ClickDetector",true)
			if click then
				return "click",click
			end

			return nil,nil
		end

		local function exactBreakerNumber(value)
			local number = tonumber(tostring(value or ""))
			if number then
				number = math.floor(number+.5)
				if number >= 1 and number <= 10 then
					return number
				end
			end

			local digits =
				string.match(
					string.lower(tostring(value or "")),
					"(%d+)"
				)
			number = tonumber(digits)
			if number and number >= 1 and number <= 10 then
				return math.floor(number)
			end

			return nil
		end

		local function breakerNumber(root)
			if not root then
				return nil
			end

			for _,attributeName in ipairs({
				"BreakerNumber",
				"SwitchNumber",
				"Number",
				"ID",
				"Id",
				"Index"
			}) do
				local ok,value = pcall(function()
					return root:GetAttribute(attributeName)
				end)
				if ok and value ~= nil then
					local number = exactBreakerNumber(value)
					if number then
						return number
					end
				end
			end

			local fromName = exactBreakerNumber(root.Name)
			if fromName
				and containsAny(root.Name,{"breaker","switch"}) then
				return fromName
			end

			for _,descendant in ipairs(root:GetDescendants()) do
				if descendant:IsA("IntValue")
					or descendant:IsA("NumberValue")
					or descendant:IsA("StringValue") then
					local childName = compact(descendant.Name)
					if containsAny(childName,{
						"number","index","id","breaker","switch"
					}) then
						local number = exactBreakerNumber(descendant.Value)
						if number then
							return number
						end
					end
				elseif descendant:IsA("TextLabel")
					or descendant:IsA("TextBox")
					or descendant:IsA("TextButton") then
					local number = exactBreakerNumber(descendant.Text)
					if number
						and tostring(descendant.Text):match("^%s*%d+%s*$") then
						return number
					end
				end
			end

			return nil
		end

		local function looksLikePanelSwitch(object)
			if not object or not object.Parent or isLoosePole(object) then
				return false
			end

			if not (
				object:IsA("Model")
				or object:IsA("BasePart")
				or object:IsA("Tool")
			) then
				return false
			end

			local name = compact(object.Name)
			if not containsAny(name,{"breaker","switch"}) then
				return false
			end

			if containsAny(name,{
				"box","panel","puzzle","power","elevator",
				"generator","polepickup"
			}) then
				return false
			end

			local interactionType = interactionFor(object)
			return interactionType ~= nil
		end

		local function canonicalSwitch(object)
			if not object or not object.Parent then
				return nil
			end

			local cursor = object
			local best = nil

			for _ = 1,6 do
				if not cursor or cursor == room100 then
					break
				end

				if looksLikePanelSwitch(cursor) then
					best = cursor
				end

				cursor = cursor.Parent
			end

			return best
		end

		local function buildSwitchMap()
			lastBuild = os.clock()
			switchMap = {}
			switchRoots = {}
			puzzleRoot = nil

			local newRoom = getRoom100()
			if newRoom ~= room100 then
				room100 = newRoom
			end

			if not room100 then
				return false
			end

			local seen = {}

			for _,object in ipairs(room100:GetDescendants()) do
				if object:IsA("Model")
					or object:IsA("BasePart")
					or object:IsA("Tool") then

					local root = canonicalSwitch(object)
					if root and not seen[root] then
						seen[root] = true
