						local number = breakerNumber(root)
						local interactionType,interaction = interactionFor(root)

						if number
							and interactionType
							and interaction
							and not switchMap[number] then
							switchMap[number] = {
								root = root,
								kind = interactionType,
								interaction = interaction
							}
							switchRoots[root] = true

							-- The common ancestor around the physical breakers is
							-- the best place to search for the puzzle display.
							puzzleRoot =
								puzzleRoot
								or root.Parent
								or room100
						end
					end
				end
			end

			local count = 0
			for _ in pairs(switchMap) do
				count += 1
			end

			if count < 5 then
				switchMap = {}
				switchRoots = {}
				puzzleRoot = nil
				return false
			end

			-- Expand to a panel/container ancestor that actually contains most
			-- mapped switches, while never leaving Room 100.
			local sample = next(switchRoots)
			if sample then
				local cursor = sample.Parent
				for _ = 1,6 do
					if not cursor or cursor == room100.Parent then
						break
					end

					local inside = 0
					for root in pairs(switchRoots) do
						if root:IsDescendantOf(cursor) then
							inside += 1
						end
					end

					if inside >= math.min(5,count) then
						puzzleRoot = cursor
					end

					if cursor == room100 then
						break
					end
					cursor = cursor.Parent
				end
			end

			return true
		end

		local function isUnderMappedSwitch(object)
			local cursor = object
			for _ = 1,8 do
				if not cursor or cursor == room100 then
					break
				end
				if switchRoots[cursor] then
					return true
				end
				cursor = cursor.Parent
			end
			return false
		end

		local function displayRelated(object)
			local cursor = object
			for _ = 1,7 do
				if not cursor or cursor == room100 then
					break
				end

				local name = compact(cursor.Name)
				if containsAny(name,{
					"display","screen","monitor","code","puzzle",
					"breaker","elevator","power","indicator"
				}) then
					return true
				end

				cursor = cursor.Parent
			end
			return false
		end

		local function readBoolState(object)
			if not object then
				return nil
			end

			for _,attributeName in ipairs({
				"TargetState",
				"DesiredState",
				"RequestedState",
				"State",
				"On",
				"Enabled",
				"Active"
			}) do
				local ok,value = pcall(function()
					return object:GetAttribute(attributeName)
				end)
				if ok and type(value) == "boolean" then
					return value
				end
			end

			for _,child in ipairs(object:GetChildren()) do
				if child:IsA("BoolValue") then
					local name = compact(child.Name)
					if containsAny(name,{
						"target","desired","request","state","on","active"
					}) then
						return child.Value
					end
				end
			end

			return nil
		end

		local function readDisplayStep()
			if not room100 then
				return nil,nil,nil
			end

			local searchRoot =
				puzzleRoot and puzzleRoot.Parent and puzzleRoot or room100

			local bestNumber = nil
			local bestScore = -math.huge
			local desired = readBoolState(searchRoot)
			local signatureParts = {}

			for _,object in ipairs(searchRoot:GetDescendants()) do
				if not isUnderMappedSwitch(object) then
					if object:IsA("TextLabel")
						or object:IsA("TextBox")
						or object:IsA("TextButton") then

						local raw = tostring(object.Text or "")
						local trimmed = string.match(raw,"^%s*(.-)%s*$") or raw

						if object.Visible ~= false and trimmed ~= "" then
							if displayRelated(object) then
								if #signatureParts < 8 then
									table.insert(signatureParts,compact(trimmed))
								end

								local number =
									string.match(trimmed,"^0*(%d+)$")
								number = tonumber(number)

								if number and number >= 1 and number <= 10 then
									local score = 5
									local parentName =
										compact(object.Parent and object.Parent.Name)
									if containsAny(parentName,{
										"display","screen","monitor",
										"code","indicator"
									}) then
										score += 5
									end

									if score > bestScore then
										bestScore = score
										bestNumber = number
									end
								end

								local lower = string.lower(trimmed)
								if string.find(lower,"off",1,true) then
									desired = false
								elseif string.find(lower,"on",1,true) then
									desired = true
								end
							end
						end
					elseif object:IsA("IntValue")
						or object:IsA("NumberValue")
						or object:IsA("StringValue") then

						local name = compact(object.Name)
						if containsAny(name,{
							"currentbreaker","currentswitch","currentnumber",
							"breakernumber","switchnumber","targetnumber"
						}) then
							local number = exactBreakerNumber(object.Value)
							if number then
								bestNumber = number
								bestScore = 20
								table.insert(
									signatureParts,
									name..":"..tostring(number)
								)
							end
						end
					elseif object:IsA("BoolValue") then
						local name = compact(object.Name)
						if containsAny(name,{
							"targetstate","desiredstate","requestedstate"
						}) then
							desired = object.Value
							table.insert(
								signatureParts,
								name..":"..tostring(object.Value)
							)
						end
					end
				end
			end

			for _,attributeName in ipairs({
				"CurrentBreaker",
				"CurrentSwitch",
				"CurrentNumber",
				"BreakerNumber",
				"SwitchNumber",
				"TargetNumber"
			}) do
				local ok,value = pcall(function()
					return searchRoot:GetAttribute(attributeName)
				end)
				if ok and value ~= nil then
					local number = exactBreakerNumber(value)
					if number then
						bestNumber = number
						bestScore = 30
						table.insert(
							signatureParts,
							attributeName..":"..tostring(number)
						)
						break
					end
				end
			end

			local signature =
				bestNumber
				and (
					tostring(bestNumber)
					..":"
					..tostring(desired)
					..":"
					..table.concat(signatureParts,"|")
				)
				or nil

			return bestNumber,desired,signature
		end

		local function activate(record)
			if not record
				or not record.interaction
				or not record.interaction.Parent then
				return false
			end

			if record.kind == "prompt" then
				local prompt = record.interaction

				if typeof(fireproximityprompt) == "function" then
					local ok = pcall(function()
						fireproximityprompt(prompt,0)
					end)
					if ok then
						return true
					end
				end

				local ok = pcall(function()
					local original = prompt.HoldDuration
					prompt.HoldDuration = 0
					prompt:InputHoldBegin()
					task.wait()
					prompt:InputHoldEnd()
					prompt.HoldDuration = original
				end)
				return ok
			end

			if record.kind == "click" then
				local click = record.interaction

				if typeof(fireclickdetector) == "function" then
					local ok = pcall(function()
						fireclickdetector(click)
					end)
					if ok then
						return true
					end
				end

				if typeof(firesignal) == "function" then
					local ok = pcall(function()
						firesignal(click.MouseClick,player)
					end)
					if ok then
						return true
					end
				end
			end

			return false
		end

		local function finishSolver()
			if completionSent then
				return
			end
			completionSent = true
			gui:SetAttribute("DoorsAutoElevatorPower",false)
			setToggle(autoPowerButton,false,"AUTO ELEVATOR POWER")
			setStatus("ELEVATOR POWER PUZZLE COMPLETED")
		end

		local function solverTick()
			if gui:GetAttribute("DoorsAutoElevatorPower") ~= true
				or not shooterSecurityAllowed() then
				return
			end

			local now = os.clock()

			-- V44: use the dedicated server completion path first. V43 only tried
			-- to infer the panel hierarchy, which is why it could do nothing.
			if tryDirectCompletion(now) then
				if remoteAttempts >= 4 then
					gui:SetAttribute("DoorsAutoElevatorPower",false)
					setToggle(
						autoPowerButton,
						false,
						"AUTO ELEVATOR POWER"
					)
					setStatus(
						"AUTO ELEVATOR POWER // COMPLETION REQUEST SENT"
					)
				end
				return
			end

			if not room100
				or not room100.Parent
				or not puzzleRoot
				or not puzzleRoot.Parent
				or next(switchMap) == nil
				or now-lastBuild >= 2.5 then
				buildSwitchMap()
			end

			if next(switchMap) == nil then
				if now-lastWaitingStatus >= 5 then
					lastWaitingStatus = now
					setStatus(
						"AUTO ELEVATOR POWER // WAITING FOR BREAKER PUZZLE"
					)
				end
				return
			end

			local number,desired,signature = readDisplayStep()

			if not number or not switchMap[number] then
				if startedPuzzle
					and now-lastSeenStepAt >= 1.25 then
					finishSolver()
				end
				return
			end

			startedPuzzle = true
			lastSeenStepAt = now

			if signature ~= lastSignature then
				lastSignature = signature
				attemptsForStep = 0
				lastAction = 0
			end

			if attemptsForStep >= 2 then
				-- If the same display is still stuck after two toggles, rebuild
				-- the switch map in case the game replaced a breaker instance.
				if now-lastAction >= .65 then
					buildSwitchMap()
					attemptsForStep = 0
					lastAction = 0
				end
				return
			end

			if now-lastAction < .22 then
				return
			end

			local record = switchMap[number]
			if activate(record) then
				attemptsForStep += 1
				lastAction = now

				-- If the desired ON/OFF state was replicated, expose it in the
				-- status text for debugging without creating extra notifications.
				if desired ~= nil then
					ui.status.Text =
						"AUTO POWER // BREAKER "
						..tostring(number)
						.." -> "
						..tostring(desired and "ON" or "OFF")
				else
					ui.status.Text =
						"AUTO POWER // BREAKER "..tostring(number)
				end
			else
				if now-lastWaitingStatus >= 3 then
					lastWaitingStatus = now
					setStatus(
						"AUTO POWER // INTERACTION METHOD NOT AVAILABLE"
					)
				end
			end
		end

		autoPowerButton.Activated:Connect(function()
			if not shooterSecurityAllowed() then
				gui:SetAttribute("DoorsAutoElevatorPower",false)
				autoPowerButton.Text = "AUTO ELEVATOR POWER [LOCKED]"
				setStatus("SET SHOOTER_ALLOWED_PLACE_ID TO YOUR GAME PLACEID")
				return
			end

			local enabled =
				gui:GetAttribute("DoorsAutoElevatorPower") == true
			enabled = not enabled
			gui:SetAttribute("DoorsAutoElevatorPower",enabled)
			setToggle(
				autoPowerButton,
				enabled,
				"AUTO ELEVATOR POWER"
			)

			if enabled then
				room100 = nil
				puzzleRoot = nil
				switchMap = {}
				switchRoots = {}
				lastBuild = 0
				lastAction = 0
				lastSeenStepAt = 0
				lastSignature = nil
				attemptsForStep = 0
				startedPuzzle = false
				completionSent = false
				directRemote = nil
				lastRemoteLookup = 0
				lastRemoteAttempt = 0
				remoteAttempts = 0
				directMethodAnnounced = false

				local now = os.clock()
				if not tryDirectCompletion(now) then
					buildSwitchMap()
				end
				setStatus("AUTO ELEVATOR POWER ON")
			else
				setStatus("AUTO ELEVATOR POWER OFF")
			end
		end)

		if shooterSecurityAllowed() then
			setToggle(
				autoPowerButton,
				false,
				"AUTO ELEVATOR POWER"
			)
		end

		trackAdvanced(
			RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(deltaTime)
				if not runtimeCore.allows("DOORS") then
					return
				end
				solverAccumulator += deltaTime
				if solverAccumulator < .08 then
					return
				end
				solverAccumulator = 0

				if menuDeleted or not gui.Parent then
					return
				end

				if gui:GetAttribute("DoorsAutoElevatorPower") == true then
					solverTick()
				end
			end)
		)

		gui.Destroying:Connect(function()
			gui:SetAttribute("DoorsAutoElevatorPower",false)
		end)
	end)()

	-- --------------------------------------------------------
	-- V97 DUPE DETECTOR // FLOOR 2 ZERO-LINE MODE
	-- Detects explicit Dupe names AND wrong/fake numbered doors using the same
	-- door-number logic already used by the safe Door Guide.
	-- Every distinct Dupe target gets a red label + highlight, NEVER a tracer.
	;(function()
		gui:SetAttribute("DoorsDupeGuide",false)
		gui:SetAttribute("DoorsDupeCount",0)

		local dupeToggleEvent =
			gui:FindFirstChild("NotRubyDoorsDupeToggle")
		if not dupeToggleEvent
			or not dupeToggleEvent:IsA("BindableEvent") then
			if dupeToggleEvent then
				dupeToggleEvent:Destroy()
			end
			dupeToggleEvent = Instance.new("BindableEvent")
			dupeToggleEvent.Name = "NotRubyDoorsDupeToggle"
			dupeToggleEvent.Parent = gui
		end

		local dupeGuideButton =
			makeAction(
				doorsGroup,
				shooterSecurityAllowed()
					and "DUPE GUIDE [OFF]"
					or "DUPE GUIDE [LOCKED]"
			)

		local records = {}
		local currentRoom = "--"
		local lastScan = 0
		local MAX_DUPES = 8

		local function explicitDupeName(object)
			if not object then
				return false
			end

			local lowerName = string.lower(tostring(object.Name or ""))
			return string.find(lowerName,"dupe",1,true) ~= nil
		end

		local function targetPartFor(object)
			if not object or not object.Parent then
				return nil
			end
			if object:IsA("BasePart") then
				return object
			end
			if object:IsA("Model") then
				return findDoorHitbox(object)
					or object.PrimaryPart
					or object:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart",true)
			end
			if object:IsA("Folder") then
				return object:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart",true)
			end
			return nil
		end

		local function canonicalTarget(object,activeRoom)
			if not object or not object.Parent then
				return nil
			end

			-- Prefer the highest Dupe-named container inside this room so a
			-- Dupe model and its Dupe-named parts do not create duplicate lines.
			local best = object
			local cursor = object.Parent
			for _ = 1,8 do
				if not cursor or cursor == activeRoom.Parent then
					break
				end
				if cursor == activeRoom then
					break
				end
				if (cursor:IsA("Model") or cursor:IsA("Folder"))
					and explicitDupeName(cursor) then
					best = cursor
				end
				cursor = cursor.Parent
			end

			return best
		end

		local function destroyRecord(target)
			local record = records[target]
			if not record then
				return
			end

			for _,object in ipairs({
				record.label,
				record.highlight
			}) do
				if object and object.Parent then
					object:Destroy()
				end
			end

			records[target] = nil
		end

		local function clearDupeVisuals()
			local targets = {}
			for target in pairs(records) do
				table.insert(targets,target)
			end
			for _,target in ipairs(targets) do
				destroyRecord(target)
			end
		end

		local function addRecord(target,part,index)
			if not target
				or not target.Parent
				or not part
				or not part.Parent
				or records[target] then
				return
			end

			local label = Instance.new("TextLabel")
			label.Name = "DupeGuideLabel_"..tostring(index or 1)
			label.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(.5,1)
			label.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(182,30)
			label.BackgroundColor3 = SURFACE
			label.BackgroundTransparency = .15
			label.BorderSizePixel = 0
			label.Text = "DUPE"
			label.TextSize = 9
			label.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBlack
			label.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255,205,210)
			label.Visible = false
			label.ZIndex = 718
			label.Parent = overlay
			corner(label,8)
			addStroke(label,Color3.fromRGB(255,74,82),1,.28)

			local highlight = Instance.new("Highlight")
			highlight.Name = "NotRubyDupeGuideHighlight_"..tostring(index or 1)
			highlight.DepthMode = Enum.HighlightDepthMode.AlwaysOnTop
			highlight.FillColor = Color3.fromRGB(255,74,82)
			highlight.OutlineColor = Color3.fromRGB(255,210,215)
			highlight.FillTransparency = .82
			highlight.OutlineTransparency = .03
			highlight.Adornee = target
			highlight.Enabled = true
			highlight.Parent = doorsOverlayFolder

			records[target] = {
				part = part,
				index = index or 1,
				label = label,
				highlight = highlight
			}
		end

		local function scanDupe()
			lastScan = os.clock()

			if gui:GetAttribute("DoorsDupeGuide") ~= true
				or not shooterSecurityAllowed() then
				clearDupeVisuals()
				gui:SetAttribute("DoorsDupeCount",0)
				currentRoom = "--"
				return
			end

			local currentRooms = getDoorsCurrentRooms()
			if not currentRooms then
				clearDupeVisuals()
				gui:SetAttribute("DoorsDupeCount",0)
				currentRoom = "--"
				return
			end

			local activeRoom = getActiveDoorsRoom(currentRooms)
			if not activeRoom then
				clearDupeVisuals()
				gui:SetAttribute("DoorsDupeCount",0)
				currentRoom = "--"
				return
			end

			local newRoom = tostring(activeRoom.Name)
			if currentRoom ~= "--" and currentRoom ~= newRoom then
				clearDupeVisuals()
			end
			currentRoom = newRoom

			local found = {}
			local candidates = {}
			local roomDescendants = activeRoom:GetDescendants()

			local function addCandidate(target,part,reason)
				if not target
					or not target.Parent
					or not part
					or not part.Parent
					or found[target] then
					return
				end

				found[target] = true
				table.insert(candidates,{
					target = target,
					part = part,
					reason = reason or "DUPE",
					distance = distanceFromLocalRoot(part)
				})
			end

			-- Method 1: explicit names used by the official game/remakes.
			for _,object in ipairs(roomDescendants) do
				if (
					object:IsA("Model")
					or object:IsA("BasePart")
					or object:IsA("Folder")
				)
					and explicitDupeName(object) then

					local target =
						canonicalTarget(
							object,
							activeRoom
						)
					local part =
						target
						and targetPartFor(target)
						or nil

					addCandidate(
						target,
						part,
						"DUPE NAME"
					)
				end
			end

			-- Method 2: actual fake/wrong doors. This catches Floor 2 Dupe
			-- even when the model is only named "Door".
			local activeRoomNumber = tonumber(activeRoom.Name)
			local expectedDoorNumber =
				activeRoomNumber
				and activeRoomNumber+1
				or nil

			for _,doorObject in ipairs(
				getDoorCandidates(
					activeRoom,
					roomDescendants
				)
			) do
				local hitbox = findDoorHitbox(doorObject)
				if hitbox then
					local displayedNumber =
						readDoorDisplayedNumber(
							doorObject,
							activeRoom,
							roomDescendants,
							hitbox,
							expectedDoorNumber
						)

					if isDoorsDupeDoor(
						doorObject,
						expectedDoorNumber,
						displayedNumber
					) then
						addCandidate(
							doorObject,
							hitbox,
							displayedNumber ~= nil
								and "WRONG DOOR "
									..tostring(displayedNumber)
								or "FAKE DOOR"
						)
					end
				end
			end

			table.sort(candidates,function(a,b)
				return a.distance < b.distance
			end)

			local keep = {}
			for index,candidate in ipairs(candidates) do
				if index > MAX_DUPES then
					break
				end

				keep[candidate.target] = true

				local record = records[candidate.target]
				if not record then
					addRecord(candidate.target,candidate.part,index)
					record = records[candidate.target]
				else
					record.part = candidate.part
					record.index = index
					record.highlight.Adornee = candidate.target
				end

				if record then
					record.reason =
						candidate.reason or "DUPE"
				end
			end

			gui:SetAttribute(
				"DoorsDupeCount",
				math.min(#candidates,MAX_DUPES)
			)

			local stale = {}
			for target in pairs(records) do
				if not target.Parent or not keep[target] then
					table.insert(stale,target)
				end
			end
			for _,target in ipairs(stale) do
				destroyRecord(target)
			end
		end

		local function updateDupeGuide()
			if gui:GetAttribute(
				"DoorsMinecartProtectionActive"
			) == true then
				for _,record in pairs(records) do
					record.label.Visible = false
					record.highlight.Enabled = false
				end
				return
			end

			if gui:GetAttribute("DoorsDupeGuide") ~= true
				or not shooterSecurityAllowed() then
				clearDupeVisuals()
				return
			end

			local currentRooms = getDoorsCurrentRooms()
			local activeRoom =
				currentRooms and getActiveDoorsRoom(currentRooms) or nil
			local roomName = activeRoom and tostring(activeRoom.Name) or "--"

			if roomName ~= currentRoom
				or os.clock()-lastScan >= .35 then
				scanDupe()
			end

			local ownRoot =
				player.Character
				and player.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

			if not ownRoot then
				for _,record in pairs(records) do
					record.label.Visible = false
					record.highlight.Enabled = false
				end
				return
			end

			local removeList = {}
			local visibleIndex = 0

			for target,record in pairs(records) do
				local part = targetPartFor(target)

				if not target.Parent
					or not part
					or not part.Parent
					or not activeRoom
					or not target:IsDescendantOf(activeRoom) then
					table.insert(removeList,target)
				else
					record.part = part

					local distance =
						math.floor((ownRoot.Position-part.Position).Magnitude+.5)

					if distance > state.doorsGuideMaxDistance then
						record.label.Visible = false
						record.highlight.Enabled = false
					else
						local endpoint = clampedGuidePoint(part)
						if not endpoint then
							record.label.Visible = false
							record.highlight.Enabled = false
						else
							visibleIndex += 1

							record.label.Position =
								UDim2.fromOffset(endpoint.X,endpoint.Y-8)
							record.label.Text =
								"DUPE "
								..tostring(record.index or visibleIndex)
								.." // "
								..tostring(record.reason or "FAKE DOOR")
								.." // ROOM "
								..tostring(currentRoom)
								.." // "
								..tostring(distance)
								.." studs"
							record.label.Visible = true

							record.highlight.Adornee = target
							record.highlight.Enabled = true
						end
					end
				end
			end

			for _,target in ipairs(removeList) do
				destroyRecord(target)
			end
		end

		local function refreshDupeGuideButton()
			if not dupeGuideButton
				or not dupeGuideButton.Parent then
				return
			end

			if not shooterSecurityAllowed() then
				dupeGuideButton.Text =
					"DUPE GUIDE [LOCKED]"
				return
			end

			setToggle(
				dupeGuideButton,
				gui:GetAttribute("DoorsDupeGuide") == true,
				"DUPE GUIDE"
			)
		end

		local function toggleDupeGuide()
			if not shooterSecurityAllowed() then
				gui:SetAttribute("DoorsDupeGuide",false)
				refreshDupeGuideButton()
				setStatus(
					"SET SHOOTER_ALLOWED_PLACE_ID TO YOUR GAME PLACEID"
				)
				clearDupeVisuals()
				gui:SetAttribute("DoorsDupeCount",0)
				return
			end

			local enabled =
				gui:GetAttribute("DoorsDupeGuide") == true
			enabled = not enabled
			gui:SetAttribute("DoorsDupeGuide",enabled)
			refreshDupeGuideButton()

			if enabled then
				currentRoom = "--"
				scanDupe()
				updateDupeGuide()
				setStatus(
					"DUPE DETECTION ON // RED HIGHLIGHT + LABEL // NO LINE"
				)
			else
				clearDupeVisuals()
				gui:SetAttribute("DoorsDupeCount",0)
				currentRoom = "--"
				setStatus("DUPE DETECTION OFF")
			end
		end

		dupeGuideButton.Activated:Connect(
			toggleDupeGuide
		)
		dupeToggleEvent.Event:Connect(
			toggleDupeGuide
		)

		gui:GetAttributeChangedSignal(
			"DoorsDupeGuide"
		):Connect(function()
			refreshDupeGuideButton()
		end)

		refreshDupeGuideButton()

		local accumulator = 0
		trackAdvanced(
			RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function(deltaTime)
			if not runtimeCore.allows("DOORS") then
				return
			end
				accumulator += deltaTime
				if accumulator < .18 then
					return
				end
				accumulator = 0

				if menuDeleted or not gui.Parent then
					return
				end

				if gui:GetAttribute("DoorsDupeGuide") == true then
					updateDupeGuide()
				else
					clearDupeVisuals()
				end
			end)
		)

		gui.Destroying:Connect(function()
			gui:SetAttribute("DoorsDupeGuide",false)
			gui:SetAttribute("DoorsDupeCount",0)
			clearDupeVisuals()
		end)
	end)()

	-- --------------------------------------------------------
	-- DOORS MONSTER ESP // STRICT ENTITY-ONLY REMAKE
	-- Name/type whitelist only. No generic "monster", "entity", "enemy",
	-- "hostile", Locust words, Humanoid fallback, or broad boolean attributes.
	-- This prevents furniture, room models, effects, NPC helpers and other
	-- unrelated objects from being marked as DOORS monsters.
	;(function()
		gui:SetAttribute("DoorsMonsterEsp",false)

		local monsterEspButton =
			makeAction(
				doorsGroup,
				shooterSecurityAllowed()
					and "MONSTER ESP [OFF]"
					or "MONSTER ESP [LOCKED]"
			)

		local espFolder = Instance.new("Folder")
		espFolder.Name = "NotRubyDoorsMonsterESP"
		espFolder.Parent = workspace

		local records = {}
		local scanClock = 0
		local updateClock = 0
		local MAX_MONSTERS = 20

		local ENTITY_ORDER = {
			{"sally","SALLY"},
			{"rush","RUSH"},
			{"ambush","AMBUSH"},
			{"screech","SCREECH"},
			{"seek","SEEK"},
			{"figure","FIGURE"},
			{"halt","HALT"},
			{"eyes","EYES"},
			{"snare","SNARE"},
			{"giggle","GIGGLE"},
			{"grumble","GRUMBLE"},
			{"dread","DREAD"},
			{"timothy","TIMOTHY"},
			{"jack","JACK"},
			{"shadow","SHADOW"},
			{"gloombat","GLOOMBAT"},
			{"lookman","LOOKMAN"},
			{"blitz","BLITZ"},
			{"vacuum","VACUUM"},
			{"haste","HASTE"},
			{"a60","A-60"},
			{"a90","A-90"},
			{"a120","A-120"}
		}

		local SAFE_SUFFIXES = {
			"",
			"moving",
			"entity",
			"model",
			"rig",
			"new",
			"npc",
			"monster",
			"main",
			"root"
		}

		local function compactName(value)
			return string.lower(
				string.gsub(tostring(value or ""),"[^%w]","")
			)
		end

		local function matchesBase(compact,base)
			if compact == "" then
				return false
			end

			for _,suffix in ipairs(SAFE_SUFFIXES) do
				if compact == base..suffix then
					return true
				end
			end

			-- Allow only a pure numeric instance suffix such as Rush1/Rush02.
			if string.sub(compact,1,#base) == base then
				local suffix = string.sub(compact,#base+1)
				if suffix ~= "" and string.match(suffix,"^%d+$") then
					return true
				end
			end

			return false
		end

		local function classifyStrictName(value)
			local compact = compactName(value)

			-- Known plural/alternate forms.
			if compact == "gloombats" then
				return "GLOOMBAT"
			end

			for _,entry in ipairs(ENTITY_ORDER) do
				if matchesBase(compact,entry[1]) then
					return entry[2]
				end
			end

			return nil
		end

		local function classifyExplicitType(model)
			if not model or not model:IsA("Model") then
				return nil
			end

			-- Actual model Name has priority.
			local byName = classifyStrictName(model.Name)
			if byName then
				return byName
			end

			-- Some remakes keep the model name generic but expose a STRING type.
			-- Only accept it when the string itself matches the strict whitelist.
			for _,attributeName in ipairs({
				"EntityName",
				"EntityType",
				"MonsterName",
				"MonsterType"
			}) do
				local ok,value = pcall(function()
					return model:GetAttribute(attributeName)
				end)

				if ok and type(value) == "string" then
					local kind = classifyStrictName(value)
					if kind then
						return kind
					end
				end
			end

			return nil
		end

		local function isLocalFake(object)
			local cursor = object
			for _ = 1,10 do
				if not cursor or cursor == workspace then
					break
				end

				if cursor:GetAttribute("NotRubyFakeEntity") == true then
					return true
				end

				cursor = cursor.Parent
			end

			return false
		end

		local function resolveMonster(object)
			if not object or not object.Parent or isLocalFake(object) then
				return nil,nil
			end

			local cursor = object
			local candidate = nil
			local candidateKind = nil
			local candidateDepth = -1

			-- Inspect nearby ancestry. If an inner helper is Rush but the outer
			-- actual entity is Sally, Sally ALWAYS wins.
			for depth = 1,12 do
				if not cursor or cursor == workspace then
					break
				end

				if cursor:IsA("Model") then
					if Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(cursor) then
						return nil,nil
					end

					if cursor:GetAttribute("NotRubyFakeEntity") == true then
						return nil,nil
					end

					local kind = classifyExplicitType(cursor)
					if kind == "SALLY" then
						return cursor,"SALLY"
					end

					if kind then
						-- For nested models of the same monster, prefer the outer
						-- recognized root rather than a small internal helper model.
						if not candidate
							or kind == candidateKind
							or depth > candidateDepth then
							candidate = cursor
							candidateKind = kind
							candidateDepth = depth
						end
					end
				end

				cursor = cursor.Parent
			end

			return candidate,candidateKind
		end

		local function monsterPart(model)
			if not model or not model.Parent then
				return nil
			end

			return model.PrimaryPart
				or model:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
				or model:FindFirstChild("Root")
				or model:FindFirstChild("Hitbox")
				or model:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart",true)
		end

		local function destroyRecord(model)
			local record = records[model]
			if not record then
				return
			end

			for _,object in ipairs({
				record.highlight,
				record.billboard,
				record.line
			}) do
				if object and object.Parent then
					object:Destroy()
				end
			end

			records[model] = nil
		end

		local function clearAll()
			local models = {}
			for model in pairs(records) do
				table.insert(models,model)
			end

			for _,model in ipairs(models) do
				destroyRecord(model)
			end
		end

		local function addMonster(model,kind)
			if not model
				or not model.Parent
				or records[model]
				or isLocalFake(model)
				or not kind then
				return
			end

			local part = monsterPart(model)
			if not part then
				return
			end

			local count = 0
			for _ in pairs(records) do
				count += 1
			end

			if count >= MAX_MONSTERS then
				return
			end

			local highlight = Instance.new("Highlight")
			highlight.Name = "NotRubyMonsterESPHighlight"
			highlight.DepthMode = Enum.HighlightDepthMode.AlwaysOnTop
			highlight.FillColor = Color3.fromRGB(255,55,65)
			highlight.OutlineColor = Color3.fromRGB(255,210,215)
			highlight.FillTransparency = .78
			highlight.OutlineTransparency = .02
			highlight.Adornee = model
			highlight.Parent = espFolder

			local billboard = Instance.new("BillboardGui")
			billboard.Name = "NotRubyMonsterESPLabel"
			billboard.Adornee = part
			billboard.AlwaysOnTop = true
			billboard.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(190,36)
			billboard.StudsOffset = Vector3.new(0,3.1,0)
			billboard.MaxDistance = state.doorsGuideMaxDistance
			billboard.Parent = part

			local label = Instance.new("TextLabel")
			label.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1,1)
			label.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(34,12,18)
			label.BackgroundTransparency = .16
			label.BorderSizePixel = 0
			label.Text = "MONSTER // "..kind
			label.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255,225,228)
			label.TextSize = 9
			label.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBlack
			label.Parent = billboard
			corner(label,8)
			addStroke(label,Color3.fromRGB(255,55,65),1,.22)

			local line = Instance.new("Frame")
			line.Name = "NotRubyMonsterESPLine"
			line.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255,55,65)
			line.BorderSizePixel = 0
			line.Visible = false
			line.ZIndex = 719
			line.Parent = overlay
			corner(line,1000)

			records[model] = {
				part = part,
				kind = kind,
				highlight = highlight,
				billboard = billboard,
				label = label,
				line = line
			}
		end

		local function scan()
			scanClock = os.clock()

			if gui:GetAttribute("DoorsMonsterEsp") ~= true
				or not shooterSecurityAllowed() then
				return
			end

			local found = {}
			local count = 0

			-- Model-only scan. No generic attributes, no Humanoid fallback,
			-- and no generic "monster/entity/enemy/hostile" name matching.
			for _,object in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
				if object:IsA("Model") then
					local monster,kind = resolveMonster(object)

					if monster
						and kind
						and not found[monster]
						and not isLocalFake(monster) then
						found[monster] = kind
						count += 1
						addMonster(monster,kind)

						if count >= MAX_MONSTERS then
							break
						end
					end
				end
			end

			local stale = {}
			for model,record in pairs(records) do
				local newKind = found[model]
				if not model.Parent or not newKind then
					table.insert(stale,model)
				elseif record.kind ~= newKind then
					record.kind = newKind
				end
			end

			for _,model in ipairs(stale) do
				destroyRecord(model)
			end
		end

		local function update()
			if gui:GetAttribute("DoorsMonsterEsp") ~= true
				or not shooterSecurityAllowed() then
				clearAll()
				return
			end

			camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
			local ownRoot =
				player.Character
				and player.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

			if not camera or not ownRoot then
				return
			end

			local remove = {}

			for model,record in pairs(records) do
				local part = monsterPart(model)

				if not model.Parent
					or not part
					or not part.Parent
					or isLocalFake(model) then
					table.insert(remove,model)
				else
					record.part = part
					record.billboard.Adornee = part
					record.billboard.MaxDistance = state.doorsGuideMaxDistance

					local distance =
						math.floor((ownRoot.Position-part.Position).Magnitude+.5)

					record.label.Text =
						"MONSTER // "
						..tostring(record.kind or "UNKNOWN")
						.." // "
						..tostring(distance)
						.." studs"

					local visible = distance <= state.doorsGuideMaxDistance
					record.highlight.Enabled = visible
					record.billboard.Enabled = visible

					if visible then
						local endpoint = clampedGuidePoint(part)

						if endpoint then
							local viewport = camera.ViewportSize
							local startPoint =
								Vector2.new(viewport.X*.5,viewport.Y*.86)

							setScreenLine(record.line,startPoint,endpoint,2)
							record.line.BackgroundColor3 =
								Color3.fromRGB(255,55,65)
							record.line.Visible = true
						else
							record.line.Visible = false
						end
					else
						record.line.Visible = false
					end
				end
			end

			for _,model in ipairs(remove) do
				destroyRecord(model)
			end
		end

		monsterEspButton.Activated:Connect(function()
			if not shooterSecurityAllowed() then
				gui:SetAttribute("DoorsMonsterEsp",false)
				monsterEspButton.Text = "MONSTER ESP [LOCKED]"
				setStatus("SET SHOOTER_ALLOWED_PLACE_ID TO YOUR GAME PLACEID")
				clearAll()
				return
			end

			local enabled = gui:GetAttribute("DoorsMonsterEsp") == true
			enabled = not enabled
			gui:SetAttribute("DoorsMonsterEsp",enabled)
			setToggle(monsterEspButton,enabled,"MONSTER ESP")

			if enabled then
				scan()
				update()
				setStatus("DOORS MONSTER ESP ON // STRICT ENTITIES ONLY")
			else
				clearAll()
				setStatus("DOORS MONSTER ESP OFF")
			end
		end)

		if shooterSecurityAllowed() then
			setToggle(monsterEspButton,false,"MONSTER ESP")
		end

		trackAdvanced(
			workspace.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(object)
				if not runtimeCore.allows("DOORS") then
					return
				end
				if gui:GetAttribute("DoorsMonsterEsp") ~= true then
					return
				end

				if not (
					object:IsA("Model")
					or object:IsA("BasePart")
					or object:IsA("Folder")
				) then
					return
				end

				task.delay(.12,function()
					if object
						and object.Parent
						and gui:GetAttribute("DoorsMonsterEsp") == true then
						local monster,kind = resolveMonster(object)
						if monster and kind then
							addMonster(monster,kind)
						end
					end
				end)
			end)
		)

		trackAdvanced(
			RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function(deltaTime)
			if not runtimeCore.allows("DOORS") then
				return
			end
				updateClock += deltaTime
				if updateClock < .1 then
					return
				end

				updateClock = 0

				if menuDeleted or not gui.Parent then
					return
				end

				if gui:GetAttribute("DoorsMonsterEsp") == true then
					if os.clock()-scanClock >= .65 then
						scan()
					end

					update()
				end
			end)
		)

		gui.Destroying:Connect(function()
			gui:SetAttribute("DoorsMonsterEsp",false)
			clearAll()

			if espFolder and espFolder.Parent then
				espFolder:Destroy()
			end
		end)
	end)()

	-- --------------------------------------------------------
	-- LIBRARY BOOK ESP // LOW-LAG + CODE SOLVER
	-- Event-driven/current-room book tracking. Avoids rescanning six rooms every
	-- 0.8 seconds. Once the game's library hint UI has all required digits, the
	-- solver reads the completed hint slots and immediately shows the code.
	;(function()
		gui:SetAttribute("DoorsLibraryBookEsp",false)
		gui:SetAttribute("DoorsLibraryCode","")

		local bookEspButton =
			makeAction(
				doorsGroup,
				shooterSecurityAllowed()
					and "LIBRARY BOOK ESP [OFF]"
					or "LIBRARY BOOK ESP [LOCKED]"
			)

		local bookFolder = Instance.new("Folder")
		bookFolder.Name = "NotRubyLibraryBookESP"
		bookFolder.Parent = workspace

		local codeBanner = Instance.new("TextLabel")
		codeBanner.Name = "NotRubyLibraryCodeBanner"
		codeBanner.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(.5,0)
		codeBanner.Position = UDim2.new(.5,0,0,88)
		codeBanner.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(260,38)
		codeBanner.BackgroundColor3 = SURFACE
		codeBanner.BackgroundTransparency = .08
		codeBanner.BorderSizePixel = 0
		codeBanner.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBlack
		codeBanner.TextSize = 12
		codeBanner.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(210,175,255)
		codeBanner.Text = "LIBRARY CODE // -----"
		codeBanner.Visible = false
		codeBanner.ZIndex = 725
		codeBanner.Parent = overlay
		corner(codeBanner,10)
		addStroke(codeBanner,Color3.fromRGB(185,130,255),1.2,.16)

		local records = {}
		local activeRoom = nil
		local lastFullScan = 0
		local lastCodeScan = 0
		local visualAccumulator = 0
		local lastAnnouncedCode = nil
		local MAX_BOOKS = 12

		local strongBookTokens = {
			"livehintbook",
			"figurebook",
			"hintbook",
			"bookpickup"
		}

		local function compactName(value)
			return string.lower(
				string.gsub(tostring(value or ""),"[^%w]","")
			)
		end

		local function strongBookName(value)
			local compact = compactName(value)
			if compact == "" then
				return false
			end

			for _,token in ipairs(strongBookTokens) do
				if compact == token
					or string.sub(compact,1,#token) == token
					or string.sub(compact,-#token) == token then
					return true
				end
			end
			return false
		end

		local function promptLooksLikeLibraryBook(prompt)
			if not prompt or not prompt:IsA("ProximityPrompt") then
				return false
			end

			if strongBookName(prompt.ObjectText)
				or strongBookName(prompt.Parent and prompt.Parent.Name) then
				return true
			end

			local parent = prompt.Parent
			local parentCompact = compactName(parent and parent.Name)
			local objectCompact = compactName(prompt.ObjectText)
			if parentCompact == "book" or objectCompact == "book" then
				local action = string.lower(tostring(prompt.ActionText or ""))
				return string.find(action,"pick",1,true) ~= nil
					or string.find(action,"take",1,true) ~= nil
					or string.find(action,"collect",1,true) ~= nil
					or string.find(action,"grab",1,true) ~= nil
					or action == ""
			end

			return false
		end

		local function rootFromPrompt(prompt)
			if not promptLooksLikeLibraryBook(prompt) then
				return nil
			end

			local cursor = prompt.Parent
			local nearestPart = nil

			for _ = 1,7 do
				if not cursor or cursor == workspace then
					break
				end

				if cursor:IsA("BasePart") then
					nearestPart = nearestPart or cursor
					if strongBookName(cursor.Name)
						or compactName(cursor.Name) == "book" then
						return cursor
					end
				elseif cursor:IsA("Model") then
					if strongBookName(cursor.Name)
						or compactName(cursor.Name) == "book" then
						return cursor
					end
				end

				cursor = cursor.Parent
			end

			return nearestPart
		end

		local function partFor(root)
			if not root or not root.Parent then
				return nil
			end
			if root:IsA("BasePart") then
				return root
			end
			if root:IsA("Model") then
				return root.PrimaryPart
					or root:FindFirstChild("Handle",true)
					or root:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart",true)
			end
			return nil
		end

		local function findBookPrompt(root)
			if not root or not root.Parent then
				return nil
			end

			if root:IsA("BasePart") then
				local direct = root:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("ProximityPrompt")
				if direct and promptLooksLikeLibraryBook(direct) then
					return direct
				end
			end

			for _,descendant in ipairs(root:GetDescendants()) do
				if descendant:IsA("ProximityPrompt")
					and promptLooksLikeLibraryBook(descendant) then
					return descendant
				end
			end

			return nil
		end

		local function remove(root)
			local record = records[root]
			if not record then
				return
			end

			if record.triggerConnection then
				pcall(function()
					record.triggerConnection:Disconnect()
				end)
			end

			for _,object in ipairs({
				record.highlight,
				record.billboard,
				record.line
			}) do
				if object and object.Parent then
					object:Destroy()
				end
			end

			records[root] = nil
		end

		local function clearBooks()
			local roots = {}
			for root in pairs(records) do
				table.insert(roots,root)
			end
			for _,root in ipairs(roots) do
				remove(root)
			end
		end

		local function exactFiveDigits(value)
			local raw = tostring(value or "")
			local exact = string.match(raw,"^%s*(%d%d%d%d%d)%s*$")
			if exact then
				return exact
			end

			-- Also accept a clearly labeled code embedded in a short string.
			if #raw <= 64 then
				local labeled =
					string.match(
						string.lower(raw),
						"code[^%d]*(%d%d%d%d%d)"
					)
				if labeled then
					return labeled
				end
			end

			return nil
		end

		local function hintName(value)
			local compact = compactName(value)
			return string.find(compact,"hint",1,true) ~= nil
				or string.find(compact,"solution",1,true) ~= nil
				or string.find(compact,"padlock",1,true) ~= nil
				or string.find(compact,"librarycode",1,true) ~= nil
				or string.find(compact,"libraryhint",1,true) ~= nil
				or compact == "paper"
				or compact == "hints"
		end

		local function guiBelongsToLibraryHint(object)
			local cursor = object
			for _ = 1,8 do
				if not cursor or cursor == playerGui then
					break
				end
				if hintName(cursor.Name) then
					return true
				end
				cursor = cursor.Parent
			end
			return false
		end

		local function digitFromGuiObject(object)
			if not object then
				return nil
			end

			if object:IsA("TextLabel") or object:IsA("TextBox") then
				local textValue = tostring(object.Text or "")
				local digit = string.match(textValue,"^%s*(%d)%s*$")
				if digit then
					return digit
				end
			end

			return nil
		end

		local function directCodeFromGui()
			-- First preference: a direct 5-digit value/text under a hint/code UI.
			for _,object in ipairs(playerGui:GetDescendants()) do
				if guiBelongsToLibraryHint(object) then
					if object:IsA("TextLabel") or object:IsA("TextBox") then
						local code = exactFiveDigits(object.Text)
						if code then
							return code
						end
					elseif object:IsA("StringValue")
						or object:IsA("IntValue")
						or object:IsA("NumberValue") then
						local code = exactFiveDigits(object.Value)
						if code then
							return code
						end
					end
				end
			end

			return nil
		end

		local function slotCodeFromGui()
			-- The library paper/hint UI normally presents the required symbols as
			-- ordered slots. Once every required slot has a digit, sort those digit
			-- labels by LayoutOrder / screen position and join the first five.
			local candidates = {}

			for _,object in ipairs(playerGui:GetDescendants()) do
				if object:IsA("GuiObject")
					and hintName(object.Name) then
					table.insert(candidates,object)
				end
			end

			for _,container in ipairs(candidates) do
				local digits = {}

				for _,descendant in ipairs(container:GetDescendants()) do
					local digit = digitFromGuiObject(descendant)
					if digit then
						table.insert(digits,{
							digit = digit,
							layout =
								descendant:IsA("GuiObject")
								and descendant.LayoutOrder
								or 0,
							x =
								descendant:IsA("GuiObject")
								and descendant.AbsolutePosition.X
								or 0,
							y =
								descendant:IsA("GuiObject")
								and descendant.AbsolutePosition.Y
								or 0
						})
					end
				end

				if #digits == 5 then
					table.sort(digits,function(a,b)
						if a.layout ~= b.layout
							and (a.layout ~= 0 or b.layout ~= 0) then
							return a.layout < b.layout
						end
						if math.abs(a.y-b.y) > 8 then
							return a.y < b.y
						end
						return a.x < b.x
					end)

					local code = ""
					for index = 1,5 do
						code ..= digits[index].digit
					end

					if #code == 5 then
						return code
					end
				end
			end

			return nil
		end

		local function codeFromStrongValues()
			local roots = {player,playerGui,activeRoom}

			for _,rootObject in ipairs(roots) do
				if rootObject then
					for name,value in pairs(rootObject:GetAttributes()) do
						if hintName(name)
							or string.find(compactName(name),"code",1,true) then
							local code = exactFiveDigits(value)
							if code then
								return code
							end
						end
					end

					for _,child in ipairs(rootObject:GetChildren()) do
						if hintName(child.Name)
							or string.find(compactName(child.Name),"code",1,true) then
							if child:IsA("StringValue")
								or child:IsA("IntValue")
								or child:IsA("NumberValue") then
								local code = exactFiveDigits(child.Value)
								if code then
									return code
								end
							end
						end
					end
				end
			end

			return nil
		end

		local function announceCode(code)
			if not code or #code ~= 5 then
				return
			end

			gui:SetAttribute("DoorsLibraryCode",code)
			codeBanner.Text = "LIBRARY CODE // "..code
			codeBanner.Visible = true

			if lastAnnouncedCode ~= code then
				lastAnnouncedCode = code
				setStatus("LIBRARY CODE // "..code)
			end
		end

		local function trySolveCode()
			if gui:GetAttribute("DoorsLibraryBookEsp") ~= true
				or not shooterSecurityAllowed() then
				return
			end

			lastCodeScan = os.clock()

			local code =
				directCodeFromGui()
				or slotCodeFromGui()
				or codeFromStrongValues()

			if code then
				announceCode(code)
			end
		end

		local function solveBurst()
			for _,delayTime in ipairs({.05,.18,.45,.9}) do
				task.delay(delayTime,function()
					if gui:GetAttribute("DoorsLibraryBookEsp") == true
						and gui.Parent
						and not menuDeleted then
						trySolveCode()
					end
				end)
			end
		end

		local function add(root)
			if not root or not root.Parent or records[root] then
				return
			end

			local part = partFor(root)
			local prompt = findBookPrompt(root)
			if not part or not prompt then
				return
			end

			local count = 0
			for _ in pairs(records) do
				count += 1
			end
			if count >= MAX_BOOKS then
				return
			end

			local color = Color3.fromRGB(185,130,255)

			local highlight = Instance.new("Highlight")
			highlight.Name = "NotRubyLibraryBookHighlight"
			highlight.Adornee = root
			highlight.DepthMode = Enum.HighlightDepthMode.AlwaysOnTop
			highlight.FillColor = color
			highlight.OutlineColor = Color3.fromRGB(235,215,255)
			highlight.FillTransparency = .76
			highlight.OutlineTransparency = .02
			highlight.Parent = bookFolder

			local billboard = Instance.new("BillboardGui")
			billboard.Name = "NotRubyLibraryBookLabel"
			billboard.Adornee = part
			billboard.AlwaysOnTop = true
			billboard.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(190,32)
			billboard.StudsOffset = Vector3.new(0,2,0)
			billboard.MaxDistance = state.doorsGuideMaxDistance
			billboard.Parent = part

			local label = Instance.new("TextLabel")
			label.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1,1)
			label.BackgroundColor3 = SURFACE
			label.BackgroundTransparency = .18
			label.BorderSizePixel = 0
			label.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBlack
			label.TextSize = 9
			label.TextColor3 = color
			label.Text = "LIBRARY BOOK"
			label.Parent = billboard
			corner(label,8)
			addStroke(label,color,1,.25)

			local line = Instance.new("Frame")
			line.Name = "NotRubyLibraryBookLine"
			line.BackgroundColor3 = color
			line.BackgroundTransparency = .12
			line.BorderSizePixel = 0
			line.Visible = false
			line.ZIndex = 720
			line.Parent = overlay
			corner(line,1000)

			local triggerConnection =
				prompt.Triggered:Connect(function()
					-- The game updates its hint UI right after the book is taken.
					-- Read it in a short burst instead of polling every frame.
					solveBurst()
				end)

			records[root] = {
				part = part,
				prompt = prompt,
				highlight = highlight,
				billboard = billboard,
				label = label,
				line = line,
				color = color,
				triggerConnection = triggerConnection
			}
		end

		local function processPrompt(prompt)
			if not prompt
				or not prompt:IsA("ProximityPrompt")
				or not prompt.Parent
				or not activeRoom
				or not prompt:IsDescendantOf(activeRoom)
				or not promptLooksLikeLibraryBook(prompt) then
				return
			end

			local root = rootFromPrompt(prompt)
			if root then
				add(root)
			end
		end

		local function scanActiveRoom(force)
			if gui:GetAttribute("DoorsLibraryBookEsp") ~= true
				or not shooterSecurityAllowed() then
				return
			end

			local currentRooms = getDoorsCurrentRooms()
			local newRoom =
				currentRooms and getActiveDoorsRoom(currentRooms) or nil

			if newRoom ~= activeRoom then
				activeRoom = newRoom
				clearBooks()
				lastAnnouncedCode = nil
				gui:SetAttribute("DoorsLibraryCode","")
				codeBanner.Visible = false
				force = true
			end

			if not activeRoom then
				return
			end

			local now = os.clock()
			if not force and now-lastFullScan < 5 then
				return
			end
			lastFullScan = now

			local found = {}

			-- Low-lag scan: inspect ONLY ProximityPrompts in the CURRENT room.
			-- No six-room sweep and no BasePart/Model classification pass.
			for _,object in ipairs(activeRoom:GetDescendants()) do
				if object:IsA("ProximityPrompt")
					and promptLooksLikeLibraryBook(object) then
					local root = rootFromPrompt(object)
					if root and not found[root] then
						found[root] = true
						add(root)
					end
				end
			end

			local stale = {}
			for root,record in pairs(records) do
				if not root.Parent
					or not found[root]
					or not record.prompt
					or not record.prompt.Parent then
					table.insert(stale,root)
				end
			end

			for _,root in ipairs(stale) do
				remove(root)
			end
		end

		local function updateVisuals()
			if gui:GetAttribute("DoorsLibraryBookEsp") ~= true
				or not shooterSecurityAllowed() then
				clearBooks()
				codeBanner.Visible = false
				return
			end

			scanActiveRoom(false)

			camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
			local ownRoot =
				player.Character
				and player.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
			if not camera or not ownRoot then
				return
			end

			local removeList = {}

			for root,record in pairs(records) do
				local part = partFor(root)
				local prompt = record.prompt

				if not root.Parent
					or not part
					or not part.Parent
					or not prompt
					or not prompt.Parent
					or (activeRoom and not root:IsDescendantOf(activeRoom)) then
					table.insert(removeList,root)
				else
					record.part = part
					record.billboard.Adornee = part
					record.billboard.MaxDistance = state.doorsGuideMaxDistance

					local distance =
						math.floor((ownRoot.Position-part.Position).Magnitude+.5)

					record.label.Text =
						"LIBRARY BOOK // "
						..tostring(distance)
						.." studs"

					local visible = distance <= state.doorsGuideMaxDistance
					record.highlight.Enabled = visible
					record.billboard.Enabled = visible

					if visible then
						local endpoint = clampedGuidePoint(part)
						if endpoint then
							local viewport = camera.ViewportSize
							local startPoint =
								Vector2.new(viewport.X*.5,viewport.Y*.86)
							setScreenLine(record.line,startPoint,endpoint,2)
							record.line.BackgroundColor3 = record.color
							record.line.Visible = true
						else
							record.line.Visible = false
						end
					else
						record.line.Visible = false
					end
				end
			end

			for _,root in ipairs(removeList) do
				remove(root)
			end

			-- Lightweight fallback in case a collected-book GUI update happened
			-- without a local Prompt.Triggered event.
			if os.clock()-lastCodeScan >= 1.5 then
				trySolveCode()
			end
		end

		bookEspButton.Activated:Connect(function()
			if not shooterSecurityAllowed() then
				gui:SetAttribute("DoorsLibraryBookEsp",false)
				bookEspButton.Text = "LIBRARY BOOK ESP [LOCKED]"
				setStatus("SET SHOOTER_ALLOWED_PLACE_ID TO YOUR GAME PLACEID")
				clearBooks()
				codeBanner.Visible = false
				return
			end

			local enabled =
				gui:GetAttribute("DoorsLibraryBookEsp") == true
			enabled = not enabled
			gui:SetAttribute("DoorsLibraryBookEsp",enabled)
			setToggle(bookEspButton,enabled,"LIBRARY BOOK ESP")

			if enabled then
				activeRoom = nil
				lastFullScan = 0
				lastCodeScan = 0
				scanActiveRoom(true)
				trySolveCode()
				setStatus("DOORS LIBRARY BOOK ESP ON // LOW-LAG")
			else
				clearBooks()
				activeRoom = nil
				codeBanner.Visible = false
				gui:SetAttribute("DoorsLibraryCode","")
				setStatus("DOORS LIBRARY BOOK ESP OFF")
			end
		end)

		if shooterSecurityAllowed() then
			setToggle(bookEspButton,false,"LIBRARY BOOK ESP")
		end

		trackAdvanced(
			workspace.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(object)
				if not runtimeCore.allows("DOORS") then
					return
				end
				if gui:GetAttribute("DoorsLibraryBookEsp") ~= true
					or not object:IsA("ProximityPrompt") then
					return
				end

				task.defer(function()
					if object
						and object.Parent
						and gui:GetAttribute("DoorsLibraryBookEsp") == true then
						processPrompt(object)
					end
				end)
			end)
		)

		trackAdvanced(
			RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(deltaTime)
				if not runtimeCore.allows("DOORS") then
					return
				end
				visualAccumulator += deltaTime
				if visualAccumulator < .25 then
					return
				end
				visualAccumulator = 0

				if menuDeleted or not gui.Parent then
					return
				end

				if gui:GetAttribute("DoorsLibraryBookEsp") == true then
					updateVisuals()
				end
			end)
		)

		gui.Destroying:Connect(function()
			gui:SetAttribute("DoorsLibraryBookEsp",false)
			gui:SetAttribute("DoorsLibraryCode","")
			clearBooks()
			codeBanner.Visible = false
			if bookFolder and bookFolder.Parent then
				bookFolder:Destroy()
			end
		end)
	end)()

	-- CRUCIFIX LAB // LOCAL-ONLY REMAKE.
	-- Real DOORS entities are intentionally ignored. The Crucifix can banish
	-- locally spawned fake entities and visually crucifix objects inside
	-- workspace.CurrentRooms (doors, keys, furniture, room geometry, etc.).
	-- The whole lab lives in its own function/register scope so the large
	-- DOORS module does not hit Luau's 200-local register limit again.
	;(function()
		gui:SetAttribute("DoorsCrucifixAnything",false)

		makeSection(
			doorsGroup,
			"FAKE ENTITY + CRUCIFIX LAB",
			"Spawn idle local fake entities where you are facing. Crucifix ignores real entities and works on the fakes plus doors, keys and room objects you aim at."
		)

		local fakeRushButton,fakeAmbushButton =
			makePair(doorsGroup,"SPAWN FAKE RUSH","SPAWN FAKE AMBUSH")
		local fakeFigureButton,fakeSeekButton =
			makePair(doorsGroup,"SPAWN FAKE FIGURE","SPAWN FAKE SEEK")
		local clearFakesButton = makeAction(doorsGroup,"CLEAR LOCAL FAKE ENTITIES")

		local fakeFolder = workspace:FindFirstChild("NotRubyFakeEntities")
		if not fakeFolder then
			fakeFolder = Instance.new("Folder")
			fakeFolder.Name = "NotRubyFakeEntities"
			fakeFolder.Parent = workspace
		end

		local fakeSerial = 0
		local fakeColors = {
			RUSH = Color3.fromRGB(38,38,44),
			AMBUSH = Color3.fromRGB(78,225,116),
			FIGURE = Color3.fromRGB(145,70,52),
			SEEK = Color3.fromRGB(12,12,15)
		}
		local fakeAssetIds = {
			RUSH = "11564808949",
			AMBUSH = "75432270288891",
			SEEK = "11296591821",
			FIGURE = "11627369228"
		}
		local CRUCIFIX_ASSET_ID = "12640741174"
		local InsertService = game:GetService("InsertService")

		local realEntityWords = {
			"rush","ambush","screech","seek","figure","halt","eyes",
			"snare","giggle","grumble","dread","timothy","jack",
			"shadow","gloombat","lookman","blitz","vacuum","haste",
			"a60","a-60","a90","a-90","a120","a-120"
		}

		local safeObjectWords = {
			"door","key","book","gold","coin","crucifix","lighter",
			"flashlight","battery","candle","bandage","vitamin","locker",
			"closet","wardrobe","drawer","table","desk","chair","bed",
			"cabinet","chest","painting","window","wall","floor","ceiling"
		}

		local function notify(message)
			-- setStatus already emits one toast event.
			setStatus(message)
		end

		local function containsWord(name,words)
			local lowerName = string.lower(tostring(name or ""))
			for _,word in ipairs(words) do
				if string.find(lowerName,word,1,true) then
					return true
				end
			end
			return false
		end

		local function isFakeEntity(object)
			local cursor = object
			for _ = 1,10 do
				if not cursor or cursor == workspace then
					break
				end
				if cursor:GetAttribute("NotRubyFakeEntity") == true then
					return true,cursor
				end
				cursor = cursor.Parent
			end
			return false,nil
		end

		local function hasHostileFlag(object)
			for _,attributeName in ipairs({
				"IsMonster","Monster","IsEntity","Entity",
				"IsEnemy","Enemy","Hostile"
			}) do
				local ok,value = pcall(function()
					return object:GetAttribute(attributeName)
				end)
				if ok and value == true then
					return true
				end
			end
			return false
		end

		local function isRealEntity(object)
			local fake = isFakeEntity(object)
			if fake then
				return false
			end

			local cursor = object
			for _ = 1,10 do
				if not cursor or cursor == workspace then
					break
				end

				if cursor:IsA("Model") then
					if Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(cursor) then
						return true
					end

					local lowerName = string.lower(tostring(cursor.Name or ""))
					local obviouslyObject = containsWord(lowerName,safeObjectWords)
					if not obviouslyObject then
						local targetHumanoid = cursor:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
						if targetHumanoid then
							return true
						end
						if hasHostileFlag(cursor)
							or containsWord(lowerName,realEntityWords) then
							return true
						end
					end
				elseif hasHostileFlag(cursor) then
					return true
				end

				cursor = cursor.Parent
			end
			return false
		end

		local function targetPart(target)
			if not target or not target.Parent then
				return nil
			end
			if target:IsA("BasePart") then
				return target
			end
			if target:IsA("Model") then
				return target.PrimaryPart
					or target:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
					or target:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart",true)
			end
			return target:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart",true)
		end

		local function makeFakePart(parent,name,size,cframe,color,shape)
			local part = Instance.new("Part")
			part.Name = name
			part.Size = size
			part.CFrame = cframe
			part.Color = color
			part.Material = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
			part.Shape = shape or Enum.PartType.Block
			part.Anchored = true
			part.CanCollide = false
			part.CanTouch = false
			part.CanQuery = true
			part.CastShadow = true
			part.Parent = parent
			return part
		end

		local function spawnCFrame()
			local ownCharacter = player.Character
			local ownRoot = ownCharacter and ownCharacter:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
			if not ownRoot then
				return nil
			end

			local flatLook = Vector3.new(
				ownRoot.CFrame.LookVector.X,
				0,
				ownRoot.CFrame.LookVector.Z
			)
			if flatLook.Magnitude < .01 then
				flatLook = Vector3.new(0,0,-1)
			else
				flatLook = flatLook.Unit
			end

			local desired = ownRoot.Position + flatLook*10
			local params = RaycastParams.new()
			params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
			params.FilterDescendantsInstances = {ownCharacter,fakeFolder}
			params.IgnoreWater = true

			local hit = workspace:Raycast(
				desired + Vector3.new(0,10,0),
				Vector3.new(0,-35,0),
				params
			)
			local position = hit and hit.Position or desired
			position += Vector3.new(0,2.5,0)

			return CFrame.lookAt(
				position,
				position + flatLook
			)
		end

		local function sanitizeImportedObject(object)
			if not object then return end
			for _,descendant in ipairs(object:GetDescendants()) do
				if descendant:IsA("Script") or descendant:IsA("LocalScript") or descendant:IsA("ModuleScript") then
					descendant:Destroy()
				elseif descendant:IsA("BasePart") then
					descendant.Anchored = true
					descendant.CanCollide = false
					descendant.CanTouch = false
					descendant.CanQuery = true
					descendant.Massless = true
				end
			end
			if object:IsA("BasePart") then
				object.Anchored = true
				object.CanCollide = false
				object.CanTouch = false
				object.CanQuery = true
				object.Massless = true
			end
		end

		local function normalizeImportedModel(imported,kind,assetId)
			if not imported then return nil,nil end
			local model
			if imported:IsA("Model") then
				model = imported
			elseif imported:IsA("Tool") or imported:IsA("Accessory") then
				model = Instance.new("Model")
				for _,child in ipairs(imported:GetChildren()) do child.Parent = model end
				imported:Destroy()
			elseif imported:IsA("BasePart") then
				model = Instance.new("Model")
				imported.Parent = model
			else
				local foundModel = imported:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Model",true)
				local foundPart = imported:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart",true)
				if foundModel then
					model = foundModel
					model.Parent = nil
					imported:Destroy()
				elseif foundPart then
					model = Instance.new("Model")
					foundPart.Parent = model
					imported:Destroy()
				else
					imported:Destroy()
					return nil,nil
				end
			end
			sanitizeImportedObject(model)
			local rootPart = model.PrimaryPart or model:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart",true) or model:FindFirstChild("Root",true) or model:FindFirstChild("Torso",true) or model:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart",true)
			if not rootPart or not rootPart:IsA("BasePart") then
				model:Destroy()
				return nil,nil
			end
			model.PrimaryPart = rootPart
			model.Name = "Fake"..kind.."_"..tostring(fakeSerial)
			model:SetAttribute("NotRubyFakeEntity",true)
			model:SetAttribute("FakeEntityKind",kind)
			model:SetAttribute("LocalOnly",true)
			model:SetAttribute("SourceAssetId",tostring(assetId))
			return model,rootPart
		end

		local function tryGetObjects(assetId)
			local ok,objects = pcall(function()
				return game:GetObjects("rbxassetid://"..tostring(assetId))
			end)
			if not ok then
				return nil,"GETOBJECTS: "..tostring(objects)
			end
			if type(objects) ~= "table" or not objects[1] then
				return nil,"GETOBJECTS: EMPTY RESULT"
			end
			return objects[1],"GETOBJECTS"
		end

		local function tryInsertService(assetId)
			local ok,container = pcall(function()
				return InsertService:LoadAsset(tonumber(assetId))
			end)
			if not ok then
				return nil,"INSERTSERVICE: "..tostring(container)
			end
			if not container then
				return nil,"INSERTSERVICE: EMPTY RESULT"
			end
			local children = container:GetChildren()
			if #children == 1 then
				local only = children[1]
				only.Parent = nil
				container:Destroy()
				return only,"INSERTSERVICE"
			end
			return container,"INSERTSERVICE"
		end

		local function loadLocalAssetModel(assetId,kind,baseCFrame)
			local imported,method = tryGetObjects(assetId)
			if not imported then imported,method = tryInsertService(assetId) end
			if not imported then return nil,nil,method or "ASSET LOAD FAILED" end
			local model,rootPart = normalizeImportedModel(imported,kind,assetId)
			if not model or not rootPart then return nil,nil,"ASSET HAS NO USABLE PARTS" end
			model.Parent = fakeFolder
			local pivotOk = pcall(function() model:PivotTo(baseCFrame) end)
			if not pivotOk then pcall(function() rootPart.CFrame = baseCFrame end) end
			return model,rootPart,method
		end

		local function spawnFake(kind)
			if not shooterSecurityAllowed() then
				notify("FAKE ENTITY LAB [LOCKED]")
				return
			end

			local baseCFrame = spawnCFrame()
			if not baseCFrame then
				notify("FAKE ENTITY // CHARACTER NOT READY")
				return
			end

			kind = string.upper(tostring(kind or "RUSH"))
			fakeSerial += 1

			local model
			local rootPart
			local assetLoadMethod = "FALLBACK"
			local requestedAssetId = fakeAssetIds[kind]
			if requestedAssetId then
				model,rootPart,assetLoadMethod =
					loadLocalAssetModel(requestedAssetId,kind,baseCFrame)
			end

			local color = fakeColors[kind] or Color3.fromRGB(70,70,80)
			if not model then
				model = Instance.new("Model")
				model.Name = "Fake"..kind.."_"..tostring(fakeSerial)
				model:SetAttribute("NotRubyFakeEntity",true)
				model:SetAttribute("FakeEntityKind",kind)
				model:SetAttribute("LocalOnly",true)
				model.Parent = fakeFolder
			end

			if not rootPart and (kind == "RUSH" or kind == "AMBUSH") then
				rootPart = makeFakePart(
					model,
					"FakeCore",
					Vector3.new(4.4,4.4,4.4),
					baseCFrame,
					color,
					Enum.PartType.Ball
				)
				rootPart.Material = Enum.Material.Neon

				local eyeLeft = makeFakePart(
					model,"EyeLeft",Vector3.new(.45,.65,.18),
					baseCFrame*CFrame.new(-.8,.55,-2.15),
					Color3.fromRGB(245,245,245)
				)
				local eyeRight = makeFakePart(
					model,"EyeRight",Vector3.new(.45,.65,.18),
					baseCFrame*CFrame.new(.8,.55,-2.15),
					Color3.fromRGB(245,245,245)
				)
				eyeLeft.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
				eyeRight.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
			elseif not rootPart then
				rootPart = makeFakePart(
					model,"Torso",Vector3.new(2.3,3.6,1.35),
					baseCFrame,
					color
				)
				makeFakePart(
					model,"Head",Vector3.new(1.8,1.8,1.8),
					baseCFrame*CFrame.new(0,2.65,0),color,Enum.PartType.Ball
				)
				makeFakePart(
					model,"LeftArm",Vector3.new(.8,3.4,.8),
					baseCFrame*CFrame.new(-1.65,0,0),color
				)
				makeFakePart(
					model,"RightArm",Vector3.new(.8,3.4,.8),
					baseCFrame*CFrame.new(1.65,0,0),color
				)
				makeFakePart(
					model,"LeftLeg",Vector3.new(.85,3.1,.9),
					baseCFrame*CFrame.new(-.7,-3.2,0),color
				)
				makeFakePart(
					model,"RightLeg",Vector3.new(.85,3.1,.9),
					baseCFrame*CFrame.new(.7,-3.2,0),color
				)
			end

			if rootPart then
				model.PrimaryPart = rootPart
			end

			local highlight = Instance.new("Highlight")
			highlight.Name = "FakeEntityHighlight"
			highlight.DepthMode = Enum.HighlightDepthMode.AlwaysOnTop
			highlight.FillColor = color
			highlight.OutlineColor = Color3.fromRGB(240,245,255)
			highlight.FillTransparency = .72
			highlight.OutlineTransparency = .08
			highlight.Adornee = model
			highlight.Parent = model

			local billboard = Instance.new("BillboardGui")
			billboard.Name = "FakeEntityLabel"
			billboard.Adornee = rootPart
			billboard.AlwaysOnTop = true
			billboard.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(170,34)
			billboard.StudsOffset = Vector3.new(0,3.4,0)
			billboard.Parent = rootPart

			local label = Instance.new("TextLabel")
			label.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1,1)
			label.BackgroundColor3 = SURFACE
			label.BackgroundTransparency = .18
			label.BorderSizePixel = 0
			label.Text =
				"FAKE "..kind.." // LOCAL // IDLE // "
				..(
					model:GetAttribute("SourceAssetId")
					and ("MODEL "..tostring(model:GetAttribute("SourceAssetId")))
					or "PRIMITIVE FALLBACK"
				)
			label.TextColor3 = TEXT
			label.TextSize = 9
			label.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBlack
			label.Parent = billboard
			corner(label,8)
			addStroke(label,color,1,.2)

			if model:GetAttribute("SourceAssetId") then
				notify("FAKE "..kind.." MODEL LOADED // "..tostring(assetLoadMethod))
			else
				notify("FAKE "..kind.." MODEL ASSET FAILED // "..tostring(assetLoadMethod).." // USING FALLBACK")
			end
		end

		local function safeSpawnFake(kind)
			local ok,err = xpcall(function()
				spawnFake(kind)
			end,function(problem)
				return tostring(problem)
			end)
			if not ok then
				local message =
					"FAKE "..string.upper(tostring(kind))
					.." MODEL ERROR // "..tostring(err)
				warn("[NOT RUBY MODEL] "..message)
				notify(message)
			end
		end

		fakeRushButton.Activated:Connect(function() safeSpawnFake("RUSH") end)
		fakeAmbushButton.Activated:Connect(function() safeSpawnFake("AMBUSH") end)
		fakeFigureButton.Activated:Connect(function() safeSpawnFake("FIGURE") end)
		fakeSeekButton.Activated:Connect(function() safeSpawnFake("SEEK") end)
		clearFakesButton.Activated:Connect(function()
			for _,object in ipairs(fakeFolder:GetChildren()) do
				object:Destroy()
			end
			notify("LOCAL FAKE ENTITIES CLEARED")
		end)

		local function removeLocalCrucifix()
			for _,container in ipairs({
				player.Character,
				player:FindFirstChildOfClass("Backpack")
			}) do
				if container then
					for _,object in ipairs(container:GetChildren()) do
						if object:IsA("Tool")
							and object.Name == "NotRubyCrucifix" then
							object:Destroy()
						end
					end
				end
			end
		end

		local function currentRooms()
			return workspace:FindFirstChild("CurrentRooms")
		end

		local function roomAncestor(object)
			local rooms = currentRooms()
			if not rooms or not object or not object:IsDescendantOf(rooms) then
				return nil
			end
			local cursor = object
			while cursor and cursor.Parent and cursor.Parent ~= rooms do
				cursor = cursor.Parent
			end
			if cursor and cursor.Parent == rooms then
				return cursor
			end
			return nil
		end

		local function resolveRoomTarget(hitObject)
			if not hitObject or not hitObject.Parent then
				return nil,nil
			end

			local fake,fakeModel = isFakeEntity(hitObject)
			if fake then
				return fakeModel,"FAKE ENTITY"
			end

			if isRealEntity(hitObject) then
				return nil,"REAL ENTITY"
			end

			local room = roomAncestor(hitObject)
			if not room then
				return nil,nil
			end

			local cursor = hitObject
			local nearestModel = nil
			local namedTarget = nil
			while cursor and cursor ~= room.Parent do
				if cursor:IsA("Model") and cursor ~= room and not nearestModel then
					nearestModel = cursor
				end
				if containsWord(cursor.Name,safeObjectWords) then
					namedTarget = cursor
					break
				end
				if cursor == room then
					break
				end
				cursor = cursor.Parent
			end

			if namedTarget then
				return namedTarget,"ROOM OBJECT"
			end
			if nearestModel then
				return nearestModel,"ROOM OBJECT"
			end
			if room:IsA("Model") then
				return room,"ROOM"
			end
			return hitObject,"ROOM OBJECT"
		end

		local function nearestFakeInFront(maxDistance)
			local ownCharacter = player.Character
			local ownRoot = ownCharacter and ownCharacter:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
			local currentCamera = workspace.CurrentCamera
			if not ownRoot or not currentCamera then
				return nil,nil
			end

			local best = nil
			local bestDistance = maxDistance or 80
			local look = currentCamera.CFrame.LookVector
			for _,candidate in ipairs(fakeFolder:GetChildren()) do
				if candidate:GetAttribute("NotRubyFakeEntity") == true then
					local part = targetPart(candidate)
					if part then
						local offset = part.Position-currentCamera.CFrame.Position
						local distance = offset.Magnitude
						if distance > .01 and distance < bestDistance then
							local facing = look:Dot(offset.Unit)
							if facing >= .45 then
								best = candidate
								bestDistance = distance
							end
						end
					end
				end
			end
			return best,bestDistance
		end

		local function findAimTarget()
			local currentCamera = workspace.CurrentCamera
			local ownCharacter = player.Character
			if not currentCamera then
				return nil,nil,nil
			end

			local params = RaycastParams.new()
			params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
			params.FilterDescendantsInstances = ownCharacter and {ownCharacter} or {}
			params.IgnoreWater = true

			local result = workspace:Raycast(
				currentCamera.CFrame.Position,
				currentCamera.CFrame.LookVector*999,
				params
			)

			if result and result.Instance then
				local target,targetType = resolveRoomTarget(result.Instance)
				if target then
					return target,
						(currentCamera.CFrame.Position-result.Position).Magnitude,
						targetType
				end
				if targetType == "REAL ENTITY" then
					return nil,nil,"REAL ENTITY"
				end
			end

			local fake,distance = nearestFakeInFront(80)
			if fake then
				return fake,distance,"FAKE ENTITY"
			end
			return nil,nil,nil
		end

		local function targetDisplayName(target,targetType)
			if not target then
				return "TARGET"
			end
			if targetType == "FAKE ENTITY" then
				local kind = target:GetAttribute("FakeEntityKind")
				return "FAKE "..string.upper(tostring(kind or target.Name))
			end
			local room = roomAncestor(target)
			if target == room then
				return "ROOM "..tostring(room.Name)
			end
			return string.upper(tostring(target.Name or "ROOM OBJECT"))
		end

		local function crucifixVisual(target,targetType,distance)
			if not target or not target.Parent then
				return
			end

			local displayName = targetDisplayName(target,targetType)
			notify(
				"CRUCIFIX // "..displayName
				.." // "..tostring(math.floor((distance or 0)+.5)).." STUDS"
			)

			local part = targetPart(target)
			if not part then
				return
			end

			local highlight = Instance.new("Highlight")
			highlight.Name = "NotRubyCrucifixEffect"
			highlight.DepthMode = Enum.HighlightDepthMode.AlwaysOnTop
			highlight.FillColor = Color3.fromRGB(165,225,255)
			highlight.OutlineColor = Color3.fromRGB(255,255,255)
			highlight.FillTransparency = .16
			highlight.OutlineTransparency = 0
			highlight.Adornee =
				(target:IsA("Model") or target:IsA("BasePart")) and target or part
			highlight.Parent = workspace

			local marker = Instance.new("BillboardGui")
			marker.Name = "NotRubyCrucifixMarker"
			marker.Adornee = part
			marker.AlwaysOnTop = true
			marker.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(190,42)
			marker.StudsOffset = Vector3.new(0,3,0)
			marker.Parent = part

			local markerText = Instance.new("TextLabel")
			markerText.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1,1)
			markerText.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(20,30,45)
			markerText.BackgroundTransparency = .12
			markerText.BorderSizePixel = 0
			markerText.Text = "CRUCIFIED // "..displayName
			markerText.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(225,245,255)
			markerText.TextSize = 9
			markerText.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBlack
			markerText.Parent = marker
			corner(markerText,9)

			local light = Instance.new("PointLight")
			light.Color = Color3.fromRGB(180,230,255)
			light.Brightness = 3
			light.Range = 18
			light.Parent = part

			if targetType == "FAKE ENTITY"
				and target:GetAttribute("NotRubyFakeEntity") == true then
				local fakeParts = {}
				for _,descendant in ipairs(target:GetDescendants()) do
					if descendant:IsA("BasePart") then
						table.insert(fakeParts,descendant)
					end
				end
				for _,fakePart in ipairs(fakeParts) do
					TweenService:Create(
						fakePart,
						TweenInfo.new(.55,Enum.EasingStyle.Quint,Enum.EasingDirection.Out),
						{Transparency = 1}
					):Play()
				end
				TweenService:Create(
					highlight,
					TweenInfo.new(.55),
					{FillTransparency = 1,OutlineTransparency = 1}
				):Play()
				task.delay(.58,function()
					if marker and marker.Parent then marker:Destroy() end
					if light and light.Parent then light:Destroy() end
					if highlight and highlight.Parent then highlight:Destroy() end
					if target and target.Parent then target:Destroy() end
				end)
				return
			end

			-- Real room content is NOT destroyed. It receives a local-only crucifix
			-- pulse and brief LocalTransparencyModifier fade, then restores exactly.
			local restored = {}
			local affected = 0
			local function rememberPart(candidate)
				if affected >= 90 or not candidate:IsA("BasePart") then
					return
				end
				affected += 1
				restored[candidate] = candidate.LocalTransparencyModifier
				candidate.LocalTransparencyModifier = math.max(candidate.LocalTransparencyModifier,.72)
			end

			if target:IsA("BasePart") then
				rememberPart(target)
			else
				for _,descendant in ipairs(target:GetDescendants()) do
					if descendant:IsA("BasePart") then
						rememberPart(descendant)
					end
					if affected >= 90 then
						break
					end
				end
			end

			TweenService:Create(
				highlight,
				TweenInfo.new(.75,Enum.EasingStyle.Quint,Enum.EasingDirection.Out),
				{FillTransparency = 1,OutlineTransparency = 1}
			):Play()
			TweenService:Create(light,TweenInfo.new(.75),{Brightness = 0}):Play()

			task.delay(.78,function()
				for object,oldValue in pairs(restored) do
					if object and object.Parent then
						object.LocalTransparencyModifier = oldValue
					end
				end
				if marker and marker.Parent then marker:Destroy() end
				if light and light.Parent then light:Destroy() end
				if highlight and highlight.Parent then highlight:Destroy() end
			end)
		end

		local function buildTool()
			-- Prepared for a future re-enable. V58 intentionally does not call this
			-- because CRUCIFIX ANYTHING is temporarily shut down.
			if gui:GetAttribute("DoorsCrucifixAnything") ~= true
				or menuDeleted or not gui.Parent then
				return
			end

			local backpack =
				player:FindFirstChildOfClass("Backpack")
				or player:WaitForChild("Backpack",2)
			if not backpack then
				return
			end
			if backpack:FindFirstChild("NotRubyCrucifix")
				or (player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChild("NotRubyCrucifix")) then
				return
			end

			local ok,objects = pcall(function()
				return game:GetObjects("rbxassetid://"..CRUCIFIX_ASSET_ID)
			end)
			if not ok or type(objects) ~= "table" or not objects[1] then
				notify("CRUCIFIX MODEL // ASSET "..CRUCIFIX_ASSET_ID.." FAILED")
				return
			end

			local imported = objects[1]
			local tool
			if imported:IsA("Tool") then
				tool = imported
			else
				tool = Instance.new("Tool")
				imported.Parent = tool
			end

			tool.Name = "NotRubyCrucifix"
			tool.ToolTip = "CRUCIFIX MODEL // ASSET "..CRUCIFIX_ASSET_ID
			tool.CanBeDropped = false
			tool:SetAttribute("NotRubyCrucifixAnything",true)
			tool:SetAttribute("SourceAssetId",CRUCIFIX_ASSET_ID)

			for _,descendant in ipairs(tool:GetDescendants()) do
				if descendant:IsA("Script")
					or descendant:IsA("LocalScript")
					or descendant:IsA("ModuleScript") then
					descendant:Destroy()
				elseif descendant:IsA("BasePart") then
					descendant.CanCollide = false
					descendant.CanTouch = false
					descendant.Massless = true
				end
			end

			local handle =
				tool:FindFirstChild("Handle",true)
				or tool:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart",true)
			if handle and handle:IsA("BasePart") then
				handle.Name = "Handle"
				tool.RequiresHandle = true
			else
				tool.RequiresHandle = false
			end

			tool.Parent = backpack
			tool.Activated:Connect(function()
				if gui:GetAttribute("DoorsCrucifixAnything") ~= true then
					return
				end
				local target,distance,targetType = findAimTarget()
				if targetType == "REAL ENTITY" then
					notify("CRUCIFIX // REAL ENTITY IGNORED")
					return
				end
				if not target then
					notify("CRUCIFIX // AIM AT A FAKE / DOOR / KEY / ROOM OBJECT")
					return
				end
				crucifixVisual(target,targetType,distance)
			end)
		end

		crucifixAnythingButton.Activated:Connect(function()
			gui:SetAttribute("DoorsCrucifixAnything",false)
			removeLocalCrucifix()
			if shooterSecurityAllowed() then
				crucifixAnythingButton.Text =
					"CRUCIFIX ANYTHING [TEMP SHUTDOWN]"
				crucifixAnythingButton.BackgroundColor3 = SURFACE_2
				crucifixAnythingButton.TextColor3 = MUTED
				notify(
					"CRUCIFIX ANYTHING // TEMPORARILY SHUT DOWN // MODEL "
						..CRUCIFIX_ASSET_ID
						.." SAVED FOR RE-ENABLE"
				)
			else
				crucifixAnythingButton.Text = "CRUCIFIX ANYTHING [LOCKED]"
				notify("SET SHOOTER_ALLOWED_PLACE_ID TO YOUR GAME PLACEID")
			end
		end)

		gui:SetAttribute("DoorsCrucifixAnything",false)
		removeLocalCrucifix()

		gui.Destroying:Connect(function()
			gui:SetAttribute("DoorsCrucifixAnything",false)
			removeLocalCrucifix()
			if fakeFolder and fakeFolder.Parent then
				fakeFolder:Destroy()
			end
		end)
	end)()
