		if not shooterSecurityAllowed() then
			state.doorsEntityAlerts = false
			entityAlertButton.Text = "ALL ENTITY ALERTS + SOUND [LOCKED]"
			setStatus("SET SHOOTER_ALLOWED_PLACE_ID TO YOUR GAME PLACEID")
			return
		end
		state.doorsEntityAlerts = not state.doorsEntityAlerts

			or "DOORS ALL ENTITY ALERTS + SOUND OFF"
		)
	end)

			state.doorsItemEsp = false
			itemEspButton.Text = "COLLECTIBLES + HIDING ESP [LOCKED]"
			setStatus("SET SHOOTER_ALLOWED_PLACE_ID TO YOUR GAME PLACEID")
			return
		end

		crucifixAnythingButton.Text = "CRUCIFIX ANYTHING [TEMP SHUTDOWN]"

	end

			doorsRangeBox.Text = tostring(state.doorsGuideMaxDistance)
			setStatus("INVALID GUIDE RANGE")
			return
		end
		state.doorsGuideMaxDistance =
			math.clamp(math.floor(value+.5),50,3000)
		doorsRangeBox.Text = tostring(state.doorsGuideMaxDistance)

		updateDoorsGuide()
		setStatus("DOORS GUIDE RANGE // "..doorsRangeBox.Text)
	end)

	local doorsRenderAccumulator = 0
	trackAdvanced(
		RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function(deltaTime)
			if not runtimeCore.allows("DOORS") then
				return
			end
			doorsRenderAccumulator += deltaTime
			if doorsRenderAccumulator < .1 then
				return
			end
			doorsRenderAccumulator = 0

			if menuDeleted or not gui.Parent then
				return
			end

					or state.doorsDoorGuide
					or state.doorsSmartGuide

				doorsItemEsp.update()

				doorsItemEsp.clear()
			end
		end)
	)

		local function makeRock(
			name,
			x,
			y,
			width,
			height,
			shade,
			roundness,
			zIndex
		)
			local safeWidth =
				math.clamp(
					tonumber(width) or .10,
					.035,
					.28
				)
			local halfWidth = safeWidth*.5
			local sidePadding = .025

			local safeX =
				math.clamp(
					tonumber(x) or .5,
					halfWidth+sidePadding,
					1-halfWidth-sidePadding
				)

			local safeY =
				math.clamp(
					tonumber(y) or 100,
					12,
					828
				)

			local safeHeight =
				math.clamp(
					tonumber(height) or 30,
					10,
					105
				)

			local rock = Instance.new("Frame")
			rock.Name = name
			rock.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(.5,.5)
			rock.Position = UDim2.new(safeX,0,0,safeY)
			rock.Size = UDim2.new(safeWidth,0,0,safeHeight)

			-- Rotation intentionally stays at zero. ClipsDescendants is much
			-- more reliable across mobile executors when descendants are not
			-- rotated near the edge of a scrolling GUI.
			rock.Rotation = 0
			rock.BackgroundColor3 = shade
			rock.BorderSizePixel = 0
			rock.ZIndex = zIndex or 2
			rock.Parent = rockViewport
			corner(rock,roundness or 10)

			local rockGradient = Instance.new("UIGradient")
			rockGradient.Color = ColorSequence.new({
				ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(
					0,
					shade:Lerp(Color3.fromRGB(110,101,91),.16)
				),
				ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(.55,shade),
				ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(
					1,
					shade:Lerp(Color3.fromRGB(4,4,5),.22)
				)
			})
			rockGradient.Rotation = 34
			rockGradient.Parent = rock

			return rock
		end

		local function refreshFloor2Dupe()
			if not floor2DupeButton.Parent then
				return
			end

			if not shooterSecurityAllowed() then
				floor2DupeButton.Text =
					"DUPE DETECTION [LOCKED]"
				return
			end

			local enabled =
				gui:GetAttribute("DoorsDupeGuide") == true

			setToggle(
				floor2DupeButton,
				enabled,
				"DUPE DETECTION"
			)

			floor2DupeCount.Text =
				"DUPES: "
				..tostring(
					tonumber(
						gui:GetAttribute("DoorsDupeCount")
					)
					or 0
				)
		end

		floor2DupeButton.Activated:Connect(function()
			if not shooterSecurityAllowed() then
				refreshFloor2Dupe()
				setStatus(
					"SET SHOOTER_ALLOWED_PLACE_ID TO YOUR GAME PLACEID"
				)
				return
			end

			local event =
				gui:FindFirstChild(
					"NotRubyDoorsDupeToggle"
				)

			if event

	-- --------------------------------------------------------
	-- V96 DOORS FLOOR 2 // FUSE ESP // EVENT-CACHED LOW-LAG
	-- Finds collectible fuse objects in CurrentRooms, including the
	-- early Door 1 fuse and fuses that spawn in later rooms.
	-- --------------------------------------------------------
	;(function()
		local records = setmetatable({}, {__mode = "k"})
		local scanToken = 0
		local scanAccumulator = 0
		local visualAccumulator = 0
		local maxDistance = 5000

		local fuseFolder = Instance.new("Folder")
		fuseFolder.Name = "NotRubyFloor2FuseESP"
		fuseFolder.Parent = workspace

		local function getFloor2Button()
			for _,object in ipairs(gui:GetDescendants()) do
				if object:IsA("TextButton")
					and object.Name == "Floor2FuseEspButton" then
					return object
				end
			end
			return nil
		end

		local function getFloor2CountLabel()
			for _,object in ipairs(gui:GetDescendants()) do
				if object:IsA("TextLabel")
					and object.Name == "Floor2FuseEspCount" then
					return object
				end
			end
			return nil
		end

		local function compactFuse(value)
			return string.lower(
				tostring(value or ""):gsub("[^%w]","")
			)
		end

		local function hasBadFuseWord(value)
			local c = compactFuse(value)
			for _,word in ipairs({
				"fusebox",
				"fusepanel",
				"fuseholder",
				"fuseslot",
				"fusesocket",
				"fuseboard",
				"fusedoor",
				"generator",
				"breaker",
				"installedfuse",
				"insertedfuse",
				"usedfuse",
				"fusegate",
				"fusemachine"
			}) do
				if string.find(c,word,1,true) then
					return true
				end
			end
			return false
		end

		local function isStrongFuseName(value)
			local c = compactFuse(value)
			if c == "" or hasBadFuseWord(c) then
				return false
			end

			if c == "fuse"
				or c == "fuses"
				or c == "fuze"
				or c == "fuseobtain"
				or c == "fusepickup"
				or c == "fuseitem"
				or c == "fusepiece"
				or c == "fusepart"
				or c == "fusecollect"
				or c == "fusecollectible"
				or c == "collectfuse"
				or c == "takefuse"
				or c == "pickupfuse"
				or c == "obtainfuse"
				or c == "electricalfuse"
				or c == "powerfuse"
				or c == "generatorfuse"
				or c == "minefuse"
				or c == "minesfuse" then
				return true
			end

			if string.match(c,"^fuse%d+$")
				or string.match(c,"^fusepickup%d+$")
				or string.match(c,"^fuseobtain%d+$")
				or string.match(c,"^fuseitem%d+$")
				or string.match(c,"^fusepiece%d+$") then
				return true
			end

			for _,needle in ipairs({
				"collectiblefuse",
				"pickupfuse",
				"obtainfuse",
				"fusepickup",
				"fuseobtain"
			}) do
				if string.find(c,needle,1,true) then
					return true
				end
			end

			return false
		end

		local function hasFuseAttribute(object)
			if not object then
				return false
			end

			for _,attributeName in ipairs({
				"Fuse",
				"IsFuse",
				"FuseItem",
				"CollectibleFuse",
				"IsCollectibleFuse",
				"PickupFuse"
			}) do
				local ok,value = pcall(function()
					return object:GetAttribute(attributeName)
				end)
				if ok and value == true then
					return true
				end
			end

			for _,attributeName in ipairs({
				"ItemName",
				"ItemType",
				"PickupName",
				"PickupType",
				"ObjectType",
				"Type"
			}) do
				local ok,value = pcall(function()
					return object:GetAttribute(attributeName)
				end)
				if ok and value ~= nil and isStrongFuseName(value) then
					return true
				end
			end

			local ok,tags = pcall(function()
				return CollectionService:GetTags(object)
			end)
			if ok and type(tags) == "table" then
				for _,tag in ipairs(tags) do
					if isStrongFuseName(tag) then
						return true
					end
				end
			end

			return false
		end

		local function hasCollectedFlag(object)
			if not object then
				return false
			end

			for _,attributeName in ipairs({
				"Collected",
				"PickedUp",
				"Picked",
				"Taken",
				"Used",
				"Inserted",
				"Consumed"
			}) do
				local ok,value = pcall(function()
					return object:GetAttribute(attributeName)
				end)
				if ok and value == true then
					return true
				end

				local valueObject =
					object:FindFirstChild(attributeName,true)
				if valueObject
					and valueObject:IsA("BoolValue")
					and valueObject.Value == true then
					return true
				end
			end

			return false
		end

		local function roomForObject(object,currentRooms)
			local cursor = object
			while cursor and cursor ~= workspace do
				if currentRooms and cursor.Parent == currentRooms then
					return cursor
				end
				cursor = cursor.Parent
			end
			return nil
		end

		local function objectPartForFuse(object)
			if not object or not object.Parent then
				return nil
			end

			if object:IsA("BasePart") then
				return object
			end

			if object:IsA("ProximityPrompt") then
				if object.Parent and object.Parent:IsA("BasePart") then
					return object.Parent
				end
				return object.Parent
					and object.Parent:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart",true)
					or nil
			end

			if object:IsA("Model") then
				return object.PrimaryPart
					or object:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart",true)
			end

			if object:IsA("Tool") then
				return object:FindFirstChild("Handle")
					or object:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart",true)
			end

			return object:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart",true)
		end

		local function fusePromptText(prompt)
			if not prompt or not prompt:IsA("ProximityPrompt") then
				return ""
			end
			return
				tostring(prompt.Name)
				.." "
				..tostring(prompt.ObjectText)
				.." "
				..tostring(prompt.ActionText)
		end

		local function isFuseCandidate(object)
			if not object or not object.Parent then
				return false
			end

			if hasCollectedFlag(object) then
				return false
			end

			-- V82 checks each object separately. V81 joined every ancestor name
			-- together, so a real Fuse inside a FuseBox/FuseHolder could be
			-- rejected just because the container name contained a blocked word.
			if isStrongFuseName(object.Name)
				or hasFuseAttribute(object) then
				return true
			end

			if object:IsA("ProximityPrompt") then
				if isStrongFuseName(object.ObjectText)
					or isStrongFuseName(object.ActionText) then
					return true
				end

				local promptText = compactFuse(fusePromptText(object))
				local action = compactFuse(object.ActionText)
				local pickupAction =
					action == ""
					or string.find(action,"take",1,true)
					or string.find(action,"grab",1,true)
					or string.find(action,"pick",1,true)
					or string.find(action,"collect",1,true)
					or string.find(action,"interact",1,true)

				if pickupAction
					and (
						string.find(promptText,"fuse",1,true)
						or string.find(promptText,"fuze",1,true)
					)
					and not hasBadFuseWord(promptText) then
					return true
				end
			end

			local cursor = object.Parent
			for _ = 1,10 do
				if not cursor or cursor == workspace then
					break
				end

				if isStrongFuseName(cursor.Name)
					or hasFuseAttribute(cursor) then
					return true
				end

				cursor = cursor.Parent
			end

			return false
		end

		local function fuseRoot(object,currentRooms)
			if not object then
				return nil
			end

			local room = roomForObject(object,currentRooms)
			local cursor =
				object:IsA("ProximityPrompt")
				and object.Parent
				or object

			local fallback = nil
			local bestFuseRoot = nil

			for _ = 1,10 do
				if not cursor
					or cursor == workspace
					or cursor == room then
					break
				end

				if cursor:IsA("Model")
					or cursor:IsA("Tool")
					or cursor:IsA("BasePart") then
					fallback = fallback or cursor

					if isStrongFuseName(cursor.Name)
						or hasFuseAttribute(cursor) then
						bestFuseRoot = cursor
					end
				end

				cursor = cursor.Parent
			end

			return bestFuseRoot or fallback
		end

		local function roomTextFor(root,currentRooms)
			local room = roomForObject(root,currentRooms)
			if not room then
				return "?"
			end

			local number = tonumber(room.Name)
			if number then
				return tostring(math.floor(number+.5))
			end

			return tostring(room.Name)
		end

		-- V96 LOW-LAG FUSE ESP
		-- No tracer Frames. Existing rooms are scanned once and newly streamed
		-- objects are handled event-first instead of CurrentRooms:GetDescendants()
		-- every 1.4 seconds.
		local scannedRooms = setmetatable({}, {__mode = "k"})

		local function destroyRecord(rootObject)
			local record = records[rootObject]
			if not record then
				return
			end

			for _,object in ipairs({
				record.highlight,
				record.billboard
			}) do
				if object and object.Parent then
					object:Destroy()
				end
			end

			records[rootObject] = nil
		end

		local function updateCount()
			local count = 0
			for rootObject,record in pairs(records) do
				if rootObject
					and rootObject.Parent
					and record
					and record.part
					and record.part.Parent
					and not hasCollectedFlag(rootObject) then
					count += 1
				else
					destroyRecord(rootObject)
				end
			end

			gui:SetAttribute("DoorsFloor2FuseCount",count)

			local label = getFloor2CountLabel()
			if label then
				label.Text = "FUSES: "..tostring(count)
			end

			return count
		end

		local function clearAll()
			local roots = {}
			for rootObject in pairs(records) do
				table.insert(roots,rootObject)
			end
			for _,rootObject in ipairs(roots) do
				destroyRecord(rootObject)
			end

			gui:SetAttribute("DoorsFloor2FuseCount",0)

			local label = getFloor2CountLabel()
			if label then
				label.Text = "FUSES: 0"
			end
		end

		local function createMarker(object,currentRooms)
			if not state.doorsFloor2FuseEsp
				or not shooterSecurityAllowed()
				or not object
				or not object.Parent
				or not isFuseCandidate(object) then
				return false
			end

			local room = roomForObject(object,currentRooms)
			if not room then
				return false
			end

			local roomNumber = tonumber(room.Name)
			if roomNumber and roomNumber < 0 then
				return false
			end

			local rootObject = fuseRoot(object,currentRooms)
			if not rootObject
				or not rootObject.Parent
				or records[rootObject]
				or hasCollectedFlag(rootObject) then
				return false
			end

			local part =
				objectPartForFuse(rootObject)
				or objectPartForFuse(object)
			if not part or not part.Parent then
				return false
			end

			local color = Color3.fromRGB(255,201,72)

			local highlight = Instance.new("Highlight")
			highlight.Name = "NotRubyFloor2FuseHighlight"
			highlight.Adornee =
				(
					rootObject:IsA("Model")
					or rootObject:IsA("BasePart")
				)
				and rootObject
				or part
			highlight.DepthMode =
				Enum.HighlightDepthMode.AlwaysOnTop
			highlight.FillColor = color
			highlight.OutlineColor = Color3.fromRGB(255,242,177)
			highlight.FillTransparency = .74
			highlight.OutlineTransparency = .02
			highlight.Parent = fuseFolder

			local billboard = Instance.new("BillboardGui")
			billboard.Name = "NotRubyFloor2FuseLabel"
			billboard.Adornee = part
			billboard.AlwaysOnTop = true
			billboard.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(210,34)
			billboard.StudsOffset = Vector3.new(0,2.25,0)
			billboard.MaxDistance = maxDistance
			billboard.Parent = gui

			local label = Instance.new("TextLabel")
			label.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1,1)
			label.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(38,31,16)
			label.BackgroundTransparency = .12
			label.BorderSizePixel = 0
			label.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBlack
			label.TextSize = 9
			label.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255,232,163)
			label.TextStrokeTransparency = .55
			label.Text = "FUSE"
			label.Parent = billboard
			corner(label,8)
			addStroke(label,color,1,.22)

			records[rootObject] = {
				part = part,
				label = label,
				billboard = billboard,
				highlight = highlight,
				room = roomTextFor(rootObject,currentRooms),
				source = object
			}

			return true
		end

		local function scanRoom(room,currentRooms)
			if not room
				or not room.Parent
				or scannedRooms[room]
				or not state.doorsFloor2FuseEsp then
				return
			end

			scannedRooms[room] = true

			local descendants = room:GetDescendants()
			for index,object in ipairs(descendants) do
				if not state.doorsFloor2FuseEsp
					or menuDeleted then
					return
				end

				if isFuseCandidate(object) then
					createMarker(object,currentRooms)
				end

				if index%180 == 0 then
					task.wait()
				end
			end
		end

		local function scanRecentRooms()
			if gui:GetAttribute(
				"DoorsMinecartProtectionActive"
			) == true then
				return
			end

			if not state.doorsFloor2FuseEsp
				or not shooterSecurityAllowed()
				or menuDeleted then
				return
			end

			local currentRooms =
				workspace:FindFirstChild("CurrentRooms")
			if not currentRooms then
				return
			end

			-- Current/recent rooms are what matter for collectible Fuses. Each room
			-- gets a deep scan only ONCE; DescendantAdded covers later Fuse spawns.
			for _,room in ipairs(
				getRecentDoorsRooms(currentRooms,6)
			) do
				scanRoom(room,currentRooms)
			end

			updateCount()
		end

		local function setEnabled(value)
			value = value == true

			if value and not shooterSecurityAllowed() then
				state.doorsFloor2FuseEsp = false
				gui:SetAttribute("DoorsFloor2FuseEsp",false)

				local button = getFloor2Button()
				if button then
					button.Text = "FUSE ESP [LOCKED]"
				end

				setStatus(
					"SET SHOOTER_ALLOWED_PLACE_ID TO YOUR GAME PLACEID"
				)
				return
			end

			state.doorsFloor2FuseEsp = value
			gui:SetAttribute("DoorsFloor2FuseEsp",value)
			scanToken += 1

			local button = getFloor2Button()
			if button then
				button.Text =
					value and "FUSE ESP [ON]" or "FUSE ESP [OFF]"
				button.BackgroundColor3 =
					value
					and Color3.fromRGB(69,103,60)
					or Color3.fromRGB(43,39,35)
			end

			if not value then
				clearAll()
				table.clear(scannedRooms)
				setStatus("FLOOR 2 FUSE ESP OFF")
				return
			end

			gui:SetAttribute("RuntimeProfile","DOORS")
			table.clear(scannedRooms)
			setStatus(
				"FUSE ESP V96 // LOW-LAG // RECENT ROOMS + EVENT CACHE"
			)

			local token = scanToken
			task.spawn(function()
				scanRecentRooms()

				if state.doorsFloor2FuseEsp
					and token == scanToken then
					setStatus(
						"FUSE ESP V96 ON // "
						..tostring(
							gui:GetAttribute("DoorsFloor2FuseCount")
							or 0
						)
						.." FOUND // NO TRACER"
					)
				end
			end)
		end

		local function connectButton()
			local button = getFloor2Button()
			if not button then
				return
			end

			button.Activated:Connect(function()
				setEnabled(not state.doorsFloor2FuseEsp)
			end)
		end

		connectButton()

		workspace.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(object)
			if menuDeleted
				or not state.doorsFloor2FuseEsp
				or not runtimeCore.allows("DOORS") then
				return
			end

			task.defer(function()
				if not object or not object.Parent then
					return
				end

				local currentRooms =
					workspace:FindFirstChild("CurrentRooms")
				if not currentRooms
					or not object:IsDescendantOf(currentRooms) then
					return
				end

				-- A newly generated room gets one cached scan.
				if object.Parent == currentRooms
					and (
						object:IsA("Model")
						or object:IsA("Folder")
					) then
					task.delay(.12,function()
						if object
							and object.Parent
							and state.doorsFloor2FuseEsp then
							scanRoom(object,currentRooms)
							updateCount()
						end
					end)
					return
				end

				-- New Fuse objects are handled directly, no room-wide rescan.
				if isFuseCandidate(object) then
					createMarker(object,currentRooms)
					updateCount()
				end
			end)
		end)

		RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(deltaTime)
			if menuDeleted or not state.doorsFloor2FuseEsp then
				return
			end

			if not runtimeCore.allows("DOORS") then
				return
			end

			if gui:GetAttribute(
				"DoorsMinecartProtectionActive"
			) == true then
				for _,record in pairs(records) do
					if record.billboard then
						record.billboard.Enabled = false
					end
					if record.highlight then
						record.highlight.Enabled = false
					end
				end
				return
			end

			scanAccumulator += deltaTime
			visualAccumulator += deltaTime

			-- Cheap cached pass: only scans rooms that have never been scanned.
			if scanAccumulator >= 2.5 then
				scanAccumulator = 0
				task.spawn(scanRecentRooms)
			end

			if visualAccumulator < .18 then
				return
			end
			visualAccumulator = 0

			local ownRoot =
				player.Character
				and player.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
			local currentRooms =
				workspace:FindFirstChild("CurrentRooms")
			local removeList = {}

			for rootObject,record in pairs(records) do
				if not rootObject
					or not rootObject.Parent
					or hasCollectedFlag(rootObject)
					or not record
					or not record.part
					or not record.part.Parent then
					table.insert(removeList,rootObject)
				else
					local distance =
						ownRoot
						and (
							ownRoot.Position-record.part.Position
						).Magnitude
						or math.huge

					if currentRooms then
						record.room =
							roomTextFor(rootObject,currentRooms)
					end

					record.billboard.Enabled =
						distance <= maxDistance
					record.highlight.Enabled =
						distance <= maxDistance

					record.label.Text =
						"FUSE // ROOM "
						..tostring(record.room)
						.." // "
						..(
							distance < math.huge
							and tostring(math.floor(distance+.5))
							or "--"
						)
						.." STUDS"
				end
			end

			for _,rootObject in ipairs(removeList) do
				destroyRecord(rootObject)
			end

			updateCount()
		end)

		runtimeCore.stopEvent.Event:Connect(function()
			if state.doorsFloor2FuseEsp then
				setEnabled(false)
			else
				clearAll()
				gui:SetAttribute("DoorsFloor2FuseEsp",false)
			end
		end)

		gui.Destroying:Connect(function()
			state.doorsFloor2FuseEsp = false
			gui:SetAttribute("DoorsFloor2FuseEsp",false)
			clearAll()

			if fuseFolder and fuseFolder.Parent then
				fuseFolder:Destroy()
			end
		end)
	end)()

	-- --------------------------------------------------------
	-- DOORS FLOOR 2 // MONSTER ESP + V78 UNIFIED OLD + NEW NOTIFICATIONS
	-- V99 LOW-LAG EVENT HALT NOTIFIER + V94 NO-LINE MONSTER ESP FIX
	-- Specific Floor 2 entities:
	-- Giggle, Gloombats, Grumble, Queen, Dam Seek, Halt.
	-- Monster ESP now uses Highlight + Billboard only. Screen tracer lines
	-- are removed completely so multi-part monsters cannot create starbursts.
	-- --------------------------------------------------------
	;(function()
		local records = setmetatable({}, {__mode = "k"})
		local seenAlertRoots = setmetatable({}, {__mode = "k"})
		local lastAlertAt = {}
		local scanAccumulator = 0
		local visualAccumulator = 0
		local haltAccumulator = 0
		local haltWatchedUi =
			setmetatable({}, {__mode = "k"})
		local maxDistance = 5000
		local gloombatMarkerByRoom = {}

		local monsterFolder = Instance.new("Folder")
		monsterFolder.Name = "NotRubyFloor2MonsterESP"
		monsterFolder.Parent = workspace

		local ENTITY = {
			giggle = {
				label = "GIGGLE",
				color = Color3.fromRGB(255,117,95),
				message = "GIGGLE SPAWNED // WATCH ABOVE",
				window = 4
			},
			gloombats = {
				label = "GLOOMBATS",
				color = Color3.fromRGB(184,104,255),
				message = "GLOOMBATS SPAWNED // WATCH THE SWARM",
				window = 8
			},
			grumble = {
				label = "GRUMBLE",
				color = Color3.fromRGB(255,93,72),
				message = "GRUMBLE SPAWNED // RUN",
				window = 3.5
			},
			queen = {
				label = "QUEEN",
				color = Color3.fromRGB(255,67,97),
				message = "QUEEN SPAWNED // RUN",
				window = 4
			},
			damseek = {
				label = "DAM SEEK",
				color = Color3.fromRGB(86,86,96),
				message = "DAM SEEK SPAWNED // RUN",
				window = 20
			},
			halt = {
				label = "HALT",
				color = Color3.fromRGB(88,186,255),
				message = "HALT SPAWNED // TURN AROUND",
				window = 6
			}
		}

		local function compactFloor2(value)
			return string.lower(
				tostring(value or ""):gsub("[^%w]","")
			)
		end

		local function floor2KindFromName(value)
			local c = compactFloor2(value)

			-- Specific forms first so QueenGrumble never becomes plain Grumble.
			if string.find(c,"queen",1,true)
				and (
					string.find(c,"grumble",1,true)
					or c == "queen"
					or string.find(c,"queenentity",1,true)
				) then
				return "queen"
			end

			if string.find(c,"damseek",1,true)
				or string.find(c,"seekdam",1,true)
				or string.find(c,"damchase",1,true) then
				return "damseek"
			end

			if c == "halt"
				or c == "shade"
				or c == "haltentity"
				or c == "shadeentity"
				or c == "haltroom"
				or c == "shaderoom"
				or c == "haltcorridor"
				or c == "shadecorridor"
				or c == "haltactive"
				or c == "shadeactive"
				or string.find(c,"hallwayshade",1,true)
				or string.find(c,"shadehallway",1,true)
				or string.find(c,"haltmonster",1,true)
				or string.find(c,"haltchase",1,true) then
				return "halt"
			end

			if string.find(c,"gloombats",1,true)
				or string.find(c,"gloombat",1,true) then
				return "gloombats"
			end

			if string.find(c,"giggle",1,true) then
				return "giggle"
			end

			if string.find(c,"grumble",1,true) then
				return "grumble"
			end

			return nil
		end

		local function obviouslySpawner(value)
			local c = compactFloor2(value)
			return
				string.find(c,"spawner",1,true) ~= nil
				or string.find(c,"spawnpoint",1,true) ~= nil
				or string.find(c,"template",1,true) ~= nil
				or string.find(c,"storage",1,true) ~= nil
				or string.find(c,"assetfolder",1,true) ~= nil
		end

		local function classifyFloor2(object)
			if not object
				or not object.Parent
				or not (
					object:IsA("Model")
					or object:IsA("Folder")
					or object:IsA("BasePart")
					or object:IsA("ValueBase")
					or object:IsA("Sound")
				) then
				return nil
			end

			local cursor = object
			for _ = 1,8 do
				if not cursor or cursor == workspace then
					break
				end

				if cursor:GetAttribute("NotRubyFakeEntity") == true
					or cursor:GetAttribute("LocalOnly") == true then
					return nil
				end

				if obviouslySpawner(cursor.Name) then
					return nil
				end

				local kind = floor2KindFromName(cursor.Name)
				if kind then
					return kind
				end

				for _,attributeName in ipairs({
					"EntityName",
					"MonsterName",
					"Type",
					"EntityType",
					"Halt",
					"IsHalt",
					"HaltActive",
					"Shade",
					"IsShade",
					"ShadeActive"
				}) do
					local ok,value = pcall(function()
						return cursor:GetAttribute(attributeName)
					end)
					if ok and value ~= nil then
						kind = floor2KindFromName(value)
						if kind then
							return kind
						end
					end
				end

				if cursor:IsA("ValueBase") then
					local ok,value = pcall(function()
						return cursor.Value
					end)
					if ok and value ~= nil then
						local valueKind = floor2KindFromName(value)
						if valueKind then
							return valueKind
						end
					end
				end

				cursor = cursor.Parent
			end

			return nil
		end

		-- V94: collapse child body/tentacle models into one canonical entity root.
		local function resolveMonsterRoot(object,kind)
			if not object or not object.Parent then
				return nil
			end

			local currentRooms =
				workspace:FindFirstChild("CurrentRooms")

			local cursor = object
			local closestContainer = nil
			local highestKindContainer = nil

			for _ = 1,12 do
				if not cursor
					or cursor == workspace
					or cursor == currentRooms then
					break
				end

				-- Never turn the numeric room itself into a monster marker.
				if currentRooms
					and cursor.Parent == currentRooms then
					break
				end

				if cursor:IsA("Model")
					or cursor:IsA("Folder") then

					if not closestContainer then
						closestContainer = cursor
					end

					local currentKind =
						floor2KindFromName(cursor.Name)

					if currentKind ~= kind then
						for _,attributeName in ipairs({
							"EntityName",
							"MonsterName",
							"Type",
							"EntityType"
						}) do
							local ok,value =
								pcall(function()
									return cursor:GetAttribute(attributeName)
								end)

							if ok
								and value ~= nil
								and floor2KindFromName(value) == kind then
								currentKind = kind
								break
							end
						end
					end

					-- Keep climbing. The highest matching container is the real
					-- entity root; the first match may only be a tentacle/body part.
					if currentKind == kind then
						highestKindContainer = cursor
					end
				end

				cursor = cursor.Parent
			end

			local resolved =
				highestKindContainer
				or closestContainer
				or object

			if resolved == player.Character then
				return nil
			end

			return resolved
		end

		local function monsterPart(rootObject)
			if not rootObject or not rootObject.Parent then
				return nil
			end

			if rootObject:IsA("BasePart") then
				return rootObject
			end

			if rootObject:IsA("Model") then
				return rootObject.PrimaryPart
					or rootObject:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
					or rootObject:FindFirstChild("Head")
					or rootObject:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart",true)
			end

			return rootObject:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart",true)
		end

		local function deadOrGone(rootObject)
			if not rootObject or not rootObject.Parent then
				return true
			end

			if rootObject:IsA("Model") then
				local targetHumanoid =
					rootObject:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
				if targetHumanoid and targetHumanoid.Health <= 0 then
					return true
				end
			end

			for _,attributeName in ipairs({
				"Dead",
				"Defeated",
				"Destroyed",
				"Despawned"
			}) do
				local ok,value = pcall(function()
					return rootObject:GetAttribute(attributeName)
				end)
				if ok and value == true then
					return true
				end
			end

			return false
		end

		local function floor2RoomName(object)
			local currentRooms =
				workspace:FindFirstChild("CurrentRooms")
			if not currentRooms then
				return "?"
			end

			local cursor = object
			while cursor and cursor ~= workspace do
				if cursor.Parent == currentRooms then
					return tostring(cursor.Name)
				end
				cursor = cursor.Parent
			end

			return "WORLD"
		end

		local function getButton(buttonName)
			for _,object in ipairs(gui:GetDescendants()) do
				if object:IsA("TextButton")
					and object.Name == buttonName then
					return object
				end
			end
			return nil
		end

		local function getCountLabel()
			for _,object in ipairs(gui:GetDescendants()) do
				if object:IsA("TextLabel")
					and object.Name == "Floor2MonsterCount" then
					return object
				end
			end
			return nil
		end

		local function destroyMarker(rootObject)
			local record = records[rootObject]
			if not record then
				return
			end

			if record.kind == "gloombats"
				and record.roomKey
				and gloombatMarkerByRoom[record.roomKey] == rootObject then
				gloombatMarkerByRoom[record.roomKey] = nil
			end

			for _,object in ipairs({
				record.highlight,
				record.billboard
			}) do
				if object and object.Parent then
					object:Destroy()
				end
			end

			records[rootObject] = nil
		end

		local function updateCount()
			local count = 0
			for rootObject,record in pairs(records) do
				if rootObject
					and rootObject.Parent
					and record
					and record.part
					and record.part.Parent
					and not deadOrGone(rootObject) then
					count += 1
				else
					destroyMarker(rootObject)
				end
			end

			gui:SetAttribute("DoorsFloor2MonsterCount",count)

			local label = getCountLabel()
			if label then
				label.Text =
					"MONSTERS: "
					..tostring(count)
			end

			return count
		end

		local function clearMarkers()
			for rootObject in pairs(records) do
				destroyMarker(rootObject)
			end

			gui:SetAttribute("DoorsFloor2MonsterCount",0)
			local label = getCountLabel()
			if label then
				label.Text = "MONSTERS: 0"
			end
		end

		local function createMarker(rootObject,kind)
			if not state.doorsFloor2MonsterEsp
				or not shooterSecurityAllowed()
				or not rootObject
				or not rootObject.Parent
				or records[rootObject] then
				return false
			end

			local data = ENTITY[kind]
			if not data then
				return false
			end

			local roomKey = floor2RoomName(rootObject)

			if kind == "gloombats" then
				local existing =
					gloombatMarkerByRoom[roomKey]

				if existing
					and existing.Parent
					and records[existing] then
					-- V92: one swarm = one purple guide line.
					return false
				end
			end

			local part = monsterPart(rootObject)
			if not part or not part.Parent then
				return false
			end

			local highlight = Instance.new("Highlight")
			highlight.Name = "NotRubyFloor2MonsterHighlight"
			highlight.Adornee = rootObject
			highlight.DepthMode =
				Enum.HighlightDepthMode.AlwaysOnTop
			highlight.FillColor = data.color
			highlight.OutlineColor = Color3.fromRGB(255,232,225)
			highlight.FillTransparency = .78
			highlight.OutlineTransparency = .02
			highlight.Parent = monsterFolder

			local billboard = Instance.new("BillboardGui")
			billboard.Name = "NotRubyFloor2MonsterLabel"
			billboard.Adornee = part
			billboard.AlwaysOnTop = true
			billboard.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(225,34)
			billboard.StudsOffset = Vector3.new(0,2.45,0)
			billboard.MaxDistance = maxDistance
			billboard.Parent = gui

			local label = Instance.new("TextLabel")
			label.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1,1)
			label.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(39,22,24)
			label.BackgroundTransparency = .12
			label.BorderSizePixel = 0
			label.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBlack
			label.TextSize = 9
			label.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255,227,220)
			label.TextStrokeTransparency = .55
			label.Text = data.label
			label.Parent = billboard
			corner(label,8)
			addStroke(label,data.color,1,.18)

			-- V94: no tracer Frame. Billboard + Highlight are sufficient.
			records[rootObject] = {
				kind = kind,
				data = data,
				roomKey = roomKey,
				part = part,
				label = label,
				billboard = billboard,
				highlight = highlight
			}

			if kind == "gloombats" then
				gloombatMarkerByRoom[roomKey] =
					rootObject
			end

			return true
		end

		local function playFloor2Warning(kind)
			local soundService = game:GetService("SoundService")
			local debris = game:GetService("Debris")

			local sound = Instance.new("Sound")
			sound.Name = "NotRubyFloor2MonsterWarning"
			sound.SoundId = "rbxassetid://7383525713"
			sound.Volume = 1.2
			sound.PlaybackSpeed =
				kind == "damseek" and .82
				or kind == "queen" and .88
				or kind == "halt" and .90
				or kind == "gloombats" and 1.08
				or .96
			sound.Parent = soundService

			pcall(function()
				soundService:PlayLocalSound(sound)
			end)
			debris:AddItem(sound,4)
		end

		local function alertMonster(rootObject,kind)
			if not state.doorsFloor2MonsterAlerts
				or not shooterSecurityAllowed()
				or not rootObject
				or not rootObject.Parent
				or seenAlertRoots[rootObject] then
				return
			end

			local data = ENTITY[kind]
			if not data then
				return
			end

			local now = os.clock()

			if kind == "halt" then
				local sharedLast =
					tonumber(
						gui:GetAttribute("DoorsHaltLastAlertAt")
					)
					or 0
				if now-sharedLast < 2.75 then
					seenAlertRoots[rootObject] = true
					return
				end
			end

			if now-(lastAlertAt[kind] or 0) < data.window then
				seenAlertRoots[rootObject] = true
				return
			end

			seenAlertRoots[rootObject] = true
			lastAlertAt[kind] = now
			if kind == "halt" then
				gui:SetAttribute("DoorsHaltLastAlertAt",now)
			end

			-- setStatus emits one NotRubyNotifyEvent, which now knows
			-- the supplied Floor 2 image IDs and uses rbxthumb.
			setStatus(data.message)
			playFloor2Warning(kind)
		end

		-- V98 HALT WATCHER
		-- Event-driven UI detection is primary so Halt/Shade is caught when its
		-- client hint appears or changes, without the old tiny scan cutoffs.
		local function haltSignalFrom(object)
			if not object or not object.Parent then
				return false,false
			end

			local compactName = compactFloor2(object.Name)
			local nameKind = floor2KindFromName(object.Name)

			local turnAround =
				string.find(compactName,"turnaround",1,true) ~= nil
				or string.find(compactName,"turnback",1,true) ~= nil
				or string.find(compactName,"reverse",1,true) ~= nil

			local haltSignal =
				nameKind == "halt"
				or turnAround

			if object:IsA("TextLabel")
				or object:IsA("TextButton")
				or object:IsA("TextBox") then

				local compactText = compactFloor2(object.Text)

				if string.find(compactText,"turnaround",1,true)
					or string.find(compactText,"turnback",1,true)
					or string.find(compactText,"reverse",1,true) then
					haltSignal = true
					turnAround = true
				elseif floor2KindFromName(compactText) == "halt" then
					haltSignal = true
				end
			end

			if object:IsA("ValueBase") then
				local ok,value = pcall(function()
					return object.Value
				end)

				if ok and value ~= nil then
					local compactValue = compactFloor2(value)

					if floor2KindFromName(value) == "halt" then
						haltSignal = true
					end

					if string.find(compactValue,"turnaround",1,true)
						or string.find(compactValue,"turnback",1,true)
						or string.find(compactValue,"reverse",1,true) then
						haltSignal = true
						turnAround = true
					end
				end
			end

			for _,attributeName in ipairs({
				"Halt","IsHalt","HaltActive",
				"Shade","IsShade","ShadeActive",
				"EntityName","MonsterName","EntityType","Type",
				"State","Action","Hint","Message"
			}) do
				local ok,value = pcall(function()
					return object:GetAttribute(attributeName)
				end)

				if ok and value ~= nil then
					local compactValue = compactFloor2(value)

					if value == true
						and (
							string.find(
								compactFloor2(attributeName),
								"halt",1,true
							)
							or string.find(
								compactFloor2(attributeName),
								"shade",1,true
							)
						) then
						haltSignal = true
					elseif floor2KindFromName(value) == "halt" then
						haltSignal = true
					end

					if string.find(compactValue,"turnaround",1,true)
						or string.find(compactValue,"turnback",1,true)
						or string.find(compactValue,"reverse",1,true) then
						haltSignal = true
						turnAround = true
					end
				end
			end

			return haltSignal,turnAround
		end

		local function currentHaltRoom()
			local currentRooms = getDoorsCurrentRooms()
			if not currentRooms then
				return nil
			end

			local function byNumber(value)
				local number = tonumber(value)
				if not number then
					return nil
				end

				number = math.floor(number+.5)

				return
					currentRooms:FindFirstChild(tostring(number))
					or currentRooms:FindFirstChild(
						string.format("%04d",number)
					)
			end

			for _,holder in ipairs({
				player,
				player.Character
			}) do
				if holder then
					for _,name in ipairs({
						"CurrentRoom",
						"RoomNumber",
						"Room"
					}) do
						local ok,value = pcall(function()
							return holder:GetAttribute(name)
						end)

						if ok and value ~= nil then
							local room = byNumber(value)
							if room then
								return room
							end
						end
					end
				end
			end

			local replicatedStorage =
				game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
			local gameData =
				replicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("GameData")

			if gameData then
				for _,name in ipairs({
					"CurrentRoom",
					"RoomNumber"
				}) do
					local valueObject =
						gameData:FindFirstChild(name)

					if valueObject
						and valueObject:IsA("ValueBase") then
						local room = byNumber(valueObject.Value)
						if room then
							return room
						end
					end
				end
			end

			return getActiveDoorsRoom(currentRooms)
		end

		local function liveHaltContext(object,activeRoom)
			if not object or not object.Parent then
				return false
			end

			if playerGui
				and object:IsDescendantOf(playerGui) then
				return
					object ~= gui
					and not object:IsDescendantOf(gui)
			end

			if activeRoom
				and object:IsDescendantOf(activeRoom) then
				return true
			end

			local currentRooms = getDoorsCurrentRooms()
			if currentRooms
				and object:IsDescendantOf(currentRooms) then
				return true
			end

			local ownRoot =
				player.Character
					and player.Character:FindFirstChild(
						"HumanoidRootPart"
					)

			local candidatePart = nil

			if object:IsA("BasePart") then
				candidatePart = object
			elseif object:IsA("Model") then
				candidatePart =
					object.PrimaryPart
					or object:FindFirstChildWhichIsA(
						"BasePart",true
					)
			else
				local model =
					object:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("Model")
				if model then
					candidatePart =
						model.PrimaryPart
						or model:FindFirstChildWhichIsA(
							"BasePart",true
						)
				end
			end

			return
				ownRoot ~= nil
				and candidatePart ~= nil
				and (
					ownRoot.Position-candidatePart.Position
				).Magnitude <= 650
		end

		local function emitHaltSignal(signalObject,turnAround,source)
			if not state.doorsFloor2MonsterAlerts
				or not shooterSecurityAllowed()
				or menuDeleted
				or not gui.Parent
				or not signalObject
				or not signalObject.Parent then
				return false
			end

			local activeRoom = currentHaltRoom()
			if not liveHaltContext(signalObject,activeRoom) then
				return false
			end

			local now = os.clock()

			gui:SetAttribute("DoorsHaltActive",true)
			gui:SetAttribute("DoorsHaltLastSeenAt",now)
			gui:SetAttribute(
				"DoorsHaltSignalSource",
				tostring(source or signalObject.Name or "HALT")
			)

			if turnAround then
				gui:SetAttribute("DoorsHaltTurnAround",true)
				gui:SetAttribute("DoorsHaltTurnAroundAt",now)
			end

			local rootObject =
				resolveMonsterRoot(signalObject,"halt")
				or activeRoom
				or signalObject

			if rootObject and rootObject.Parent then
				alertMonster(rootObject,"halt")
				return true
			end

			return false
		end

		local function inspectHaltSignal(object,source)
			local found,turnAround = haltSignalFrom(object)
			if not found then
				return false
			end

			return emitHaltSignal(
				object,
				turnAround,
				source
			)
		end

		local function attachHaltUiWatcher(object)
			if not object
				or not object.Parent
				or haltWatchedUi[object]
				or object == gui
				or object:IsDescendantOf(gui)
				or not object:IsA("GuiObject") then
				return
			end

			local isText =
				object:IsA("TextLabel")
				or object:IsA("TextButton")
				or object:IsA("TextBox")

			local nameCompact = compactFloor2(object.Name)
			local nameLikely =
				floor2KindFromName(object.Name) == "halt"
				or string.find(nameCompact,"turnaround",1,true) ~= nil
				or string.find(nameCompact,"turnback",1,true) ~= nil
				or string.find(nameCompact,"reverse",1,true) ~= nil

			-- V99: only likely Halt UI receives property listeners.
			if not isText and not nameLikely then
				return
			end

			haltWatchedUi[object] = true

			local function check()
				if not object
					or not object.Parent
					or not state.doorsFloor2MonsterAlerts
					or not runtimeCore.allows("DOORS") then
					return
				end

				if object.Visible then
					inspectHaltSignal(object,"PLAYERGUI")
				end
			end

			if isText then
				trackAdvanced(
					object:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Text"):Connect(check)
				)
			end

			if nameLikely then
				trackAdvanced(
					object:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Visible"):Connect(check)
				)
			end

			task.defer(check)
		end

		local function scanExistingHaltOnce()
			if not state.doorsFloor2MonsterAlerts
				or not shooterSecurityAllowed()
				or menuDeleted then
				return
			end

			local activeRoom = currentHaltRoom()
			if activeRoom then
				local checked = 0

				local function walk(container,depth)
					if not container
						or depth > 4
						or checked >= 700 then
						return
					end

					for _,object in ipairs(container:GetChildren()) do
						checked += 1

						if inspectHaltSignal(object,"HALT_INITIAL") then
							return true
						end

						if checked >= 700 then
							return
						end

						if object:IsA("Model")
							or object:IsA("Folder") then
							if walk(object,depth+1) then
								return true
							end
						end
					end
				end

				walk(activeRoom,1)
			end

			-- One-time UI catch-up only.
			if playerGui then
				for _,object in ipairs(playerGui:GetDescendants()) do
					attachHaltUiWatcher(object)
				end
			end
		end

		local function pollHalt()
			if not state.doorsFloor2MonsterAlerts
				or menuDeleted
				or not gui.Parent then
				return
			end

			local now = os.clock()
			local activeRoom = currentHaltRoom()

			if activeRoom then
				local found,turnAround = haltSignalFrom(activeRoom)

				if found then
					emitHaltSignal(
						activeRoom,
						turnAround,
						"ACTIVE_ROOM_ROOT"
					)
				else
					-- Only direct children. Deep/new objects are event-driven.
					for _,object in ipairs(activeRoom:GetChildren()) do
						found,turnAround = haltSignalFrom(object)
						if found then
							emitHaltSignal(
								object,
								turnAround,
								"ACTIVE_ROOM_CHILD"
							)
							break
						end
					end
				end
			end

			local lastSeen =
				tonumber(gui:GetAttribute("DoorsHaltLastSeenAt"))
				or 0

			if now-lastSeen > 5 then
				gui:SetAttribute("DoorsHaltActive",false)
			end

			local turnAt =
				tonumber(gui:GetAttribute("DoorsHaltTurnAroundAt"))
				or 0

			if now-turnAt > 1.35 then
				gui:SetAttribute("DoorsHaltTurnAround",false)
			end
		end


		local function inspect(object)
			local kind = classifyFloor2(object)
			if not kind then
				return
			end

			local rootObject = resolveMonsterRoot(object,kind)
			if not rootObject
				or rootObject == player.Character
				or not rootObject.Parent then
				return
			end

			if state.doorsFloor2MonsterEsp then
				createMarker(rootObject,kind)
			end

			if state.doorsFloor2MonsterAlerts then
				if kind == "halt" then
					local found,turnAround =
						haltSignalFrom(object)

					if found then
						emitHaltSignal(
							object,
							turnAround,
							"WORKSPACE"
						)
					end
				else
					alertMonster(rootObject,kind)
				end
			end
		end

		local function scanWorkspace()
			if gui:GetAttribute(
				"DoorsMinecartProtectionActive"
			) == true then
				return
			end

			if menuDeleted
				or not shooterSecurityAllowed()
				or not (
					state.doorsFloor2MonsterEsp
					or state.doorsFloor2MonsterAlerts
				) then
				return
			end

			local checked = 0
			local MAX_INITIAL_OBJECTS = 1100

			local function inspectTree(container,depth)
				if not container
					or depth > 4
					or checked >= MAX_INITIAL_OBJECTS then
					return
				end

				for _,object in ipairs(container:GetChildren()) do
					checked += 1

					if object:IsA("Model")
						or object:IsA("Folder")
						or object:IsA("ValueBase")
						or object:IsA("Sound") then
						inspect(object)
					end

					if checked >= MAX_INITIAL_OBJECTS then
						break
					end

					if object:IsA("Model")
						or object:IsA("Folder") then
						inspectTree(object,depth+1)
					end
				end
			end

			local currentRooms = getDoorsCurrentRooms()

			-- Check top-level entity containers without allocating the whole workspace tree.
			for _,object in ipairs(workspace:GetChildren()) do
				if object ~= currentRooms
					and (
						object:IsA("Model")
						or object:IsA("Folder")
						or object:IsA("ValueBase")
						or object:IsA("Sound")
					) then
					inspect(object)
				end
			end

			if currentRooms then
				local activeRoom = currentHaltRoom()

				if activeRoom then
					inspectTree(activeRoom,1)
				end

				for _,room in ipairs(
					getRecentDoorsRooms(currentRooms,3)
				) do
					if room ~= activeRoom
						and checked < MAX_INITIAL_OBJECTS then
						inspectTree(room,1)
					end
				end
			end

			updateCount()
		end

		local function setMonsterEsp(value)
			value = value == true

			if value and not shooterSecurityAllowed() then
				state.doorsFloor2MonsterEsp = false
				gui:SetAttribute("DoorsFloor2MonsterEsp",false)

				local button = getButton("Floor2MonsterEspButton")
				if button then
					button.Text = "MONSTER ESP [LOCKED]"
				end
				setStatus(
					"SET SHOOTER_ALLOWED_PLACE_ID TO YOUR GAME PLACEID"
				)
				return
			end

			state.doorsFloor2MonsterEsp = value
			gui:SetAttribute("DoorsFloor2MonsterEsp",value)

			local button = getButton("Floor2MonsterEspButton")
			if button then
				button.Text =
					value and "MONSTER ESP [ON]" or "MONSTER ESP [OFF]"
				button.BackgroundColor3 =
					value
					and Color3.fromRGB(91,55,50)
					or Color3.fromRGB(48,35,35)
			end

			if not value then
				clearMarkers()
				setStatus("FLOOR 2 MONSTER ESP OFF")
				return
			end

			gui:SetAttribute("RuntimeProfile","DOORS")
			clearMarkers()
			table.clear(gloombatMarkerByRoom)
			setStatus(
				"FLOOR 2 MONSTER ESP // V99 LOW-LAG EVENT MODE // NO LINES"
			)
			task.spawn(scanWorkspace)
		end

		local function setMonsterAlerts(value)
			value = value == true

			if value and not shooterSecurityAllowed() then
				state.doorsFloor2MonsterAlerts = false
				gui:SetAttribute("DoorsFloor2MonsterAlerts",false)

				local button =
					getButton("Floor2MonsterAlertButton")
				if button then
					button.Text =
						"MONSTER ALERTS [LOCKED]"
				end
				setStatus(
					"SET SHOOTER_ALLOWED_PLACE_ID TO YOUR GAME PLACEID"
				)
				return
			end

			state.doorsFloor2MonsterAlerts = value
			gui:SetAttribute("DoorsFloor2MonsterAlerts",value)

			local button = getButton("Floor2MonsterAlertButton")
			if button then
				button.Text =
					value
					and "MONSTER ALERTS [ON]"
					or "MONSTER ALERTS [OFF]"
				button.BackgroundColor3 =
					value
					and Color3.fromRGB(91,55,50)
					or Color3.fromRGB(48,35,35)
			end

			if value then
				gui:SetAttribute("RuntimeProfile","DOORS")
				gui:SetAttribute("DoorsHaltWatcherReady",true)

				setStatus(
					"ALL MONSTER NOTIFICATIONS ON // V99 LOW-LAG HALT WATCHER"
				)

				task.spawn(scanWorkspace)
				task.spawn(scanExistingHaltOnce)
				task.defer(pollHalt)
			else
				gui:SetAttribute("DoorsHaltWatcherReady",false)
				setStatus(
					"ALL MONSTER NOTIFICATIONS OFF"
				)
			end
		end

		local espButton = getButton("Floor2MonsterEspButton")
		if espButton then
			espButton.Activated:Connect(function()
				setMonsterEsp(not state.doorsFloor2MonsterEsp)
			end)
		end

		local alertButton = getButton("Floor2MonsterAlertButton")
		if alertButton then
			alertButton.Activated:Connect(function()
				setMonsterAlerts(not state.doorsFloor2MonsterAlerts)
			end)
		end

		if playerGui then
			trackAdvanced(
				playerGui.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(object)
					if object == gui
						or object:IsDescendantOf(gui) then
						return
					end

					attachHaltUiWatcher(object)
				end)
			)
		end

		workspace.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(object)
			if menuDeleted
				or not runtimeCore.allows("DOORS")
				or not (
					state.doorsFloor2MonsterEsp
					or state.doorsFloor2MonsterAlerts
				) then
				return
			end

			if not (
				object:IsA("Model")
				or object:IsA("Folder")
				or object:IsA("BasePart")
				or object:IsA("ValueBase")
				or object:IsA("Sound")
			) then
				return
			end

			task.delay(.08,function()
				if object and object.Parent then
					inspect(object)
				end
			end)
		end)

		RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(deltaTime)
			if menuDeleted
				or not runtimeCore.allows("DOORS") then
				return
			end

			if state.doorsFloor2MonsterAlerts then
				haltAccumulator += deltaTime

				if haltAccumulator >= .55 then
					haltAccumulator = 0
					pollHalt()
				end
			end

			if gui:GetAttribute(
				"DoorsMinecartProtectionActive"
			) == true then
				for _,record in pairs(records) do
					if record.billboard then record.billboard.Enabled = false end
					if record.highlight then record.highlight.Enabled = false end
				end
				return
			end

			if not (
				state.doorsFloor2MonsterEsp
				or state.doorsFloor2MonsterAlerts
			) then
				return
			end

			visualAccumulator += deltaTime

			-- V99: live entities are handled by workspace.DescendantAdded.
			-- scanWorkspace() runs only when the feature is enabled.
			if not state.doorsFloor2MonsterEsp then
				return
			end

			if visualAccumulator < .15 then
				return
			end
			visualAccumulator = 0

			local ownRoot =
				player.Character
				and player.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
			local removeList = {}

			for rootObject,record in pairs(records) do
				if not rootObject
					or not rootObject.Parent
					or deadOrGone(rootObject)
					or not record
					or not record.part
					or not record.part.Parent then
					table.insert(removeList,rootObject)
				else
					local distance =
						ownRoot
						and (
							ownRoot.Position-record.part.Position
						).Magnitude
						or math.huge

					record.label.Text =
						record.data.label
						.." // ROOM "
						..floor2RoomName(rootObject)
						.." // "
						..(
							distance < math.huge
							and tostring(math.floor(distance+.5))
							or "--"
						)
						.." STUDS"

					record.billboard.Enabled =
						distance <= maxDistance
					record.highlight.Enabled =
						distance <= maxDistance
				end
			end

			for _,rootObject in ipairs(removeList) do
				destroyMarker(rootObject)
			end

			updateCount()
		end)

		runtimeCore.stopEvent.Event:Connect(function()
			state.doorsFloor2MonsterEsp = false
			state.doorsFloor2MonsterAlerts = false
			gui:SetAttribute("DoorsFloor2MonsterEsp",false)
			gui:SetAttribute("DoorsFloor2MonsterAlerts",false)
			gui:SetAttribute("DoorsFloor2MonsterCount",0)
			gui:SetAttribute("DoorsHaltActive",false)
			gui:SetAttribute("DoorsHaltTurnAround",false)
			gui:SetAttribute("DoorsHaltWatcherReady",false)
			gui:SetAttribute("DoorsHaltSignalSource","--")
			clearMarkers()

			local button = getButton("Floor2MonsterEspButton")
			if button and shooterSecurityAllowed() then
				button.Text = "MONSTER ESP [OFF]"
				button.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(48,35,35)
			end

			button = getButton("Floor2MonsterAlertButton")
			if button and shooterSecurityAllowed() then
				button.Text = "MONSTER ALERTS [OFF]"
				button.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(48,35,35)
			end
		end)

		gui.Destroying:Connect(function()
			state.doorsFloor2MonsterEsp = false
			state.doorsFloor2MonsterAlerts = false
			gui:SetAttribute("DoorsHaltActive",false)
			gui:SetAttribute("DoorsHaltTurnAround",false)
			gui:SetAttribute("DoorsHaltWatcherReady",false)
			gui:SetAttribute("DoorsHaltSignalSource","--")
			clearMarkers()
			if monsterFolder and monsterFolder.Parent then
				monsterFolder:Destroy()
			end
		end)
	end)()

	-- --------------------------------------------------------
	-- V90 FLOOR 2 // FIREDAMP WARNING // TEXT ONLY
	-- Firedamp is a Floor 2 hazard, not a monster. No image/photo asset is
	-- attached to these alerts.
	-- --------------------------------------------------------
	;(function()
		local firedampButton =
			gui:FindFirstChild(
				"Floor2FiredampWarningButton",
				true
			)
		local firedampStatus =
			gui:FindFirstChild(
				"Floor2FiredampStatus",
				true
			)

		local enabled = false
		local lastAlertRoom = nil
		local lastAlertAt = 0
		local scanAccumulator = 0

		local function compactHazard(value)
			return string.lower(
				tostring(value or "")
			):gsub("[^%w]","")
		end

		local function strongFiredampName(value)
			local c = compactHazard(value)
			if c == "" then
				return false
			end

			for _,word in ipairs({
				"firedamp",
				"firedampgas",
				"firedamphole",
				"firedampleak",
				"firedamproom",
				"flammablegas",
				"methanegas",
				"gasleak",
				"gasleakhole",
				"minegas",
				"minefiredamp",
				"firedampzone"
			}) do
				if string.find(c,word,1,true) then
					return true
				end
			end

			return false
		end

		local function hasFiredampAttribute(object)
			if not object then
				return false
			end

			for _,attributeName in ipairs({
				"Firedamp",
				"FireDamp",
				"IsFiredamp",
				"IsFireDamp",
				"HasFiredamp",
				"HasFireDamp",
				"FlammableGas",
				"GasLeak",
				"IsGasLeak"
			}) do
				local ok,value = pcall(function()
					return object:GetAttribute(attributeName)
				end)

				if ok and value == true then
					return true
				end
			end

			for _,attributeName in ipairs({
				"RoomType",
				"RoomTheme",
				"Hazard",
				"HazardType",
				"Environment",
				"Type"
			}) do
				local ok,value = pcall(function()
					return object:GetAttribute(attributeName)
				end)

				if ok
					and value ~= nil
					and strongFiredampName(value) then
					return true
				end
			end

			return false
		end

		local function markedGasEmitter(object)
			if not object
				or not (
					object:IsA("ParticleEmitter")
					or object:IsA("Smoke")
				) then
				return false
			end

			local name = compactHazard(object.Name)
			if not (
				string.find(name,"gas",1,true)
				or string.find(name,"mist",1,true)
				or string.find(name,"fume",1,true)
				or string.find(name,"smoke",1,true)
			) then
				return false
			end

			-- Generic smoke is not enough by itself; require a marked ancestor.
			local cursor = object.Parent
			for _ = 1,6 do
				if not cursor then
					break
				end

				if strongFiredampName(cursor.Name)
					or hasFiredampAttribute(cursor) then
					return true
				end

				cursor = cursor.Parent
			end

			return false
		end

		local function signalsFiredamp(object)
			if not object or not object.Parent then
				return false
			end

			local cursor = object
			for _ = 1,7 do
				if not cursor or cursor == workspace then
					break
				end

				if cursor:GetAttribute("NotRubyFakeEntity") == true
					or cursor:GetAttribute("LocalOnly") == true
					or cursor.Name == "NotRubyFloor2SpawnedMonsters" then
					return false
				end

				cursor = cursor.Parent
			end

			return
				strongFiredampName(object.Name)
				or hasFiredampAttribute(object)
				or markedGasEmitter(object)
		end

		local function roomHasFiredamp(room)
			if not room or not room.Parent then
				return false
			end

			if signalsFiredamp(room) then
				return true
			end

			for _,object in ipairs(room:GetDescendants()) do
				if signalsFiredamp(object) then
					return true
				end
			end

			return false
		end

		local function candidateRooms()
			local currentRooms = getDoorsCurrentRooms()
			if not currentRooms then
				return {}
			end

			local result = {}
			local added = {}
			local activeRoom = getActiveDoorsRoom(currentRooms)

			local function add(room)
				if room and room.Parent and not added[room] then
					added[room] = true
					table.insert(result,room)
				end
			end

			add(activeRoom)

			-- Early warning: inspect the next room too if it is already loaded.
			local number =
				activeRoom and tonumber(activeRoom.Name) or nil

			if number then
				add(
					currentRooms:FindFirstChild(
						tostring(number+1)
					)
				)
			end

			return result
		end

		local function refreshFiredampUi()
			if firedampButton and firedampButton.Parent then
				if not shooterSecurityAllowed() then
					firedampButton.Text =
						"FIREDAMP WARNING [LOCKED]"
				else
					setToggle(
						firedampButton,
						enabled,
						"FIREDAMP WARNING"
					)
				end
			end

			if firedampStatus and firedampStatus.Parent then
				if not enabled then
					firedampStatus.Text = "FIREDAMP: OFF"
					firedampStatus.TextColor3 =
						Color3.fromRGB(205,173,124)
				elseif gui:GetAttribute(
					"DoorsFiredampDetected"
				) == true then
					firedampStatus.Text =
						"FIREDAMP: ROOM "
						..tostring(
							gui:GetAttribute(
								"DoorsFiredampRoom"
							)
							or "--"
						)
					firedampStatus.TextColor3 =
						Color3.fromRGB(255,124,88)
				else
					firedampStatus.Text = "FIREDAMP: CLEAR"
					firedampStatus.TextColor3 =
						Color3.fromRGB(145,218,153)
				end
			end
		end

		local function clearDetection()
			if gui:GetAttribute("DoorsFiredampDetected") == true then
				gui:SetAttribute("DoorsFiredampDetected",false)
			end
			if gui:GetAttribute("DoorsFiredampRoom") ~= "--" then
				gui:SetAttribute("DoorsFiredampRoom","--")
			end
			refreshFiredampUi()
		end

		local function alertRoom(room)
			local roomName = tostring(room.Name or "--")
			local now = os.clock()

			gui:SetAttribute("DoorsFiredampDetected",true)
			gui:SetAttribute("DoorsFiredampRoom",roomName)
			refreshFiredampUi()

			-- Avoid toast spam while the same room remains loaded.
			if lastAlertRoom == roomName
				and now-lastAlertAt < 12 then
				return
			end

			lastAlertRoom = roomName
			lastAlertAt = now

			-- Text-only warning. Because this message has no entity-image match,
			-- the existing toast system shows it without a photo.
			setStatus(
				"FIREDAMP WARNING // ROOM "
				..roomName
				.." // FLAMMABLE GAS // DO NOT USE FIRE ITEMS"
			)
		end

		local function scanFiredamp()
			if gui:GetAttribute(
				"DoorsMinecartProtectionActive"
			) == true then
				return
			end

			if not enabled
				or menuDeleted
				or not gui.Parent
				or not runtimeCore.allows("DOORS") then
				clearDetection()
				return
			end

			for _,room in ipairs(candidateRooms()) do
				if roomHasFiredamp(room) then
					alertRoom(room)
					return
				end
			end

			clearDetection()
		end

		local function setFiredampWarning(value)
			value = value == true

			if value and not shooterSecurityAllowed() then
				enabled = false
				gui:SetAttribute("DoorsFiredampWarning",false)
				clearDetection()
				refreshFiredampUi()
				setStatus(
					"SET SHOOTER_ALLOWED_PLACE_ID TO YOUR GAME PLACEID"
				)
				return
			end

			enabled = value
			gui:SetAttribute("DoorsFiredampWarning",enabled)

			if enabled then
				gui:SetAttribute("RuntimeProfile","DOORS")
				setStatus(
					"FIREDAMP WARNING ON // TEXT ONLY // NO PHOTO"
				)
				scanFiredamp()
			else
				lastAlertRoom = nil
				clearDetection()
				setStatus("FIREDAMP WARNING OFF")
			end

			refreshFiredampUi()
		end

		if firedampButton then
			firedampButton.Activated:Connect(function()
				setFiredampWarning(not enabled)
			end)
		end

		workspace.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(object)
			if enabled
				and runtimeCore.allows("DOORS")
				and signalsFiredamp(object) then
				task.defer(scanFiredamp)
			end
		end)

		trackAdvanced(
			RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(deltaTime)
				if not enabled then
					return
				end

				scanAccumulator += deltaTime
				if scanAccumulator < .45 then
					return
				end
				scanAccumulator = 0
				scanFiredamp()
			end)
		)

		runtimeCore.stopEvent.Event:Connect(function()
			enabled = false
			gui:SetAttribute("DoorsFiredampWarning",false)
			lastAlertRoom = nil
			clearDetection()
			refreshFiredampUi()
		end)

		gui.Destroying:Connect(function()
			enabled = false
			gui:SetAttribute("DoorsFiredampWarning",false)
			gui:SetAttribute("DoorsFiredampDetected",false)
			gui:SetAttribute("DoorsFiredampRoom","--")
		end)

		refreshFiredampUi()
	end)()

	-- --------------------------------------------------------
	-- V97 FLOOR 2 // CORRECT PATH ESP // ZERO-LINE
	-- Green Highlight + Billboard to the real next exit. No tracer Frame.
	-- V96 Halt reverse-direction and room/tunnel fallback logic are preserved.
	-- --------------------------------------------------------
	;(function()
		local pathButton =
			gui:FindFirstChild("Floor2CorrectPathEspButton",true)
		local enabled = false
		local targetPart = nil
		local targetDoor = nil
		local expectedDoor = nil
		local targetMode = "DOOR"
		local lastScan = 0

		local oldFolder = workspace:FindFirstChild("NotRubyFloor2CorrectPathESP")
		if oldFolder then oldFolder:Destroy() end

		local pathFolder = Instance.new("Folder")
		pathFolder.Name = "NotRubyFloor2CorrectPathESP"
		pathFolder.Parent = workspace

		local highlight = Instance.new("Highlight")
		highlight.Name = "NotRubyFloor2CorrectPathHighlight"
		highlight.DepthMode = Enum.HighlightDepthMode.AlwaysOnTop
		highlight.FillColor = Color3.fromRGB(67,210,104)
		highlight.OutlineColor = Color3.fromRGB(196,255,208)
		highlight.FillTransparency = .80
		highlight.OutlineTransparency = .02
		highlight.Enabled = false
		highlight.Parent = pathFolder

		local billboard = Instance.new("BillboardGui")
		billboard.Name = "NotRubyFloor2CorrectPathLabel"
		billboard.AlwaysOnTop = true
		billboard.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(240,36)
		billboard.StudsOffset = Vector3.new(0,2.6,0)
		billboard.MaxDistance = 5000
		billboard.Enabled = false
		billboard.Parent = gui

		local label = Instance.new("TextLabel")
		label.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1,1)
		label.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(24,46,29)
		label.BackgroundTransparency = .10
		label.BorderSizePixel = 0
		label.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBlack
		label.TextSize = 9
		label.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(218,255,224)
		label.Text = "CORRECT PATH"
		label.Parent = billboard
		corner(label,9)
		addStroke(label,Color3.fromRGB(74,220,110),1,.12)

		local function refreshButton()
			if not pathButton or not pathButton.Parent then return end
			if not shooterSecurityAllowed() then
				pathButton.Text = "CORRECT PATH ESP [LOCKED]"
				return
			end
			setToggle(pathButton,enabled,"CORRECT PATH ESP")
		end

		local function clearVisuals()
			targetPart = nil
			targetDoor = nil
			expectedDoor = nil
			targetMode = "DOOR"
			gui:SetAttribute("DoorsFloor2CorrectPathRoom","--")
			highlight.Enabled = false
			highlight.Adornee = nil
			billboard.Enabled = false
			billboard.Adornee = nil
		end

		-- V96: robust Floor 2 path resolver.
		local function roomByNumber(currentRooms,number)
			number = tonumber(number)
			if not currentRooms or not number then
				return nil
			end

			number = math.floor(number+.5)
			local direct =
				currentRooms:FindFirstChild(tostring(number))
				or currentRooms:FindFirstChild(string.format("%04d",number))
			if direct then
				return direct
			end

			for _,room in ipairs(getRecentDoorsRooms(currentRooms,8)) do
				if tonumber(room.Name) == number then
					return room
				end
			end

			return nil
		end

		local function pathWordScore(value)
			local c =
				string.lower(tostring(value or "")):gsub("[^%w]","")
			if c == "roomstart" or c == "entrance" or c == "entry" then
				return 220
			end
			if string.find(c,"doorhitbox",1,true) then
				return 210
			end
			if string.find(c,"doorway",1,true) then
				return 190
			end
			if string.find(c,"entrance",1,true)
				or string.find(c,"entry",1,true) then
				return 180
			end
			if string.find(c,"exit",1,true)
				or string.find(c,"gate",1,true)
				or string.find(c,"tunnel",1,true)
				or string.find(c,"passage",1,true)
				or string.find(c,"path",1,true) then
				return 150
			end
			if c == "door" then
				return 120
			end
			return 0
		end

		local function bestRoomEntryPart(room)
			if not room or not room.Parent then
				return nil
			end

			local ownRoot =
				player.Character
				and player.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

			local bestPart = nil
			local bestScore = -math.huge
			local checked = 0

			for _,object in ipairs(room:GetDescendants()) do
				if object:IsA("BasePart") then
					checked += 1
					local score = pathWordScore(object.Name)

					if score > 0 then
						local distance =
							ownRoot
								and (
									ownRoot.Position-object.Position
								).Magnitude
								or 0
						score -= math.min(distance,500)*.06

						if object.Transparency >= .80 then
							score += 18
						end

						if score > bestScore then
							bestScore = score
							bestPart = object
						end
					end

					if checked >= 520 then
						break
					end
				end
			end

			if bestPart then
				return bestPart
			end

			-- Geometry fallback: closest physical part in the destination room.
			local nearest = nil
			local nearestDistance = math.huge
			checked = 0
			for _,object in ipairs(room:GetDescendants()) do
				if object:IsA("BasePart") then
					checked += 1
					local distance =
						ownRoot
							and (
								ownRoot.Position-object.Position
							).Magnitude
							or 0
					if distance < nearestDistance then
						nearestDistance = distance
						nearest = object
					end
					if checked >= 260 then
						break
					end
				end
			end
			return nearest
		end

		local function doorAttributeNumber(doorObject)
			if not doorObject then
				return nil
			end

			for _,name in ipairs({
				"DoorNumber","RoomNumber","NextRoom",
				"TargetRoom","DestinationRoom","DestRoom"
			}) do
				local ok,value = pcall(function()
					return doorObject:GetAttribute(name)
				end)
				if ok and tonumber(value) then
					return math.floor(tonumber(value)+.5)
				end
			end

			return nil
		end

		local function chooseCorrectDoor()
			lastScan = os.clock()

			if not enabled
				or not shooterSecurityAllowed()
				or menuDeleted
				or not gui.Parent then
				clearVisuals()
				return
			end

			local currentRooms = getDoorsCurrentRooms()
			local activeRoom =
				currentRooms
					and getActiveDoorsRoom(currentRooms)
					or nil
			if not activeRoom then
				clearVisuals()
				return
			end

			local activeNumber = tonumber(activeRoom.Name)
			if not activeNumber then
				clearVisuals()
				return
			end

			local haltBack =
				gui:GetAttribute("DoorsHaltActive") == true
				and gui:GetAttribute("DoorsHaltTurnAround") == true

			local destinationNumber =
				activeNumber + (haltBack and -1 or 1)

			local destinationRoom =
				roomByNumber(currentRooms,destinationNumber)
			local destinationEntry =
				bestRoomEntryPart(destinationRoom)

			local descendants = activeRoom:GetDescendants()

			local bestPart,bestDoor = nil,nil
			local bestScore = -math.huge
			local unknownCount = 0

			for _,doorObject in ipairs(
				getDoorCandidates(activeRoom,descendants)
			) do
				local hitbox = findDoorHitbox(doorObject)

				if hitbox
					and not isDoorsDoorOpen(doorObject) then

					local displayed =
						readDoorDisplayedNumber(
							doorObject,
							activeRoom,
							descendants,
							hitbox,
							destinationNumber
						)
						or doorAttributeNumber(doorObject)

					local fake =
						isDoorsDupeDoor(
							doorObject,
							destinationNumber,
							displayed
						)

					if not fake then
						local score = 0

						if displayed == destinationNumber then
							score += 1000
						elseif displayed == nil then
							unknownCount += 1
							score += 180
						else
							score -= 600
						end

						if destinationEntry then
							score -= math.min(
								(
									hitbox.Position
									-destinationEntry.Position
								).Magnitude,
								1000
							)*.18
						else
							score -= math.min(
								distanceFromLocalRoot(hitbox),
								1000
							)*.05
						end

						if score > bestScore then
							bestScore = score
							bestPart = hitbox
							bestDoor = doorObject
						end
					end
				end
			end

			-- If the numbered Door model is missing/unreadable in Floor 2,
			-- guide directly to the already-generated destination room entrance.
			if not bestPart
				or (
					bestScore < 300
					and unknownCount > 1
					and destinationEntry
				) then
				bestPart = destinationEntry
				bestDoor = nil
				targetMode = "ROOM"
			else
				targetMode = "DOOR"
			end

			-- Last Floor 2 fallback: named tunnel/gate/exit geometry in active room.
			if not bestPart then
				local fallback = nil
				local fallbackScore = -math.huge
				for _,object in ipairs(descendants) do
					if object:IsA("BasePart") then
						local score = pathWordScore(object.Name)
						if score > 0 then
							score -= math.min(
								distanceFromLocalRoot(object),
								1000
							)*.05
							if score > fallbackScore then
								fallbackScore = score
								fallback = object
							end
						end
					end
				end
				bestPart = fallback
				bestDoor = nil
				targetMode = "PATH"
			end

			if not bestPart or not bestPart.Parent then
				clearVisuals()
				return
			end

			targetPart = bestPart
			targetDoor = bestDoor
			expectedDoor = destinationNumber

			gui:SetAttribute(
				"DoorsFloor2CorrectPathRoom",
				tostring(activeRoom.Name)
			)

			highlight.Adornee =
				targetDoor or targetPart
			highlight.Enabled = true
			billboard.Adornee = targetPart
			billboard.Enabled = true
		end

		local function updateVisuals()
			if not enabled then clearVisuals() return end

			-- V97: Correct Path stays available in minecart/Halt encounters.
			-- It is now Highlight + Billboard only, with no screen tracer cost.

			if not targetPart
				or not targetPart.Parent
				or (
					targetDoor
					and (
						not targetDoor.Parent
						or isDoorsDoorOpen(targetDoor)
					)
				)
				or os.clock()-lastScan >= .35 then
				chooseCorrectDoor()
			end
			if not targetPart or not targetPart.Parent then return end

			local ownRoot =
				player.Character
				and player.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
			if not ownRoot then
				highlight.Enabled = false
				billboard.Enabled = false
				return
			end

			local distance =
				math.floor((ownRoot.Position-targetPart.Position).Magnitude+.5)
			local haltBack =
				gui:GetAttribute("DoorsHaltActive") == true
				and gui:GetAttribute("DoorsHaltTurnAround") == true

			label.Text =
				(
					haltBack
						and "HALT // TURN AROUND // "
						or "CORRECT PATH // "
				)
				..(
					targetMode == "DOOR"
						and (
							expectedDoor
								and "DOOR "..tostring(expectedDoor)
								or "NEXT DOOR"
						)
						or (
							expectedDoor
								and "ROOM "..tostring(expectedDoor)
								or "NEXT EXIT"
						)
				)
				.." // "
				..tostring(distance)
				.." STUDS"

			highlight.Adornee = targetDoor or targetPart
			highlight.Enabled = true
			billboard.Adornee = targetPart
			billboard.Enabled = true
		end

		local function setEnabled(value)
			value = value == true
			if value and not shooterSecurityAllowed() then
				enabled = false
				gui:SetAttribute("DoorsFloor2CorrectPathEsp",false)
				clearVisuals()
				refreshButton()
				setStatus("SET SHOOTER_ALLOWED_PLACE_ID TO YOUR GAME PLACEID")
				return
			end

			enabled = value
			gui:SetAttribute("DoorsFloor2CorrectPathEsp",enabled)
			if enabled then
				gui:SetAttribute("RuntimeProfile","DOORS")
				chooseCorrectDoor()
				updateVisuals()
				setStatus("FLOOR 2 CORRECT PATH ESP ON // HIGHLIGHT + LABEL // NO LINE")
			else
				clearVisuals()
				setStatus("FLOOR 2 CORRECT PATH ESP OFF")
			end
			refreshButton()
		end

		if pathButton then
			pathButton.Activated:Connect(function()
				setEnabled(not enabled)
			end)
		end

		local accumulator = 0
		trackAdvanced(
			RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function(deltaTime)
				if not enabled or menuDeleted
					or not runtimeCore.allows("DOORS") then return end
				accumulator += deltaTime
				local interval =
					gui:GetAttribute("DoorsMinecartProtectionActive") == true
						and .20
						or .16
				if accumulator < interval then return end
				accumulator = 0
				updateVisuals()
			end)
		)

		runtimeCore.stopEvent.Event:Connect(function()
			enabled = false
			gui:SetAttribute("DoorsFloor2CorrectPathEsp",false)
			clearVisuals()
			refreshButton()
		end)

		gui.Destroying:Connect(function()
			enabled = false
			gui:SetAttribute("DoorsFloor2CorrectPathEsp",false)
			gui:SetAttribute("DoorsFloor2CorrectPathRoom","--")
			clearVisuals()
			if billboard and billboard.Parent then billboard:Destroy() end
			if pathFolder and pathFolder.Parent then pathFolder:Destroy() end
		end)

		refreshButton()
	end)()

	-- --------------------------------------------------------
	-- V92 DOORS // TAP INTERACT
	-- Converts HOLD ProximityPrompts in CurrentRooms into instant TAP prompts.
	-- Only HoldDuration is changed; distance/LOS/action behavior stays original.
	-- --------------------------------------------------------
	;(function()
		local tapButton =
			gui:FindFirstChild(
				"Floor2TapInteractButton",
				true
			)

		local enabled = false
		local originals =
			setmetatable(
				{},
				{__mode = "k"}
			)
		local scanAccumulator = 0

		local function currentRooms()
			return
				workspace:FindFirstChild("CurrentRooms")
				or workspace:FindFirstChild("Rooms")
		end

		local function promptInsideDoors(prompt)
			if not prompt
				or not prompt.Parent
				or not prompt:IsA("ProximityPrompt") then
				return false
			end

			local rooms = currentRooms()
			return
				rooms ~= nil
				and prompt:IsDescendantOf(rooms)
		end

		local function rememberPrompt(prompt)
			if originals[prompt] then
				return
			end

			local clickable = nil
			pcall(function()
				clickable = prompt.ClickablePrompt
			end)

			originals[prompt] = {
				holdDuration = prompt.HoldDuration,
				clickablePrompt = clickable
			}
		end

		local function applyPrompt(prompt)
			if not enabled
				or not promptInsideDoors(prompt) then
				return false
			end

			rememberPrompt(prompt)

			pcall(function()
				prompt.HoldDuration = 0
			end)

			-- Some mobile builds expose this property; keep it tap-friendly
			-- when available without relying on it to function.
			pcall(function()
				prompt.ClickablePrompt = true
			end)

			return true
		end

		local function restorePrompt(prompt,record)
			if not prompt or not prompt.Parent or not record then
				return
			end

			pcall(function()
				prompt.HoldDuration =
					tonumber(record.holdDuration)
					or 0
			end)

			if record.clickablePrompt ~= nil then
				pcall(function()
					prompt.ClickablePrompt =
						record.clickablePrompt
				end)
			end
		end

		local function updateCount()
			local count = 0
			for prompt in pairs(originals) do
				if prompt
					and prompt.Parent
					and promptInsideDoors(prompt) then
					count += 1
				end
			end

			gui:SetAttribute(
				"DoorsTapInteractPromptCount",
				count
			)

			return count
		end

		local function scanPrompts()
			if not enabled then
				return
			end

			local rooms = currentRooms()
			if not rooms then
				gui:SetAttribute(
					"DoorsTapInteractPromptCount",
					0
				)
				return
			end

			for _,object in ipairs(
				rooms:GetDescendants()
			) do
				if object:IsA("ProximityPrompt") then
					applyPrompt(object)
				end
			end

			updateCount()
		end

		local function refreshButton()
			if not tapButton or not tapButton.Parent then
				return
			end

			if not shooterSecurityAllowed() then
				tapButton.Text =
					"TAP INTERACT [LOCKED]"
				return
			end

			setToggle(
				tapButton,
				enabled,
				"TAP INTERACT"
			)
		end

		local function setEnabled(value)
			value = value == true

			if value and not shooterSecurityAllowed() then
				enabled = false
				gui:SetAttribute(
					"DoorsTapInteract",
					false
				)
				refreshButton()
				setStatus(
					"SET SHOOTER_ALLOWED_PLACE_ID TO YOUR GAME PLACEID"
				)
				return
			end

			enabled = value
			gui:SetAttribute(
				"DoorsTapInteract",
				enabled
			)

			if enabled then
				gui:SetAttribute(
					"RuntimeProfile",
					"DOORS"
				)
				scanPrompts()
				setStatus(
					"TAP INTERACT ON // HOLD PROMPTS ARE NOW TAP"
				)
			else
				for prompt,record in pairs(originals) do
					restorePrompt(prompt,record)
				end
				table.clear(originals)
				gui:SetAttribute(
					"DoorsTapInteractPromptCount",
					0
				)
				setStatus(
					"TAP INTERACT OFF // HOLD TIMES RESTORED"
				)
			end

			refreshButton()
		end

		if tapButton then
			tapButton.Activated:Connect(function()
				setEnabled(not enabled)
			end)
		end

		workspace.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(object)
			if not enabled
				or not object:IsA("ProximityPrompt") then
				return
			end

			task.defer(function()
				if object
					and object.Parent
					and promptInsideDoors(object) then
					applyPrompt(object)
					updateCount()
				end
			end)
		end)

		trackAdvanced(
			RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(deltaTime)
				if not enabled
					or menuDeleted
					or not runtimeCore.allows("DOORS") then
					return
				end

				if gui:GetAttribute(
					"DoorsMinecartProtectionActive"
				) == true then
					return
				end

				scanAccumulator += deltaTime
				if scanAccumulator < .35 then
					return
				end
				scanAccumulator = 0

				-- Re-enforce only HoldDuration in case a room script rewrites it.
				for prompt in pairs(originals) do
					if prompt
						and prompt.Parent
						and promptInsideDoors(prompt) then
						if prompt.HoldDuration ~= 0 then
							pcall(function()
								prompt.HoldDuration = 0
							end)
						end
					end
				end

				scanPrompts()
			end)
		)

		runtimeCore.stopEvent.Event:Connect(function()
			enabled = false
			gui:SetAttribute(
				"DoorsTapInteract",
				false
			)
