			for prompt,record in pairs(originals) do
				restorePrompt(prompt,record)
			end

			table.clear(originals)
			gui:SetAttribute(
				"DoorsTapInteractPromptCount",
				0
			)
			refreshButton()
		end)

		gui.Destroying:Connect(function()
			enabled = false

			for prompt,record in pairs(originals) do
				restorePrompt(prompt,record)
			end

			gui:SetAttribute(
				"DoorsTapInteract",
				false
			)
			gui:SetAttribute(
				"DoorsTapInteractPromptCount",
				0
			)
		end)

		refreshButton()
	end)()

	-- --------------------------------------------------------
	-- V99 FLOOR 2 // DOOR ESP // STRICT NUMBER + LOW-LAG
	-- Uses the player's real current room plus the next loaded room.
	-- Strict plaque numbers: ambiguous RoomNumber/RoomId metadata is ignored.
	-- No screen tracer lines are created by this ESP.
	-- --------------------------------------------------------
	;(function()
		local doorEspButton =
			gui:FindFirstChild(
				"Floor2DoorEspButton",
				true
			)

		local enabled = false
		local records =
			setmetatable(
				{},
				{__mode = "k"}
			)
		local scanAccumulator = 0
		local visualAccumulator = 0
		local MAX_DOORS = 10

		local oldFolder =
			workspace:FindFirstChild(
				"NotRubyFloor2DoorESP"
			)
		if oldFolder then
			oldFolder:Destroy()
		end

		local folder = Instance.new("Folder")
		folder.Name = "NotRubyFloor2DoorESP"
		folder.Parent = workspace

		local function clearRecord(doorObject)
			local record = records[doorObject]
			if not record then
				return
			end

			for _,object in ipairs({
				record.highlight,
				record.billboard
			}) do
				if object and object.Parent then
					object:Destroy()
				end
			end

			records[doorObject] = nil
		end

		local function clearAll()
			local list = {}
			for doorObject in pairs(records) do
				table.insert(list,doorObject)
			end
			for _,doorObject in ipairs(list) do
				clearRecord(doorObject)
			end

			gui:SetAttribute(
				"DoorsFloor2DoorEspCount",
				0
			)
		end

		local function colorFor(kind)
			if kind == "CORRECT" then
				return
					Color3.fromRGB(70,215,106),
					Color3.fromRGB(203,255,214)
			elseif kind == "DUPE" then
				return
					Color3.fromRGB(239,67,77),
					Color3.fromRGB(255,215,219)
			end

			return
				Color3.fromRGB(92,165,235),
				Color3.fromRGB(215,238,255)
		end

		local function addRecord(
			doorObject,
			hitbox,
			roomName,
			displayedNumber,
			expectedNumber,
			kind
		)
			if records[doorObject]
				or not doorObject
				or not doorObject.Parent
				or not hitbox
				or not hitbox.Parent then
				return
			end

			local fill,outline = colorFor(kind)

			local highlight = Instance.new("Highlight")
			highlight.Name = "NotRubyFloor2DoorHighlight"
			highlight.DepthMode =
				Enum.HighlightDepthMode.AlwaysOnTop
			highlight.FillColor = fill
			highlight.OutlineColor = outline
			highlight.FillTransparency = .83
			highlight.OutlineTransparency = .02
			highlight.Adornee = doorObject
			highlight.Enabled = true
			highlight.Parent = folder

			local billboard = Instance.new("BillboardGui")
			billboard.Name = "NotRubyFloor2DoorLabel"
			billboard.AlwaysOnTop = true
			billboard.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(240,34)
			billboard.StudsOffset = Vector3.new(0,2.7,0)
			billboard.MaxDistance = 5000
			billboard.Adornee = hitbox
			billboard.Parent = gui

			local label = Instance.new("TextLabel")
			label.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1,1)
			label.BackgroundColor3 =
				Color3.fromRGB(22,25,30)
			label.BackgroundTransparency = .10
			label.BorderSizePixel = 0
			label.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBlack
			label.TextSize = 8
			label.TextColor3 = outline
			label.TextStrokeTransparency = .62
			label.Text = "DOOR"
			label.Parent = billboard
			corner(label,8)
			addStroke(label,fill,1,.16)

			records[doorObject] = {
				hitbox = hitbox,
				room = tostring(roomName or "--"),
				displayed = displayedNumber,
				expected = expectedNumber,
				kind = kind or "DOOR",
				highlight = highlight,
				billboard = billboard,
				label = label,
				fill = fill,
				outline = outline
			}
		end

		local function getDoorEspCurrentRoom(currentRooms)
			if not currentRooms then
				return nil
			end

			local function findRoom(value)
				local number = tonumber(value)
				if not number then
					return nil
				end

				number = math.floor(number+.5)

				return
					currentRooms:FindFirstChild(tostring(number))
					or currentRooms:FindFirstChild(
						string.format("%04d",number)
					)
			end

			for _,holder in ipairs({
				player,
				player.Character
			}) do
				if holder then
					for _,name in ipairs({
						"CurrentRoom",
						"RoomNumber",
						"Room"
					}) do
						local ok,value = pcall(function()
							return holder:GetAttribute(name)
						end)

						if ok and value ~= nil then
							local room = findRoom(value)
							if room then
								return room
							end
						end
					end
				end
			end

			local replicatedStorage =
				game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
			local gameData =
				replicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("GameData")

			if gameData then
				for _,name in ipairs({
					"CurrentRoom",
					"RoomNumber"
				}) do
					local valueObject =
						gameData:FindFirstChild(name)

					if valueObject
						and valueObject:IsA("ValueBase") then
						local room = findRoom(valueObject.Value)
						if room then
							return room
						end
					end
				end
			end

			local ownRoot =
				player.Character
					and player.Character:FindFirstChild(
						"HumanoidRootPart"
					)

			if ownRoot then
				local bestRoom = nil
				local bestDistance = math.huge
				local bestNumber = -math.huge

				for _,room in ipairs(
					getRecentDoorsRooms(currentRooms,8)
				) do
					local roomNumber = tonumber(room.Name)

					if roomNumber and room:IsA("Model") then
						local ok,cf,size = pcall(function()
							local boxCf,boxSize = room:GetBoundingBox()
							return boxCf,boxSize
						end)

						if ok and cf and size then
							local p = cf:PointToObjectSpace(ownRoot.Position)
							local dx =
								math.max(math.abs(p.X)-size.X*.5,0)
							local dy =
								math.max(math.abs(p.Y)-size.Y*.5,0)
							local dz =
								math.max(math.abs(p.Z)-size.Z*.5,0)
							local distance =
								Vector3.new(dx,dy,dz).Magnitude

							if distance < bestDistance-.05
								or (
									math.abs(distance-bestDistance) <= .05
									and roomNumber > bestNumber
								) then

								bestDistance = distance
								bestNumber = roomNumber
								bestRoom = room
							end
						end
					end
				end

				if bestRoom then
					return bestRoom
				end
			end

			return getActiveDoorsRoom(currentRooms)
		end

		local function candidateRooms()
			local currentRooms = getDoorsCurrentRooms()
			if not currentRooms then
				return {}
			end

			local activeRoom =
				getDoorEspCurrentRoom(currentRooms)
			local result = {}
			local added = {}

			local function add(room)
				if room
					and room.Parent
					and not added[room] then
					added[room] = true
					table.insert(result,room)
				end
			end

			add(activeRoom)

			local number =
				activeRoom
				and tonumber(activeRoom.Name)
				or nil

			if number then
				add(
					currentRooms:FindFirstChild(
						tostring(number+1)
					)
					or currentRooms:FindFirstChild(
						string.format("%04d",number+1)
					)
				)
			end

			return result
		end

		local function scanDoors()
			if gui:GetAttribute(
				"DoorsMinecartProtectionActive"
			) == true then
				return
			end

			if not enabled
				or menuDeleted
				or not gui.Parent
				or not runtimeCore.allows("DOORS") then
				clearAll()
				return
			end

			local keep = {}
			local count = 0

			for _,room in ipairs(candidateRooms()) do
				if count >= MAX_DOORS then
					break
				end

				local descendants = room:GetDescendants()
				local roomNumber = tonumber(room.Name)
				local expectedNumber =
					roomNumber
						and roomNumber+1
						or nil

				for _,doorObject in ipairs(
					getDoorCandidates(
						room,
						descendants
					)
				) do
					if count >= MAX_DOORS then
						break
					end

					local hitbox =
						findDoorHitbox(doorObject)

					if hitbox
						and not isDoorsDoorOpen(doorObject) then

						local displayedNumber =
							readDoorDisplayedNumber(
								doorObject,
								room,
								descendants,
								hitbox,
								expectedNumber
							)

						local fake =
							isDoorsDupeDoor(
								doorObject,
								expectedNumber,
								displayedNumber
							)

						local kind = "DOOR"
						if fake then
							kind = "DUPE"
						elseif expectedNumber ~= nil
							and displayedNumber == expectedNumber then
							kind = "CORRECT"
						end

						keep[doorObject] = true
						count += 1

						local record =
							records[doorObject]

						if not record then
							addRecord(
								doorObject,
								hitbox,
								room.Name,
								displayedNumber,
								expectedNumber,
								kind
							)
						else
							record.hitbox = hitbox
							record.room =
								tostring(room.Name)
							record.displayed =
								displayedNumber
							record.expected =
								expectedNumber
							record.kind = kind

							local fill,outline =
								colorFor(kind)
							record.fill = fill
							record.outline = outline

							record.highlight.Adornee =
								doorObject
							record.highlight.FillColor =
								fill
							record.highlight.OutlineColor =
								outline
							record.billboard.Adornee =
								hitbox
							record.label.TextColor3 =
								outline
						end
					end
				end
			end

			local stale = {}
			for doorObject in pairs(records) do
				if not doorObject
					or not doorObject.Parent
					or not keep[doorObject] then
					table.insert(stale,doorObject)
				end
			end

			for _,doorObject in ipairs(stale) do
				clearRecord(doorObject)
			end

			gui:SetAttribute(
				"DoorsFloor2DoorEspCount",
				count
			)
		end

		local function updateVisuals()
			if not enabled then
				return
			end

			local ownRoot =
				player.Character
				and player.Character:FindFirstChild(
					"HumanoidRootPart"
				)

			for doorObject,record in pairs(records) do
				if not doorObject
					or not doorObject.Parent
					or not record.hitbox
					or not record.hitbox.Parent then
					clearRecord(doorObject)
				else
					local distance = "--"
					if ownRoot then
						distance =
							tostring(
								math.floor(
									(
										ownRoot.Position
										-record.hitbox.Position
									).Magnitude
									+.5
								)
							)
					end

					local title =
						record.kind == "DUPE"
							and "DUPE DOOR"
							or (
								record.kind == "CORRECT"
									and "CORRECT DOOR"
									or "DOOR"
							)

					local resolvedNumber =
						record.kind == "CORRECT"
							and record.expected
							or record.displayed

					local numberText =
						resolvedNumber ~= nil
							and tostring(
								resolvedNumber
							)
							or "?"

					record.label.Text =
						title
						.." "
						..numberText
						.." // ROOM "
						..record.room
						.." // "
						..distance
						.." STUDS"

					record.highlight.Enabled = true
					record.billboard.Enabled = true
				end
			end
		end

		local function refreshButton()
			if not doorEspButton
				or not doorEspButton.Parent then
				return
			end

			if not shooterSecurityAllowed() then
				doorEspButton.Text =
					"DOOR ESP [LOCKED]"
				return
			end

			setToggle(
				doorEspButton,
				enabled,
				"DOOR ESP"
			)
		end

		local function setEnabled(value)
			value = value == true

			if value and not shooterSecurityAllowed() then
				enabled = false
				gui:SetAttribute(
					"DoorsFloor2DoorEsp",
					false
				)
				clearAll()
				refreshButton()
				setStatus(
					"SET SHOOTER_ALLOWED_PLACE_ID TO YOUR GAME PLACEID"
				)
				return
			end

			enabled = value
			gui:SetAttribute(
				"DoorsFloor2DoorEsp",
				enabled
			)

			if enabled then
				gui:SetAttribute(
					"RuntimeProfile",
					"DOORS"
				)
				scanDoors()
				updateVisuals()
				setStatus(
					"FLOOR 2 DOOR ESP V99 // STRICT NUMBERS // LOW-LAG // NO LINE"
				)
			else
				clearAll()
				setStatus(
					"FLOOR 2 DOOR ESP OFF"
				)
			end

			refreshButton()
		end

		if doorEspButton then
			doorEspButton.Activated:Connect(function()
				setEnabled(not enabled)
			end)
		end

		trackAdvanced(
			RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(deltaTime)
				if not enabled
					or menuDeleted
					or not runtimeCore.allows("DOORS") then
					return
				end

				if gui:GetAttribute(
					"DoorsMinecartProtectionActive"
				) == true then
					for _,record in pairs(records) do
						if record.highlight then record.highlight.Enabled = false end
						if record.billboard then record.billboard.Enabled = false end
					end
					return
				end

				scanAccumulator += deltaTime
				visualAccumulator += deltaTime

				if scanAccumulator >= 1.35 then
					scanAccumulator = 0
					scanDoors()
				end

				if visualAccumulator >= .20 then
					visualAccumulator = 0
					updateVisuals()
				end
			end)
		)

		runtimeCore.stopEvent.Event:Connect(function()
			enabled = false
			gui:SetAttribute(
				"DoorsFloor2DoorEsp",
				false
			)
			clearAll()
			refreshButton()
		end)

		gui.Destroying:Connect(function()
			enabled = false
			gui:SetAttribute(
				"DoorsFloor2DoorEsp",
				false
			)
			gui:SetAttribute(
				"DoorsFloor2DoorEspCount",
				0
			)
			clearAll()

			if folder and folder.Parent then
				folder:Destroy()
			end
		end)

		refreshButton()
	end)()

	-- --------------------------------------------------------
	-- V95 FLOOR 2 // MINECART SEEK PROTECTION + MINECART ESP
	-- Protection does NOT touch cart physics, speed, or player position.
	-- It only pauses expensive NOT RUBY scans while the player rides.
	-- Minecart ESP is Highlight + Billboard only: NO tracer line.
	-- --------------------------------------------------------
	;(function()
		local protectButton =
			gui:FindFirstChild("Floor2MinecartProtectButton",true)
		local minecartEspButton =
			gui:FindFirstChild("Floor2MinecartEspButton",true)

		local protectionEnabled =
			gui:GetAttribute("DoorsMinecartProtection") == true
		local minecartEspEnabled = false
		local protectionActive = false
		local protectionAccumulator = 0
		local scanAccumulator = 0
		local visualAccumulator = 0
		local MAX_CARTS = 8

		local records = setmetatable({}, {__mode = "k"})

		local oldFolder =
			workspace:FindFirstChild("NotRubyFloor2MinecartESP")
		if oldFolder then
			oldFolder:Destroy()
		end

		local folder = Instance.new("Folder")
		folder.Name = "NotRubyFloor2MinecartESP"
		folder.Parent = workspace

		local function compactCart(value)
			return string.lower(
				tostring(value or "")
			):gsub("[^%w]","")
		end

		local function hasCartWord(value)
			local c = compactCart(value)
			return
				string.find(c,"minecart",1,true) ~= nil
				or string.find(c,"railcart",1,true) ~= nil
				or string.find(c,"cartseat",1,true) ~= nil
				or c == "cart"
				or c == "minecar"
		end

		local function hasMinecartAttribute(object)
			if not object then return false end
			for _,name in ipairs({
				"Minecart","IsMinecart","MineCart","IsMineCart",
				"RailCart","IsCart"
			}) do
				local ok,value = pcall(function()
					return object:GetAttribute(name)
				end)
				if ok and value == true then
					return true
				end
			end
			return false
		end

		local function minecartRootFrom(object)
			if not object or not object.Parent then return nil end
			local currentRooms = getDoorsCurrentRooms()
			local cursor = object
			local nearestModel = nil
			local best = nil

			for _ = 1,10 do
				if not cursor
					or cursor == workspace
					or cursor == currentRooms then
					break
				end

				if cursor:IsA("Model") then
					nearestModel = nearestModel or cursor
					if hasCartWord(cursor.Name)
						or hasMinecartAttribute(cursor) then
						best = cursor
					end
				end

				if hasCartWord(cursor.Name)
					or hasMinecartAttribute(cursor) then
					if cursor:IsA("Model") then
						best = cursor
					elseif cursor.Parent
						and cursor.Parent:IsA("Model") then
						best = cursor.Parent
					end
				end

				cursor = cursor.Parent
			end

			return best or nearestModel
		end

		local function minecartPart(rootObject)
			if not rootObject or not rootObject.Parent then return nil end
			if rootObject:IsA("BasePart") then return rootObject end

			if rootObject:IsA("Model") then
				for _,name in ipairs({
					"MinecartSeat","CartSeat","VehicleSeat",
					"Seat","Main","Base"
				}) do
					local part = rootObject:FindFirstChild(name,true)
					if part and part:IsA("BasePart") then
						return part
					end
				end

				return
					rootObject.PrimaryPart
					or rootObject:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart",true)
			end

			return rootObject:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart",true)
		end

		local function isMinecartCandidate(object)
			if not object
				or not object.Parent
				or object:GetAttribute("NotRubyFakeEntity") == true
				or object:GetAttribute("LocalOnly") == true then
				return false
			end

			if hasCartWord(object.Name)
				or hasMinecartAttribute(object) then
				return true
			end

			if object:IsA("Seat")
				or object:IsA("VehicleSeat") then
				local cursor = object.Parent
				for _ = 1,5 do
					if not cursor then break end
					if hasCartWord(cursor.Name)
						or hasMinecartAttribute(cursor) then
						return true
					end
					cursor = cursor.Parent
				end
			end

			return false
		end

		local function currentMinecartSeat()
			local character = player.Character
			local humanoid =
				character
				and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
			local seat = humanoid and humanoid.SeatPart or nil

			if not seat or not seat.Parent then
				return nil,nil
			end

			if isMinecartCandidate(seat) then
				return seat,minecartRootFrom(seat)
			end

			local rootObject = minecartRootFrom(seat)
			if rootObject
				and (
					hasCartWord(rootObject.Name)
					or hasMinecartAttribute(rootObject)
				) then
				return seat,rootObject
			end

			return nil,nil
		end

		local function refreshProtectButton()
			if not protectButton or not protectButton.Parent then return end

			if not shooterSecurityAllowed() then
				protectButton.Text = "MINECART PROTECT [LOCKED]"
				return
			end

			if protectionActive then
				protectButton.Text = "MINECART PROTECT [ACTIVE]"
				protectButton.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(53,92,66)
				return
			end

			setToggle(
				protectButton,
				protectionEnabled,
				"MINECART PROTECT"
			)
		end

		local function refreshEspButton()
			if not minecartEspButton or not minecartEspButton.Parent then
				return
			end

			if not shooterSecurityAllowed() then
				minecartEspButton.Text = "MINECART ESP [LOCKED]"
				return
			end

			setToggle(
				minecartEspButton,
				minecartEspEnabled,
				"MINECART ESP"
			)
		end

		local function setProtectionActive(value)
			value = value == true
			if protectionActive == value then return end

			protectionActive = value
			gui:SetAttribute("DoorsMinecartProtectionActive",value)

			if value then
				setStatus(
					"MINECART SEEK PROTECTION // LOW-LAG MODE ACTIVE"
				)
			else
				setStatus(
					"MINECART PROTECTION // NORMAL SCANS RESTORED"
				)
			end

			refreshProtectButton()
		end

		local function clearRecord(rootObject)
			local record = records[rootObject]
			if not record then return end

			for _,object in ipairs({
				record.highlight,
				record.billboard
			}) do
				if object and object.Parent then
					object:Destroy()
				end
			end

			records[rootObject] = nil
		end

		local function clearMinecartEsp()
			local roots = {}
			for rootObject in pairs(records) do
				table.insert(roots,rootObject)
			end
			for _,rootObject in ipairs(roots) do
				clearRecord(rootObject)
			end
			gui:SetAttribute("DoorsMinecartEspCount",0)
		end

		local function addRecord(rootObject,part,roomName)
			if records[rootObject]
				or not rootObject
				or not rootObject.Parent
				or not part
				or not part.Parent then
				return
			end

			local highlight = Instance.new("Highlight")
			highlight.Name = "NotRubyFloor2MinecartHighlight"
			highlight.Adornee = rootObject
			highlight.DepthMode = Enum.HighlightDepthMode.AlwaysOnTop
			highlight.FillColor = Color3.fromRGB(67,181,225)
			highlight.OutlineColor = Color3.fromRGB(205,244,255)
			highlight.FillTransparency = .82
			highlight.OutlineTransparency = .02
			highlight.Enabled = true
			highlight.Parent = folder

			local billboard = Instance.new("BillboardGui")
			billboard.Name = "NotRubyFloor2MinecartLabel"
			billboard.Adornee = part
			billboard.AlwaysOnTop = true
			billboard.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(225,34)
			billboard.StudsOffset = Vector3.new(0,2.7,0)
			billboard.MaxDistance = 5000
			billboard.Parent = gui

			local label = Instance.new("TextLabel")
			label.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1,1)
			label.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(22,36,43)
			label.BackgroundTransparency = .10
			label.BorderSizePixel = 0
			label.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBlack
			label.TextSize = 9
			label.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(213,245,255)
			label.TextStrokeTransparency = .62
			label.Text = "MINECART"
			label.Parent = billboard
			corner(label,8)
			addStroke(label,Color3.fromRGB(67,181,225),1,.14)

			records[rootObject] = {
				part = part,
				room = tostring(roomName or "--"),
				highlight = highlight,
				billboard = billboard,
				label = label
			}
		end

		local function scanMinecarts()
			if not minecartEspEnabled
				or menuDeleted
				or not gui.Parent
				or not runtimeCore.allows("DOORS") then
				return
			end

			local currentRooms = getDoorsCurrentRooms()
			if not currentRooms then
				clearMinecartEsp()
				return
			end

			local keep = {}
			local count = 0

			for _,room in ipairs(getRecentDoorsRooms(currentRooms,5)) do
				if count >= MAX_CARTS then break end

				for _,object in ipairs(room:GetDescendants()) do
					if count >= MAX_CARTS then break end

					if (
						object:IsA("Model")
						or object:IsA("Seat")
						or object:IsA("VehicleSeat")
						or object:IsA("BasePart")
					)
						and isMinecartCandidate(object) then

						local rootObject = minecartRootFrom(object)
						local part =
							rootObject and minecartPart(rootObject) or nil

						if rootObject
							and rootObject.Parent
							and part
							and part.Parent
							and not keep[rootObject] then

							keep[rootObject] = true
							count += 1

							if not records[rootObject] then
								addRecord(rootObject,part,room.Name)
							else
								local record = records[rootObject]
								record.part = part
								record.room = tostring(room.Name)
								record.highlight.Adornee = rootObject
								record.billboard.Adornee = part
							end
						end
					end
				end
			end

			local stale = {}
			for rootObject in pairs(records) do
				if not rootObject
					or not rootObject.Parent
					or not keep[rootObject] then
					table.insert(stale,rootObject)
				end
			end

			for _,rootObject in ipairs(stale) do
				clearRecord(rootObject)
			end

			gui:SetAttribute("DoorsMinecartEspCount",count)
		end

		local function updateVisuals()
			if not minecartEspEnabled then return end

			local ownRoot =
				player.Character
				and player.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
			local ridingRoot =
				select(2,currentMinecartSeat())

			for rootObject,record in pairs(records) do
				if not rootObject
					or not rootObject.Parent
					or not record.part
					or not record.part.Parent then
					clearRecord(rootObject)
				else
					local distance = "--"
					if ownRoot then
						distance =
							tostring(
								math.floor(
									(ownRoot.Position-record.part.Position).Magnitude
									+.5
								)
							)
					end

					record.label.Text =
						(
							ridingRoot == rootObject
								and "MINECART [RIDING]"
								or "MINECART"
						)
						.." // ROOM "
						..record.room
						.." // "
						..distance
						.." STUDS"

					record.highlight.Enabled = true
					record.billboard.Enabled = true
				end
			end
		end

		local function setProtectionEnabled(value)
			value = value == true

			if value and not shooterSecurityAllowed() then
				protectionEnabled = false
				gui:SetAttribute("DoorsMinecartProtection",false)
				setProtectionActive(false)
				refreshProtectButton()
				return
			end

			protectionEnabled = value
			gui:SetAttribute("DoorsMinecartProtection",value)

			if not value then
				setProtectionActive(false)
				setStatus("MINECART SEEK PROTECTION OFF")
			else
				setStatus(
					"MINECART SEEK PROTECTION ON // AUTO LOW-LAG"
				)
			end

			refreshProtectButton()
		end

		local function setMinecartEsp(value)
			value = value == true

			if value and not shooterSecurityAllowed() then
				minecartEspEnabled = false
				gui:SetAttribute("DoorsMinecartEsp",false)
				clearMinecartEsp()
				refreshEspButton()
				return
			end

			minecartEspEnabled = value
			gui:SetAttribute("DoorsMinecartEsp",value)

			if value then
				gui:SetAttribute("RuntimeProfile","DOORS")
				scanMinecarts()
				updateVisuals()
				setStatus(
					"MINECART ESP ON // HIGHLIGHT + LABEL // NO LINE"
				)
			else
				clearMinecartEsp()
				setStatus("MINECART ESP OFF")
			end

			refreshEspButton()
		end

		if protectButton then
			protectButton.Activated:Connect(function()
				setProtectionEnabled(not protectionEnabled)
			end)
		end

		if minecartEspButton then
			minecartEspButton.Activated:Connect(function()
				setMinecartEsp(not minecartEspEnabled)
			end)
		end

		trackAdvanced(
			RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(deltaTime)
				if menuDeleted
					or not runtimeCore.allows("DOORS") then
					if protectionActive then
						setProtectionActive(false)
					end
					return
				end

				protectionAccumulator += deltaTime
				scanAccumulator += deltaTime
				visualAccumulator += deltaTime

				if protectionAccumulator >= .10 then
					protectionAccumulator = 0
					local seat = select(1,currentMinecartSeat())

					setProtectionActive(
						protectionEnabled
						and shooterSecurityAllowed()
						and seat ~= nil
					)
				end

				local scanDelay =
					protectionActive and 2.0 or .80
				if minecartEspEnabled
					and scanAccumulator >= scanDelay then
					scanAccumulator = 0
					scanMinecarts()
				end

				local visualDelay =
					protectionActive and .28 or .18
				if minecartEspEnabled
					and visualAccumulator >= visualDelay then
					visualAccumulator = 0
					updateVisuals()
				end
			end)
		)

		runtimeCore.stopEvent.Event:Connect(function()
			protectionEnabled = false
			minecartEspEnabled = false
			setProtectionActive(false)
			gui:SetAttribute("DoorsMinecartProtection",false)
			gui:SetAttribute("DoorsMinecartEsp",false)
			clearMinecartEsp()
			refreshProtectButton()
			refreshEspButton()
		end)

		gui.Destroying:Connect(function()
			protectionEnabled = false
			minecartEspEnabled = false
			gui:SetAttribute("DoorsMinecartProtection",false)
			gui:SetAttribute("DoorsMinecartProtectionActive",false)
			gui:SetAttribute("DoorsMinecartEsp",false)
			gui:SetAttribute("DoorsMinecartEspCount",0)
			clearMinecartEsp()

			if folder and folder.Parent then
				folder:Destroy()
			end
		end)

		if protectionEnabled and not shooterSecurityAllowed() then
			protectionEnabled = false
			gui:SetAttribute("DoorsMinecartProtection",false)
		end

		refreshProtectButton()
		refreshEspButton()
	end)()

	-- --------------------------------------------------------
	-- V79 FLOOR 2 // LOCAL MONSTER SPAWNER
	-- --------------------------------------------------------
	;(function()
		local InsertService = game:GetService("InsertService")
		local serial = 0
		local ASSETS = {
			GIGGLE = "70665402954663",
			QUEEN = "113634923235398",
			GRUMBLE = "137682565641802",
			GLOOMBAT = "130911497544825"
		}
		local COLORS = {
			GIGGLE = Color3.fromRGB(255,117,95),
			QUEEN = Color3.fromRGB(255,67,97),
			GRUMBLE = Color3.fromRGB(255,93,72),
			GLOOMBAT = Color3.fromRGB(184,104,255)
		}

		local oldFolder = workspace:FindFirstChild("NotRubyFloor2SpawnedMonsters")
		if oldFolder then
			oldFolder:Destroy()
		end
		local spawnFolder = Instance.new("Folder")
		spawnFolder.Name = "NotRubyFloor2SpawnedMonsters"
		spawnFolder:SetAttribute("NotRubyFakeEntity",true)
		spawnFolder:SetAttribute("LocalOnly",true)
		spawnFolder.Parent = workspace

		local function getButton(name)
			for _,object in ipairs(gui:GetDescendants()) do
				if object:IsA("TextButton") and object.Name == name then
					return object
				end
			end
			return nil
		end

		local function updateSpawnCount()
			local count = 0
			for _,object in ipairs(spawnFolder:GetChildren()) do
				if object and object.Parent then
					count += 1
				end
			end
			gui:SetAttribute("DoorsFloor2SpawnedMonsterCount",count)
			return count
		end

		local function stripScripts(rootObject)
			for _,object in ipairs(rootObject:GetDescendants()) do
				if object:IsA("Script")
					or object:IsA("LocalScript")
					or object:IsA("ModuleScript") then
					object:Destroy()
				end
			end
		end

		local function tryGetObjects(assetId)
			local ok,objects = pcall(function()
				return game:GetObjects("rbxassetid://"..tostring(assetId))
			end)
			if not ok then
				return nil,"GETOBJECTS: "..tostring(objects)
			end
			if type(objects) ~= "table" or not objects[1] then
				return nil,"GETOBJECTS: EMPTY"
			end
			return objects[1],"GETOBJECTS"
		end

		local function tryInsertService(assetId)
			local ok,container = pcall(function()
				return InsertService:LoadAsset(tonumber(assetId))
			end)
			if not ok then
				return nil,"INSERTSERVICE: "..tostring(container)
			end
			if not container then
				return nil,"INSERTSERVICE: EMPTY"
			end
			local children = container:GetChildren()
			if #children == 1 then
				local only = children[1]
				only.Parent = nil
				container:Destroy()
				return only,"INSERTSERVICE"
			end
			return container,"INSERTSERVICE"
		end

		local function normalizeImported(imported,kind,assetId)
			if not imported then
				return nil,nil
			end
			local model
			if imported:IsA("Model") then
				model = imported
			else
				model = Instance.new("Model")
				model.Name = "Imported"..kind
				imported.Parent = model
			end
			stripScripts(model)
			local rootPart =
				model.PrimaryPart
				or model:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart",true)
				or model:FindFirstChild("Root",true)
				or model:FindFirstChild("Torso",true)
				or model:FindFirstChild("Head",true)
				or model:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart",true)
			if not rootPart or not rootPart:IsA("BasePart") then
				model:Destroy()
				return nil,nil
			end
			model.PrimaryPart = rootPart
			model:SetAttribute("NotRubyFakeEntity",true)
			model:SetAttribute("LocalOnly",true)
			model:SetAttribute("Floor2SpawnedMonster",true)
			model:SetAttribute("Floor2SpawnKind",kind)
			model:SetAttribute("FakeEntityKind",kind)
			model:SetAttribute("SourceAssetId",tostring(assetId))
			for _,part in ipairs(model:GetDescendants()) do
				if part:IsA("BasePart") then
					part.Anchored = true
					part.CanCollide = false
					part.CanTouch = false
					part.CanQuery = true
					part.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
					part.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
				end
			end
			return model,rootPart
		end

		local function makeFallback(kind,assetId)
			local model = Instance.new("Model")
			model.Name = "Floor2LocalMonsterFallback"
			model:SetAttribute("NotRubyFakeEntity",true)
			model:SetAttribute("LocalOnly",true)
			model:SetAttribute("Floor2SpawnedMonster",true)
			model:SetAttribute("Floor2SpawnKind",kind)
			model:SetAttribute("FakeEntityKind",kind)
			model:SetAttribute("SourceAssetId",tostring(assetId))
			model:SetAttribute("AssetLoadFailed",true)
			local part = Instance.new("Part")
			part.Name = "Body"
			part.Size =
				kind == "GLOOMBAT"
					and Vector3.new(3.2,1.2,4.2)
					or Vector3.new(3.2,3.2,2.2)
			part.Color = COLORS[kind] or Color3.fromRGB(90,90,100)
			part.Material = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
			part.Anchored = true
			part.CanCollide = false
			part.Parent = model
			model.PrimaryPart = part
			return model,part
		end

		local function spawnCFrame()
			local character = player.Character
			local rootPart =
				character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
			if not rootPart then
				return nil
			end
			return rootPart.CFrame*CFrame.new(0,1.5,-10)
		end

		local function addLabel(model,rootPart,kind)
			local billboard = Instance.new("BillboardGui")
			billboard.Name = "NotRubyFloor2SpawnLabel"
			billboard.Adornee = rootPart
			billboard.AlwaysOnTop = true
			billboard.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(220,34)
			billboard.StudsOffset = Vector3.new(0,3.4,0)
			billboard.Parent = rootPart
			local label = Instance.new("TextLabel")
			label.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1,1)
			label.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(28,27,29)
			label.BackgroundTransparency = .12
			label.BorderSizePixel = 0
			label.Text =
				kind.." // LOCAL SPAWN // "
				..(
					model:GetAttribute("AssetLoadFailed") == true
					and "FALLBACK"
					or "MODEL"
				)
			label.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(245,238,230)
			label.TextSize = 9
			label.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBlack
			label.Parent = billboard
			corner(label,8)
			addStroke(label,COLORS[kind] or accent,1,.2)
		end

		local function spawnMonster(kind)
			if not shooterSecurityAllowed() then
				setStatus("FLOOR 2 MONSTER SPAWNER [LOCKED]")
				return
			end
			kind = string.upper(tostring(kind or "GIGGLE"))
			local assetId = ASSETS[kind]
			if not assetId then
				setStatus("SPAWNER ERROR // UNKNOWN MONSTER")
				return
			end
			local targetCFrame = spawnCFrame()
			if not targetCFrame then
				setStatus("SPAWNER ERROR // CHARACTER NOT READY")
				return
			end

			serial += 1
			local imported,method = tryGetObjects(assetId)
			if not imported then
				imported,method = tryInsertService(assetId)
			end

			local model,rootPart = normalizeImported(imported,kind,assetId)
			if not model or not rootPart then
				model,rootPart = makeFallback(kind,assetId)
				method = method or "ASSET FAILED"
			end

			model.Name = "NotRubyFloor2Spawn_"..tostring(serial)
			model.Parent = spawnFolder
			local moved = pcall(function()
				model:PivotTo(targetCFrame)
			end)
			if not moved then
				pcall(function()
					rootPart.CFrame = targetCFrame
				end)
			end

			addLabel(model,rootPart,kind)
			updateSpawnCount()
			setStatus(
				"SPAWNED "..kind.." // LOCAL // "..tostring(method or "FALLBACK")
			)
		end

		local function bind(buttonName,kind)
			local button = getButton(buttonName)
			if button then
				button.Activated:Connect(function()
					spawnMonster(kind)
				end)
			end
		end

		bind("Floor2SpawnGiggle","GIGGLE")
		bind("Floor2SpawnQueen","QUEEN")
		bind("Floor2SpawnGrumble","GRUMBLE")
		bind("Floor2SpawnGloombat","GLOOMBAT")

		local clearButton = getButton("Floor2ClearSpawnedMonsters")
		if clearButton then
			clearButton.Activated:Connect(function()
				if not shooterSecurityAllowed() then
					setStatus("FLOOR 2 MONSTER SPAWNER [LOCKED]")
					return
				end
				for _,object in ipairs(spawnFolder:GetChildren()) do
					object:Destroy()
				end
				updateSpawnCount()
				setStatus("FLOOR 2 SPAWNED MONSTERS CLEARED")
			end)
		end

		runtimeCore.stopEvent.Event:Connect(function()
			for _,object in ipairs(spawnFolder:GetChildren()) do
				object:Destroy()
			end
			updateSpawnCount()
		end)

		gui.Destroying:Connect(function()
			gui:SetAttribute("DoorsFloor2SpawnedMonsterCount",0)
			if spawnFolder and spawnFolder.Parent then
				spawnFolder:Destroy()
			end
		end)
	end)()

	-- --------------------------------------------------------
	-- V83 FLOOR 2 // FULL GIGGLE RAGDOLL + INVISIBLE-WALL DROP
	-- --------------------------------------------------------
	;(function()
		local tortured = setmetatable({}, {__mode = "k"})
		local barrierOriginalGroups = setmetatable({}, {__mode = "k"})
		local phaseCooldown = setmetatable({}, {__mode = "k"})
		local scanAccumulator = 0
		local pushAccumulator = 0
		local barrierAccumulator = 0
		local PhysicsService = game:GetService("PhysicsService")
		local GIGGLE_COLLISION_GROUP = "NotRubyTortureGiggle"
		local BARRIER_COLLISION_GROUP = "NotRubyInvisibleBarrier"

		local function ensureCollisionGroup(name)
			local ok = pcall(function()
				PhysicsService:RegisterCollisionGroup(name)
			end)
			if not ok then
				pcall(function()
					PhysicsService:CreateCollisionGroup(name)
				end)
			end
		end

		ensureCollisionGroup(GIGGLE_COLLISION_GROUP)
		ensureCollisionGroup(BARRIER_COLLISION_GROUP)

		-- V82: the Giggle assembly never collides with its own pieces.
		-- This prevents the tentacles/body from fighting each other and
		-- launching the model apart.
		pcall(function()
			PhysicsService:CollisionGroupSetCollidable(
				GIGGLE_COLLISION_GROUP,
				GIGGLE_COLLISION_GROUP,
				false
			)
		end)

		pcall(function()
			PhysicsService:CollisionGroupSetCollidable(
				GIGGLE_COLLISION_GROUP,
				BARRIER_COLLISION_GROUP,
				false
			)
		end)

		local function getButton()
			for _,object in ipairs(gui:GetDescendants()) do
				if object:IsA("TextButton")
					and object.Name == "Floor2TortureGiggleButton" then
					return object
				end
			end
			return nil
		end

		local function getCountLabel()
			for _,object in ipairs(gui:GetDescendants()) do
				if object:IsA("TextLabel")
					and object.Name == "Floor2TortureGiggleCount" then
					return object
				end
			end
			return nil
		end

		local function compact(value)
			return string.lower(tostring(value or ""):gsub("[^%w]",""))
		end

		local function hasAnyWord(value,words)
			local c = compact(value)
			for _,word in ipairs(words) do
				if string.find(c,word,1,true) then
					return true
				end
			end
			return false
		end

		local function isInvisibleBarrier(part)
			if not part
				or not part:IsA("BasePart")
				or not part.Parent
				or not part.CanCollide then
				return false
			end

			local name = compact(part.Name)
			local explicitBarrier =
				hasAnyWord(name,{
					"invisiblewall",
					"inviswall",
					"barrier",
					"boundary",
					"blocker",
					"wallblock",
					"collisionwall",
					"clipwall",
					"outofboundswall"
				})

			local invisibleEnough = part.Transparency >= .82

			if not explicitBarrier and not invisibleEnough then
				return false
			end

			local sx = part.Size.X
			local sy = part.Size.Y
			local sz = part.Size.Z

			-- Do not phase normal invisible floors/ceilings. The feature targets
			-- tall invisible walls/boundaries so Giggle can be pushed off ledges.
			local looksLikeHorizontalSurface =
				sy <= 2.25
				and sx >= 4
				and sz >= 4

			if looksLikeHorizontalSurface
				and not explicitBarrier then
				return false
			end

			if hasAnyWord(name,{"floor","ground","ceiling","roof"})
				and not hasAnyWord(name,{"wall","barrier","boundary"}) then
				return false
			end

			local thinHorizontalAxis = math.min(sx,sz)
			local wallLikeShape =
				sy >= 3.5
				and (
					thinHorizontalAxis <= 5
					or sy >= thinHorizontalAxis*1.15
				)

			return explicitBarrier or (invisibleEnough and wallLikeShape)
		end

		local function phaseBarrier(part)
			if not isInvisibleBarrier(part) then
				return false
			end

			if barrierOriginalGroups[part] == nil then
				local ok,currentGroup = pcall(function()
					return part.CollisionGroup
				end)
				if ok then
					barrierOriginalGroups[part] = currentGroup
				else
					barrierOriginalGroups[part] = "Default"
				end
			end

			pcall(function()
				part.CollisionGroup = BARRIER_COLLISION_GROUP
			end)

			return true
		end

		local function restoreBarrierGroups()
			for part,originalGroup in pairs(barrierOriginalGroups) do
				if part and part.Parent then
					pcall(function()
						part.CollisionGroup =
							tostring(originalGroup or "Default")
					end)
				end
				barrierOriginalGroups[part] = nil
			end
		end

		local function phaseNearbyBarriers(rootObject,record)
			if not rootObject
				or not rootObject.Parent
				or not record
				or not record.pushPart
				or not record.pushPart.Parent then
				return
			end

			local params = OverlapParams.new()
			params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
			params.FilterDescendantsInstances = {
				rootObject,
				player.Character
			}

			local ok,nearby = pcall(function()
				return workspace:GetPartBoundsInRadius(
					record.pushPart.Position,
					18,
					params
				)
			end)

			if not ok or type(nearby) ~= "table" then
				return
			end

			for _,part in ipairs(nearby) do
				if isInvisibleBarrier(part) then
					phaseBarrier(part)
				end
			end
		end

		local function moveRagdollBy(record,delta)
			if not record or delta.Magnitude <= .01 then
				return
			end

			for part in pairs(record.parts) do
				if part and part.Parent then
					pcall(function()
						part.CFrame = part.CFrame + delta
					end)
				end
			end
		end

		local function phaseThroughBarrierIfNeeded(
			rootObject,
			record,
			moveDirection
		)
			local pushPart = record and record.pushPart
			if not pushPart or not pushPart.Parent then
				return
			end

			local horizontal =
				Vector3.new(
					moveDirection.X,
					0,
					moveDirection.Z
				)

			if horizontal.Magnitude <= .01 then
				return
			end
			horizontal = horizontal.Unit

			local params = RaycastParams.new()
			params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
			params.IgnoreWater = true
			params.FilterDescendantsInstances = {
				rootObject,
				player.Character
			}

			local result =
				workspace:Raycast(
					pushPart.Position,
					horizontal*4.75,
					params
				)

			if not result
				or not result.Instance
				or not isInvisibleBarrier(result.Instance) then
				return
			end

			local barrier = result.Instance
			phaseBarrier(barrier)

			local now = os.clock()
			if now-(phaseCooldown[rootObject] or 0) < .28 then
				return
			end
			phaseCooldown[rootObject] = now

			-- Collision groups normally let the ragdoll pass straight through.
			-- This small local phase-step is a fallback for games that constantly
			-- rewrite collision state on their invisible boundary parts.
			local localDirection =
				barrier.CFrame:VectorToObjectSpace(horizontal)
			local halfThickness =
				(
					math.abs(localDirection.X)*barrier.Size.X
					+math.abs(localDirection.Y)*barrier.Size.Y
					+math.abs(localDirection.Z)*barrier.Size.Z
				)*.5

			local phaseDistance =
				math.clamp(halfThickness+2.35,2.75,10)

			moveRagdollBy(
				record,
				horizontal*phaseDistance
			)

			pcall(function()
				pushPart.AssemblyLinearVelocity =
					horizontal*16
					+Vector3.new(0,-2.5,0)
			end)

			setStatus(
				"GIGGLE PHASED THROUGH INVISIBLE WALL // DROP!"
			)
		end

		local function isTemplateWord(value)
			local c = compact(value)
			return
				string.find(c,"spawner",1,true) ~= nil
				or string.find(c,"spawnpoint",1,true) ~= nil
				or string.find(c,"template",1,true) ~= nil
				or string.find(c,"storage",1,true) ~= nil
				or string.find(c,"assetfolder",1,true) ~= nil
		end

		local function isGiggleEntityName(value)
			local c = compact(value)
			if c == "" then
				return false
			end

			for _,childWord in ipairs({
				"tentacle",
				"tendril",
				"appendage",
				"arm",
				"leg",
				"eye",
				"face",
				"mouth",
				"hitbox",
				"trigger",
				"damage",
				"hurt"
			}) do
				if string.find(c,childWord,1,true) then
					return false
				end
			end

			if c == "giggle"
				or c == "giggleentity"
				or c == "gigglerig"
				or c == "gigglemodel"
				or c == "gigglemonster"
				or c == "gigglenpc"
				or c == "gigglemain"
				or c == "giggleroot"
				or c == "ceilinggiggle" then
				return true
			end

			if string.match(c,"^giggle%d+$")
				or string.match(c,"^giggleentity%d+$")
				or string.match(c,"^gigglerig%d+$") then
				return true
			end

			if string.find(c,"giggle",1,true)
				and (
					string.find(c,"entity",1,true)
					or string.find(c,"monster",1,true)
					or string.find(c,"rig",1,true)
					or string.find(c,"npc",1,true)
					or string.find(c,"ceiling",1,true)
				) then
				return true
			end

			return false
		end

		local function rootKind(rootObject)
			if not rootObject then
				return nil
			end

			local explicit =
				rootObject:GetAttribute("Floor2SpawnKind")
				or rootObject:GetAttribute("FakeEntityKind")
				or rootObject:GetAttribute("EntityName")
				or rootObject:GetAttribute("MonsterName")

			if explicit
				and string.find(compact(explicit),"giggle",1,true) then
				return "GIGGLE"
			end

			if isGiggleEntityName(rootObject.Name) then
				return "GIGGLE"
			end

			return nil
		end

		local function resolveGiggleRoot(object)
			if not object or not object.Parent then
				return nil
			end

			local cursor = object
			local bestModel = nil
			local bestPart = nil

			for _ = 1,12 do
				if not cursor or cursor == workspace then
					break
				end

				if isTemplateWord(cursor.Name) then
					return nil
				end

				if rootKind(cursor) == "GIGGLE" then
					if cursor:IsA("Model") or cursor:IsA("Folder") then
						bestModel = cursor
					elseif cursor:IsA("BasePart") then
						bestPart = bestPart or cursor
					end
				end

				cursor = cursor.Parent
			end

			return bestModel or bestPart
		end

		local function baseParts(rootObject)
			local parts = {}
			if rootObject:IsA("BasePart") then
				table.insert(parts,rootObject)
			end
			for _,object in ipairs(rootObject:GetDescendants()) do
				if object:IsA("BasePart") then
					table.insert(parts,object)
				end
			end
			return parts
		end

		local function insideRoot(part,rootObject)
			return
				part ~= nil
				and (
					part == rootObject
					or part:IsDescendantOf(rootObject)
				)
		end

		local function choosePushPart(parts)
			local best = nil
			local bestScore = -math.huge

			for _,part in ipairs(parts) do
				local c = compact(part.Name)
				local score = part.Size.Magnitude

				if string.find(c,"body",1,true)
					or string.find(c,"torso",1,true)
					or string.find(c,"head",1,true)
					or string.find(c,"main",1,true) then
					score += 24
				elseif string.find(c,"root",1,true) then
					score += 12
				end

				if part.Transparency >= .95 then
					score -= 18
				end

				if string.find(c,"hitbox",1,true)
					or string.find(c,"trigger",1,true)
					or string.find(c,"damage",1,true)
					or string.find(c,"hurt",1,true) then
					score -= 42
				end

				if score > bestScore then
					bestScore = score
					best = part
				end
			end

			return best
		end

		local function saveEnabledAndDisable(object,record)
			local ok,value = pcall(function()
				return object.Enabled
			end)
			if ok then
				record.enabledObjects[object] = value
				pcall(function()
					object.Enabled = false
				end)
				return true
			end
			return false
		end

		local function pairAlreadyConnected(record,part0,part1)
			if not part0 or not part1 then
				return true
			end

			local side = record.connectedPairs[part0]
			if side and side[part1] then
				return true
			end

			side = side or setmetatable({}, {__mode = "k"})
			record.connectedPairs[part0] = side
			side[part1] = true

			local reverse =
				record.connectedPairs[part1]
				or setmetatable({}, {__mode = "k"})
			record.connectedPairs[part1] = reverse
			reverse[part0] = true

			return false
		end

		local function makeSocket(
			record,
			part0,
			part1,
			cframe0,
			cframe1,
			label
		)
			if not part0 or not part1 or part0 == part1 then
				return false
			end

			if pairAlreadyConnected(record,part0,part1) then
				return false
			end

			local attachment0 = Instance.new("Attachment")
			attachment0.Name =
				"NotRubyGiggleFullRagdollA0_"..tostring(label or "Joint")
			attachment0.CFrame = cframe0 or CFrame.new()
			attachment0.Parent = part0

			local attachment1 = Instance.new("Attachment")
			attachment1.Name =
				"NotRubyGiggleFullRagdollA1_"..tostring(label or "Joint")
			attachment1.CFrame = cframe1 or CFrame.new()
			attachment1.Parent = part1

			local socket = Instance.new("BallSocketConstraint")
			socket.Name =
				"NotRubyGiggleFullRagdollSocket_"..tostring(label or "Joint")
			socket.Attachment0 = attachment0
			socket.Attachment1 = attachment1
			socket.LimitsEnabled = true
			socket.UpperAngle = 78
			socket.TwistLimitsEnabled = true
			socket.TwistLowerAngle = -62
			socket.TwistUpperAngle = 62
			socket.Restitution = 0
			socket.Parent = part0

			table.insert(
				record.created,
				{attachment0,attachment1,socket}
			)

			return true
		end

		local function makeMotorRagdoll(motor,record)
			local part0 = motor.Part0
			local part1 = motor.Part1
			if not part0 or not part1 then
				return false
			end

			record.motors[motor] = {
				enabled = motor.Enabled,
				part0 = part0,
				part1 = part1
			}

			local created =
				makeSocket(
					record,
					part0,
					part1,
					motor.C0,
					motor.C1,
					motor.Name
				)

			motor.Enabled = false
			return created
		end

		local function makeLegacyJointRagdoll(joint,record)
			local part0 = joint.Part0
			local part1 = joint.Part1
			if not part0 or not part1 then
				return false
			end

			record.joints[joint] = {
				enabled = joint.Enabled
			}

			local cframe0 = CFrame.new()
			local cframe1 = CFrame.new()

			pcall(function()
				cframe0 = joint.C0
				cframe1 = joint.C1
			end)

			local created =
				makeSocket(
					record,
					part0,
					part1,
					cframe0,
					cframe1,
					joint.Name
				)

			joint.Enabled = false
			return created
		end

		local function makeWeldConstraintRagdoll(weld,record)
			local part0 = weld.Part0
			local part1 = weld.Part1
			if not part0 or not part1 then
				return false
			end

			record.joints[weld] = {
				enabled = weld.Enabled
			}

			-- WeldConstraint has no C0/C1. Put both attachments at the exact
			-- same current world midpoint so disabling the weld causes NO snap.
			local jointWorld =
				(part0.Position+part1.Position)*.5

			local cframe0 =
				CFrame.new(
					part0.CFrame:PointToObjectSpace(jointWorld)
				)
			local cframe1 =
				CFrame.new(
					part1.CFrame:PointToObjectSpace(jointWorld)
				)

			local created =
				makeSocket(
					record,
					part0,
					part1,
					cframe0,
					cframe1,
					weld.Name
				)

			weld.Enabled = false
			return created
		end

		local function ragdollGiggle(rootObject)
			if not state.doorsTortureGiggle
				or not rootObject
				or not rootObject.Parent
				or tortured[rootObject]
				or rootKind(rootObject) ~= "GIGGLE" then
				return false
			end

			local parts = baseParts(rootObject)
			if #parts == 0 then
				return false
			end

			local record = {
				parts = {},
				motors = {},
				enabledObjects = {},
				joints = {},
				created = {},
				connectedPairs = setmetatable({}, {__mode = "k"}),
				humanoid = nil,
				humanoidState = nil,
				pushPart = choosePushPart(parts)
			}

			if not record.pushPart then
				return false
			end

			tortured[rootObject] = record
			rootObject:SetAttribute("NotRubyTorturedGiggle",true)

			for _,part in ipairs(parts) do
				record.parts[part] = {
					Anchored = part.Anchored,
					CanCollide = part.CanCollide,
					CanTouch = part.CanTouch,
					CanQuery = part.CanQuery,
					Massless = part.Massless,
					CollisionGroup = part.CollisionGroup,
					CustomPhysicalProperties = part.CustomPhysicalProperties
				}

				part.Anchored = false

				local partName = compact(part.Name)
				local hiddenControlPart =
					part.Transparency >= .96
					or string.find(partName,"hitbox",1,true)
					or string.find(partName,"trigger",1,true)
					or string.find(partName,"damage",1,true)
					or string.find(partName,"hurt",1,true)
					or string.find(partName,"collision",1,true)

				-- FULL ragdoll: body + every visible tentacle is physical.
				-- They collide with the map, but NOT with each other because
				-- GIGGLE_COLLISION_GROUP is self-non-collidable.
				part.CanCollide = not hiddenControlPart
				part.CanTouch = true
				part.CanQuery = true
				part.Massless = hiddenControlPart

				pcall(function()
					part.CollisionGroup = GIGGLE_COLLISION_GROUP
				end)

				pcall(function()
					part.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
					part.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
				end)
			end

			local targetHumanoid =
				rootObject:IsA("Model")
				and rootObject:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
				or nil

			if targetHumanoid then
				record.humanoid = targetHumanoid
				record.humanoidState = {
					PlatformStand = targetHumanoid.PlatformStand,
					AutoRotate = targetHumanoid.AutoRotate
				}
				targetHumanoid.PlatformStand = true
				targetHumanoid.AutoRotate = false
				pcall(function()
					targetHumanoid:ChangeState(
						Enum.HumanoidStateType.Physics
					)
				end)
			end

			local descendants = rootObject:GetDescendants()

			-- Pass 1: convert every INTERNAL joint into a loose socket.
			-- This makes the head/body/tentacles all genuinely ragdoll.
			for _,object in ipairs(descendants) do
				if object:IsA("Motor6D") then
					local in0 = insideRoot(object.Part0,rootObject)
					local in1 = insideRoot(object.Part1,rootObject)

					if in0 and in1 then
						makeMotorRagdoll(object,record)
					elseif in0 ~= in1 then
						record.joints[object] = {
							enabled = object.Enabled
						}
						object.Enabled = false
					end

				elseif object:IsA("WeldConstraint") then
					local in0 = insideRoot(object.Part0,rootObject)
					local in1 = insideRoot(object.Part1,rootObject)

					if in0 and in1 then
						makeWeldConstraintRagdoll(object,record)
					elseif in0 ~= in1 then
						record.joints[object] = {
							enabled = object.Enabled
						}
						object.Enabled = false
					end

				elseif object:IsA("JointInstance")
					and not object:IsA("Motor6D") then
					local part0 = nil
					local part1 = nil

					pcall(function()
						part0 = object.Part0
						part1 = object.Part1
					end)

					local in0 = insideRoot(part0,rootObject)
					local in1 = insideRoot(part1,rootObject)

					if in0 and in1 then
						makeLegacyJointRagdoll(object,record)
					elseif in0 ~= in1 then
						local enabled = true
						pcall(function()
							enabled = object.Enabled
						end)
						record.joints[object] = {
							enabled = enabled
						}
						pcall(function()
							object.Enabled = false
						end)
					end
				end
			end

			-- Pass 2: disable mover/control constraints that can fight gravity.
			-- Existing internal BallSockets are left alone unless they connect
			-- Giggle to something outside the entity.
			for _,object in ipairs(descendants) do
				if object:IsA("AlignPosition")
					or object:IsA("AlignOrientation")
					or object:IsA("LinearVelocity")
					or object:IsA("AngularVelocity")
					or object:IsA("VectorForce")
					or object:IsA("Torque") then
					saveEnabledAndDisable(object,record)

				elseif object:IsA("Constraint")
					and not string.find(
						tostring(object.Name),
						"NotRubyGiggleFullRagdoll",
						1,
						true
					) then
					local attachment0
					local attachment1

					pcall(function()
						attachment0 = object.Attachment0
						attachment1 = object.Attachment1
					end)

					if attachment0 or attachment1 then
						local parent0 = attachment0 and attachment0.Parent
						local parent1 = attachment1 and attachment1.Parent

						local in0 =
							parent0
							and (
								parent0 == rootObject
								or parent0:IsDescendantOf(rootObject)
							)
						local in1 =
							parent1
							and (
								parent1 == rootObject
								or parent1:IsDescendantOf(rootObject)
							)

						if in0 ~= in1 then
							saveEnabledAndDisable(object,record)
						end
					end
				end
			end

			-- Start the FULL ragdoll with a tiny varied tumble. No huge force:
			-- enough to prove every tentacle is loose without launching Giggle.
			for part in pairs(record.parts) do
				if part and part.Parent and not part.Massless then
					pcall(function()
						local seed =
							(
								#tostring(part.Name)*17
								+math.floor(part.Position.X*3)
								+math.floor(part.Position.Z*5)
							)%11

						part.AssemblyAngularVelocity =
							part.AssemblyAngularVelocity
							+Vector3.new(
								(seed%3-1)*.45,
								((seed+2)%3-1)*.35,
								((seed+4)%3-1)*.45
							)
					end)
				end
			end

			return true
		end

		local function restoreGiggle(rootObject)
			local record = tortured[rootObject]
			if not record then
				return
			end
			for _,createdSet in ipairs(record.created) do
				for _,object in ipairs(createdSet) do
					if object and object.Parent then
						object:Destroy()
					end
				end
			end
			for motor,data in pairs(record.motors) do
				if motor and motor.Parent then
					pcall(function()
						motor.Enabled = data.enabled
					end)
				end
			end
			for joint,data in pairs(record.joints) do
				if joint and joint.Parent then
					pcall(function()
						joint.Enabled = data.enabled
					end)
				end
			end
			for object,enabled in pairs(record.enabledObjects) do
				if object and object.Parent then
					pcall(function()
						object.Enabled = enabled
					end)
				end
			end
			for part,data in pairs(record.parts) do
				if part and part.Parent then
					pcall(function()
						part.Anchored = data.Anchored
						part.CanCollide = data.CanCollide
						part.CanTouch = data.CanTouch
						part.CanQuery = data.CanQuery
						part.Massless = data.Massless
						part.CollisionGroup =
							tostring(data.CollisionGroup or "Default")
						part.CustomPhysicalProperties =
							data.CustomPhysicalProperties
						part.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
						part.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
					end)
				end
			end
			if record.humanoid and record.humanoid.Parent
				and record.humanoidState then
				record.humanoid.PlatformStand =
					record.humanoidState.PlatformStand
				record.humanoid.AutoRotate =
					record.humanoidState.AutoRotate
				pcall(function()
					record.humanoid:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.GettingUp)
				end)
			end
			if rootObject and rootObject.Parent then
				rootObject:SetAttribute("NotRubyTorturedGiggle",nil)
			end
			tortured[rootObject] = nil
		end

		local function updateCount()
			local count = 0
			local removeList = {}
			for rootObject,record in pairs(tortured) do
				if rootObject
					and rootObject.Parent
					and record
					and record.pushPart
					and record.pushPart.Parent then
					count += 1
				else
					table.insert(removeList,rootObject)
				end
			end
			for _,rootObject in ipairs(removeList) do
				tortured[rootObject] = nil
			end
			gui:SetAttribute("DoorsTortureGiggleCount",count)
			local label = getCountLabel()
			if label then
				label.Text =
					"RAGDOLL GIGGLES: "
					..tostring(count)
					.." // FULL BODY + TENTACLES RAGDOLLED"
			end
			return count
		end

		local function scanGiggles()
			if not state.doorsTortureGiggle then
				return
			end
			local seen = {}
			local objects = workspace:GetDescendants()
			for index,object in ipairs(objects) do
				if object:IsA("Model")
					or object:IsA("Folder")
					or object:IsA("BasePart") then
					local rootObject = resolveGiggleRoot(object)
					if rootObject and not seen[rootObject] then
						seen[rootObject] = true
						ragdollGiggle(rootObject)
					end
				end
				if index%300 == 0 then
					task.wait()
				end
			end
			updateCount()
		end

		local function setEnabled(value)
			value = value == true
			if value and not shooterSecurityAllowed() then
				state.doorsTortureGiggle = false
				gui:SetAttribute("DoorsTortureGiggle",false)
				local button = getButton()
				if button then
					button.Text = "TORTURE GIGGLE [LOCKED]"
				end
				setStatus("TORTURE GIGGLE [LOCKED]")
				return
			end

			state.doorsTortureGiggle = value
			gui:SetAttribute("DoorsTortureGiggle",value)
			local button = getButton()
			if button then
				button.Text =
					value and "TORTURE GIGGLE [ON]" or "TORTURE GIGGLE [OFF]"
				button.BackgroundColor3 =
					value
						and Color3.fromRGB(111,42,48)
						or Color3.fromRGB(60,31,34)
			end

			if value then
				gui:SetAttribute("RuntimeProfile","DOORS")
				setStatus("TORTURE GIGGLE V83 // FULL BODY + ALL TENTACLES RAGDOLLED")
				task.spawn(scanGiggles)
			else
				local restoreList = {}
				for rootObject in pairs(tortured) do
					table.insert(restoreList,rootObject)
				end
				for _,rootObject in ipairs(restoreList) do
					restoreGiggle(rootObject)
				end
				restoreBarrierGroups()
				updateCount()
				setStatus("TORTURE GIGGLE OFF // RESTORED")
			end
		end

		local button = getButton()
		if button then
			button.Activated:Connect(function()
				setEnabled(not state.doorsTortureGiggle)
			end)
		end

		workspace.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(object)
			if not state.doorsTortureGiggle
				or menuDeleted
				or not runtimeCore.allows("DOORS") then
				return
			end
			if not (
				object:IsA("Model")
					or object:IsA("Folder")
					or object:IsA("BasePart")
			) then
				return
			end
			task.delay(.10,function()
				if object and object.Parent then
					local rootObject = resolveGiggleRoot(object)
					if rootObject then
						ragdollGiggle(rootObject)
						updateCount()
					end
				end
			end)
		end)

		RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(deltaTime)
			if not state.doorsTortureGiggle
				or menuDeleted
				or not runtimeCore.allows("DOORS") then
				return
			end

			scanAccumulator += deltaTime
			pushAccumulator += deltaTime
			barrierAccumulator += deltaTime
			if scanAccumulator >= 1.3 then
				scanAccumulator = 0
				task.spawn(scanGiggles)
			end
			if pushAccumulator < .05 then
				return
			end
			pushAccumulator = 0

			local character = player.Character
			local ownRoot =
				character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
			local ownHumanoid =
				character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
			if not ownRoot or not ownHumanoid then
				return
			end

			if barrierAccumulator >= .14 then
				barrierAccumulator = 0
				for rootObject,record in pairs(tortured) do
					if rootObject
						and rootObject.Parent
						and record then
						phaseNearbyBarriers(rootObject,record)
					end
				end
			end

			local moveDirection = ownHumanoid.MoveDirection
			if moveDirection.Magnitude <= .03 then
				return
			end
			moveDirection = moveDirection.Unit

			for rootObject,record in pairs(tortured) do
				local pushPart = record.pushPart
				if rootObject
					and rootObject.Parent
					and pushPart
					and pushPart.Parent then
					local distance =
						(ownRoot.Position-pushPart.Position).Magnitude
					if distance <= 5.25 then
						phaseThroughBarrierIfNeeded(
							rootObject,
							record,
							moveDirection
						)

						local horizontal =
							Vector3.new(moveDirection.X,0,moveDirection.Z)
						if horizontal.Magnitude > .01 then
							horizontal = horizontal.Unit
							pcall(function()
								pushPart:ApplyImpulse(
									(
										horizontal*12
										+Vector3.new(0,1.4,0)
									)
									*math.max(pushPart.AssemblyMass,.25)
								)
							end)
							pcall(function()
								pushPart.AssemblyLinearVelocity =
									pushPart.AssemblyLinearVelocity*.55
									+horizontal*14
									+Vector3.new(0,1.6,0)
								pushPart.AssemblyAngularVelocity =
									pushPart.AssemblyAngularVelocity
									+Vector3.new(0,2.4,0)
							end)
						end
					end
				end
			end
		end)

		runtimeCore.stopEvent.Event:Connect(function()
			if state.doorsTortureGiggle then
				setEnabled(false)
			else
				gui:SetAttribute("DoorsTortureGiggle",false)
				gui:SetAttribute("DoorsTortureGiggleCount",0)
			end
		end)

		gui.Destroying:Connect(function()
			state.doorsTortureGiggle = false
			local restoreList = {}
			for rootObject in pairs(tortured) do
				table.insert(restoreList,rootObject)
			end
			for _,rootObject in ipairs(restoreList) do
				restoreGiggle(rootObject)
			end
			restoreBarrierGroups()
			gui:SetAttribute("DoorsTortureGiggle",false)
			gui:SetAttribute("DoorsTortureGiggleCount",0)
		end)
	end)()

	-- --------------------------------------------------------
	-- V85 FLOOR 2 // GIGGLE TENTACLE BLASTER // TAP FIRE + THIRD PERSON
	-- Fun local-only ragdoll interaction. No blood/gore effects.
	-- Only disconnects tentacle joints while Giggle has the
	-- NotRubyTorturedGiggle ragdoll attribute.
	-- --------------------------------------------------------
	;(function()
		local TOOL_NAME = "Giggle Tentacle Blaster"
		local RANGE = 420
		local detached = setmetatable({}, {__mode = "k"})
		local crosshair = nil
		local thirdPersonHudButton = nil
		local thirdPersonActive = false
		local thirdPersonSaved = nil
		local lastShotAt = 0
		local THIRD_PERSON_DISTANCE = 10.5
		local THIRD_PERSON_HEIGHT = 3.2
		local THIRD_PERSON_FOCUS_HEIGHT = 2.1
		local THIRD_PERSON_RENDER_NAME =
			"NotRubyV88ThirdPersonCamera"
		local thirdPersonRenderBound = false

		local function compact(value)
			return string.lower(
				tostring(value or ""):gsub("[^%w]","")
			)
		end

		local function getButton()
			for _,object in ipairs(gui:GetDescendants()) do
				if object:IsA("TextButton")
					and object.Name == "Floor2GiggleBlasterButton" then
					return object
				end
			end
			return nil
		end

		local function findTool()
			for _,container in ipairs({
				player.Character,
				player:FindFirstChildOfClass("Backpack")
			}) do
				if container then
					local tool = container:FindFirstChild(TOOL_NAME)
					if tool and tool:IsA("Tool") then
						return tool
					end
				end
			end
			return nil
		end

		local function updateButton()
			local button = getButton()
			if not button then
				return
			end

			if not shooterSecurityAllowed() then
				button.Text = "TENTACLE BLASTER [LOCKED]"
				button.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(31,43,58)
				return
			end

			local hasTool = findTool() ~= nil
			gui:SetAttribute("DoorsGiggleBlaster",hasTool)
			button.Text =
				hasTool
					and "REMOVE TENTACLE BLASTER"
					or "GET TENTACLE BLASTER"
			button.BackgroundColor3 =
				hasTool
					and Color3.fromRGB(39,77,108)
					or Color3.fromRGB(31,43,58)
		end

		local function ensureCrosshair()
			if crosshair and crosshair.Parent then
				return crosshair
			end

			crosshair = Instance.new("TextLabel")
			crosshair.Name = "NotRubyGiggleBlasterCrosshair"
			crosshair.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(.5,.5)
			crosshair.Position = UDim2.fromScale(.5,.5)
			crosshair.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(34,34)
			crosshair.BackgroundTransparency = 1
			crosshair.Text = "+"
			crosshair.TextSize = 28
			crosshair.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBlack
			crosshair.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(168,220,255)
			crosshair.TextStrokeTransparency = .25
			crosshair.Visible = false
			crosshair.ZIndex = 1500
			crosshair.Parent = gui
			return crosshair
		end

		local function currentHumanoid()
			local character = player.Character
			return
				character
				and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
				or nil
		end

		local function ensureThirdPersonHudButton()
			if thirdPersonHudButton
				and thirdPersonHudButton.Parent then
				return thirdPersonHudButton
			end

			thirdPersonHudButton = Instance.new("TextButton")
			thirdPersonHudButton.Name = "NotRubyGiggleThirdPersonHud"
			thirdPersonHudButton.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1,1)
			thirdPersonHudButton.Position = UDim2.new(1,-32,1,-312)
			thirdPersonHudButton.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(116,38)
			thirdPersonHudButton.Text = "3RD PERSON V88 [OFF]"
			thirdPersonHudButton.TextSize = 9
			thirdPersonHudButton.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBlack
			thirdPersonHudButton.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(228,239,251)
			thirdPersonHudButton.BackgroundColor3 =
				Color3.fromRGB(31,43,58)
			thirdPersonHudButton.BackgroundTransparency = .08
			thirdPersonHudButton.BorderSizePixel = 0
			thirdPersonHudButton.AutoButtonColor = false
			thirdPersonHudButton.Visible = false
			thirdPersonHudButton.ZIndex = 1600
			thirdPersonHudButton.Parent = gui
			corner(thirdPersonHudButton,12)
			addStroke(
				thirdPersonHudButton,
				Color3.fromRGB(91,150,214),
				1.2,
				.10
			)

			return thirdPersonHudButton
		end

		local function updateThirdPersonHud()
			local button = ensureThirdPersonHudButton()
			local enabled =
				gui:GetAttribute("DoorsThirdPersonMode") == true

			button.Text =
				enabled
					and "3RD PERSON V88 [ON]"
					or "3RD PERSON V88 [OFF]"

			button.BackgroundColor3 =
				enabled
					and Color3.fromRGB(49,83,116)
					or Color3.fromRGB(31,43,58)
		end

		local function saveThirdPersonCamera()
			if thirdPersonSaved then
				return
			end

			camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
			thirdPersonSaved = {
				cameraMode = player.CameraMode,
				minZoom = player.CameraMinZoomDistance,
				maxZoom = player.CameraMaxZoomDistance,
				cameraType = camera and camera.CameraType or nil,
				cameraSubject = camera and camera.CameraSubject or nil,
				cameraCFrame = camera and camera.CFrame or nil,
				cameraFocus = camera and camera.Focus or nil,
				fov = camera and camera.FieldOfView or nil
			}
		end

		local function unbindThirdPersonCamera()
			if thirdPersonRenderBound then
				thirdPersonRenderBound = false
				pcall(function()
					RunService:UnbindFromRenderStep(
						THIRD_PERSON_RENDER_NAME
					)
				end)
			end
		end

		local function thirdPersonCharacter()
			local character = player.Character
			if not character then
				return nil,nil,nil
			end

			local humanoid =
				character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
			local rootPart =
				character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
				or character:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso")
				or character:FindFirstChild("Torso")

			return character,humanoid,rootPart
		end

		local function safeFlatLook(rootPart,humanoid)
			local direction =
				humanoid
				and humanoid.MoveDirection
				or Vector3.zero

			if direction.Magnitude < .08 then
				direction = rootPart.CFrame.LookVector
			end

			direction =
				Vector3.new(
					direction.X,
					0,
					direction.Z
				)

			if direction.Magnitude < .01 then
				return Vector3.new(0,0,-1)
			end

			return direction.Unit
		end

		local function thirdPersonCameraPosition(
			character,
			rootPart,
			humanoid
		)
			local focus =
				rootPart.Position
				+Vector3.new(
					0,
					THIRD_PERSON_FOCUS_HEIGHT,
					0
				)

			local flatLook =
				safeFlatLook(rootPart,humanoid)

			local desired =
				focus
				-flatLook*THIRD_PERSON_DISTANCE
				+Vector3.new(
					0,
					THIRD_PERSON_HEIGHT,
					0
				)

			local params = RaycastParams.new()
			params.FilterType =
				Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
			params.IgnoreWater = true
			params.FilterDescendantsInstances = {
				character
			}

			local rayDirection = desired-focus
			local result =
				workspace:Raycast(
					focus,
					rayDirection,
					params
				)

			if result then
				local direction =
					rayDirection.Magnitude > .01
					and rayDirection.Unit
					or Vector3.new(0,0,1)

				desired =
					result.Position
					-direction*.45

				-- Never let wall collision place the camera almost inside
				-- the player's head.
				if (desired-focus).Magnitude < 2.6 then
					desired =
						focus
						-flatLook*2.6
						+Vector3.new(0,1.1,0)
				end
			end

			return desired,focus
		end

		local function startThirdPersonCamera()
			saveThirdPersonCamera()
			unbindThirdPersonCamera()

			player.CameraMode = Enum.CameraMode.Classic

			-- Keep normal zoom values sane in case another Roblox camera
			-- controller briefly takes over during respawn.
			pcall(function()
				player.CameraMinZoomDistance = 2.5
				player.CameraMaxZoomDistance = 18
			end)

			thirdPersonRenderBound = true
			RunService:BindToRenderStep(
				THIRD_PERSON_RENDER_NAME,
				Enum.RenderPriority.Camera.Value+20,
				function(deltaTime)
					if not thirdPersonActive
						or menuDeleted
						or not gui.Parent then
						return
					end

					camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
					local character,humanoid,rootPart =
						thirdPersonCharacter()

					if not camera
						or not humanoid
						or not rootPart then
						return
					end

					local desired,focus =
						thirdPersonCameraPosition(
							character,
							rootPart,
							humanoid
						)

					local target =
						CFrame.lookAt(
							desired,
							focus,
							Vector3.new(0,1,0)
						)

					camera.CameraType =
						Enum.CameraType.Scriptable
					camera.CameraSubject = humanoid

					local alpha =
						math.clamp(
							(tonumber(deltaTime) or .016)*14,
							.08,
							1
						)

					-- Snap if the camera is absurdly far away; otherwise
					-- smooth it so mobile movement does not shake.
					if (
						camera.CFrame.Position-desired
					).Magnitude > 55 then
						camera.CFrame = target
					else
						camera.CFrame =
							camera.CFrame:Lerp(
								target,
								alpha
							)
					end

					camera.Focus = CFrame.new(focus)
				end
			)
		end

		local function restoreThirdPerson()
			unbindThirdPersonCamera()

			if not thirdPersonSaved then
				camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
				if camera then
					camera.CameraType =
						Enum.CameraType.Custom
					local humanoid = currentHumanoid()
					if humanoid then
						camera.CameraSubject = humanoid
					end
				end
				return
			end

			local saved = thirdPersonSaved
			thirdPersonSaved = nil

			pcall(function()
				player.CameraMode =
					saved.cameraMode
					or Enum.CameraMode.Classic
				player.CameraMinZoomDistance =
					tonumber(saved.minZoom) or .5
				player.CameraMaxZoomDistance =
					tonumber(saved.maxZoom) or 128
			end)

			camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
			if camera then
				camera.CameraType =
					saved.cameraType
					or Enum.CameraType.Custom

				if saved.cameraSubject
					and saved.cameraSubject.Parent then
					camera.CameraSubject =
						saved.cameraSubject
				else
					local humanoid = currentHumanoid()
					if humanoid then
						camera.CameraSubject = humanoid
					end
				end

				if saved.fov then
					camera.FieldOfView = saved.fov
				end

				if saved.cameraCFrame then
					camera.CFrame = saved.cameraCFrame
				end

				if saved.cameraFocus then
					camera.Focus = saved.cameraFocus
				end
			end
		end

		local function setThirdPerson(value)
			value = value == true

			if value == thirdPersonActive then
				gui:SetAttribute(
					"DoorsThirdPersonMode",
					value
				)

				if value and not thirdPersonRenderBound then
					startThirdPersonCamera()
				end

				updateThirdPersonHud()
				return
			end

			thirdPersonActive = value
			gui:SetAttribute(
				"DoorsThirdPersonMode",
				value
			)

			if value then
				startThirdPersonCamera()
				setStatus(
					"THIRD PERSON V88 ON // STABLE FOLLOW CAMERA"
				)
			else
				restoreThirdPerson()
				setStatus(
					"THIRD PERSON OFF // CAMERA RESTORED"
				)
			end

			updateThirdPersonHud()
		end

		local function isTentacleName(value)
			local c = compact(value)
			return
				string.find(c,"tentacle",1,true) ~= nil
				or string.find(c,"tendril",1,true) ~= nil
				or string.find(c,"appendage",1,true) ~= nil
		end

		local function findTorturedGiggleRoot(object)
			local cursor = object
			for _ = 1,12 do
				if not cursor or cursor == workspace then
					break
				end

				if cursor:GetAttribute("NotRubyTorturedGiggle") == true then
					return cursor
				end

				cursor = cursor.Parent
			end
			return nil
		end

		local function findTentacleRoot(hitPart,giggleRoot)
			if not hitPart or not giggleRoot then
				return nil
			end

			local cursor = hitPart
			local candidate = nil

			while cursor and cursor ~= giggleRoot do
				if isTentacleName(cursor.Name) then
					candidate = cursor
				end
				cursor = cursor.Parent
			end

			return candidate
		end

		local function collectTentacleParts(tentacleRoot)
			local set = {}

			if tentacleRoot:IsA("BasePart") then
				set[tentacleRoot] = true
			end

			for _,object in ipairs(tentacleRoot:GetDescendants()) do
				if object:IsA("BasePart") then
					set[object] = true
				end
			end

			return set
		end

		local function partInsideSet(part,set)
			return part ~= nil and set[part] == true
		end

		local function recordEnabled(record,object)
			if record.enabled[object] ~= nil then
				return
			end

			local ok,value = pcall(function()
				return object.Enabled
			end)

			if ok then
				record.enabled[object] = value
			end
		end

		local function disconnectTentacle(
			giggleRoot,
			tentacleRoot,
			hitPart,
			shotDirection
		)
			if tentacleRoot:GetAttribute("NotRubyTentacleDetached") == true then
				setStatus("TENTACLE ALREADY POPPED OFF")
				return false
			end

			local tentacleParts = collectTentacleParts(tentacleRoot)
			if next(tentacleParts) == nil then
				return false
			end

			local rootRecord = detached[giggleRoot]
			if not rootRecord then
				rootRecord = {
					joints = {},
					tentacles = setmetatable({}, {__mode = "k"})
				}
				detached[giggleRoot] = rootRecord
			end

			local record = {
				enabled = {},
				root = tentacleRoot
			}
			rootRecord.tentacles[tentacleRoot] = record

			for _,object in ipairs(giggleRoot:GetDescendants()) do
				if object:IsA("Motor6D") then
					local in0 = partInsideSet(object.Part0,tentacleParts)
					local in1 = partInsideSet(object.Part1,tentacleParts)
					if in0 ~= in1 then
						recordEnabled(record,object)
						pcall(function()
							object.Enabled = false
						end)
					end

				elseif object:IsA("WeldConstraint") then
					local in0 = partInsideSet(object.Part0,tentacleParts)
					local in1 = partInsideSet(object.Part1,tentacleParts)
					if in0 ~= in1 then
						recordEnabled(record,object)
						pcall(function()
							object.Enabled = false
						end)
					end

				elseif object:IsA("BallSocketConstraint")
					or object:IsA("HingeConstraint")
					or object:IsA("RodConstraint")
					or object:IsA("RopeConstraint")
					or object:IsA("SpringConstraint") then

					local attachment0 = nil
					local attachment1 = nil
					pcall(function()
						attachment0 = object.Attachment0
						attachment1 = object.Attachment1
					end)

					local part0 = attachment0 and attachment0.Parent
					local part1 = attachment1 and attachment1.Parent
					local in0 = partInsideSet(part0,tentacleParts)
					local in1 = partInsideSet(part1,tentacleParts)

					if in0 ~= in1 then
						recordEnabled(record,object)
						pcall(function()
							object.Enabled = false
						end)
					end
				end
			end

			tentacleRoot:SetAttribute("NotRubyTentacleDetached",true)

			local launchPart = hitPart
			if not launchPart or not launchPart:IsA("BasePart") then
				for part in pairs(tentacleParts) do
					launchPart = part
					break
				end
			end

			if launchPart and launchPart:IsA("BasePart") then
				local direction =
					shotDirection.Magnitude > .01
						and shotDirection.Unit
						or Vector3.new(0,0,-1)

				pcall(function()
					launchPart:ApplyImpulse(
						(
							direction*18
							+Vector3.new(0,5.5,0)
						)
						*math.max(launchPart.AssemblyMass,.18)
					)
					launchPart.AssemblyAngularVelocity =
						launchPart.AssemblyAngularVelocity
						+Vector3.new(4,6,3)
				end)
			end

			-- Harmless blue spark/pop visual. No blood particles or red splatter.
			if hitPart and hitPart:IsA("BasePart") then
				local pop = Instance.new("Part")
				pop.Name = "NotRubyTentaclePop"
				pop.Shape = Enum.PartType.Ball
				pop.Size = Vector3.new(.42,.42,.42)
				pop.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
				pop.Color = Color3.fromRGB(112,205,255)
				pop.CanCollide = false
				pop.CanTouch = false
				pop.CanQuery = false
				pop.Anchored = true
				pop.CFrame = CFrame.new(hitPart.Position)
				pop.Parent = workspace

				local light = Instance.new("PointLight")
				light.Color = Color3.fromRGB(130,215,255)
				light.Brightness = 2
				light.Range = 7
				light.Parent = pop

				TweenService:Create(
					pop,
					TweenInfo.new(.16,Enum.EasingStyle.Quad,Enum.EasingDirection.Out),
					{
						Size = Vector3.new(1.5,1.5,1.5),
						Transparency = 1
					}
				):Play()

				task.delay(.2,function()
					if pop and pop.Parent then
						pop:Destroy()
					end
				end)
			end

			local detachedCount =
				tonumber(
					gui:GetAttribute("DoorsGiggleTentaclesDetached")
				)
