				or 0
			gui:SetAttribute(
				"DoorsGiggleTentaclesDetached",
				detachedCount+1
			)

			setStatus("TENTACLE POPPED OFF // NO BLOOD")
			return true
		end

		local function restoreDetachedFor(rootObject)
			local rootRecord = detached[rootObject]
			if not rootRecord then
				return
			end

			for tentacleRoot,record in pairs(rootRecord.tentacles) do
				for object,enabled in pairs(record.enabled) do
					if object and object.Parent then
						pcall(function()
							object.Enabled = enabled
						end)
					end
				end

				if tentacleRoot and tentacleRoot.Parent then
					tentacleRoot:SetAttribute(
						"NotRubyTentacleDetached",
						nil
					)
				end
			end

			detached[rootObject] = nil
		end

		local function restoreEndedRagdolls()
			local restoreList = {}
			for rootObject in pairs(detached) do
				if not rootObject
					or not rootObject.Parent
					or rootObject:GetAttribute("NotRubyTorturedGiggle") ~= true then
					table.insert(restoreList,rootObject)
				end
			end

			for _,rootObject in ipairs(restoreList) do
				restoreDetachedFor(rootObject)
			end
		end

		local function shoot()
			local now = os.clock()
			if now-lastShotAt < .14 then
				return
			end
			lastShotAt = now

			if not shooterSecurityAllowed() then
				setStatus("TENTACLE BLASTER [LOCKED]")
				return
			end

			if gui:GetAttribute("DoorsTortureGiggle") ~= true then
				setStatus("TURN TORTURE GIGGLE ON FIRST")
				return
			end

			camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
			if not camera then
				setStatus("BLASTER // CAMERA NOT READY")
				return
			end

			local viewport = camera.ViewportSize
			local ray =
				camera:ViewportPointToRay(
					viewport.X*.5,
					viewport.Y*.5
				)

			local params = RaycastParams.new()
			params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
			params.IgnoreWater = true
			params.FilterDescendantsInstances = {
				player.Character
			}

			local result =
				workspace:Raycast(
					ray.Origin,
					ray.Direction*RANGE,
					params
				)

			if not result or not result.Instance then
				setStatus("BLASTER MISSED")
				return
			end

			local hitPart = result.Instance
			local giggleRoot =
				findTorturedGiggleRoot(hitPart)

			if not giggleRoot then
				setStatus("BLASTER // ONLY RAGDOLLED GIGGLE")
				return
			end

			local tentacleRoot =
				findTentacleRoot(hitPart,giggleRoot)

			if not tentacleRoot then
				setStatus("HIT GIGGLE // AIM AT A TENTACLE")
				return
			end

			disconnectTentacle(
				giggleRoot,
				tentacleRoot,
				hitPart,
				ray.Direction
			)
		end

		ensureThirdPersonHudButton().Activated:Connect(function()
			local toggleEvent =
				gui:FindFirstChild("NotRubyThirdPersonToggle")

			if toggleEvent
				and toggleEvent:IsA("BindableEvent") then
				toggleEvent:Fire()
			else
				setThirdPerson(not thirdPersonActive)
			end
		end)

		local thirdPersonToggleEvent =
			gui:FindFirstChild("NotRubyThirdPersonToggle")

		if thirdPersonToggleEvent
			and thirdPersonToggleEvent:IsA("BindableEvent") then
			thirdPersonToggleEvent.Event:Connect(function()
				setThirdPerson(
					gui:GetAttribute("DoorsThirdPersonMode") ~= true
				)
			end)
		end

		gui:GetAttributeChangedSignal(
			"DoorsThirdPersonMode"
		):Connect(function()
			local requested =
				gui:GetAttribute(
					"DoorsThirdPersonMode"
				) == true

			if requested ~= thirdPersonActive then
				setThirdPerson(requested)
			else
				updateThirdPersonHud()
			end
		end)

		gui:GetAttributeChangedSignal("CameraFixPulse"):Connect(function()
			local wasActive =
				thirdPersonActive
				or thirdPersonRenderBound

			thirdPersonActive = false
			gui:SetAttribute(
				"DoorsThirdPersonMode",
				false
			)
			unbindThirdPersonCamera()

			if wasActive then
				restoreThirdPerson()
			end

			updateThirdPersonHud()
		end)

		-- V88 camera ownership is handled by BindToRenderStep.
		local function makeTool()
			if findTool() then
				updateButton()
				return
			end

			if not shooterSecurityAllowed() then
				setStatus("TENTACLE BLASTER [LOCKED]")
				updateButton()
				return
			end

			local backpack =
				player:FindFirstChildOfClass("Backpack")
				or player:WaitForChild("Backpack",2)

			if not backpack then
				setStatus("BLASTER // BACKPACK NOT READY")
				return
			end

			local tool = Instance.new("Tool")
			tool.Name = TOOL_NAME
			tool.ToolTip =
				"Ragdoll Giggle only // shoot tentacles // no blood"
			tool.RequiresHandle = true
			tool.CanBeDropped = false
			tool:SetAttribute("NotRubyLocalTool",true)

			local handle = Instance.new("Part")
			handle.Name = "Handle"
			handle.Size = Vector3.new(.75,.85,2.15)
			handle.Color = Color3.fromRGB(32,42,56)
			handle.Material = Enum.Material.Metal
			handle.CanCollide = false
			handle.CanTouch = false
			handle.CanQuery = false
			handle.Massless = true
			handle.Parent = tool

			local barrel = Instance.new("Part")
			barrel.Name = "Barrel"
			barrel.Size = Vector3.new(.42,.42,1.35)
			barrel.Color = Color3.fromRGB(93,168,235)
			barrel.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
			barrel.CanCollide = false
			barrel.CanTouch = false
			barrel.CanQuery = false
			barrel.Massless = true
			barrel.CFrame = handle.CFrame*CFrame.new(0,0,-1.55)
			barrel.Parent = tool

			local weld = Instance.new("WeldConstraint")
			weld.Part0 = handle
			weld.Part1 = barrel
			weld.Parent = barrel

			tool.Grip =
				CFrame.new(0,-.1,-.1)
				*CFrame.Angles(
					math.rad(-6),
					math.rad(180),
					0
				)

			-- V92 correction: the requested TAP feature was for DOORS
			-- interaction prompts, not the blaster. Restore normal Tool tap fire.
			tool.ManualActivationOnly = false
			tool.Activated:Connect(shoot)

			tool.Equipped:Connect(function()
				ensureCrosshair().Visible = true

				local third = ensureThirdPersonHudButton()
				third.Visible = true

				gui:SetAttribute("DoorsTapFireReady",false)
				updateThirdPersonHud()
			end)

			tool.Unequipped:Connect(function()
				if crosshair and crosshair.Parent then
					crosshair.Visible = false
				end

				if tapFireButton and tapFireButton.Parent then
					tapFireButton.Visible = false
				end

				if thirdPersonHudButton
					and thirdPersonHudButton.Parent then
					thirdPersonHudButton.Visible = false
				end

				gui:SetAttribute("DoorsTapFireReady",false)
			end)

			tool.Destroying:Connect(function()
				if crosshair and crosshair.Parent then
					crosshair.Visible = false
				end
				task.defer(updateButton)
			end)

			tool.Parent = backpack
			gui:SetAttribute("DoorsGiggleBlaster",true)
			updateButton()
			setStatus("TENTACLE BLASTER ADDED // AIM AT GIGGLE TENTACLES")
		end

		local function removeTool()
			local tool = findTool()
			if tool then
				tool:Destroy()
			end

			gui:SetAttribute("DoorsGiggleBlaster",false)

			if crosshair and crosshair.Parent then
				crosshair.Visible = false
			end


			if thirdPersonHudButton
				and thirdPersonHudButton.Parent then
				thirdPersonHudButton.Visible = false
			end

			gui:SetAttribute("DoorsTapFireReady",false)

			updateButton()
			setStatus("TENTACLE BLASTER REMOVED")
		end

		local button = getButton()
		if button then
			button.Activated:Connect(function()
				if not shooterSecurityAllowed() then
					setStatus("TENTACLE BLASTER [LOCKED]")
					return
				end

				if findTool() then
					removeTool()
				else
					makeTool()
				end
			end)
		end

		RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
			restoreEndedRagdolls()

			local tool = findTool()
			local hasTool = tool ~= nil
			if gui:GetAttribute("DoorsGiggleBlaster") ~= hasTool then
				gui:SetAttribute("DoorsGiggleBlaster",hasTool)
				updateButton()
			end
		end)

		runtimeCore.stopEvent.Event:Connect(function()
			removeTool()

			if thirdPersonActive
				or thirdPersonRenderBound then
				thirdPersonActive = false
				gui:SetAttribute(
					"DoorsThirdPersonMode",
					false
				)
				restoreThirdPerson()
			else
				unbindThirdPersonCamera()
			end

			gui:SetAttribute("DoorsTapFireReady",false)

			local roots = {}
			for rootObject in pairs(detached) do
				table.insert(roots,rootObject)
			end
			for _,rootObject in ipairs(roots) do
				restoreDetachedFor(rootObject)
			end

			gui:SetAttribute("DoorsGiggleTentaclesDetached",0)
		end)

		gui.Destroying:Connect(function()
			local tool = findTool()
			if tool then
				tool:Destroy()
			end

			if crosshair and crosshair.Parent then
				crosshair:Destroy()
			end

			if tapFireButton and tapFireButton.Parent then
				tapFireButton:Destroy()
			end

			if thirdPersonHudButton
				and thirdPersonHudButton.Parent then
				thirdPersonHudButton:Destroy()
			end

			if thirdPersonActive
				or thirdPersonRenderBound then
				thirdPersonActive = false
				restoreThirdPerson()
			else
				unbindThirdPersonCamera()
			end

			local roots = {}
			for rootObject in pairs(detached) do
				table.insert(roots,rootObject)
			end
			for _,rootObject in ipairs(roots) do
				restoreDetachedFor(rootObject)
			end

			gui:SetAttribute("DoorsGiggleBlaster",false)
			gui:SetAttribute("DoorsGiggleTentaclesDetached",0)
			gui:SetAttribute("DoorsThirdPersonMode",false)
			gui:SetAttribute("DoorsTapFireReady",false)
		end)

		updateButton()
	end)()

		gui:SetAttribute("DoorsTortureGiggle",false)
		gui:SetAttribute("DoorsTortureGiggleCount",0)

	end)

		hideDoorsGuideVisuals()
		if doorsOverlayFolder and doorsOverlayFolder.Parent then
			doorsOverlayFolder:Destroy()
		end
	end)
	end)() -- DOORS isolated function scope

	local function refreshServerPlusInfo()
		serverInfoLabel.Text = table.concat({
			"PLACE ID  //  "..tostring(game.PlaceId),

		},"\n")
	end

	local function clipboardServerValue(value,message)
		if type(setclipboard) ~= "function" then
			setStatus("CLIPBOARD UNAVAILABLE")
			return
		end
		local ok = pcall(setclipboard,tostring(value))
		setStatus(ok and message or "COPY FAILED")
	end

	local function teleportToPublicServer(preferLowest)
		setStatus(preferLowest and "SEARCHING LOW PLAYER SERVER" or "SEARCHING RANDOM SERVER")
		task.spawn(function()
			local ok,err = pcall(function()
				local HttpService = game:GetService("HttpService")
				local TeleportService = game:GetService("TeleportService")
				local url =
					"https://games.roblox.com/v1/games/"
					..tostring(game.PlaceId)
					.."/servers/Public?sortOrder="
					..(preferLowest and "Asc" or "Desc")
					.."&limit=100"
				local raw = game:HttpGet(url,true)
				local decoded = HttpService:JSONDecode(raw)
				local candidates = {}
				for _,server in ipairs(decoded.data or {}) do
					if server.id
						and server.id ~= game.JobId
						and tonumber(server.playing or 0) < tonumber(server.maxPlayers or 0) then
						table.insert(candidates,server)
					end
				end
				if #candidates == 0 then error("NO OPEN PUBLIC SERVER FOUND") end
				local selected = nil
				if preferLowest then
					table.sort(candidates,function(a,b)
						return tonumber(a.playing or 0) < tonumber(b.playing or 0)
					end)
					selected = candidates[1]
				else
					selected = candidates[math.random(1,#candidates)]
				end
				TeleportService:TeleportToPlaceInstance(game.PlaceId,selected.id,player)
			end)
			if not ok then
				setStatus("SERVER HOP FAILED // "..string.sub(tostring(err),1,70))
			end
		end)
	end

	rejoinPlusButton.Activated:Connect(function()
		local TeleportService = game:GetService("TeleportService")
		setStatus("REJOINING SERVER")
		pcall(function()
			if game.JobId ~= "" then
				TeleportService:TeleportToPlaceInstance(game.PlaceId,game.JobId,player)
			else
				TeleportService:Teleport(game.PlaceId,player)
			end
		end)
	end)
	randomServerButton.Activated:Connect(function() teleportToPublicServer(false) end)
	lowServerButton.Activated:Connect(function() teleportToPublicServer(true) end)
	refreshServerButton.Activated:Connect(function()

		setStatus("SERVER INFO REFRESHED")

	-- Advanced live update loop. Keeps every new client feature independent
	-- from the original shooter RenderStepped connection.
	trackAdvanced(RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function(deltaTime)
		if menuDeleted or not gui.Parent then return end
		local allowed = shooterSecurityAllowed()
		local ownCharacter = player.Character
		local ownHumanoid = ownCharacter and ownCharacter:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
		local ownRoot = ownCharacter and ownCharacter:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

		if not allowed then
			state.targetOrbit = false
			state.targetHighlight = false
			state.targetHud = false
			state.autoSprintPlus = false
			state.superJumpPlus = false
			state.hoverPlus = false
			state.radarEnabled = false
			state.offscreenArrows = false
			state.velocityTags = false
			targetGlow.Enabled = false
			targetHudFrame.Visible = false
			radarFrame.Visible = false
			for _,label in pairs(offscreenLabels) do if label then label.Visible = false end end
			return
		end

		local targetPlayer,targetCharacter,targetHumanoid,targetRoot = currentTargetBundle()
		if state.targetHighlight and targetCharacter then
			targetGlow.Adornee = targetCharacter
			targetGlow.Enabled = true
			targetGlow.FillColor = gui:GetAttribute("OutlineColor") or accent
		else
			targetGlow.Enabled = false
			targetGlow.Adornee = nil
		end

		if state.targetHud then
			targetHudFrame.Visible = true
			if targetPlayer and targetHumanoid and targetRoot then
				local distance = ownRoot and math.floor((ownRoot.Position-targetRoot.Position).Magnitude) or 0
				local velocity = math.floor(targetRoot.AssemblyLinearVelocity.Magnitude+.5)
				targetHudLabel.Text = table.concat({
					"TARGET  //  "..targetPlayer.DisplayName,
					"@"..targetPlayer.Name.."  //  ID "..tostring(targetPlayer.UserId),
					"HP "..math.floor(targetHumanoid.Health+.5).." / "..math.floor(targetHumanoid.MaxHealth+.5),
					"DIST "..tostring(distance).." studs  //  VEL "..tostring(velocity)
				},"\n")
			else
				targetHudLabel.Text = "TARGET // NONE"
			end
		else
			targetHudFrame.Visible = false
		end

		if state.targetSpectate then
			if not targetPlayer or not targetHumanoid or targetHumanoid.Health <= 0 then
				stopTargetSpectate()
			else
				camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
				if camera and camera.CameraSubject ~= targetHumanoid then
					camera.CameraSubject = targetHumanoid
				end
			end
		end

		if state.targetOrbit
			and ownRoot
			and targetRoot
			and not state.flingActive then
			local angle = math.rad((os.clock()*state.orbitSpeed)%360)
			local offset = Vector3.new(math.cos(angle)*state.orbitRadius,1.5,math.sin(angle)*state.orbitRadius)
			local newPos = targetRoot.Position+offset
			ownRoot.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(newPos,targetRoot.Position)
			ownRoot.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
		end

		if ownHumanoid and ownHumanoid.Health > 0 then
			if state.autoSprintPlus and ownHumanoid.MoveDirection.Magnitude > .05 then
				ownHumanoid.WalkSpeed = state.sprintPlusSpeed
			end
			if state.superJumpPlus then
				pcall(function()
					if ownHumanoid.UseJumpPower then
						ownHumanoid.JumpPower = state.superJumpPower
					else
						ownHumanoid.JumpHeight = math.clamp(state.superJumpPower/7.2,7.2,40)
					end
				end)
			end
		end

		if state.hoverPlus and ownRoot and not state.flingActive then
			state.hoverHeight = state.hoverHeight or ownRoot.Position.Y
			local pos = ownRoot.Position
			local targetY = state.hoverHeight
			local deltaY = targetY-pos.Y
			local v = ownRoot.AssemblyLinearVelocity
			ownRoot.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(v.X,math.clamp(deltaY*10,-25,25),v.Z)
		end

		camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
		if camera and ownRoot then
			local viewport = camera.ViewportSize
			local center2 = Vector2.new(viewport.X*.5,viewport.Y*.5)
			local margin = 36
			for _,otherPlayer in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
				if otherPlayer ~= player and not isSameTeam(otherPlayer) then
					local character = otherPlayer.Character
					local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
					local enemyRoot = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
					if humanoid and humanoid.Health > 0 and enemyRoot then
						if state.radarEnabled then
							local localPos = ownRoot.CFrame:PointToObjectSpace(enemyRoot.Position)
							local nx = math.clamp(localPos.X/state.radarRadius,-1,1)
							local nz = math.clamp(localPos.Z/state.radarRadius,-1,1)
							local dot = getRadarDot(otherPlayer)
							dot.Visible = (Vector2.new(localPos.X,localPos.Z).Magnitude <= state.radarRadius)
							dot.Position = UDim2.fromScale(.5+nx*.44,.5+nz*.44)
						end

						local screen,onScreen = camera:WorldToViewportPoint(enemyRoot.Position)
						local arrow = getOffscreenLabel(otherPlayer)
						if state.offscreenArrows and (not onScreen or screen.Z <= 0) then
							local direction = Vector2.new(screen.X-center2.X,screen.Y-center2.Y)
							if screen.Z <= 0 then direction = -direction end
							if direction.Magnitude < 1 then direction = Vector2.new(0,-1) end
							direction = direction.Unit
							local maxX = math.max(1,center2.X-margin)
							local maxY = math.max(1,center2.Y-margin)
							local scale = math.min(
								maxX/math.max(.001,math.abs(direction.X)),
								maxY/math.max(.001,math.abs(direction.Y))
							)
							local point = center2+direction*scale
							arrow.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(point.X,point.Y)
							arrow.Rotation = math.deg(math.atan2(direction.Y,direction.X))+90
							arrow.Text = state.velocityTags
								and ("▲\n"..tostring(math.floor(enemyRoot.AssemblyLinearVelocity.Magnitude+.5)))
								or "▲"
							arrow.Visible = true
						else
							arrow.Visible = false
						end
					end
				else
					local dot = radarDots[otherPlayer]
					if dot then dot.Visible = false end
					local arrow = offscreenLabels[otherPlayer]
					if arrow then arrow.Visible = false end
				end
			end
			for otherPlayer,dot in pairs(radarDots) do
				if otherPlayer.Parent ~= Players or isSameTeam(otherPlayer) then
					if dot and dot.Parent then dot:Destroy() end
					radarDots[otherPlayer] = nil
				end
			end
			for otherPlayer,label in pairs(offscreenLabels) do
				if otherPlayer.Parent ~= Players or isSameTeam(otherPlayer) then
					if label and label.Parent then label:Destroy() end
					offscreenLabels[otherPlayer] = nil
				end
			end
		end
	end))

	trackAdvanced(Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(otherPlayer)
		local dot = radarDots[otherPlayer]
		if dot and dot.Parent then dot:Destroy() end
		radarDots[otherPlayer] = nil
		local arrow = offscreenLabels[otherPlayer]
		if arrow and arrow.Parent then arrow:Destroy() end

		if state.selectedAimbotPlayer == otherPlayer then
			state.selectedAimbotPlayer = nil
			clearTargetLabButton.Text = "TARGET: AUTO"
		end
	end))

	end

	local function cleanupMegaExpansion()
		if state.targetSpectate then
			camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
			if camera then
				local ownHumanoid =
					player.Character
					and player.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
				camera.CameraType = savedCameraType or Enum.CameraType.Custom
				camera.CameraSubject = ownHumanoid or savedCameraSubject
			end
		end
		state.targetSpectate = false
		state.targetHighlight = false
		state.targetHud = false
		state.targetOrbit = false
		state.autoSprintPlus = false
		state.superJumpPlus = false
		state.hoverPlus = false
		state.radarEnabled = false
		state.offscreenArrows = false
		state.velocityTags = false
		state.touchFling = false
		state.touchFlingToken = state.touchFlingToken + 1
		state.doorsKeyGuide = false
		state.doorsDoorGuide = false
		state.doorsSmartGuide = false
		pcall(applyMovementStats)
		if targetGlow and targetGlow.Parent then targetGlow:Destroy() end
		if targetHudFrame and targetHudFrame.Parent then targetHudFrame:Destroy() end
		if radarFrame and radarFrame.Parent then radarFrame:Destroy() end
		clearRadarObjects()
		for _,connection in ipairs(advancedConnections) do
			pcall(function() connection:Disconnect() end)
		end
		advancedConnections = {}
	end
	gui.Destroying:Connect(cleanupMegaExpansion)

	local function selectedFaceTeleportBundle()
		local targetPlayer = state.selectedAimbotPlayer
		if not targetPlayer
			or targetPlayer == player
			or targetPlayer.Parent ~= Players
			or isSameTeam(targetPlayer) then
			return nil,nil,nil,nil
		end
		local targetCharacter = targetPlayer.Character
		local targetHumanoid =
			targetCharacter
			and targetCharacter:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
		local targetRoot =
			targetCharacter
			and targetCharacter:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		local targetPart =
			targetCharacter
			and (
				targetCharacter:FindFirstChild(state.aimTarget)
				or targetRoot
			)
		if not targetHumanoid
			or targetHumanoid.Health <= 0
			or not targetRoot
			or not targetPart
			or not targetPart:IsA("BasePart") then
			return targetPlayer,targetCharacter,targetHumanoid,nil
		end
		return targetPlayer,targetCharacter,targetHumanoid,targetPart
	end

	local function restoreAutoFaceRotation()
		local currentHumanoid =
			player.Character
			and player.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
		if not currentHumanoid then
			return
		end
		if currentHumanoid:GetAttribute("NotRubyAutoFaceOwned") == true then
			local original = currentHumanoid:GetAttribute("NotRubyAutoFaceOriginalAutoRotate")
			if typeof(original) == "boolean" then
				currentHumanoid.AutoRotate = original
			else
				currentHumanoid.AutoRotate = true
			end
			currentHumanoid:SetAttribute("NotRubyAutoFaceOwned",nil)
			currentHumanoid:SetAttribute("NotRubyAutoFaceOriginalAutoRotate",nil)
		end
	end

	selectFaceTeleportTargetButton.Activated:Connect(function()
		if not shooterSecurityAllowed() then
			selectFaceTeleportTargetButton.Text = "SELECT FACE/TP TARGET [LOCKED]"
			setStatus("SET SHOOTER_ALLOWED_PLACE_ID TO YOUR GAME PLACEID")
			return
		end
		showPlayerPicker(
			"SELECT FACE / TELEPORT TARGET",
			function(selectedPlayer)
				if not selectedPlayer or selectedPlayer == player then
					return
				end
				if isSameTeam(selectedPlayer) then
					setStatus("TARGET BLOCKED // TEAMMATE")
					return
				end
				state.selectedAimbotPlayer = selectedPlayer
				state.lockedTarget = selectedPlayer
				local shortName = string.upper(string.sub(selectedPlayer.DisplayName,1,10))
				clearFaceTeleportTargetButton.Text = "FACE/TP: "..shortName
				clearAimbotTargetButton.Text = "TARGET: "..shortName
				if clearTargetLabButton then
					clearTargetLabButton.Text = "TARGET: "..shortName
				end
				setStatus("FACE/TP TARGET // "..selectedPlayer.DisplayName)
			end,
			false
		)
	end)

	clearFaceTeleportTargetButton.Activated:Connect(function()
		state.selectedAimbotPlayer = nil
		state.lockedTarget = nil
		clearFaceTeleportTargetButton.Text = "FACE/TP TARGET: NONE"
		clearAimbotTargetButton.Text = "TARGET: AUTO"
		if clearTargetLabButton then
			clearTargetLabButton.Text = "TARGET: AUTO"
		end
		setStatus("FACE/TP TARGET // NONE")
	end)

	autoFaceButton.Activated:Connect(function()
		local newValue = not state.autoFace
		if setSecurityToggle(
			autoFaceButton,
			"autoFace",
			"AUTO FACE TARGET",
			newValue
		) then
			if newValue and state.spinbot then
				state.spinbot = false
				setToggle(spinbotButton,false,"SPINBOT")
			end
			if newValue then
				local targetPlayer = selectedFaceTeleportBundle()
				if not targetPlayer then
					setStatus("AUTO FACE // SELECT FACE/TP TARGET FIRST")
				end
			else
				restoreAutoFaceRotation()
			end
		end
	end)

	hitboxSizeApply.Activated:Connect(function()
		local value = tonumber(hitboxSizeBox.Text)
		if not value then
			hitboxSizeBox.Text = tostring(state.hitboxSize)
			setStatus("INVALID HITBOX SIZE")
			return
		end
		state.hitboxSize = math.clamp(value,2,25)
		hitboxSizeBox.Text = string.format("%.1f",state.hitboxSize)
		if state.hitboxExpander and shooterSecurityAllowed() then
			refreshHitboxes()
		end
		setStatus("HITBOX SIZE // "..hitboxSizeBox.Text)
	end)

	spinSpeedApply.Activated:Connect(function()
		local value = tonumber(spinSpeedBox.Text)
		if not value then
			spinSpeedBox.Text = tostring(state.spinSpeed)
			setStatus("INVALID SPIN SPEED")
			return
		end
		state.spinSpeed = math.clamp(math.floor(value+.5),45,1440)
		spinSpeedBox.Text = tostring(state.spinSpeed)
		setStatus("SPIN SPEED // "..spinSpeedBox.Text)
	end)

	teleportBehindButton.Activated:Connect(function()
		if not shooterSecurityAllowed() then
			teleportBehindButton.Text = "TELEPORT BEHIND TARGET [LOCKED]"
			setStatus("SET SHOOTER_ALLOWED_PLACE_ID TO YOUR GAME PLACEID")
			return
		end
		local targetPlayer,targetCharacter,targetHumanoid,targetPart =
			selectedFaceTeleportBundle()
		if not targetPlayer then
			setStatus("TELEPORT // SELECT FACE/TP TARGET FIRST")
			return
		end
		local targetRoot =
			targetCharacter
			and targetCharacter:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		local currentRoot =
			player.Character
			and player.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		if not targetHumanoid
			or targetHumanoid.Health <= 0
			or not targetPart
			or not targetRoot
			or not currentRoot then
			setStatus("TELEPORT // SELECTED TARGET INVALID")
			return
		end

		local behindPosition =
			(targetRoot.CFrame*CFrame.new(0,0,4.5)).Position
		currentRoot.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(
			behindPosition,
			Vector3.new(
				targetRoot.Position.X,
				behindPosition.Y,
				targetRoot.Position.Z
			)
		)
		currentRoot.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
		currentRoot.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
		setStatus("TELEPORTED BEHIND // "..targetPlayer.DisplayName)
	end)

	local infiniteJumpConnection = UIS.JumpRequest:Connect(function()
		if menuDeleted
			or not gui.Parent
			or not state.infiniteJump
			or not shooterSecurityAllowed() then
			return
		end
		local currentHumanoid =
			player.Character
			and player.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
		if currentHumanoid and currentHumanoid.Health > 0 then
			pcall(function()
				currentHumanoid:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Jumping)
			end)
		end
	end)

	selectAimbotTargetButton.Activated:Connect(function()
		showPlayerPicker(
			"SELECT AIM TARGET",
			function(selectedPlayer)
				if not selectedPlayer
					or selectedPlayer == player then
					return
				end
				if isSameTeam(selectedPlayer) then
					setStatus(
						"AIM TARGET BLOCKED // TEAMMATE"
					)
					return
				end
				state.selectedAimbotPlayer = selectedPlayer
				state.lockedTarget = nil
				clearAimbotTargetButton.Text =
					"TARGET: "
					..string.upper(
						string.sub(
							selectedPlayer.DisplayName,
							1,
							12
						)
					)
				clearFaceTeleportTargetButton.Text =
					"FACE/TP: "..string.upper(string.sub(selectedPlayer.DisplayName,1,10))
				if clearTargetLabButton then
					clearTargetLabButton.Text = clearAimbotTargetButton.Text
				end
				setStatus(
					"AIM TARGET // "
					..selectedPlayer.DisplayName
				)
			end,
			false
		)
	end)
	clearAimbotTargetButton.Activated:Connect(function()
		state.selectedAimbotPlayer = nil
		state.lockedTarget = nil
		clearAimbotTargetButton.Text = "TARGET: AUTO"
		clearFaceTeleportTargetButton.Text = "FACE/TP TARGET: NONE"
		if clearTargetLabButton then
			clearTargetLabButton.Text = "TARGET: AUTO"
		end
		setStatus("AIM TARGET // AUTO")
	end)
	autoDodgeButton.Activated:Connect(function()
		setAutoDodge(not state.autoDodge)
	end)
	dodgeButton.Activated:Connect(function()
		-- Manual fallback: nearest player in the selected radius,
		-- regardless of the weapon they are holding.
		performDodge(false,false)
	end)
	dodgeRadiusApply.Activated:Connect(function()
		local value = tonumber(dodgeRadiusBox.Text)
		if not value then
			dodgeRadiusBox.Text = tostring(state.dodgeRadius)
			setStatus("INVALID DODGE RADIUS")
			return
		end
		state.dodgeRadius =
			math.clamp(math.floor(value+.5),5,100)
		dodgeRadiusBox.Text = tostring(state.dodgeRadius)
		setStatus(
			"DODGE RADIUS // "
			..tostring(state.dodgeRadius)
		)
	end)
	dodgeDistanceApply.Activated:Connect(function()
		local value = tonumber(dodgeDistanceBox.Text)
		if not value then
			dodgeDistanceBox.Text = tostring(state.dodgeDistance)
			setStatus("INVALID DODGE DISTANCE")
			return
		end
		state.dodgeDistance =
			math.clamp(math.floor(value+.5),4,60)
		dodgeDistanceBox.Text = tostring(state.dodgeDistance)
		setStatus(
			"DODGE DISTANCE // "
			..tostring(state.dodgeDistance)
		)
	end)
	selectFlingTargetButton.Activated:Connect(function()
		showPlayerPicker(
			"SELECT FLING TARGET",
			function(selectedPlayer)
				if not selectedPlayer
					or selectedPlayer == player then
					return
				end
				state.selectedFlingPlayer = selectedPlayer
				clearFlingTargetButton.Text =
					"FLING TARGET: "
					..string.upper(
						string.sub(
							selectedPlayer.DisplayName,
							1,
							10
						)
					)
				setStatus(
					"FLING TARGET // "
					..selectedPlayer.DisplayName
				)
			end,
			false
		)
	end)
	clearFlingTargetButton.Activated:Connect(function()
		state.selectedFlingPlayer = nil
		clearFlingTargetButton.Text = "FLING TARGET: NONE"
		setStatus("FLING TARGET // NONE")
	end)
	flingButton.Activated:Connect(startClientFling)
	flingPowerApply.Activated:Connect(function()
		local value = tonumber(flingPowerBox.Text)
		if not value then
			flingPowerBox.Text = tostring(state.flingPower)
			setStatus("INVALID FLING POWER")
			return
		end
		state.flingPower =
			math.clamp(math.floor(value+.5),60,260)
		flingPowerBox.Text = tostring(state.flingPower)
		setStatus(
			"FLING POWER // "
			..tostring(state.flingPower)
		)
	end)
	aimAssistButton.Activated:Connect(function()
		setAimAssist(not state.aimAssist)
	end)
	aimbotButton.Activated:Connect(function()
		setAimbot(not state.aimbot)
	end)
	autoShootButton.Activated:Connect(function()
		setAutoShoot(not state.autoShoot)
	end)
	aimStrengthApply.Activated:Connect(function()
		local value = tonumber(aimStrengthBox.Text)
		if not value then
			aimStrengthBox.Text = tostring(state.aimStrength)
			setStatus("INVALID AIM ASSIST STRENGTH")
			return
		end
		state.aimStrength =
			math.clamp(value,.02,1)
		aimStrengthBox.Text =
			string.format("%.2f",state.aimStrength)
		setStatus(
			"AIM ASSIST STRENGTH // "
			..aimStrengthBox.Text
		)
	end)
	aimTargetButton.Activated:Connect(function()
		state.aimTarget =
			state.aimTarget == "Head"
			and "HumanoidRootPart"
			or "Head"
		state.lockedTarget = nil
		aimTargetButton.Text =
			state.aimTarget == "Head"
			and "AIM TARGET: HEAD"
			or "AIM TARGET: BODY"
		setStatus(
			state.aimTarget == "Head"
			and "AIM TARGET // HEAD"
			or "AIM TARGET // BODY"
		)
	end)
	crosshairButton.Activated:Connect(function()
		state.crosshair = not state.crosshair
		renderButtons()
	end)
	fovButton.Activated:Connect(function()
		state.fov = not state.fov
		renderButtons()
	end)
	centerDotButton.Activated:Connect(function()
		state.centerDot = not state.centerDot
		renderButtons()
	end)
	teamLocatorButton.Activated:Connect(function()
		state.teamLocator = not state.teamLocator
		renderButtons()
		refreshLocators()
	end)
	enemyLocatorButton.Activated:Connect(function()
		state.enemyLocator = not state.enemyLocator
		renderButtons()
		refreshLocators()
	end)
	fovApply.Activated:Connect(function()
		local value = tonumber(fovBox.Text)
		if not value then
			fovBox.Text = tostring(state.fovRadius)
			setStatus("INVALID FOV RADIUS")
			return
		end
		state.fovRadius =
			math.clamp(math.floor(value+.5),30,500)
		fovBox.Text = tostring(state.fovRadius)
		fovCircle.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(
			state.fovRadius*2,
			state.fovRadius*2
		)
		setStatus(
			"FOV CIRCLE RADIUS // "
			..tostring(state.fovRadius)
		)
	end)
	Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(otherPlayer)
		otherPlayer.CharacterAdded:Connect(function()
			task.wait(.2)
			refreshLocators()
		end)
		otherPlayer:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Team"):Connect(
			refreshLocators
		)
		otherPlayer:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Neutral"):Connect(
			refreshLocators
		)
		refreshLocators()
	end)
	Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(otherPlayer)
		clearLocator(otherPlayer)
		if state.selectedAimbotPlayer == otherPlayer then
			state.selectedAimbotPlayer = nil
			state.lockedTarget = nil
			clearAimbotTargetButton.Text = "TARGET: AUTO"
			setStatus("AIM TARGET LEFT // AUTO")
		end
		if state.selectedFlingPlayer == otherPlayer then
			state.selectedFlingPlayer = nil
			clearFlingTargetButton.Text = "FLING TARGET: NONE"
			stopClientFling("FLING TARGET LEFT // NONE")
		end
	end)
	player:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Team"):Connect(refreshLocators)
	player:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Neutral"):Connect(refreshLocators)
	for _,otherPlayer in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
		if otherPlayer ~= player then
			otherPlayer.CharacterAdded:Connect(function()
				task.wait(.2)
				refreshLocators()
			end)
			otherPlayer:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Team"):Connect(
				refreshLocators
			)
			otherPlayer:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Neutral"):Connect(
				refreshLocators
			)
		end
	end
	-- Equipped Tools and held weapon-like Models are automatic threats.
	-- The floating DODGE button remains the manual fallback.
	task.spawn(function()
		while gui.Parent and not menuDeleted do
			if runtimeCore.allows("SHOOTER")
				and state.autoDodge
				and shooterSecurityAllowed() then
				performDodge(true,true)
			end
			task.wait(.06)
		end
	end)
	task.spawn(function()
		while gui.Parent and not menuDeleted do
			local localRoot =
				player.Character
				and player.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
			if runtimeCore.allows("SHOOTER")
				and (state.teamLocator or state.enemyLocator) then
				refreshLocators()
				if localRoot then
					for _,bundle in pairs(locatorObjects) do
						if bundle.root
							and bundle.root.Parent
							and bundle.label
							and bundle.label.Parent then
							local distance =
								math.floor(
									(localRoot.Position-bundle.root.Position)
									.Magnitude
								)
							local targetPlayer = nil
							for candidate,candidateBundle in pairs(locatorObjects) do
								if candidateBundle == bundle then
									targetPlayer = candidate
									break
								end
							end
							if targetPlayer then
								bundle.label.Text =
									targetPlayer.DisplayName
									.." // "
									..tostring(distance)
									.." studs"
							end
						end
					end
				end
			elseif next(locatorObjects) ~= nil then
				clearAllLocators()
			end
			if runtimeCore.allows("SHOOTER")
				and state.hitboxExpander
				and shooterSecurityAllowed() then
				refreshHitboxes()
			elseif next(hitboxOriginals) ~= nil then
				restoreHitboxes()
			end
			local outline =
				gui:GetAttribute("OutlineColor") or accent
			fovStroke.Color = outline
			local dodgeStroke =
				dodgeButton:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIStroke")
			if dodgeStroke then
				dodgeStroke.Color = outline
			end
			task.wait(.35)
		end
	end)
	RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function(deltaTime)
		if not runtimeCore.allows("SHOOTER")
			or not shooterSecurityAllowed()
			or menuDeleted then
			if next(extraVisualObjects) ~= nil then
				clearAllExtraVisuals()
			end
			return
		end

		local currentCharacter = player.Character
		local currentHumanoid =
			currentCharacter
			and currentCharacter:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
		local currentRoot =
			currentCharacter
			and currentCharacter:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

		if state.bunnyHop
			and currentHumanoid
			and currentHumanoid.Health > 0
			and currentHumanoid.MoveDirection.Magnitude > .05
			and currentHumanoid.FloorMaterial ~= Enum.Material.Air
			and os.clock()-state.lastHop >= .1 then
			state.lastHop = os.clock()
			currentHumanoid.Jump = true
		end

		if state.spinbot
			and currentRoot
			and not state.flingActive then
			currentRoot.CFrame =
				currentRoot.CFrame
				*CFrame.Angles(
					0,
					math.rad(state.spinSpeed*math.max(deltaTime,0)),
					0
				)
		end

		updateExtraVisuals()

		camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
		if not camera then
			return
		end
		local targetPart = nil
		if state.aimbot then
			targetPart = getAimbotTargetPart()
			if targetPart then
				state.aimNoTargetReported = false
				local origin = camera.CFrame.Position
				camera.CFrame =
					CFrame.lookAt(
						origin,
						targetPart.Position
					)
			elseif not state.aimNoTargetReported then
				state.aimNoTargetReported = true
				setStatus(
					"AIMBOT ERROR // NO VALID TARGET"
				)
			end
		elseif state.aimAssist then
			targetPart = getBestAimTarget()
			if targetPart then
				state.aimNoTargetReported = false
				local origin = camera.CFrame.Position
				local desired =
					CFrame.lookAt(
						origin,
						targetPart.Position
					)
				camera.CFrame =
					camera.CFrame:Lerp(
						desired,
						math.clamp(
							state.aimStrength,
							0,
							1
						)
					)
			elseif not state.aimNoTargetReported then
				state.aimNoTargetReported = true
				setStatus(
					"AIM ASSIST ERROR // NO VALID TARGET"
				)
			end
		elseif state.autoFace then
			local _,_,_,selectedTargetPart = selectedFaceTeleportBundle()
			targetPart = selectedTargetPart
		else
			state.aimNoTargetReported = false
		end

		if state.autoFace
			and currentHumanoid
			and currentHumanoid.Health > 0 then
			if currentHumanoid:GetAttribute("NotRubyAutoFaceOwned") ~= true then
				currentHumanoid:SetAttribute(
					"NotRubyAutoFaceOriginalAutoRotate",
					currentHumanoid.AutoRotate
				)
				currentHumanoid:SetAttribute("NotRubyAutoFaceOwned",true)
			end
			currentHumanoid.AutoRotate = false
		end

		if targetPart
			and state.autoFace
			and currentRoot
			and not state.flingActive then
			local flatTarget =
				Vector3.new(
					targetPart.Position.X,
					currentRoot.Position.Y,
					targetPart.Position.Z
				)
			if (flatTarget-currentRoot.Position).Magnitude > .05 then
				currentRoot.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(
					currentRoot.Position,
					flatTarget
				)
			end
		elseif not state.autoFace then
			restoreAutoFaceRotation()
		end

		if targetPart and (state.aimbot or state.aimAssist) then
			tryAutoShoot(targetPart)
		end
	end)
	renderButtons()
	if not shooterSecurityAllowed() then
		aimAssistButton.Text = "AIM ASSIST [LOCKED]"
		aimAssistButton.BackgroundColor3 = SURFACE_2
		aimAssistButton.TextColor3 = MUTED
		aimbotButton.Text = "AIMBOT [LOCKED]"
		aimbotButton.BackgroundColor3 = SURFACE_2
		aimbotButton.TextColor3 = MUTED
		autoShootButton.Text = "AUTO SHOOT [LOCKED]"
		autoShootButton.BackgroundColor3 = SURFACE_2
		autoShootButton.TextColor3 = MUTED
		autoDodgeButton.Text = "AUTO DODGE [LOCKED]"
		autoDodgeButton.BackgroundColor3 = SURFACE_2
		autoDodgeButton.TextColor3 = MUTED
		dodgeButton.Visible = false
		flingButton.Text = "FLING [LOCKED]"
		flingButton.BackgroundColor3 = SURFACE_2
		flingButton.TextColor3 = MUTED
		for _,button in ipairs({
			tracerButton,
			healthEspButton,
			infiniteJumpButton,
			bunnyHopButton,
			spinbotButton,
			hitboxButton,
			autoFaceButton,
			selectFaceTeleportTargetButton,
			teleportBehindButton,
			touchFlingButton,
			phaseWallButton
		}) do
			button.BackgroundColor3 = SURFACE_2
			button.TextColor3 = MUTED
		end
	end
	runtimeCore.stopEvent.Event:Connect(function()
		state.aimbot = false
		state.aimAssist = false
		state.autoShoot = false
		state.autoDodge = false
		state.teamLocator = false
		state.enemyLocator = false
		state.tracers = false
		state.healthEsp = false
		state.infiniteJump = false
		state.bunnyHop = false
		state.spinbot = false
		state.hitboxExpander = false
		state.autoFace = false
		state.touchFling = false
		state.touchFlingToken = state.touchFlingToken + 1
		state.flingActive = false
		state.flingToken = state.flingToken + 1
		gui:SetAttribute("ShooterAimbot",false)
		gui:SetAttribute("ShooterAimAssist",false)
		gui:SetAttribute("ShooterAutoShoot",false)
		gui:SetAttribute("ShooterAutoDodge",false)
		dodgeButton.Visible = false
		clearAllLocators()
		clearAllExtraVisuals()
		restoreHitboxes()
		restoreAutoFaceRotation()
		renderButtons()
	end)

	gui.Destroying:Connect(function()
		state.aimbot = false
		state.aimAssist = false
		state.autoShoot = false
		state.autoDodge = false
		state.tracers = false
		state.healthEsp = false
		state.infiniteJump = false
		state.bunnyHop = false
		state.spinbot = false
		state.hitboxExpander = false
		state.autoFace = false
		restoreAutoFaceRotation()
		state.touchFling = false
		state.touchFlingToken = state.touchFlingToken + 1
		dodgeButton.Visible = false
		state.lockedTarget = nil
		state.selectedAimbotPlayer = nil
		state.selectedFlingPlayer = nil
		state.flingActive = false
		state.flingToken = state.flingToken + 1
		clearAllLocators()
		clearAllExtraVisuals()
		restoreHitboxes()
		if infiniteJumpConnection then
			pcall(function()
				infiniteJumpConnection:Disconnect()
			end)
		end
		if extraVisualFolder and extraVisualFolder.Parent then
			extraVisualFolder:Destroy()
		end
		if locatorFolder and locatorFolder.Parent then
			locatorFolder:Destroy()
		end
	end)
end

--============================================================
-- NOT RUBY V1 // ULTIMATE EXPANSION PACK
-- Extra universal client-side tabs: Command Center, FX Lab, Monitor,
-- Timer and Notes. Designed to stay local, mobile-friendly and removable.
--============================================================
do
local function setupUltimateExpansion()
	local StatsService = game:GetService("Stats")
	local HttpService = game:GetService("HttpService")
	local expansionConnections = {}
	local expansionDestroyed = false
	local sessionStartedAt = os.clock()

	local function trackConnection(connection)
		table.insert(expansionConnections,connection)
		return connection
	end

	local function expansionRoot()
		if root and root.Parent then
			return root
		end
		local currentCharacter = player.Character
		return currentCharacter and currentCharacter:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or nil
	end

	local function clamp255(value)
		return math.clamp(math.floor((tonumber(value) or 0)+.5),0,255)
	end

	local function safeClipboard(text,successMessage)
		if type(setclipboard) ~= "function" then
			setStatus("CLIPBOARD UNAVAILABLE")
			return false
		end
		local ok = pcall(setclipboard,tostring(text))
		setStatus(ok and (successMessage or "COPIED") or "COPY FAILED")
		return ok
	end

	local function applyExpansionAccent(color,statusMessage)
		if typeof(color) ~= "Color3" then
			return
		end
		local previousAccent = accent
		accent = color
		themeIndex = 0
		refreshAccentBoundVisuals(previousAccent)
		status.TextColor3 = accent
		sidebar.ScrollBarImageColor3 = accent
		applyTabVisuals()
		refreshToggleColors()
		if themeButton and themeButton.Parent then
			themeButton.Text = "THEME: CUSTOM"
		end
		if gui:GetAttribute("OutlineMode") == "MATCH" then
			gui:SetAttribute("OutlineColor",accent)
			for _,object in ipairs(gui:GetDescendants()) do
				if object:IsA("UIStroke")
					and object:GetAttribute("NotRubyFixedColor") ~= true then
					object.Color = accent
				end
			end
		end
		if statusMessage then
			setStatus(statusMessage)
		end
	end

	local function applyExpansionAccentFast(color)
		if typeof(color) ~= "Color3" then
			return
		end
		local previousAccent = accent
		accent = color
		themeIndex = 0
		refreshAccentBoundVisuals(previousAccent)
		status.TextColor3 = accent
		sidebar.ScrollBarImageColor3 = accent
		for button,data in pairs(activeToggleButtons) do
			if data.on and button and button.Parent then
				button.TextColor3 = readableTextOn(accent)
			end
		end
		local activeTabButton = tabButtons[currentTab]
		if activeTabButton then
			local activeText = readableTextOn(accent)
			local activeIcon = activeTabButton:FindFirstChild("TabIcon")
			local activeLabel = activeTabButton:FindFirstChild("TabLabel")
			if activeIcon then activeIcon.TextColor3 = activeText end
			if activeLabel then activeLabel.TextColor3 = activeText end
		end
		if gui:GetAttribute("OutlineMode") == "MATCH" then
			gui:SetAttribute("OutlineColor",accent)
			for _,object in ipairs(gui:GetDescendants()) do
				if object:IsA("UIStroke")
					and object:GetAttribute("NotRubyFixedColor") ~= true then
					object.Color = accent
				end
			end
		end
	end

	local function formatDuration(seconds)
		seconds = math.max(0,math.floor(tonumber(seconds) or 0))
		local hours = math.floor(seconds/3600)
		local minutes = math.floor((seconds%3600)/60)
		local secs = seconds%60
		if hours > 0 then
			return string.format("%02d:%02d:%02d",hours,minutes,secs)
		end
		return string.format("%02d:%02d",minutes,secs)
	end

	local function getPingText()
		local ping = nil
		pcall(function()
			local network = StatsService.Network
			local serverStats = network and network.ServerStatsItem
			local item = serverStats and serverStats["Data Ping"]
			if item then
				ping = item:GetValueString()
			end
		end)
		return ping or "--"
	end

	local function getMemoryText()
		local memory = nil
		pcall(function()
			if type(gcinfo) == "function" then
				memory = string.format("%.1f MB",gcinfo()/1024)
			end
		end)
		return memory or "--"
	end

	-- Brand-image fallback: if a private/unavailable image cannot load in the
	-- current experience, keep every dragon mark image-based instead of emoji.
	local brandBadge = header and header:FindFirstChild("DragonBadge")
	if brandBadge and brandBadge:IsA("ImageLabel") then
		local fallback = Instance.new("ImageLabel")
		fallback.Name = "BrandImageFallback"
		fallback.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1,1)
		fallback.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		fallback.Image = BRAND_IMAGE
		fallback.ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Fit
		fallback.Visible = false
		fallback.ZIndex = brandBadge.ZIndex + 2
		fallback.Parent = brandBadge
		task.spawn(function()
			for _ = 1,20 do
				if expansionDestroyed or not brandBadge.Parent then
					return
				end
				local loaded = false
				pcall(function()
					loaded = brandBadge.IsLoaded
				end)
				fallback.Visible = not loaded
				if loaded then
					return
				end
				task.wait(.25)
			end
			fallback.Visible = true
		end)
	end

	local function makeInfoCard(page,height)
		local card = Instance.new("Frame")
		card.Size = UDim2.new(1,0,0,height or 150)
		card.BackgroundColor3 = SURFACE
		card.BorderSizePixel = 0
		card.Parent = page
		corner(card,14)
		addStroke(card,accent,1,.64)

		local gradient = Instance.new("UIGradient")
		gradient.Color = ColorSequence.new({
			ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0,SURFACE_2),
			ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1,SURFACE)
		})
		gradient.Rotation = 15
		gradient.Parent = card
		return card
	end

	local commandLines = {"NOT RUBY COMMAND CENTER","> Type HELP and press RUN"}
	local function logCommand(text)
		table.insert(commandLines,tostring(text))
		while #commandLines > 13 do
			table.remove(commandLines,1)
		end
		consoleLog.Text = table.concat(commandLines,"\n")
	end

	local function splitCommand(text)
		local args = {}
		for token in string.gmatch(tostring(text),"%S+") do
			table.insert(args,token)
		end
		return args
	end

	local helpText = table.concat({
		"HELP",
		"FOV <40-120>",
		"THEME <R> <G> <B>",
		"OUTLINE <R> <G> <B>",
		"TAB <name>",
		"SCALE <80-130>",
		"POS / COPYPOS",
		"COPYPLACE / COPYJOB",
		"PLAYERS / FPS / PING / TIME",
		"CENTER / RESETCAMERA / HOME",
		"CLEAR"
	},"  |  ")

	local function executeCommand(raw)
		raw = tostring(raw or "")
		local args = splitCommand(raw)
		local command = string.lower(args[1] or "")
		if command == "" then
			return
		end
		logCommand("> "..raw)

		if command == "help" or command == "?" then
			logCommand(helpText)
		elseif command == "fov" then
			local value = math.clamp(tonumber(args[2]) or 70,40,120)
			camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
			if camera then
				camera.FieldOfView = value
				logCommand("FOV = "..tostring(value))
				setStatus("FOV "..tostring(value))
			else
				logCommand("Camera unavailable")
			end
		elseif command == "theme" then
			if not args[2] or not args[3] or not args[4] then
				logCommand("Usage: THEME 255 0 100")
				return
			end
			local color = Color3.fromRGB(clamp255(args[2]),clamp255(args[3]),clamp255(args[4]))
			applyExpansionAccent(color,"COMMAND THEME APPLIED")
			logCommand(string.format("Theme RGB(%d,%d,%d)",clamp255(args[2]),clamp255(args[3]),clamp255(args[4])))
		elseif command == "outline" then
			if not args[2] or not args[3] or not args[4] then
				logCommand("Usage: OUTLINE 0 255 255")
				return
			end
			local color = Color3.fromRGB(clamp255(args[2]),clamp255(args[3]),clamp255(args[4]))
			gui:SetAttribute("OutlineMode","CUSTOM")
			gui:SetAttribute("OutlineIndex",0)
			gui:SetAttribute("OutlineColor",color)
			for _,object in ipairs(gui:GetDescendants()) do
				if object:IsA("UIStroke")
					and object:GetAttribute("NotRubyFixedColor") ~= true then
					object.Color = color
				end
			end
			if outlineButton and outlineButton.Parent then
				outlineButton.Text = "OUTLINE: CUSTOM"
			end
			logCommand("Custom outline applied")
			setStatus("COMMAND OUTLINE APPLIED")
		elseif command == "tab" then
			local requested = string.upper(args[2] or "")
			if pages[requested] then
				setTab(requested)
				logCommand("Opened tab "..requested)
			else
				logCommand("Unknown tab: "..requested)
			end
		elseif command == "scale" then
			local percent = math.clamp(tonumber(args[2]) or 100,80,130)
			setPanelScale(percent/100,true)
			logCommand("UI scale = "..tostring(percent).."%")
		elseif command == "pos" then
			local currentRoot = expansionRoot()
			if currentRoot then
				local p = currentRoot.Position
				logCommand(string.format("X %.1f  Y %.1f  Z %.1f",p.X,p.Y,p.Z))
			else
				logCommand("Character root unavailable")
			end
		elseif command == "copypos" then
			local currentRoot = expansionRoot()
			if currentRoot then
				local p = currentRoot.Position
				local text = string.format("%.2f, %.2f, %.2f",p.X,p.Y,p.Z)
				safeClipboard(text,"POSITION COPIED")
				logCommand(text)
			else
				logCommand("Character root unavailable")
			end
		elseif command == "copyplace" then
			safeClipboard(tostring(game.PlaceId),"PLACE ID COPIED")
			logCommand("PlaceId = "..tostring(game.PlaceId))
		elseif command == "copyjob" then
			safeClipboard(tostring(game.JobId),"JOB ID COPIED")
			logCommand("JobId copied")
		elseif command == "players" then
			logCommand("Players = "..tostring(#Players:GetPlayers()))
		elseif command == "fps" then
			logCommand("Live FPS is shown in MONITOR")
		elseif command == "ping" then
			logCommand("Ping = "..getPingText())
		elseif command == "time" then
			logCommand("Session = "..formatDuration(os.clock()-sessionStartedAt))
		elseif command == "center" then
			panel.Position = UDim2.new(.5,-math.floor(panel.AbsoluteSize.X/2),.5,-math.floor(panel.AbsoluteSize.Y/2))
			logCommand("Panel centered")
			setStatus("PANEL CENTERED")
		elseif command == "resetcamera" then
			camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
			if camera then
				camera.CameraType = Enum.CameraType.Custom
				local currentHumanoid = player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
				if currentHumanoid then
					camera.CameraSubject = currentHumanoid
				end
				camera.FieldOfView = originalFOV
			end
			player.CameraMode = Enum.CameraMode.Classic
			logCommand("Camera restored")
			setStatus("CAMERA RESTORED")
		elseif command == "home" then
			setTab("HOME")
		elseif command == "clear" then
			commandLines = {"NOT RUBY COMMAND CENTER"}
			consoleLog.Text = table.concat(commandLines,"\n")
		else
			logCommand("Unknown command. Type HELP")
		end
	end

	local function clearTrail()
		if trailObject then
			trailObject:Destroy()
			trailObject = nil
		end
		for _,attachment in ipairs(trailAttachments) do
			if attachment and attachment.Parent then
				attachment:Destroy()
			end
		end
		trailAttachments = {}
	end

	local function buildTrail()
		clearTrail()
		local currentRoot = expansionRoot()
		if not currentRoot then
			return false
		end
		local a0 = Instance.new("Attachment")
		a0.Name = "NotRubyTrailTop"
		a0.Position = Vector3.new(0,1.25,0)
		a0.Parent = currentRoot
		local a1 = Instance.new("Attachment")
		a1.Name = "NotRubyTrailBottom"
		a1.Position = Vector3.new(0,-1.25,0)
		a1.Parent = currentRoot
		local trail = Instance.new("Trail")
		trail.Name = "NotRubyNeonTrail"
		trail.Attachment0 = a0
		trail.Attachment1 = a1
		trail.Lifetime = .48
		trail.MinLength = .05
		trail.FaceCamera = true
		trail.LightEmission = 1
		trail.Transparency = NumberSequence.new({
			NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0,.05),
			NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1,1)
		})
		trail.Color = ColorSequence.new(accent)
		trail.Parent = currentRoot
		trailObject = trail
		trailAttachments = {a0,a1}
		return true
	end

	local function clearOrbit()
		for _,part in ipairs(orbitParts) do
			if part and part.Parent then
				part:Destroy()
			end
		end
		orbitParts = {}
	end

	local function buildOrbit()
		clearOrbit()
		for index = 1,7 do
			local orb = Instance.new("Part")
			orb.Name = "NotRubyOrbitOrb"
			orb.Shape = Enum.PartType.Ball
			orb.Size = Vector3.new(.42,.42,.42)
			orb.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
			orb.Color = accent
			orb.Transparency = .1
			orb.Anchored = true
			orb.CanCollide = false
			orb.CanTouch = false
			orb.CanQuery = false
			orb.CastShadow = false
			orb.Parent = fxFolder
			table.insert(orbitParts,orb)
		end
	end

	local function clearAuraPulse()
		if auraHighlight then
			auraHighlight:Destroy()
			auraHighlight = nil
		end
	end

	local function buildAuraPulse()
		clearAuraPulse()
		local currentCharacter = player.Character
		if not currentCharacter then
			return false
		end
		local highlight = Instance.new("Highlight")
		highlight.Name = "NotRubyUltimateAura"
		highlight.Adornee = currentCharacter
		highlight.FillColor = accent
		highlight.OutlineColor = Color3.fromRGB(255,255,255)
		highlight.FillTransparency = .65
		highlight.OutlineTransparency = .12
		highlight.DepthMode = Enum.HighlightDepthMode.AlwaysOnTop
		highlight.Parent = currentCharacter
		auraHighlight = highlight
		return true
	end

		local attachment = Instance.new("Attachment")

	trackConnection(RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
		if expansionDestroyed or menuDeleted then
			return
		end
		local now = os.clock()
		if rgbEnabled and now-lastRgbUpdate >= .12 then
			lastRgbUpdate = now
			local hue = (now*.08)%1
			applyExpansionAccentFast(Color3.fromHSV(hue,.82,1))
		end
		if trailObject then
			trailObject.Color = ColorSequence.new(accent)
		end
		if auraHighlight then
			auraHighlight.FillColor = accent
			auraHighlight.FillTransparency = .58 + math.sin(now*3.2)*.13
		end
		if orbitEnabled then
			local currentRoot = expansionRoot()
			if not currentRoot then
				return
			end
			if #orbitParts == 0 then
				buildOrbit()
			end
			for index,orb in ipairs(orbitParts) do
				if orb and orb.Parent then
					local angle = now*1.8 + (index-1)*(math.pi*2/#orbitParts)
					local radius = 3.1 + math.sin(now*1.3+index)*.28
					local y = 1.15 + math.sin(now*2.1+index*.7)*1.05
					orb.Color = accent
					orb.Position = currentRoot.Position + Vector3.new(math.cos(angle)*radius,y,math.sin(angle)*radius)
				end
			end
		end
	end))

	local function cleanAllFx()
		rgbEnabled = false
		trailEnabled = false
		orbitEnabled = false
		auraPulseEnabled = false
		scanlinesEnabled = false
		letterboxEnabled = false
		setToggle(rainbowButton,false,"RGB THEME")
		setToggle(trailButton,false,"NEON TRAIL")
		setToggle(orbitButton,false,"ORBIT ORBS")
		setToggle(auraPulseButton,false,"AURA PULSE")
		setToggle(scanlinesButton,false,"SCANLINES")
		setToggle(letterboxButton,false,"CINEMA BARS")
		clearTrail()
		clearOrbit()
		clearAuraPulse()
		scanlineContainer.Visible = false
		topBar.Size = UDim2.new(1,0,0,0)
		bottomBar.Size = UDim2.new(1,0,0,0)
		flashOverlay.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		for _,object in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
			if object.Name == "NotRubyUltimateSparkBurst" then
				object:Destroy()
			end
		end
		setStatus("ULTIMATE FX CLEANED")
	end
	cleanFxButton.Activated:Connect(cleanAllFx)

	trackConnection(player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function()
		task.wait(.35)
		if trailEnabled then
			buildTrail()
		end
		if auraPulseEnabled then
			buildAuraPulse()
		end
	end))

	-- --------------------------------------------------------
	-- LIVE MONITOR
	-- --------------------------------------------------------
	tabIcons.MONITOR = "▤"
	local monitorTab = makeTab("MONITOR","LIVE MONITOR")
	local monitorPage = makePage("MONITOR")
	monitorTab.Activated:Connect(function() setTab("MONITOR") end)

	makeSection(
		monitorPage,
		"LIVE MONITOR",
		"A lightweight client snapshot for FPS, ping, memory, character speed, coordinates and session information."
	)

	local monitorCard = makeInfoCard(monitorPage,238)
	local monitorTitle = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	monitorTitle.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	monitorTitle.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(14,10)
	monitorTitle.Size = UDim2.new(1,-28,0,22)
	monitorTitle.Text = "REAL-TIME SNAPSHOT"

	monitorTitle.TextColor3 = accent
	monitorTitle.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left

		"COPY POSITION"
	)

	local monitorAuto = runtimeCore.safeStart ~= true
	local frameCounter = 0
	local fpsValue = 0
	local fpsWindowStarted = os.clock()
	local lastMonitorUpdate = 0
	local lastSnapshot = ""
	trackConnection(RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
		frameCounter = frameCounter + 1
		local now = os.clock()
		local elapsed = now-fpsWindowStarted
		if elapsed >= .5 then
			fpsValue = math.floor(frameCounter/elapsed+.5)
			frameCounter = 0
			fpsWindowStarted = now
		end
	end))

	local function buildSnapshot()
		local currentRoot = expansionRoot()
		local positionText = "--, --, --"
		local speedText = "--"
		if currentRoot then
			local p = currentRoot.Position
			positionText = string.format("%.1f, %.1f, %.1f",p.X,p.Y,p.Z)
			speedText = string.format("%.1f",currentRoot.AssemblyLinearVelocity.Magnitude)
		end
		camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
		local fovText = camera and string.format("%.0f",camera.FieldOfView) or "--"
		local viewportText = camera and string.format("%dx%d",math.floor(camera.ViewportSize.X),math.floor(camera.ViewportSize.Y)) or "--"
		local snapshot = table.concat({
			"FPS           "..tostring(fpsValue),
			"PING          "..getPingText(),
			"LUA MEMORY    "..getMemoryText(),
			"PLAYERS       "..tostring(#Players:GetPlayers()),
			"SPEED         "..speedText,
			"POSITION      "..positionText,
			"FOV           "..fovText,
			"VIEWPORT      "..viewportText,
			"SESSION       "..formatDuration(os.clock()-sessionStartedAt),
			"PLACE ID      "..tostring(game.PlaceId),
			"JOB ID        "..(tostring(game.JobId) ~= "" and tostring(game.JobId) or "Studio / unavailable")
		},"\n")
		lastSnapshot = snapshot
		monitorText.Text = snapshot
		monitorTitle.TextColor3 = accent
		return snapshot
	end

	trackConnection(RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
		if expansionDestroyed or menuDeleted or not monitorAuto then
			return
		end
		if not monitorPage.Visible and os.clock()-lastMonitorUpdate < 2 then
			return
		end
		if os.clock()-lastMonitorUpdate >= .45 then
			lastMonitorUpdate = os.clock()
			buildSnapshot()
		end
	end))

	copySnapshotButton.Activated:Connect(function()
		safeClipboard(lastSnapshot ~= "" and lastSnapshot or buildSnapshot(),"SNAPSHOT COPIED")
	end)
	refreshSnapshotButton.Activated:Connect(function()
		buildSnapshot()
		setStatus("MONITOR REFRESHED")
	end)
	copyJobButton.Activated:Connect(function()
		safeClipboard(tostring(game.JobId),"JOB ID COPIED")
	end)
	copyPositionMonitorButton.Activated:Connect(function()

		if not currentRoot then
			setStatus("CHARACTER UNAVAILABLE")
			return
		end
		local p = currentRoot.Position
		safeClipboard(string.format("%.2f, %.2f, %.2f",p.X,p.Y,p.Z),"POSITION COPIED")
	end)
	monitorAutoButton.Activated:Connect(function()
		monitorAuto = not monitorAuto
		setToggle(monitorAutoButton,monitorAuto,"AUTO REFRESH")
		if monitorAuto then
			buildSnapshot()
		end
		setStatus(monitorAuto and "MONITOR AUTO REFRESH ON" or "MONITOR AUTO REFRESH OFF")
	end)
	setToggle(monitorAutoButton,monitorAuto,"AUTO REFRESH")
	buildSnapshot()

	makeSection(
		monitorPage,
		"PLAYER EVENT FEED",
		"Shows the most recent joins and leaves observed during this script session."
	)

	local feedText = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	feedText.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	feedText.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(12,10)
	feedText.Size = UDim2.new(1,-24,1,-20)
	feedText.Text = "No player events yet."
	feedText.TextSize = 9
	feedText.Font = Enum.Font.Code
	feedText.TextColor3 = MUTED
	feedText.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
	feedText.TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Top
	feedText.TextWrapped = true
	feedText.Parent = feedCard
	local feedLines = {}
	local function pushFeed(text)
		table.insert(feedLines,1,os.date("%H:%M:%S").."  "..text)
		while #feedLines > 6 do
			table.remove(feedLines)
		end
		feedText.Text = table.concat(feedLines,"\n")
	end
	trackConnection(Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(otherPlayer)
		pushFeed("+ "..otherPlayer.DisplayName.." (@"..otherPlayer.Name..")")
	end))
	trackConnection(Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(otherPlayer)
		pushFeed("- "..otherPlayer.DisplayName.." (@"..otherPlayer.Name..")")
	end))

	-- --------------------------------------------------------
	-- TIMER LAB
	-- --------------------------------------------------------
	tabIcons.TIMER = "◷"
	local timerTab = makeTab("TIMER","TIMER LAB")
	local timerPage = makePage("TIMER")
	timerTab.Activated:Connect(function() setTab("TIMER") end)

	makeSection(
		timerPage,
		"STOPWATCH",
		"A session stopwatch with pause, resume and lap support."
	)
	local stopwatchCard = makeInfoCard(timerPage,112)
	local stopwatchText = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	stopwatchText.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1,1)
	stopwatchText.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	stopwatchText.Text = "00:00.00"
	stopwatchText.TextSize = 30
	stopwatchText.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBlack
	stopwatchText.TextColor3 = accent
	stopwatchText.Parent = stopwatchCard
	local startWatchButton,resetWatchButton = makePair(timerPage,"START","RESET")
	local lapButton,clearLapsButton = makePair(timerPage,"LAP","CLEAR LAPS")
	local lapsCard = makeInfoCard(timerPage,112)
	local lapsText = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	lapsText.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	lapsText.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(12,8)
	lapsText.Size = UDim2.new(1,-24,1,-16)
	lapsText.Text = "No laps"
	lapsText.TextSize = 9
	lapsText.Font = Enum.Font.Code
	lapsText.TextColor3 = MUTED
	lapsText.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
	lapsText.TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Top
	lapsText.TextWrapped = true
	lapsText.Parent = lapsCard

	local watchRunning = false
	local watchStarted = 0
	local watchAccumulated = 0
	local lapValues = {}
	local function watchElapsed()
		return watchAccumulated + (watchRunning and (os.clock()-watchStarted) or 0)
	end
	local function formatWatch(value)
		local totalHundredths = math.floor(math.max(0,value)*100)
		local minutes = math.floor(totalHundredths/6000)
		local seconds = math.floor((totalHundredths%6000)/100)
		local hundredths = totalHundredths%100
		return string.format("%02d:%02d.%02d",minutes,seconds,hundredths)
	end
	startWatchButton.Activated:Connect(function()
		if watchRunning then
			watchAccumulated = watchElapsed()
			watchRunning = false
			startWatchButton.Text = "RESUME"
			setStatus("STOPWATCH PAUSED")
		else
			watchStarted = os.clock()
			watchRunning = true
			startWatchButton.Text = "PAUSE"
			setStatus("STOPWATCH RUNNING")
		end
	end)
	resetWatchButton.Activated:Connect(function()
		watchRunning = false
		watchStarted = 0
		watchAccumulated = 0
		startWatchButton.Text = "START"
		stopwatchText.Text = "00:00.00"
		setStatus("STOPWATCH RESET")
	end)
	lapButton.Activated:Connect(function()
		local value = watchElapsed()
		table.insert(lapValues,1,formatWatch(value))
		while #lapValues > 6 do
			table.remove(lapValues)
		end
		local display = {}
		for index,lap in ipairs(lapValues) do
			table.insert(display,string.format("LAP %d   %s",#lapValues-index+1,lap))
		end
		lapsText.Text = table.concat(display,"\n")
		setStatus("LAP RECORDED")
	end)
	clearLapsButton.Activated:Connect(function()
		lapValues = {}
		lapsText.Text = "No laps"
		setStatus("LAPS CLEARED")
	end)

	makeSection(
		timerPage,
		"COUNTDOWN",
		"Enter a number of seconds. The timer runs locally while this script is active."
	)
	local countdownBox,countdownStartButton = makeNumberRow(timerPage,"SECONDS","60","START")
	local cancelCountdownButton = makeAction(timerPage,"CANCEL COUNTDOWN")
	local countdownCard = makeInfoCard(timerPage,98)
	local countdownText = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	countdownText.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1,1)
	countdownText.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	countdownText.Text = "01:00"
	countdownText.TextSize = 28
	countdownText.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBlack
	countdownText.TextColor3 = TEXT
	countdownText.Parent = countdownCard
	local countdownActive = false
	local countdownEnd = 0
	local countdownGeneration = 0

	local function cancelCountdown(statusText)
		countdownActive = false
		countdownGeneration = countdownGeneration + 1
		if statusText then
			setStatus(statusText)
		end
	end
	countdownStartButton.Activated:Connect(function()
		local seconds = math.clamp(math.floor(tonumber(countdownBox.Text) or 60),1,86400)
		countdownBox.Text = tostring(seconds)
		countdownGeneration = countdownGeneration + 1
		countdownEnd = os.clock()+seconds
		countdownActive = true
		countdownText.Text = formatDuration(seconds)
		setStatus("COUNTDOWN STARTED")
	end)
	cancelCountdownButton.Activated:Connect(function()
		cancelCountdown("COUNTDOWN CANCELED")
	end)

	makeSection(
		timerPage,
		"CLOCK",
		"Local device clock plus time elapsed since this Not Ruby session started."
	)
	local clockCard = makeInfoCard(timerPage,100)
	local clockText = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	clockText.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1,1)
	clockText.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	clockText.Text = "--:--:--"
	clockText.TextSize = 16
	clockText.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBlack
	clockText.TextColor3 = TEXT
	clockText.TextWrapped = true
	clockText.Parent = clockCard

	trackConnection(RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
		if expansionDestroyed or menuDeleted then
			return
		end
		stopwatchText.Text = formatWatch(watchElapsed())
		stopwatchText.TextColor3 = accent
		clockText.Text = os.date("%H:%M:%S").."\nSESSION "..formatDuration(os.clock()-sessionStartedAt)
		if countdownActive then
			local remaining = math.max(0,countdownEnd-os.clock())
			countdownText.Text = formatDuration(math.ceil(remaining))
			countdownText.TextColor3 = remaining <= 10 and Color3.fromRGB(255,110,110) or accent
			if remaining <= 0 then
				countdownActive = false
				countdownText.Text = "00:00"
				-- setStatus already emits the notification once.
				setStatus("COUNTDOWN FINISHED")
			end
		end
	end))

	-- --------------------------------------------------------
	-- NOTES
	-- --------------------------------------------------------
	tabIcons.NOTES = "✎"
	local notesTab = makeTab("NOTES","NOTES")
	local notesPage = makePage("NOTES")
	notesTab.Activated:Connect(function() setTab("NOTES") end)

	makeSection(
		notesPage,
		"NOTES",
		"A scratchpad for this session. If file functions are available, you can also save the note on this device/account."
	)
	local notesBox = Instance.new("TextBox")
	notesBox.Size = UDim2.new(1,0,0,260)
	notesBox.Text = ""
	notesBox.PlaceholderText = "Write anything here..."
	notesBox.ClearTextOnFocus = false
	notesBox.MultiLine = true
	notesBox.TextWrapped = true
	notesBox.TextSize = 10
	notesBox.Font = Enum.Font.Code
	notesBox.TextColor3 = TEXT
	notesBox.PlaceholderColor3 = MUTED
	notesBox.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
	notesBox.TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Top
	notesBox.BackgroundColor3 = SURFACE
	notesBox.BorderSizePixel = 0
	notesBox.Parent = notesPage
	corner(notesBox,13)
	addStroke(notesBox,accent,1,.64)
	local notesPadding = Instance.new("UIPadding")
	notesPadding.PaddingTop = UDim.new(0,12)
	notesPadding.PaddingBottom = UDim.new(0,12)
	notesPadding.PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0,12)
	notesPadding.PaddingRight = UDim.new(0,12)
	notesPadding.Parent = notesBox

	local saveNoteButton,loadNoteButton = makePair(notesPage,"SAVE NOTE","LOAD NOTE")
	local copyNoteButton,clearNoteButton = makePair(notesPage,"COPY NOTE","CLEAR NOTE")
	local noteStatus = makeAction(notesPage,"STORAGE STATUS")
	local notesFile = "not_ruby_notes_"..tostring(player.UserId)..".txt"
	local canNoteFiles = type(isfile)=="function" and type(readfile)=="function" and type(writefile)=="function"

	saveNoteButton.Activated:Connect(function()
		if not canNoteFiles then
			setStatus("NOTE STORAGE // SESSION ONLY")
			return
		end
		local ok = pcall(writefile,notesFile,notesBox.Text)
		setStatus(ok and "NOTE SAVED" or "NOTE SAVE FAILED")
	end)
	loadNoteButton.Activated:Connect(function()
		if not canNoteFiles then
			setStatus("NOTE STORAGE // SESSION ONLY")
			return
		end
		local ok,result = pcall(function()
			if not isfile(notesFile) then
				return nil
			end
			return readfile(notesFile)
		end)
		if ok and result ~= nil then
			notesBox.Text = tostring(result)
			setStatus("NOTE LOADED")
		else
			setStatus("NO SAVED NOTE")
		end
	end)
	copyNoteButton.Activated:Connect(function()
		safeClipboard(notesBox.Text,"NOTE COPIED")
	end)
	clearNoteButton.Activated:Connect(function()
		notesBox.Text = ""
		setStatus("NOTE CLEARED")
	end)
	noteStatus.Activated:Connect(function()
		setStatus(canNoteFiles and "NOTES // FILE STORAGE AVAILABLE" or "NOTES // SESSION STORAGE ONLY")
	end)

	-- --------------------------------------------------------
	-- QUICK DOCK
	-- --------------------------------------------------------
	makeSection(
		commandPage,
		"QUICK DOCK",
		"A small optional floating bar for fast access to Home, theme cycling, FOV and photo mode."
	)
	local quickDockToggle = makeAction(commandPage,"QUICK DOCK [OFF]")
	local quickDock = Instance.new("Frame")
	quickDock.Name = "NotRubyQuickDock"
	quickDock.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(.5,1)
	quickDock.Position = UDim2.new(.5,0,1,-18)
	quickDock.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(330,48)
	quickDock.BackgroundColor3 = PANEL
	quickDock.BackgroundTransparency = .06
	quickDock.BorderSizePixel = 0
	quickDock.Visible = false
	quickDock.ZIndex = 620
	quickDock.Parent = gui
	corner(quickDock,14)
	addStroke(quickDock,accent,1.3,.08)
	local dockLayout = Instance.new("UIListLayout")
	dockLayout.FillDirection = Enum.FillDirection.Horizontal
	dockLayout.HorizontalAlignment = Enum.HorizontalAlignment.Center
	dockLayout.VerticalAlignment = Enum.VerticalAlignment.Center
	dockLayout.Padding = UDim.new(0,5)
	dockLayout.Parent = quickDock

	local function dockButton(text,width)
		local button = Instance.new("TextButton")
		button.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(width or 58,34)
		button.Text = text
		button.TextSize = 8
		button.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBlack
		button.TextColor3 = TEXT
		button.BackgroundColor3 = SURFACE_2
		button.BorderSizePixel = 0
		button.AutoButtonColor = false
		button.ZIndex = 621
		button.Parent = quickDock
		corner(button,9)
		addStroke(button,accent,.7,.76)
		return button
	end
	local dockHome = dockButton("HOME",56)
	local dockTheme = dockButton("THEME",62)
	local dockFov70 = dockButton("FOV 70",62)
	local dockPhoto = dockButton("PHOTO",62)
	local dockHide = dockButton("HIDE",56)
	local quickDockEnabled = false
	quickDockToggle.Activated:Connect(function()
		quickDockEnabled = not quickDockEnabled
		quickDock.Visible = quickDockEnabled
		setToggle(quickDockToggle,quickDockEnabled,"QUICK DOCK")
		setStatus(quickDockEnabled and "QUICK DOCK ON" or "QUICK DOCK OFF")
	end)
	dockHome.Activated:Connect(function()
		panel.Visible = true
		openButton.Visible = false
		setTab("HOME")
	end)
	dockTheme.Activated:Connect(function()
		cycleTheme()
		if themeButton and themeButton.Parent and themeIndex > 0 then
			themeButton.Text = "THEME: "..themes[themeIndex].name
		end
	end)
	dockFov70.Activated:Connect(function()
		camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
		if camera then
			camera.FieldOfView = 70
			setStatus("FOV 70")
		end
	end)
	dockPhoto.Activated:Connect(function()
		local panelWasVisible = panel.Visible
		local miniWasVisible = openButton.Visible
		local dockWasVisible = quickDock.Visible
		panel.Visible = false
		openButton.Visible = false
		quickDock.Visible = false
		task.delay(3,function()
			if expansionDestroyed or menuDeleted or not gui.Parent then
				return
			end
			panel.Visible = panelWasVisible
			openButton.Visible = miniWasVisible
			quickDock.Visible = dockWasVisible and quickDockEnabled
			setStatus("QUICK PHOTO MODE FINISHED")
		end)
	end)
	dockHide.Activated:Connect(function()
		quickDockEnabled = false
		quickDock.Visible = false
		setToggle(quickDockToggle,false,"QUICK DOCK")
	end)

	runtimeCore.stopEvent.Event:Connect(function()
		monitorAuto = false
		setToggle(monitorAutoButton,false,"AUTO REFRESH")
		cleanAllFx()
		quickDockEnabled = false
		quickDock.Visible = false
		setToggle(quickDockToggle,false,"QUICK DOCK")
	end)

	local function cleanupExpansion()
		if expansionDestroyed then
			return
		end
		expansionDestroyed = true
		cleanAllFx()
		cancelCountdown(nil)
		quickDockEnabled = false
		if quickDock and quickDock.Parent then
			quickDock:Destroy()
		end
		if fxOverlay and fxOverlay.Parent then
			fxOverlay:Destroy()
		end
		if fxFolder and fxFolder.Parent then
			fxFolder:Destroy()
		end
		for _,connection in ipairs(expansionConnections) do
			pcall(function()
				connection:Disconnect()
			end)
		end
		expansionConnections = {}
	end

	trackConnection(gui.Destroying:Connect(cleanupExpansion))
	setStatus("ULTIMATE EXPANSION READY")
end
safeSetup("Ultimate Expansion",setupUltimateExpansion)
end

--============================================================
-- NOT RUBY V1 // V58 RUNTIME CONTROL CENTER
-- Profiles + safe mode + task manager + config export/import.
--============================================================
;(function()
	local HttpService = game:GetService("HttpService")

	tabIcons.RUNTIME = "◌"
	local runtimeTab = makeTab("RUNTIME","RUNTIME")
	local runtimePage = makePage("RUNTIME")
	runtimeTab.Activated:Connect(function()
		setTab("RUNTIME")
	end)

	makeSection(
		runtimePage,
		"GAME PROFILES // LAZY SLEEP",
		"Opening DOORS, House of the Locust or Shooter automatically wakes that profile. Other game scanners stay asleep. No PlaceId is required."
	)

	local profileUniversal,profileDoors =
		makePair(runtimePage,"PROFILE: UNIVERSAL","PROFILE: DOORS")
	local profileLocust,profileShooter =
		makePair(runtimePage,"PROFILE: LOCUST","PROFILE: SHOOTER")
	local profileAll = makeAction(runtimePage,"PROFILE: ALL MODULES")
	local profileStatus = makeAction(runtimePage,"ACTIVE PROFILE: UNIVERSAL")

	local function setProfile(profile)
		profile = string.upper(tostring(profile or "UNIVERSAL"))
		if gui:GetAttribute("SafeMode") == true and profile ~= "UNIVERSAL" then
			setStatus("SAFE MODE // ONLY UNIVERSAL PROFILE AVAILABLE")
			return
		end
		gui:SetAttribute("RuntimeProfile",profile)
		profileStatus.Text = "ACTIVE PROFILE: "..profile
		setStatus("RUNTIME PROFILE // "..profile)
	end

	profileUniversal.Activated:Connect(function() setProfile("UNIVERSAL") end)
	profileDoors.Activated:Connect(function() setProfile("DOORS") end)
	profileLocust.Activated:Connect(function() setProfile("LOCUST") end)
	profileShooter.Activated:Connect(function() setProfile("SHOOTER") end)
	profileAll.Activated:Connect(function() setProfile("ALL") end)
	profileStatus.Activated:Connect(function()
		setStatus("PROFILE // "..tostring(gui:GetAttribute("RuntimeProfile")))
	end)

	makeSection(
		runtimePage,
		"SAFE MODE",
		"Safe Mode pauses game-specific scanners and active background features. You can also make the next launch start safe."
	)

	local safeNowButton,safeNextButton =
		makePair(
			runtimePage,
			gui:GetAttribute("SafeMode") == true and "SAFE MODE [ON]" or "SAFE MODE [OFF]",
			runtimeCore.safeStart and "SAFE NEXT LOAD [ON]" or "SAFE NEXT LOAD [OFF]"
		)

	local function applySafeMode(enabled)
		enabled = enabled == true
		gui:SetAttribute("SafeMode",enabled)
		if enabled then
			gui:SetAttribute("RuntimeProfile","UNIVERSAL")
			runtimeCore.stopEvent:Fire()
		end
		setToggle(safeNowButton,enabled,"SAFE MODE")
		profileStatus.Text =
			"ACTIVE PROFILE: "..tostring(gui:GetAttribute("RuntimeProfile"))
		setStatus(enabled and "SAFE MODE ON // BACKGROUND TASKS STOPPED" or "SAFE MODE OFF")
	end

	safeNowButton.Activated:Connect(function()
		applySafeMode(gui:GetAttribute("SafeMode") ~= true)
	end)

	safeNextButton.Activated:Connect(function()
		runtimeCore.safeStart = not runtimeCore.safeStart
		local saved = false
		if type(writefile) == "function" then
			saved = pcall(
				writefile,
				runtimeCore.safeStartFile,
				runtimeCore.safeStart and "1" or "0"
			)
		end
		setToggle(safeNextButton,runtimeCore.safeStart,"SAFE NEXT LOAD")
		setStatus(
			saved
			and (
				runtimeCore.safeStart
				and "NEXT LOAD WILL START IN SAFE MODE"
				or "NEXT LOAD SAFE MODE DISABLED"
			)
			or "SAFE START // FILE STORAGE UNAVAILABLE"
		)
	end)

	makeSection(
		runtimePage,
		"BACKGROUND TASK MANAGER",
		"Shows the important systems currently running or sleeping. Stop All disables the major Not Ruby background features without destroying the menu."
	)

	local taskCard = Instance.new("Frame")
	taskCard.Size = UDim2.new(1,0,0,230)
	taskCard.BackgroundColor3 = SURFACE
	taskCard.BorderSizePixel = 0
	taskCard.Parent = runtimePage
	corner(taskCard,14)
	addStroke(taskCard,accent,1,.72)

	local taskText = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	taskText.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	taskText.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(14,12)

	local function buildTaskSnapshot()
