	local function buildExport()
		local mainData = {}
		if type(isfile) == "function"
			and type(readfile) == "function"
			and isfile(mainConfigFile) then
			local ok,decoded = pcall(function()
				return HttpService:JSONDecode(readfile(mainConfigFile))
			end)
			if ok and typeof(decoded) == "table" then
				mainData = decoded
			end
		end

		return HttpService:JSONEncode({
			version = 58,
			main = mainData,
			runtime = {
				profile = tostring(gui:GetAttribute("RuntimeProfile") or "UNIVERSAL"),
				safeMode = gui:GetAttribute("SafeMode") == true,
				safeNextLoad = runtimeCore.safeStart == true,
				autoSafeRadius = tonumber(gui:GetAttribute("AutoSafeRadius")) or 80,
				autoSafeThreatFilter =
					tostring(gui:GetAttribute("AutoSafeThreatFilter") or "ALL")
			}
		})
	end

	exportConfigButton.Activated:Connect(function()
		local ok,result = pcall(buildExport)
		if not ok then
			setStatus("CONFIG EXPORT FAILED")
			return
		end
		configBox.Text = result
		if type(setclipboard) == "function" then
			local copied = pcall(setclipboard,result)
			setStatus(copied and "CONFIG EXPORTED + COPIED" or "CONFIG EXPORTED // COPY FAILED")
		else
			setStatus("CONFIG EXPORTED // SELECT TEXT MANUALLY")
		end
	end)

	importConfigButton.Activated:Connect(function()
		local raw = tostring(configBox.Text or "")
		local ok,decoded = pcall(function()
			return HttpService:JSONDecode(raw)
		end)
		if not ok or typeof(decoded) ~= "table" then
			setStatus("CONFIG IMPORT // INVALID JSON")
			return
		end

		local runtime = decoded.runtime
		if typeof(runtime) == "table" then
			if tonumber(runtime.autoSafeRadius) then
				local radius = math.clamp(
					math.floor(tonumber(runtime.autoSafeRadius)+.5),
					5,
					5000
				)
				gui:SetAttribute("AutoSafeRadius",radius)
				locustSafeControls.radiusBox.Text = tostring(radius)
			end
			if runtime.autoSafeThreatFilter ~= nil then
				local filter = string.upper(tostring(runtime.autoSafeThreatFilter))
				gui:SetAttribute("AutoSafeThreatFilter",filter)
				locustSafeControls.filterBox.Text = filter
			end
			runtimeCore.safeStart = runtime.safeNextLoad == true
			if type(writefile) == "function" then
				pcall(
					writefile,
					runtimeCore.safeStartFile,
					runtimeCore.safeStart and "1" or "0"
				)
			end
			setToggle(safeNextButton,runtimeCore.safeStart,"SAFE NEXT LOAD")
			if runtime.safeMode == true then
				applySafeMode(true)
			elseif gui:GetAttribute("SafeMode") ~= true then
				setProfile(runtime.profile or "UNIVERSAL")
			end
		end

		local wroteMain = false
		if typeof(decoded.main) == "table"
			and type(writefile) == "function" then
			wroteMain = pcall(
				writefile,
				mainConfigFile,
				HttpService:JSONEncode(decoded.main)
			)
		end

		setStatus(
			wroteMain
			and "CONFIG IMPORTED // RELOAD MENU TO APPLY MAIN SETTINGS"
			or "RUNTIME CONFIG IMPORTED // MAIN FILE STORAGE UNAVAILABLE"
		)
	end)

	clearConfigButton.Activated:Connect(function()
		configBox.Text = ""
		setStatus("CONFIG BOX CLEARED")
	end)

	if gui:GetAttribute("SafeMode") == true then
		setToggle(safeNowButton,true,"SAFE MODE")
		profileStatus.Text = "ACTIVE PROFILE: UNIVERSAL"
	else
		setToggle(safeNowButton,false,"SAFE MODE")
	end
	setToggle(safeNextButton,runtimeCore.safeStart,"SAFE NEXT LOAD")
	buildTaskSnapshot()
end)()

	local function compact(value)
		return string.lower(
			tostring(value or "")
		):gsub("[^%w]","")
	end

	local function rootPart()
		local char = player.Character
		return
			char
			and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
			or nil
	end

	local function humanoidNow()
		local char = player.Character
		return
			char
			and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
			or nil
	end

	local function partFor(object)
		if not object or not object.Parent then
			return nil
		end

		if object:IsA("BasePart") then
			return object
		end

		if object:IsA("Tool") then
			return
				object:FindFirstChild("Handle")
				or object:FindFirstChildWhichIsA(
					"BasePart",
					true
				)
		end

		if object:IsA("Model") then
			return
				object.PrimaryPart
				or object:FindFirstChildWhichIsA(
					"BasePart",
					true
				)
		end

		return object:FindFirstChildWhichIsA(
			"BasePart",
			true
		)
	end

	local function modelDiagonal(model)
		if not model or not model:IsA("Model") then
			return math.huge
		end

		local ok,_,size = pcall(function()
			local cf,boxSize = model:GetBoundingBox()
			return cf,boxSize
		end)

		if not ok or not size then
			return math.huge
		end

		return size.Magnitude
	end

	local function obviousWorldContainer(object)
		if not object then
			return true
		end

		local c = compact(object.Name)
		return
			c == "map"
			or c == "world"
			or c == "workspace"
			or c == "rooms"
			or c == "currentrooms"
			or c == "buildings"
			or c == "terrain"
			or c == "wagons"
			or c == "structures"
			or c == "decor"
	end

	local function canonicalItemRoot(object)
		if not object or not object.Parent then
			return nil
		end

		local cursor = object
		local firstPart = nil
		local nearestSmallModel = nil

		for _ = 1,10 do
			if not cursor or cursor == workspace then
				break
			end

			if cursor:IsA("Tool") then
				return cursor
			end

			if cursor:IsA("BasePart") and not firstPart then
				firstPart = cursor
			end

			if cursor:IsA("Model")
				and not obviousWorldContainer(cursor)
				and modelDiagonal(cursor) <= MAX_ITEM_MODEL_DIAGONAL then

				-- Nearest sensible model wins. V100 incorrectly kept climbing
				-- and often returned the entire room/map model.
				nearestSmallModel = cursor
				break
			end

			cursor = cursor.Parent
		end

		return nearestSmallModel or firstPart or object
	end

	local function signalPart(object,itemRoot)
		if object and object:IsA("BasePart") then
			return object
		end

		local cursor = object
		for _ = 1,8 do
			if not cursor
				or cursor == workspace
				or cursor == itemRoot then
				break
			end

			if cursor:IsA("BasePart") then
				return cursor
			end

			cursor = cursor.Parent
		end

		if object then
			local surface =
				object:FindFirstAncestorWhichIsA("SurfaceGui")
			local billboard =
				object:FindFirstAncestorWhichIsA("BillboardGui")

			local guiObject = surface or billboard
			if guiObject and guiObject.Adornee
				and guiObject.Adornee:IsA("BasePart") then
				return guiObject.Adornee
			end
		end

		return partFor(itemRoot)
	end

	local function withinMegaRadius(part)
		if not part or not part.Parent then
			return false
		end

		local ownRoot = rootPart()
		if not ownRoot then
			return true
		end

		return
			(ownRoot.Position-part.Position).Magnitude
			<= DEAD_SPELLS_SCAN_RADIUS
	end

	local function pickupLike(itemRoot)
		if not itemRoot or not itemRoot.Parent then
			return false
		end

		if itemRoot:IsA("Tool") then
			return true
		end

		if itemRoot:IsA("BasePart") then
			return
				itemRoot.Size.Magnitude <= 70
				or itemRoot:FindFirstChildOfClass("ProximityPrompt") ~= nil
				or itemRoot:FindFirstChildOfClass("ClickDetector") ~= nil
		end

		if itemRoot:IsA("Model") then
			if modelDiagonal(itemRoot) > MAX_ITEM_MODEL_DIAGONAL then
				return false
			end

			local checked = 0
			for _,object in ipairs(itemRoot:GetDescendants()) do
				checked += 1

				if object:IsA("ProximityPrompt")
					or object:IsA("ClickDetector")
					or object:IsA("Tool") then
					return true
				end

				if checked >= 180 then
					break
				end
			end

			-- Small physical item models are allowed even when collection is touch-only.
			return true
		end

		return false
	end

	local function isInsidePlayer(object)
		if not object then
			return false
		end

		local char = player.Character
		if char and object:IsDescendantOf(char) then
			return true
		end

		local backpack = player:FindFirstChildOfClass("Backpack")
		if backpack and object:IsDescendantOf(backpack) then
			return true
		end

		return false
	end

	local function characterLikeContainer(object)
		if not object
			or object == workspace then
			return false
		end

		if object:IsA("Model") then
			local ownedPlayer =
				Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(
					object
				)

			if ownedPlayer then
				return true
			end

			if object:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
				or object:FindFirstChildOfClass("AnimationController") then
				return true
			end

			local head =
				object:FindFirstChild("Head")
			local body =
				object:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
				or object:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso")
				or object:FindFirstChild("Torso")

			if head and body then
				return true
			end
		end

		local c = compact(object.Name)

		return
			string.find(c,"npc",1,true) ~= nil
			or string.find(c,"customer",1,true) ~= nil
			or string.find(c,"enemy",1,true) ~= nil
			or string.find(c,"mob",1,true) ~= nil
			or string.find(c,"dummy",1,true) ~= nil
			or string.find(c,"character",1,true) ~= nil
			or string.find(c,"merchant",1,true) ~= nil
			or string.find(c,"villager",1,true) ~= nil
			or string.find(c,"shopkeeper",1,true) ~= nil
	end

	local function belongsToCharacter(object)
		local cursor = object

		for _ = 1,14 do
			if not cursor
				or cursor == workspace then
				break
			end

			if characterLikeContainer(cursor) then
				return true
			end

			cursor = cursor.Parent
		end

		return false
	end

	local function burgerAttachedToCharacter(itemRoot)
		if not itemRoot
			or not itemRoot.Parent then
			return false
		end

		-- First: normal hierarchy case. If Burger is physically parented under
		-- an NPC/player character, reject it immediately.
		local cursor = itemRoot.Parent

		for _ = 1,14 do
			if not cursor
				or cursor == workspace then
				break
			end

			if characterLikeContainer(cursor) then
				return true
			end

			cursor = cursor.Parent
		end

		-- Second: some games keep held items under workspace.Models and attach
		-- them to an NPC hand with a weld/constraint. Reject only EXTERNAL
		-- character attachments; internal Burger welds are allowed.
		local checked = 0

		for _,object in ipairs(itemRoot:GetDescendants()) do
			checked += 1

			if object:IsA("ObjectValue") then
				local value = object.Value

				if value
					and not value:IsDescendantOf(itemRoot)
					and belongsToCharacter(value) then
					return true
				end
			end

			for _,propertyName in ipairs({
				"Part0",
				"Part1",
				"Attachment0",
				"Attachment1"
			}) do
				local ok,value =
					pcall(function()
						return object[propertyName]
					end)

				if ok and value then
					local linked =
						value:IsA("Attachment")
							and value.Parent
							or value

					if linked
						and linked ~= itemRoot
						and not linked:IsDescendantOf(itemRoot)
						and belongsToCharacter(linked) then
						return true
					end
				end
			end

			if checked >= 140 then
				break
			end
		end

		return false
	end

	local function rejectNpcBurger(itemRoot)
		if not burgerAttachedToCharacter(itemRoot) then
			return false
		end

		if not ignoredNpcBurgers[itemRoot] then
			ignoredNpcBurgers[itemRoot] = true

			gui:SetAttribute(
				"DeadSpellsNpcBurgersIgnored",
				(
					tonumber(
						gui:GetAttribute(
							"DeadSpellsNpcBurgersIgnored"
						)
					) or 0
				)+1
			)
		end

		burgerCache[itemRoot] = nil
		return true
	end

	local function isInsideTrain(object)
		local cursor = object
		for _ = 1,10 do
			if not cursor or cursor == workspace then
				break
			end

			local c = compact(cursor.Name)
			if c == "wagons"
				or string.find(c,"wagon",1,true)
				or string.find(c,"train",1,true) then
				return true
			end

			cursor = cursor.Parent
		end

		return false
	end

	local function burgerTypeFromValue(value)
		local c = compact(value)

		if c == "" then
			return nil
		end

		local looksLikeBurger =
			string.find(c,"burger",1,true) ~= nil
			or string.find(c,"hamburger",1,true) ~= nil
			or string.find(c,"cheeseburger",1,true) ~= nil

		if not looksLikeBurger then
			return nil
		end

		if string.find(c,"golden",1,true)
			or string.find(c,"gold",1,true) then
			return "GOLDEN BURGER",200
		end

		return "BURGER",100
	end

	local function burgerTypeFromObject(object)
		if not object then
			return nil
		end

		local function inspect(candidate)
			if not candidate then
				return nil
			end

			local label,priority =
				burgerTypeFromValue(candidate.Name)

			if label then
				return label,priority
			end

			if candidate:IsA("ProximityPrompt") then
				label,priority =
					burgerTypeFromValue(candidate.ObjectText)

				if not label then
					label,priority =
						burgerTypeFromValue(candidate.ActionText)
				end
			elseif candidate:IsA("StringValue") then
				label,priority =
					burgerTypeFromValue(candidate.Value)
			elseif candidate:IsA("TextLabel")
				or candidate:IsA("TextButton")
				or candidate:IsA("TextBox") then
				label,priority =
					burgerTypeFromValue(candidate.Text)
			end

			if label then
				return label,priority
			end

			local ok,attributes = pcall(function()
				return candidate:GetAttributes()
			end)

			if ok and attributes then
				for attributeName,value in pairs(attributes) do
					label,priority =
						burgerTypeFromValue(attributeName)

					if not label then
						label,priority =
							burgerTypeFromValue(value)
					end

					if label then
						return label,priority
					end
				end
			end

			local okTags,tags = pcall(function()
				return CollectionService:GetTags(candidate)
			end)

			if okTags and tags then
				for _,tag in ipairs(tags) do
					label,priority =
						burgerTypeFromValue(tag)

					if label then
						return label,priority
					end
				end
			end

			return nil
		end

		local label,priority = inspect(object)

		if label then
			return label,priority
		end

		local cursor = object.Parent
		for _ = 1,10 do
			if not cursor or cursor == workspace then
				break
			end

			label,priority = inspect(cursor)

			if label then
				return label,priority
			end

			cursor = cursor.Parent
		end

		return nil
	end

	local function burgerSignal(object)
		if not object then
			return false
		end

		if burgerTypeFromObject(object) then
			return true
		end

		local function hasBurger(value)
			local c = compact(value)

			return
				string.find(c,"burger",1,true) ~= nil
				or string.find(c,"hamburger",1,true) ~= nil
				or string.find(c,"cheeseburger",1,true) ~= nil
				or string.find(c,"burgeritem",1,true) ~= nil
				or string.find(c,"burgerpickup",1,true) ~= nil
		end

		local function objectSignal(candidate)
			if not candidate then
				return false
			end

			if hasBurger(candidate.Name)
				or hasBurger(candidate.ClassName) then
				return true
			end

			if candidate:IsA("ProximityPrompt") then
				if hasBurger(candidate.ObjectText)
					or hasBurger(candidate.ActionText) then
					return true
				end
			elseif candidate:IsA("StringValue") then
				if hasBurger(candidate.Value) then
					return true
				end
			elseif candidate:IsA("TextLabel")
				or candidate:IsA("TextButton")
				or candidate:IsA("TextBox") then
				if hasBurger(candidate.Text) then
					return true
				end
			end

			local ok,attributes = pcall(function()
				return candidate:GetAttributes()
			end)

			if ok and attributes then
				for attributeName,value in pairs(attributes) do
					if hasBurger(attributeName)
						or hasBurger(value) then
						return true
					end
				end
			end

			local okTags,tags = pcall(function()
				return CollectionService:GetTags(candidate)
			end)

			if okTags and tags then
				for _,tag in ipairs(tags) do
					if hasBurger(tag) then
						return true
					end
				end
			end

			return false
		end

		if objectSignal(object) then
			return true
		end

		-- V101: children of a Burger object now inherit the signal too.
		-- This catches generic MeshPart/Handle/Prompt names inside Burger models.
		local cursor = object.Parent
		for _ = 1,7 do
			if not cursor or cursor == workspace then
				break
			end

			if objectSignal(cursor) then
				return true
			end

			cursor = cursor.Parent
		end

		return false
	end

	local function wantedLootName(value)
		local c = compact(value)

		if c == "" then
			return nil
		end

		if string.find(c,"reaper",1,true)
			and string.find(c,"scythe",1,true) then
			return "REAPER'S SCYTHE",400
		end

		if string.find(c,"katana",1,true) then
			return "KATANA",300
		end

		if string.find(c,"raygun",1,true)
			or (
				string.find(c,"ray",1,true)
				and string.find(c,"gun",1,true)
			) then
			return "RAY GUN",250
		end

		if string.find(c,"meteortome",1,true)
			or (
				string.find(c,"meteor",1,true)
				and string.find(c,"tome",1,true)
			) then
			return "METEOR TOME",200
		end

		if string.find(c,"dingus",1,true) then
			return "DINGUS",360
		end

		if string.find(c,"dragonsclaw",1,true)
			or string.find(c,"dragonclaw",1,true)
			or (
				string.find(c,"dragon",1,true)
				and string.find(c,"claw",1,true)
			) then
			return "DRAGON'S CLAW",350
		end

		if string.find(c,"dragonsfoot",1,true)
			or string.find(c,"dragonfoot",1,true)
			or (
				string.find(c,"dragon",1,true)
				and string.find(c,"foot",1,true)
			) then
			return "DRAGON'S FOOT",340
		end

		return nil
	end

	local function namedLootFromObject(object)
		if not object then
			return nil
		end

		local function inspect(candidate)
			if not candidate then
				return nil
			end

			local label,priority =
				wantedLootName(candidate.Name)

			if label then
				return label,priority
			end

			if candidate:IsA("StringValue") then
				label,priority =
					wantedLootName(candidate.Value)

			elseif candidate:IsA("TextLabel")
				or candidate:IsA("TextButton")
				or candidate:IsA("TextBox") then

				label,priority =
					wantedLootName(candidate.Text)

			elseif candidate:IsA("ProximityPrompt") then
				label,priority =
					wantedLootName(candidate.ObjectText)

				if not label then
					label,priority =
						wantedLootName(candidate.ActionText)
				end
			end

			if label then
				return label,priority
			end

			local ok,attributes = pcall(function()
				return candidate:GetAttributes()
			end)

			if ok and attributes then
				for attributeName,value in pairs(attributes) do
					label,priority =
						wantedLootName(attributeName)

					if not label then
						label,priority =
							wantedLootName(value)
					end

					if label then
						return label,priority
					end
				end
			end

			local okTags,tags = pcall(function()
				return CollectionService:GetTags(candidate)
			end)

			if okTags and tags then
				for _,tag in ipairs(tags) do
					label,priority =
						wantedLootName(tag)

					if label then
						return label,priority
					end
				end
			end

			return nil
		end

		local label,priority = inspect(object)

		if label then
			return label,priority
		end

		local cursor = object.Parent

		for _ = 1,10 do
			if not cursor or cursor == workspace then
				break
			end

			label,priority = inspect(cursor)

			if label then
				return label,priority
			end

			cursor = cursor.Parent
		end

		return nil
	end

	local function namedLootFromItemFamily(object)
		local label,priority =
			namedLootFromObject(object)

		if label then
			return label,priority
		end

		local rootCandidate =
			canonicalItemRoot(object)
			or (
				object
				and object.Parent
			)

		if not rootCandidate then
			return nil
		end

		local checked = 0
		local stack = {rootCandidate}

		while #stack > 0 and checked < 320 do
			local current = table.remove(stack)
			checked += 1

			label,priority =
				namedLootFromObject(current)

			if label then
				return label,priority
			end

			local ok,children = pcall(function()
				return current:GetChildren()
			end)

			if ok and children then
				for _,child in ipairs(children) do
					table.insert(stack,child)
				end
			end

			if checked%100 == 0 then
				task.wait()
			end
		end

		return nil
	end

	local function rarityFromObject(object)
		if not object then
			return nil
		end

		local function classify(value)
			local c = compact(value)

			if string.find(c,"transcendent",1,true)
				or string.find(c,"transcend",1,true) then
				return "TRANSCENDENT"
			end

			if string.find(c,"mythical",1,true)
				or string.find(c,"mythic",1,true) then
				return "MYTHICAL"
			end

			return nil
		end

		local function classifyObject(candidate)
			if not candidate then
				return nil
			end

			local direct =
				classify(candidate.Name)

			if direct then
				return direct
			end

			if candidate:IsA("StringValue") then
				direct = classify(candidate.Value)
			elseif candidate:IsA("TextLabel")
				or candidate:IsA("TextButton")
				or candidate:IsA("TextBox") then
				direct = classify(candidate.Text)
			elseif candidate:IsA("ProximityPrompt") then
				direct =
					classify(candidate.ObjectText)
					or classify(candidate.ActionText)
			end

			if direct then
				return direct
			end

			local ok,attributes = pcall(function()
				return candidate:GetAttributes()
			end)

			if ok and attributes then
				for attributeName,value in pairs(attributes) do
					direct =
						classify(attributeName)
						or classify(value)

					if direct then
						return direct
					end
				end
			end

			local okTags,tags = pcall(function()
				return CollectionService:GetTags(candidate)
			end)

			if okTags and tags then
				for _,tag in ipairs(tags) do
					direct = classify(tag)
					if direct then
						return direct
					end
				end
			end

			return nil
		end

		local direct = classifyObject(object)
		if direct then
			return direct
		end

		local cursor = object.Parent
		for _ = 1,8 do
			if not cursor or cursor == workspace then
				break
			end

			direct = classifyObject(cursor)
			if direct then
				return direct
			end

			cursor = cursor.Parent
		end

		return nil
	end

	local function rarityFromItemFamily(object)
		local direct = rarityFromObject(object)
		if direct then
			return direct
		end

		local rootCandidate =
			canonicalItemRoot(object)
			or (
				object
				and object.Parent
			)

		if not rootCandidate then
			return nil
		end

		local checked = 0
		local stack = {rootCandidate}

		while #stack > 0 and checked < 260 do
			local current =
				table.remove(stack)

			checked += 1

			direct = rarityFromObject(current)
			if direct then
				return direct
			end

			local ok,children = pcall(function()
				return current:GetChildren()
			end)

			if ok and children then
				for _,child in ipairs(children) do
					table.insert(stack,child)
				end
			end

			if checked%80 == 0 then
				task.wait()
			end
		end

		return nil
	end

	local function cacheBurger(object)
		if not burgerSignal(object) then
			return false
		end

		local itemRoot = canonicalItemRoot(object)
		if not itemRoot
			or not itemRoot.Parent
			or isInsidePlayer(itemRoot)
			or rejectNpcBurger(itemRoot)
			or not pickupLike(itemRoot) then
			return false
		end

		local part =
			signalPart(object,itemRoot)
			or partFor(itemRoot)

		if not part
			or not part.Parent
			or not withinMegaRadius(part) then
			return false
		end

		local burgerLabel,burgerPriority =
			burgerTypeFromObject(object)

		local record = burgerCache[itemRoot]

		if not record then
			burgerCache[itemRoot] = {
				part = part,
				signal = object,
				label = burgerLabel or "BURGER",
				golden = burgerLabel == "GOLDEN BURGER",
				priority = tonumber(burgerPriority) or 100,
				attempts = 0,
				lastAttempt = 0
			}
		else
			record.part = part
			record.signal = object
			record.label = burgerLabel or record.label or "BURGER"
			record.golden =
				burgerLabel == "GOLDEN BURGER"
				or record.golden == true
			record.priority =
				math.max(
					tonumber(record.priority) or 100,
					tonumber(burgerPriority) or 100
				)
		end

		lastBurgerSeenAt = os.clock()
		return true
	end

	local function cacheLoot(object)
		local namedLabel,namedPriority =
			namedLootFromItemFamily(object)

		local rarity =
			rarityFromItemFamily(object)

		if not rarity and not namedLabel then
			return false
		end

		local itemRoot =
			canonicalItemRoot(object)

		if not itemRoot
			or not itemRoot.Parent
			or deliveredLoot[itemRoot]
			or isInsidePlayer(itemRoot)
			or (
				isInsideTrain(itemRoot)
				and not namedLabel
			) then
			return false
		end

		local part =
			signalPart(object,itemRoot)
			or partFor(itemRoot)

		if not part
			or not part.Parent
			or not withinMegaRadius(part) then
			return false
		end

		local record = lootCache[itemRoot]

		if not record then
			lootCache[itemRoot] = {
				part = part,
				signal = object,
				rarity = rarity or "TARGET",
				label = namedLabel or rarity,
				named = namedLabel ~= nil,
				namedPriority = tonumber(namedPriority) or 0,
				attempts = 0,
				lastAttempt = 0
			}
		else
			record.part = part
			record.signal = object
			record.rarity = rarity or record.rarity or "TARGET"
			record.label = namedLabel or rarity or record.label
			record.named = namedLabel ~= nil or record.named == true
			record.namedPriority =
				math.max(
					tonumber(record.namedPriority) or 0,
					tonumber(namedPriority) or 0
				)
		end

		if namedLabel then
			namedLootSeen[itemRoot] = true
		end

		lastLootSeenAt = os.clock()
		return true
	end

	local pruneCaches

	local function inspectFarmObject(object)
		if not object or not object.Parent then
			return
		end

		if burgerEnabled or ultraEnabled then
			cacheBurger(object)
		end

		if lootEnabled then
			cacheLoot(object)
		end
	end

	local function incrementalWorldScan(kind)
		if kind == "BURGER" then
			burgerScanToken += 1
			burgerInitialScanDone = false
		elseif kind == "LOOT" then
			lootScanToken += 1
			lootInitialScanDone = false
		end

		if worldScanBusy then
			worldScanQueued = true
			return
		end

		worldScanBusy = true
		worldScanQueued = false
		gui:SetAttribute("DeadSpellsScanBusy",true)

		task.spawn(function()
			repeat
				worldScanQueued = false

				local stack = {workspace}
				local checked = 0
				local burgerFoundBefore =
					tonumber(
						gui:GetAttribute("DeadSpellsBurgersCached")
					) or 0
				local lootFoundBefore =
					tonumber(
						gui:GetAttribute("DeadSpellsLootCached")
					) or 0

				while #stack > 0
					and gui.Parent
					and not menuDeleted
					and not stopped do

					local container =
						table.remove(stack)

					if container
						and (
							container == workspace
							or container.Parent
						) then

						local ok,children = pcall(function()
							return container:GetChildren()
						end)

						if ok and children then
							for _,child in ipairs(children) do
								-- Skip our own UI tree and player character.
								local skip =
									child == gui
									or (
										player.Character
										and child == player.Character
									)

								if not skip then
									table.insert(stack,child)
									checked += 1

									-- V102: the same 1B-stud mega scan also caches
									-- train/Part108 candidates, so no separate constant poll is needed.
									if child:IsA("BasePart")
										or trainWord(child.Name)
										or isPart108Name(child.Name) then
										rememberTrainCandidate(child)
									end

									if burgerEnabled or ultraEnabled then
										cacheBurger(child)
									end

									if lootEnabled then
										cacheLoot(child)
									end
								end

								if checked%120 == 0 then
									gui:SetAttribute(
										"DeadSpellsLastScanCount",
										checked
									)
									task.wait()
								end
							end
						end
					end
				end

				lastWorldScanAt = os.clock()

				if burgerEnabled or ultraEnabled then
					burgerInitialScanDone = true
				end
				if lootEnabled then
					lootInitialScanDone = true
				end

				local burgers,loot = pruneCaches()

				if burgers == 0
					and (burgerEnabled or ultraEnabled) then
					burgerEmptyScans += 1
				else
					burgerEmptyScans = 0
				end

				if loot == 0 and lootEnabled then
					lootEmptyScans += 1
				else
					lootEmptyScans = 0
				end

				gui:SetAttribute(
					"DeadSpellsLastScanCount",
					checked
				)

				if checked > 0 then
					setFarmStatus(
						"MEGA SCAN // "
						..tostring(checked)
						.." OBJECTS // "
						..tostring(burgers)
						.." BURGERS // "
						..tostring(loot)
						.." HIGH-RARITY LOOT"
					)
				end

				-- Keep local variables used so debugging can compare scan changes.
				if burgerFoundBefore < 0 or lootFoundBefore < 0 then
					warn("NOT RUBY DEAD SPELLS CACHE DIAGNOSTIC")
				end
			until not worldScanQueued
				or stopped
				or menuDeleted
				or not gui.Parent

			worldScanBusy = false
			gui:SetAttribute("DeadSpellsScanBusy",false)
		end)
	end

	pruneCaches = function()
		local burgers = 0
		local goldenBurgers = 0
		local normalBurgers = 0

		for itemRoot,record in pairs(burgerCache) do
			if not itemRoot
				or not itemRoot.Parent
				or not record
				or not record.part
				or not record.part.Parent
				or isInsidePlayer(itemRoot)
				or rejectNpcBurger(itemRoot) then
				burgerCache[itemRoot] = nil
			else
				burgers += 1

				if record.golden == true
					or record.label == "GOLDEN BURGER" then
					goldenBurgers += 1
				else
					normalBurgers += 1
				end
			end
		end

		gui:SetAttribute(
			"DeadSpellsGoldenBurgersCached",
			goldenBurgers
		)

		gui:SetAttribute(
			"DeadSpellsNormalBurgersCached",
			normalBurgers
		)

		local loot = 0
		for itemRoot,record in pairs(lootCache) do
			if not itemRoot
				or not itemRoot.Parent
				or deliveredLoot[itemRoot]
				or isInsidePlayer(itemRoot)
				or isInsideTrain(itemRoot)
				or not record
				or not record.part
				or not record.part.Parent then
				lootCache[itemRoot] = nil
			else
				loot += 1
			end
		end

		gui:SetAttribute(
			"DeadSpellsBurgersCached",
			burgers
		)
		gui:SetAttribute(
			"DeadSpellsLootCached",
			loot
		)

		local namedCount = 0

		for itemRoot,record in pairs(lootCache) do
			if itemRoot
				and itemRoot.Parent
				and record
				and record.named == true then
				namedCount += 1
			end
		end

		gui:SetAttribute(
			"DeadSpellsNamedLootCached",
			namedCount
		)

		if farmCounts and farmCounts.Parent then
			farmCounts.Text =
				"BURGERS: "
				..tostring(burgers)
				.."  •  GOLDEN: "
				..tostring(goldenBurgers)
				.."  •  LOOT: "
				..tostring(loot)
				.."  •  TARGETED: "
				..tostring(namedCount)
				.."  •  RANGE: 1B"
				.."  •  FAR: "
				..(
					farDetectionEnabled
						and (
							farScoutBusy
								and "SCOUTING"
								or "AUTO"
						)
						or "OFF"
				)
				.."  •  TARGET: "
				..lootTargetMode
				.."  •  DELIVERY: RAIN"
		end

		return burgers,loot
	end

	local function tryMaximizeClientStreaming()
		if streamUnlockAttempted then
			return
		end

		streamUnlockAttempted = true

		gui:SetAttribute(
			"DeadSpellsStreamingUnlockAttempted",
			true
		)

		-- Best effort only. Executors differ. Failures are intentionally ignored.
		if type(sethiddenproperty) == "function" then
			pcall(function()
				sethiddenproperty(
					workspace,
					"StreamingTargetRadius",
					1000000000
				)
			end)

			pcall(function()
				sethiddenproperty(
					workspace,
					"StreamingMinRadius",
					1000000000
				)
			end)
		end

		pcall(function()
			workspace.StreamingTargetRadius =
				1000000000
		end)

		pcall(function()
			workspace.StreamingMinRadius =
				1000000000
		end)
	end

	local function scanLoadedWorldNow()
		if loadedWorldScanBusy then
			loadedWorldScanQueued = true
			return
		end

		loadedWorldScanBusy = true
		loadedWorldScanQueued = false

		repeat
			loadedWorldScanQueued = false

			local stack = {workspace}
			local checked = 0

			while #stack > 0
				and gui.Parent
				and not menuDeleted
				and not stopped do

				local container =
					table.remove(stack)

				local ok,children = pcall(function()
					return container:GetChildren()
				end)

				if ok and children then
					for _,child in ipairs(children) do
						if child ~= gui
							and (
								not player.Character
								or child ~= player.Character
							) then

							table.insert(stack,child)

							if burgerEnabled or ultraEnabled then
								cacheBurger(child)
							end

							if lootEnabled then
								cacheLoot(child)
							end

							if child:IsA("BasePart")
								or trainWord(child.Name)
								or isPart108Name(child.Name) then
								rememberTrainCandidate(child)
							end
						end

						checked += 1

						if checked%180 == 0 then
							task.wait()
						end
					end
				end
			end

			gui:SetAttribute(
				"DeadSpellsLoadedWorldPasses",
				(
					tonumber(
						gui:GetAttribute(
							"DeadSpellsLoadedWorldPasses"
						)
					) or 0
				)+1
			)

			gui:SetAttribute(
				"DeadSpellsLastScanCount",
				checked
			)

			pruneCaches()
		until not loadedWorldScanQueued
			or stopped
			or menuDeleted
			or not gui.Parent

		loadedWorldScanBusy = false
	end

	local function tagFastScan()
		for _,tag in ipairs({
			"Burger","burger","Hamburger","hamburger",
			"Golden Burger","GoldenBurger","goldenburger",
			"Mythical","mythical","Mythic","mythic",
			"Transcendent","transcendent",
			"Reaper's Scythe","ReapersScythe","ReaperScythe",
			"Katana","katana",
			"Ray Gun","RayGun","raygun",
			"Meteor Tome","MeteorTome","meteortome",
			"Dingus","dingus",
			"Dragon's Claw","DragonsClaw","DragonClaw","dragonsclaw",
			"Dragon's Foot","DragonsFoot","DragonFoot","dragonsfoot"
		}) do
			local ok,objects = pcall(function()
				return CollectionService:GetTagged(tag)
			end)

			if ok and objects then
				for _,object in ipairs(objects) do
					if burgerEnabled or ultraEnabled then
						cacheBurger(object)
					end
					if lootEnabled then
						cacheLoot(object)
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end

	local function quickPointScan(position)
		local overlap = OverlapParams.new()
		overlap.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
		overlap.FilterDescendantsInstances = {
			player.Character
		}

		local boxSize =
			Vector3.new(
				DEAD_SPELLS_SCOUT_LOCAL_RADIUS*2,
				24000,
				DEAD_SPELLS_SCOUT_LOCAL_RADIUS*2
			)

		local boxCf =
			CFrame.new(
				position.X,
				position.Y,
				position.Z
			)

		local ok,parts = pcall(function()
			return workspace:GetPartBoundsInBox(
				boxCf,
				boxSize,
				overlap
			)
		end)

		if not ok or not parts then
			return 0
		end

		local seenRoots =
			setmetatable({}, {__mode = "k"})
		local checked = 0

		for _,part in ipairs(parts) do
			checked += 1

			if part and part.Parent then
				if burgerEnabled or ultraEnabled then
					cacheBurger(part)
				end

				if lootEnabled then
					cacheLoot(part)
				end

				rememberTrainCandidate(part)

				local rootCandidate =
					canonicalItemRoot(part)
					or part.Parent

				if rootCandidate
					and not seenRoots[rootCandidate] then

					seenRoots[rootCandidate] = true

					local familyChecked = 0
					local familyStack = {
						rootCandidate
					}

					while #familyStack > 0
						and familyChecked < 180 do

						local current =
							table.remove(familyStack)

						familyChecked += 1

						if burgerEnabled or ultraEnabled then
							cacheBurger(current)
						end

						if lootEnabled then
							cacheLoot(current)
						end

						local okChildren,children =
							pcall(function()
								return current:GetChildren()
							end)

						if okChildren and children then
							for _,child in ipairs(children) do
								table.insert(
									familyStack,
									child
								)
							end
						end
					end
				end
			end

			if checked%160 == 0 then
				task.wait()
			end

			if checked >= 2600 then
				break
			end
		end

		return checked
	end

	local function requestStreamAt(position)
		tryMaximizeClientStreaming()

		local ok = pcall(function()
			player:RequestStreamAroundAsync(
				position,
				DEAD_SPELLS_SCOUT_STREAM_TIMEOUT
			)
		end)

		if not ok then
			-- One short retry catches executors that reject the first request
			-- while the stream target radius is being changed.
			task.wait(.03)

			ok = pcall(function()
				player:RequestStreamAroundAsync(
					position,
					DEAD_SPELLS_SCOUT_STREAM_TIMEOUT
				)
			end)
		end

		gui:SetAttribute(
			"DeadSpellsStreamRequests",
			(
				tonumber(
					gui:GetAttribute(
						"DeadSpellsStreamRequests"
					)
				) or 0
			)+1
		)

		return ok
	end

	local function collectScoutPoints(origin)
		if denseStreamPoints then
			return denseStreamPoints
		end

		local points = {}
		local used = {}

		local function add(position)
			if typeof(position) ~= "Vector3" then
				return
			end

			local dx = position.X-origin.X
			local dz = position.Z-origin.Z

			local key =
				tostring(
					math.floor(dx/1200)
				)
				..":"
				..tostring(
					math.floor(dz/1200)
				)

			if used[key] then
				return
			end

			used[key] = true

			table.insert(
				points,
				Vector3.new(
					position.X,
					origin.Y,
					position.Z
				)
			)
		end

		add(origin)

		-- Real loaded landmarks get priority.
		for _,object in ipairs(workspace:GetChildren()) do
			if object:IsA("Model") then
				local ok,cf,size = pcall(function()
					local boxCf,boxSize =
						object:GetBoundingBox()
					return boxCf,boxSize
				end)

				if ok and cf and size
					and size.Magnitude >= 25 then
					add(cf.Position)
				end

			elseif object:IsA("BasePart")
				and object.Size.Magnitude >= 25 then
				add(object.Position)
			end
		end

		-- Dense square rings for the actual playable-map zone.
		local maxCell =
			math.floor(
				DEAD_SPELLS_DENSE_LOCAL_RADIUS
					/DEAD_SPELLS_DENSE_STEP
			)

		for ring = 1,maxCell do
			for x = -ring,ring do
				add(
					origin
					+Vector3.new(
						x*DEAD_SPELLS_DENSE_STEP,
						0,
						-ring*DEAD_SPELLS_DENSE_STEP
					)
				)
				add(
					origin
					+Vector3.new(
						x*DEAD_SPELLS_DENSE_STEP,
						0,
						ring*DEAD_SPELLS_DENSE_STEP
					)
				)
			end

			for z = -ring+1,ring-1 do
				add(
					origin
					+Vector3.new(
						-ring*DEAD_SPELLS_DENSE_STEP,
						0,
						z*DEAD_SPELLS_DENSE_STEP
					)
				)
				add(
					origin
					+Vector3.new(
						ring*DEAD_SPELLS_DENSE_STEP,
						0,
						z*DEAD_SPELLS_DENSE_STEP
					)
				)
			end
		end

		-- Exponential far probes out to the advertised 1B logical radius.
		local radius = 180000

		while radius <= DEAD_SPELLS_SCOUT_RADIUS do
			for angleIndex = 0,15 do
				local angle =
					math.rad(
						angleIndex*22.5
					)

				add(
					origin
					+Vector3.new(
						math.cos(angle)*radius,
						0,
						math.sin(angle)*radius
					)
				)
			end

			radius *= 2
		end

		table.sort(points,function(a,b)
			return
				(a-origin).Magnitude
				<
				(b-origin).Magnitude
		end)

		denseStreamPoints = points

		gui:SetAttribute(
			"DeadSpellsDenseStreamTotal",
			#points
		)

		return points
	end

	local function farScoutHasTarget()
		local burgers,loot = pruneCaches()

		return
			((burgerEnabled or ultraEnabled) and burgers > 0)
			or (lootEnabled and loot > 0)
	end

	local function runFarDetectionScout(reason)
		if not farDetectionEnabled
			or stopped
			or menuDeleted
			or not gui.Parent
			or not (
				burgerEnabled
					or ultraEnabled
					or lootEnabled
			) then
			return
		end

		if farScoutBusy then
			farScoutQueued = true
			return
		end

		farScoutBusy = true
		farScoutQueued = false
		farScoutToken += 1

		local token = farScoutToken
		local ownRoot = rootPart()

		if not ownRoot then
			farScoutBusy = false
			return
		end

		farScoutOrigin =
			farScoutOrigin
			or ownRoot.Position

		gui:SetAttribute(
			"DeadSpellsFarScoutBusy",
			true
		)

		gui:SetAttribute(
			"DeadSpellsRemoteVisibilityBarrier",
			false
		)

		setFarmStatus(
			"REMOTE LOOT DETECTION // STREAMING WITHOUT MOVING PLAYER"
		)

		tryMaximizeClientStreaming()
		tagFastScan()
		scanLoadedWorldNow()

		local points =
			collectScoutPoints(
				farScoutOrigin
			)

		if #points == 0 then
			farScoutBusy = false

			gui:SetAttribute(
				"DeadSpellsFarScoutBusy",
				false
			)

			return
		end

		denseStreamCursor =
			math.clamp(
				denseStreamCursor,
				1,
				#points
			)

		local batch = {}

		for _ = 1,DEAD_SPELLS_DENSE_BATCH do
			if denseStreamCursor > #points then
				denseStreamCursor = 1
				farScoutCycleComplete = true
			end

			table.insert(
				batch,
				{
					index = denseStreamCursor,
					position = points[denseStreamCursor]
				}
			)

			denseStreamCursor += 1
		end

		-- Parallel stream requests are much faster than V105's 96 sequential
		-- RequestStreamAroundAsync calls.
		for _,entry in ipairs(batch) do
			task.spawn(function()
				if token == farScoutToken
					and not stopped
					and farDetectionEnabled then
					requestStreamAt(
						entry.position
					)
				end
			end)
		end

		-- Let the parallel requests produce replicated instances.
		task.wait(
			DEAD_SPELLS_SCOUT_STREAM_TIMEOUT
				+.18
		)

		for _,entry in ipairs(batch) do
			if token ~= farScoutToken
				or stopped
				or not farDetectionEnabled then
				break
			end

			gui:SetAttribute(
				"DeadSpellsDenseStreamCursor",
				entry.index
			)

			gui:SetAttribute(
				"DeadSpellsFarScoutIndex",
				entry.index
			)

			quickPointScan(
				entry.position
			)
		end

		-- Critical V106 change: after remote stream requests, scan EVERY object
		-- that actually became client-visible. This avoids missing loot because
		-- its Y level/name hierarchy did not match the local box query.
		scanLoadedWorldNow()
		tagFastScan()

		lastFarScoutAt = os.clock()

		gui:SetAttribute(
			"DeadSpellsFarScoutCycles",
			(
				tonumber(
					gui:GetAttribute(
						"DeadSpellsFarScoutCycles"
					)
				) or 0
			)+1
		)

		gui:SetAttribute(
			"DeadSpellsFarScoutBusy",
			false
		)

		farScoutBusy = false

		local burgers,loot =
			pruneCaches()

		if burgers > 0 or loot > 0 then
			consecutiveRemoteEmptyPasses = 0

			gui:SetAttribute(
				"DeadSpellsRemoteVisibilityBarrier",
				false
			)

			setFarmStatus(
				"REMOTE DETECTION // ITEM FOUND // PLAYER NEVER MOVED"
			)
		else
			consecutiveRemoteEmptyPasses += 1

			if consecutiveRemoteEmptyPasses >= 8 then
				gui:SetAttribute(
					"DeadSpellsRemoteVisibilityBarrier",
					true
				)

				setFarmStatus(
					"REMOTE SCAN ACTIVE // SERVER HAS NOT REPLICATED LOOT YET"
				)
			else
				setFarmStatus(
					"REMOTE SCAN // NEXT STREAM BATCH"
				)
			end
		end

		if farScoutQueued
			and not stopped
			and farDetectionEnabled then

			farScoutQueued = false

			task.delay(.08,function()
				runFarDetectionScout(
					"QUEUED"
				)
			end)
		end
	end

	local function nearestBurger()
		local ownRoot = rootPart()
		if not ownRoot then
			return nil,nil
		end

		local now = os.clock()
		local bestRoot = nil
		local bestRecord = nil
		local bestDistance = math.huge

		for itemRoot,record in pairs(burgerCache) do
			if itemRoot
				and itemRoot.Parent
				and record
				and record.part
				and record.part.Parent
				and not rejectNpcBurger(itemRoot) then

				local cooldown =
					record.attempts >= 3
						and 5
						or .8

				if now-(record.lastAttempt or 0) >= cooldown then
					local distance =
						(
							ownRoot.Position
							-record.part.Position
						).Magnitude

					local goldenBonus =
						record.golden == true
							and 2500
							or 0

					local score =
						distance-goldenBonus

					if score < bestDistance then
						bestDistance = score
						bestRoot = itemRoot
						bestRecord = record
					end
				end
			end
		end

		return bestRoot,bestRecord
	end

	local burgerDirectFindBusy = false
	local lootDirectFindBusy = false
	local lastLootDirectFindAt = 0
	local lastLootMemoryProbeAt = 0
	local lootMemoryHints = {}
	local lootMemoryHintKeys = {}

	local function directFindBurgerNow()
		local cachedRoot,cachedRecord =
			nearestBurger()

		if cachedRoot and cachedRecord then
			return cachedRoot,cachedRecord
		end

		if burgerDirectFindBusy then
			return nil,nil
		end

		burgerDirectFindBusy = true

		gui:SetAttribute(
			"DeadSpellsBurgerDirectFindBusy",
			true
		)

		gui:SetAttribute(
			"DeadSpellsBurgerDirectFindCount",
			(
				tonumber(
					gui:GetAttribute(
						"DeadSpellsBurgerDirectFindCount"
					)
				) or 0
			)+1
		)

		-- Fast exact-name probes first. These usually resolve the Burger model
		-- immediately without running the old incremental world scan.
		for _,name in ipairs({
			"Golden Burger",
			"GoldenBurger",
			"Burger",
			"Hamburger",
			"Cheeseburger"
		}) do
			local object =
				workspace:FindFirstChild(
					name,
					true
				)

			if object
				and object.Parent then

				cacheBurger(object)

				local itemRoot =
					canonicalItemRoot(object)

				if itemRoot
					and burgerCache[itemRoot]
					and not rejectNpcBurger(itemRoot) then

					burgerDirectFindBusy = false

					gui:SetAttribute(
						"DeadSpellsBurgerDirectFindBusy",
						false
					)

					return
						itemRoot,
						burgerCache[itemRoot]
				end
			end
		end

		-- Fallback is targeted only by Burger-like names. It does NOT call the
		-- old incrementalWorldScan / far 1B scan. Stop as soon as a valid free
		-- Burger is found.
		local stack =
			workspace:GetChildren()
		local checked = 0

		while #stack > 0
			and gui.Parent
			and not menuDeleted
			and not stopped do

			local object =
				table.remove(stack)

			if object
				and object.Parent then

				local c =
					compact(object.Name)

				if string.find(c,"burger",1,true)
					or string.find(c,"hamburger",1,true)
					or string.find(c,"cheeseburger",1,true) then

					if cacheBurger(object) then
						local itemRoot =
							canonicalItemRoot(object)

						if itemRoot
							and burgerCache[itemRoot]
							and not rejectNpcBurger(itemRoot) then

							burgerDirectFindBusy = false

							gui:SetAttribute(
								"DeadSpellsBurgerDirectFindBusy",
								false
							)

							return
								itemRoot,
								burgerCache[itemRoot]
						end
					end
				end

				local ok,children =
					pcall(function()
						return object:GetChildren()
					end)

				if ok and children then
					for _,child in ipairs(children) do
						table.insert(
							stack,
							child
						)
					end
				end

				checked += 1

				if checked%500 == 0 then
					task.wait()
				end
			end
		end

		burgerDirectFindBusy = false

		gui:SetAttribute(
			"DeadSpellsBurgerDirectFindBusy",
			false
		)

		return nil,nil
	end

	local directLootNames = {
		"Reaper's Scythe",
		"Reapers Scythe",
		"ReapersScythe",
		"ReaperScythe",
		"Katana",
		"Ray Gun",
		"RayGun",
		"Meteor Tome",
		"MeteorTome",
		"Dingus",
		"Dragon's Claw",
		"Dragons Claw",
		"DragonsClaw",
		"DragonClaw",
		"Dragon's Foot",
		"Dragons Foot",
		"DragonsFoot",
		"DragonFoot"
	}

	local function directCachedLoot()
		for itemRoot,record in pairs(lootCache) do
			if itemRoot
				and itemRoot.Parent
				and record
				and record.part
				and record.part.Parent
				and not deliveredLoot[itemRoot] then

				gui:SetAttribute(
					"DeadSpellsLootClientVisible",
					true
				)

				return itemRoot,record
			end
		end

		return nil,nil
	end

	local function cacheDirectLootObject(object)
		if not object
			or not object.Parent then
			return nil,nil
		end

		cacheLoot(object)

		local itemRoot =
			canonicalItemRoot(object)

		if itemRoot
			and lootCache[itemRoot]
			and not deliveredLoot[itemRoot] then

			local record =
				lootCache[itemRoot]

			gui:SetAttribute(
				"DeadSpellsLootClientVisible",
				true
			)

			gui:SetAttribute(
				"DeadSpellsLootLastDirectResult",
				tostring(
					record.label
					or record.rarity
					or object.Name
				)
			)

			return itemRoot,record
		end

		return nil,nil
	end

	local function exactLoadedLootLookup()
		local cachedRoot,cachedRecord =
			directCachedLoot()

		if cachedRoot and cachedRecord then
			return cachedRoot,cachedRecord
		end

		for _,name in ipairs(directLootNames) do
			local object =
				workspace:FindFirstChild(
					name,
					true
				)

			if object and object.Parent then
				local itemRoot,record =
					cacheDirectLootObject(object)

				if itemRoot and record then
					return itemRoot,record
				end
			end
		end

		-- CollectionService is cheap and catches generic physical roots tagged
		-- with rarity or item names.
		tagFastScan()

		return directCachedLoot()
	end

	local function addLootMemoryHint(position)
		if typeof(position) ~= "Vector3" then
			return
		end

		local key =
			tostring(math.floor(position.X/10))
			..":"
			..tostring(math.floor(position.Y/10))
			..":"
			..tostring(math.floor(position.Z/10))

		if lootMemoryHintKeys[key] then
			return
		end

		lootMemoryHintKeys[key] = true
		table.insert(lootMemoryHints,position)
	end

	local function probeClientLootMemory()
		if os.clock()-lastLootMemoryProbeAt < 8 then
			return #lootMemoryHints
		end

		lastLootMemoryProbeAt = os.clock()

		local supported =
			type(getgc) == "function"

		gui:SetAttribute(
			"DeadSpellsLootMemoryProbeSupported",
			supported
		)

		if not supported then
			return #lootMemoryHints
		end

		local ok,objects =
			pcall(function()
				return getgc(true)
			end)

		if not ok
			or type(objects) ~= "table" then
			return #lootMemoryHints
		end

		local inspected = 0

		for _,value in ipairs(objects) do
			if inspected >= 6000 then
				break
			end

			inspected += 1

			if typeof(value) == "Instance" then
				if value.Parent
					and value:IsDescendantOf(workspace)
					and wantedLootName(value.Name) then

					cacheDirectLootObject(value)
				end

			elseif type(value) == "table" then
				local relevant = false
				local checkedEntries = 0

				for key,entry in pairs(value) do
					checkedEntries += 1

					if checkedEntries > 36 then
						break
					end

					if wantedLootName(key)
						or wantedLootName(entry) then
						relevant = true
						break
					end
				end

				if relevant then
					local checkedFields = 0

					for _,entry in pairs(value) do
						checkedFields += 1

						if checkedFields > 64 then
							break
						end

						if typeof(entry) == "Vector3" then
							addLootMemoryHint(entry)

						elseif typeof(entry) == "CFrame" then
							addLootMemoryHint(entry.Position)

						elseif typeof(entry) == "Instance"
							and entry.Parent
							and entry:IsDescendantOf(workspace) then

							cacheDirectLootObject(entry)
						end
					end
				end
			end

			if inspected%600 == 0 then
				task.wait()
			end
		end

		gui:SetAttribute(
			"DeadSpellsLootMemoryHints",
			#lootMemoryHints
		)

		return #lootMemoryHints
	end

	local function streamLootMemoryHints()
		if #lootMemoryHints == 0 then
			return
		end

		for index = 1,math.min(#lootMemoryHints,16) do
			local position =
				lootMemoryHints[index]

			task.spawn(function()
				requestStreamAt(position)
			end)
		end

		task.wait(
			DEAD_SPELLS_SCOUT_STREAM_TIMEOUT
				+.12
		)
	end

	local function directFindLootNow(useMemoryProbe)
		if lootDirectFindBusy then
			return nil,nil
		end

		lootDirectFindBusy = true
		lastLootDirectFindAt = os.clock()

		gui:SetAttribute(
			"DeadSpellsLootDirectFindBusy",
			true
		)

		gui:SetAttribute(
			"DeadSpellsLootDirectFindCount",
			(
				tonumber(
					gui:GetAttribute(
						"DeadSpellsLootDirectFindCount"
					)
				) or 0
			)+1
		)

		local itemRoot,record =
			exactLoadedLootLookup()

		if not itemRoot
			and useMemoryProbe ~= false then

			probeClientLootMemory()
			streamLootMemoryHints()

			itemRoot,record =
				exactLoadedLootLookup()
		end

		lootDirectFindBusy = false

		gui:SetAttribute(
			"DeadSpellsLootDirectFindBusy",
			false
		)

		if itemRoot and record then
			gui:SetAttribute(
				"DeadSpellsLootClientVisible",
				true
			)

			return itemRoot,record
		end

		gui:SetAttribute(
			"DeadSpellsLootClientVisible",
			false
		)

		gui:SetAttribute(
			"DeadSpellsLootLastDirectResult",
			"NOT_CLIENT_VISIBLE"
		)

		return nil,nil
	end

	local function bestLoot()
		local ownRoot = rootPart()
		if not ownRoot then
			return nil,nil
		end

		local now = os.clock()
		local bestRoot = nil
		local bestRecord = nil
		local bestScore = math.huge

		for itemRoot,record in pairs(lootCache) do
			if itemRoot
				and itemRoot.Parent
				and record
				and record.part
				and record.part.Parent
				and not deliveredLoot[itemRoot] then

				local cooldown =
					record.attempts >= 3
						and 7
						or 1.0

				if now-(record.lastAttempt or 0) >= cooldown then
					local distance =
						(
							ownRoot.Position
							-record.part.Position
						).Magnitude

					local rarityBonus =
						record.rarity == "TRANSCENDENT"
							and 5000
							or (
								record.rarity == "MYTHICAL"
									and 2500
									or 0
							)

					local namedBonus =
						record.named == true
							and (
								50000
								+(tonumber(record.namedPriority) or 0)*25
							)
							or 0

					local score =
						distance
						-rarityBonus
						-namedBonus

					if score < bestScore then
						bestScore = score
						bestRoot = itemRoot
						bestRecord = record
					end
				end
			end
		end

		return bestRoot,bestRecord
	end

	local function setItemCFrame(itemRoot,record,targetCf,velocity)
		if not itemRoot
			or not itemRoot.Parent then
			return false
		end

		local moved = false

		if itemRoot:IsA("Model") then
			moved = pcall(function()
				itemRoot:PivotTo(targetCf)

				for _,object in ipairs(itemRoot:GetDescendants()) do
					if object:IsA("BasePart") then
						object.AssemblyLinearVelocity =
							velocity or Vector3.zero
						object.AssemblyAngularVelocity =
							Vector3.zero
					end
				end
			end)

		elseif itemRoot:IsA("Tool") then
			local handle = partFor(itemRoot)

			if handle then
				moved = pcall(function()
					handle.CFrame = targetCf
					handle.AssemblyLinearVelocity =
						velocity or Vector3.zero
					handle.AssemblyAngularVelocity =
						Vector3.zero
				end)
			end

		elseif itemRoot:IsA("BasePart") then
			moved = pcall(function()
				itemRoot.CFrame = targetCf
				itemRoot.AssemblyLinearVelocity =
					velocity or Vector3.zero
				itemRoot.AssemblyAngularVelocity =
					Vector3.zero
			end)

		else
			local part =
				record
				and record.part
				or partFor(itemRoot)

			if part then
				moved = pcall(function()
					part.CFrame = targetCf
					part.AssemblyLinearVelocity =
						velocity or Vector3.zero
					part.AssemblyAngularVelocity =
						Vector3.zero
				end)
			end
		end

		return moved
	end

	local function rainLootOnTarget(itemRoot,record,destination)
		if not destination
			or not destination.Parent then
			return false
		end

		lootRainSerial += 1

		local angle =
			math.rad(
				(lootRainSerial*137.5)%360
			)

		local radius =
			2
			+(lootRainSerial%DEAD_SPELLS_RAIN_SPREAD)

		local heightRange =
			DEAD_SPELLS_RAIN_MAX_HEIGHT
				-DEAD_SPELLS_RAIN_MIN_HEIGHT
				+1

		local height =
			DEAD_SPELLS_RAIN_MIN_HEIGHT
			+(lootRainSerial%heightRange)

		local targetCf =
			CFrame.new(
				destination.Position
				+Vector3.new(
					math.cos(angle)*radius,
					height,
					math.sin(angle)*radius
				)
			)

		local moved =
			setItemCFrame(
				itemRoot,
				record,
				targetCf,
				Vector3.new(0,-68,0)
			)

		if moved then
			gui:SetAttribute(
				"DeadSpellsLootRainCount",
				(
					tonumber(
						gui:GetAttribute(
							"DeadSpellsLootRainCount"
						)
					) or 0
				)+1
			)
		end

		return moved
	end

	local function activateObject(itemRoot,targetPart)
		if not itemRoot or not itemRoot.Parent then
			return false
		end

		local activated = false
		local seen = setmetatable({}, {__mode = "k"})
		local candidates = {}

		local function add(object)
			if object and object.Parent and not seen[object] then
				seen[object] = true
				table.insert(candidates,object)
			end
		end

		add(itemRoot)
		add(targetPart)

		if targetPart then
			add(targetPart.Parent)
			if targetPart.Parent then
				add(targetPart.Parent.Parent)
			end
		end

		local checked = 0
		for _,container in ipairs(candidates) do
			if container and container.Parent then
				local list = {container}

				local ok,descendants = pcall(function()
					return container:GetDescendants()
				end)

				if ok and descendants then
					for _,object in ipairs(descendants) do
						table.insert(list,object)
						checked += 1
						if checked >= 260 then
							break
						end
					end
				end

				for _,object in ipairs(list) do
					if object:IsA("ProximityPrompt")
						and object.Enabled then

						pcall(function()
							object.HoldDuration = 0
							object.MaxActivationDistance =
								math.max(
									object.MaxActivationDistance,
									100
								)
						end)

						if type(fireproximityprompt) == "function" then
							local okFire = pcall(
								fireproximityprompt,
								object,
								0
							)
							activated =
								activated or okFire
						else
							local okFire = pcall(function()
								object:InputHoldBegin()
								task.wait(.04)
								object:InputHoldEnd()
							end)
							activated =
								activated or okFire
						end

					elseif object:IsA("ClickDetector")
						and type(fireclickdetector) == "function" then

						local okFire =
							pcall(
								fireclickdetector,
								object
							)
						activated =
							activated or okFire
					end
				end
			end

			if checked >= 260 then
				break
			end
		end

		local ownRoot = rootPart()
		local touchPart =
			targetPart
			or partFor(itemRoot)

		if ownRoot
			and touchPart
			and touchPart:IsA("BasePart")
			and type(firetouchinterest) == "function" then

			local okTouch = pcall(function()
				firetouchinterest(ownRoot,touchPart,0)
				task.wait(.05)
				firetouchinterest(ownRoot,touchPart,1)
				task.wait(.04)
				firetouchinterest(ownRoot,touchPart,0)
				firetouchinterest(ownRoot,touchPart,1)
			end)

			activated =
				activated or okTouch
		end

		return activated
	end

	local function trainWord(value)
		local c = compact(value)

		return
			string.find(c,"wagon",1,true) ~= nil
			or string.find(c,"train",1,true) ~= nil
			or string.find(c,"locomotive",1,true) ~= nil
			or string.find(c,"railcar",1,true) ~= nil
			or string.find(c,"railcoach",1,true) ~= nil
			or string.find(c,"carriage",1,true) ~= nil
			or string.find(c,"coach",1,true) ~= nil
	end

	local function isPart108Name(value)
		local c = compact(value)
		return
			c == "part108"
			or c == "part0108"
			or c == "108"
			or string.find(c,"part108",1,true) ~= nil
	end

	local function trainContextScore(object)
		if not object or not object.Parent then
			return -math.huge,"NONE"
		end

		local score = 0
		local kind = "TRAIN"
		local cursor = object

		for depth = 1,10 do
			if not cursor or cursor == workspace then
				break
			end

			local c = compact(cursor.Name)

			if isPart108Name(cursor.Name) then
				score += 100000
				kind = "PART108"
			end

			if c == "wagon2"
				or string.find(c,"wagon2",1,true) then
				score += 9000
			end

			if string.find(c,"floor",1,true) then
				score += 6500
			end

			if trainWord(cursor.Name) then
				score += 5000
			end

			local ok,attributes = pcall(function()
				return cursor:GetAttributes()
			end)

			if ok and attributes then
				for attributeName,value in pairs(attributes) do
					if isPart108Name(attributeName)
						or isPart108Name(value) then
						score += 50000
						kind = "PART108"
					elseif trainWord(attributeName)
						or trainWord(value) then
						score += 2500
					end
				end
			end

			local okTags,tags = pcall(function()
				return CollectionService:GetTags(cursor)
			end)

			if okTags and tags then
				for _,tag in ipairs(tags) do
					if isPart108Name(tag) then
						score += 50000
						kind = "PART108"
					elseif trainWord(tag) then
						score += 2500
					end
				end
			end

			-- Prefer lower/deeper parts over giant parent containers.
			score -= depth*.25
			cursor = cursor.Parent
		end

		return score,kind
	end

	local function targetPartFromObject(object)
		if not object or not object.Parent then
			return nil
		end

		if object:IsA("BasePart") then
			return object
		end

		if object:IsA("Model") then
			return
				object.PrimaryPart
				or object:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart",true)
		end

		return object:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart",true)
	end

	local function rememberTrainCandidate(object)
		if not object or not object.Parent then
			return false
		end

		local candidate = targetPartFromObject(object)
		if not candidate or not candidate.Parent then
			return false
		end

		local score,kind = trainContextScore(candidate)

		-- Any Part108 is accepted anywhere in the loaded Workspace. Generic train
		-- targets need at least a real train/wagon/floor context.
		if kind ~= "PART108" and score < 4000 then
			return false
		end

		trainTargetCache[candidate] = {
			score = score,
			kind = kind,
			lastSeen = os.clock()
		}

		return true
	end

	local function bestCachedTrainTarget(preferPart108)
		local ownRoot = rootPart()
		local best = nil
		local bestKind = "NONE"
		local bestScore = -math.huge

		for part,data in pairs(trainTargetCache) do
			if not part
				or not part.Parent
				or not part:IsA("BasePart")
				or not data then
				trainTargetCache[part] = nil
			else
				local score =
					tonumber(data.score)
					or select(
						1,
						trainContextScore(part)
					)

				local kind =
					tostring(data.kind or "TRAIN")

				if preferPart108
					and kind == "PART108" then
					score += 1000000
				elseif not preferPart108
					and kind == "TRAIN" then
					score += 10000
				end

				if ownRoot then
					score -= math.min(
						(
							ownRoot.Position-part.Position
						).Magnitude,
						100000
					)*.005
				end

				if score > bestScore then
					bestScore = score
					best = part
					bestKind = kind
				end
			end
		end

		return best,bestKind,bestScore
	end

	local function publishTrainTarget(part,kind)
		destinationCache = part

		local found =
			part ~= nil
				and part.Parent ~= nil

		gui:SetAttribute(
			"DeadSpellsTrainTargetFound",
			found
		)
		gui:SetAttribute(
			"DeadSpellsTrainTargetKind",
			found and tostring(kind or "TRAIN") or "NONE"
		)
		gui:SetAttribute(
			"DeadSpellsTrainTargetPath",
			found
				and part:GetFullName()
				or "--"
		)

		if found then
			setFarmStatus(
				"TRAIN TARGET FOUND // "
				..tostring(kind or "TRAIN")
				.." // "
				..part:GetFullName()
			)
		end

		return part
	end

	local function deepTrainTargetScan(preferPart108)
		if trainTargetScanBusy then
			trainTargetScanQueued = true
			return destinationCache
		end

		trainTargetScanBusy = true
		trainTargetScanQueued = false
		gui:SetAttribute(
			"DeadSpellsTrainTargetScanBusy",
			true
		)

		repeat
			trainTargetScanQueued = false

			local stack = {workspace}
			local checked = 0

			while #stack > 0
				and gui.Parent
				and not menuDeleted
				and not stopped do

				local container =
					table.remove(stack)

				if container
					and (
						container == workspace
						or container.Parent
					) then

					local ok,children = pcall(function()
						return container:GetChildren()
					end)

					if ok and children then
						for _,child in ipairs(children) do
							if child ~= gui
								and (
									not player.Character
									or child ~= player.Character
								) then

								table.insert(stack,child)

								-- Check every physical part plus any container whose
								-- name itself says train/wagon/Part108.
								if child:IsA("BasePart")
									or trainWord(child.Name)
									or isPart108Name(child.Name) then
									rememberTrainCandidate(child)
								end
							end

							checked += 1
							if checked%140 == 0 then
								task.wait()
							end
						end
					end
				end
			end

			lastTrainTargetScanAt = os.clock()

			local best,kind =
				bestCachedTrainTarget(
					preferPart108
				)

			if best then
				publishTrainTarget(best,kind)
			else
				destinationCache = nil
				gui:SetAttribute(
					"DeadSpellsTrainTargetFound",
					false
				)
				gui:SetAttribute(
					"DeadSpellsTrainTargetPath",
					"--"
				)
				gui:SetAttribute(
					"DeadSpellsTrainTargetKind",
					"NONE"
				)
			end
		until not trainTargetScanQueued
			or stopped
			or menuDeleted
			or not gui.Parent

		trainTargetScanBusy = false
		gui:SetAttribute(
			"DeadSpellsTrainTargetScanBusy",
			false
		)

		return destinationCache
	end

	local function exactPart108()
		-- Fast paths first, but none of them require exact casing or exact root path.
		local direct = nil

		for _,top in ipairs(workspace:GetChildren()) do
			if trainWord(top.Name)
				or compact(top.Name) == "wagons" then

				local stack = {top}
				local checked = 0

				while #stack > 0 and checked < 2200 do
					local container =
						table.remove(stack)

					for _,child in ipairs(container:GetChildren()) do
						checked += 1

						if isPart108Name(child.Name) then
							local part =
								targetPartFromObject(child)

							if part and part.Parent then
								rememberTrainCandidate(part)
								direct = part
								break
							end
						end

						if child:IsA("Model")
							or child:IsA("Folder") then
							table.insert(stack,child)
						end
					end

					if direct then
						break
					end
				end
			end

			if direct then
				break
			end
		end

		if direct then
			return
				publishTrainTarget(
					direct,
					"PART108"
				)
		end

		local cached,kind =
			bestCachedTrainTarget(true)

		if cached
			and kind == "PART108" then
			return
				publishTrainTarget(
					cached,
					"PART108"
				)
		end

		-- Hard fallback: entire loaded Workspace, incremental/yielding.
		local found =
			deepTrainTargetScan(true)

		if found then
			local _,foundKind =
				trainContextScore(found)

			if foundKind == "PART108"
				or isPart108Name(found.Name) then
				return found
			end
		end

		return nil
	end

	local function teleportAbovePart108()
		if gui:GetAttribute(
			"DeadSpellsPart108TeleportBusy"
		) == true then
			return false
		end

		gui:SetAttribute(
			"DeadSpellsPart108TeleportBusy",
			true
		)

		local target =
			exactPart108()

		if not target
			or not target.Parent then

			setFarmStatus(
				"PART108 TELEPORT // FINDING PART108"
			)

			-- exactPart108 already does a deep loaded-world fallback, but a
			-- second explicit refresh helps when the train just streamed in.
			destinationCache = nil
			table.clear(trainTargetCache)

			deepTrainTargetScan(true)

			target =
				exactPart108()
		end

		if not target
			or not target.Parent then

			gui:SetAttribute(
				"DeadSpellsPart108TeleportFound",
				false
			)

			gui:SetAttribute(
				"DeadSpellsPart108TeleportBusy",
				false
			)

			setFarmStatus(
				"PART108 TELEPORT // PART108 NOT LOADED"
			)

			return false
		end

		local char =
			player.Character
		local ownRoot =
			rootPart()

		if not char
			or not ownRoot then

			gui:SetAttribute(
				"DeadSpellsPart108TeleportBusy",
				false
			)

			setFarmStatus(
				"PART108 TELEPORT // CHARACTER NOT READY"
			)

			return false
		end

		-- IMPORTANT: world-space +Y. This is directly in the sky ABOVE Part108,
		-- even if the train or Part108 itself is rotated.
		local skyPosition =
			target.Position
			+Vector3.new(
				0,
				DEAD_SPELLS_PART108_TELEPORT_HEIGHT,
				0
			)

		local horizontalLook =
			Vector3.new(
				ownRoot.CFrame.LookVector.X,
				0,
				ownRoot.CFrame.LookVector.Z
			)

		if horizontalLook.Magnitude < .01 then
			horizontalLook =
				Vector3.new(0,0,-1)
		else
			horizontalLook =
				horizontalLook.Unit
		end

		local skyCf =
			CFrame.new(
				skyPosition,
				skyPosition+horizontalLook
			)

		local ok =
			pcall(function()
				ownRoot.AssemblyLinearVelocity =
					Vector3.zero
				ownRoot.AssemblyAngularVelocity =
					Vector3.zero

				char:PivotTo(skyCf)

				ownRoot.AssemblyLinearVelocity =
					Vector3.zero
				ownRoot.AssemblyAngularVelocity =
					Vector3.zero
			end)

		gui:SetAttribute(
			"DeadSpellsPart108TeleportFound",
			ok
		)

		gui:SetAttribute(
			"DeadSpellsPart108TeleportBusy",
			false
		)

		if ok then
			setFarmStatus(
				"TELEPORTED // 140 STUDS DIRECTLY ABOVE PART108"
			)
		else
			setFarmStatus(
				"PART108 TELEPORT // TELEPORT FAILED"
			)
		end

		return ok
	end

	local function automaticTrainTarget()
		local cached,kind =
			bestCachedTrainTarget(false)

		if cached then
			return
				publishTrainTarget(
					cached,
					kind
				)
		end

		return deepTrainTargetScan(false)
	end

	local function resolveLootTarget()
		if destinationCache
			and destinationCache.Parent
			and destinationCache:IsA("BasePart") then
			return destinationCache
		end

		destinationCache = nil

		if lootTargetMode == "PART108" then
			destinationCache =
				exactPart108()

			-- If actual Part108 is not loaded yet, do not make Farm Loot useless.
			-- Fall back to the best train floor/body part until Part108 streams in.
			if not destinationCache then
				destinationCache =
					automaticTrainTarget()
			end
		else
			destinationCache =
				automaticTrainTarget()
				or exactPart108()
		end

		return destinationCache
	end

	local function worldUpCFrame(position,lookVector)
		local look = lookVector

		if typeof(look) ~= "Vector3" then
			look = Vector3.new(0,0,-1)
		end

		look = Vector3.new(look.X,0,look.Z)

		if look.Magnitude < .01 then
			look = Vector3.new(0,0,-1)
		else
			look = look.Unit
		end

		return CFrame.new(
			position,
			position+look
		)
	end

	local function moveLootToDestination(
		itemRoot,
		record,
		destination
	)
		if not itemRoot
			or not itemRoot.Parent
			or not destination
			or not destination.Parent then
			return false
		end

		local dropPosition =
			destination.Position
			+Vector3.new(0,3.4,0)

		return
			setItemCFrame(
				itemRoot,
				record,
				worldUpCFrame(
					dropPosition,
					destination.CFrame.LookVector
				),
				Vector3.zero
			)
	end

	local function dangerousNpcNear(position,radius)
		if typeof(position) ~= "Vector3" then
			return false,nil
		end

		local overlap =
			OverlapParams.new()

		overlap.FilterType =
			Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude

		local excluded = {}

		if player.Character then
			table.insert(
				excluded,
				player.Character
			)
		end

		overlap.FilterDescendantsInstances =
			excluded
		overlap.MaxParts = 180

		local ok,parts =
			pcall(function()
				return workspace:GetPartBoundsInRadius(
					position,
					tonumber(radius)
						or DEAD_SPELLS_BURGER_DANGER_RADIUS,
					overlap
				)
			end)

		if not ok or not parts then
			return false,nil
		end

		local seenModels = {}

		for _,part in ipairs(parts) do
			local model =
				part:FindFirstAncestorOfClass(
					"Model"
				)

			if model
				and not seenModels[model] then

				seenModels[model] = true

				local ownedPlayer =
					Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(
						model
					)

				if not ownedPlayer then
					local human =
						model:FindFirstChildOfClass(
							"Humanoid"
						)

					local c =
						compact(model.Name)

					local threatWord =
						string.find(c,"boss",1,true)
						or string.find(c,"enemy",1,true)
						or string.find(c,"monster",1,true)
						or string.find(c,"hostile",1,true)
						or string.find(c,"demon",1,true)
						or string.find(c,"zombie",1,true)
						or string.find(c,"bandit",1,true)
						or string.find(c,"skeleton",1,true)
						or string.find(c,"guardian",1,true)
						or string.find(c,"golem",1,true)

					if threatWord
						or (
							human
							and human.Health > 0
						) then

						return true,model
					end
				end
			end
		end

		return false,nil
	end

	-- V119 COMPILE-SAFE RANGED GUARD
	-- One outer local only; helper bodies compile in their own function frames.
	local crossbowGuard = {
		avoidRadius = 520,
		protectRadius = 180,
		minSpeed = 8,
		lastAt = 0
	}

	crossbowGuard.weaponName = function(value)
		local c = compact(value)

		return
			string.find(c,"crossbow",1,true) ~= nil
			or string.find(c,"archer",1,true) ~= nil
			or string.find(c,"bowman",1,true) ~= nil
			or string.find(c,"longbow",1,true) ~= nil
			or string.find(c,"shortbow",1,true) ~= nil
			or string.find(c,"ranger",1,true) ~= nil
			or string.find(c,"shooter",1,true) ~= nil
	end

	crossbowGuard.modelHasWeapon = function(model)
		if not model or not model.Parent then
			return false
		end

		if crossbowGuard.weaponName(model.Name) then
			return true
		end

		local stack = model:GetChildren()
		local checked = 0

		while #stack > 0 and checked < 140 do
			local object = table.remove(stack)

			if object then
				checked += 1

				if crossbowGuard.weaponName(object.Name) then
					return true
				end

				if checked < 140 then
					local ok,children = pcall(function()
						return object:GetChildren()
					end)

					if ok and children then
						for _,child in ipairs(children) do
							table.insert(stack,child)
						end
					end
				end
			end
		end

		return false
	end

	crossbowGuard.rangedNpcNear = function(position,radius)
		if typeof(position) ~= "Vector3" then
			return false,nil
		end

		local overlap = OverlapParams.new()
		overlap.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude

		local excluded = {}
		if player.Character then
			table.insert(excluded,player.Character)
		end

		overlap.FilterDescendantsInstances = excluded
		overlap.MaxParts = 420

		local ok,parts = pcall(function()
			return workspace:GetPartBoundsInRadius(
				position,
				tonumber(radius) or crossbowGuard.avoidRadius,
				overlap
			)
		end)

		if not ok or not parts then
			return false,nil
		end

		local seen = {}

		for _,part in ipairs(parts) do
			local model = part:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("Model")

			if model and not seen[model] then
				seen[model] = true

				if not Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(model) then
					local human = model:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")

					if human
						and human.Health > 0
						and crossbowGuard.modelHasWeapon(model) then
						return true,model
					end
				end
			end
		end

		return false,nil
	end

	crossbowGuard.projectileSignal = function(object)
		if not object then
			return false
		end

		for _ = 1,4 do
			if not object or object == workspace then
				break
			end

			local c = compact(object.Name)

			if string.find(c,"arrow",1,true)
				or string.find(c,"crossbowbolt",1,true)
				or string.find(c,"boltprojectile",1,true)
				or string.find(c,"quarrel",1,true)
				or string.find(c,"projectile",1,true) then
				return true
			end

			object = object.Parent
		end

		return false
	end

	crossbowGuard.neutralize = function(force)
		local now = os.clock()

		if not force and now-crossbowGuard.lastAt < .045 then
			return 0
		end

		crossbowGuard.lastAt = now

		local ownRoot = rootPart()
		if not ownRoot then
			return 0
		end

		local overlap = OverlapParams.new()
		overlap.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude

		local excluded = {}
		if player.Character then
			table.insert(excluded,player.Character)
		end

		overlap.FilterDescendantsInstances = excluded
		overlap.MaxParts = 260

		local ok,parts = pcall(function()
			return workspace:GetPartBoundsInRadius(
				ownRoot.Position,
				crossbowGuard.protectRadius,
				overlap
			)
		end)

		if not ok or not parts then
			return 0
		end

		local neutralized = 0
		local seen = {}

		for _,part in ipairs(parts) do
			if part
				and part.Parent
				and part:IsA("BasePart")
				and not seen[part]
				and crossbowGuard.projectileSignal(part) then

				seen[part] = true

				if part.AssemblyLinearVelocity.Magnitude >= crossbowGuard.minSpeed then
					local moved = pcall(function()
						part.CanTouch = false
						part.CanCollide = false
						part.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
						part.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
						part.CFrame = CFrame.new(
							ownRoot.Position+Vector3.new(0,5000,0)
						)
					end)

					if moved then
						neutralized += 1
					end
				end
			end
		end

		if neutralized > 0 then
			gui:SetAttribute(
				"DeadSpellsProjectilesNeutralized",
				(tonumber(gui:GetAttribute("DeadSpellsProjectilesNeutralized")) or 0)
					+neutralized
			)
		end

		return neutralized
	end

	local function flyToBurger(itemRoot,record)
		if burgerFlightBusy
			or not itemRoot
			or not itemRoot.Parent
			or not record
			or not record.part
			or not record.part.Parent
			or rejectNpcBurger(itemRoot) then
			return false
		end

		local char = player.Character
		local ownRoot = rootPart()
		local human = humanoidNow()

		if not char
			or not ownRoot
			or not human then
			return false
		end

		burgerFlightBusy = true

		gui:SetAttribute(
			"DeadSpellsBurgerFlightBusy",
			true
		)

		local oldAutoRotate =
			human.AutoRotate

		local collisionState = {}

		for _,object in ipairs(char:GetDescendants()) do
			if object:IsA("BasePart") then
				collisionState[object] =
					object.CanCollide
				object.CanCollide = false
			end
		end

		human.AutoRotate = false

		local targetPart =
			record.part

		local arrivePosition =
			targetPart.Position
			+Vector3.new(
				0,
				DEAD_SPELLS_BURGER_ARRIVE_HEIGHT,
				0
			)

		local distance =
			(
				ownRoot.Position
				-arrivePosition
			).Magnitude

		local duration =
			math.clamp(
				distance
					/DEAD_SPELLS_BURGER_FLY_SPEED,
				.015,
				DEAD_SPELLS_BURGER_MAX_FLIGHT
			)

		local targetCf =
			CFrame.new(
				arrivePosition,
				targetPart.Position
			)

		local tween =
			TweenService:Create(
				ownRoot,
				TweenInfo.new(
					duration,
					Enum.EasingStyle.Linear,
					Enum.EasingDirection.Out
				),
				{
					CFrame = targetCf
				}
			)

		local finished = false
		local connection =
			tween.Completed:Connect(function()
				finished = true
			end)

		tween:Play()

		local cancelled = false

		while not finished
			and gui.Parent
			and not menuDeleted do

			crossbowGuard.neutralize(false)

			if stopped
				or not (burgerEnabled or ultraEnabled)
				or not itemRoot.Parent
				or not targetPart.Parent
				or rejectNpcBurger(itemRoot) then

				cancelled = true
				pcall(function()
					tween:Cancel()
				end)
				break
			end

			pcall(function()
				ownRoot.AssemblyLinearVelocity =
					Vector3.zero
				ownRoot.AssemblyAngularVelocity =
					Vector3.zero
			end)

			task.wait(.03)
		end

		if connection then
			connection:Disconnect()
		end

		if human and human.Parent then
			human.AutoRotate =
				oldAutoRotate
		end

		for object,oldCanCollide in pairs(collisionState) do
			if object and object.Parent then
				object.CanCollide =
					oldCanCollide
			end
		end

		burgerFlightBusy = false

		gui:SetAttribute(
			"DeadSpellsBurgerFlightBusy",
			false
		)

		if cancelled
			or not itemRoot.Parent
			or not targetPart.Parent
			or rejectNpcBurger(itemRoot) then
			return false
		end

		-- V117: never teleport ONTO the Burger/NPC. Hold a safe world-space hover
		-- above it and interact from there.
		pcall(function()
			local burgerPosition =
				targetPart.Position
				+Vector3.new(
					0,
					DEAD_SPELLS_BURGER_ARRIVE_HEIGHT,
					0
				)

			ownRoot.CFrame =
				worldUpCFrame(
					burgerPosition,
					ownRoot.CFrame.LookVector
				)

			ownRoot.AssemblyLinearVelocity =
				Vector3.zero
			ownRoot.AssemblyAngularVelocity =
				Vector3.zero
		end)

		return true
	end

	local function collectBurger(itemRoot,record)
		if not itemRoot
			or not record
			or not record.part
			or not record.part.Parent
			or rejectNpcBurger(itemRoot) then
			return false
		end

		record.lastAttempt = os.clock()
		record.attempts += 1

		local pickupPart =
			partFor(itemRoot)
			or record.part

		-- V118: TRY TO PICK IT UP FROM THE STRAIGHT ROUTE FIRST.
		-- Executors that support prompt/click/touch firing can collect without
		-- making the player dive into a camp full of NPCs/crossbows.
		setFarmStatus(
			"BURGER FARM // REMOTE PICKUP FIRST"
		)

		for attempt = 1,5 do
			if not itemRoot.Parent
				or isInsidePlayer(itemRoot) then
				break
			end

			crossbowGuard.neutralize(true)

			activateObject(
				itemRoot,
				pickupPart
			)

			task.wait(.045)
		end

		if not itemRoot.Parent
			or isInsidePlayer(itemRoot) then

			burgerCache[itemRoot] = nil

			gui:SetAttribute(
				"DeadSpellsBurgerPickupSuccesses",
				(
					tonumber(
						gui:GetAttribute(
							"DeadSpellsBurgerPickupSuccesses"
						)
					) or 0
				)+1
			)

			setFarmStatus(
				"BURGER COLLECTED // NO DETOUR"
			)

			return true
		end

		local danger,dangerModel =
			dangerousNpcNear(
				record.part.Position,
