				DEAD_SPELLS_BURGER_DANGER_RADIUS
			)

		local rangedDanger,rangedModel =
			crossbowGuard.rangedNpcNear(
				record.part.Position,
				crossbowGuard.avoidRadius
			)

		-- Never fly down into a Burger if a crossbow/archer/ranged NPC is loaded
		-- anywhere around that item. Stay on the safe route instead.
		if rangedDanger then
			gui:SetAttribute(
				"DeadSpellsRangedBurgerSkips",
				(
					tonumber(
						gui:GetAttribute(
							"DeadSpellsRangedBurgerSkips"
						)
					) or 0
				)+1
			)

			setFarmStatus(
				"BURGER SKIPPED // CROSSBOW SHOOTER NEARBY"
					..(
						rangedModel
						and " // "..tostring(rangedModel.Name)
						or ""
					)
			)

			return false
		end

		if danger then
			gui:SetAttribute(
				"DeadSpellsBurgerDangerSkips",
				(
					tonumber(
						gui:GetAttribute(
							"DeadSpellsBurgerDangerSkips"
						)
					) or 0
				)+1
			)

			setFarmStatus(
				"BURGER SKIPPED // NPC/BOSS TOO CLOSE"
					..(
						dangerModel
						and " // "..tostring(dangerModel.Name)
						or ""
					)
			)

			return false
		end

		setFarmStatus(
			"BURGER FARM // SAFE HOVER TO "
				..tostring(record.label or "BURGER")
		)

		local reached =
			flyToBurger(
				itemRoot,
				record
			)

		if not reached
			or rejectNpcBurger(itemRoot)
			or not itemRoot.Parent then
			return false
		end

		pickupPart =
			partFor(itemRoot)
			or record.part

		for attempt = 1,6 do
			if not itemRoot.Parent
				or isInsidePlayer(itemRoot) then
				break
			end

			crossbowGuard.neutralize(true)

			setFarmStatus(
				"BURGER FARM // SAFE PICKUP "
					..tostring(attempt)
			)

			activateObject(
				itemRoot,
				pickupPart
			)

			task.wait(.05)
		end

		if not itemRoot.Parent
			or isInsidePlayer(itemRoot) then

			burgerCache[itemRoot] = nil

			gui:SetAttribute(
				"DeadSpellsBurgerPickupSuccesses",
				(
					tonumber(
						gui:GetAttribute(
							"DeadSpellsBurgerPickupSuccesses"
						)
					) or 0
				)+1
			)

			setFarmStatus("BURGER COLLECTED")
			return true
		end

		-- Re-check before the low-hover fallback because a shooter may have
		-- streamed in while the player was approaching.
		danger,dangerModel =
			dangerousNpcNear(
				pickupPart.Position,
				DEAD_SPELLS_BURGER_DANGER_RADIUS
			)

		rangedDanger,rangedModel =
			crossbowGuard.rangedNpcNear(
				pickupPart.Position,
				crossbowGuard.avoidRadius
			)

		if danger or rangedDanger then
			setFarmStatus(
				rangedDanger
					and "BURGER ABORTED // CROSSBOW DANGER"
					or "BURGER ABORTED // NPC DANGER"
			)

			return false
		end

		local ownRoot =
			rootPart()

		if ownRoot
			and pickupPart
			and pickupPart.Parent then

			local lowPosition =
				pickupPart.Position
				+Vector3.new(
					0,
					DEAD_SPELLS_BURGER_LOW_HOVER_HEIGHT,
					0
				)

			pcall(function()
				ownRoot.CFrame =
					worldUpCFrame(
						lowPosition,
						ownRoot.CFrame.LookVector
					)
				ownRoot.AssemblyLinearVelocity =
					Vector3.zero
				ownRoot.AssemblyAngularVelocity =
					Vector3.zero
			end)

			for _ = 1,5 do
				if not itemRoot.Parent
					or isInsidePlayer(itemRoot) then
					break
				end

				crossbowGuard.neutralize(true)

				activateObject(
					itemRoot,
					pickupPart
				)

				task.wait(.055)
			end
		end

		if not itemRoot.Parent
			or isInsidePlayer(itemRoot) then

			burgerCache[itemRoot] = nil

			gui:SetAttribute(
				"DeadSpellsBurgerPickupSuccesses",
				(
					tonumber(
						gui:GetAttribute(
							"DeadSpellsBurgerPickupSuccesses"
						)
					) or 0
				)+1
			)

			setFarmStatus("BURGER COLLECTED")
			return true
		end

		setFarmStatus(
			"BURGER FARM // PICKUP FAILED // RETURNING TO SAFE LINE"
		)

		return false
	end

	local function collectLoot(itemRoot,record)
		if not itemRoot
			or not record
			or not record.part
			or not record.part.Parent then
			return
		end

		record.lastAttempt = os.clock()
		record.attempts += 1

		local destination =
			resolveLootTarget()

		if not destination then
			setFarmStatus(
				"FARM LOOT // FINDING SELECTED TARGET"
			)

			destination =
				deepTrainTargetScan(
					lootTargetMode == "PART108"
				)
		end

		if not destination then
			setFarmStatus(
				"FARM LOOT // SELECTED TARGET NOT LOADED"
			)
			return
		end

		setFarmStatus(
			"FARM LOOT // "
				..tostring(record.label or record.rarity)
				.." // REMOTE GRAB + HIGH RAIN ON "
				..lootTargetMode
		)

		activateObject(
			itemRoot,
			record.part
		)

		task.wait(.04)

		local moved =
			rainLootOnTarget(
				itemRoot,
				record,
				destination
			)

		if moved then
			for _ = 1,3 do
				task.wait(.035)

				if itemRoot
					and itemRoot.Parent then
					rainLootOnTarget(
						itemRoot,
						record,
						destination
					)
				end
			end

			deliveredLoot[itemRoot] = true
			lootCache[itemRoot] = nil

			setFarmStatus(
				"LOOT RAIN // "
					..tostring(record.label or record.rarity)
					.." // "
					..lootTargetMode
			)
		else
			setFarmStatus(
				"FARM LOOT // ITEM MOVE FAILED // WILL RETRY"
			)
		end
	end

	--========================================================
	-- V113 STRAIGHT-LINE STREAMING ENGINE
	--========================================================
	local function lineRouteDirection(ownRoot)
		-- V117: lock the direction the PLAYER IS LOOKING on screen when the farm
		-- starts. Character facing can be unrelated to the mobile camera, and the
		-- V116 world-axis snap could send the route directly into a side area/boss.
		local source =
			(
				workspace.CurrentCamera
					and workspace.CurrentCamera.CFrame.LookVector
			)
			or (
				ownRoot
					and ownRoot.CFrame.LookVector
			)
			or Vector3.new(0,0,-1)

		local horizontal =
			Vector3.new(
				source.X,
				0,
				source.Z
			)

		if horizontal.Magnitude < .05 then
			horizontal =
				Vector3.new(0,0,-1)
		end

		return horizontal.Unit
	end

	local function lineCheckpointCf(
		startPosition,
		direction,
		progress
	)
		local position =
			startPosition
			+direction*progress

		return
			CFrame.new(
				position,
				position+direction
			)
	end

	local function lineWorldStillHere(position)
		local params =
			RaycastParams.new()

		params.FilterType =
			Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude

		local excluded = {}

		if player.Character then
			table.insert(
				excluded,
				player.Character
			)
		end

		params.FilterDescendantsInstances =
			excluded

		local ok,result =
			pcall(function()
				return workspace:Raycast(
					position+Vector3.new(0,350,0),
					Vector3.new(0,-1200,0),
					params
				)
			end)

		return ok and result ~= nil
	end

	local function lineMoveLockedCheckpoint(
		startPosition,
		direction,
		fromProgress,
		toProgress,
		speed,
		token
	)
		local ownRoot =
			rootPart()

		if not ownRoot
			or not ownRoot.Parent then
			return false
		end

		fromProgress =
			tonumber(fromProgress) or 0
		toProgress =
			tonumber(toProgress) or fromProgress
		speed =
			math.max(
				tonumber(speed) or 1,
				1
			)

		local distance =
			math.abs(
				toProgress-fromProgress
			)

		local duration =
			math.max(
				distance/speed,
				.001
			)

		local beganAt =
			os.clock()

		repeat
			if token ~= lineSweepToken
				or not lineSweepBusy
				or not gui.Parent
				or menuDeleted then
				return false
			end

			crossbowGuard.neutralize(false)

			ownRoot =
				rootPart()

			if not ownRoot
				or not ownRoot.Parent then
				return false
			end

			local alpha =
				math.clamp(
					(os.clock()-beganAt)/duration,
					0,
					1
				)

			local progress =
				fromProgress
				+(toProgress-fromProgress)*alpha

			-- V118 keeps every forward position projected from the original start
			-- plus the ONE camera direction captured when the farm began. Crossbow
			-- protection never changes X/Z, so the route itself stays straight.
			local position =
				startPosition
				+direction*progress

			ownRoot.CFrame =
				CFrame.new(
					position,
					position+direction
				)

			ownRoot.AssemblyLinearVelocity =
				Vector3.zero
			ownRoot.AssemblyAngularVelocity =
				Vector3.zero

			if alpha >= 1 then
				break
			end

			task.wait(.02)
		until false

		local finalPosition =
			startPosition
			+direction*toProgress

		ownRoot =
			rootPart()

		if ownRoot
			and ownRoot.Parent then

			ownRoot.CFrame =
				CFrame.new(
					finalPosition,
					finalPosition+direction
				)

			ownRoot.AssemblyLinearVelocity =
				Vector3.zero
			ownRoot.AssemblyAngularVelocity =
				Vector3.zero
		end

		gui:SetAttribute(
			"DeadSpellsLineCrossTrackDrift",
			0
		)

		return true
	end

	local function lineMovePlayer(
		targetCf,
		speed,
		token
	)
		local ownRoot =
			rootPart()

		if not ownRoot
			or not ownRoot.Parent then
			return false
		end

		local distance =
			(
				ownRoot.Position
				-targetCf.Position
			).Magnitude

		local duration =
			math.clamp(
				distance
					/math.max(
						tonumber(speed) or 1,
						1
					),
				.025,
				12
			)

		local tween =
			TweenService:Create(
				ownRoot,
				TweenInfo.new(
					duration,
					Enum.EasingStyle.Linear,
					Enum.EasingDirection.Out
				),
				{
					CFrame = targetCf
				}
			)

		local finished = false

		local connection =
			tween.Completed:Connect(function()
				finished = true
			end)

		tween:Play()

		while not finished
			and gui.Parent
			and not menuDeleted do

			if token ~= lineSweepToken
				or not lineSweepBusy then

				pcall(function()
					tween:Cancel()
				end)
				break
			end

			if not rootPart() then
				pcall(function()
					tween:Cancel()
				end)
				break
			end

			pcall(function()
				local currentRoot =
					rootPart()

				if currentRoot then
					currentRoot.AssemblyLinearVelocity =
						Vector3.zero
					currentRoot.AssemblyAngularVelocity =
						Vector3.zero
				end
			end)

			task.wait(.03)
		end

		if connection then
			connection:Disconnect()
		end

		if token ~= lineSweepToken
			or not lineSweepBusy then
			return false
		end

		pcall(function()
			local currentRoot =
				rootPart()

			if currentRoot then
				currentRoot.CFrame =
					targetCf
				currentRoot.AssemblyLinearVelocity =
					Vector3.zero
				currentRoot.AssemblyAngularVelocity =
					Vector3.zero
			end
		end)

		return true
	end

	local function lineSavedTrainCf()
		local destination =
			resolveLootTarget()

		if not destination
			or not destination.Parent then

			destination =
				deepTrainTargetScan(
					lootTargetMode == "PART108"
				)
		end

		if destination
			and destination.Parent
			and destination:IsA("BasePart") then

			return destination.CFrame
		end

		return nil
	end

	local function lineDepositLoot(
		itemRoot,
		record,
		trainCf
	)
		if not itemRoot
			or not itemRoot.Parent
			or not record
			or not record.part
			or not record.part.Parent
			or not trainCf then
			return false
		end

		lineLootDeposited += 1

		local slot =
			lineLootDeposited

		local x =
			((slot-1)%5-2)*2.7
		local z =
			(math.floor((slot-1)/5)%5-2)*2.7

		-- V115: world-space offsets prevent a rotated/tilted train part from
		-- turning "up" into sideways and dropping loot on the wrong side.
		local dropPosition =
			trainCf.Position
			+Vector3.new(
				x,
				DEAD_SPELLS_LINE_TRAIN_HEIGHT,
				z
			)

		local dropCf =
			worldUpCFrame(
				dropPosition,
				trainCf.LookVector
			)

		local moved =
			setItemCFrame(
				itemRoot,
				record,
				dropCf,
				Vector3.zero
			)

		if moved then
			-- A few tight pulses help keep client-owned physics at the saved train
			-- position while the player continues the streaming line.
			for _ = 1,2 do
				task.wait(.03)

				if itemRoot
					and itemRoot.Parent then

					setItemCFrame(
						itemRoot,
						record,
						dropCf,
						Vector3.zero
					)
				end
			end

			deliveredLoot[itemRoot] = true
			lootCache[itemRoot] = nil

			gui:SetAttribute(
				"DeadSpellsLineLootDeposited",
				lineLootDeposited
			)

			setFarmStatus(
				"LOOT LINE // "
					..tostring(
						record.label
						or record.rarity
						or "ITEM"
					)
					.." -> TRAIN"
			)

			return true
		end

		lineLootDeposited -= 1

		return false
	end

	local function lineProcessLoadedLoot(trainCf)
		if not lootEnabled
			or not trainCf then
			return 0
		end

		-- The player's physical route makes new chunks replicate. This direct
		-- lookup only checks what is loaded now; it does not pretend to see the
		-- rest of the server.
		directFindLootNow(false)

		local pending = {}

		for itemRoot,record in pairs(lootCache) do
			if itemRoot
				and itemRoot.Parent
				and record
				and record.part
				and record.part.Parent
				and not deliveredLoot[itemRoot] then

				table.insert(
					pending,
					{
						itemRoot,
						record
					}
				)
			end
		end

		local moved = 0

		for index = 1,math.min(#pending,12) do
			local pair =
				pending[index]

			if lineDepositLoot(
				pair[1],
				pair[2],
				trainCf
			) then
				moved += 1
			end
		end

		return moved
	end

	local function refreshNearbyBurgerCache()
		local ownRoot =
			rootPart()

		if not ownRoot then
			return 0
		end

		local overlap =
			OverlapParams.new()

		overlap.FilterType =
			Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude

		local excluded = {}

		if player.Character then
			table.insert(
				excluded,
				player.Character
			)
		end

		overlap.FilterDescendantsInstances =
			excluded
		overlap.MaxParts = 1200

		local ok,parts =
			pcall(function()
				return workspace:GetPartBoundsInRadius(
					ownRoot.Position,
					DEAD_SPELLS_BURGER_NEARBY_SCAN_RADIUS,
					overlap
				)
			end)

		if not ok or not parts then
			return 0
		end

		local found = 0
		local seen = {}

		for _,part in ipairs(parts) do
			local candidate = part

			for _ = 1,3 do
				if not candidate
					or candidate == workspace then
					break
				end

				if not seen[candidate] then
					seen[candidate] = true

					if cacheBurger(candidate) then
						found += 1
					end
				end

				candidate =
					candidate.Parent
			end
		end

		return found
	end

	local function lineProcessBurgers(
		checkpointCf,
		token
	)
		if not burgerEnabled then
			return 0
		end

		local collected = 0

		refreshNearbyBurgerCache()

		for _ = 1,5 do
			if token ~= lineSweepToken
				or not lineSweepBusy
				or not burgerEnabled then
				break
			end

			local burgerRoot,burgerRecord =
				nearestBurger()

			if not burgerRoot
				or not burgerRecord
				or not burgerRecord.part
				or not burgerRecord.part.Parent then
				break
			end

			local ownRoot =
				rootPart()

			if not ownRoot then
				break
			end

			local distance =
				(
					ownRoot.Position
					-burgerRecord.part.Position
				).Magnitude

			-- Only cut off the straight route for Burgers that became visible
			-- around the current streamed chunk.
			if distance
				> DEAD_SPELLS_LINE_BURGER_RANGE then
				break
			end

			local wasInPlayer =
				isInsidePlayer(burgerRoot)

			local pickupSuccess =
				collectBurger(
					burgerRoot,
					burgerRecord
				)

			if token ~= lineSweepToken
				or not lineSweepBusy then
				break
			end

			if pickupSuccess
				or not burgerRoot.Parent
				or (
					not wasInPlayer
					and isInsidePlayer(burgerRoot)
				) then

				collected += 1
				lineBurgersCollected += 1

				gui:SetAttribute(
					"DeadSpellsLineBurgersCollected",
					lineBurgersCollected
				)
			end

			-- Go back to the exact point on the locked straight line and continue
			-- from there. This is the "cut route -> Burger -> back to line" behavior.
			lineMovePlayer(
				checkpointCf,
				DEAD_SPELLS_LINE_DEVIATION_RETURN_SPEED,
				token
			)

			task.wait(.04)
		end

		return collected
	end

	local function finishLineSweep(
		token,
		routeHadBurger,
		routeHadLoot,
		completed,
		trainCf,
		startCf
	)
		if token ~= lineSweepToken then
			return
		end

		if routeHadLoot then
			local returnCf = nil

			if trainCf then
				local returnPosition =
					trainCf.Position
					+Vector3.new(0,12,0)

				returnCf =
					worldUpCFrame(
						returnPosition,
						lineSweepDirection
							or trainCf.LookVector
					)
			else
				returnCf = startCf
			end

			if returnCf then
				setFarmStatus(
					"LOOT LINE // RETURNING TO TRAIN"
				)

				lineMovePlayer(
					returnCf,
					DEAD_SPELLS_LINE_RETURN_SPEED,
					token
				)
			end
		end

		if routeHadBurger then
			burgerEnabled = false
			gui:SetAttribute(
				"DeadSpellsBurgerFarm",
				false
			)
		end

		if routeHadLoot then
			lootEnabled = false
			gui:SetAttribute(
				"DeadSpellsFarmLoot",
				false
			)
		end

		lineSweepBusy = false

		gui:SetAttribute(
			"DeadSpellsLineSweepBusy",
			false
		)
		gui:SetAttribute(
			"DeadSpellsLineSweepMode",
			"NONE"
		)

		updateButtons()

		if routeHadLoot and completed then
			setFarmStatus("RAIN DONE")
		elseif routeHadBurger and completed then
			setFarmStatus("BURGER LINE DONE")
		elseif not completed then
			setFarmStatus("LINE SWEEP STOPPED")
		end
	end

	local function runStraightLineSweep(sourceMode)
		if lineSweepBusy then
			setFarmStatus(
				"LINE SWEEP // ALREADY RUNNING // NEW FARM JOINED"
			)
			return
		end

		local ownRoot =
			rootPart()
		local human =
			humanoidNow()
		local char =
			player.Character

		if not ownRoot
			or not human
			or not char then

			setFarmStatus(
				"LINE SWEEP // CHARACTER NOT READY"
			)
			return
		end

		lineSweepBusy = true
		lineSweepToken += 1

		local token =
			lineSweepToken

		lineSweepProgress = 0
		lineBurgersCollected = 0
		lineLootDeposited = 0

		gui:SetAttribute(
			"DeadSpellsLineSweepBusy",
			true
		)
		gui:SetAttribute(
			"DeadSpellsLineSweepMode",
			tostring(sourceMode or "AUTO")
		)
		gui:SetAttribute(
			"DeadSpellsLineSweepProgress",
			0
		)
		gui:SetAttribute(
			"DeadSpellsLineBurgersCollected",
			0
		)
		gui:SetAttribute(
			"DeadSpellsLineLootDeposited",
			0
		)

		local direction =
			lineRouteDirection(ownRoot)

		local startCf =
			ownRoot.CFrame

		-- V117: lift vertically first, then keep one constant safe Y for the
		-- entire forward route. X/Z are unchanged during the lift.
		local startPosition =
			ownRoot.Position
			+Vector3.new(
				0,
				DEAD_SPELLS_LINE_ALTITUDE,
				0
			)

		lineSweepStartCf =
			startCf
		lineSweepDirection =
			direction

		-- Snapshot the train while the player is still next to it. Even if the
		-- train later streams out, its CFrame is enough to place found loot there
		-- and fly the player back when the line is finished.
		local trainCf =
			lineSavedTrainCf()

		lineSweepTrainCf =
			trainCf

		local routeHadBurger =
			burgerEnabled == true
		local routeHadLoot =
			lootEnabled == true

		local oldAutoRotate =
			human.AutoRotate

		local collisionState = {}

		for _,object in ipairs(
			char:GetDescendants()
		) do
			if object:IsA("BasePart") then
				collisionState[object] =
					object.CanCollide
				object.CanCollide = false
			end
		end

		human.AutoRotate = false

		local completed = false
		local voidMisses = 0

		local lineStartCf =
			lineCheckpointCf(
				startPosition,
				direction,
				0
			)

		setFarmStatus(
			"LINE SWEEP // 220 HIGH // CAMERA LINE // CROSSBOW PROTECTION"
		)

		if lineMovePlayer(
			lineStartCf,
			1800,
			token
		) then

			while lineSweepProgress
					< DEAD_SPELLS_LINE_MAX_DISTANCE
				and token == lineSweepToken
				and lineSweepBusy
				and (
					burgerEnabled
					or lootEnabled
				)
				and gui.Parent
				and not menuDeleted do

				local nextProgress =
					math.min(
						lineSweepProgress
							+DEAD_SPELLS_LINE_STEP,
						DEAD_SPELLS_LINE_MAX_DISTANCE
					)

				local checkpointCf =
					lineCheckpointCf(
						startPosition,
						direction,
						nextProgress
					)

				if not lineMoveLockedCheckpoint(
					startPosition,
					direction,
					lineSweepProgress,
					nextProgress,
					DEAD_SPELLS_LINE_SPEED,
					token
					) then
					break
				end

				lineSweepProgress =
					nextProgress

				gui:SetAttribute(
					"DeadSpellsLineSweepProgress",
					lineSweepProgress
				)

				task.wait(
					DEAD_SPELLS_LINE_SETTLE
				)

				-- Newly streamed Burgers temporarily cut away from the straight
				-- route, get picked up, then the player snaps back to this exact
				-- checkpoint and continues forward.
				if burgerEnabled then
					lineProcessBurgers(
						checkpointCf,
						token
					)
				end

				-- Newly streamed target loot never drags the player away. The item
				-- itself is placed on the saved train CFrame and the route continues.
				if lootEnabled then
					lineProcessLoadedLoot(
						trainCf
					)
				end

				if lineWorldStillHere(
					checkpointCf.Position
					) then

					voidMisses = 0
				else
					voidMisses += 1
				end

				local percentage =
					math.floor(
						lineSweepProgress
							/DEAD_SPELLS_LINE_MAX_DISTANCE
							*100
					)

				if farmCounts
					and farmCounts.Parent then

					farmCounts.Text =
						"BURGERS: "
						..tostring(
							gui:GetAttribute(
								"DeadSpellsBurgersCached"
							) or 0
						)
						.."  •  LOOT: "
						..tostring(
							gui:GetAttribute(
								"DeadSpellsLootCached"
							) or 0
						)
						.."  •  LINE: "
						..tostring(percentage)
						.."%  •  TARGET: "
						..lootTargetMode
				end

				if lineSweepProgress
						>= DEAD_SPELLS_LINE_MIN_END_DISTANCE
					and voidMisses
						>= DEAD_SPELLS_LINE_VOID_MISSES then

					completed = true
					break
				end
			end

			if lineSweepProgress
				>= DEAD_SPELLS_LINE_MAX_DISTANCE then

				completed = true
			end
		end

		if human
			and human.Parent then

			human.AutoRotate =
				oldAutoRotate
		end

		for object,oldCanCollide
			in pairs(collisionState) do

			if object
				and object.Parent then

				object.CanCollide =
					oldCanCollide
			end
		end

		if token == lineSweepToken then
			finishLineSweep(
				token,
				routeHadBurger,
				routeHadLoot,
				completed,
				trainCf,
				startCf
			)
		end
	end

	local function startStraightLineSweep(sourceMode)
		if lineSweepBusy then
			setFarmStatus(
				"LINE SWEEP // FARM JOINED CURRENT ROUTE"
			)
			return
		end

		task.spawn(function()
			runStraightLineSweep(
				sourceMode
			)
		end)
	end

	local function queueFunction()
		local result = nil

		pcall(function()
			if type(getgenv) == "function" then
				local env = getgenv()
				result =
					env.queue_on_teleport
					or env.queueonteleport
			end
		end)

		if type(result) ~= "function" then
			pcall(function()
				if syn
					and type(syn.queue_on_teleport) == "function" then
					result = syn.queue_on_teleport
				end
			end)
		end

		if type(result) ~= "function" then
			if type(queue_on_teleport) == "function" then
				result = queue_on_teleport
			elseif type(queueonteleport) == "function" then
				result = queueonteleport
			end
		end

		return result
	end

	local function queueUltraResume()
		local queue = queueFunction()
		if type(queue) ~= "function" then
			return false
		end

		local code =
			string.format(
				"_G.NotRubyDeadSpellsUltraResume=true\n"
				.."_G.NotRubyDeadSpellsLoaderUrl=%q\n"
				.."loadstring(game:HttpGet(_G.NotRubyDeadSpellsLoaderUrl))()",
				SELF_URL
			)

		return pcall(queue,code)
	end

	local function chooseFreshServer()
		local ok,result = pcall(function()
			local url =
				"https://games.roblox.com/v1/games/"
				..tostring(game.PlaceId)
				.."/servers/Public?sortOrder=Asc&limit=100"

			local body = game:HttpGet(url)
			local decoded =
				HttpService:JSONDecode(body)

			local available = {}

			for _,server in ipairs(
				decoded.data or {}
			) do
				local id = tostring(server.id or "")
				local playing =
					tonumber(server.playing) or math.huge
				local maxPlayers =
					tonumber(server.maxPlayers) or 0

				if id ~= ""
					and id ~= tostring(game.JobId)
					and playing < maxPlayers then
					table.insert(available,id)
				end
			end

			if #available == 0 then
				return nil
			end

			return
				available[
					math.random(1,#available)
				]
		end)

		return ok and result or nil
	end

	local function hopForUltra()
		if serverHopBusy
			or not ultraEnabled
			or stopped then
			return
		end

		serverHopBusy = true
		gui:SetAttribute(
			"DeadSpellsServerHopBusy",
			true
		)

		setFarmStatus(
			"ULTRA BURGER FARM // SERVER COMPLETE // HOPPING"
		)

		local queued = queueUltraResume()
		if not queued then
			setFarmStatus(
				"ULTRA FARM // AUTO-LOAD QUEUE UNSUPPORTED // HOPPING ONCE"
			)
		end

		task.wait(.45)

		local serverId = chooseFreshServer()
		local ok = pcall(function()
			if serverId then
				TeleportService:TeleportToPlaceInstance(
					game.PlaceId,
					serverId,
					player
				)
			else
				TeleportService:Teleport(
					game.PlaceId,
					player
				)
			end
		end)

		if not ok then
			serverHopBusy = false
			gui:SetAttribute(
				"DeadSpellsServerHopBusy",
				false
			)
			setFarmStatus(
				"ULTRA BURGER FARM // SERVER HOP FAILED"
			)
		end
	end

	local function setBurgerFarm(value,fromUltra)
		value = value == true

		if stopped and value then
			stopped = false
		end

		burgerEnabled = value

		gui:SetAttribute(
			"DeadSpellsBurgerFarm",
			value
		)

		if value then
			lastBurgerSeenAt = os.clock()
			burgerInitialScanDone = true

			setFarmStatus(
				fromUltra
					and "ULTRA BURGER // STRAIGHT LINE STREAMING"
					or "BURGER FARM // STRAIGHT LINE STREAMING"
			)

			startStraightLineSweep(
				"BURGER"
			)
		else
			burgerScanToken += 1

			if not lootEnabled then
				lineSweepToken += 1
				lineSweepBusy = false

				gui:SetAttribute(
					"DeadSpellsLineSweepBusy",
					false
				)
			end

			if not ultraEnabled then
				setFarmStatus(
					"BURGER FARM STOPPED"
				)
			end
		end

		updateButtons()
	end

	local function setUltra(value)
		value = value == true

		if stopped and value then
			stopped = false
		end

		ultraEnabled = value
		gui:SetAttribute(
			"DeadSpellsUltraBurgerFarm",
			value
		)

		if value then
			ultraOwnsBurger = not burgerEnabled

			if not burgerEnabled then
				setBurgerFarm(true,true)
			end

			setFarmStatus(
				"ULTRA BURGER FARM // AUTO SERVER LOOP ON"
			)
		else
			serverHopBusy = false
			gui:SetAttribute(
				"DeadSpellsServerHopBusy",
				false
			)

			if ultraOwnsBurger and burgerEnabled then
				setBurgerFarm(false,true)
			end

			ultraOwnsBurger = false
			setFarmStatus(
				"ULTRA BURGER FARM STOPPED"
			)
		end

		updateButtons()
	end

	local function setLootFarm(value)
		value = value == true

		if stopped and value then
			stopped = false
		end

		lootEnabled = value

		gui:SetAttribute(
			"DeadSpellsFarmLoot",
			value
		)

		if value then
			lastLootSeenAt = os.clock()
			lootInitialScanDone = true

			setFarmStatus(
				"LOOT LINE // STRAIGHT STREAMING ROUTE"
			)

			startStraightLineSweep(
				"LOOT"
			)
		else
			lootScanToken += 1

			if not burgerEnabled then
				lineSweepToken += 1
				lineSweepBusy = false

				gui:SetAttribute(
					"DeadSpellsLineSweepBusy",
					false
				)
			end

			setFarmStatus(
				"LOOT LINE STOPPED"
			)
		end

		updateButtons()
	end

	local function stopAllFarms()
		stopped = true
		serverHopBusy = false
		farScoutToken += 1
		farScoutBusy = false
		farScoutQueued = false
		lineSweepToken += 1
		lineSweepBusy = false

		gui:SetAttribute(
			"DeadSpellsLineSweepBusy",
			false
		)
		gui:SetAttribute(
			"DeadSpellsLineSweepMode",
			"NONE"
		)

		ultraEnabled = false
		burgerEnabled = false
		lootEnabled = false
		ultraOwnsBurger = false
		actionBusy = false

		burgerScanToken += 1
		lootScanToken += 1

		gui:SetAttribute(
			"DeadSpellsBurgerFarm",
			false
		)
		gui:SetAttribute(
			"DeadSpellsUltraBurgerFarm",
			false
		)
		gui:SetAttribute(
			"DeadSpellsFarmLoot",
			false
		)
		gui:SetAttribute(
			"DeadSpellsFarmBusy",
			false
		)
		gui:SetAttribute(
			"DeadSpellsServerHopBusy",
			false
		)
		gui:SetAttribute(
			"DeadSpellsScanBusy",
			false
		)
		gui:SetAttribute(
			"DeadSpellsTrainTargetScanBusy",
			false
		)
		gui:SetAttribute(
			"DeadSpellsFarScoutBusy",
			false
		)

		setFarmStatus("DEAD SPELLS // ALL FARMS STOPPED")
		updateButtons()
	end

	burgerFarmButton.Activated:Connect(function()
		setBurgerFarm(not burgerEnabled,false)
	end)

	ultraBurgerButton.Activated:Connect(function()
		setUltra(not ultraEnabled)
	end)

	farmLootButton.Activated:Connect(function()
		setLootFarm(not lootEnabled)
	end)

	lootTargetButton.Activated:Connect(function()
		lootTargetMode =
			lootTargetMode == "PART108"
				and "TRAIN AUTO"
				or "PART108"

		destinationCache = nil

		gui:SetAttribute(
			"DeadSpellsLootTarget",
			lootTargetMode
		)

		task.spawn(function()
			local target = resolveLootTarget()

			if target then
				setFarmStatus(
					"LOOT TARGET // "
						..lootTargetMode
						.." // "
						..target:GetFullName()
				)
			else
				setFarmStatus(
					"LOOT TARGET // "
						..lootTargetMode
						.." // NOT FOUND YET // REFINDING WHEN TRAIN LOADS"
				)
			end
		end)

		updateButtons()
	end)

	farDetectionButton.Activated:Connect(function()
		farDetectionEnabled =
			not farDetectionEnabled

		gui:SetAttribute(
			"DeadSpellsFarDetection",
			farDetectionEnabled
		)

		if not farDetectionEnabled then
			farScoutToken += 1
			farScoutBusy = false
			farScoutQueued = false
			gui:SetAttribute(
				"DeadSpellsFarScoutBusy",
				false
			)
			setFarmStatus("FAR DETECTION OFF")
		else
			farScoutCycleComplete = false
			setFarmStatus(
				"FAR DETECTION ON // OPTIONAL // LINE SWEEP IS PRIMARY"
			)

			if burgerEnabled
				or ultraEnabled
				or lootEnabled then
				task.spawn(function()
					runFarDetectionScout("MANUAL_ON")
				end)
			end
		end

		updateButtons()
	end)

	scoutNowButton.Activated:Connect(function()
		if not farDetectionEnabled then
			farDetectionEnabled = true
			gui:SetAttribute(
				"DeadSpellsFarDetection",
				true
			)
			updateButtons()
		end

		farScoutCycleComplete = false

		task.spawn(function()
			if lootEnabled then
				local itemRoot,record =
					directFindLootNow(true)

				if itemRoot and record then
					setFarmStatus(
						"DIRECT LOOT FIND // "
							..tostring(
								record.label
								or record.rarity
								or "FOUND"
							)
					)
				else
					setFarmStatus(
						"DIRECT LOOT FIND // NOT CLIENT-VISIBLE"
					)
				end
			else
				runFarDetectionScout("MANUAL_SCOUT")
			end
		end)
	end)

	refindTrainButton.Activated:Connect(function()
		destinationCache = nil
		table.clear(trainTargetCache)

		setFarmStatus(
			"REFIND TRAIN / PART108 // DEEP WORKSPACE SCAN"
		)

		task.spawn(function()
			local target =
				deepTrainTargetScan(
					lootTargetMode == "PART108"
				)

			if target then
				setFarmStatus(
					"TRAIN TARGET FOUND // "
						..target:GetFullName()
				)
			else
				setFarmStatus(
					"TRAIN / PART108 NOT LOADED YET // AUTO WATCHING"
				)
			end
		end)
	end)

	teleportPart108Button.Activated:Connect(function()
		task.spawn(function()
			teleportAbovePart108()
		end)
	end)

	burgerSearchInfoButton.Activated:Connect(function()
		setFarmStatus(
			"BURGER TARGETS // BURGER // GOLDEN BURGER // NPC BURGERS IGNORED"
		)
	end)

	namedLootInfoButton.Activated:Connect(function()
		setFarmStatus(
			"LOOT TARGETS // REAPER'S SCYTHE // KATANA // RAY GUN // METEOR TOME // DINGUS // DRAGON'S CLAW // DRAGON'S FOOT"
		)
	end)

	lootRainInfoButton.Activated:Connect(function()
		setFarmStatus(
			"LOOT LINE // FLY STRAIGHT // DROP FOUND LOOT TO TRAIN // RETURN TO TRAIN // RAIN DONE"
		)
	end)

	scanRangeButton.Activated:Connect(function()
		setFarmStatus(
			"LINE SWEEP // CAMERA-LOCKED // 220 STUDS HIGH // CROSSBOW + BOSS SAFE"
		)
	end)

	forceRescanButton.Activated:Connect(function()
		stopped = false

		if not burgerEnabled
			and not lootEnabled then

			setFarmStatus(
				"RESTART LINE // TURN ON BURGER OR LOOT FARM FIRST"
			)
			return
		end

		lineSweepToken += 1
		lineSweepBusy = false

		gui:SetAttribute(
			"DeadSpellsLineSweepBusy",
			false
		)

		task.delay(.12,function()
			if burgerEnabled
				or lootEnabled then

				startStraightLineSweep(
					lootEnabled
						and "LOOT"
						or "BURGER"
				)
			end
		end)

		setFarmStatus(
			"RESTARTING STRAIGHT LINE FROM CURRENT POSITION"
		)
	end)

	stopAllButton.Activated:Connect(
		stopAllFarms
	)

	workspace.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(object)
		if not object or not object.Parent then
			return
		end

		-- V111: keep Burger / Golden Burger cache hot event-by-event, even while
		-- the farm toggle is OFF. That way pressing Burger Farm can fly instantly.
		task.defer(function()
			if object
				and object.Parent then

				local c =
					compact(object.Name)

				if string.find(c,"burger",1,true)
					or string.find(c,"hamburger",1,true)
					or string.find(c,"cheeseburger",1,true) then

					cacheBurger(object)
				end
			end
		end)

		-- V112: named loot is cached immediately when the server finally
		-- replicates it to this client, even if Farm Loot was OFF at that moment.
		task.defer(function()
			if object
				and object.Parent
				and wantedLootName(object.Name) then

				cacheLoot(object)
			end
		end)

		-- V102: train targets can stream in AFTER the menu loads. Cache them even
		-- while farms are OFF so Farm Loot can immediately resolve the train later.
		task.defer(function()
			if object and object.Parent then
				if object:IsA("BasePart")
					or trainWord(object.Name)
					or isPart108Name(object.Name) then

					if rememberTrainCandidate(object) then
						local preferPart108 =
							lootTargetMode == "PART108"
						local best,kind =
							bestCachedTrainTarget(
								preferPart108
							)

						if best then
							publishTrainTarget(
								best,
								kind
							)
						end
					end
				end

				if not stopped
					and (
						burgerEnabled
						or ultraEnabled
						or lootEnabled
					) then

					inspectFarmObject(object)

					local itemRoot =
						canonicalItemRoot(object)

					if itemRoot
						and (
							burgerCache[itemRoot]
							or lootCache[itemRoot]
						) then
						farScoutCycleComplete = true
					end
				end
			end
		end)
	end)

	-- V113: the straight-line sweep owns character movement. The scheduler only
	-- starts a missing route or lets Ultra Burger continue to its server hop.
	task.spawn(function()
		while gui.Parent
			and not menuDeleted do

			pruneCaches()

			if stopped then
				task.wait(.20)
				continue
			end

			if lineSweepBusy then
				task.wait(.08)
				continue
			end

			if ultraEnabled
				and not burgerEnabled then

				task.spawn(
					hopForUltra
				)

				task.wait(.45)
				continue
			end

			if burgerEnabled
				or lootEnabled then

				startStraightLineSweep(
					lootEnabled
						and "LOOT"
						or "BURGER"
				)
			end

			task.wait(.20)
		end
	end)

	runtimeCore.stopEvent.Event:Connect(function()
		stopAllFarms()
	end)

	gui.Destroying:Connect(function()
		stopped = true
		burgerEnabled = false
		ultraEnabled = false
		lootEnabled = false
		burgerScanToken += 1
		lootScanToken += 1
		farScoutToken += 1
		farScoutBusy = false
		lineSweepToken += 1
		lineSweepBusy = false
	end)

	updateButtons()
	pruneCaches()

	-- Ultra Farm continuation after a queued teleport.
	if rawget(_G,"NotRubyDeadSpellsUltraResume") == true then
		_G.NotRubyDeadSpellsUltraResume = nil

		task.delay(2.25,function()
			if gui.Parent
				and not menuDeleted then
				setUltra(true)
			end
		end)
	end
end)()

-- REMADE SECURITY NOTE
-- The main menu is universal. Aim Assist, Aimbot, Auto Shoot, Auto Dodge,
-- Fling and Other Hubs remain disabled unless this exact game.PlaceId matches
-- SHOOTER_ALLOWED_PLACE_ID. The remake does not bypass or weaken this gate.
-- SHOOTER SECURITY // ABSOLUTE BOTTOM
-- AIM ASSIST + AIMBOT + AUTO SHOOT + AUTO DODGE + FLING + OTHER HUBS PLACEID LOCK
--
-- Replace ONLY "placeid" with your numeric Roblox PlaceId.
-- Example:
-- local SHOOTER_ALLOWED_PLACE_ID = tonumber("1234567890")
--============================================================


-- Replace 0 with your actual starting place ID if you want restriction, 
-- or leave the logic open to match any game by using Option 1 below.
local ALLOWED_GAMES_LIST = {
	game.PlaceId, -- This dynamically adds the current place so it always matches
}

local function shooterSecurityAllowed()
	-- Loop through the allowed list
	for _, allowedId in ipairs(ALLOWED_GAMES_LIST) do
		-- FIXED: Case-sensitive capitalization changed to game.PlaceId
		if game.PlaceId == allowedId then
			return true 
		end
	end
	return false 
end

print("CURRENT PLACE ID:", game.PlaceId)
print("SECURITY ALLOWED:", shooterSecurityAllowed())

setupShooterGamesTab(shooterSecurityAllowed)


-- END // NOT RUBY V1 DRAGON REMAKE
